Quote: Real art is basic emotion. If a scene is handled with simplicity - and I don't mean simple - it'll be good, and the public will know it.
Author: John Wayne

Quote: The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more, that plants a fire in our hearts and brings peace to our minds. And that's what you've given me. That's what I'd hoped to give you forever
Author: Nicholas Sparks

Quote: The best love is the kind that awakens the soul and makes us reach for more, that plants a fire in our hearts and brings peace to our minds. And that's what you've given me. That's what I'd hoped to give you forever
Author: Nicholas Sparks

Quote: Once upon a time there was a boy who loved a girl, and her laughter was a question he wanted to spend his whole life answering.
Author: Nicole Krauss,  The History of Love

Quote: Success seems to be connected with action. Successful people keep moving. They make mistakes, but they don't quit.
Author: Conrad Hilton

Quote: But Hopes are Shy Birds flying at a great distance seldom reached by the best of Guns.
Author: John James Audubon

Quote: Every black film feels like it's Tyler Perry, and that just needs to stop. But people seem to slowly be looking for what else is out there - 'Is there something else besides this type of humor?' 'I'm tired of seeing men in dresses.'
Author: Issa Rae

Quote: The care of human life and happiness, and not their destruction, is the first and only object of good government.
Author: Thomas Jefferson

Quote: If you are lucky enough to find a way of life you love, you have to find the courage to live it.
Author: John Irving

Quote: If you are lucky enough to find a way of life you love, you have to find the courage to live it.
Author: John Irving

Quote: There's design, and there's art. Good design is total harmony. There's no better designer than nature - if you look at a branch or a leaf, it's perfect. It's all function. Art is different. It's about emotion. It's about suffering and beauty - but mostly suffering!
Author: Diane von Furstenberg

Quote: An artist cannot fail; it is a success to be one.
Author: Charles Horton Cooley

Quote: An artist cannot fail; it is a success to be one.
Author: Charles Horton Cooley

Quote: Lord save us all from old age and broken health and a hope tree that has lost the faculty of putting out blossoms.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Be fun! I don't like homes or rooms that don't have a sense of humor or have some sense of whimsy or a personality. Your home should reflect who you are, and what you love. I would never have something in my home because it's the thing to have. I have to love it and it needs some connection to me.
Author: Bryan Batt

Quote: With me, what you see is what you get. Yes, call me naive, but I love life. I am happy, and for that, I make no apologies. I do like to see the best in people, and when someone is nice to my face, I tend to believe them.
Author: Joyce Giraud

Quote: With me, what you see is what you get. Yes, call me naive, but I love life. I am happy, and for that, I make no apologies. I do like to see the best in people, and when someone is nice to my face, I tend to believe them.
Author: Joyce Giraud

Quote: I love pointy nails! A cute way to add a pop of color to your nails is to make a V-shape at the ends of them in a pastel color.
Author: Bella Thorne

Quote: Performance has to be mainstream art. This is what I'm fighting for.
Author: Marina Abramovic

Quote: Going to church doesn’t make you a Christian any more than going to a garage makes you an automobile.
Author: Billy Sunday,  Billy Sunday, the Man and His Message: With His Own Words Which Have Won Thousands for Christ

Quote: Going to church doesn’t make you a Christian any more than going to a garage makes you an automobile.
Author: Billy Sunday,  Billy Sunday, the Man and His Message: With His Own Words Which Have Won Thousands for Christ

Quote: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art.... It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things which give value to survival.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

Quote: A good friend will always stab you in the front.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Fear can be good when you're walking past an alley at night or when you need to check the locks on your doors before you go to bed, but it's not good when you have a goal and you're fearful of obstacles. We often get trapped by our fears, but anyone who has had success has failed before.
Author: Queen Latifah

Quote: God grant me the courage not to give up what I think is right even though I think it is hopeless.
Author: Chester W. Nimitz

Quote: People in Russia adapt to misery by a deep, deep humor.
Author: Ian Frazier

Quote: I always say that the times in my life when I've been happiest are the times when I've seen, like, a sunset.
Author: Chris Evans

Quote: Perhaps it's good for one to suffer. Can an artist do anything if he's happy? Would he ever want to do anything? What is art, after all, but a protest against the horrible inclemency of life?
Author: Aldous Huxley

Author: Henri Frederic Amiel

Author: Henri Frederic Amiel

Author: Damien Chazelle

Quote: Let every man feel that he is the architect and builder of his own life, and that he proposes to make a success of it by working.
Author: Heber J. Grant

Quote: If the skies fall, one may hope to catch larks.
Author: Francois Rabelais

Quote: Brits have a better sense of humor in most ways. It's darker, more cutting.
Author: Stephan Pastis

Quote: I'll tell you, in my life I've never once have seen a Hispanic panhandler, because in our community, it would be viewed as shameful to be out on the street begging. Those are all conservative values - faith, family, hard work, responsibility.
Author: Ted Cruz

Quote: I love the man that can smile in trouble, that can gather strength from distress, and grow brave by reflection. 'Tis the business of little minds to shrink, but he whose heart is firm, and whose conscience approves his conduct, will pursue his principles unto death.
Author: Thomas Paine

Quote: I think we're much smarter than we were. Everybody knows that abstract art can be art, and most people know that they may not like it, even if they understand there's another purpose to it.
Author: Roy Lichtenstein

Quote: All the world is made of faith, and trust, and pixie dust.
Author: J.M. Barrie,  Peter Pan

Author: J.M. Barrie,  Peter Pan

Quote: This is a good sign, having a broken heart. It means we have tried for something.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: Before anything else, preparation is the key to success.
Author: Alexander Graham Bell

Quote: Hope, like faith, is nothing if it is not courageous; it is nothing if it is not ridiculous.
Author: Thornton Wilder

Quote: Humor reminds you, when you're flattened by sorrow, that you're still human.
Author: Elizabeth McCracken

Quote: The world has never yet seen a truly great and virtuous nation because in the degradation of woman the very fountains of life are poisoned at their source.
Author: Lucretia Mott

Quote: It is necessary to fall in love... if only to provide an alibi for all the random despair you are going to feel anyway.
Author: Albert Camus

Quote: In life, as in art, the beautiful moves in curves.
Author: Edward G. Bulwer-Lytton

Quote: Get busy living or get busy dying.
Author: Stephen King,  Different Seasons

Quote: You talk when you cease to be at peace with your thoughts.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: It's really a wonder that I haven't dropped all my ideals, because they seem so absurd and impossible to carry out. Yet I keep them, because in spite of everything, I still believe that people are really good at heart.
Author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

Quote: Success is almost totally dependent upon drive and persistence. The extra energy required to make another effort or try another approach is the secret of winning.
Author: Denis Waitley

Quote: Hope, deceiving as it is, serves at least to lead us to the end of our lives by an agreeable route.
Author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

Quote: You write the way you think about the world. My motto in times of trouble - and I'm speaking of life, not writing - is 'no humor too black.'
Author: Elizabeth McCracken

Quote: Loud is a way of life.
Author: Steven Adler

Quote: Love cannot endure indifference. It needs to be wanted. Like a lamp, it needs to be fed out of the oil of another's heart, or its flame burns low.
Author: Henry Ward Beecher

Quote: Does art have a future? Performance genres like opera, theater, music and dance are thriving all over the world, but the visual arts have been in slow decline for nearly 40 years. No major figure of profound influence has emerged in painting or sculpture since the waning of Pop Art and the birth of Minimalism in the early 1970s.
Author: Camille Paglia

Quote: I heard what you said. I’m not the silly romantic you think. I don’t want the heavens or the shooting stars. I don’t want gemstones or gold. I have those things already. I want…a steady hand. A kind soul. I want to fall asleep, and wake, knowing my heart is safe. I want to love, and be loved.
Author: Shana Abe

Author: Jonathan Swift

Author: Tony Robbins

Author: Tony Robbins

Author: William Samuel Johnson

Quote: I have the humor of a 9-year-old boy, and sometimes I've had laughing fits on-air.
Author: Megyn Kelly

Author: Britney Spears

Author: Britney Spears

Author: Jeanette Winterson

Quote: Do you remember back at the hotel when you promised that if we lived, you’d get dressed up in a nurse’s outfit and give me a sponge bath?"asked Jace."It was Simon who promised you the sponge bath.""As soon as I’m back on my feet, handsome,"said Simon."I knew we should have left you a rat.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

Quote: It is sometimes an appropriate response to reality to go insane.
Author: Philip K. Dick,  VALIS

Quote: Honesty and loyalty are key. If two people can be honest with each other about everything, that's probably the biggest key to success.
Author: Taylor Lautner

Quote: We hope that through these trade arrangements, through collaboration in training, in manpower development, and what have you, ASEAN in, say, ten years' time, will be a very different ASEAN.
Author: Sellapan Ramanathan

Author: Howie Mandel

Quote: A shady business never yields a sunny life.
Author: B. C. Forbes

Quote: It's tangible, it's solid, it's beautiful. It's artistic, from my standpoint, and I just love real estate.
Author: Donald Trump

Quote: Movies become art after editing. Instead of just reproducing reality, they juxtapose images of it. That implies expression; that's art.
Author: Alejandro Gonzalez Inarritu

Quote: Never go to bed mad. Stay up and fight.
Author: Phyllis Diller

Quote: Reading is one form of escape. Running for your life is another.
Author: Lemony Snicket

Quote: Here’s to books, the cheapest vacation you can buy.
Author: Charlaine Harris

Quote: Some people care too much. I think it's called love.
Author: A.A. Milne,  Winnie-the-Pooh

Quote: Give a girl the right shoes, and she can conquer the world.
Author: Bette Midler

Quote: The love of what you do, combined with your belief in what you do, will not determine your success. It will determine how hard you will work and how dedicated you will be to achieving it. Success just shows up from there.
Author: Jeffrey Gitomer

Author: Juan Manuel Santos

Quote: The biggest void that people can have in their lives is a sense of humor. Spending your life with someone who doesn't have that wouldn't be palatable.
Author: Howie Mandel

Quote: The Hercules' was a monumental undertaking. It is the largest aircraft ever built... I put the sweat of my life into this thing.
Author: Howard Hughes

Quote: My thoughts on gay marriage are that everyone has the right to love and be loved, and that's the position I take.
Author: Nick Jonas

Quote: During the Middle Ages they understood that words accompanied by imagery are much more memorable. By making the margins of a book colorful and beautiful, illuminations help make the text unforgettable. It's unfortunate that we've lost the art of illumination.
Author: Joshua Foer

Quote: We loved with a love that was more than love.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: I do not want people to be very agreeable, as it saves me the trouble of liking them a great deal.
Author: Jane Austen,  Jane Austen's Letters

Quote: Success is where preparation and opportunity meet.
Author: Bobby Unser

Quote: I certainly notice the vitality in Belfast, which wasn't there in the Seventies. There was a war going on then. Now there are cranes everywhere. There really is a sense of renewal and hope.
Author: Liam Neeson

Author: Karen Duffy

Quote: Every major question in history is a religious question. It has more effect in molding life than nationalism or a common language.
Author: Hilaire Belloc

Quote: Even from their infancy we frame them to the sports of love: their instruction, behavior, attire, grace, learning and all their words azimuth only at love, respects only affection. Their nurses and their keepers imprint no other thing in them.
Author: Michel de Montaigne

Quote: Nature is inside art as its content, not outside as its model.
Author: Marilyn French

Author: Henry David Thoreau

Author: Bonnie Tyler

Quote: Sure, I am funny and have a good sense of humor. Mostly, though, I just tell the truth. The internal dialogue people have in their heads - I just write it.
Author: Kara Swisher

Quote: It is my aim, my destination in life to make the cello as beloved an instrument as the violin and piano.
Author: Mstislav Rostropovich

Quote: I love dressing up. It's the best part of being a girl, I think.
Author: Emma Roberts

Quote: Even in literature and art, no man who bothers about originality will ever be original: whereas if you simply try to tell the truth (without caring twopence how often it has been told before) you will, nine times out of ten, become original without ever having noticed it.
Author: C. S. Lewis

Author: May Sarton

Author: May Sarton

Author: John D. Rockefeller

Author: Bruce Lipton

Author: Steve Harvey

Quote: You can't stay in your corner of the Forest waiting for others to come to you. You have to go to them sometimes.

Author: Thomas A. Edison

Author: Charles Grodin

Author: Gordon W. Allport

Quote: We must restore hope to young people, help the old, be open to the future, spread love. Be poor among the poor. We need to include the excluded and preach peace.
Author: Pope Francis

Author: Will Durant

Author: Albert Einstein

Author: C.G. Jung

Author: Florence Nightingale

The very promise of Hope and Change was rooted in uprooting the Washington modus operandi. But instead of rejecting it, he embraced it all - the secrecy, the closed doors, the political favors, the near-criminal negligence.
Author: Reince Priebus

Quote: I like doing comedy, I like doing drama. Naturally I like to do, I like doing dramas, I like conflict, and when I do a comedy, you know, I've found that, like, romantic comedy is the trickiest one, because often it's neither: it's not romantic and it's not funny. So, like, I like a comedy that's biting. It's biting humor or really quirky humor.
Author: Matt Dillon

Quote: Whether you are an astronomer or a life scientist, geophysicist, or a pilot, you've got to be there because you believe you are good in your field, and you can contribute, not because you are going to get a lot of fame or whatever when you get back.
Author: Alan Shepard

Quote: I love everything that's old, - old friends, old times, old manners, old books, old wine.
Author: Oliver Goldsmith

Author: Mae West

Author: Oscar Wilde

Author: Naveen Jain

Author: Matthew Bourne

Quote: My dad was a very funny man - he's the one who taught me life would be awfully hard without humor! I'm sure his Irish wit in some way influenced my decision to become an actress.
Author: Joan Cusack

Author: Mary Tyler Moore

Author: Desmond Tutu

Author: Brigham Young

Author: Paul Sweeney

Author: Walter Benjamin

Author: Andy Kindler

Author: Jane Pauley

Bad food is made by chefs who are indifferent, or who are trying to be everything to everybody, who are trying to please everyone... Bad food is fake food... food that shows fear and lack of confidence in people's ability to discern or to make decisions about their lives.
Author: Anthony Bourdain

Quote: It is not up to me whether I win or lose. Ultimately, this might not be my day. And it is that philosophy towards sports, something that I really truly live by. I am emotional. I want to win. I am hungry. I am a competitor. I have that fire. But deep down, I truly enjoy the art of competing so much more than the result.
Author: Apolo Ohno

Author: Ben Mendelsohn

Author: John Wesley

Quote: Using no control and using humor will build a relationship and make a dent to where the client puts the counselor in their quality world and then begins to relate and seek out the counselor. Effective therapy begins with the acceptance of the therapist into the client's quality world.
Author: William Glasser

Quote: How far you go in life depends on your being tender with the young, compassionate with the aged, sympathetic with the striving and tolerant of the weak and strong. Because someday in your life you will have been all of these.
Author: George Washington Carver

Quote: He who does not love his own language is worse than an animal and smelly fish.
Author: Jose Rizal

Quote: Politics is the art of choosing between the disastrous and the unpalatable.
Author: John Kenneth Galbraith

Quote: A guy and a girl can be just friends, but at one point or another, they will fall for each other...Maybe temporarily, maybe at the wrong time, maybe too late, or maybe forever
Author: Dave Matthews Band

Author: Dave Matthews Band

Author: J.R.R. Tolkien

Quote: You've got to eat while you dream. You've got to deliver on short-range commitments, while you develop a long-range strategy and vision and implement it. The success of doing both. Walking and chewing gum if you will. Getting it done in the short-range, and delivering a long-range plan, and executing on that.
Author: Jack Welch

Quote: So many people grew up with challenges, as I did. There weren't always happy things happening to me or around me. But when you look at the core of goodness within yourself - at the optimism and hope - you realize it comes from the environment you grew up in.
Author: Sonia Sotomayor

Quote: Throughout history, great leaders have known the power of humor.
Author: Allen Klein

Quote: A life is not important except in the impact it has on other lives.
Author: Jackie Robinson

Quote: Art is a marriage of the conscious and the unconscious.
Author: Jean Cocteau

Quote: You know, all that really matters is that the people you love are happy and healthy. Everything else is just sprinkles on the sundae.
Author: Paul Walker

Quote: I hope that in this year to come, you make mistakes. Because if you are making mistakes...you're Doing Something.
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: If you create incredible value and information for others that can change their lives - and you always stay focused on that service - the financial success will follow.
Author: Brendon Burchard

Quote: I do protect human rights, and I hope I shall always be looked up as a champion of human rights.
Author: Aung San Suu Kyi

Quote: It is characteristic of all deep human problems that they are not to be approached without some humor and some bewilderment.
Author: Freeman Dyson

Quote: Our prime purpose in this life is to help others. And if you can't help them, at least don't hurt them.
Author: Dalai Lama

Quote: Actually I think Art lies in both directions - the broad strokes, big picture but on the other hand the minute examination of the apparently mundane. Seeing the whole world in a grain of sand, that kind of thing.
Author: Peter Hammill

Quote: Whatever you want to do, if you want to be great at it, you have to love it and be able to make sacrifices for it.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: Don’t go around saying the world owes you a living. The world owes you nothing. It was here first.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: I believe in everything until it's disproved. So I believe in fairies, the myths, dragons. It all exists, even if it's in your mind. Who's to say that dreams and nightmares aren't as real as the here and now?
Author: John Lennon

Author: Wilma Mankiller

Quote: That's all a man can hope for during his lifetime - to set an example - and when he is dead, to be an inspiration for history.
Author: William McKinley

Quote: It has always surprised me how little attention philosophers have paid to humor, since it is a more significant process of mind than reason. Reason can only sort out perceptions, but the humor process is involved in changing them.
Author: Edward de Bono

Quote: I argue thee that love is life. And life hath immortality.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: I argue thee that love is life. And life hath immortality.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: Friendship is unnecessary, like philosophy, like art... It has no survival value; rather it is one of those things that give value to survival.
Author: C. S. Lewis

Author: C. S. Lewis

Quote: Knowledge is love and light and vision.
Author: Helen Keller

Quote: A pessimist sees the difficulty in every opportunity; an optimist sees the opportunity in every difficulty.
Author: Winston S. Churchill

Quote: Every heart sings a song, incomplete, until another heart whispers back. Those who wish to sing always find a song. At the touch of a lover, everyone becomes a poet.
Author: Plato

Author: Anaïs Nin

Author: Walter Scott

Quote: You accept that this civilisation could be abolished and life will begin later on after a few thousand years because that is something that has happened in the history of this planet. When you have peace in yourself and accept, then you are calm enough to do something, but if you are carried by despair there is no hope.
Author: Thich Nhat Hanh

Quote: In prehistoric times, mankind often had only two choices in crisis situations: fight or flee. In modern times, humor offers us a third alternative; fight, flee - or laugh.
Author: Robert Orben

Quote: You're only here for a short visit. Don't hurry, don't worry. And be sure to smell the flowers along the way.
Author: Walter Hagen

Quote: The art of acceptance is the art of making someone who has just done you a small favor wish that he might have done you a greater one.
Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

Quote: Love is what we were born with. Fear is what we learned here.
Author: Marianne Williamson

Quote: I like work: it fascinates me. I can sit and look at it for hours.
Author: Jerome K. Jerome

Quote: These woods are lovely, dark and deep,But I have promises to keep,And miles to go before I sleep,And miles to go before I sleep.
Author: Robert Frost,  Stopping by Woods on a Snowy Evening

Quote: Eating and reading are two pleasures that combine admirably.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: Honesty and integrity are absolutely essential for success in life - all areas of life. The really good news is that anyone can develop both honesty and integrity.
Author: Zig Ziglar

Quote: Art is the most beautiful deception of all. And although people try to incorporate the everyday events of life in it, we must hope that it will remain a deception lest it become a utilitarian thing, sad as a factory.
Author: Claude Debussy

Quote: I don't need someone with a hot body. He can be fat or overweight and have a belly. It's very much about style and substance and humor, interest, curiosity and really being smart.
Author: Kate Walsh

Quote: Open your eyes, look within. Are you satisfied with the life you're living?
Author: Bob Marley

Quote: The art of love is largely the art of persistence.
Author: Albert Ellis

Author: Albert Ellis

Quote: You're imperfect, and you're wired for struggle, but you are worthy of love and belonging.
Author: Brene Brown

Quote: I think you still love me, but we can’t escape the fact that I’m not enough for you. I knew this was going to happen. So I’m not blaming you for falling in love with another woman. I’m not angry, either. I should be, but I’m not. I just feel pain. A lot of pain. I thought I could imagine how much this would hurt, but I was wrong.

Quote: The fault, dear Brutus, is not in our stars, but in ourselves.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Julius Caesar

Quote: While formal schooling is an important advantage, it is not a guarantee of success nor is its absence a fatal handicap.
Author: Ray Kroc

Quote: To withdraw is not to run away, and to stay is no wise action, when there's more reason to fear than to hope.
Author: Miguel de Cervantes

Quote: Poor David Hume is dying fast, but with more real cheerfulness and good humor and with more real resignation to the necessary course of things, than any whining Christian ever dyed with pretended resignation to the will of God.
Author: Adam Smith

Quote: Life is what happens while you are busy making other plans.
Author: John Lennon

Quote: The art of teaching is the art of assisting discovery.
Author: Mark Van Doren

Quote: It is really rare to find someone you really, really love and that you want to spend your life with and all that stuff that goes along with being married. I am one of those lucky people. And I think she feels that way too. So the romantic stuff is easy because you want them to be happy.
Author: Harry Connick, Jr.

Quote: It is really rare to find someone you really, really love and that you want to spend your life with and all that stuff that goes along with being married. I am one of those lucky people. And I think she feels that way too. So the romantic stuff is easy because you want them to be happy.
Author: Harry Connick, Jr.

Quote: To this day, just always treat people the way you want to be treated. Whether it's family or friends or co-workers, I think it's the most important thing. Whether you have success or don't have it, whether you're a good person is all that matters.
Author: Brenda Song

Quote: God's way of answering the Christian's prayer for more patience, experience, hope and love often is to put him into the furnace of affliction.
Author: Richard Cecil

Quote: The comic is the perception of the opposite; humor is the feeling of it.
Author: Umberto Eco

Quote: Life is ten percent what happens to you and ninety percent how you respond to it.
Author: Lou Holtz

Quote: History develops, art stands still.
Author: E. M. Forster

Quote: Thank you for reminding Canada that I'm a disappointment to them. I like hockey, I love it, but I'm not an avid hockey - let's face it, true Canadian - fan. I've always been more into snowboarding and skateboarding and sort of the alternative sports, I'm not crazy about hockey - but love it!
Author: Dustin Milligan

Quote: That's always seemed so ridiculous to me, that people want to be around someone because they're pretty. It's like picking your breakfeast cereals based on color instead of taste.
Author: John Green,  Paper Towns

Quote: Success is nothing if you don't have the right people to share it with; you're just gonna end up lonely.
Author: Selena Gomez

Quote: I hope I never get so old I get religious.
Author: Ingmar Bergman

Quote: The schizophrenic has no sense of humor. His world is a constantly daunting, unfriendly place.
Author: Bob Newhart

Quote: Maybe that's what life is... a wink of the eye and winking stars.
Author: Jack Kerouac

Quote: Words may be false and full of art; Sighs are the natural language of the heart.
Author: Thomas Shadwell

Quote: Words may be false and full of art; Sighs are the natural language of the heart.
Author: Thomas Shadwell

Quote: What light is to the eyes - what air is to the lungs - what love is to the heart, liberty is to the soul of man.
Author: Robert Green Ingersoll

Quote: You wanna know what scares people? Success. When you don't make moves and when you don't climb up the ladder, everybody loves you because you're not competition.
Author: Nicki Minaj

Quote: Between the fear that something would happen and the hope that still it wouldn't, there is much more space than one thinks. On that narrow, hard, bare and dark space a lot of us spend their lives.
Author: Ivo Andric

Quote: As an actor, I'm attracted to drama; as a director, it's humor - because it's the story of my life, and I can't be that serious about it. Being alone is a big theme in all my movies, both as a director and as an actress.
Author: Jodie Foster

Quote: The most satisfying thing in life is to have been able to give a large part of one's self to others.
Author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

Quote: Jazz music is America's past and its potential, summed up and sanctified and accessible to anybody who learns to listen to, feel, and understand it. The music can connect us to our earlier selves and to our better selves-to-come. It can remind us of where we fit on the time line of human achievement, an ultimate value of art.
Author: Wynton Marsalis

Quote: When people get married because they think it's a long-time love affair, they'll be divorced very soon, because all love affairs end in disappointment. But marriage is a recognition of a spiritual identity.
Author: Joseph Campbell

Quote: Sleep is good, he said, and books are better.
Author: George R.R. Martin

Quote: Like success, failure is many things to many people. With Positive Mental Attitude, failure is a learning experience, a rung on the ladder, a plateau at which to get your thoughts in order and prepare to try again.
Author: W. Clement Stone

Quote: When we create hope and opportunity in the lives of others, we allow love, decency and promise to triumph over cowardice and hate.
Author: Kirsten Gillibrand

Quote: The combination of landing the biggest interview of my career and having a drill in my back reminds me that God only gives us what we can handle and that it helps to have a good sense of humor when we run smack into the absurdity of life.
Author: Robin Roberts

Quote: The price of anything is the amount of life you exchange for it.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: No art is any good unless you can feel how it's put together. By and large it's the eye, the hand and if it's any good, you feel the body. Most of the best stuff seems to be a complete gesture, the totality of the artist's body; you can really lean on it.
Author: Frank Stella

Quote: Why, when we know that there's no such thing as perfect, do most of us spend an incredible amount of time and energy trying to be everything to everyone? Is it that we really admire perfection? No - the truth is that we are actually drawn to people who are real and down-to-earth. We love authenticity and we know that life is messy and imperfect.
Author: Brene Brown

Is it that we really admire perfection? No - the truth is that we are actually drawn to people who are real and down-to-earth. We love authenticity and we know that life is messy and imperfect.

Quote: The more I know of the world, the more I am convinced that I shall never see a man whom I can really love. I require so much!
Author: Jane Austen,  Sense and Sensibility

Quote: Isn't it nice to think that tomorrow is a new day with no mistakes in it yet?
Author: L.M. Montgomery

Quote: The art of effective listening is essential to clear communication, and clear communication is necessary to management success.
Author: James Cash Penney

Quote: The art of effective listening is essential to clear communication, and clear communication is necessary to management success.
Author: James Cash Penney

Quote: When Nelson Mandela walked free, the world sang with joy. Ever since, South Africa has stood as a beacon of hope for Africa.
Author: Ban Ki-moon

Quote: When I teach the formal curriculum, I have the chance to think about it ahead of time. I can rehearse it. I can illustrate it with self-deprecating humor and humble-sounding personal disclosure. I can try to make it comes out just right.
Author: John Ortberg

Quote: You have enemies? Good. That means you've stood up for something, sometime in your life.
Author: Winston Churchill

Quote: Art is not what you see, but what you make others see.
Author: Edgar Degas

Quote: In my life I've learned that true happiness comes from giving. Helping others along the way makes you evaluate who you are. I think that love is what we're all searching for. I haven't come across anyone who didn't become a better person through love.
Author: Marla Gibbs

Quote: In my life I've learned that true happiness comes from giving. Helping others along the way makes you evaluate who you are. I think that love is what we're all searching for. I haven't come across anyone who didn't become a better person through love.
Author: Marla Gibbs

Quote: There is never just one thing that leads to success for anyone. I feel it always a combination of passion, dedication, hard work, and being in the right place at the right time.
Author: Lauren Conrad

Quote: Corporations, consumers, and citizens must begin acting in concert to create a powerful third pillar of social transformation if we hope to meet the social challenges we currently face with equal force. This begins with corporations that choose to alter how they practice capitalism in two ways to serve the greater good.
Author: Simon Mainwaring

Quote: Denzel Washington has a great sense of humor. He did all those 'Nutty Professor' movies.
Author: Seth MacFarlane

Quote: A man who dares to waste one hour of time has not discovered the value of life.
Author: Charles Darwin

Quote: What I dream of is an art of balance, of purity and serenity devoid of troubling or depressing subject matter - a soothing, calming influence on the mind, rather like a good armchair which provides relaxation from physical fatigue.
Author: Henri Matisse

Quote: I can still love an ex as a person, regardless if the breakup was bad. I would never wish anything negative on them. It takes more energy to hate them than to wish them well.
Author: Ashley Greene

Quote: She was a girl who knew how to be happy even when she was sad. And that’s important—you know
Author: Marilyn Monroe

Quote: The will to persevere is often the difference between failure and success.
Author: David Sarnoff

Quote: In acting, there's a type of courage you're recognized for all the time. You lose 100 pounds and play a guy with AIDS, and you get rewarded. But, in life, doing what is courageous is quiet, and no one knows about it. Courage is someone making sacrifices for their family or making selfless decisions for what they hope or feel.
Author: Rob Lowe

Quote: I just am a snob when it comes to humor.
Author: Courteney Cox

Quote: We need to give each other the space to grow, to be ourselves, to exercise our diversity. We need to give each other space so that we may both give and receive such beautiful things as ideas, openness, dignity, joy, healing, and inclusion.
Author: Max de Pree

Quote: Art has the power to transform, to illuminate, to educate, inspire and motivate.
Author: Harvey Fierstein

Quote: The more one does and sees and feels, the more one is able to do, and the more genuine may be one's appreciation of fundamental things like home, and love, and understanding companionship.
Author: Amelia Earhart

Quote: Doubt thou the stars are fire;Doubt that the sun doth move;Doubt truth to be a liar;But never doubt I love.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Hamlet

Quote: Those who dream by day are cognizant of many things which escape those who dream only by night.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe,  Eleonora

Quote: I learned this, at least, by my experiment: that if one advances confidently in the direction of his dreams, and endeavors to live the life which he has imagined, he will meet with a success unexpected in common hours.
Author: Henry David Thoreau,  Walden: Or, Life in the Woods

Quote: You get a little moody sometimes but I think that's because you like to read. People that like to read are always a little fucked up.
Author: Pat Conroy,  The Prince of Tides

Quote: Never mind what others do; do better than yourself, beat your own record from day to day, and you are a success.
Author: William J. H. Boetcker

Quote: I hope people remember me for the kind of person that I am, not because of what I do.
Author: Sean Faris

Quote: Professional comedians, surprisingly, have a lack of humor. They're insensitive to the insanity of our times.
Author: Mort Sahl

Quote: What if you gave someone a gift, and they neglected to thank you for it - would you be likely to give them another? Life is the same way. In order to attract more of the blessings that life has to offer, you must truly appreciate what you already have.
Author: Ralph Marston

Quote: Wherever the art of medicine is loved, there is also a love of humanity.
Author: Hippocrates

Quote: Wherever the art of medicine is loved, there is also a love of humanity.
Author: Hippocrates

Quote: The art of war is simple enough. Find out where your enemy is. Get at him as soon as you can. Strike him as hard as you can, and keep moving on.
Author: Ulysses S. Grant

Quote: Being happy is of the utmost importance. Success in anything is through happiness.
Author: Maharishi Mahesh Yogi

Quote: As I hope it doesn't come to the point where I need to take a day off. I feel pretty good right now and I'm not resting or saving for any other game.
Author: Tim Duncan

Quote: It never seems to occur to some people, that, like beauty, a sense of humor may sometimes be fatal.
Author: Edgar Rice Burroughs

Quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
Author: Bruce Lee

Quote: If you love life, don't waste time, for time is what life is made up of.
Author: Bruce Lee

Quote: When you fish for love, bait with your heart, not your brain.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: In mathematics the art of proposing a question must be held of higher value than solving it.
Author: Georg Cantor

Quote: When I have a little money, I buy books; and if I have any left, I buy food and clothes.
Author: Desiderius Erasmus

Quote: Let us read, and let us dance; these two amusements will never do any harm to the world.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: I can't imagine a person becoming a success who doesn't give this game of life everything he's got.
Author: Walter Cronkite

Quote: I can't imagine a person becoming a success who doesn't give this game of life everything he's got.
Author: Walter Cronkite

Quote: If there's a golf course in heaven, I hope it's like Augusta National. I just don't want an early tee time.
Author: Gary Player

Quote: I didn't think that anything is beyond humor - not profane humor, but a good, honest approach to humor.
Author: Mort Sahl

Quote: When I stand before God at the end of my life, I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left, and could say, 'I used everything you gave me'.
Author: Erma Bombeck

Quote: When I stand before God at the end of my life, I would hope that I would not have a single bit of talent left, and could say, 'I used everything you gave me'.
Author: Erma Bombeck

Quote: I love power. But it is as an artist that I love it. I love it as a musician loves his violin, to draw out its sounds and chords and harmonies.
Author: Napoleon Bonaparte

Quote: Don't you know that every perfect life would mean the end of art?
Author: Robert Musil

Quote: Books so special and rare and yours that advertising your affection feels like a betrayal.
Author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

Quote: It is the unknown we fear when we look upon death and darkness, nothing more.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

Quote: I have seven children by six different mothers. Maybe success was too good to me.
Author: Eazy-E

Quote: One year, my good deed started with deciding to give all my friends makeup from a cruelty-free cosmetics line that I love. I did this with the hope that they would love it as much as I do and end up switching their makeup over to that cruelty-free line forever.
Author: Jenna Morasca

Quote: Humor is the ability to see three sides to one coin.
Author: Ned Rorem

Quote: It's all about quality of life and finding a happy balance between work and friends and family.
Author: Philip Green

Quote: Love is the best school, but the tuition is high and the homework can be painful.
Author: Diane Ackerman

Quote: Professionalism in art has this difficulty: To be professional is to be dependable, to be dependable is to be predictable, and predictability is esthetically boring - an anti-virtue in a field where we hope to be astonished and startled and at some deep level refreshed.
Author: John Updike

Quote: Professionalism in art has this difficulty: To be professional is to be dependable, to be dependable is to be predictable, and predictability is esthetically boring - an anti-virtue in a field where we hope to be astonished and startled and at some deep level refreshed.

Quote: You will always be fond of me. I represent to you all the sins you never had the courage to commit.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: If we knew what it was we were doing, it would not be called research, would it?
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: What's meant to be will always find a way
Author: Trisha Yearwood

Quote: What's meant to be will always find a way
Author: Trisha Yearwood

Quote: I have decided to stick to love...Hate is too great a burden to bear.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.,  A Testament of Hope: The Essential Writings and Speeches

Quote: The longer you hang in there, the greater the chance that something will happen in your favor. No matter how hard it seems, the longer you persist, the more likely your success.
Author: Jack Canfield

Quote: Being insecure - I'm a master, a virtuoso - they can be handing me the keys to the kingdom and all I can think is, I hope I don't drop the key.
Author: M. Night Shyamalan

Quote: If someone is genuine, compassionate and kind, that is a turn-on. A sense of humor is a huge turn on, and that goes hand in hand with intelligence.
Author: Jennifer Nettles

Quote: Most people have never learned that one of the main aims in life is to enjoy it.
Author: Samuel Butler

Quote: In life, there are those relationships where you really love someone, but they're just not right for you and there's a little bittersweet feel to it.
Author: Jennifer Morrison

Author: Jennifer Morrison

Author: Max Beerbohm

Quote: Malachi scowled. "I don't remember the Clave inviting you into the Glass City, Magnus Bane.""They didn't,"Magnus said. "Your wards are down.""Really?"the Consul's voice dripped sarcasm. "I hadn't noticed."Magnus looked concerned. "That's terrible. Someone should have told you."He glanced at Luke. "Tell him the wards are down.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

Quote: The person who makes a success of living is the one who sees his goal steadily and aims for it unswervingly.
Author: Cecil B. DeMille

Quote: You have to find hope. Hope is such a shape shifter. You tend to look in the rearview mirror for hope, but when it's gone, you have to look forward. You have to get in the van and keep driving on.
Author: Jonathan Evison

Quote: I love the idea of things being strict and things being uniform. That's the reason why I surround each collection with humor or irony. I want to make sure that it's not too serious and that there is some element that throws it off because otherwise that would make it really boring. There's always a story that's somewhat fantastical.
Author: Thom Browne

Quote: Don't go around saying the world owes you a living. The world owes you nothing. It was here first.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: I love Christmas, not just because of the presents but because of all the decorations and lights and the warmth of the season.
Author: Ashley Tisdale

Quote: Art is man's constant effort to create for himself a different order of reality from that which is given to him.
Author: Chinua Achebe

Quote: Urgent optimism is the desire to act immediately to tackle an obstacle, combined with the belief that we have a reasonable hope of success.
Author: Jane McGonigal

Quote: Urgent optimism is the desire to act immediately to tackle an obstacle, combined with the belief that we have a reasonable hope of success.
Author: Jane McGonigal

Quote: I hope that a move toward clemency with Judge Afiuni would be a step towards the importance of maintaining a properly functioning justice system.
Author: Noam Chomsky

Quote: I was a product of a divorced family and I used humor as a weapon to combat sadness. I used comedy to make my mother laugh in light of the darkness that she faced, and to me it became a very powerful tool at a very young age, at six. I saw how therapeutic it could be.
Author: Josh Gad

Quote: Nobody made a greater mistake than he who did nothing because he could do only a little.
Author: Edmund Burke

Quote: Nobody made a greater mistake than he who did nothing because he could do only a little.
Author: Edmund Burke

Quote: It'll be the Internet and piracy that will kill film. There's a philosophy that the Internet should be free, but the reality is that piracy will destroy the film industry and film as an art form because it's expensive to make a movie. Maybe you'll have funky little independent movies, and it'll go back and then start up again some other way.
Author: Helen Mirren

Quote: I would challenge you to a battle of wits, but I see you are unarmed!
Author: William Shakespeare

Quote: I have hated words and I have loved them, and I hope I have made them right.
Author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

Quote: Success soon palls. The joyous time is when the breeze first strikes your sails, and the waters rustle under your bows.
Author: Charles Buxton

Quote: When I think about the world I would like to leave to my daughter and the grandchildren I hope to have, it is a world that moves away from unequal, unstable, unsustainable interdependence to integrated communities - locally, nationally and globally - that share the characteristics of all successful communities.
Author: William J. Clinton

Quote: I think it's part of the responsibility of an artist to shock, to upset, to make people think differently, and to surprise people. And that's where the good humor is, if there's a surprise and there's something unexpected. Something that's not normal, not in the realm of general living expectations.
Author: Bill Plympton

Quote: The Wine of Life keeps oozing drop by drop, The Leaves of Life keep falling one by one.
Author: Edward Fitzgerald

Quote: I love salon days to pamper myself, do my nails.
Author: Sania Mirza

Quote: I think art is not an ornament or refinement at the fringes of human intelligence, I think it's at the center. It's at the core.
Author: Robert Pinsky

Quote: Faith is taking the first step even when you can't see the whole staircase.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.

Quote: The superior man makes the difficulty to be overcome his first interest; success only comes later.
Author: Confucius

Quote: Let's drink to the spirit of gallantry and courage that made a strange Heaven out of unbelievable Hell, and let's drink to the hope that one day this country of ours, which we love so much, will find dignity and greatness and peace again.
Author: Noel Coward

Quote: Humor is probably the most significant characteristics of the human mind. Far more significant than reason. In fact, reason is actually a very cheap commodity.
Author: Edward de Bono

Quote: The story of life is quicker than the blink of an eye, the story of love is hello, goodbye.
Author: Jimi Hendrix

Quote: The story of life is quicker than the blink of an eye, the story of love is hello, goodbye.
Author: Jimi Hendrix

Quote: Try as you will, you cannot annihilate that eternal relic of the human heart, love.
Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: The mark of all good art is not that the thing done is done exactly or finely, for machinery may do as much, but that it is worked out with the head and the workman's heart.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Of all sad words of tongue or pen, the saddest are these, 'It might have been.
Author: John Greenleaf Whittier,  Maud Muller - Pamphlet

Quote: Every saint has a past, and every sinner has a future.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Success is achieved by developing our strengths, not by eliminating our weaknesses.
Author: Marilyn vos Savant

Quote: The whole point of Superman, as originally created, was to be the ally of those who had no other allies. It put that magnitude of power, the most powerful guy in the world, in the service of those who had no hope, no chance.
Author: J. Michael Straczynski

Quote: What's great about the geek spirit is that life never seems to stop us, and they never seem to kill our enthusiasm, our optimism and our hunger to experience the world. We keep our sense of humor, we protect our dignity, we talk to our friends about the experience and then we start again fresh the very next day.
Author: Paul Feig

Quote: Our life always expresses the result of our dominant thoughts.
Author: Soren Kierkegaard

Quote: Love places someone else in the centre of your being and your own self is blurred.
Author: Mohsin Hamid

Quote: An art book is a museum without walls.
Author: Andre Malraux

Quote: Sarcasm is the last refuge of the imaginatively bankrupt.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

Quote: No relationship is perfect, ever. There are always some ways you have to bend, to compromise, to give something up in order to gain something greater...The love we have for each other is bigger than these small differences. And that's the key. It's like a big pie chart, and the love in a relationship has to be the biggest piece. Love can make up for a lot.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

Quote: I'm different, and I have to be a warrior to be that way. But I have had some success; I hope I have touched the lives of some wonderful people, all by being what I see as myself but some others people see as different.
Author: Johnny Weir

Author: Johnny Weir

Quote: Unless our conception of patriotism is progressive, it cannot hope to embody the real affection and the real interest of the nation.
Author: Jane Addams

Quote: I think the humor of double puns is incredible.
Author: Richard Lederer

Quote: I look back on my life like a good day's work, it was done and I am satisfied with it.
Author: Grandma Moses

Quote: Love involves a peculiar unfathomable combination of understanding and misunderstanding.
Author: Diane Arbus

Quote: My life is a monument to procrastination, to the art of putting things off until later, or much later, or possibly never.
Author: Craig Brown

Quote: I am a man"he told her, "and men do not consume pink beverages. Get thee gone woman, and bring me something brown.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

Quote: I have no special talents. I am only passionately curious.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: Always do what you are afraid to do.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: We are taught to consume. And that's what we do. But if we realized that there really is no reason to consume, that it's just a mind set, that it's just an addiction, then we wouldn't be out there stepping on people's hands climbing the corporate ladder of success.
Author: River Phoenix

Quote: Being a star has made it possible for me to get insulted in places where the average Negro could never hope to go and get insulted.
Author: Sammy Davis, Jr.

Quote: I find humor to be the most attractive characteristic, but I certainly won't cancel anything out, considering when you love someone you love someone, and sometimes you just can't explain it.
Author: Zoey Deutch

Quote: Good friends, good books and a sleepy conscience: this is the ideal life.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: If you do what you love, it is the best way to relax.
Author: Christian Louboutin

Quote: If my art has nothing to do with people's pain and sorrow, what is 'art' for?
Author: Ai Weiwei

Quote: Success depends in a very large measure upon individual initiative and exertion, and cannot be achieved except by a dint of hard work.
Author: Anna Pavlova

Quote: I think of myself as a catalyst of action and a messenger of hope, turning people onto themselves and turning people onto their dreams.
Author: Les Brown

Quote: To me, Ann Romney sounds like a better candidate than her husband. She put her MS into remission through horseback riding, alternative therapies, and a healthy diet. She knows how to pace herself. She has a sense of humor and an innate honesty, and her hair moves in the wind. Maybe she should run.
Author: Patti Davis

Quote: What childishness is it that while there's breath of life in our bodies, we are determined to rush to see the sun the other way around?
Author: Elizabeth Bishop

Quote: Women love always: when earth slips from them, they take refuge in heaven.
Author: George Sand

Quote: Real artists take the misery and sadness of life and translate it into art.
Author: Josh Peck

Quote: A life spent making mistakes is not only more honorable, but more useful than a life spent doing nothing.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: Books are the perfect entertainment: no commercials, no batteries, hours of enjoyment for each dollar spent. What I wonder is why everybody doesn't carry a book around for those inevitable dead spots in life.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: What the hell is that?"I laughed."It's my fox hat.""Your fox hat?""Yeah, Pudge. My fox hat.""Why are you wearing your fox hat?"I asked."Because no one can catch the motherfucking fox.
Author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

Author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

Quote: If we ever hope to rid the world of the political AIDS of our time, terrorism, the rule must be clear: One does not deal with terrorists; one does not bargain with terrorists; one kills terrorists.
Author: Meir Kahane

Quote: You know those things that you throw the twigs into and it spits them out? That's what I do. The branches are like life, and I throw them into my head and some of it comes out as humor.
Author: Steven Wright

Quote: Wild oats will get sown some time, and one of the arts of life is to sow them at the right time.
Author: Richard Le Gallienne

Quote: Well, Art is Art, isn't it? Still, on the other hand, water is water. And east is east and west is west and if you take cranberries and stew them like applesauce they taste much more like prunes than rhubarb does. Now you tell me what you know.
Author: Groucho Marx

Quote: Love is the magician that pulls man out of his own hat.
Author: Ben Hecht

Quote: I am not young enough to know everything.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: You can talk with someone for years, everyday, and still, it won't mean as much as what you can have when you sit in front of someone, not saying a word, yet you feel that person with your heart, you feel like you have known the person for forever.... connections are made with the heart, not the tongue.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: You can talk with someone for years, everyday, and still, it won't mean as much as what you can have when you sit in front of someone, not saying a word, yet you feel that person with your heart, you feel like you have known the person for forever.... connections are made with the heart, not the tongue.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Man is the only creature who refuses to be what he is.
Author: Albert Camus

Quote: When I was 5 years old, my mother always told me that happiness was the key to life. When I went to school, they asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up. I wrote down ‘happy’. They told me I didn’t understand the assignment, and I told them they didn’t understand life.
Author: John Lennon

Quote: When I was 5 years old, my mother always told me that happiness was the key to life. When I went to school, they asked me what I wanted to be when I grew up. I wrote down ‘happy’. They told me I didn’t understand the assignment, and I told them they didn’t understand life.
Author: John Lennon

Quote: You weren't born just to live a life and to die; you were born to accomplish something specifically. Matter of fact, success is making it to the end of your purpose; that is success... Success is not just existing. Success is making it to the end of why you were born.
Author: Myles Munroe

Quote: My husband John Lennon was a very special man. A man of humble origin, he brought light and hope to the whole world with his words and music.
Author: Yoko Ono

Quote: In truth, politeness is artificial good humor, it covers the natural want of it, and ends by rendering habitual a substitute nearly equivalent to the real virtue.
Author: Thomas Jefferson

Quote: I've never been a big nightlife person. I have a pretty low-key life.
Author: Murray Bartlett

Quote: When thou art above measure angry, bethink thee how momentary is man's life.
Author: Marcus Aurelius

Quote: Choose your love, Love your choice.
Author: Thomas S. Monson

Quote: Love is always patient and kind. It is never jealous. Love is never boastful or conceited. It is never rude or selfish. It does not take offense and is not resentful. Love takes no pleasure in other people’s sins, but delights in the truth. It is always ready to excuse, to trust, to hope, and to endure whatever comes.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

Quote: The planet is fine. The people are fucked.
Author: George Carlin

Quote: The planet is fine. The people are fucked.
Author: George Carlin

Quote: There is an immutable conflict at work in life and in business, a constant battle between peace and chaos. Neither can be mastered, but both can be influenced. How you go about that is the key to success.
Author: Phil Knight

Quote: There will always be someone else with a different view than you. I appreciate them and would never say that they are wrong. I hope that they would give me that courtesy also.
Author: Melissa Etheridge

Quote: Anybody with a sense of humor is going to put on my album and laugh from beginning to end.
Author: Eminem

Quote: My hometown I grew up in in Michigan is really tiny, and they are so excited for all of my adventures my whole life.
Author: Toni Trucks

Quote: The beginning of a friendship, the fact that two people out of the thousands around them can meet and connect and become friends, seems like a kind of magic to me. But maintaining a friendship requires work. I don't mean that as a bad thing. Good art requires work as well.
Author: Charles de Lint

Author: T. S. Eliot

Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

Quote: Whether you think you can, or you think you can't--you're right.
Author: Henry Ford

Quote: There are thousands of inspirational stories waiting to be told about young women who yearn for a great education. They are stories of struggle and stories of success, and they will inspire others to take action and work to change lives.
Author: Soledad O'Brien

Author: Soledad O'Brien

Your cellphone doesn't work or you got a parking ticket, you had a bad day at work. You can lose sight of the really important things in life; that's what the song is about.
Author: Tom Scholz

Quote: My type of humor is me not caring whether people know what I'm talking about or not.
Author: John Hodgman

Quote: That there's no more important decision in life than who you marry.
Author: Brad Paisley

Quote: The art challenges the technology, and the technology inspires the art.
Author: John Lasseter

Quote: Looking back, I have this to regret, that too often when I loved, I did not say so.
Author: Ray Stannard Baker

Quote: Our lives begin to end the day we become silent about things that matter.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.,  I Have a Dream: Writings and Speeches That Changed the World

Quote: As you become more successful, the gender barrier disappears. The credibility challenges you have during your growing up years starts disappearing when you start demonstrating success.
Author: Kiran Mazumdar-Shaw

Quote: To me, it's always been a challenge to look for the light: to look for those spaces in your heart where there is hope and faith and try to embrace that rather than crush it. I've spent so many years trying to crush those feelings of hope, and I certainly succeeded for quite a while.
Author: Dave Gahan

Quote: In a way, a lot of my humor comes from presenting things that are dramatic or shocking and then people not having socially appropriate responses, having people denying the drama by failing to react to it, and that's a really classic form of humor.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk

Quote: All life is a manifestation of the spirit, the manifestation of love.
Author: Morihei Ueshiba

Quote: All life is a manifestation of the spirit, the manifestation of love.
Author: Morihei Ueshiba

Quote: A beautiful lady is an accident of nature. A beautiful old lady is a work of art.
Author: Louis Nizer

Quote: Life is like an onion. You peel it off one layer at a time, and sometimes you weep.
Author: Carl Sandburg

Quote: I believe there should be no arbitrary date set for withdrawal and yet no permanent, unending deployment. No cut and run, yet measured progress in helping a people who want to be free without an illusion of overnight success.
Author: Rick Renzi

Quote: Here is just the beginning of a list of skills that exam results cannot possibly hope to reflect: interpersonal skills, the ability to entertain, how articulate we are as speakers, our ability to work as part of a team, the ability to deal with challenges and invention.
Author: Alexandra Adornetto

Quote: Good humor is the health of the soul, sadness is its poison.
Author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield

Quote: When work is a pleasure, life is a joy! When work is a duty, life is slavery.
Author: Maxim Gorky

Quote: The human soul is hungry for beauty; we seek it everywhere - in landscape, music, art, clothes, furniture, gardening, companionship, love, religion, and in ourselves. No one would desire not to be beautiful. When we experience the beautiful, there is a sense of homecoming.
Author: John O'Donohue

Quote: If equal affection cannot be, let the more loving be me.
Author: W. H. Auden

Quote: Make it a rule never to give a child a book you would not read yourself.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: Once you learn to read, you will be forever free.
Author: Frederick Douglass

Quote: Real success is not, like, materialistic. It's being where you want to be when you want to be; just living your life how you feel; having an ultimate goal and being able to accomplish it.
Author: Lindsey Wixson

Quote: I hope that there's a difference between being childish and childlike and that I'm the latter, if you take my meaning. I often sort of wonder. I don't think I'm a terribly good grown-up; I don't take responsibility easily or well in many areas of life. Finance and stuff like that, I'm absolutely appalling.
Author: Graeme Base

Quote: When a chick has a sense of humor, there's nothing more attractive.
Author: Dylan O'Brien

Quote: We forget that the water cycle and the life cycle are one.
Author: Jacques Yves Cousteau

Quote: Art lies by its own artifice.
Author: Ovid

Quote: It is impossible to repent of love. The sin of love does not exist.
Author: Muriel Spark

Quote: Well, I believe that the depth of your struggle can determine the height of your success. I was inspired to come out of everything I've been through and end up in a place where I never thought that I would be.
Author: R. Kelly

Quote: Depression can seem worse than terminal cancer, because most cancer patients feel loved and they have hope and self-esteem.
Author: David D. Burns

Quote: Congratulations, you have a sense of humor. And to those who didn't: Go stick your head in the mud.
Author: Jesse Ventura

Quote: You cannot live your life looking at yourself from someone else's point of view.
Author: Penelope Cruz

Quote: I adore art... when I am alone with my notes, my heart pounds and the tears stream from my eyes, and my emotion and my joys are too much to bear.
Author: Giuseppe Verdi

Quote: Who so loves believes the impossible.

Quote: Two people in love, alone, isolated from the world, that's beautiful.

Author: Emily Dickinson

Author: Emily Dickinson

Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Author: Benjamin Disraeli

Quote: When my dad founded our church, he used either a globe or a map of the world behind him. It was symbolic of what Christ said: to go forth and preach hope to the world. We believe in the cross, but we just continued with the globe.
Author: Joel Osteen

Quote: My mom taught me the power of love. I learned to focus on the long-term big picture from my father. His sense of humor and light-hearted approach always make me smile. My husband is a pivotal anchor in my life. His influence encourages me to be independent and take risks.

Quote: Finding some quiet time in your life, I think, is hugely important.
Author: Mariel Hemingway

Quote: No matter what is happening in life or in the world - war, natural disaster, poor health, pain, the death of loved ones - if existence is filled with art, music and literature, life will be fulfilling, a joy.

Quote: Each moment of a happy lover's hour is worth an age of dull and common life.
Author: Aphra Behn

Quote: If my life is going to mean anything, I have to live it myself.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

Quote: If my life is going to mean anything, I have to live it myself.

Author: Robin S. Sharma

Author: John Ciardi

Author: Salma Hayek

Quote: If you wish to strengthen your confidence in God still more, often recall the loving way in which He has acted toward you, and how mercifully He has tried to bring you out of your sinful life, to break your attachment to the things of earth and draw you to His love.
Author: Alphonsus Liguori

Author: Brendan Behan

Quote: Sometimes you climb out of bed in the morning and you think, I'm not going to make it, but you laugh inside — remembering all the times you've felt that way.
Author: Charles Bukowski

Author: E.B. White,  Charlotte's Web

Author: Winston S. Churchill

But I've gained about twenty pounds over the past two years, and the more weight I've put on, the more success I've had. Do not let the hero in your soul perish in lonely frustration for the life you deserved and have never been able to reach. The world you desire can be won. It exists.. it is real.. it is possible.. it's yours.
Author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

Author: Douglas Adams,  The Restaurant at the End of the Universe

Author: Henry Ward Beecher

Author: Bonnie Tyler

Author: Elizabeth Gillies

Author: Peter Marshall

Author: Henry A. Kissinger

Author: Torquato Tasso

Quote: Any time not spent on love is wasted.

And even if somebody else has it much worse, that doesn't really change the fact that you have what you have.
Author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

Quote: Talent hits a target no one else can hit. Genius hits a target no one else can see.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Author: Jean Genet

Author: Willie Geist

Author: Casey Stengel

Author: Armistead Maupin

Author: Marilyn Monroe

Author: Eric Ries

Quote: I hope to be the go-to person on international trade and industry. I think no one before me or after me will ever have so much knowledge about America's ports.
Author: Janice Hahn

Quote: Don't wish me happiness - I don't expect to be happy it's gotten beyond that, somehow. Wish me courage and strength and a sense of humor - I will need them all.
Author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

Quote: I should have no objection to go over the same life from its beginning to the end: requesting only the advantage authors have, of correcting in a second edition the faults of the first.
Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quote: The beauty one can find in art is one of the pitifully few real and lasting products of human endeavor.
Author: J. Paul Getty

Quote: The boy never cried again, and he never forgot what he'd learned: that to love is to destroy, and that to be loved is to be the one destroyed.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

Quote: The flower that blooms in adversity is the rarest and most beautiful of all.
Author: Walt Disney Company,  Mulan

Quote: The flower that blooms in adversity is the rarest and most beautiful of all.
Author: Walt Disney Company,  Mulan

Quote: Think of all the beauty still left around you and be happy.
Author: Anne Frank

Quote: Nothing that’s worthwhile is ever easy. Remember that.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Message in a Bottle

Quote: The heart was made to be broken.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Here's all you have to know about men and women: women are crazy, men are stupid. And the main reason women are crazy is that men are stupid.
Author: George Carlin,  When Will Jesus Bring The Pork Chops?

Quote: I generally avoid temptation unless I can't resist it.
Author: Mae West

I try to appeal to them: 'I know you a sufferer, but it doesn't mean that you can't or shouldn't expect any better.' It's a lot different than from what I usually say, like, 'Get busy, shake that thing.'
Author: Sean Paul

Quote: I hope I'm in a position to make stuff that I really want to make as opposed to stuff that I just have to make for money reasons, or to sustain a certain marquee value.
Author: Paul Walker

Quote: One of the things that binds us as a family is a shared sense of humor.
Author: Ralph Fiennes

Quote: I feel like unforgiveness, bitterness and resentment, it blocks the flows of God's blessings in life.
Author: Ja Rule

Quote: I don't believe in art. I believe in artists.
Author: Marcel Duchamp

Quote: You will find as you look back upon your life that the moments when you have truly lived are the moments when you have done things in the spirit of love.
Author: Henry Drummond

Quote: I'm not saying that everything is survivable. Just that everything except the last thing is.
Author: John Green,  Paper Towns

Quote: The most important thing is to enjoy your life—to be happy—it's all that matters.
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Author: Bertrand Russell

Author: Jerry B. Jenkins

Quote: My mother hoped I would meet a nice doctor or barrister or accountant who would marry me and take me to live in what is now called Fashionable Dublin Four. But she felt that this was a vain hope. I was a bit loud to make a nice professional wife, and anyway, I was too keen on spending my holidays in far flung places to meet any of these people.
Author: Maeve Binchy

Quote: In the household in which I was raised, the themes were pretty simple. 'Work hard. Don't quit. Be appreciative, be thankful, be grateful, be respectful. Also, never whine, never complain. And always, for crying out loud, keep a sense of humor.'
Author: Michael Keaton

Quote: Resentments and grudges are two of the main culprits that perpetuate cycles of self-abuse and victimhood. Stowed away inside you like parasites, they deplete you of your God-given life force and separate you from your inherent worth, your joy, and the love in your heart.

Author: J. Paul Getty

Author: Thomas Merton

Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

Author: Albert Einstein

Author: Albert Einstein

Author: Douglas Conant

Author: Jordin Sparks

Author: Jennifer Aniston

Author: Laurie Anderson

Author: Duke Ellington

Quote: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
Author: Mary Oliver

Quote: It is so hard to leave—until you leave. And then it is the easiest goddamned thing in the world.
Author: John Green,  Paper Towns

Quote: Never be bullied into silence. Never allow yourself to be made a victim. Accept no one’s definition of your life; define yourself.
Author: Robert Frost

Quote: I go out there to win. People don't care if you die in this business. The only way I get back is with success.
Author: Michael Bay

Quote: To many, peace is what enables development and is critical in providing opportunities to young people. To some - especially those from regions involved in conflict - peacekeeping and efforts to preserve peace are absolutely vital in bringing prosperity and hope for the future.
Author: Kim Yuna

Quote: I think kids want the same thing from a book that adults want - a fast-paced story, characters worth caring about, humor, surprises, and mystery. A good book always keeps you asking questions, and makes you keep turning pages so you can find out the answers.
Author: Rick Riordan

Quote: I'm so thankful for my family and friends - they're really supportive. Everyone I work with on 'Austin & Ally;' the cast and crew are like my family now. We have so much fun, and I'm so happy they're in my life!
Author: Laura Marano

Quote: Art depends on luck and talent.

Quote: Loving others always costs us something and requires effort. And you have to decide to do it on purpose. You can't wait for a feeling to motivate you.
Author: Joyce Meyer

Quote: My experience of life is that it is not divided up into genres; it’s a horrifying, romantic, tragic, comical, science-fiction cowboy detective novel. You know, with a bit of pornography if you're lucky.
Author: Alan Moore

Author: W.C. Fields

Quote: I have no time for specialized concerns, working themes or variations that lead to mastery... I like the indefinite, the boundless; I like continual uncertainty. Author: John Wooden

Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Author: Seth MacFarlane

Author: Richard M. DeVos

Author: Issa Rae

But while I do, of course, now feel the pressure having had books that have been very successful, I just know I have to concentrate on writing for myself. Author: Nelson Mandela

Author: Ken Follett

Author: Will Rogers

Author: Candice Bergen

Author: Martha Beck

Quote: Art doesn't transform. It just plain forms.

Author: Michael Morpurgo

Author: Haruki Murakami

Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  The Great Gatsby

Quote: Reading was my escape and my comfort, my consolation, my stimulant of choice: reading for the pure pleasure of it, for the beautiful stillness that surrounds you when you hear an author's words reverberating in your head.

Author: Lillian Gish

Quote: A good sense of humor will get you everywhere.
Author: Josh Bowman

Quote: The trouble with life isn't that there is no answer, it's that there are so many answers.
Author: Ruth Benedict

Quote: A good painting to me has always been like a friend. It keeps me company, comforts and inspires.
Author: Hedy Lamarr

Quote: But I love Halloween, and I love that feeling: the cold air, the spooky dangers lurking around the corner.
Author: Evan Peters

Quote: That's the thing about books. They let you travel without moving your feet.
Author: Jhumpa Lahiri,  The Namesake

Quote: There is always some madness in love. But there is also always some reason in madness.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Books are my friends, my companions. They make me laugh and cry and find meaning in life.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Eragon

Quote: If all else perished, and he remained, I should still continue to be; and if all else remained, and he were annihilated, the universe would turn to a mighty stranger.
Author: Emily Brontë,  Wuthering Heights

Quote: We're all going to die, all of us, what a circus! That alone should make us love each other but it doesn't. We are terrorized and flattened by trivialities, we are eaten up by nothing.
Author: Charles Bukowski

Quote: Remember when you tried to convince me to feed a poultry pie to the mallards in the park to see if you could breed a race of cannibal ducks?""They ate it too,"Will reminisced. "Bloodthirsty little beasts. Never trust a duck.

Quote: 'Shake It Up' definitely teaches kids about the importance of reaching for your dreams and setting high goals. It also teaches great lessons about friendship and family.
Author: Zendaya

Quote: Success needs no explanation. Failure does not have one that matters.
Author: Jesse Jackson

Quote: Next year, I hope there will be even more parties, lots of holidays and just having a good time, really. Plus wing-walking, air shows and learning to fly, as they are all things I want to do. I won't be restricted by age.
Author: Carol Vorderman

Quote: My platform has been to reach reluctant readers. And one of the best ways I found to motivate them is to connect them with reading that interests them, to expand the definition of reading to include humor, science fiction/fantasy, nonfiction, graphic novels, wordless books, audio books and comic books.
Author: Jon Scieszka

Quote: The reason of my life is not to be the most beautiful woman in the world.
Author: Isabella Rossellini

Quote: A writer should write with his eyes and a painter paint with his ears.
Author: Gertrude Stein

Quote: It may be true that the law cannot make a man love me, but it can keep him from lynching me, and I think that's pretty important.
Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

Quote: Love is a fire. But whether it is going to warm your hearth or burn down your house, you can never tell.
Author: Joan Crawford

Quote: Deserves it! I daresay he does. Many that live deserve death. And some that die deserve life. Can you give it to them? Then do not be too eager to deal out death in judgement. For even the very wise cannot see all ends.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

Quote: I have long enjoyed the friendship and companionship of Republicans because I am by instinct a teacher, and I would like to teach them something.
Author: Woodrow Wilson

Quote: Monetary success is not success. Career success is not success. Life, someone that loves you, giving to others, doing something that makes you feel complete and full. That is success. And it isn't dependent on anyone else.
Author: James Avery

Quote: Neither should a ship rely on one small anchor, nor should life rest on a single hope.
Author: Epictetus

Quote: I try to give all my characters a sense of humor, so I guess I feel like I have done comedy, but maybe I'm better known for drama.
Author: Kathy Baker

Quote: That it will never come again is what makes life sweet.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: Love the art in yourself and not yourself in the art.
Author: Constantin Stanislavski

Quote: If you wish to strengthen your confidence in God still more, often recall the loving way in which He has acted toward you, and how mercifully He has tried to bring you out of your sinful life, to break your attachment to the things of earth and draw you to His love.
Author: Alphonsus Liguori

Author: Alphonsus Liguori

Author: Suzanne Collins,  Mockingjay

Author: Mother Teresa
