Author: Gail Carson Levine

Quote: Kind words can be short and easy to speak, but their echoes are truly endless.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: The scar had not pained Harry for nineteen years. All was well.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: Black holes are where God divided by zero.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: Success is not to be pursued; it is to be attracted by the person you become.
Author: Jim Rohn

Quote: I think it's a mistake to ever look for hope outside of one's self.
Author: Arthur Miller

Quote: When the bank asks me about my assets, I include my friendship with Regis Philbin.
Author: Lou Holtz

Quote: I'd probably describe my sense of humor as 'twisted,' I guess. It's not hard to make me laugh, especially when I'm surrounded by my close friends, especially my bandmates.
Author: Mac DeMarco

Quote: Believe that life is worth living and your belief will help create the fact.
Author: William James

Quote: The only creatures that are evolved enough to convey pure love are dogs and infants.
Author: Johnny Depp

Quote: All I tell artists is, 'Do what you love. Never let anybody talk you into changing what your musical idea is just to try to get a hit, because you're chasing your tail that way. It's not going to happen, and if you're successful, you have to do it the rest of your life. Stay true to it and do it for the sake of the art.'
Author: Gloria Estefan

Quote: And when at last you find someone to whom you feel you can pour out your soul, you stop in shock at the words you utter— they are so rusty, so ugly, so meaningless and feeble from being kept in the small cramped dark inside you so long.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: Love can change a person the way a parent can change a baby- awkwardly, and often with a great deal of mess.
Author: Lemony Snicket,  Horseradish

Quote: Love can change a person the way a parent can change a baby- awkwardly, and often with a great deal of mess.
Author: Lemony Snicket,  Horseradish

Quote: Where words leave off, music begins.
Author: Heinrich Heine

Quote: I know I am but summer to your heart, and not the full four seasons of the year.
Author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

Quote: Let us learn to show our friendship for a man when he is alive and not after he is dead.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  The Great Gatsby

Quote: Our memory is a more perfect world than the universe: it gives back life to those who no longer exist.
Author: Guy de Maupassant

Quote: Patience, grasshopper,"said Maia. "Good things come to those who wait.""I always thought that was 'Good things come to those who do the wave,'"said Simon. "No wonder I've been so confused all my life.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

Quote: One wordFrees us of all the weight and pain of life:That word is love.
Author: Sophocles

Quote: The longer I live, the more I observe that carrying around anger is the most debilitating to the person who bears it.
Author: Katharine Graham

Quote: If there's a single lesson that life teaches us, it's that wishing doesn't make it so.
Author: Lev Grossman,  The Magicians

Quote: Scared is what you're feeling. Brave is what you're doing.
Author: Emma Donoghue,  Room

Quote: Success is not built on success. It's built on failure. It's built on frustration. Sometimes its built on catastrophe.
Author: Sumner Redstone

Quote: There will always be a place for us somewhere, somehow, as long as we see to it that working people fight for everything they have, everything they hope to get, for dignity, equality, democracy, to oppose war and to bring to the world a better life.
Author: Harry Bridges

Quote: As told in Friendship with God, if we simply decided to believe and act as if first, we're all one, and second, life is eternal, it would render virtually everything we've done all our lives pointless.
Author: Neale Donald Walsch

Quote: Humor has justly been regarded as the finest perfection of poetic genius.
Author: Thomas Carlyle

Quote: Live life to the fullest, and focus on the positive.
Author: Matt Cameron

Quote: If we went by the world's definition of who I'm supposed to be because I look weird... 'Well, surely, this guy can't have a productive life, surely, he doesn't have a sense of humor. Surely, he can't love life.' We stereotype people in this world. And so... if the world thinks you're not good enough, it's a lie, you know. Get a second opinion.
Author: Nick Vujicic

Quote: If we went by the world's definition of who I'm supposed to be because I look weird... 'Well, surely, this guy can't have a productive life, surely, he doesn't have a sense of humor. Surely, he can't love life.' We stereotype people in this world. And so... if the world thinks you're not good enough, it's a lie, you know. Get a second opinion.
Author: Nick Vujicic

Quote: If we went by the world's definition of who I'm supposed to be because I look weird... 'Well, surely, this guy can't have a productive life, surely, he doesn't have a sense of humor. Surely, he can't love life.' We stereotype people in this world. And so... if the world thinks you're not good enough, it's a lie, you know. Get a second opinion.
Author: Nick Vujicic

Quote: I don't know if One Direction will stand the test of time. I have a niece who goes crazy for them. But the only way to judge art is to wait and see if it becomes evergreen. This takes a bit of time. Adele is a very good musician and I'd like to sing with her. But, again, time will tell if her music will become evergreen.
Author: Andrea Bocelli

Quote: It's funny how humans can wrap their mind around things and fit them into their version of reality.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

Quote: Older men declare war. But it is youth that must fight and die.
Author: Herbert Hoover

Quote: No matter how careful you are, there's going to be the sense you missed something, the collapsed feeling under your skin that you didn't experience it all. There's that fallen heart feeling that you rushed right through the moments where you should've been paying attention.Well, get used to that feeling. That's how your whole life will feel some day.This is all practice.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

Quote: Still round the corner there may wait A new road or a secret gateAnd though I oft have passed them by A day will come at last when IShall take the hidden paths that run West of the Moon, East of the Sun.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien

Quote: Still round the corner there may wait A new road or a secret gateAnd though I oft have passed them by A day will come at last when IShall take the hidden paths that run West of the Moon, East of the Sun.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien

Quote: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: He who has a why to live for can bear almost any how.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: It is better, I think, to grab at the stars than to sit flustered because you know you cannot reach them.
Author: R.A. Salvatore,  Sojourn

Quote: If I’m honest I have to tell you I still read fairy-tales and I like them best of all.
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Quote: Nobody gets everything in this life. You decide your priorities and you make your choices. I'd decided long ago that any cake I had would be eaten.
Author: Donald E. Westlake,  Two Much

Quote: Ginny!"said Mr. Weasley, flabbergasted. "Haven't I taught you anything? What have I always told you? Never trust anything that can think for itself if you can't see where it keeps its brain?
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets

Quote: Life is a series of natural and spontaneous changes. Don't resist them; that only creates sorrow. Let reality be reality. Let things flow naturally forward in whatever way they like.
Author: Lao Tzu

Quote: The making of friends who are real friends, is the best token we have of a man's success in life.
Author: Edward Everett Hale

Quote: I hope we will not so characterize religious people as being so narrow and so biased towards people not of their own religion that they cannot even work with them in this common cause to which you say they are committed.
Author: Barney Frank

Quote: I experience for the American officers and soldiers that friendship which arises from having shared with them for a length of time dangers, sufferings, and both good and evil fortune.
Author: Marquis de Lafayette

Quote: Having a sense of humor has served me more than it has hurt me - just in the sense that it has allowed me to keep my sanity.
Author: Dee Dee Myers

Quote: I believe that if life gives you lemons, you should make lemonade... And try to find somebody whose life has given them vodka, and have a party.
Author: Ron White

Quote: In the film world, we can all be heroes. In the real world, where heroism can cost you your life or the life of the ones you love, people aren't so willing to make those sacrifices. When they do, they are set apart from the rest of us.
Author: John Rhys-Davies

Quote: In the film world, we can all be heroes. In the real world, where heroism can cost you your life or the life of the ones you love, people aren't so willing to make those sacrifices. When they do, they are set apart from the rest of us.
Author: John Rhys-Davies

Quote: Simplicity, clarity, singleness: These are the attributes that give our lives power and vividness and joy as they are also the marks of great art. They seem to be the purpose of God for his whole creation.
Author: Richard Holloway

Quote: Confidence is ignorance. If you're feeling cocky, it's because there's something you don't know.
Author: Eoin Colfer,  Artemis Fowl

Quote: Confidence is ignorance. If you're feeling cocky, it's because there's something you don't know.
Author: Eoin Colfer,  Artemis Fowl

Quote: To choose doubt as a philosophy of life is akin to choosing immobility as a means of transportation.
Author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

Quote: The earth has music for those who listen.
Author: George Santayana

Quote: I don't go out with strangers,"I said."Good thing I do. I'll pick you up at five.
Author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Hush, Hush

Quote: I could easily forgive his pride, if he had not mortified mine.
Author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

Quote: being alone never felt right. sometimes it felt good, but it never felt right.
Author: Charles Bukowski,  Women

Quote: Better a cruel truth than a comfortable delusion.
Author: Edward Abbey

Quote: It takes courage to love, but pain through love is the purifying fire which those who love generously know. We all know people who are so much afraid of pain that they shut themselves up like clams in a shell and, giving out nothing, receive nothing and therefore shrink until life is a mere living death.
Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

Quote: If someone were to harm my family or a friend or somebody I love, I would eat them. I might end up in jail for 500 years, but I would eat them.
Author: Johnny Depp

Quote: Nearly all men can stand adversity, but if you want to test a man's character, give him power.
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: When the heart speaks, the mind finds it indecent to object.
Author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

Quote: Learn from the mistakes of others. You can never live long enough to make them all yourself.
Author: Groucho Marx

Quote: We need, in love, to practice only this: letting each other go. For holding on comes easily; we do not need to learn it.
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Translations from the Poetry of Rainer Maria Rilke

Quote: If you work just for money, you'll never make it, but if you love what you're doing and you always put the customer first, success will be yours.
Author: Ray Kroc

Quote: 'Peace Train' is a song I wrote, the message of which continues to breeze thunderously through the hearts of millions. There is a powerful need for people to feel that gust of hope rise up again.
Author: Cat Stevens

Quote: Never was a man further from a partiality for Spain than I am. But I think I now have left them in a sincere and steady intention to cultivate the friendship of America.
Author: Marquis de Lafayette

Quote: Our subconscious minds have no sense of humor, play no jokes and cannot tell the difference between reality and an imagined thought or image. What we continually think about eventually will manifest in our lives.
Author: Robert Collier

Quote: Your time is limited, so don't waste it living someone else's life. Don't be trapped by dogma - which is living with the results of other people's thinking. Don't let the noise of others' opinions drown out your own inner voice. And most important, have the courage to follow your heart and intuition.
Author: Steve Jobs

Quote: You should hurry up and acquire the cigar habit. It's one of the major happinesses. And so much more lasting than love, so much less costly in emotional wear and tear.
Author: Aldous Huxley

Quote: My goal is to be one with the music. I just dedicate my whole life to this art.
Author: Jimi Hendrix

Quote: No one can construct for you the bridge upon which precisely you must cross the stream of life, no one but you yourself alone.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Youth is happy because it has the capacity to see beauty. Anyone who keeps the ability to see beauty never grows old.
Author: Franz Kafka

Quote: You can only become truly accomplished at something you love. Don’t make money your goal. Instead pursue the things you love doing and then do them so well that people can’t take their eyes off of you.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: When I was your age, television was called books.
Author: William Goldman,  The Princess Bride

Quote: Some people have a way with words, and other people...oh, uh, not have way.
Author: Steve Martin

Quote: Sometimes when I look at you, I feel I'm gazing at a distant star. It's dazzling, but the light is from tens of thousands of years ago.Maybe the star doesn't even exist any more. Yet sometimes that light seems more real to me than anything.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  South of the Border, West of the Sun

Quote: Who in the world am I? Ah, that's the great puzzle.
Author: Lewis Carroll,  Alice in Wonderland

Quote: Everyone is a moon, and has a dark side which he never shows to anybody.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: She feels in italics and thinks in CAPITALS.
Author: Henry James

Quote: Letting go means to come to the realization that some people are a part of your history, but not a part of your destiny.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: Letting go means to come to the realization that some people are a part of your history, but not a part of your destiny.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: Letting go means to come to the realization that some people are a part of your history, but not a part of your destiny.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: Letting go means to come to the realization that some people are a part of your history, but not a part of your destiny.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: When we least expect it, life sets us a challenge to test our courage and willingness to change; at such a moment, there is no point in pretending that nothing has happened or in saying that we are not yet ready. The challenge will not wait. Life does not look back. A week is more than enough time for us to decide whether or not to accept our destiny.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Devil and Miss Prym

Quote: There is only one good, knowledge, and one evil, ignorance.
Author: Socrates

Quote: For to know a man's library is, in some measure, to know his mind.
Author: Geraldine Brooks,  March

Quote: Though she be but little, she is fierce!
Author: William Shakespeare,  A Midsummer Night's Dream

Quote: Pretty women wonder where my secret lies.I'm not cute or built to suit a fashion model's sizeBut when I start to tell them,They think I'm telling lies.I say,It's in the reach of my armsThe span of my hips,The stride of my step,The curl of my lips.I'm a womanPhenomenally.Phenomenal woman,That's me.
Author: Maya Angelou,  Phenomenal Woman: Four Poems Celebrating Women

Quote: Remain true to yourself, child. If you know your own heart, you will always have one friend who does not lie.
Author: Marion Zimmer Bradley,  The Forest House

Quote: What a blessing it is to love books as I love them;- to be able to converse with the dead, and to live amidst the unreal!
Author: Thomas Babington Macaulay,  The Selected Letters Of Thomas Babington Macaulay

Quote: You might want to lie down,"Magnus advised. "I find that it helps when the crushing sense of horrible realization sets in.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

Quote: Reading is the sole means by which we slip, involuntarily, often helplessly, into another's skin, another's voice, another's soul.
Author: Joyce Carol Oates

Quote: You wanna fly, you got to give up the shit that weighs you down.
Author: Toni Morrison,  Song of Solomon

Quote: We do not grow absolutely, chronologically. We grow sometimes in one dimension, and not in another; unevenly. We grow partially. We are relative. We are mature in one realm, childish in another. The past, present, and future mingle and pull us backward, forward, or fix us in the present. We are made up of layers, cells, constellations.
Author: Anaïs Nin

Quote: When one tugs at a single thing in nature, he finds it attached to the rest of the world.
Author: John Muir

Quote: When we don't know who to hate, we hate ourselves.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

Quote: Problems or successes, they all are the results of our own actions. Karma. The philosophy of action is that no one else is the giver of peace or happiness. One's own karma, one's own actions are responsible to come to bring either happiness or success or whatever.
Author: Maharishi Mahesh Yogi

Quote: I would hope my legacy would be bringing smiles to faces. Happiness with my music.
Author: Janet Jackson

Quote: Friendship is one of our most treasured relationships, but it isn't codified and celebrated; it's never going to give you a party.
Author: Hanya Yanagihara

Quote: There is a collective as well as an individual humor inclining peoples to sadness or cheerfulness, making them see things in bright or somber lights. In fact, only society can pass a collective opinion on the value of human life; for this the individual is incompetent.
Author: Emile Durkheim

Quote: A hero is someone who has given his or her life to something bigger than oneself.
Author: Joseph Campbell

Quote: A hero is someone who has given his or her life to something bigger than oneself.
Author: Joseph Campbell

Quote: The purest and most thoughtful minds are those which love colour the most.
Author: John Ruskin

Quote: What an artist is trying to do for people is bring them closer to something, because of course art is about sharing. You wouldn't be an artist unless you wanted to share an experience, a thought.
Author: David Hockney

Quote: Nowadays people know the price of everything and the value of nothing.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: Somewhere over the rainbow, skies are blue, and the dreams that you dare to dream really do come true.
Author: E.Y. Harburg

Quote: All parents damage their children. It cannot be helped. Youth, like pristine glass, absorbs the prints of its handlers. Some parents smudge, others crack, a few shatter childhoods completely into jagged little pieces, beyond repair.
Author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

Quote: All parents damage their children. It cannot be helped. Youth, like pristine glass, absorbs the prints of its handlers. Some parents smudge, others crack, a few shatter childhoods completely into jagged little pieces, beyond repair.
Author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

Quote: The darker the night, the brighter the stars,  The deeper the grief, the closer is God!
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Crime and Punishment

Quote: I'm happy. Which often looks like crazy.
Author: David Henry Hwang,  M. Butterfly

Quote: If books could have more, give more, be more, show more, they would still need readers who bring to them sound and smell and light and all the rest that can’t be in books. The book needs you.
Author: Gary Paulsen,  The Winter Room

Quote: What do you want?""Just coffee. Black - like my soul.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

Quote: I guess that’s just part of loving people: You have to give things up. Sometimes you even have to give them up.
Author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

Quote: I kept always two books in my pocket, one to read, one to write in.
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  Essays of Robert Louis Stevenson

Quote: I kept always two books in my pocket, one to read, one to write in.
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  Essays of Robert Louis Stevenson

Quote: Wisdom comes from experience. Experience is often a result of lack of wisdom.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: Wisdom comes from experience. Experience is often a result of lack of wisdom.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: The purpose of life is not to be happy. It is to be useful, to be honorable, to be compassionate, to have it make some difference that you have lived and lived well.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Success comes to those who have an entire mountain of gold that they continually mine, not those who find one nugget and try to live on it for fifty years.
Author: John C. Maxwell

Quote: All what we hope for is that a day will come, when we have all gone, when people will say that this man has tried, and his family tried. This is all there is to seek in this world.
Author: King Hussein I

Quote: I find that the Amazon comments often are exceptionally shrewd and insightful, so I'm not going to diss them. But you don't really have any guarantees that what you're reading wasn't written out of friendship or spite.
Author: Michael Dirda

Quote: Humor is not a mood but a way of looking at the world. So if it is correct to say that humor was stamped out in Nazi Germany, that does not mean that people were not in good spirits, or anything of that sort, but something much deeper and more important.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

Quote: Clouds come floating into my life, no longer to carry rain or usher storm, but to add color to my sunset sky.
Author: Rabindranath Tagore

Quote: Clouds come floating into my life, no longer to carry rain or usher storm, but to add color to my sunset sky.
Author: Rabindranath Tagore

Quote: There were times, especially when I was traveling for 'Eat, Pray, Love,' when, I swear to God, I would feel this weight of my female ancestors, all those Swedish farmwives from beyond the grave who were like, 'Go! Go to Naples! Eat more pizza! Go to India, ride an elephant! Do it! Swim in the Indian Ocean. Read those books. Learn a language.'
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert

Quote: Madness is the absolute break with the work of art; it forms the constitutive moment of abolition, which dissolves in time the truth of the work of art.
Author: Michel Foucault

Quote: It is a curious thing, Harry, but perhaps those who are best suited to power are those who have never sought it. Those who, like you, have leadership thrust upon them, and take up the mantle because they must, and find to their own surprise that they wear it well.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: Let the rain kiss you. Let the rain beat upon your head with silver liquid drops. Let the rain sing you a lullaby.
Author: Langston Hughes

Quote: If you have a sister and she dies, do you stop saying you have one? Or are you always a sister, even when the other half of the equation is gone?
Author: Jodi Picoult,  My Sister's Keeper

Quote: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
Author: Rumi

Quote: In the world I amAlways a strangerI do not understand its languageIt does not understand my silence
Author: Bei Dao

Quote: You will lose what you value most, so treasure it while you can.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Shadow Kiss

Quote: I have the simplest tastes. I am always satisfied with the best.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Between two evils, I always pick the one I never tried before.
Author: Mae West

Quote: The more one judges, the less one loves.
Author: Honoré de Balzac,  Physiologie Du Mariage

Quote: Dreams are always crushing when they don't come true. But it's the simple dreams that are often the most painful because they seem so personal, so reasonable, so attainable. You're always close enough to touch, but never quite close enough to hold and it's enough to break your heart.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Three Weeks With My Brother

Quote: I know how devastated you must be to miss me, but leave a message, and I'll try to ease your agony
Author: Richelle Mead,  Blood Promise

Quote: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
Author: J.K. Rowling

Quote: Go on with what your heart tells you, or you will lose all.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

Quote: Change will not come if we wait for some other person, or if we wait for some other time. We are the ones we've been waiting for. We are the change that we seek.
Author: Barack Obama

Quote: Words are pale shadows of forgotten names. As names have power, words have power. Words can light fires in the minds of men. Words can wring tears from the hardest hearts.
Author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Name of the Wind

Quote: Adults are always asking little kids what they want to be when they grow up ’cause they’re looking for ideas.
Author: Paula Poundstone

Quote: It's not the size of the dog in the fight, it's the size of the fight in the dog.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Success is about dedication. You may not be where you want to be or do what you want to do when you're on the journey. But you've got to be willing to have vision and foresight that leads you to an incredible end.
Author: Usher

Quote: I hope I look skinnier in 3D. I hope I don't look three times as fat. That'll be disappointing.
Author: Kathy Bates

Quote: I firmly believe, only because I've been doing this for so long, every show takes three years. 90% of them don't get three years. It just does. It takes a long time to build a community, build a friendship with your characters. It's hard for people to grasp on and make them care about you.
Author: Kaley Cuoco

Quote: The reason why you know more funny dudes than funny chicks is that dudes are funnier than chicks. If my daughter has a mediocre sense of humor, I'm just gonna tell her, 'Be a staff writer for a sitcom. Because they'll have to hire you, they can't really fire you, and you don't have to produce that much. It'll be awesome.'
Author: Adam Carolla

Quote: God wants us to know that life is a series of beginnings, not endings. Just as graduations are not terminations, but commencements. Creation is an ongoing process, and when we create a perfect world where love and compassion are shared by all, suffering will cease.
Author: Bernie Siegel

Quote: God wants us to know that life is a series of beginnings, not endings. Just as graduations are not terminations, but commencements. Creation is an ongoing process, and when we create a perfect world where love and compassion are shared by all, suffering will cease.
Author: Bernie Siegel

Quote: We provide food that customers love, day after day after day. People just want more of it.
Author: Ray Kroc

Quote: If you don't get noticed, you don't have anything. You just have to be noticed, but the art is in getting noticed naturally, without screaming or without tricks.
Author: Leo Burnett

Quote: Sometimes love means letting go when you want to hold on tighter.
Author: Melissa Marr,  Ink Exchange

Quote: All a girl really wants is for one guy to prove to her that they are not all the same.
Author: Marilyn Monroe

Quote: When everything goes to hell, the people who stand by you without flinching -- they are your family.
Author: Jim Butcher

Quote: Friendship marks a life even more deeply than love. Love risks degenerating into obsession, friendship is never anything but sharing.
Author: Elie Wiesel

Quote: Friendship marks a life even more deeply than love. Love risks degenerating into obsession, friendship is never anything but sharing.
Author: Elie Wiesel

Quote: Friendship marks a life even more deeply than love. Love risks degenerating into obsession, friendship is never anything but sharing.
Author: Elie Wiesel

Quote: I was dead until you found me, though I breathed. I was sightless, though I could see. And then you came...and I was awakened.
Author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Awakened

Quote: A purpose of human life, no matter who is controlling it, is to love whoever is around to be loved.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  The Sirens of Titan

Quote: A purpose of human life, no matter who is controlling it, is to love whoever is around to be loved.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  The Sirens of Titan

Quote: Remember me and smile, for it's better to forget than to remember me and cry.
Author: Dr. Seuss

Quote: Kindness is a language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Words dazzle and deceive because they are mimed by the face. But black words on a white page are the soul laid bare.
Author: Guy de Maupassant

Quote: I feel like someone breathed new air into my lungs. I am not Abnegation. I am not Dauntless. I am Divergent.
Author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

Quote: Magnus, standing by the door, snapped his fingers impatiently. "Move it along, teenagers. The only person who gets to canoodle in my bedroom is my magnificent self.""Canoodle?"repeated Clary, never having heard the word before."Magnificent?"repeated Jace, who was just being nasty. Magnus growled. The growl sounded like "Get out.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

Quote: Evil is always possible. And goodness is eternally difficult.
Author: Anne Rice,  Interview with the Vampire

Quote: They say I'm old-fashioned, and live in the past, but sometimes I think progress progresses too fast!
Author: Dr. Seuss

Quote: My library is an archive of longings.
Author: Susan Sontag,  As Consciousness is Harnessed to Flesh: Journals and Notebooks, 1964-1980

Quote: It is easy to love people in memory; the hard thing is to love them when they are there in front of you.
Author: John Updike,  My Father's Tears and Other Stories

Quote: To put everything in balance is good, to put everything in harmony is better.
Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: A person has to remember that the road to success is always under construction. You have to get that through your head. That it is not easy becoming successful.
Author: Steve Harvey

Quote: There is hope for the future because God has a sense of humor and we are funny to God.
Author: Bill Cosby

Quote: There is hope for the future because God has a sense of humor and we are funny to God.
Author: Bill Cosby

Quote: There was a time when I thought dudes had friendship all figured out. The focus on eating things in front of giant screens, pretending to punch one another, competing over who can utter the grossest and most profane personal insults imaginable - this struck me as the very apex of human social exchange.
Author: Lynn Coady

Quote: A book without potty humor is like a banana split without hot fudge. It can still be good, I suppose, but you kinda get the feeling that something is missing.
Author: Dav Pilkey

Quote: Life is one big road with lots of signs. So when you riding through the ruts, don't complicate your mind. Flee from hate, mischief and jealousy. Don't bury your thoughts, put your vision to reality. Wake Up and Live!
Author: Bob Marley

Quote: We adore chaos because we love to produce order.
Author: M. C. Escher

Quote: As it has been said:Love and a coughcannot be concealed.Even a small cough.Even a small love.
Author: Anne Sexton

Quote: There is more than one way to burn a book. And the world is full of people running about with lit matches.
Author: Ray Bradbury

Quote: Selfishness is not living as one wishes to live, it is asking others to live as one wishes to live.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: The only way that we can live, is if we grow. The only way that we can grow is if we change. The only way that we can change is if we learn. The only way we can learn is if we are exposed. And the only way that we can become exposed is if we throw ourselves out into the open. Do it. Throw yourself.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: I've lived through some terrible things in my life, some of which actually happened.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Things need not have happened to be true. Tales and dreams are the shadow-truths that will endure when mere facts are dust and ashes, and forgot.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 3: Dream Country

Quote: I write to give myself strength. I write to be the characters that I am not. I write to explore all the things I'm afraid of.
Author: Joss Whedon

Quote: Tell me and I forget, teach me and I may remember, involve me and I learn.
Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quote: I feel free and strong. If I were not a reader of books I could not feel this way.
Author: Walter Tevis

Quote: But I believe in true love, you know? I don't believe that everybody gets to keep their eyes or not get sick or whatever, but everybody should have true love, and it should last at least as long as your life does.
Author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

Quote: Believe only half of what you see and nothing that you hear.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: The best way to cheer yourself is to cheer somebody else up.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: There are two ways of spreading light: to be the candle or the mirror that receives it.
Author: Edith Wharton

Quote: If you don't know history, then you don't know anything. You are a leaf that doesn't know it is part of a tree.
Author: Michael Crichton

Quote: The two most important requirements for major success are: first, being in the right place at the right time, and second, doing something about it.
Author: Ray Kroc

Quote: Loyalty and friendship, which is to me the same, created all the wealth that I've ever thought I'd have.
Author: Ernie Banks

Quote: All the interests of my reason, speculative as well as practical, combine in the three following questions: 1. What can I know? 2. What ought I to do? 3. What may I hope?
Author: Immanuel Kant

Quote: Humor is one of the best ingredients of survival.
Author: Aung San Suu Kyi

Quote: I only photograph myself at poignant moments in my life as a check of where I am and how large my thighs are.
Author: Sam Taylor-Johnson

Quote: The greatest happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved; loved for ourselves, or rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: Poetry is often the art of overhearing yourself say things you didn't know you knew. It is a learned skill to force yourself to articulate your life, your present world or your possibilities for the future.
Author: David Whyte

Quote: You should write because you love the shape of stories and sentences and the creation of different words on a page. Writing comes from reading, and reading is the finest teacher of how to write.
Author: Annie Proulx

Quote: Sell your cleverness and buy bewilderment.
Author: Rumi,  Masnavi i Man'avi, the spiritual couplets of Maula

Quote: I'm killing time while I wait for life to shower me with meaning and happiness.
Author: Bill Watterson

Quote: I'm killing time while I wait for life to shower me with meaning and happiness.
Author: Bill Watterson

Quote: If neurotic is wanting two mutually exclusive things at one and the same time, then I'm neurotic as hell. I'll be flying back and forth between one mutually exclusive thing and another for the rest of my days.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Bell Jar

Quote: It's like Tolstoy said. Happiness is an allegory, unhappiness a story.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Kafka on the Shore

Quote: If you're texting Magnus to say 'I think u r kewl,' I'm going to kill you.""Who's Magnus?"Max inquired."He's a warlock,"said Alec."A sexy, sexy warlock,"Isabelle told Max, ignoring Alec's look of total fury."But warlocks are bad,"protested Max, looking baffled."Exactly,"said Isabelle.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

Quote: If you stay, I'll do whatever you want. I'll quit the band, go with you to New York. But if you need me to go away, I'll do that, too. I was talking to Liz and she said maybe coming back to your old life would be too painful, that maybe it'd be easier for you to erase us. And that would suck, but I'd do it. I can lose you like that if I don't lose you today. I'll let you go. If you stay.
Author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

Quote: If you stay, I'll do whatever you want. I'll quit the band, go with you to New York. But if you need me to go away, I'll do that, too. I was talking to Liz and she said maybe coming back to your old life would be too painful, that maybe it'd be easier for you to erase us. And that would suck, but I'd do it. I can lose you like that if I don't lose you today. I'll let you go. If you stay.
Author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

Quote: so I wait for you like a lonely housetill you will see me again and live in me.Till then my windows ache.
Author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

Quote: The past is never where you think you left it.
Author: Katherine Anne Porter

Quote: Be with me always - take any form - drive me mad! only do not leave me in this abyss, where I cannot find you! Oh, God! it is unutterable! I can not live without my life! I can not live without my soul!
Author: Emily Brontë,  Wuthering Heights

Quote: I have nothing to declare except my genius.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: I hope that one day you will have the experience of doing something you do not understand for someone you love.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

Quote: I think that we're all mentally ill. Those of us outside the asylums only hide it a little better - and maybe not all that much better after all.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: Damn, Claire. Warn a guy before you do a face-plant on the floor next time. I could have looked all heroic and caught you or something -Shane
Author: Rachel Caine,  Glass Houses

Quote: Everyone who achieves success in a great venture, solves each problem as they came to it. They helped themselves. And they were helped through powers known and unknown to them at the time they set out on their voyage. They keep going regardless of the obstacles they met.
Author: W. Clement Stone

Quote: You can't build anything with a flimsy foundation. Friendship is the foundation.
Author: Hill Harper

Quote: You cannot hope to sweep someone else away by the force of your writing until it has been done to you.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: The duty of comedy is to correct men by amusing them.
Author: Moliere

Quote: Difficult times always create opportunities for you to experience more love in your life.
Author: Barbara de Angelis

Quote: Difficult times always create opportunities for you to experience more love in your life.
Author: Barbara de Angelis

Quote: First love is only a little foolishness and a lot of curiosity.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: Anime is intended to have ambiguous features. That's part of the art form.
Author: M. Night Shyamalan

Quote: I myself have never been able to find out precisely what feminism is: I only know that people call me a feminist whenever I express sentiments that differentiate me from a doormat.
Author: Rebecca West

Quote: There are two means of refuge from the misery of life — music and cats.
Author: Albert Schweitzer

Quote: Absence diminishes small loves and increases great ones, as the wind blows out the candle and fans the bonfire.
Author: François de La Rochefoucauld,  Maxims

Quote: They always say time changes things, but you actually have to change them yourself.
Author: Andy Warhol,  The Philosophy of Andy Warhol

Quote: Holding people away from you, and denying yourself love, that doesn't make you strong. if anything, it makes you weaker. Because you're doing it out of fear.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

Quote: When you play a game of thrones you win or you die.
Author: George R.R. Martin,  A Game of Thrones

Quote: Make your own Bible. Select and collect all the words and sentences that in all your readings have been to you like the blast of a trumpet.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Imagination is like a muscle. I found out that the more I wrote, the bigger it got.
Author: Philip José Farmer

Quote: I am lonely, yet not everybody will do. I don't know why, some people fill the gaps and others emphasize my loneliness. In reality those who satisfy me are those who simply allow me to live with my ''idea of them.
Author: Anaïs Nin

Quote: If you look the right way, you can see that the whole world is a garden.
Author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  The Secret Garden

Quote: I'm a success today because I had a friend who believed in me and I didn't have the heart to let him down.
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: How do I love thee? Let me count the ways.I love thee to the depth and breadth and heightMy soul can reach
Author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

Quote: Lack of direction, not lack of time, is the problem. We all have twenty-four hour days.
Author: Zig Ziglar

Quote: It's only those who do nothing that make no mistakes, I suppose.
Author: Joseph Conrad,  An Outcast of the Islands

Quote: Never be bullied into silence. Never allow yourself to be made a victim. Accept no one's definition of your life, but define yourself.
Author: Harvey Fierstein

Quote: Never be bullied into silence. Never allow yourself to be made a victim. Accept no one's definition of your life, but define yourself.
Author: Harvey Fierstein

Quote: Rare as is true love, true friendship is rarer.
Author: Jean de La Fontaine

Quote: Rare as is true love, true friendship is rarer.
Author: Jean de La Fontaine

Quote: If you're too open-minded; your brains will fall out.
Author: Lawrence Ferlinghetti

Quote: Stories can conquer fear, you know. They can make the heart bigger.
Author: Ben Okri

Quote: If you're lonely when you're alone, you're in bad company.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre

Quote: When will you learn that there isn't a word for everything?
Author: Nicole Krauss,  The History of Love

Quote: There are perhaps many causes worth dying for, but to me, certainly, there are none worth killing for.
Author: Albert Dietrich,  Army GI, Pacifist CO: The World War II Letters of Frank and Albert Dietrich

Quote: Don't cry over someone who wouldn't cry over you.
Author: Lauren Conrad

Quote: Only a generation of readers will spawn a generation of writers.
Author: Steven Spielberg

Quote: Success is having to worry about every damn thing in the world, except money.
Author: Johnny Cash

Quote: The only things that are really permanent are love, family, friendship, and that is a lesson. At the end of the day, that's really what it boils down to. The rest of it is just stuff.
Author: Jared Kushner

Quote: The secret to humor is surprise.
Author: Aristotle

Quote: I'm very happy with my life. I am what I am. I don't worry about anything that I can't control. That's a really good lesson in life.
Author: Tom Watson

Quote: Love is the only reality and it is not a mere sentiment. It is the ultimate truth that lies at the heart of creation.
Author: Rabindranath Tagore

Quote: My university degree is in art and, yes, I do a lot of drawing for all my books. I have a big drafting table set up in a spare bedroom and I cover it with maps and house plans and sketches that I use in the books. Also, I truly love architecture, so that plays a big part in all my books.
Author: Jude Deveraux

Quote: When someone is in your heart, they're never truly gone. They can come back to you, even at unlikely times.
Author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

Quote: You could rattle the stars,"she whispered. "You could do anything, if only you dared. And deep down, you know it, too. That’s what scares you most.
Author: Sarah J. Maas,  Throne of Glass

Quote: Name the greatest of all inventors. Accident.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Maybe our girlfriends are our soulmates and guys are just people to have fun with.
Author: Candace Bushnell,  Sex and the City

Quote: Maybe our girlfriends are our soulmates and guys are just people to have fun with.
Author: Candace Bushnell,  Sex and the City

Quote: You have everything needed for the extravagant journey that is your life.
Author: Carlos Castaneda

Quote: I decided it is better to scream. Silence is the real crime against humanity.
Author: Nadezhda Mandelstam,  Hope Against Hope

Quote: Behind every beautiful thing, there's some kind of pain.
Author: Bob Dylan

Quote: Wanting to be someone else is a waste of the person you are.
Author: Marilyn Monroe

Quote: The future is now. It's time to grow up and be strong. Tomorrow may well be too late.
Author: Neil LaBute,  Reasons to Be Pretty

Quote: Respect was invented to cover the empty place where love should be.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Quote: Very few of us are what we seem.
Author: Agatha Christie,  The Man in the Mist

Quote: Anyone whose goal is 'something higher' must expect someday to suffer vertigo. What is vertigo? Fear of falling? No, Vertigo is something other than fear of falling. It is the voice of the emptiness below us which tempts and lures us, it is the desire to fall, against which, terrified, we defend ourselves.
Author: Milan Kundera,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

Quote: Your success depends mainly upon what you think of yourself and whether you believe in yourself.
Author: William J. H. Boetcker

Quote: Watching John Lasseter's films, I think I can understand better than anyone that what he's doing, is going straight ahead with his vision and working really hard to get that vision into film form. And I feel that my understanding this of him is my friendship towards him.
Author: Hayao Miyazaki

Quote: Not without hope we suffer and we mourn.
Author: William Wordsworth

Quote: You may not be able to change a situation, but with humor you can change your attitude about it.
Author: Allen Klein

Quote: For those who have made the ultimate sacrifice, we are grateful that such men and women were among us. For those who continue to serve, we honor their commitment. For those who return to civilian life, we honor their service.
Author: Steve Buyer

Quote: Love in its essence is spiritual fire.
Author: Lucius Annaeus Seneca

Quote: The educator must believe in the potential power of his pupil, and he must employ all his art in seeking to bring his pupil to experience this power.
Author: Alfred Adler

Quote: Little by little, one travels far
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien

Quote: You see I usually find myself among strangers because I drift here and there trying to forget the sad things that happened to me.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  The Great Gatsby

Quote: I restore myself when I'm alone.
Author: Marilyn Monroe

Quote: I just want to be wonderful.
Author: Marilyn Monroe

Quote: You're something between a dream and a miracle.
Author: Elizabeth Barrett Browning

Quote: Oh, we're playing nice now? Shall we have tea first? Brew up a nice pot of kiss-my-ass?
Author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron King

Quote: I got schooled this yearbyaboy.A boy that I'm seriously, deeply, madly, incredibly, and undeniably in  love  with.And he taught me the most important thing of all...To put the emphasisOn  life .
Author: Colleen Hoover,  Slammed

Quote: Don't waste your time with explanations: people only hear what they want to hear.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Don't waste your time with explanations: people only hear what they want to hear.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Moths,"repeats Will. "You're afraid of moths?""Not just a cloud of moths,"she says, "like...a swarm of them. Everywhere. All those wings and legs and..."She shudders and shakes her head."Terrifying,"Will says with mock seriousness. "That's my girl. Tough as cotton balls.""Oh, Shut up.
Author: Veronica Roth,  Divergent

Quote: The Very first moment I beheld him, my heart was irrevocably gone.
Author: Jane Austen,  Love and Friendship

Quote: Time was passing like a hand waving from a train I wanted to be on. I hope you never have to think about anything as much as I think about you.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer

Quote: Time was passing like a hand waving from a train I wanted to be on. I hope you never have to think about anything as much as I think about you.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer

Quote: A mother is the truest friend we have, when trials heavy and sudden fall upon us; when adversity takes the place of prosperity; when friends desert us; when trouble thickens around us, still will she cling to us, and endeavor by her kind precepts and counsels to dissipate the clouds of darkness, and cause peace to return to our hearts.
Author: Washington Irving

Quote: Once you have read a book you care about, some part of it is always with you.
Author: Louis L'Amour,  Matagorda/The First Fast Draw

Quote: Once you have read a book you care about, some part of it is always with you.
Author: Louis L'Amour,  Matagorda/The First Fast Draw

Quote: You must write every single day of your life... You must lurk in libraries and climb the stacks like ladders to sniff books like perfumes and wear books like hats upon your crazy heads... may you be in love every day for the next 20,000 days. And out of that love, remake a world.
Author: Ray Bradbury

Quote: Yes, I was infatuated with you: I am still. No one has ever heightened such a keen capacity of physical sensation in me. I cut you out because I couldn't stand being a passing fancy. Before I give my body, I must give my thoughts, my mind, my dreams. And you weren't having any of those.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: The best books... are those that tell you what you know already.
Author: George Orwell,  1984

Quote: One must dare to be happy.
Author: Gertrude Stein

Quote: Holding anger is a poison...It eats you from inside...We think that by hating someone we hurt them...But hatred is a curved blade...and the harm we do to others...we also do to ourselves.
Author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

Quote: Being with you never felt wrong. It's the one thing I did right. You're the one thing I did right.
Author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Crescendo

Quote: From childhood's hour I have not been. As others were, I have not seen. As others saw, I could not awaken. My heart to joy at the same tone. And all I loved, I loved alone.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: That's what careless words do. They make people love you a little less.
Author: Arundhati Roy,  The God of Small Things

Quote: Success represents the 1% of your work which results from the 99% that is called failure.
Author: Soichiro Honda

Quote: One friend in a lifetime is much, two are many, three are hardly possible. Friendship needs a certain parallelism of life, a community of thought, a rivalry of aim.
Author: Henry Adams

Quote: The care of the Earth is our most ancient and most worthy, and after all our most pleasing responsibility. To cherish what remains of it and to foster its renewal is our only hope.
Author: Wendell Berry

Quote: Good planning is important. I've also regarded a sense of humor as one of the most important things on a big expedition. When you're in a difficult or dangerous situation, or when you're depressed about the chances of success, someone who can make you laugh eases the tension.
Author: Edmund Hillary

Quote: Good planning is important. I've also regarded a sense of humor as one of the most important things on a big expedition. When you're in a difficult or dangerous situation, or when you're depressed about the chances of success, someone who can make you laugh eases the tension.
Author: Edmund Hillary

Quote: If you spend your whole life waiting for the storm, you'll never enjoy the sunshine.
Author: Morris West

Quote: Love is suffering. One side always loves more.
Author: Catherine Deneuve

Quote: My philosophy is that I'm an artist. I perform an art not with a paint brush or a camera. I perform with bodily movement. Instead of exhibiting my art in a museum or a book or on canvas, I exhibit my art in front of the multitudes.
Author: Steve Prefontaine

Quote: Kindred spirits are not so scarce as I used to think. It's splendid to find out there are so many of them in the world.
Author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of Green Gables

Quote: The trouble is not that I am single and likely to stay single, but that I am lonely and likely to stay lonely.
Author: Charlotte Brontë

Quote: Everything must be made as simple as possible. But not simpler.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: It's not worth doing something unless someone, somewhere, would much rather you weren't doing it.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: Alec looked at her and shook his head. "How do you manage never to get mud on your clothes?"Isabelle shrugged philosophically. "I'm pure at heart. It repels the dirt.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

Quote: It crosses my mind that Cinna's calm and normal demeanor masks a complete madman.
Author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

Quote: To err is human, to forgive, divine.
Author: Alexander Pope,  An Essay on Criticism

Quote: Fashion is a form of ugliness so intolerable that we have to alter it every six months.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: But I don't want comfort. I want God, I want poetry, I want real danger, I want freedom, I want goodness. I want sin.
Author: Aldous Huxley,  Brave New World

Quote: A man is but the product of his thoughts. What he thinks, he becomes.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: There is only one sin. and that is theft... when you tell a lie, you steal someones right to the truth.
Author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner

Quote: We dream in our waking moments, and walk in our sleep.
Author: Nathaniel Hawthorne,  The Scarlet Letter

Quote: District 12: Where you can starve to death in safety.
Author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

Quote: Life is a mirror: if you frown at it, it frowns back; if you smile, it returns the greeting.
Author: William Makepeace Thackeray

Quote: Luxury is the wolf at the door and its fangs are the vanities and conceits germinated by success. When an artist learns this, he knows where the danger is.
Author: Tennessee Williams

Quote: Love is flower like; Friendship is like a sheltering tree.
Author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

Quote: My goal is to be the best quarterback I can be for the Colts, and hope that it's good enough.
Author: Andrew Luck

Quote: If you can get humor and seriousness at the same time, you've created a special little thing, and that's what I'm looking for, because if you get pompous, you lose everything.
Author: Paul Simon

Quote: It is my goal to love everyone. I hate no one. Regardless of their race, religion, their proclivities, the desire of their heart and how they want to live their life and the decisions that they make. I can even respect people's decisions and lifestyle choices just as I hope they have the courtesy to respect my decisions and my choices.
Author: Kirk Cameron

Regardless of their race, religion, their proclivities, the desire of their heart and how they want to live their life and the decisions that they make. I can even respect people's decisions and lifestyle choices just as I hope they have the courtesy to respect my decisions and my choices.

Quote: Don't threaten me with love, baby. Let's just go walking in the rain.
Author: Billie Holiday

Quote: Art is much less important than life, but what a poor life without it.
Author: Robert Motherwell

Quote: ...you can hate a place with all your heart and soul and still be homesick for it.
Author: Joseph Mitchell

Quote: This is where it all begins. Everything starts here, today.
Author: David Nicholls,  One Day

Quote: This is where it all begins. Everything starts here, today.
Author: David Nicholls,  One Day

Quote: When people talk, listen completely. Most people never listen.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: People demand freedom of speech as a compensation for the freedom of thought which they seldom use.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard

Quote: Being a nerd, which is to say going too far and caring too much about a subject, is the best way to make friends I know.
Author: Sarah Vowell,  The Partly Cloudy Patriot

Quote: This is a new year. A new beginning. And things will change.
Author: Taylor Swift

Quote: I meant,"said Ipslore bitterly, "what is there in this world that truly makes living worthwhile?"Death thought about it.CATS, he said eventually. CATS ARE NICE.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Sourcery

Quote: I meant,"said Ipslore bitterly, "what is there in this world that truly makes living worthwhile?"Death thought about it.CATS, he said eventually. CATS ARE NICE.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Sourcery

Quote: It's going to be all right, sir,"Harry said over and over again, more worried by Dumbledore's silence than he had been by his weakened voice. "We're nearly there ... I can Apparate us both back ... don't worry ...""I am not worried, Harry,"said Dumbledore, his voice a little stronger despite the freezing water. "I am with you.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

Quote: Of course motivation is not permanent. But then, neither is bathing; but it is something you should do on a regular basis.
Author: Zig Ziglar,  Raising Positive Kids in a Negative World

Quote: The mind once enlightened cannot again become dark.
Author: Thomas Paine,  A Letter Addressed to the Abbe Raynal on the Affairs of North America

Quote: The mind once enlightened cannot again become dark.
Author: Thomas Paine,  A Letter Addressed to the Abbe Raynal on the Affairs of North America

Quote: I wish I were a girl again, half-savage and hardy, and free.
Author: Emily Brontë,  Wuthering Heights

Quote: If death meant just leaving the stage long enough to change costume and come back as a new character...Would you slow down? Or speed up?
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Invisible Monsters

Quote: I guess that's what saying good-bye is always like--like jumping off an edge. The worst part is making the choice to do it. Once you're in the air, there's nothing you can do but let go.
Author: Lauren Oliver,  Before I Fall

Quote: Every weirdo in the world is on my wavelength.
Author: Thomas Pynchon

Quote: If you let people into your life a little bit, they can be pretty damn amazing.
Author: Sherman Alexie,  The Absolutely True Diary of a Part-Time Indian

Quote: Life is a beautiful magnificent thing, even to a jellyfish.
Author: Charlie Chaplin

Quote: Without you in my arms, I feel an emptiness in my soul. I find myself searching the crowds for your face - I know it's an impossibility, but I cannot help myself.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Message in a Bottle

Quote: A word after a word after a word is power.
Author: Margaret Atwood

Quote: I think that my biggest attribute to any success that I have had is hard work. There really is no substitute for working hard.
Author: Maria Bartiromo

Quote: In the family, in interpersonal relationships, even in friendship, faith is tremendously important. If you have a partner who you believe is a good person, then it is your duty to have faith in them until the end, despite the fact that they might have done some bad things. And you have to support and believe in your children.
Author: Greg Graffin

Quote: Many possessions, if they do not make a man better, are at least expected to make his children happier; and this pathetic hope is behind many exertions.
Author: George Santayana

Quote: Humor is the most engaging cowardice.
Author: Robert Frost

Quote: You make a choice in your life, and it affects your life in all the ways, good and bad.
Author: John Mayer

Quote: More than kisses, letters mingle souls.
Author: John Donne

Quote: Everyone discusses my art and pretends to understand, as if it were necessary to understand, when it is simply necessary to love.
Author: Claude Monet

Quote: She looked at nice young men as if she could smell their stupidity.
Author: Flannery O'Connor

Quote: Ignorance killed the cat; curiosity was framed!
Author: C.J. Cherryh

Quote: You endure what is unbearable, and you bear it. That is all.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Princess

Quote: Someone I loved once gave me a box full of darkness. It took me years to understand that this too, was a gift.
Author: Mary Oliver

Quote: Only those who will risk going too far can possibly find out how far one can go.
Author: T.S. Eliot

Quote: I like good strong words that mean something…
Author: Louisa May Alcott,  Little Women

Quote: Don't bend; don't water it down; don't try to make it logical; don't edit your own soul according to the fashion. Rather, follow your most intense obsessions mercilessly.
Author: Franz Kafka

Quote: Try to be a rainbow in someone's cloud.
Author: Maya Angelou,  Letter to My Daughter

Quote: We are always the same age inside.
Author: Gertrude Stein

Quote: You believe in a book that has talking animals, wizards, witches, demons, sticks turning into snakes, burning bushes, food falling from the sky, people walking on water, and all sorts of magical, absurd and primitive stories, and you say that we are the ones that need help?
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Knowing too much of your future is never a good thing.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

Quote: You can cut all the flowers but you cannot keep Spring from coming.
Author: Pablo Neruda

Quote: Have you ever lost someone you love and wanted one more conversation, one more chance to make up for the time when you thought they would be here forever? If so, then you know you can go your whole life collecting days, and none will outweigh the one you wish you had back.
Author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

Quote: Do I contradict myself? Very well, then, I contradict myself; I am large -- I contain multitudes.
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: Trains are great dirty smoky things,"said Will. "You won't like it."Tessa was unmoved. Author: Alyson Noel,  Evermore

Author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

Author: Pablo Neruda

Author: Albert Einstein

Author: Bob Newhart

And in resisting untruth, I shall put up with all suffering.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Author: Virginia Woolf

Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Author: Nicole Krauss,  The History of Love

Author: Bill Vaughan

Author: Jacob Riis

Author: Mae West

Author: Maya Angelou

Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Essays, Letters and Miscellanies

Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Guardian

Author: Charlotte Bronte

Purged of both hope and fear, we find courage in the face of helplessness, insignificance and uncertainty.

Author: Lucille Ball

Author: Rumi

Author: Abraham Lincoln

Author: Phyllis McGinley

Quote: I am too fond of reading books to care to write them.

Author: L.J. Smith,  Secret Vampire

Author: Maya Angelou

Author: Karen Blixen

Author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Old Man and the Sea

Author: Anthony Burgess

Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Author: Gertrude Stein

Author: Tryon Edwards

I feel like there's a lot of information there and you can really bring those emotions to the situations that may feel mundane or familiar. That gives them new life and gives you a new relationship with it - if that makes any sort of sense.
Author: Jennifer Carpenter

Author: Jimi Hendrix

Author: E.E. Cummings

Author: Ernest Hemingway

Author: Henry Thomas Buckle

Author: Robin Williams

Author: Confucius

Author: Chuck Palahniuk

Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Quote: Can you understand? Someone, somewhere, can you understand me a little, love me a little? For all my despair, for all my ideals, for all that - I love life. But it is hard, and I have so much - so very much to learn.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: Ultimately, leadership is not about glorious crowning acts. It's about keeping your team focused on a goal and motivated to do their best to achieve it, especially when the stakes are high and the consequences really matter. It is about laying the groundwork for others' success, and then standing back and letting them shine.
Author: Chris Hadfield

Author: Georg Brandes

You've got to realize that that's where your trust comes in. You have to trust God, and keep your hope, because your hope is what produces your faith.
Author: Victoria Osteen

Quote: To deprive a man of his natural liberty and to deny to him the ordinary amenities of life is worse then starving the body; it is starvation of the soul, the dweller in the body.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: Heaven grant us patience with a man in love.
Author: Rudyard Kipling

Quote: I like girls who are funny with a warped sense of humor.
Author: Robert Buckley

Author: Henry Moore

Quote: Laugh all you want and cry all you want and whistle at pretty men in the street and to hell with anybody who thinks you're a damned fool!

Quote: I will take the sun in my mouthand leap into the ripe air Alive with closed eyesto dash against darkness
Author: E.E. Cummings,  Poems, 1923-1954

Author: Kate Chopin,  The Awakening

Author: John Henry Newman

Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

That deep part of you that allows you to stand for those things without which humankind cannot survive. Love that conquers hate, peace that rises triumphant over war, and justice that proves more powerful than greed.
Author: Fred Rogers

Author: Curtis Sittenfeld,  Prep

Author: Kathleen Winsor

Author: Coco Chanel

Author: Judy Garland

Author: Paul Bloom

Author: Farrah Fawcett

Author: Paul Klee

Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Fallen Angels

Quote: It's so strange how life works: You want something and you wait and wait and feel like it's taking forever to come. Then it happens and it's over and all you want to do is curl back up in that moment before things changed.
Author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

Author: Lemony Snicket,  The Slippery Slope

Author: Joseph Joubert

When Will says 'enterprising' he means 'morally deficient.'""No, I mean enterprising,"said Will. "When I mean morally deficient, I say, 'Now, that's something I would have done'.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

Author: Gustave Flaubert

Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want Two apply for a job at our country's largest funeral home, and then wear a suit and noose to the job interview.

Author: Virginia Woolf

Author: William Shakespeare

Author: William Collins

Author: Khalil Gibran

Author: Seán O'Casey

Author: Irvine Welsh,  Porno

On the contrary, if I have the belief that I can do it, I shall surely acquire the capacity to do it even if I may not have it at the beginning.

Author: Lloyd Alexander,  The Black Cauldron

Author: Action Bronson

Author: Charles de Montesquieu

Author: Isaac Bashevis Singer

Author: Stephen Chbosky,  The Perks of Being a Wallflower

Author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

Quote: if you love two people at the same time, choose the second. Because if you really loved the first one, you wouldn't have fallen for the second.
Author: Johnny Depp

Quote: Books are no more threatened by Kindle than stairs by elevators.
Author: Stephen Fry

Quote: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.

Quote: When I do good, I feel good. When I do bad, I feel bad. That's my religion.
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: My wish is that you may be loved to the point of madness.
Author: André Breton,  What is Surrealism?: Selected Writings

Quote: When the enemy has no face, society will invent one.
Author: Susan Faludi

Quote: Whenever you feel like criticizing any one...just remember that all the people in this world haven't had the advantages that you've had.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

We'd never go in business because we'd be cynical: "It's gonna go wrong."Or "She's going to hurt me."Or,"I've had a couple of bad love affairs, so therefore . . ."Well, that's nonsense. You're going to miss life. You've got to jump off the cliff all the time and build your wings on the way down.
Author: Ray Bradbury

Author: Rodney Dangerfield

He stomped towardme, planting his hands on the bed and leaning into my face.“WELL I BELONG TO YOU!” The veins in his neckbulged as he shouted, and I met his glare, refusing to evenflinch. He looked at my lips, panting. “I belong to you.
Author: Jamie McGuire,  Beautiful Disaster

Quote: لا تقدم ابداً شروحاً لأحد.. أصدقاؤك الحقيقيون ليسوا فى حاجة إليها و أعداؤك لن يصدقوها
Author: أحلام مستغانمي,  com نسيان

Quote: The most terrible poverty is loneliness, and the feeling of being unloved.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: Inspirational leaders need to have a winning mentality in order to inspire respect. It is hard to trust in the leadership of someone who is half-hearted about their purpose, or only sporadic in focus or enthusiasm.
Author: Sebastian Coe

Quote: Just remember: to be grateful and thank the people who are there and support you along the way is a great start to success.
Author: Meryl Davis

And I like you and I don't want to compromise our friendship.'
Author: Trent Reznor

Quote: Well I certainly have learned and I hope I'm moving on and certainly two years of prison was a terrible punishment.
Author: Jeffrey Archer

Quote: I think a big test we all face in life on a regular basis is that discouragement test. Life's not always fair, but I believe if you keep doing the right thing, God will get you to where you are.
Author: Joel Osteen

Quote: It is cruel, you know, that music should be so beautiful. It has the beauty of loneliness of pain: of strength and freedom. The beauty of disappointment and never-satisfied love. The cruel beauty of nature and everlasting beauty of monotony.
Author: Benjamin Britten

Quote: Those who knew Lincoln described him as an extraordinarily funny man. Humor was an essential aspect of his temperament. He laughed, he explained, so he did not weep.
Author: Doris Kearns Goodwin

Quote: What I wish to show when I paint is the way I see things with my eyes and in my heart.
Author: Raoul Dufy

Quote: I am not interested in being original. I am interested in being true.
Author: Agostinho da Silva

Quote: Every couple needs to argue now and then. Just to prove that the relationship is strong enough to survive. Long-term relationships, the ones that matter, are all about weathering the peaks and the valleys.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Safe Haven

Quote: If you ever meet the man who could take advantage of Isabelle, you’ll have to let me know. I’d like to shake his hand. Or run away from him very fast, I’m not sure which.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Glass

Quote: What I've come to learn is that the world is never saved in grand messianic gestures, but in the simple accumulation of gentle, soft, almost invisible acts of compassion.
Author: Chris Abani

Quote: Book collecting is an obsession, an occupation, a disease, an addiction, a fascination, an absurdity, a fate. It is not a hobby. Those who do it must do it. Those who do not do it, think of it as a cousin of stamp collecting, a sister of the trophy cabinet, bastard of a sound bank account and a weak mind.

Quote: Men go to far greater lengths to avoid what they fear than to obtain what they desire.
Author: Dan Brown,  The Da Vinci Code

Quote: We are who we are, be­cause of those we choose to love and be­cause of those who love us.
Author: Kate Mosse,  The Winter Ghosts

You're like a song that I heard when I was a little kid but forgot I knew until I heard it again."For a long moment there was only the whirring sound of the tires on the road, and then Sam said softly, "Thank you.
Author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Shiver

Quote: The truth will set you free. But not until it is finished with you.
Author: David Foster Wallace,  Infinite Jest

Quote: Shoot for the moon. Even if you miss, you'll land among the stars.
Author: Norman Vincent Peale

Quote: Kind people have a way of working their way inside me and rooting there.
Author: Suzanne Collins,  The Hunger Games

Quote: God alert!"Blackjack yelled. "It's the wine dude!Mr. D sighed in exasperation. "The next person, or horse, who calls me the 'wine dude' will end up in a bottle of Merlot!
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Titan's Curse

Quote: It's the job that's never started as takes longest to finish.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Lord of the Rings

Quote: The easy confidence with which I know another man's religion is folly teaches me to suspect that my own is also.
Author: Mark Twain

Author: Isaac Asimov

Author: C.S. Lewis

Author: George Lucas

Quote: Success is a sort of metaphysical experience. I live exactly as I did before - only on a slightly bigger scale. Naturally, I won't be corrupted. I'll sit there in my Rolls, uncorrupted, and tell my chauffeur, uncorruptedly, where to go.
Author: Tom Stoppard

Quote: Primarily, 'Black Girl/White Girl' is the story of two very different, yet somehow 'fated' girls; for Genna, her 'friendship' with Minette is the most haunting of her life, though it is one-sided and ends in tragedy.

Quote: I hope we're all kind of influencing each other now to keep the quality up on those things. They seem to be getting better and better and better as there's not only sort of a film geek audience, there's also a general interest in the overall film consuming population.
Author: Jay Roach

Quote: A successful life is one that is lived through understanding and pursuing one's own path, not chasing after the dreams of others.
Author: Chin-Ning Chu

Quote: Unconditional love really exists in each of us. It is part of our deep inner being. It is not so much an active emotion as a state of being. It's not 'I love you' for this or that reason, not 'I love you if you love me.' It's love for no reason, love without an object.
Author: Ram Dass

Quote: I like guys who have a plan or a dream. A good sense of humor is also a must. I can be weird with my humor and say things that are random. You need to understand that I'm really goofy and go with it.
Author: Edy Ganem

Quote: My painting does not come from the easel.

Quote: Wounds turn into scars and scars make you tough.
Author: Aisha Tyler

Quote: It's hard to enjoy practical jokes when your whole life feels like one.

Quote: Be happy for this moment. This moment is your life.

Quote: Life is like a prism. What you see depends on how you turn the glass.
Author: Jonathan Kellerman

Quote: Love can make even nice people do awful things.
Author: Jude Deveraux

Quote: The most beautiful things in the world cannot be seen or touched, they are felt with the heart.
Author: Antoine de Saint-Exupéry,  The Little Prince

Quote: If you have enough book space, I don't want to talk to you.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: You can go through life and make new friends every year - every month practically - but there was never any substitute for those friendships of childhood that survive into adult years. Those are the ones in which we are bound to one another with hoops of steel.
Author: Alexander McCall Smith,  The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency

Quote: Always be a poet, even in prose.
Author: Charles Baudelaire

Quote: Always be a poet, even in prose.
Author: Charles Baudelaire

Quote: We can't be afraid of change. You may feel very secure in the pond that you are in, but if you never venture out of it, you will never know that there is such a thing as an ocean, a sea. Holding onto something that is good for you now, may be the very reason why you don't have something better.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: There's something ugly about the flawless.
Author: Dennis Lehane,  Sacred

Quote: Music is ... A higher revelation than all Wisdom & Philosophy
Author: Ludwig van Beethoven

Quote: Music is ... A higher revelation than all Wisdom & Philosophy
Author: Ludwig van Beethoven

Quote: Intelligence plus character-that is the goal of true education.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.

Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

Quote: Dimitri: "Why did you come here?"Rose: "Because you hit me on the head and dragged me here.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Blood Promise

Quote: Your lucky enough to be different, never change

Quote: He was the crazy one who had painted himself black and defeated the world.She was the book thief without the words.Trust me, though, the words were on their way, and when they arrived, Liesel would hold them in her hands like the clouds, and she would wring them out like rain.

Author: Stephen Hawking

Author: Prince Royce

Quote: People of mediocre ability sometimes achieve outstanding success because they don't know when to quit. Most men succeed because they are determined to.
Author: George Allen, Sr.

Author: Charles de Lint

Quote: Creativity comes from trust. Trust your instincts. And never hope more than you work.
Author: Rita Mae Brown

Quote: Little white lies are part of everyday life. If you're in court being charged with a felony, you're probably going to be tempted to lie. Or if your girlfriend asks you if the sweater she is wearing makes her look fat; you're going to lie because you love that person. There are different reasons and justifications to lie; it's human nature.
Author: Monica Raymund

Author: Henri Matisse

Author: Sue Grafton

Author: Anna Akhmatova,  The Complete Poems of Anna Akhmatova

I want to go too!"And with his last measure of strength, McKinley turned to her and spoke his last words: "We are all going.

Quote: Survival was my only hope, success my only revenge.

Author: Marcus Aurelius

Author: W.B. Yeats

Author: Albert Camus,  A Happy Death

Author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

Author: Hunter S. Thompson

Author: Robert Frost

Quote: Got that gun?” Peter says to Tobias. “No,” says Tobias, “I figured I would shoot the bullets out of my nostrils, so I left it upstairs.
Author: Veronica Roth,  Insurgent

Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Author: Leo Tolstoy

Author: Khloe Kardashian

Author: Oscar Wilde

Author: Oscar Wilde,  Lady Windermere's Fan

Author: Harry Seidler

Author: H. Jackson Brown, Jr.

Quote: I had three chairs in my house; one for solitude, two for friendship, three for society.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Author: Sharron Angle
