Quote: For never was a story of more woe than this of Juliet and her Romeo.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: I'm not in search of sanctity, sacredness, purity; these things are found after this life, not in this life; but in this life I search to be completely human: to feel, to give, to take, to laugh, to get lost, to be found, to dance, to love and to lust, to be so human.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Author: Emmett F. Fields

Quote: One should never trust a woman who tells one her real age. A woman who would tell one that would tell one anything.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: I have never made but one prayer to God, a very short one: Oh Lord, make my enemies ridiculous. And God granted it."(Letter to Étienne Noël Damilaville, May 16, 1767)
Author: Voltaire

Author: Unknown

Author: James Allen

Quote: All you have in comedy, in general, is just going with your instincts. You can only hope that other people think that what you think is funny is funny. I don't have an answer but I just try to plough straight ahead.
Author: Will Ferrell

Quote: Where would you be without friends? The people to pick you up when you need lifting? We come from homes far from perfect, so you end up almost parent and sibling to your friends - your own chosen family. There's nothing like a really loyal, dependable, good friend. Nothing.
Author: Jennifer Aniston

Quote: You may not always have a comfortable life and you will not always be able to solve all of the world's problems at once but don't ever underestimate the importance you can have because history has shown us that courage can be contagious and hope can take on a life of its own.
Author: Michelle Obama

Quote: Red is such an interesting color to correlate with emotion, because it's on both ends of the spectrum. On one end you have happiness, falling in love, infatuation with someone, passion, all that. On the other end, you've got obsession, jealousy, danger, fear, anger and frustration.
Author: Taylor Swift

Quote: Life is never all one thing. It bounces around. Certainly, my own life has. Look at Woody Allen's funny movies - all the humor comes out of sad stuff. Sometimes you have to laugh, no matter what life deals you.
Author: Tim O'Brien

Quote: A rose is the visible result of an infinitude of complicated goings on in the bosom of the earth and in the air above, and similarly a work of art is the product of strange activities in the human mind.
Author: Clive Bell

Quote: So much good, so much evil. Just add water.
Author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

Quote: This planet has - or rather had - a problem, which was this: most of the people living on it were unhappy for pretty much of the time. Many solutions were suggested for this problem, but most of these were largely concerned with the movement of small green pieces of paper, which was odd because on the whole it wasn't the small green pieces of paper that were unhappy.
Author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

Quote: Last time I saw you, I said that it hurt too much to love you. But I was wrong about that. The truth is it hurts too much not to love you.
Author: P.C. Cast

Quote: Resentment is like drinking poison and then hoping it will kill your enemies.
Author: Nelson Mandela

Quote: Live not for Battles Won.Live not for The-End-of-the-Song. Live in the along.
Author: Gwendolyn Brooks,  Report from Part One

Quote: Your life is an occasion. Rise to it.
Author: Suzanne Weyn,  Mr. Magorium's Wonder Emporium

Quote: How far should a person go in the name of true love?
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Choice

Quote: With all its sham, drudgery, and broken dreams,it is still a beautiful world.Be cheerful.Strive to be happy.
Author: Max Ehrmann,  Desiderata: A Poem for a Way of Life

Author: Jodi Picoult,  Keeping Faith

Quote: Of course it hurt that we could never love each other in a physical way. We would have been far more happy if we had. But that was like the tides, the change of seasons--something immutable, an immovable destiny we could never alter. No matter how cleverly we might shelter it, our delicate friendship wasn't going to last forever. We were bound to reach a dead end. That was painfully clear.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Sputnik Sweetheart

Quote: nothing in this world was more difficult than love.

Author: Nalo Hopkinson,  Brown Girl in the Ring

Quote: Never dull your shine for somebody else.
Author: Tyra Banks

Quote: A #2 pencil and a dream can take you anywhere.
Author: Joyce Meyer

Quote: The biggest start-up successes - from Henry Ford to Bill Gates to Mark Zuckerberg - were pioneered by people from solidly middle-class backgrounds. These founders were not wealthy when they began. They were hungry for success, but knew they had a solid support system to fall back on if they failed.
Author: Eric Ries

Quote: We need to move into a culture of peace. What I hope to promote is the idea that we all need each other and that the greatest happiness in life is not how much we have but how much we give. That's a wealth that's priceless. You can't buy compassion.
Author: Herbie Hancock

Quote: Lovers have a right to betray you... friends don't.
Author: Judy Holliday

Quote: Our heavenly Father understands our disappointment, suffering, pain, fear, and doubt. He is always there to encourage our hearts and help us understand that He's sufficient for all of our needs. When I accepted this as an absolute truth in my life, I found that my worrying stopped.
Author: Charles Stanley

Quote: I love sleep. My life has the tendency to fall apart when I'm awake, you know?
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: Texas humor and Southern humor are pretty similar.
Author: Daniel Woodrell

Quote: Society is like a large piece of frozen water; and skating well is the great art of social life.
Author: Letitia Elizabeth Landon

Quote: The funniest people are the saddest ones
Author: Confucius

Quote: It is easy enough to be friendly to one's friends. But to befriend the one who regards himself as your enemy is the quintessence of true religion. The other is mere business.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: Accept the things to which fate binds you, and love the people with whom fate brings you together,but do so with all your heart.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: We kiss all the time."I clear my throat, then add, "We just...do it in private.""A smug expression crosses his face. "I don't buy it for a second, 'cause if you were my girlfriend and a stud like me was livin' in your house, I'd kiss you in front of the guy every chance I got as a reminder.""A reminder of w-w-what?""That you were mine.
Author: Simone Elkeles,  Rules of Attraction

Author: Georgia O'Keeffe

Author: Chance The Rapper

Quote: I do hope that our spring will be starting shortly and we will all be able to enjoy some sunshine again.
Author: Lesley Garrett

Quote: Our most intimate friend is not he to whom we show the worst, but the best of our nature.
Author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

Quote: Too often in life, something happens and we blame other people for us not being happy or satisfied or fulfilled. So the point is, we all have choices, and we make the choice to accept people or situations or to not accept situations.
Author: Tom Brady

Quote: My friends and family are my support system. They tell me what I need to hear, not what I want to hear and they are there for me in the good and bad times. Without them I have no idea where I would be and I know that their love for me is what's keeping my head above the water.
Author: Kelly Clarkson

Quote: I can't begin to tell you how fulfilling the perennial nature of 'Elf' on television has been for me. It's great to be able to connect parents with children both emotionally and through humor.
Author: Jon Favreau

Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

Author: Nicholas Sparks,  A Walk to Remember

Quote: A good writer possesses not only his own spirit but also the spirit of his friends.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: The Christian ideal has not been tried and found wanting. It has been found difficult; and left untried.
Author: G.K. Chesterton,  What's Wrong with the World

Quote: You were given life; it is your duty (and also your entitlement as a human being) to find something beautiful within life, no matter how slight.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert

Quote: I have often wished I had time to cultivate modesty...But I am too busy thinking about myself.
Author: Edith Sitwell

Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban

Quote: Don't ever take a fence down until you know why it was put up.
Author: Robert Frost

Quote: Love. The reason I dislike that word is that it means too much for me, far more than you can understand."- Anna Karenina {Anna Karenina}
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Author: George Eliot

Quote: It goes without saying that it's hard to attain a certain level of success.
Author: T.I.

Quote: I never make a movie for awards consideration. I will use the hope of getting an Academy Award a) to honor the people who work so hard and also b) it's the greatest Good Housekeeping seal in the world. It's the greatest brand. It's as good as Louis Vuitton and Dior in the world of moviemaking. It's the Super Bowl.
Author: Harvey Weinstein

Quote: Never do a wrong thing to make a friend or to keep one.
Author: Robert E. Lee

Quote: The greatest thing about where my life is right now is it's very relaxed and chill. I'm just hanging out, being myself and doing my work.
Author: Lucas Grabeel

Quote: A deep sense of love and belonging is an irreducible need of all people. We are biologically, cognitively, physically, and spiritually wired to love, to be loved, and to belong. When those needs are not met, we don't function as we were meant to. We break. We fall apart. We numb. We ache. We hurt others. We get sick.
Author: Brene Brown

Quote: The ultimate storyteller is Shakespeare, who was able to get the 'groundlings' to laugh at his bawdy humor and storylines but could still be studied by scholars to this day for the complexity of his language, meter, and symbolism. That's the real guy.
Author: Jon Favreau

Quote: I think it's difficult to do fashion for men, because either you become very over-homosexual fashion or very boring fashion. You don't want a boy who looks 15 in a little pair of shorts with some strange art... But to see just a jacket and tie is boring.
Author: Carine Roitfeld

Quote: To love is to suffer. To avoid suffering one must not love. But then one suffers from not loving. Therefore, to love is to suffer; not to love is to suffer; to suffer is to suffer. To be happy is to love. To be happy, then, is to suffer, but suffering makes one unhappy. Therefore, to be happy one must love or love to suffer or suffer from too much happiness.
Author: Woody Allen

I hope they didn't kick you our or anything.""Nah. They asked me a lot of questions about you. I played dumb.""Was it hard?"Annabeth asked.

Quote: If this is going to be a Christian nation that doesn't help the poor, either we have to pretend that Jesus was just as selfish as we are, or we've got to acknowledge that He commanded us to love the poor and serve the needy without condition and then admit that we just don't want to do it.

Quote: great writers are indecent peoplethey live unfairlysaving the best part for paper.good human beings save the worldso that bastards like me can keep creating art,become immortal.if you read this after I am deadit means I made it.

Author: Charlotte Brontë,  Jane Eyre

Quote: I, not events, have the power to make me happy or unhappy today. I can choose which it shall be. Yesterday is dead, tomorrow hasn't arrived yet. I have just one day, today, and I'm going to be happy in it.

Author: John Keats

Happiness is like a tree going into the sky, and sadness is like the roots going down into the womb of the earth. Both are needed, and the higher a tree goes, the deeper it goes, simultaneously. The bigger the tree, the bigger will be its roots. In fact, it is always in proportion. That's its balance.

Author: Terry Pratchett,  The Color of Magic

Author: David Foster Wallace,  Infinite Jest

Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: She walks in beauty, like the nightOf cloudless climes and starry skies;And all that's best of dark and brightMeet in her aspect and her eyes...
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: Magic exists. Who can doubt it, when there are rainbows and wildflowers, the music of the wind and the silence of the stars? Anyone who has loved has been touched by magic. It is such a simple and such an extraordinary part of the lives we live.
Author: Nora Roberts

Quote: Would it hurt to die?
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: If I could but know his heart, everything would become easy.
Author: Jane Austen,  Sense and Sensibility

Quote: God does not play dice with the universe.
Author: Albert Einstein,  The Born-Einstein Letters 1916-55

Quote: Each relationship between two persons is absolutely unique. That is why you cannot love two people the same. It simply is not possible. You love each person differently because of who they are and the uniqueness that they draw out of you.
Author: Wm. Paul Young,  The Shack

Quote: The universe is big, its vast and complicated, and ridiculous. And sometimes, very rarely, impossible things just happen and we call them miracles. And that's the theory. Nine hundred years, never seen one yet, but this would do me.
Author: Steven Moffat

Quote: Look, if you wanted to be babied you should have asked Peeta.
Author: Suzanne Collins,  Catching Fire

Quote: Imagination is the highest form of research.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: Ah coffee. The sweet balm by which we shall accomplish today's tasks.
Author: Holly Black,  Ironside

Quote: The meaning I picked, the one that changed my life: Overcome fear, behold wonder.
Author: Richard Bach

Quote: Nothing good comes in life or athletics unless a lot of hard work has preceded the effort. Only temporary success is achieved by taking short cuts.
Author: Roger Staubach

Quote: Anyone who thinks they can write the perfect comedy that everyone will love is a fool. I can only write what I think is funny and hope that there is a likeminded audience out there.
Author: Brendan O'Carroll

Quote: Every friendship goes through ups and downs. Dysfunctional patterns set in; external situations cause internal friction; you grow apart and then bounce back together.

Quote: You don't have to have anything in common with people you've known since you were five. With old friends, you've got your whole life in common.
Author: Lyle Lovett

Quote: '24' is a pretty serious show - there isn't a lot of improv that is happening. Having said that, I do play around with the delivery. A lot of the humor comes from playing a character who is very furious and really up in her own brain and in a serious situation. That is humorous to me.
Author: Mary Lynn Rajskub

Quote: A strong work of art really leaves people speechless. They feel a little angry because they don't understand it.

Quote: Loving someone and having them love you back is the most precious thing in the world.

Quote: If you're horrible to me, I'm going to write a song about it, and you won't like it. That's how I operate.
Author: Taylor Swift

Author: Emily Giffin,  Baby Proof

Author: Jorge Luis Borges

Author: Terry Pratchett

Author: Sarah Dessen,  Along for the Ride

Quote: You never know what's around the corner. It could be everything. Or it could be nothing. You keep putting one foot in front of the other, and then one day you look back and you've climbed a mountain.
Author: Tom Hiddleston

Quote: Successful people are always looking for opportunities to help others. Unsuccessful people are always asking, "What's in it for me?
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: I think true success is intrinsic... It's love. It's kindness. It's community.
Author: Tom Shadyac

Quote: I hope the BWF (Badminton World Federation) will seriously do something about the Olympic qualifying format or risk getting badminton dropped from the Games.
Author: Taufik Hidayat

Quote: To be poor does not mean you lack the means to extend charity to another. You may lack money or food, but you have the gift of friendship to overwhelm the loneliness that grips the lives of so many.
Author: Stanley Hauerwas

Quote: Life is one grand, sweet song, so start the music.
Author: Ronald Reagan

Quote: There are only really a few stories to tell in the end, and betrayal and the failure of love is one of those good stories to tell.
Author: Sean Lennon

Quote: We have always had gross humor. But we try for funny, not gross.
Author: Shawn Wayans

Quote: It is a law woven into the nature of man, attested by history, by science, by literature and art, and by dally experience, that strength of mind and force of character are the supreme rulers of human affairs.
Author: Lucius Quintus Cincinnatus Lamar II

Quote: There are people who are generic. They make generic responses and they expect generic answers. They live inside a box and they think people who don't fit into their box are weird. But I'll tell you what, generic people are the weird people. They are like genetically-manipulated plants growing inside a laboratory, like indistinguishable faces, like droids. Like ignorance.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Author: Tabitha Suzuma,  Forbidden

Author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

Author: Laurie Halse Anderson,  Speak

Author: Emma Stone

Author: King Felipe VI

Author: Oliver Goldsmith

Quote: Caregivers attract caregivers and live in a community of love. They are energized by their caring, fulfilled, and they love life. Caretakers attract caretakers and live in the company of resentful victims who see themselves as misused and are fatigued from constant giving with no return.
Author: Gary Zukav

All these things are qualities of survivors.

Author: Ernst F. Schumacher

Consider how lucky you are that life has been good to you so far. Alternatively, if life hasn't been good to you so far, which given your current circumstances seems more likely, consider how lucky you are that it won't be troubling you much longer.
Author: Douglas Adams,  The Original Hitchhiker Radio Scripts

Author: Lucy Larcom

Quote: I'm the one that has to die when it's time for me to die, so let me live my life, the way I want to.

Author: William Shakespeare

Author: Nicholas Stoller

Quote: We have been so successful in the past century at the art of living longer and staying alive that we have forgotten how to die. Too often we learn the hard way. As soon as the baby boomers pass pensionable age, their lesson will be harsher still.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: One of the things that makes me who I am is the loyalty I have to people I hold close to my heart.
Author: Simone Elkeles,  Perfect Chemistry

Quote: If I know what love is, it is because of you.
Author: Hermann Hesse

Author: Edgar Allan Poe,  Loss of Breath

Quote: Oft hope is born when all is forlorn.

Author: George Tenet

Author: Dalai Lama

Author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  A Little Princess

Quote: But remember, boy, that a kind act can sometimes be as powerful as a sword.

Author: Alfred Lord Tennyson,  Idylls of the King and a Selection of Poems

Quote: Dusk is just an illusion because the sun is either above the horizon or below it. And that means that day and night are linked in a way that few things are there cannot be one without the other yet they cannot exist at the same time. How would it feel I remember wondering to be always together yet forever apart?

Author: Orson Welles

Quote: I believe that what we become depends on what our fathers teach us at odd moments, when they aren't trying to teach us. We are formed by little scraps of wisdom.
Author: Umberto Eco,  Foucault's Pendulum

Author: C. JoyBell C.

Author: Bill Watterson,  Weirdos From Another Planet: Calvin & Hobbes Series: Book Six: A Calvin and Hobbes Collection

Quote: Second hand books are wild books, homeless books; they have come together in vast flocks of variegated feather, and have a charm which the domesticated volumes of the library lack.
Author: Virginia Woolf

Author: Jonathan Kellerman

Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Success is never final, but failure can be.
Author: Bill Parcells

Quote: I try to make my life about service, and hope that one day we can all 'see' a little better because God is with everyone and everywhere.

Author: Lee Westwood

Author: Ronald Reagan

Maybe, but I couldn't do it, I had buried too much too deeply inside me. And here I am, instead of there.

Quote: Heaven can be found in the most unlikely corners.

Quote: I’m bored’ is a useless thing to say. I mean, you live in a great, big, vast world that you’ve seen none percent of. Even the inside of your own mind is endless; it goes on forever, inwardly, do you understand? The fact that you’re alive is amazing, so you don’t get to say ‘I’m bored.
Author: Louis C.K.

Quote: I challenge anyone to understand Islam, its spirit, and not to love it. It is a beautiful religion of brotherhood and devotion.
Author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

Quote: Read not to contradict and confute; nor to believe and take for granted; nor to find talk and discourse; but to weigh and consider. Some books are to be tasted, others to be swallowed, and some few to be chewed and digested: that is, some books are to be read only in parts, others to be read, but not curiously, and some few to be read wholly, and with diligence and attention.
Author: Francis Bacon,  The Essays

Quote: It doesn't have to be on Valentine's Day. It doesn't have to be by the time you turn eighteen or thirty-three or fifty-nine. It doesn't have to conform to whatever is usual. It doesn't have to be kismet at once, or rhapsody by the third date.It just has to be. In time. In place. In spirit.It just has to be.

Quote: Things that matter are not easy. Feelings of happiness are easy. Happiness is not. Flirting is easy. Love is not. Saying you’re friends is easy. Being friends is not.
Author: David Levithan,  Naomi and Ely's No Kiss List

Author: Jon Stewart

It sounds too simple to be true, but consider the Great Wall of China, if you will: one stone at a time, man. That's all. One stone at a time. But I've read you can see that motherfucker from space without a telescope.

Quote: When you love you wish to do things for. You wish to sacrifice for. You wish to serve.

Quote: Such short little lives our pets have to spend with us, and they spend most of it waiting for us to come home each day. It is amazing how much love and laughter they bring into our lives and even how much closer we become with each other because of them.

Author: Megan McCafferty,  Sloppy Firsts

Quote: What about a compromise? I’ll kill them first, and if it turns out they were friendly, I’ll apologize.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Lost Hero

Quote: Happiness. It was the place where passion, with all its dazzle and drumbeat, met something softer: homecoming and safety and pure sunbeam comfort. It was all those things, intertwined with the heat and the thrill, and it was as bright within her as a swallowed star.
Author: Laini Taylor,  Daughter of Smoke & Bone

Quote: Failed relationships can be described as so much wasted make-up.
Author: Marian Keyes,  Watermelon

Author: Nicholas Sparks

Quote: Be believing, be happy, don't get discouraged. Things will work out.
Author: Gordon B. Hinckley

Quote: Deliver me from writers who say the way they live doesn't matter. I'm not sure a bad person can write a good book. If art doesn't make us better, then what on earth is it for.
Author: Alice Walker

Quote: Ah, how good it is to be among people who are reading.
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  The Notebooks of Malte Laurids Brigge

Quote: The truth is that the world is full of dragons, and none of us are as powerful or cool as we’d like to be. And that sucks. But when you’re confronted with that fact, you can either crawl into a hole and quit, or you can get out there, take off your shoes, and Bilbo it up.
Author: Patrick Rothfuss

Quote: Maybe there isn’t such a thing as fate. Maybe it’s just the opportunities we’re given, and what we do with them. I’m beginning to think that maybe great, epic romances don’t just happen. We have to make them ourselves.
Author: Marissa Meyer,  Cress

Quote: Do not lose hope — what you seek will be found. Trust ghosts. Trust those that you have helped to help you in their turn. Trust dreams. Trust your heart, and trust your story. (from 'Instructions')
Author: Neil Gaiman,  Fragile Things: Short Fictions and Wonders

Quote: When you look for a man- what you want to look for is a man with the heart of a poor boy and the mind of a conqueror.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: How hurtful it can be to deny one's true self and live a life of lies just to appease others.
Author: June Ahern

Quote: When you love someone, you don't have a choice. Love takes your choices away.- Clary Fray
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Ashes

Quote: The worst memories stick with us, while the nice ones always seem to slip through our fingers.
Author: Rachel Vincent,  My Soul to Save

Quote: Bermimpilah, karena Tuhan akan memeluk mimpi-mimpi itu.
Author: Andrea Hirata,  Sang Pemimpi

Quote: Today I choose life. Every morning when I wake up I can choose joy, happiness, negativity, pain... To feel the freedom that comes from being able to continue to make mistakes and choices - today I choose to feel life, not to deny my humanity but embrace it.
Author: Kevyn Aucoin

Quote: Whenever you're successful you owe that success to the people in the community, because they are the ones buying your product.
Author: Carl Karcher

Quote: I hope that through my example, such as my role on 'The West Wing,' I can help change attitudes on deafness and prove we can really do everything... except hear.
Author: Marlee Matlin

Quote: I really think that technology has the greatest potential to accelerate happiness of most things in the world. The companies that will ultimately do well are the companies that chase happiness. If you find a way to help people find love, or health or friendship, the dollar will chase that.
Author: Ashton Kutcher

Quote: Freedom means you are unobstructed in living your life as you choose. Anything less is a form of slavery.
Author: Wayne Dyer

Quote: Love can do much, but duty more.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: I don't think arrested-adolescent humor will fade. Maybe the form will change, but I guarantee its replacement will still be based in immature behavior from mature figures.
Author: Adam McKay

Quote: I think the art fair is very much a form of urbanism. I think something really happens to the cities when such a fair happens. The city becomes an exhibition; it's amazing.
Author: Hans-Ulrich Obrist

Quote: The three great essentials to achieve anything worthwhile are, first, hard work; second, stick-to-itiveness; third, common sense.
Author: Thomas A. Edison

Quote: The three great essentials to achieve anything worthwhile are, first, hard work; second, stick-to-itiveness; third, common sense.

Quote: I've been lucky. Opportunities don't often come along. So, when they do, you have to grab them.
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Quote: I want my time to be taken up by chores, errands, appointments, and arguments. In other words, I want to get married.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

Quote: I want my time to be taken up by chores, errands, appointments, and arguments. In other words, I want to get married.

Quote: The truth is not for all men but only for those who seek it.
Author: Ayn Rand

Quote: I was waiting for the longest time, she said. I thought you forgot.It is hard to forget, I said, when there is such an empty space when you are gone.
Author: Brian Andreas,  Story People: Selected Stories & Drawings of Brian Andreas

Quote: You can’t turn love on and off like a light switch, no matter how hard you try. All you can do is wall it off, one brick at a time, until you’ve created an impenetrable fortress around your emotions. And once that fortress is built, you camouflage it so well that even you can’t see it anymore.
Author: Katherine Allred,  The Sweet Gum Tree

Quote: He sighed and then focused his eyes right on me. It was like drowning, drowning in seas of green. There was nothing in the world except for those eyes."I want to kiss you, Rose,"he said softly. "And I want you to want me too.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Shadow Kiss

Quote: Goodbyes, they often come in waves.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

Quote: Goodbyes, they often come in waves.

Quote: A kind gesture can reach a wound that only compassion can heal.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: I'll find you. There is no place in this world you can hide from me. I'm watching.Love, Dimitri
Author: Richelle Mead,  Spirit Bound

Quote: Hello, Minister!"bellowed Percy, sending a neat jinx straight at Thicknesse, who dropped his wand and clawed at the front of his robes, apparently in awful discomfort. "Did I mention I'm resigning?
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: The scientist is not a person who gives the right answers, he's one who asks the right questions.
Author: Claude Lévi-Strauss

Quote: Being rich is not about how much money you have or how many homes you own; it's the freedom to buy any book you want without looking at the price and wondering if you can afford it.
Author: John Waters,  Role Models

Quote: To answer your question, you want me because I'm made of awesome.
Author: Gena Showalter,  Heart of Darkness

Quote: To answer your question, you want me because I'm made of awesome.
Author: Gena Showalter,  Heart of Darkness

Quote: It seems to me that if you or I must choose between two courses of thought or action, we should remember our dying and try so to live that our death brings no pleasure to the world.
Author: John Steinbeck,  East of Eden

Quote: She's my kitten, and no one else's.
Author: Jeaniene Frost,  One Foot in the Grave

Quote: I want to scream sometimes, because I hate when people refer to a dead person as the “late” so and so. I’m sorry to break that bad news, but that person isn’t just late—they’re not even coming!
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want Two apply for a job at our country's largest funeral home, and then wear a suit and noose to the job interview.

Quote: There is nothing on earth more beautiful to me than your smile...no sound sweeter than your laughter...no pleasure greater than holding you in my arms. I realized today that I could never live without you, stubborn little hellion that you are. In this life and the next, you’re my only hope of happiness. Tell me, Lillian, dearest love...how can you have reached so far inside my heart?
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  It Happened One Autumn

Quote: The tears of the world are a constant quantity. For each one who begins to weep somewhere else another stops. The same is true of the laugh.
Author: Samuel Beckett,  Waiting for Godot

Quote: FEAR stands for fuck everything and run.
Author: Stephen King,  Doctor Sleep

Quote: Don't limit yourself. Many people limit themselves to what they think they can do. You can go as far as your mind lets you. What you believe, remember, you can achieve.
Author: Mary Kay Ash

Quote: It is true that the aristocracies seem to have abused their monopoly of legal knowledge; and at all events their exclusive possession of the law was a formidable impediment to the success of those popular movements which began to be universal in the western world.
Author: Henry James Sumner Maine

Quote: I did this book 'Harvest for Hope,' and I learned so much about food. And one thing I learned is that we have the guts not of a carnivore, but of an herbivore. Herbivore guts are very long because they have to get the last bit of nutrition out of leaves and things.
Author: Jane Goodall

Quote: All who consult on doubtful matters, should be void of hatred, friendship, anger, and pity.
Author: Sallust

Quote: Grief can be the garden of compassion. If you keep your heart open through everything, your pain can become your greatest ally in your life's search for love and wisdom.
Author: Rumi

Quote: Only in the agony of parting do we look into the depths of love.
Author: George Eliot

Quote: Putting a little time aside for clean fun and good humor is very necessary to relieve the tensions of our time.
Author: Hattie McDaniel

Quote: And that's what art is, a form in which people can reflect on who we are as human beings and come to some understanding of this journey we are on.
Author: Wendell Pierce

Quote: MagicSandra’s seen a leprechaun,Eddie touched a troll,Laurie danced with witches once,Charlie found some goblins gold.Donald heard a mermaid sing,Susy spied an elf,But all the magic I have knownI've had to make myself.

Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Author: Dalai Lama XIV,  The Dalai Lama: A Policy of Kindness: An Anthology of Writings By and About the Dalai Lama

Author: Patricia Briggs,  Moon Called

Quote: I don't like it when I outweigh my men.

Quote: That's when I finally got it. I finally understood. It wasn't the thought that counted. It was the actual execution that mattered, the showing up for somebody. The intent behind it wasn't enough. Not for me. Not anymore. It wasn't enough to know that deep down, he loved me. You had to actually say it to somebody, show them you cared. And he just didn't. Not enough.
Author: Jenny Han,  It's Not Summer Without You

Quote: Every great dream begins with a dreamer. Always remember, you have within you the strength, the patience, and the passion to reach for the stars to change the world.
Author: Harriet Tubman

Quote: It doesn't matter if they hate you, or embarrass you, or simply don't appreciate your genius for inventing the internet-""You invented the internet?"It was my idea, Martha said.Rats are delicious, George said."It was my idea!"Hermes said. "I mean the internet, not the rats. But that's not the point.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Sea of Monsters

Quote: Knowing can be a curse on a person's life. I'd traded in a pack of lies for a pack of truth, and I didn't know which one was heavier. Which one took the most strength to carry around? It was a ridiculous question, though, because once you know the truth, you can't ever go back and pick up your suitcase of lies. Heavier or not, the truth is yours now.
Author: Sue Monk Kidd,  The Secret Life of Bees:

Quote: If you cannot read all your books...fondle them---peer into them, let them fall open where they will, read from the first sentence that arrests the eye, set them back on the shelves with your own hands, arrange them on your own plan so that you at least know where they are. Let them be your friends; let them, at any rate, be your acquaintances.
Author: Winston S. Churchill

Quote: Love is always open arms. If you close your arms about love you will find that you are left holding only yourself.
Author: Leo Buscaglia

Quote: Desiring another person is perhaps the most risky endeavor of all. As soon as you want somebody—really want him—it is as though you have taken a surgical needle and sutured your happiness to the skin of that person, so that any separation will now cause a lacerating injury.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Committed: A Skeptic Makes Peace with Marriage

Quote: You show me a capitalist, and I'll show you a bloodsucker
Author: Malcolm X

Quote: You show me a capitalist, and I'll show you a bloodsucker
Author: Malcolm X

Quote: The Reality of The Other Person Lies Not In What He Reveals To You, But What He Cannot Reveal To You.Therefore, If You Would Understand Him, Listen Not To What He Says, But Rather To What He Does Not Say.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: Everybody going to be dead one day, just give them time.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  Anansi Boys

Quote: Everybody going to be dead one day, just give them time.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  Anansi Boys

Quote: When you get to the end of all the light you know and it's time to step into the darkness of the unknown, faith is knowing that one of two things shall happen: either you will be given something solid to stand on, or you will be taught how to fly.
Author: Edward Teller

Quote: And then the line was quite but not dead. I almost felt like he was there in my room with me, but in a way it was better, like I was not in my room and he was not in his, but instead we were together in some invisible and tenuous third space that could only be visited on the phone.
Author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

Quote: If you can't do anything about it, laugh like hell.
Author: David Cook

Quote: We are all connected; To each other, biologically. To the earth, chemically. To the rest of the universe atomically.
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

Quote: The great object of life is sensation- to feel that we exist, even though in pain.
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: I want everything with you, America. I want the holidays and the birthdays, the busy season and lazy weekends. I want peanut butter fingertips on my desk. I want inside jokes and fights and everything. I want a life with you.
Author: Kiera Cass,  The One

Quote: It takes three to make love, not two: you, your spouse, and God. Without God people only succeed in bringing out the worst in one another. Lovers who have nothing else to do but love each other soon find there is nothing else. Without a central loyalty life is unfinished.
Author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

Author: Rachel Caine,  Feast of Fools

Quote: But magic is neither good nor evil. It is a tool, like a knife. Is a knife evil? Only if the wielder is evil.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The House of Hades

Quote: In the end, it wasn't death that surprised her but the stubbornness of life.
Author: Jeffrey Eugenides,  The Virgin Suicides

Quote: In the end, it wasn't death that surprised her but the stubbornness of life.

Quote: Love Jo all your days, if you choose, but don't let it spoil you, for it's wicked to throw away so many good gifts because you can't have the one you want.
Author: Louisa May Alcott,  Little Women

Quote: Love wins, love always wins.
Author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

Quote: There are so many things that demand to be said. Where did you go? Do you ever think about me? You've ruined me. Are you okay? But of course, I can't say any of that.
Author: Gayle Forman,  Where She Went

Quote: There are so many things that demand to be said. Where did you go? Do you ever think about me? You've ruined me. Are you okay? But of course, I can't say any of that.

Quote: I love her, and that's the beginning and end of everything.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  Dear Scott, Dearest Zelda: The Love Letters of F. Scott and Zelda Fitzgerald

Quote: misgivings, n.Last night, I got up the courage to ask you if you regretted us. "There are things I miss,"you said. "But if I didn't have you, I'd miss more.
Author: David Levithan,  The Lover's Dictionary

Author: Albert Camus

Quote: There is no happiness like that of being loved by your fellow creatures, and feeling that your presence is an addition to their comfort.
Author: Charlotte Brontë,  Jane Eyre

Quote: Friendship with oneself is all important, because without it one cannot be friends with anyone else in the world.
Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

Quote: How do I know you'll keep your word?"asked Coraline."I swear it,"said the other mother. "I swear it on my own mother's grave.""Does she have a grave?"asked Coraline."Oh yes,"said the other mother. "I put her in there myself. And when I found her trying to crawl out, I put her back.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  Coraline

Quote: In time, in time they tell me, I'll not feel so bad. I don't want time to heal me. There's a reason I'm like this.I want time to set me ugly and knotted with loss of you, marking me. I won't smooth you away.I can't say goodbye.
Author: China Miéville,  The Scar

Quote: In many cases when a reader puts a story aside because it 'got boring,' the boredom arose because the writer grew enchanted with his powers of description and lost sight of his priority, which is to keep the ball rolling.
Author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

Quote: Love doesn't mean anything if you're not willing to make a commitment, and you have to think not only about what you want, but about what he wants. Not just now, but in the future.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Safe Haven

Author: Hermann Hesse,  Wer lieben kann, ist glücklich. Über die Liebe

Quote: Definition of rock journalism: People who can't write, doing interviews with people who can't think, in order to prepare articles for people who can't read.
Author: Frank Zappa,  The Real Frank Zappa Book

Quote: The secret to success is good leadership, and good leadership is all about making the lives of your team members or workers better.
Author: Tony Dungy

Quote: Occupy Wall Street is meant more as a way of life that spreads through contagion, creates as many questions as it answers, aims to force a reconsideration of the way the nation does business and offers hope to those of us who previously felt alone in our belief that the current economic system is broken.
Author: Douglas Rushkoff

Quote: Like any friendship or marriage, familiarity breeds more contempt, and love, and everything.
Author: Martin Freeman

Quote: God had brought me to my knees and made me acknowledge my own nothingness, and out of that knowledge I had been reborn. I was no longer the centre of my life and therefore I could see God in everything.
Author: Bede Griffiths

Quote: One does not kill oneself for love of a woman, but because love - any love - reveals us in our nakedness, our misery, our vulnerability, our nothingness.

Quote: Every friendship travels at sometime through the black valley of despair. This tests every aspect of your affection. You lose the attraction and the magic. Your sense of each other darkens and your presence is sore. If you can come through this time, it can purify with your love, and falsity and need will fall away. It will bring you onto new ground where affection can grow again.
Author: John O'Donohue,  Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom

Quote: Do you know what hurts so very much? It's love. Love is the strongest force in the world, and when it is blocked that means pain. There are two things we can do when this happens. We can kill that love so that it stops hurting. But then of course part of us dies, too. Or we can ask God to open up another route for that love to travel.

Quote: In life you'll meet a lot of jerks. If they hurt you, tell yourself that it's because they're stupid. That will help keep you from reacting to their cruelty. Because there is nothing worse than bitterness and vengeance... Always keep your dignity and be true to yourself.
Author: Marjane Satrapi,  Persepolis: The Story of a Childhood

Quote: We have now left Reason and Sanity Junction. Next stop, Looneyville.

Quote: Never forget that God is your friend. And like all friends, He longs to hear what's been happening in your life. Good or bad, whether it's been full of sorrow or anger, or even when you're questioning why terrible things have to happen.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Last Song

Quote: It's no good trying to get rid of your own aloneness. You've got to stick to it all your life. Only at times, at times, the gap will be filled in. At times! But you have to wait for the times. Accept your own aloneness and stick to it, all your life. And then accept the times when the gap is filled in, when they come. But they've got to come. You can't force them.
Author: D.H. Lawrence,  Lady Chatterley's Lover

Quote: She lacks confidence, she craves admiration insatiably. She lives on the reflections of herself in the eyes of others. She does not dare to be herself.
Author: Anaïs Nin

Quote: It's none of their business that you have to learn how to write. Let them think you were born that way.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: A concerted effort to preserve our heritage is a vital link to our cultural, educational, aesthetic, inspirational, and economic legacies - all of the things that quite literally make us who we are.
Author: Steve Berry

Author: Michael Korda

Author: Niccolo Machiavelli

Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: It is really rare to find someone you really, really love and that you want to spend your life with and all that stuff that goes along with being married. I am one of those lucky people. And I think she feels that way too. So the romantic stuff is easy because you want them to be happy.
Author: Harry Connick, Jr.

Author: Madeleine Stowe

Quote: You can't do sketches enough. Sketch everything and keep your curiosity fresh.
Author: John Singer Sargent

Quote: Hard is trying to rebuild yourself, piece by piece, with no instruction book, and no clue as to where all the important bits are supposed to go.
Author: Nick Hornby,  A Long Way Down

Quote: I didn't want to kiss you goodbye — that was the trouble — I wanted to kiss you good night — and there's a lot of difference.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: We are unusual and tragic and alive.
Author: Dave Eggers

Quote: Adventures are never fun while you're having them.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Voyage of the Dawn Treader

Quote: Happiness is a perfume you cannot pour on others without getting some on yourself.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: …There is the heat of Love, the pulsing rush of Longing, the lover’s whisper, irresistible—magic to make the sanest man go mad.
Author: Homer,  The Iliad

Quote: Never forget that anticipation is an important part of life. Work's important, family's important, but without excitement, you have nothing. You're cheating yourself if you refuse to enjoy what's coming.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Three Weeks With My Brother

Quote: It is amazing what you can accomplish if you do not care who gets the credit.
Author: Harry S. Truman

Quote: I do not know what I may appear to the world, but to myself I seem to have been only like a boy playing on the sea-shore, and diverting myself in now and then finding a smoother pebble or a prettier shell than ordinary, whilst the great ocean of truth lay all undiscovered before me.
Author: Isaac Newton

Author: Albert Schweitzer

Author: Patricia Briggs,  Silver Borne

God doesn’t make us try so hard, only enemies do.

Quote: Risk anything! Care no more for the opinion of others ... Do the hardest thing on earth for you. Act for yourself. Face the truth."(Journal entry, 14 October 1922)
Author: Katherine Mansfield,  Journal of Katherine Mansfield

Quote: Space is an inspirational concept that allows you to dream big.
Author: Peter Diamandis

Author: Henri Matisse

Quote: I'm a big believer in pairing classics with contemporary literature, so students have the opportunity to see that literature is not a cold, dead thing that happened once but instead a vibrant mode of storytelling that's been with us a long time - and will be with us, I hope, for a long time to come.
Author: John Green

Author: Albert Camus

Quote: Even with all our technology and the inventions that make modern life so much easier than it once was, it takes just one big natural disaster to wipe all that away and remind us that, here on Earth, we're still at the mercy of nature.
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

Quote: Love is the ultimate expression of the will to live.
Author: Tom Wolfe

Quote: Humor is imperative, more important than food. You have a choice when someone dies. You can lie down or get back into life. Do something for someone else.
Author: Doris Roberts

Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: I've been in love with you since the very beginning. You asked why there isn't anyone else in my life, and the reason... is you.
Author: Julie James,  Practice Makes Perfect

Author: Lemony Snicket

Quote: If you would be a real seeker after truth, it is necessary that at least once in your life you doubt, as far as possible, all things.
Author: René Descartes

Quote: The phoenix must burn to emerge.
Author: Janet Fitch,  White Oleander

Quote: A poet is, before anything else, a person who is passionately in love with language.
Author: W.H. Auden,  The Complete Works of W.H. Auden: Prose, Volume II: 1939-1948

Author: Michel de Montaigne,  Les Essais

Quote: Every life has one true love snapshot.
Author: Mitch Albom,  The Five People You Meet in Heaven

Quote: How we spend our days is, of course, how we spend our lives.
Author: Annie Dillard,  The Writing Life

Quote: I'll never know, and neither will you, of the life you don't choose. We'll only know that whatever that sister life was, it was important and beautiful and not ours. It was the ghost ship that didn't carry us. There's nothing to do but salute it from the shore.
Author: Cheryl Strayed,  Tiny Beautiful Things: Advice on Love and Life from Dear Sugar

Quote: Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
Author: Samuel Beckett

Quote: Arthur: If I asked you where the hell we were, would I regret it?Ford: We're safe.Arthur: Oh good.Ford: We're in a small galley cabin in one of the spaceships of the Vogon Constructor Fleet.Arthur: Ah, this is obviously some strange use of the word safe that I wasn't previously aware of.
Author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

Quote: Don't mistake activity with achievement.
Author: John Wooden

Quote: There's no need to wait for the bad things and bullshit to be over. Change now. Love now. Live now. Don't wait for people to give you permission to live, because they won't.

Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Princess

"I know you'll use this wisely.""Wisely?"She snapped the syringe out of his hand. "No, I'm going to poke him in the eye with it. Because that's what they trained me to do in medical school.
Author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Unbound

Quote: There will be no yelling at people who are bleeding themselves to unconsciousness.
Author: Kristin Cashore,  Fire

Quote: So dawn goes down today... Nothing gold can stay.-- Robert Frost
Author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

Quote: Nothing is more creative... nor destructive... than a brilliant mind with a purpose.
Author: Dan Brown,  Inferno

Quote: I'm backing down now. I really do love you. That's why I'm doing this.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Last Sacrifice

Quote: It doesn't matter if a million people tell you what you can't do, or if ten million tell you no. If you get one yes from God that's all you need.

Quote: This is how the entire course of a life can be changed: by doing nothing.
Author: Ian McEwan,  On Chesil Beach

Quote: And I, infinitesima­l being, drunk with the great starry void, likeness, image of mystery, I felt myself a pure part of the abyss, I wheeled with the stars, my heart broke loose on the wind.
Author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

Quote: Feet, what do I need them forIf I have wings to fly.
Author: Frida Kahlo

Quote: If my mind can conceive it, and my heart can believe it - then I can achieve it.
Author: Muhammad Ali,  The Soul of a Butterfly: Reflections on Life's Journey

Quote: Dude, I don’t want to talk about Lacey’s prom shoes. And I’ll tell you why: I have this thing that makes me really uninterested in prom shoes. It’s called a penis.
Author: John Green,  Paper Towns

Author: Margaret Atwood

Author: Ireland Baldwin

Quote: I'm either going to go completely mental, completely bankrupt, or have the best success of my life.
Author: Katy Perry

Quote: I always try to put a seed of hope into people's hearts. I'm not there to teach them doctrine necessarily, but to let them know that God is a good God, and has a plan for their lives. Hopefully, that will restore their faith, or draw them into faith.
Author: Joel Osteen

Quote: Friendship with ones self is all important, because without it one cannot be friends with anyone else in the world.
Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

Quote: For above all things Love means sweetness, and truth, and measure; yea, loyalty to the loved one and to your word. And because of this I dare not meddle with so high a matter.
Author: Marie de France

Author: Michael York

Author: Arthur Erickson

Quote: Every time I think I'm missing a piece of me, you give it back.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Heavenly Fire

Quote: I am my heart’s undertaker. Daily I go and retrieve its tattered remains, place them delicately into its little coffin, and bury it in the depths of my memory, only to have to do it all again tomorrow.
Author: Emilie Autumn,  The Asylum for Wayward Victorian Girls

Quote: Every normal man must be tempted, at times, to spit on his hands, hoist the black flag, and begin slitting throats.

Quote: If love be rough with you, be rough with love. Prick love for pricking and you beat love down.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Author: Vladimir Lenin

Quote: There is creative reading as well as creative writing.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: I was feeling the height of bitchiness.
Author: Jennifer L. Armentrout,  Obsidian

Quote: O teach me how I should forget to think (1.1.224)

Author: Robin Sloan,  Mr. Penumbra's 24-Hour Bookstore

Quote: You're never alone when you're reading a book.

Quote: Cassia.I know which life is my real one now, no matter what happens. It’s the one with you. For some reason, knowing that even one person knows my story makes things different. Maybe it’s like the poem says. Maybe this is my way of not going gentle.I love you. (Ky Markham)
Author: Ally Condie,  Matched

Quote: When you're missing a peice of yourself, aching, gut wrenching emptiness begins to take over. Until you find the link that completes your very soul, the feeling will never go away. Most people find a way to fill this void, material possessions, a string of relationships, affairs, food...I bear my soul, with words, for all to see.
Author: Jennifer Salaiz

Author: John Adams

Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: I love you when you bow in your mosque, kneel in your temple, pray in your church. For you and I are sons of one religion, and it is the spirit.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Author: Bertrand Russell,  New Hopes for a Changing World

Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Witch Of Portobello

Author: Plato,  The Symposium

Quote: You have wakened not out of sleep, but into a prior dream, and that dream lies within another, and so on, to infinity, which is the number of grains of sand. The path that you are to take is endless, and you will die before you have truly awakened.
Author: Jorge Luis Borges

Quote: Life happens. Shit happens. And it happens a lot. To a lot of people.
Author: Colleen Hoover,  Slammed

Quote: Let me love you, but don't love me back. Do love me and let me hate you for a while. Let me feel like I have some control, because I know I never do.
Author: Ann Brashares

Quote: Stay hungry. Stay foolish.
Author: Steve Jobs

Quote: Beauty is about being comfortable in your own skin. It's about knowing and accepting who you are.

I'd go out into a great big field all alone or in the deep, deep woods and I'd look up into the sky—up—up—up—into that lovely blue sky that looks as if there was no end to its blueness. And then I'd just feel a prayer.

Quote: I know it's not easy for you, living this life, but try to remember, always try to remember, you're not the only one with troubles.

Author: Sarah J. Maas,  Crown of Midnight

Quote: His lips tasted cool and sharp, peppermint, winter, but his hands, soft on the back of my neck, promised long days and summer and forever.
Author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Shiver

Quote: All these people talk so eloquently about getting back to good old-fashioned values. Well, as an old poop I can remember back to when we had those old-fashioned values, and I say let's get back to the good old-fashioned First Amendment of the good old-fashioned Constitution of the United States -- and to hell with the censors! Give me knowledge or give me death!
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: Where should I go?"-Alice. "That depends on where you want to end up."- The Cheshire Cat.
Author: Lewis Carroll,  Alice's Adventures in Wonderland & Through the Looking-Glass

Quote: As the light begins to intensify, so does my misery, and I wonder how it is possible to hurt so much when nothing is wrong.
Author: Tabitha Suzuma,  Forbidden

Quote: I had jumped off the edge, and then, at the very last moment, something reached out and caught me in midair. That something is what I define as love. It is the one thing that can stop a man from falling, powerful enough to negate the laws of gravity.
Author: Paul Auster,  Moon Palace

Quote: If nature has made you for a giver, your hands are born open, and so is your heart; and though there may be times when your hands are empty, your heart is always full, and you can give things out of that--warm things, kind things, sweet things--help and comfort and laughter--and sometimes gay, kind laughter is the best help of all.
Author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  A Little Princess

Quote: Anything under God's control is never out of control.
Author: Charles R. Swindoll

Author: Charles R. Swindoll

Quote: Death, taxes and childbirth! There's never any convenient time for any of them.
Author: Margaret Mitchell,  Gone with the Wind

Quote: Almost every college playwright or sketch or improv comedian was sort of aware of Christopher Durang - even kids in high school. His short plays were so accessible to younger people and I think that was inspirational to me.
Author: Mindy Kaling

Quote: Tell me, why is the media here so negative? Why are we in India so embarrassed to recognise our own strengths, our achievements? We are such a great nation. We have so many amazing success stories but we refuse to acknowledge them. Why?
Author: A. P. J. Abdul Kalam

Quote: The friend in my adversity I shall always cherish most. I can better trust those who helped to relieve the gloom of my dark hours than those who are so ready to enjoy with me the sunshine of my prosperity.
Author: Ulysses S. Grant

Quote: Cosmetics makers have always sold 'hope in a jar' - creams and potions that promise youth, beauty, sex appeal, and even love for the women who use them.
Author: Virginia Postrel

Quote: Life was always a matter of waiting for the right moment to act.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Strangely enough, they have a mind to till the soil, and the love of possessions is a disease in them.
Author: Sitting Bull

Quote: I don't think that because you die and move on to somewhere else that you lose your sense of humor.
Author: Peter Jackson

Quote: Dance music is my love, is my passion, is my life. I live for my fans and take my art very seriously.
Author: Steve Aoki

Quote: Give a bowl of rice to a man and you will feed him for a day. Teach him how to grow his own rice and you will save his life.
Author: Confucius

Quote: I love you and it's getting worse.
Author: Joseph E. Morris

Author: Marcel Proust,  In Search of Lost Time

Quote: What are you doing?”“Kneeling before a goddess.”“I’m not a goddess.”“You are. A goddess, a princess, a queen. As a soldier, I pledge myself to your service. As a prince, I grant you any boon within my power. As a man, I ask to sit at your feet and worship you. Ask me to do anything for you and I will do it.
Author: Colleen Houck

Author: Dan Brown,  The Lost Symbol

Quote: The trick is in what one emphasizes. We either make ourselves miserable, or we make ourselves happy. The amount of work is the same.
Author: Carlos Castaneda

Quote: The pupil dilates in darkness and in the end finds light, just as the soul dilates in misfortune and in the end finds God.
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Author: Tyler Perry

Quote: He: What’s the matter with you?Me: Nothing.Nothing was slowly clotting my arteries. Nothing slowly numbing my soul. Caught by nothing, saying nothing, nothingness becomes me. When I am nothing they will say surprised in the way that they are forever surprised, "but there was nothing the matter with her.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Gut Symmetries

Quote: I thought about all of the things that everyone ever says to each other, and how everyone is going to die, whether it's in a millisecond, or days, or months, or 76.5 years, if you were just born. Everything that's born has to die, which means our lives are like skyscrapers. The smoke rises at different speeds, but they're all on fire, and we're all trapped.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

Quote: The best you can hope for in a relationship is to findsomeone whose flaws are the sort you don’t mind. It isfutile to look for someone who has no flaws, or someonewho is capable of significant change; that sort of personexists only in our imaginations.
Author: Scott Adams,  God's Debris: A Thought Experiment

Quote: In the DesertIn the desert I saw a creature, naked, bestial, Who, squatting upon the ground, Held his heart in his hands, And ate of it. I said, “Is it good, friend?” “It is bitter—bitter,” he answered; “But I like it “Because it is bitter, “And because it is my heart.
Author: Stephen Crane,  The Black Riders and Other Lines

Quote: Literature was not born the day when a boy crying "wolf, wolf"came running out of the Neanderthal valley with a big gray wolf at his heels; literature was born on the day when a boy came crying "wolf, wolf"and there was no wolf behind him.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov,  Lectures on Literature

Quote: No furniture is so charming as books.
Author: Sydney Smith,  A memoir of the Rev. Sydney Smith

Author: Sophie Kinsella,  Remember Me?

Quote: Any game plan? Xypher asked Sin.Don't die.I like it. Simple, bold. Impossible. Works for me.Kat scoffed at his sarcasm. What are you bitching about, Xypher? You're already dead.He laughed. You know, for once, it's good to be me.
Author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Devil May Cry

Quote: There's some heinous fuckery goin' on mon.
Author: Christopher Moore,  Fluke: Or, I Know Why the Winged Whale Sings

Quote: One can be the master of what one does, but never of what one feels.
Author: Gustave Flaubert

Quote: Life will hit you hard in the face, wait for you to get back up just so it can kick you in the stomach. But getting the wind knocked out of you is the only way to remind your lungs how much they like the taste of air.
Author: Sarah Kay

Author: Charles Bukowski

Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Bones

Author: Winston S. Churchill

Quote: Do not dare not to dare.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Horse and His Boy

Quote: Many people could say things in a cutting way, Nanny knew. But Granny Weatherwax could listen in a cutting way. She could make something sound stupid just by hearing it.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: Right,"she said, "We're going to the Land of the Dead and I shouldn't think negative.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Lightning Thief

Quote: The evil that is in the world almost always comes from ignorance, and good intentions may do as much harm as malevolence if they lack understanding.
Author: Albert Camus

Quote: I love the stars.Because they can't say anything.I love the stars.Because they do not judge anyone.
Author: Natsuki Takaya

Quote: Drop out of school before your mind rots from exposure to our mediocre educational system. Forget about the Senior Prom and go to the library and educate yourself if you've got any guts. Some of you like Pep rallies and plastic robots who tell you what to read.
Author: Frank Zappa

Quote: I'm afraid of time... I mean, I'm afraid of not having enough time. Not enough time to understand people, how they really are, or to be understood myself. I'm afraid of the quick judgements or mistakes everybody makes. You can't fix them without time. I'm afraid of seeing snapshots, not movies.
Author: Ann Brashares

Quote: Conventionality is not morality. Self-righteousness is not religion. To attack the first is not to assail the last.
Author: Charlotte Brontë,  Jane Eyre

Quote: Must I go bound while you go freeMust I love a manwho doesn't love meMust I be born with so little artAs to love a man who'll break my Heart
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Prince

Quote: We pass through this world but once. Few tragedies can be more extensive than the stunting of life, few injustices deeper than the denial of an opportunity to strive or even to hope, by a limit imposed from without, but falsely identified as lying within.
Author: Stephen Jay Gould,  The Mismeasure of Man

Quote: I have gained this by philosophy … I do without being ordered what some are constrained to do by their fear of the law.
Author: Aristotle

Quote: Who are you?"he asked.I am the future queen of this world, at the very least. You may refer to me as Mistress Koboi for the next five minutes. After that you may refer to me as Aaaaarrrrgh, hold your throat, die screaming, and so on.
Author: Eoin Colfer,  The Time Paradox

Quote: You know that look that women get when they want to have sex? Me neither.
Author: Steve Martin

Quote: I'm a pessimist because of intelligence, but an optimist because of will.
Author: Antonio Gramsci,  Gramsci's Prison Letters

Quote: Well, I like to eat, sleep, drink, and be in love.I like to work, read, learn, and understand life.
Author: Langston Hughes

Quote: Drink your tea slowly and reverently, as if it is the axis on which the world earth revolves - slowly, evenly, without rushing toward the future.
Author: Hanh Nhat Thich

Author: Marianne Williamson

Author: Jo Nesbø

Quote: Intellectual growth should commence at birth and cease only at death.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: I believe compassion to be one of the few things we can practice that will bring immediate and long-term happiness to our lives. I’m not talking about the short-term gratification of pleasures like sex, drugs or gambling (though I’m not knocking them), but something that will bring true and lasting happiness. The kind that sticks.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: The hardest thing of all is to find a black cat in a dark room, especially if there is no cat.
Author: Confucius

Quote: Reading was very important to me as a kid. It was very inspirational to me. I went to a school where that wasn't encouraged so much, but my parents encouraged that, and it has made me part of who I am.
Author: Sasha Grey

Quote: Success is a beast. And it actually puts the emphasis on the wrong thing. You get away with more instead of looking within.
Author: Brad Pitt

Quote: That friendship will not continue to the end which is begun for an end.
Author: Francis Quarles

Quote: All I can hope to do is instill great morality in my son and trust him along the way. The music he listens to or how he chooses to wear his hair doesn't define his moral compass, and if he wants to listen to country music and wear a cowboy hat too, that's fine.
Author: Mark Hoppus

Quote: For me life is continuously being hungry. The meaning of life is not simply to exist, to survive, but to move ahead, to go up, to achieve, to conquer.
Author: Arnold Schwarzenegger

Quote: You have to love what you do to want to do it everyday.
Author: Aaliyah

Quote: I wore goofy hats to school and did musical theater. Most people thought I was a dork. But if you have a sense of humor about it, no one can bring you down.
Author: Zac Efron

Quote: The biggest problem with every art is by the use of appearance to create a loftier reality.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: Love is the will to extend one's self for the purpose of nurturing one's own or another's spiritual growth... Love is as love does. Love is an act of will -- namely, both an intention and an action. Will also implies choice. We do not have to love. We choose to love.
Author: M. Scott Peck

Quote: What if love wasn't the act of finding what you were missing but the give-and-take that made you both match?
Author: Jodi Picoult,  The Tenth Circle

Quote: Knowing is not enough, we must apply. Willing is not enough, we must do.
Author: Bruce Lee

Quote: Never doubt my weaseling abilities, Shadowhunter, for they are epic and memorable in their scope.
Author: Cassandra Clare

Quote: Ignorance more frequently begets confidence than does knowledge: it is those who know little, not those who know much, who so positively assert that this or that problem will never be solved by science.

Quote: True teachers are those who use themselves as bridges over which they invite their students to cross; then, having facilitated their crossing, joyfully collapse, encouraging them to create theirown.
Author: Nikos Kazantzakis

Author: أنيس منصور,  في صالون العقاد كانت لنا أيام

Quote: I wore your promise on my finger for one yearI'll wear your name on my heart til I dieBecause you were my boy, you were my only boy forever.
Author: Coco J. Ginger

Quote: Don’t take the high ground and assume you already know what you’ll do. The truth is, when it comes to someone you love, you’ll find there isn’t anything you won’t do.
Author: Richelle Mead,  The Fiery Heart

Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Safe Haven

Quote: Difficulties strengthen the mind, as labor does the body.
Author: Seneca

Quote: And I thought that all those little kids are going to grow up someday. And all of those little kids are going to do the things that we do. And they will all kiss someone someday. But for now, sledding is enough. I think it would be great if sledding were always enough, but it isn't.

Author: Natsuki Takaya,  Fruits Basket, Vol. 21

Quote: Those unable to catalog the past are doomed to repeat it.
Author: Lemony Snicket,  The End

Quote: There is only one way to happiness and that is to cease worrying about things which are beyond the power or our will.
Author: Epictetus

Quote: Only the wisest and stupidest of men never change.
Author: Confucius

Quote: Hope in reality is the worst of all evils because it prolongs the torments of man.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: I was with book, as a woman is with child.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  Till We Have Faces

Quote: I have come from the End of the World. From the River of Dreams, through the gauntlet and the Briar and the Deep Wyld, in order to stand before you today. I have but one request—to take my place at your side. To resume my duty as your knight, and to protect you and your kingdom for as long as I draw breath.
Author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron Knight

Quote: Love takes off the masks we fear we cannot live without and know we cannot live within.
Author: James Baldwin

Quote: And in the end, we were all just humans.. drunk on the idea that love, only love, could heal our brokenness.

Quote: You backbiting, poisonous, treacherous, deceitful, wicked, clever girl. If this works I'll buy you a pony.
Author: Jim Butcher,  Summer Knight

Quote: But maybe happiness isn't in the choosing. Maybe it's in the fiction, in the pretending: that wherever we have ended up is where we intended to be all along.

Quote: From my rotting body, flowers shall grow and I am in them, and that is eternity.

Quote: A fire broke out backstage in a theatre. The clown came out to warn the public; they thought it was a joke and applauded. He repeated it; the acclaim was even greater. I think that's just how the world will come to an end: to general applause from wits who believe it's a joke.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard,  Either/Or, Part I

Quote: You are not a victim. No matter what you have been through, you're still here. You may have been challenged, hurt, betrayed, beaten, and discouraged, but nothing has defeated you. You are still here! You have been delayed but not denied. You are not a victim, you are a victor. You have a history of victory.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: When I was a boy the Dead Sea was only sick.
Author: George Burns

Quote: Many religions now come before us with ingratiating smirks and outspread hands, like an unctuous merchant in a bazaar. They offer consolation and solidarity and uplift, competing as they do in a marketplace. But we have a right to remember how barbarically they behaved when they were strong and were making an offer that people could not refuse.
Author: Christopher Hitchens

Quote: Only priests and fools are fearless and I've never been on the best of terms with God.
Author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Name of the Wind

Author: Dave Barry,  Dave Barry Turns Fifty

Quote: I have never voted in my life... I have always known and understood that the idiots are in a majority so it's certain they will win.
Author: Louis-Ferdinand Céline

Quote: You're still here. No beer. I'm not corrupting a minor.""But you're a minor,"she pointed out. "At least for beer.""Yeah, and by the way, how much does it suck that I'm an adult if I kill somebody, and I'm not if I want a beer?
Author: Rachel Caine,  Glass Houses

Quote: I could see that, if not actually disgruntled, he was far from being gruntled.
Author: P.G. Wodehouse,  The Code of the Woosters

Quote: Women may fall when there's no strength in men.Act II
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: Death leaves a heartache no one can heal, love leaves a memory no one can steal.From an Irish headstone
Author: Richard Puz,  The Carolinian

Quote: Night poured over the desert. It came suddenly, in purple. In the clear air, the stars drilled down out of the sky, reminding any thoughtful watcher that it is in the deserts and high places that religions are generated. When men see nothing but bottomless infinity over their heads they have always had a driving and desperate urge to find someone to put in the way.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Jingo

Quote: In old days books were written by men of letters and read by the public. Nowadays books are written by the public and read by nobody.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: God loves to help him who strives to help himself.
Author: Aeschylus

Quote: There is nothing more difficult to take in hand, more perilous to conduct, or more uncertain in its success, than to take the lead in the introduction of a new order of things.
Author: Niccolo Machiavelli

Quote: A friendship can weather most things and thrive in thin soil; but it needs a little mulch of letters and phone calls and small, silly presents every so often - just to save it from drying out completely.
Author: Pam Brown

Quote: I think that hope, that ability to envision, to imagine a better way, and then to apply yourself to it, is the way to climb out of a hole, is the way to build a better life, is the way to build a better community and a better country.
Author: Deval Patrick

Quote: Few people seem to realize that the resurrection of Jesus is the cornerstone to a worldview that provides the perspective to all of life.
Author: Josh McDowell

Quote: I had parents who instilled in me the importance of love, morals and hard work. I give God all the glory because he has brought me through so much.
Author: Junior Seau

Quote: There's always a source for humor.
Author: Calvin Trillin

Quote: Works of art make rules; rules do not make works of art.
Author: Claude Debussy

Quote: I had rather be shut up in a very modest cottage with my books, my family and a few old friends, dining on simple bacon, and letting the world roll on as it liked, than to occupy the most splendid post, which any human power can give.
Author: Thomas Jefferson,  Letters of Thomas Jefferson

Quote: Oh, it's always the same,' she sighed, 'if you want men to behave well to you, you must be beastly to them; if you treat them decently they make you suffer for it.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham,  Of Human Bondage

Quote: Love is not patronizing and charity isn't about pity, it is about love. Charity and love are the same -- with charity you give love, so don't just give money but reach out your hand instead.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: To pay attention, this is our endless and proper work.
Author: Mary Oliver

Author: Albert Einstein

Christ changes men, who then change their environment. The world would shape human behavior, but Christ can change human nature.

Author: John Burroughs

Quote: I’ve had many enemies over the years. If there’s one thing I’ve learned, it’s never engage in a fight you’re sure to lose. On the other hand, never let anyone who has insulted you get away with it. Bide your time and strike back when you’re in a position of strength—even if you no longer need to strike back.
Author: Stieg Larsson,  The Girl with the Dragon Tattoo

Author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Devil May Cry

Quote: Self-respect is the root of discipline: The sense of dignity growswith the ability to say no to oneself.
Author: Abraham Joshua Heschel

Quote: The further you go, the more you have to be proud of. At the same time, in order to come a long way, you have to be behind to begin with. IN the end, though maybe it's not how you reach a place that matters. Just that you get there at all.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  Lock and Key

Quote: Did you see me disarm Hermione, Harry?""Only once"said Hermione stung. "I got you loads more then you got me—""I did not only get you once, I got you at least three times—""Well if you're counting the one where you tripped over your own feet and knocked the wand out of my hand—
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix

Quote: The ideals which have always shone before me and filled me with joy are goodness, beauty, and truth.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: Courage, my friends; 'tis not too late to build a better world.
Author: Tommy Douglas

Author: Stephen Covey

Quote: Of all possessions a friend is the most precious.
Author: Herodotus

Quote: Putting on my legs is like putting on my shoes. I understand that's how some people might think differently, but I hope that in London, their perceptions open up.
Author: Oscar Pistorius

Quote: We cannot always control everything that happens to us in this life, but we can control how we respond. Many struggles come as problems and pressures that sometimes cause pain. Others come as temptations, trials, and tribulations.
Author: L. Lionel Kendrick

Quote: I didn't have a fireworks moment for my salvation. I had a falling in love with Jesus in Sunday school when I was a very young child.
Author: Beth Moore

Quote: A lot of stars don't have a sense of humor.
Author: Kathy Griffin

Quote: As in nature, as in art, so in grace; it is rough treatment that gives souls, as well as stones, their luster.
Author: Thomas Guthrie

Quote: Pierre was right when he said that one must believe in the possibility of happiness in order to be happy, and I now believe in it. Let the dead bury the dead, but while I'm alive, I must live and be happy.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  War and Peace

Quote: Every person must choose how much truth he can stand.

Quote: Our bodies have five senses: touch, smell, taste, sight, hearing. But not to be overlooked are the senses of our souls: intuition, peace, foresight, trust, empathy. But hatred, now, that's something you can use. Sculpt. Wield. It's hard, or soft, however you need it. Love humiliates you, but Hatred cradles you.

Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: It's just the most amazing thing to love a dog, isn't it? It makes our relationships with people seem as boring as a bowl of oatmeal.
Author: John Grogan,  Marley and Me: Life and Love With the World's Worst Dog

Quote: Writing simply means no dependent clauses, no dangling things, no flashbacks, and keeping the subject near the predicate. We throw in as many fresh words we can get away with. Quote: Instruction does much, but encouragement everything."(Letter to A.F. Oeser, Nov. 9, 1768)

You have to forgive yourself so much, until you don't even see those things anymore. Because that's what love is like.

I don't want to understand you.

Quote: I consider myself a stained-glass window. And this is how I live my life. Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Enlightenment is man's release from his self-incurred tutelage. Tutelage is man's inability to make use of his understanding without direction from another.
