Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: I do not consider it an insult, but rather a compliment to be called an agnostic. I do not pretend to know where many ignorant men are sure — that is all that agnosticism means.
Author: Clarence Darrow

Quote: I remember one desolate Sunday night, wondering: Is this how I´m going to spend the rest of my life? Marrid to someone who is perpetually distracted and somewhat wistful, as though a marvelous party is going on in the next room, which but for me he could be attending?
Author: Suzanne Finnamore

Quote: It's impossible to say a thing exactly the way it was, because of what you say can never be exact, you always have to leave something out, there are too many parts, sides, crosscurrents, nuances; too many gestures, which could mean this or that, too many shapes which can never be fully described, too many flavors, in the air or on the tongue, half-colors, too many.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  The Handmaid's Tale

Quote: Writing has nothing to do with meaning. It has to do with landsurveying and cartography, including the mapping of countries yet to come.
Author: Gilles Deleuze

Quote: The greatest gift is the passion for reading.It is cheap, it consoles, it distracts, it excites,it gives you knowledge of the world and experience of a wide kind.It is a moral illumination.
Author: Elizabeth Hardwick

Quote: They had only ever discussed books but what, in this life, is more personal than books?
Author: Gabrielle Zevin,  The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry

Quote: A good book should leave you....slightly exhausted at the end. You live several lives while reading it.
Author: William Styron

Quote: I once had a dreams of becoming a beautiful poet, but upon an unfortunate series of events some of those dreams dashed and divided like a million stars in the night sky that I wished on over and over again, sparkling and broken.But I didn't really mind, because I knew that it takes getting everything you ever wanted, and then losing it to know what true freedom is.
Author: Lana Del Rey

Quote: I love you, Missy girl. Even if I can't be with you, know that I'm here. So, that's it. More than the stars, Taylor. More than the stars.

Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

Quote: Dreamers are mocked as impractical. The truth is they are the most practical, as their innovations lead to progress and a better way of life for all of us.
Author: Robin S. Sharma

Quote: Not sure how I felt about Antonio and Echo, I linked my fingers with hers. Antonio cocked a surprised eyebrow. Damn straight, bro. I just marked my territory.
Author: Katie McGarry,  Pushing the Limits

Quote: If we are to love our neighbors, before doing anything else we must see our neighbors. With our imagination as well as our eyes, that is to say like artists, we must see not just their faces but the life behind and within their faces. Here it is love that is the frame we see them in.
Author: Frederick Buechner,  Whistling in the Dark: A Doubter's Dictionary

Quote: My love is like one of those wooden Russian nesting dolls (matryoshka doll). I know, because your heart fits perfectly inside mine.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Who Moved My Choose?: An Amazing Way to Deal With Change by Deciding to Let Indecision Into Your Life

Quote: Love is on every side, and no one's side. Don't ask what Love can do for you.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The House of Hades

Quote: Spirituality is not to be learned by flight from the world, or by running away from things, or by turning solitary and going apart from the world. Rather, we must learn an inner solitude wherever or with whomsoever we may be. We must learn to penetrate things and find God there.
Author: Meister Eckhart

Quote: Peace is present right here and now, in ourselves and in everything we do and see. Every breath we take, every step we take, can be filled with peace, joy, and serenity. The question is whether or not we are in touch with it. We need only to be awake, alive in the present moment.

Quote: Holly's theory about the army,"Sharon explained.And what is it?"Denise asked, intrigued.Oh, that fighting for peace is like screwing for virginity.

Quote: When people ask me how I slept, I tell them I don’t know—I’ll have to ask The Professor, and read his notes on my performance.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: If a man has character, he has also his typical experience, which always recurs.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: The teacher who is indeed wise does not bid you to enter the house of his wisdom but rather leads you to the threshold of your mind.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: The simple step of a courageous individual is not to take part in the lie. "One word of truth outweighs the world.
Author: Aleksandr Solzhenitsyn

Quote: Faith is an oasis in the heart which will never be reached by the caravan of thinking.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: The first kiss can be as terrifying as the last.
Author: Daina Chaviano,  The Island of Eternal Love

Quote: إذا كنت لاترى إلا مايظهره النور، ولاتسمع إلا ماتعلنه الأصوات فأنت بالحقيقة لاترى ولاتسمع٠
Author: جبران خليل جبران

Quote: If you walk on sunlight, bathe in moonlight, breathe in a golden air and exhale a Midas' touch; mark my words, those who exist in the shadows will try to pull you into the darkness with them. The last thing that they want is for you to see the wonder of your life because they can't see theirs.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Nothing is so firmly believed as that which we least know.
Author: Michel de Montaigne,  The Complete Essays

Quote: I remainMistress of mine own self and mine own soul
Author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

Quote: Knowledge is the ultimate weapon. It always has been.
Author: Jim Butcher,  White Night

Quote: If a person holds no ambitions in this world, he suffers unknowingly. If a person holds ambitions, he suffers knowingly, but very slowly.
Author: Alan Lightman,  Einstein's Dreams

Quote: He's still looking in my eyes. Staring me down like he did that dragon, chin tilted and locked. "I'm not the Chosen One,"he says.I meet his gaze and sneer. My arm is a steel band around his waist. "I choose you,"I say. "Simon Snow, I choose you.
Author: Rainbow Rowell,  Carry On

Quote: My first feeling was that there was no way to continue. Writing isn't like math;in math, two plus two always equals four no matter what your mood is like. With writing, the way you feel changes everything.
Author: Stephenie Meyer,  Midnight Sun

Quote: I want to be strapped to a table, while a family of chickens argues over who gets to eat my legs.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

Quote: I'll drive like my grandma. I'll drive like your grandma.""You wouldn't say that if you knew my gramma.
Author: Kami Garcia,  Beautiful Creatures

Quote: Real education must ultimately be limited to men who insist on knowing. The rest is mere sheep herding.
Author: Ezra Pound

Quote: Act the way you'd like to be and soon you'll be the way you'd like to act.
Author: Bob Dylan

Quote: Spirituality is recognizing and celebrating that we are all inextricably connected to each other by a power greater than all of us, and that our connection to that power and to one another is grounded in love and compassion. Practicing spirituality brings a sense of perspective, meaning and purpose to our lives.
Author: Brené Brown,  The Gifts of Imperfection: Let Go of Who You Think You're Supposed to Be and Embrace Who You Are

Quote: The aim of science is not to open the door to infinite wisdom, but to set a limit to infinite error.
Author: Bertolt Brecht,  Life of Galileo

Quote: Your work is going to fill a large part of your life, and the only way to be truly satisfied is to do what you believe is great work. And the only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking. Don't settle. As with all matters of the heart, you'll know when you find it.
Author: Steve Jobs

Author: Jean de la Bruyere

Author: William Cowper

Quote: No matter what has happened to you in the past or what is going on in your life right now, it has no power to keep you from having an amazingly good future if you will walk by faith in God. God loves you! He wants you to live with victory over sin so you can possess His promises for your life today!
Author: Joyce Meyer

Quote: A home with a loving and loyal husband and wife is the supreme setting in which children can be reared in love and righteousness and in which the spiritual and physical needs of children can be met.
Author: David A. Bednar

Quote: If you approach Cannes with a sense of humor, nothing is that bad. You have to take it for what it is; otherwise, it's silly.
Author: Mathieu Amalric

Quote: I was the least Pop of all the Pop artists.
Author: Robert Indiana

Quote: It may be true that the law cannot make a man love me, but it can stop him from lynching me, and I think that's pretty important.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.

Quote: But instead of spending our lives running towards our dreams, we are often running away from a fear of failure or a fear of criticism.
Author: Eric Wright

Quote: And you know, there's less charm in life when you think about death--but it's more peaceful.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Author: Paulo Coelho,  Eleven Minutes

Author: Brennan Manning,  The Ragamuffin Gospel: Good News for the Bedraggled, Beat-Up, and Burnt Out

Quote: Silent solitude makes true speech possible and personal. If I am not in touch with my own belovedness, then I cannot touch the sacredness of others. If I am estranged from myself, I am likewise a stranger to others.
Author: Brennan Manning,  Abba's Child: The Cry of the Heart for Intimate Belonging

Quote: Those who make us believe that anything’s possible and fire our imagination over the long haul, are often the ones who have survived the bleakest of circumstances. The men and women who have every reason to despair, but don’t, may have the most to teach us, not only about how to hold true to our beliefs, but about how such a life can bring about seemingly impossible social change.

Quote: Full fathom five thy father lies;Of his bones are coral made;Those are pearls that were his eyes:Nothing of him that doth fade,But doth suffer a sea-changeInto something rich and strange.Sea-nymphs hourly ring his knell: Ding-dong Hark! now I hear them,—Ding-dong, bell.

Quote: They say even death can't cure an idiot.-Ririn

Author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

Quote: For a moment I was distracted. Books always did that to me... I liked the creamy pages, the smell of ink, all the secrets locked inside.

Quote: Books can truly change our lives: the lives of those who read them, the lives of those who write them. Readers and writers alike discover things they never knew about the world and about themselves.

Author: H. Jackson Brown Jr.

Quote: No, Miss Palmer. What is bizarre is that I currently have a vagina.
Author: Karen Chance,  Curse the Dawn

Quote: We're miserable because we think that we are mere individuals, alone with our fears and flaws and resentment and mortality.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: If a man could have half of his wishes, he would double his troubles.
Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quote: Why should we build our happiness on the opinons of others, when we can find it in our own hearts?
Author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau,  The Social Contract and Discourses

Quote: People always say life is too short for regrets. But the truth is, it's too long.
Author: Sarah Addison Allen,  The Peach Keeper

Quote: If happy I can be I will, if suffer I must I can.
Author: William Faulkner,  Absalom, Absalom!

Quote: I think you have every right to cherry-pick when it comes to moving your spirit and finding peace in God. You take whatever works from wherever you can find it, and you keep moving toward the light.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: I think you have every right to cherry-pick when it comes to moving your spirit and finding peace in God. You take whatever works from wherever you can find it, and you keep moving toward the light.

Quote: I waited for dawn, but only because I had forgotten how hard mornings were. For a second I'd be normal. Then came the dim awareness of something off, out of place. Then the truth came crashing down and that was it for the rest of the day. Sunlight was reproof. Shouldn't I feel better than I had in the dead of night.
Author: Francine Prose,  Goldengrove

Quote: My idea of God is not a divine idea. It has to be shattered time after time. He shatters it Himself.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  A Grief Observed

Quote: My idea of God is not a divine idea. It has to be shattered time after time. He shatters it Himself.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  A Grief Observed

Quote: I think of how life takes unexpected twists and turns, sometimes through sheer happenstance, sometimes through calculated decisions. In the end, it can all be called fate, but to me, it is more a matter of faith.
Author: Emily Giffin,  Love the One You're With

Quote: Profound joy of the heart is like a magnet that indicates the path of life.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: The poor man shuddered, overflowed with an angelic joy; he declared in his transport that this would last through life; he said to himself that he really had not suffered enough to deserve such radiant happiness, and he thanked God, in the depths of his soul, for having permitted that he, a miserable man, should be so loved by this innocent being.
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Quote: Hmm…now that I think about it, housecats are often coddled and petted. You don’t pet me nearly enough. You must be a lax owner. How selfish of you to deprive your cat of attention.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: You are the trip I did not take, you are the pearls I could not buy,you are my blue Italian lake, you are my piece of foreign sky.You are my Honolulu moon, you are the book I did not write,you are my heart's unuttered tune, you are a candle in my night.You are the flower beneath the snow, in my dark sky a bit of blue,answering disappointment's blow with "I am happy! I have you!
Author: Anne Campbell

Quote: See mirror, every time you will miss me and look deeper into your eyes till you will find me.
Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

Quote: This is what I want. This is the only thing I've ever wanted. Everything else—every single second of every single day that has come before this very moment, this kiss—has meant nothing.
Author: Lauren Oliver,  Delirium

Quote: A witch, a vampire, and a pixy walk into a bar, I thought as I led the way into the Squirrel’s End. It was early, and the sun had yet to set when the door swung shut behind Jenks, sealing us in the warm air smelling faintly of smoke. Immediately Nick yanked it open to come in behind us. And there’s the punch line.
Author: Kim Harrison,  A Fistful of Charms

Quote: It is not about doing what we feel like. It is about doing what God says.
Author: Joyce Meyer

Quote: In religion and politics people’s beliefs and convictions are in almost every case gotten at second-hand, and without examination, from authorities who have not themselves examined the questions at issue but have taken them at second-hand from other non-examiners, whose opinions about them were not worth a brass farthing.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: A lie was something you told because you were mean or a coward. A story was something you made up out of something that might have happened. Only you didn't tell it like it was, you told it like you thought it should have been.
Author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

Quote: Try looking at your mind as a wayward puppy that you are trying to paper train. You don't drop-kick a puppy into the neighbor's yard every time it piddles on the floor. You just keep bringing it back to the newspaper.
Author: Anne Lamott,  Bird by Bird: Some Instructions on Writing and Life

Quote: Write every day, line by line, page by page, hour by hour. Do this despite fear. For above all else, beyond imagination and skill, what the world asks of you is courage, courage to risk rejection, ridicule and failure. As you follow the quest for stories told with meaning and beauty, study thoughtfully but write boldly. Then, like the hero of the fable, your dance will dazzle the world.
Author: Robert McKee

Quote: I just sit at my typewriter and curse a bit.
Author: P.G. Wodehouse

Quote: The ‘Muse’ is not an artistic mystery, but a mathematical equation. The gift are those ideas you think of as you drift to sleep. The giver is that one you think of when you first awake.
Author: Roman Payne

Quote: Sama juga kalau untuk contoh lelaki. Kalau baca Al - Quran hari-hari, tapi main bola nampak kepala lutut,tak cukup balik lagi.Atau kalau solat lima waktu sehari semalam tapi pegang tangan anak dara orang bukan mahram sesuka hati, tu belum cukup baik lagi.
Author: Hlovate,  Versus

Quote: It's so trendy, almost bleeding to death. All the cool girls are doing it.
Author: Francine Pascal,  Fearless

Quote: Flowers and fear are a lot alike. For one, flowers and fear have a distinct smell, and two, I’m currently trying to grow both in my garden.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

Quote: What do you think? Does this face make me look fat?

Quote: I like wearing a blindfold while watching movies, so that I can focus on the dialogue. My favorite flicks are the silent movies.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: A teacher who loves learning earns the right and the ability to help others learn.
Author: Ruth Beechick,  An Easy Start in Arithmetic, Grades K-3

Quote: Whosoever desires constant success must change his conduct with the times.
Author: Niccolò Machiavelli

Quote: An active mind didn't need distractions in its physical environment. It needed a collection of outstanding books and a good lamp. Maybe some cheese and crackers.
Author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Unbound

Quote: When you re-read a classic you do not see in the book more than you did before. You see more in you than there was before.
Author: Clifton Fadiman,  Any Number Can Play

Quote: Single |sin•gle| (adjective) - Too fabulous to settle.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: Of all the inanimate objects, of all men's creations, books are the nearest to us for they contain our very thoughts, our ambitions, our indignations, our illusions, our fidelity to the truth, and our persistent leanings to error. But most of all they resemble us in their precious hold on life.
Author: Joseph Conrad

Quote: My mission in life is not merely to survive, but to thrive; and to do so with some passion, some compassion, some humor, and some style.
Author: Maya Angelou

Author: Noel Gallagher

Quote: The most I can do for my friend is simply be his friend.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: You see, in my view a writer is a writer not because she writes well and easily, because she has amazing talent, because everything she does is golden. In my view a writer is a writer because even when there is no hope, even when nothing you do shows any sign of promise, you keep writing anyway.
Author: Junot Diaz

Quote: He who is not everyday conquering some fear has not learned the secret of life.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Don't ever criticize yourself. Don't go around all day long thinking, 'I'm unattractive, I'm slow, I'm not as smart as my brother.' God wasn't having a bad day when he made you... If you don't love yourself in the right way, you can't love your neighbour. You can't be as good as you are supposed to be.
Author: Joel Osteen

Quote: Even people that I agree with can do something that would be a target for a bit of humor.
Author: Jonathan Shapiro

Quote: Great art picks up where nature ends.
Author: Marc Chagall

Quote: You can't have living without dying. So you can't call it living, what we got. We just are, we just be, like rocks beside the road.
Author: Natalie Babbitt,  Tuck Everlasting

Quote: You can't have living without dying. So you can't call it living, what we got. We just are, we just be, like rocks beside the road.

Quote: In my crazy world, above all others...you were the only one who was the ugliest. And you were the only one...who was the most beautiful.... This is the unspoken truth.
Author: Kaori Yuki

Quote: It's become impossible to deny he means something to me.
Author: Stephanie Perkins,  Lola and the Boy Next Door

Quote: I always knew, on some level, that I wouldn't live long. It's simply not written in my stars.
Author: Marie Lu,  Champion

Quote: I always knew, on some level, that I wouldn't live long. It's simply not written in my stars.

Quote: People will kill you. Over time. They will shave out every last morsel of fun in you with little, harmless sounding phrases that people uses every day, like: 'Be realistic!'"[What It Is (2009)]
Author: Dylan Moran

Quote: You just have to go after what you want and if it doesn't want you back then so be it; it doesn't deserve you anyways.

Quote: No matter what happened yesterday it is insignificant when compared to what lies within the core of your being today.
Author: Sandy Brewer,  Pursuit of Light: An Extraordinary Journey

Quote: Many things are not as they seem: The worst things in life never are.
Author: Jim Butcher,  White Night

Quote: He recognized her despite the uproar, through his tears of unrepeatable sorrow at dying without her, and he looked at her for the last and final time with eyes more luminous, more grief-stricken, more grateful than she had ever seen them in half a century of a shared life, and he managed to say to her with his last breath: “Only God knows how much I loved you
Author: Gabriel Garcí­a Márquez,  Love in the Time of Cholera

Quote: How far have you walked for men who’ve never held your feet in their laps?
Author: Warsan Shire

Quote: You know quite well, deep within you, that there is only a single magic, a single power, a single salvation...and that is called loving. Well, then, love your suffering. Do not resist it, do not flee from it. It is your aversion that hurts, nothing else.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Wer lieben kann, ist glücklich. Über die Liebe

Quote: A child may not know how to feed itself, or what to eat, yet it knows hunger.
Author: Daniel Keyes,  Flowers for Algernon

Quote: The dream was always running ahead of me. To catch up, to live for a moment in unison, was the miracle.
Author: Anaïs Nin

Quote: All persons, living and dead, are purely coincidental.

Just stay behind me if there's trouble.""You sound like Shane.""Well, he did say he'd kill me if I got you hurt. I'm just looking after my own neck.""Liar.

Quote: Of course, everyone's parents are embarrassing. It goes with the territory. The nature of parents is to embarrass merely by existing, just as it is the nature of children of a certain age to cringe with embarrassment, shame, and mortification should their parents so much as speak to them on the street.

Quote: Capabilities are clearly manifested only when they have been realized.
Author: Simone de Beauvoir,  The Second Sex

Quote: He must be very ignorant for he answers every question he is asked.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: Do not look for happiness outside yourself. The awakened seek happiness inside.
Author: Peter Deunov

Quote: Do not look for happiness outside yourself. The awakened seek happiness inside.

Quote: You cannot conceive, nor can I, of the appalling strangeness of the mercy of God.
Author: Graham Greene,  Brighton Rock

Quote: Here I am going to say something which may come as a bit of a shock. God doesn't necessarily want us to be happy. He wants us to be lovable. Worthy of love. Able to be loved by Him. We don't start off being all that lovable, if we're honest. What makes people hard to love? Isn't it what is commonly called selfishness? Selfish people are hard to love because so little love comes out of them.
Author: William Nicholson,  Shadowlands

Quote: And it's the funniest thing: as soon as I see it, the whistling in my ears stops and the feeling of terror drains away, and I realize this whole time I haven't been falling at all. I've been floating.

Quote: There's nothing to writing. All you do is sit down at a typewriter and open a vein.

Quote: When I'm really into a novel, I'm seeing the world differently during that time— not just for the hour or so in the day when I get to read. I'm actually walking around in a haze, spellbound by the book and looking at everything through a different prism.
Author: Colin Firth

Quote: I think books are like people, in the sense that they'll turn up in your life when you most need them.
Author: Emma Thompson

Quote: This is the most important thing about me--I'm a card-carrying reader. All I really want to do is sit and read or lie down and read or eat and read or shit and read. I'm a trained reader. I want a job where I get paid for reading books. And I don't have to make reports on what I read or to apply what I read.

Quote: There is nothing which can better deserve our patronage than the promotion of science and literature. Knowledge is in every country the surest basis of public happiness.
Author: George Washington

Quote: I want an infinitely blank book and the rest of time......why didn't I learn to treat everything like it was the last time, my greatest regret is how much I believed in the future.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer

Quote: Sometimes God allows what he hates to accomplish what he loves.
Author: Max Lucado

Quote: I will be generous with my love today. I will sprinkle compliments and uplifting words everywhere I go. I will do this knowing that my words are like seeds and when they fall on fertile soil, a reflection of those seeds will grow into something greater.

Love like rain, like the smell of a tangerine, like a surprise found in your pocket.

Quote: You say, it's dark. And in truth, I did place a cloud before your sun. But do you not see how the edges of the cloud are already glowing and turning light.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Were I a Roman Catholic, perhaps I should on this occasion vow to build a chapel to some saint, but as I am not, if I were to vow at all, it should be to build a light-house.[Letter to his wife, 17 July 1757, after narrowly avoiding a shipwreck; often misquoted as "Lighthouses are more helpful than churches."]
Author: Benjamin Franklin,  Memoirs of the Life and Writings of Benjamin Franklin

Quote: I can't give a Professor love!

Quote: I disapprove of matrimony as a matter of principle.... Why should any independent, intelligent female choose to subject herself to the whims and tyrannies of a husband? I assure you, I have yet to meet a man as sensible as myself! (Amelia Peabody)
Author: Elizabeth Peters,  Crocodile on the Sandbank

Quote: Another relative?"Valek asked.A broad smile stretched Moon Man's lips. "Yes. I am her mother's uncle's wife'sthird cousin."--Valek and Moon Man
Author: Maria V. Snyder,  Magic Study

Quote: I'm telling you, you really should stick to mating within your species, whatever that is.''I would,' I said, 'but unfortunately, there are no gorgeous, all-powerful, all-knowing gods around here. I'd even settle for a demigod. It's a step down, I know. But alas, there are nothing but low-brained mortals here. And half-brains, like you.

Quote: It was so strange, the way that life moved forward: the twists and the dead ends, the sudden opportunities. She supposed if you could predict or foresee everything that was going to happen, you’d lose the motivation to go through it all. The promise was always in the possibility.

Author: Morrissey

Quote: He feared me as many men fear women: because their mistresses (or their wives) understand them. Quote: Annabeth realized that if six of them went on these two quests, it would leave Percy alone on the ship with Coach Hedge, which was maybe not a situation a caring girlfriend should put him in. Quote: I am yours,"he whispered. "I live to hold you, Risa. I breathe to touch you.

Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: Are you going to allow the world around you to change while you remain stagnant? Make this the time you throw away old habits that have hindered your happiness and success and finally allow your greatest self to flourish.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: What does ‘hmm’ have to do with anything? Could you ever use more than five words? All this grunting and minced words make you come across—primal.”His smile tipped higher. “Primal.”“You’re impossible.”“Me Jev, you Nora.
Author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Silence

Quote: Here,"Myrnin said, his voice still gentle and low. "Amelie said you had to work. No one said you had to work alone."He picked up the next part and slotted it in, took the screwdriver from Claire's numbed fingers, and fastened it with a couple of deft, fast movements. "I'll be your hands."She wanted to cry, because it was so sweet, but it wouldn't do any good.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Ghost Town

Quote: You must have been going very fast.""I was, until I hit the fence.
Author: Anthony Horowitz,  Ark Angel

Quote: Now stand in the corner, and think about what you've done!
Author: Taylor Swift

Quote: At first, I could lie about my lack of sleep and she'd fall for it, but she started suspecting insomnia when I began seeing purple elephants in the air vents at the office. I knew I shouldn't have asked her about them. I thought maybe she'd redecorated.
Author: Darynda Jones,  Third Grave Dead Ahead

Quote: Pressure makes diamonds
Author: George S. Patton Jr.

Quote: Time ripens all things; no man is born wise.
Author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra

Quote: Once the writer in every individual comes to life (and that time is not far off), we are in for an age of universal deafness and lack of understanding.
Author: Milan Kundera,  The Book of Laughter and Forgetting

Quote: Once the writer in every individual comes to life (and that time is not far off), we are in for an age of universal deafness and lack of understanding.
Author: Milan Kundera,  The Book of Laughter and Forgetting

Quote: But what is liberty without wisdom and without virtue? It is the greatest of all possible evils; for it is folly, vice, and madness, without tuition or restraint. Those who know what virtuous liberty is, cannot bear to see it disgraced by incapable heads, on account of their having high-sounding words in their mouths.
Author: Edmund Burke

Quote: One of the mistakes many of us make is that we feel sorry for ourselves, or for others, thinking that life should be fair, or that someday it will be. It's not and it won't. When we make this mistake we tend to spend a lot of time wallowing and/or complaining about what's wrong with life. "It's not fair,"we complain, not realizing that, perhaps, it was never intended to be.
Author: Richard Carlson,  Don't Sweat the Small Stuff ... and it's all small stuff: Simple Ways to Keep the Little Things from Taking Over Your Life

Quote: Fear can’t be reasoned with. Neither can hate. They’re like love. They’re almost identical emotions. That’s why Ares and Aphrodite like each other. Their twin sons – Fear and Panic – were spawned from both war and love.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Blood of Olympus

Quote: We become slaves the moment we hand the keys to the definition of reality entirely over to someone else, whether it is a business, an economic theory, a political party, the White House, Newsworld or CNN.
Author: B.W. Powe,  Towards A Canada Of Light

Quote: Faith in God includes Faith in God's timing.
Author: Neal A. Maxwell

Quote: In God there is no hunger that needs to be filled, only plenteousness that desires to give.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

Quote: We are students of words: we are shut up in schools, and colleges, and recitation -rooms, for ten or fifteen years, and come out at last with a bag of wind, a memory of words, and do not know a thing.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Essays Including Essays, First & Second Series, English Traits, Nature & Considerations by the Way

Quote: A woman with romance in her life lived as grandly as a queen, because her heart was treasured.
Author: Nora Roberts,  Bed of Roses

Quote: You were on the other side of the world, but I often woke with the scent of you surrounding me. I ached for you, Kells. No matter how much Kishan thrashed me, it couldn’t diminish the pain of losing you. I’d dream of you and reach out to touch you, but you were always just out of reach.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: And if you say that's because you lot barged into her home like a herd of mentally deficient sheep, I'm disowning all three of you.
Author: Julia Quinn,  The Duke and I

Quote: The decision to kiss for the first time is the most crucial in any love story. It changes the relationship of two people much more strongly than even the final surrender; because this kiss already has within it that surrender.
Author: Emil Ludwig

Quote: The decision to kiss for the first time is the most crucial in any love story. It changes the relationship of two people much more strongly than even the final surrender; because this kiss already has within it that surrender.
Author: Emil Ludwig

Quote: The difference between theism and nontheism is not whether one does or does not believe in God. . . Theism is a deep-seated conviction that there's some hand to hold: if we just do the right things, someone will appreciate us and take care of us. . . Nontheism is relaxing with the ambiguity and uncertainty of the present moment without reaching for anything to protect ourselves.
Author: Pema Chödrön

Quote: It is beautiful, it is endless, it is full and yet seems empty. It hurts us.
Author: Jackson Pearce,  Fathomless

Quote: If God is for us, who can be against us?
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: I don't know exactly where ideas come from, but when I'm working well ideas just appear. I've heard other people say similar things - so it's one of the ways I know there's help and guidance out there. It's just a matter of our figuring out how to receive the ideas or information that are waiting to be heard.
Author: Jim Henson

Quote: You can't edit a blank page
Author: Nora Roberts

Quote: Never judge a work of art by its defects
Author: Washington Allston

Quote: I define myself and grow as a person through emotional torment, so if you love me, you will inflict as much pain on me as you possibly can.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: The Ultimate Answer to Life, The Universe and Everything is...42!
Author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

Quote: I would feel infinitely more comfortable in your presence if you would agree to treat gravity as a law, rather than one of a number of suggested options.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 9: The Kindly Ones

Quote: Get it down. Take chances. It may be bad, but it's the only way you can do anything good.
Author: William Faulkner

Quote: Almost everyone can remember losing his or her virginity, and most writers can remember the first book he/she put down thinking: I can do better than this. Hell, I am doing better than this! What could be more encouraging to the struggling writer than to realize his/her work is unquestionably better than that of someone who actually got paid for his/her stuff?
Author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

Quote: What I am telling you, before you begin my story, is this -- two things: I crave truth. And I lie.
Author: Tana French,  In the Woods

Quote: What I am telling you, before you begin my story, is this -- two things: I crave truth. And I lie.
Author: Tana French,  In the Woods

Quote: There is one who remembers the way to your door: Life you may evade, but Death you shall not.
Author: T.S. Eliot

Quote: There is one who remembers the way to your door: Life you may evade, but Death you shall not.
Author: T.S. Eliot

Quote: Some people insist that 'mediocre' is better than 'best.' They delight in clipping wings because they themselves can't fly. They despise brains because they have none.
Author: Robert A. Heinlein,  Have Space Suit—Will Travel

Quote: You'll probably die if you stay with me,' he told me.'Then I'm dead either way, because I won't survive without you.
Author: Julie Hockley,  Crow's Row

Quote: People say I make strange choices, but they’re not strange for me. My sickness is that I’m fascinated by human behavior, by what’s underneath the surface, by the worlds inside people.
Author: Johnny Depp

Quote: People say I make strange choices, but they’re not strange for me. My sickness is that I’m fascinated by human behavior, by what’s underneath the surface, by the worlds inside people.
Author: Johnny Depp

Quote: Realize that true happiness lies within you. Waste no time and effort searching for peace and contentment and joy in the world outside. Remember that there is no happiness in having or in getting, but only in giving. Reach out. Share. Smile. Hug. Happiness is a perfume you cannot pour on others without getting a few drops on yourself.
Author: Og Mandino

Quote: to love means to realize there is a time to let the beloved one go
Author: Tony Parsons,  Man and Boy

Quote: I love you now for what we've already shared, and I love you now in anticipation of all that's to come.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Nights in Rodanthe

Quote: I love you every day. And now I will miss you every day.
Author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

Quote: I love you every day. And now I will miss you every day.
Author: Mitch Albom,  For One More Day

Quote: There are no happy endings... There are no endings, happy or otherwise. We all have our own stories which are just part of the one Story that binds both this world and Faerie. Sometimes we step into each others stories - perhaps just for a few minutes, perhaps for years - and then we step out of them again. But all the while, the Story just goes on.
Author: Charles de Lint,  Dreams Underfoot

Quote: At least one thing was consistent about her life: It just kept on getting more complicated.
Author: Scott Westerfeld,  Pretties

Quote: When I try, I fail. When I trust, He succeeds.
Author: Corrie ten Boom

Quote: There are only two forces at work in this world- black and white. Only people are grey.
Author: Chris Heimerdinger,  Gadiantons and the Silver Sword

Quote: You're not aloneTogether we standI'll be by your side, you know I'll take your handWhen it gets coldAnd it feels like the endThere's no place to goYou know I won't give in
Author: Avril Lavigne

Quote: Our lives are part of a unique adventure... Nevertheless, most of us think the world is 'normal' and are constantly hunting for something abnormal--like angels or Martians. But that is just because we don't realize the world is a mystery. As for myself, I felt completely different. I saw the world as an amazing dream. I was hunting for some kind of explanation of how everything fit together.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  The Solitaire Mystery

Quote: It occurred to me by intuition, and music was the driving force behind that intuition. My discovery was the result of musical perception.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: In high school I got voted most likely to get voted for something. Even though I was the only one who voted, it still felt terrific being nominated.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

Quote: It had never occurred to me that our lives, which had been so closely interwoven, could unravel with such speed.
Author: Kazuo Ishiguro

Quote: At times our own light goes out and is rekindled by a spark from another person. Each of us has cause to think with deep gratitude of those who have lighted the flame within us.
Author: Albert Schweitzer

Quote: Rule number 2 - don't listen to me!"Arriane laughed, "I'm certifiably insane!
Author: Lauren Kate

Quote: I’ve had a tense couple of days. And I’ve got to tell you, burning someone’s face off sounds like a great way to relax.
Author: Jim Butcher,  Small Favor

Quote: That is happiness; to be dissolved into something complete and great. When it comes to one, it comes as naturally as sleep.
Author: Willa Cather,  My Ántonia

Quote: The conflict between the will to deny horrible events and the will to proclaim them aloud is the central dialectic of psychological trauma.
Author: Judith Lewis Herman,  Trauma and Recovery

Quote: Just because you can explain it doesn't mean it's not still a miracle.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Small Gods

Quote: Just because you can explain it doesn't mean it's not still a miracle.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Small Gods

Quote: Death walks faster than the wind and never returns what he has taken.
Author: Hans Christian Andersen,  The Story of a Mother

Quote: Strike the shepherd and the sheep will scatter
Author: Robert Greene,  The 48 Laws of Power

Quote: Strike the shepherd and the sheep will scatter
Author: Robert Greene,  The 48 Laws of Power

Quote: I will love you forever"swears the poet. I find this easy to swear too. "I will love you at 4:15 pm next Tuesday"- Is that still as easy?
Author: W.H. Auden

Quote: When the immense drugged universe explodesIn a cascade of unendurable colourAnd leaves us gasping naked,This is no more than the ectasy of chaos:Hold fast, with both hands, to that royal loveWhich alone, as we know certainly, restoresFragmentation into true being.Ecstasy of Chaos
Author: Robert Graves,  Poems 1965-1968

Quote: love one another, but make not a bond of love: let it rather be a moving sea between the shores of your souls. fill each other's cup but drink not from one cup. give one another of your bread but eat not from the same loaf sing and dance together and be joyous, but let each one of you be alone, even as the strings of a lute are alone though they quiver with the same music.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  Prophet Hb

Quote: You can't truly hate someone until you've cared about them. Until you've loved them.
Author: Kirsten Hubbard,  Like Mandarin

Quote: Possess. Have. Hold. Enjoy. Control. Dominate. Pick your verb, Ms. Fairchild. I intend to explore so very many of them.
Author: J. Kenner,  Release Me

Quote: الصيام رياضة روحية وقهر للبدن وكبح وإلجام للعنصر الحيوانى فى الإنسان
Author: مصطفى محمود,  القرآن: محاولة لفهم عصري

Quote: Working for Mab now, are you, Wolfman?"he smirked. "Like a good little attack dog? Will you also roll over and beg if she asks?
Author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron Knight

Quote: I want to merge a Phoenix with a Camel to create the world's first everlasting cigarette. It'll be a cigarette that rises from its own ashes, so you can keep smoking it indefinitely.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

Quote: A man wrapped up in himself always suffocates. But his loved ones will forever hold in their hearts the memory of that Christmas.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: Today is your special day, even if today might be tomorrow to an Australian. And even though you’re not Australian, it doesn’t negate the fact that today may or may not be tomorrow.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  American Association for the Advancement of Aardvarks Presents: Dear Natalie

Quote: One of the deepest longings of the human soul is to be seen.
Author: John O'Donohue

Quote: As we express our gratitude, we must never forget that the highest appreciation is not to utter words, but to live by them.
Author: John F. Kennedy

Quote: Our limitations and success will be based, most often, on your own expectations for ourselves. What the mind dwells upon, the body acts upon.
Author: Denis Waitley

Quote: The language of friendship is not words but meanings.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: My advice would be to follow your dream. Most of my life, I was in second place before I came in first place. I hope that inspired people to never give up.
Author: Jackie Evancho

Quote: It is possible to become discouraged about the injustice we see everywhere. But God did not promise us that the world would be humane and just. He gives us the gift of life and allows us to choose the way we will use our limited time on earth. It is an awesome opportunity.
Author: Cesar Chavez

Quote: The beginning of love is to let those we love be perfectly themselves, and not to twist them to fit our own image. Otherwise we love only the reflection of ourselves we find in them.
Author: Thomas Merton

Quote: I'm a novelist first, and I wrote a bunch of books, and everything I write, I just find people are more interesting when there's an element of humor to it.
Author: Jonathan Tropper

Quote: Modern art is what happens when painters stop looking at girls and persuade themselves that they have a better idea.
Author: John Ciardi

Quote: I don't understand a thing about this world: about people, and why they do the things they do. The more I find out, the more I uncover, the more I know, the less I understand.
Author: Craig Silvey,  Jasper Jones

Quote: Gabe?"The newchild stirred slightly in his sleep. Jonas looked over at him. "There could be love", Jonas whispered.
Author: Lois Lowry,  The Giver

Quote: Muscles aching to work, minds aching to create - this is man.
Author: John Steinbeck,  The Grapes of Wrath

Quote: Muscles aching to work, minds aching to create - this is man.
Author: John Steinbeck,  The Grapes of Wrath

Quote: Quizás aun no te comprenda. Pero, con un poco de tiempo, llegaré a entenderte. Y no habrá nadie en el mundo que te comprenda mejor que yo.
Author: Haruki Murakami

Quote: Love changes things; hope allows us to endure until the change arrives.
Author: Iimani David

Quote: Love changes things; hope allows us to endure until the change arrives.
Author: Iimani David

Quote: Life is something that happens when you can't get to sleep.
Author: Fran Lebowitz

Quote: He who robs us of our dreams robs us of our life.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

Author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

Quote: A wind that blows aimlessly is no good to anyone.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Blood of Olympus

Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

Quote: Life makes fools of all of us sooner or later. But keep your sense of humor and you'll at least be able to take your humiliations with some measure of grace. In the end, you know, its our own expectations that crush us.
Author: Paul Murray,  Skippy Dies

Quote: Life's pain. You just have to get over as much of it as you can.-Isabel Culpeper
Author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Linger

Quote: impossible is not a word
Author: Obert Skye,  Leven Thumps and the Gateway to Foo

Quote: The purpose of literature is to turn blood into ink.
Author: T.S. Eliot

Quote: I’d rather welcome change than cling to the past.
Author: Robert T. Kiyosaki,  Rich Dad, Poor Dad

Quote: If they give you ruled paper, write the other way.
Author: Juan Ramón Jiménez

Quote: Will it make me something? Will I be something? Am I something? And the answer comes, already am, always was, and I still have time to be
Author: Anis Mojgani

Quote: So what? You're another person, so of course you look different. What do you need to be ashamed for?
Author: Yana Toboso

Quote: Obstacles are those frightening things you see when you take you eyes off your goal.
Author: Henry James

Quote: Obstacles are those frightening things you see when you take you eyes off your goal.
Author: Henry James

Quote: Whoever cannot seek the unforeseen sees nothing for the known way is an impasse.
Author: Heraclitus,  Fragments

Quote: Whoever cannot seek the unforeseen sees nothing for the known way is an impasse.
Author: Heraclitus,  Fragments

Quote: Excuse me, Captain. Are you two going to weep salty tears of admiration over a helmet all night, or do we have matters to discuss?
Author: Eoin Colfer,  The Lost Colony

Quote: There are two ways to look at life. The first view is that nothing stays the same and that nothing is inherently connected, and that the only driving force in anyone's life is entropy. The second is that everything pretty much stays the same (more or less) and that everything is completely connected, even if we don't realize it.
Author: Chuck Klosterman,  Sex, Drugs, and Cocoa Puffs: A Low Culture Manifesto

Quote: Eagles may soar, but weasels don't get sucked into jet engines.
Author: Steven Wright

Quote: I'm happy to tell you there is very little in this world that I believe in.
Author: George Carlin,  Brain Droppings

Quote: What is morally wrong can never be advantageous, even when it enables you to make some gain that you believe to be to your advantage. The mere act of believing that some wrongful course of action constitutes an advantage is pernicious.
Author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

Quote: We're on the same boat but in different cabin
Author: Hlovate,  Rooftop Rant

Quote: Yeah. I mean, acknowledging is easy. Something happened or it didn't. But understanding... that's where things get sticky.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  What Happened to Goodbye

Quote: The supreme happiness of life is the conviction that we are loved; loved for ourselves—say rather, loved in spite of ourselves.
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Quote: Sometimes I get depressed about my age. In March I’ll be 26. If man weren’t measured in numbers, but rather letters, I’d be turning Z. And then I’d be dead.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Should Have Renamed This

Quote: Sometimes I get depressed about my age. In March I’ll be 26. If man weren’t measured in numbers, but rather letters, I’d be turning Z. And then I’d be dead.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Should Have Renamed This

Quote: Put a gun to my head and paint the wall with my brains.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Fight Club

Quote: I do know that waiting on God requires the willingness to bear uncertainty, to carry within oneself the unanswered question, lifting the heart to God about it whenever it intrudes upon one’s thoughts. Its easy to talk oneself into a decision that has no permanence – easier sometimes than to wait patiently.
Author: Elisabeth Elliot,  Passion and Purity: Learning to Bring Your Love Life Under Christ's Control

Quote: Intellect is a part of a good faith. Intellect is the light, the heart is the direction.
Author: Tariq Ramadan

Quote: We fear death, we shudder at life's instability, we grieve to see the flowers wilt again and again, and the leaves fall, and in our hearts we know that we, too, are transitory and will soon disappear. When artists create pictures and thinkers search for laws and formulate thoughts, it is in order to salvage something from the great dance of death, to make something last longer than we do.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Narcissus and Goldmund

Quote: Yahweh: You've been unhappy because you've desired things that cannot be.Lucifer: That's what desire IS. The need for what we can't have. The need for what's readily available is called greed.
Author: Mike Carey,  Lucifer, Vol. 11: Evensong

Quote: I warn you, Kelsey, that I’m an extremely patient man. I’ve had extensive practice in waiting out the enemy. My life as a tiger has taught me that attentive persistence and focused diligence always pay off. Consider yourself forewarned, priyatama. I’m on the hunt. I’ve caught your scent, and I won’t be thwarted in my course.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: Becoming a writer is about becoming conscious. When you're conscious and writing from a place of insight and simplicity and real caring about the truth, you have the ability to throw the lights on for your reader. He or she will recognize his or her life and truth in what you say, in the pictures you have painted, and this decreases the terrible sense of isolation that we have all had too much of.
Author: Anne Lamott

Quote: The figures looked more or less human. And they were engaged in religion. You could tell by the knives (it's not murder if you do it for a god).
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Small Gods

Quote: The things that the novel does not say are necessarily more numerous than those it does say and only a special halo around what is written can give the illusion that you are reading also what is not written.
Author: Italo Calvino

Quote: Writing is the geometry of the soul.
Author: Plato

Quote: Your life is your spiritual path.It's what's right in front of you. You can't live anyone else's life. The task is to live yours and stop trying to copy one you think looks better.
Author: Sandy Nathan,  Stepping Off the Edge: Learning & Living Spiritual Practice

Quote: I try to deny myself any illusions or delusions, and I think that this perhaps entitles me to try and deny the same to others, at least as long as they refuse to keep their fantasies to themselves.
Author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

Quote: Being dead wasn't supposed to hurt. Where was the fairness in that? If I was dead, the least the universe could do was make it painless
Author: Kiersten White,  Paranormalcy

Quote: Me neither,” Shane put in. “Homie don’t play that.”“I wonder, sometimes, if your generation speaks English at all,” Amelie said.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Fade Out

Quote: Mal snickered. "What's so funny?""I just pictured the Darkling being cornered by a sweaty duchess trying to have her way with him.
Author: Leigh Bardugo,  Siege and Storm

Quote: All profound distraction opens certain doors. You have to allow yourself to be distracted when you are unable to concentrate.
Author: Julio Cortázar,  Around the Day in Eighty Worlds

Quote: Risk comes from not knowing what you're doing
Author: Warren Buffett

Quote: To succeed in the world it is not enough to be stupid - one must also be polite.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: If life is a journey then let my soul travel and share your pain.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Open your eyes, train your ears, use your head. If a mind you have, then use it while you can.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Hard-Boiled Wonderland and the End of the World

Quote: You develop an instant global consciousness, a people orientation, an intense dissatisfaction with the state of the world, and a compulsion to do something about it. From out there on the moon, international politics look so petty. You want to grab a politician by the scruff of the neck and drag him a quarter of a million miles out and say, ‘Look at that, you son of a bitch.
Author: Edgar D. Mitchell

Quote: It's natural to think that living things must be the handiwork of a designer. But it was also natural to think that the sun went around the earth. Overcoming naive impressions to figure out how things really work is one of humanity's highest callings.[Can You Believe in God and Evolution? Time Magazine, August 7, 2005]
Author: Steven Pinker

Quote: That's the whole problem with science. You've got a bunch of empiricists trying to describe things of unimaginable wonder.
Author: Bill Watterson

Quote: I wanted to crawl in between those black lines of print, the way you crawl through a fence, and go to sleep under that beautiful big green fig-tree.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Bell Jar

Quote: I think when you become a parent you go from being a star in the movie of your own life to the supporting player in the movie of someone else's.
Author: Craig Ferguson,  American on Purpose: The Improbable Adventures of an Unlikely Patriot

Quote: The difference between the love of a man and the love of a woman is that a man will always give reasons for loving, but a woman gives no reasons for loving.
Author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Life Is Worth Living

Quote: I was in love one time, I said as I held up my pinky. I would have held up my index finger, but I wasn't in love that long.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: It is said that power corrupts, but actually it's more true that power attracts the corruptible. The sane are usually attracted by other things than power.
Author: David Brin

Quote: The true miracle lies in our eagerness to allow, appreciate, and honor the uniqueness, and freedom of each sentient being to sing the song of their heart.
Author: Amit Ray

Author: Amit Ray

Quote: I’m learning to play the saxophone so when you feel lonely I can come over and stand in the shadows and play it for you. Two is one too lonely for me.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

To learn something new is a timeless pleasure and a valuable treasure. And not all things that you learn are taught to you, but many things that you learn you realize you have taught yourself.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Author: Bill Watterson

Quote: If you want to be a new man you have to stay in new places, and do new things, with people who never knew you before. If you go back to the same old ways, what else can you be but the same old person?
Author: Joe Abercrombie,  Last Argument of Kings

Quote: As soon as you cross the county line into where all the wealthier people live, the weather is suddenly sunnier and warmer. Even at night.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: As soon as you cross the county line into where all the wealthier people live, the weather is suddenly sunnier and warmer. Even at night.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Take some cues from some Q’s. Quality and quantity lead to queues.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Losing you is most difficult for me, but the nature of my love for you is what matters. If it distorts into half-truth, then perhaps it is better not to love you. I must keep my mind but loose you.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Hard-Boiled Wonderland and the End of the World

Quote: Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
Author: John Wooden

Quote: Don't let what you cannot do interfere with what you can do.
Author: John Wooden

Quote: Aslan: You doubt your value. Don't run from who you are.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  Prince Caspian

Quote: Confidence is like a dragon where, for every head cut off, two more heads grow back.
Author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

Quote: Confidence is like a dragon where, for every head cut off, two more heads grow back.
Author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

Quote: I no longer agree to treat myself with disrespect. Every time a self-critical thought comes to mind, I will forgive the Judge and follow this comment with words of praise, self-acceptance, and love.
Author: Miguel Ruiz

Quote: Those who travel to mountain-tops are half in love with themselves, and half in love with oblivion.
Author: Robert Macfarlane,  Mountains of the Mind: A History of a Fascination

Quote: Only when I fall do I get up again.
Author: Vincent van Gogh

Quote: You look at yourself and you accept yourself for who you are, and once you accept yourself for who you are you become a better person.
Author: Oprah Winfrey

Quote: You say freak, I say unique.
Author: Christian Baloga

Quote: Freedom is indivisible; the chains on any one of my people were the chains on all of them, the chains on all of my people were the chains on me.
Author: Nelson Mandela,  Long Walk to Freedom: The Autobiograpy of Nelson Mandela with Connections

Quote: We carry about us the burden of what thousands of people have said and the memories of all our misfortunes. To abandon all that is to be alone, and the mind that is alone is not only innocent but young -- not in time or age, but young, innocent, alive at whatever age -- and only such a mind can see that which is truth and that which is not measurable by words.
Author: Jiddu Krishnamurti

Quote: ‎No people whose word for 'yesterday' is the same as their word for 'tomorrow' can be said to have a firm grip on the time.
Author: Salman Rushdie,  Midnight's Children

Quote: Funny thing about glass. When you broke the shit up, it got pissed and bit back.
Author: J.R. Ward,  Covet

Quote: Slumber party with Dracula, all things considerd why not?
Author: Jeaniene Frost,  Destined for an Early Grave

Quote: THE WOMAN WAS GOING TO KILL HIM, and not because she was stronger and more vicious than he was. Which, if he thought about it, she was. He’d never ripped a man’s throat out with his teeth, and he was damned impressed that Gwen had. She’d made the Lords of the Underworld look like marshmallows.
Author: Gena Showalter,  The Darkest Whisper

Quote: I am human and I need to be loved,just like everybody else does.
Author: Morrissey

Quote: You're kidding,"Shane said. "Do you think I want to visit Crazy McTeeth in his lair of insanity?""No,"Claire said, "but I'm pretty sure you won't like it if I go alone when I just kind of promised to be with you. So...?""Right. I've been missing Nutty McFang anyway.""Stop making up names for him.""What about Count Crackula?""Just stop.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Last Breath

Quote: My girlfriend is a party girl angel who can kick some arse and cook.
Author: Wendy Higgins,  Sweet Peril

Quote: I would so hate to be a first-person character! Always on your guard, always having people read your thoughts!
Author: Jasper Fforde,  Lost in a Good Book

Quote: Death comes to us all; we can only choose how to face it when it comes.
Author: Robert Jordan,  The Dragon Reborn

Quote: No one asked you to be happy. Get to work.
Author: Colette

Quote: [I]t is the wine that leads me on,the wild winethat sets the wisest man to singat the top of his lungs,laugh like a fool – it drives theman to dancing... it eventempts him to blurt out storiesbetter never told.
Author: Homer,  The Odyssey

Quote: The only tyrant I accept in this world is the 'still small voice' within me. And even though I have to face the prospect of being a minority of one, I humbly believe I have the courage to be in such a hopeless minority.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi,  The Essential Gandhi: An Anthology of His Writings on His Life, Work, and Ideas

Quote: It takes a certain ingenuous faith - but I have it - to believe that people who read and reflect more likely than not come to judge things with liberality and truth.
Author: A.C. Grayling,  The Heart of Things: Applying Philosophy to the 21st Century

Quote: It takes a certain ingenuous faith - but I have it - to believe that people who read and reflect more likely than not come to judge things with liberality and truth.
Author: A.C. Grayling,  The Heart of Things: Applying Philosophy to the 21st Century

Quote: You look up when you wish to be exalted. And I look down because I am exalted.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Thus Spoke Zarathustra

Quote: You look up when you wish to be exalted. And I look down because I am exalted.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Thus Spoke Zarathustra

Quote: Hope and Memory have one daughter and her name is Art, and she has built her dwelling far from the desperate field where men hang out their garments upon forked boughs to be banners of battle. O beloved daughter of Hope and Memory, be with me for a while.
Author: W.B. Yeats

Quote: Hope and Memory have one daughter and her name is Art, and she has built her dwelling far from the desperate field where men hang out their garments upon forked boughs to be banners of battle. O beloved daughter of Hope and Memory, be with me for a while.

Quote: There is no justice in love, no proportion in it, and there need not be, because in any specific instance it is only a glimpse or parable of an embracing, incomprehensible reality. It makes no sense at all because it is the eternal breaking in on the temporal. So how could it subordinate itself to cause or consequence?
Author: Marilynne Robinson,  Gilead

Quote: Everyone would like to have stronger faith. By themselves, the scriptures may not strengthen your faith, but being faithful to what they teach, does. In other words, faith cannot be separated from faithfulness.
Author: John Bytheway,  When Times Are Tough: 5 Scriptures That Will Help You Get Through Almost Anything

Quote: Women who focus on style over substance usually find themselves in a big fucking hole, with other men who want to fuck the hole. Oh so smooth, and none sophistacted. Because, you know, how sophisticated can hole-fucking really be
Author: Emilie Autumn

Quote: I don't want to go on being a root in the dark,vacillating, stretched out, shivering with sleep,downward, in the soaked guts of the earth,absorbing and thinking, eating each day.
Author: Pablo Neruda

Quote: The most adventurous journey to embark on; is the journey to yourself, the most exciting thing to discover; is who you really are, the most treasured pieces that you can find; are all the pieces of you, the most special portrait you can recognize; is the portrait of your soul.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: I will bathe in your warmth ma petite. Roll you around me until my heart beats only for you. My breath will grow warm from your kiss.
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Burnt Offerings

Quote: Falling in love is not a rational process. It can't be planned or avoided. It happens--for good or bad it simply happens. - Katrina Svensen
Author: Suzanne Selfors,  Coffeehouse Angel

Quote: Reality provides us with facts so romantic that imagination itself could add nothing to them.
Author: Jules Verne

Quote: Reality provides us with facts so romantic that imagination itself could add nothing to them.
Author: Jules Verne

Quote: There is no such thing as a problem without a gift for you in its hands. You seek problems because you need their gifts.
Author: Richard Bach

Quote: I refuse to believe that Hendrix had the last possessed hand,that Joplin had the last drunken throat,that Morrison had the last enlightened mind.
Author: Patti Smith

Quote: Did I ever tell you the difference between a Northern fairy tale and a Southern one?"she asked him, indulging herself and letting her head rest on his shoulder. God, he felt good. Her man. Where her head was meant to lie, right there, on him. "What's the difference?""A Northern one starts 'once upon a time,' while a Southern one starts 'y'all ain't going to believe this shit.
Author: Erin McCarthy,  Hot Finish

Quote: Are you two you know?"Jacob pointed at us. "Together? Together? "I didn't get a chance to answer. Cam spun me around and kissed me, right there between the two buildings. It was no friendly peck on the lips. When our tongues touched, my bag slipped off my arm and hit the frosted ground."Holy crap,"Jacob muttered. "I think they're going to make babies.
Author: Jennifer L. Armentrout,  Wait for You

Quote: Sentiment without action is the ruin of the soul.
Author: Edward Abbey

Quote: Power-lust is a weed that grows only in the vacant lots of an abandoned mind.
Author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

Quote: The object of a New Year is not that we should have a new year. It is that we should have a new soul and a new nose; new feet, a new backbone, new ears, and new eyes. Unless a particular man made New Year resolutions, he would make no resolutions. Unless a man starts afresh about things, he will certainly do nothing effective.
Author: G.K. Chesterton,  A Chesterton calendar

Quote: Science is a bit like the joke about the drunk who is looking under a lamppost for a key that he has lost on the other side of the street, because that's where the light is. It has no other choice.
Author: Noam Chomsky

Quote: Discovery is always rape of the natural world. Always.
Author: Michael Crichton,  Jurassic Park

Quote: I can promise you books and conversation and all my heart.
Author: Gabrielle Zevin,  The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry

Quote: It's delicious to have people adore you, but it's exhausting, too. Particularly when your own feelings don't match theirs.
Author: Tasha Alexander,  A Fatal Waltz

Quote: Now this might disturb you, but I find I'm OK by myself;and I don't need you or your benevolence to make sense.
Author: Morrissey

Quote: Anything was better than nothing. Half-full was better than empty. Ignorance was the lowest form of humiliation and suffering.
Author: Becca Fitzpatrick,  Silence

Quote: and every day I thank [God] that I am alive, not because I fear death, but because my wife has a husband and my son is not an orphan.
Author: Khaled Hosseini

Quote: If I found 20 dollars on the ground, I’d be willing to bet I’d find someone in desperate need of money that I could give it to. And I’d bet 20 dollars, so even after finding and giving away 20 dollars, I’d have made 20 dollars.

It's OK to scream, 'I'm starving' in public if you are hungry; it's OK to make a fuss and say, 'I'm so sleepy', if you are tired; but somehow we cannot say, 'I need some more love.' Why can't we say it? It's just as basic a need.
Author: Chetan Bhagat,  One Night at the Call Center

Author: Leo Buscaglia

Quote: My next breath may very well be in your lungs. Store it wisely, because my life depends on it.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Title is Invisible

Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Title is Invisible

Author: Rudyard Kipling,  The Light That Failed

Quote: People leave imprints on our lives, shaping who we become in much the same way that a symbol is pressed into the page of a book to tell you who it comes from. Dogs, however, leave paw prints on our lives and our souls, which are as unique as fingerprints in every way.
Author: Ashly Lorenzana

Quote: Being faithful in the smallest things is the way to gain, maintain, and demonstrate the strength needed to accomplish something great.
Author: Alex Harris

Quote: Things will get easier, people's minds will change, and you should be alive to see it.
Author: Ellen DeGeneres

Quote: Things will get easier, people's minds will change, and you should be alive to see it.
Author: Ellen DeGeneres

Quote: All successful people men and women are big dreamers. They imagine what their future could be, ideal in every respect, and then they work every day toward their distant vision, that goal or purpose.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: All successful people men and women are big dreamers. They imagine what their future could be, ideal in every respect, and then they work every day toward their distant vision, that goal or purpose.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: The power of God is with you at all times; through the activities of mind, senses, breathing, and emotions; and is constantly doing all the work using you as a mere instrument.
Author: Anonymous,  Bhagavad Gita: El Canto del Senor

Quote: After all, it's all kinds of things that make up a life, right? The big, like falling in love and spending time with your family, and the little....like blow drying your hair, applying concealer, and cursing those magazine inserts. It all counts. It has to.
Author: Sarah Dessen

Quote: There is a road from the eye to the heart that does not go through the intellect.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: Loneliness and the feeling of being unwanted is the most terrible poverty.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: Gordon Edgley's sudden death came as a shock to everyone - not least himself. One moment he was in his study, seven words into the twenty-fifth sentence of the final chapter of his new book, And the Darkness Rained upon Them, and the next he was dead. A tragic loss, his mind echoed numbly as he slipped away.
Author: Derek Landy,  Skulduggery Pleasant

Quote: Razo hopped back up and adopted a posture that said he was completely unruffled, never had been, and in fact was ready to do something manly like lift boulders or swallow live worms.
Author: Shannon Hale,  River Secrets

Quote: To accomplish great things, we must dream as well as act.
Author: Anatole France

Quote: If your life is worth thinking about,it is worth writing about.
Author: Robin S. Sharma

Quote: I bet you anything that 10 times out of 10, Nicky, Vinny and Tony will beat the shit out of Todd, Kyle and Tucker.
Author: George Carlin

Quote: Sure,” she said, and hugged the laptop bag closer. “What could go wrong?”Michael’s eyes flashed to meet hers in the rearview mirror.Besides everything, I mean,” she said.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Fade Out

Quote: Mary had a little lamb, its fleece electrostatic / And everywhere Mary went, the lights became erratic.
Author: David Foster Wallace,  Infinite Jest

Quote: I had a dream about you. The seasons changed, but you did not. You were the same old person you always were, only older. And I was the same old person I always was, only younger. Yes, I’d discovered the Fountain of Youth, and since we were such old friends, I was going to let you have a swig for 10% off the suggested retail price.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  We Had A #Dream About You

Quote: Don't turn over the rocks if you don't want to see the pale creatures who live under them.
Author: Janet Fitch,  White Oleander

Quote: Can you be happy with the movies, and the ads, and the clothes in the stores, and the doctors, and the eyes as you walk down the street all telling you there is something wrong with you? No. You cannot be happy. Because, you poor darling baby, you believe them.
Author: Katherine Dunn,  Geek Love

Quote: But love wasn't about sacrifice, and it wasn't about falling short of someone's expectations. By definition, love made you better than good enough; it redefined perfection to include your traits, instead of excluding them. All any of us wanted, really, was to know that we counted. That someone else's life would not have been as rich without us here.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Handle with Care

Quote: People who can change and change again are so much more reliable and happier than those who can’t
Author: Stephen Fry,  Moab Is My Washpot

Quote: Chronic anxiety is a state more undesirable than any other, and we will try almost any maneuver to eliminate it. Modern man is living in anxious anticipation of destruction. Such anxiety can be easily eliminated by self-destruction. As a German saying puts it: 'Better an end with terror than a terror without end.
Author: Robert E. Neale,  The Art of Dying

Quote: Every poem should remind the reader that they are going to die.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: Every poem should remind the reader that they are going to die.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: Perfection of character is this: to live each day as if it were your last, without frenzy, without apathy, without pretence.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: Grace is what picks me up and lifts my wings high above and I fly! Grace always conquers! Be graceful in everything; in anger, in sadness, in joy, in kindness, in unkindness, retain grace with you!
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: The purpose of poetry is to remind ushow difficult it is to remain just one person,for our house is open, there are no keys in the doors, and invisible guests come in and out at will.
Author: Czesław Miłosz

Quote: You may be the only person left who believes in you, but it's enough. It takes just one star to pierce a universe of darkness. Never give up.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

Quote: Women writers make for rewarding (and efficient) lovers. They are clever liars to fathers and husbands; yet they never hold their tongues too long, nor keep ardent typing fingers still.
Author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

Quote: Women writers make for rewarding (and efficient) lovers. They are clever liars to fathers and husbands; yet they never hold their tongues too long, nor keep ardent typing fingers still.
Author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

Quote: Doesn't it scare you sometimes how time flies and nothing changes?
Author: Ika Natassa,  Antologi Rasa

Quote: Closed. Plenty of time to see it later, remember?"He leads me into the courtyard, and I take the opportunity to admire his backside. Callipygian. There is something better than Notre-Dame.
Author: Stephanie Perkins,  Anna and the French Kiss

Quote: Existence is a series of footnotes to a vast, obscure, unfinished masterpiece.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: I am a religious person, although I am not a believer.
Author: Philip Pullman

Quote: Self-observation is the first step of inner unfolding.
Author: Amit Ray,  Yoga and Vipassana: An Integrated Life Style

Quote: Inspiration is always a surprising visitor.
Author: John O'Donohue,  Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom

Quote: The imagination needs moodling,--long, inefficient happy idling, dawdling and puttering.
Author: Brenda Ueland

Quote: Huh, another queen,” Puck mused, an evil grin crossing his face. “Maybe we should drop in and introduce ourselves, ice-boy. Do the whole, hey, we were just in the neighborhood, and we were just wondering if you had any plans to take over the Nevernever. Have a fruit basket.
Author: Julie Kagawa,  The Lost Prince

Quote: She moved like water, graceful and soft and lovely. Every part of me wanted to stick out my foot and trip her, just to see her stumble.
Author: Cassandra Rose Clarke,  The Assassin's Curse

Quote: Common sense is in spite of, not the result of, education.
Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: There are two infinities that confuse me: the one in my soul devours me; the one around me will crush me
Author: Gustave Flaubert

Quote: الأمر الوحيد الذي أندم عليه هو أنه لن يتسنى لي قراءة كل الكتب التي أود قرائتها.
Author: فرانسواز ساجان

Quote: The book smelled dusty and old but also carried a sweet tang, a hint of something inviting. She opened to the first page and started to read, pronouncing the words in a reverent whisper.
Author: Shannon Hale

Quote: People talk about books being an escape, but here on the tube, this one feels more like a lifeline...The motion of the train makes her head rattle, but her eyes lock on the words the way a figure skater might choose a focal point as she spins, and just like that, she's grounded again.
Author: Jennifer E. Smith,  The Statistical Probability of Love at First Sight

Quote: Books are the most tolerant of friends.
Author: Richard Paul Evans

Quote: If opportunity doesn't knock, build a door.
Author: Milton Berle

Quote: If you look at anyone who has achieved great success and wealth, people like Warren Buffett, Oprah Winfrey, or Lance Armstrong, they have all focused intensely in order to win.
Author: Robert Kiyosaki

Quote: Lots of people want to ride with you in the limo, but what you want is someone who will take the bus with you when the limo breaks down.
Author: Oprah Winfrey

Quote: Hope is but the dream of those who wake.
Author: Matthew Prior

Quote: Hope is but the dream of those who wake.
Author: Matthew Prior

Quote: A lot of us grow up and we grow out of the literal interpretation that we get when we're children, but we bear the scars all our life. Whether they're scars of beauty or scars of ugliness, it's pretty much in the eye of the beholder.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: May you live as long as you wish and love as long as you live.
Author: Robert A. Heinlein

Quote: May you live as long as you wish and love as long as you live.
Author: Robert A. Heinlein

Quote: I think shows that are completely dramatic are a lie. People use humor to cope. That is how we deal with things. In the darkest situations, there's humor. And if you don't show that, you're not being true to real life.
Author: Jenji Kohan

Quote: An artist's only concern is to shoot for some kind of perfection, and on his own terms, not anyone else's.
Author: J. D. Salinger

Quote: Or, rather, let us be more simple and less vain.
Author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

Author: Jim Butcher,  Vignette

Quote: Rule of life. If you bother to ask someone’s advice, then bother to listen to it.
Author: Sophie Kinsella,  Confessions of a Shopaholic

Author: Jarod Kintz,  Xazaqazax

Author: Orhan Pamuk,  The Museum of Innocence
