Quote: You will write if you will write without thinking of the result in terms of a result, but think of the writing in terms of discovery, which is to say that creation must take place between the pen and the paper, not before in a thought or afterwards in a recasting... It will come if it is there and if you will let it come.
Author: Gertrude Stein

Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quote: If a cricketer, for instance, suddenly decided to go into a school and batter a lot of people to death with a cricket bat, which he could do very easily, I mean, are you going to ban cricket bats?

Author: Robert Harris

Author: Mitch Albom,  Have a Little Faith: a True Story

Quote: I became aware that the invincible power that has moved the world is unrequited, not happy, love.
Author: Gabriel Garcí­a Márquez

Quote: After every storm, there is a rainbow. If you have eyes, you will find it. If you have wisdom, you will create it. If you have love for yourself and others, you won’t need it.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Author: Robert A. Heinlein

Quote: It was odd, (Tessa thought), what brought out tenderness in people.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

Quote: Insecurities have the ability to shape and mold our minds to live with everything that’s bad; like crying on the inside, while smiling on the outside…thus creating pain…but, alas, I have the answer; forget about what you thought and enjoy (embrace) what you feel
Author: Jeremy Aldana

Quote: The more I understand the mind and the human experience, the more I begin to suspect there is no such thing as unhappiness; there is only ungratefulness.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: On the death of a friend, we should consider that the fates through confidence have devolved on us the task of a double living, that we have henceforth to fulfill the promise of our friend's life also, in our own, to the world.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: What makes a hero? Courage, strength, morality, withstanding adversity? Are these the traits that truly show and create a hero? Is the light truly the source of darkness or vice versa? Is the soul a source of hope or despair? Who are these so called heroes and where do they come from? Are their origins in obscurity or in plain sight?
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Notes from Underground

Quote: My feeling is, quite simply, that if there is a God, He has done such a bad jobthat he isn't worth discussing.
Author: Isaac Asimov

Quote: Right, well, he'd been sick for a while and his nurse said to him, 'You seem to be feeling better this morning,' and Isben looked at her and said, 'On the contrary,' and then he died.
Author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

Quote: Before you find your soul mate, you must first discover your soul.
Author: Charles F. Glassman,  Brain Drain The Breakthrough That Will Change Your Life

Quote: I don't regret my painful times, i bare my scars as if they were medals. I know that freedom has a high price, as high as that of slavery; the only difference is that you pay with pleasure and a smile, even when that that smile dimmed by tears
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Know what you are talking about.
Author: Pope John Paul II

Quote: I need to figure out the secret. I need to work out how to keep things flying back to me instead of always flying away.

Quote: Life is a book waiting to happen.

Quote: I would know you anywhere for my true love. Whoever I was and whoever you were, I would know you at once for my true love.

Quote: A strong man cannot help a weaker unless the weaker is willing to be helped, and even then the weak man must become strong of himself; he must, by his own efforts, develop the strength which he admires in another. None but himself can alter his condition.

Quote: Paying alimony is like feeding hay to a dead horse.

Quote: Thou art a very ragged Wart.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Henry IV, Part 2

Quote: Yes, because a vampire slumber party is the pinnacle of safety conscious behavior.
Author: Stephenie Meyer,  Eclipse

Quote: We must do our work for its own sake, not for fortune or attention or applause.

Quote: There are going to be times when you learn more about the world you’re entering and feel defeated when you see the gap between the ideal and the reality… But that’s something we’ll all face. The people that face those obstacles and overcome them are people whose dreams come true.

Quote: The purpose of education is not to validate ignorance but to overcome it
Author: Lawrence M. Krauss

Quote: One glance at (a book) and you hear the voice of another person - perhaps someone dead for thousands of years. Across the millenia, the author is speaking, clearly and silently, inside your head, directly to you. Writing is perhaps the greatest of human inventions, binding together people, citizens of distant epochs, who never knew one another. Books break the shackles of time.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: I think a good book is a good book forever.I don't think they get less good because times change.
Author: Megan Whalen Turner

Quote: Occasionally in life there are those moments of unutterable fulfillment which cannot be completely explained by those symbols called words. Their meanings can only be articulated by the inaudible language of the heart.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.

Author: Alain de Botton

You know where you are when someone asks you 'What's the time?' or 'When was the battle of 1066?' or 'How do these seatbelts work that go tight when you slam the brakes on, Daddy?' The answers are easy and are, respectively, 'Seven-thirty in the evening,' 'Ten-fifteen in the morning,' and 'Don't ask stupid questions.

Author: Pope John Paul II

And where, I ask you, can a man escape to, when he hasn't enough madness left inside him? The truth is an endless death agony. The truth is death. You have to choose: death or lies. I've never been able to kill myself.

It wasn't the grand doctrines or the sweeping ideals that seemed to make believers out of men. It was the simple magic in the world around them.
Author: Brandon Sanderson,  The Hero of Ages

Quote: Hearts rebuilt from hope resurrect dreams killed by hate.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: Hearts rebuilt from hope resurrect dreams killed by hate.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: Your faith will not fail while God sustains it; you are not strong enough to fall away while God is resolved to hold you.
Author: J.I. Packer,  Knowing God

Quote: An eye for an eye my friend.
Author: Tsugumi Ohba

Quote: Everyone dies. It is how one lives that matters.
Author: R.A. Salvatore

Quote: Better was it to go unknown and leave behind you an arch, then to burn like a meteor and leave no dust.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Orlando

Quote: As Unto the bow the the cord is ,So unto the man is woman;Though she bends him, she obeys him,Though she draws him , yet she follows:Useless each without the other.
Author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

Quote: Knowledge is a better weapon than a sword.
Author: Patricia Briggs,  Raven's Shadow

Quote: All sciences are vain and full of errors that are not born of Experience, the mother of all Knowledge.
Author: Leonardo da Vinci,  Leonardo's Notebooks

Quote: All sciences are vain and full of errors that are not born of Experience, the mother of all Knowledge.
Author: Leonardo da Vinci,  Leonardo's Notebooks

Quote: No it's not!"said Constable Visit. "Atheism is a denial of a god.""Therefore It Is A Religious Position,"said Dorfl. "Indeed, A True Atheist Thinks Of The Gods Constantly, Albeit In Terms of Denial. Therefore, Atheism Is A Form Of Belief. If The Atheist Truly Did Not Believe, He Or She Would Not Bother To Deny.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Feet of Clay

Quote: Better a good journalist than a poor assassin.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre

Quote: That's the trouble with loving a wild thing: You're always left watching the door.
Author: Edith Pattou,  East

Quote: I only snatched him to get your attention,” I said. “Now that I’ve got it, this is what I want.”“Damn my dame!” Al shouted, hands raised to the ceiling. “I knew it! Not another list!
Author: Kim Harrison,  White Witch, Black Curse

Quote: When you write a book, you spend day after day scanning and identifying the trees. When you’re done, you have to step back and look at the forest.
Author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

Quote: And when demigods use cell phones, the signals agitate every monster within a hundred miles. It's like sending up a flare: Here I am! Please rearrange my face!
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Last Olympian

Quote: No matter how small you start, always dream big.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: Here is a test to find out whether your mission in life is complete. If you’re alive, it isn’t.
Author: Lauren Bacall

Quote: If your success is not on your own terms, if it looks good to the world but does not feel good in your heart, it is not success at all.
Author: Anna Quindlen

Quote: Every night, I have to read a book, so that my mind will stop thinking about things that I stress about.
Author: Britney Spears

Quote: Books fall open, you fall in
Author: David T.W. McCord

Quote: A little kid asks my dad why that man is chopping down the tree.Dad: He's not chopping it down. He's saving it. Those branches were long dead from disease. All plants are like that. By cutting off the damage you make it possible for the tree to grow again. You watch - by the end of summer, this tree will be the strongest on the block.
Author: Laurie Halse Anderson,  Speak

Quote: I just want to do something that matters. Or be something that matters. I just want to matter.
Author: John Green,  An Abundance of Katherines

Quote: I just want to do something that matters. Or be something that matters. I just want to matter.
Author: John Green,  An Abundance of Katherines

Quote: I look at you and see all the ways a soul can bruise, and I wish I could sink my hands into your flesh and light lanterns along your spine so you know that there's nothing but light when I see you.
Author: Shinji Moon,  The Anatomy of Being

Quote: The only certainty life contains is death.
Author: Patricia Briggs,  When Demons Walk

Quote: The only certainty life contains is death.
Author: Patricia Briggs,  When Demons Walk

Quote: You can't regret the life you didn't lead.
Author: Junot Díaz,  The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao

Quote: Love gives you wings. Icarus and the Challenger both had wings, and so did my first love letter, after I folded it up and flung it at my crush.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

Quote: Love is a boomerang dripped in honey, in that it emanates from me just as surely as it will return to me. Still, I think I’d much rather wash my hands and be done with it.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Love is a boomerang dripped in honey, in that it emanates from me just as surely as it will return to me. Still, I think I’d much rather wash my hands and be done with it.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I will not die an unlived life.I will not live in fearof falling or catching fire.I choose to inhabit my days,to allow my living to open me,to make me less afraid,more accessible;to loosen my heartuntil it becomes a wing, a torch, a promise.I choose to risk my significance,to live so that which came to me as seedgoes to the next as blossom,and that which came to me as blossom,goes on as fruit.
Author: Dawna Markova,  I Will Not Die an Unlived Life: Reclaiming Purpose and Passion

Quote: When I pictured myself, it was always like just an outline in a colouring book, with the inside not yet completed.
Author: Sarah Dessen

Quote: A great human revolution in just a single individual will help achieve a change in the destiny of a nation and, further, can even enable a change in the destiny of all humankind.
Author: Daisaku Ikeda,  The Human Revolution

Quote: To be a philosopher is not merely to have subtle thoughts, nor even to found a school, but so to love wisdom as to live according to its dictates, a life of simplicity, independence, magnanimity and trust.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: You can't shake hands with a clenched fist.
Author: Indira Gandhi

Quote: It was stupid to hope, she knew. But sometimes hope was all you had.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Lost Souls

Quote: It was stupid to hope, she knew. But sometimes hope was all you had.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Lost Souls

Quote: In Paris they just simply opened their eyes and stared when we spoke to them in French! We never did succeed in making those idiots understand their own language.
Author: Mark Twain,  The Innocents Abroad

Quote: I don't regret the painful times; I bare my scars as if they were medals.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: You have to rise above the squabbling and chaos, and keep believing. You have to always keep your goals in mind.” -Hera, goddess of marriage
Author: Rick Riordan

Quote: No matter who we are, no matter what our circumstances, our feelings and emotions are universal. And music has always been a great way to make people aware of that connection. It can help you open up a part of yourself and express feelings you didn't know you were feeling. It's risky to let that happen. But it's a risk you have to take-because only then will you find you're not alone.
Author: Josh Groban

Quote: I don’t want anyone to hold back who they are. It’s not okay… it’s not a good thing
Author: Connor Franta

Quote: Difficulties increase the nearer we get to the goal.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: The word 'listen' contains the same letters as the word 'silent'.
Author: Alfred Brendel

Quote: It infuriates me to be wrong when I know I'm right.
Author: Molière

Quote: One time I actually cleaned out my closet so good I ended up on the cover of Time magazine.
Author: Ellen DeGeneres

Quote: One must find the source within one's own Self, one must possess it. Everything else was seeking -- a detour, an error.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Siddhartha

Quote: Fly without wings; Dream with open eyes; See in darkness.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic

Quote: Fly without wings; Dream with open eyes; See in darkness.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic

Quote: Fly without wings; Dream with open eyes; See in darkness.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic

Quote: No one can grant you happiness. Happiness is a choice we all have the power to make.
Author: Dean Koontz,  Life Expectancy

Quote: I still believe that peace and plenty and happiness can be worked out some way. I am a fool.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: Things are not always what they seem; the first appearance deceives many; the intelligence of a few perceives what has been carefully hidden.
Author: Phaedrus

Quote: Before I die, I want to change my name to "Here,"so that my tombstone could simply read, "Here lies."And then people who knew me could walk by, shake their head, and say, "Ain't that the truth.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want Two apply for a job at our country's largest funeral home, and then wear a suit and noose to the job interview.

Quote: There was a lot they didn’t tell you about death, she had discovered, and one of the biggies was how long it took the ones you loved most to die in your heart.
Author: Stephen King,  Lisey's Story

Quote: He had been bored, that's all, bored like most people. Hence he had made himself out of whole cloth a life full of complications and drama. Something must happen - and that explains most human commitments. Something must happen, even loveless slavery, even war or death. Hurray then for funerals!
Author: Albert Camus,  The Fall

Quote: In order to share one's true brilliance one initially has to risk looking like a fool: genius is like a wheel that spins so fast, it at first glance appears to be sitting still.
Author: Criss Jami,  Venus in Arms

Quote: God always gives his best to those who leave the choice with him
Author: Jim Elliot

Quote: I could still feel the ghost of him hovering in the quiet, dark recess of my heart. It was as if he was just waiting for me to be lonely, or to let my guard down, so that he could surface and fill my mind again with thoughts of him.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: She had not made a decision to give up sex, only the clamor of romance, because it was exhausting her, doing her no good and too much harm...
Author: Michelle Herman,  Dog

Quote: Sometimes letting go is the only way to find out who you're meant to hold on to.
Author: J. Sterling,  The Perfect Game

Quote: I hate witches. Humans had the right idea, burning them at the stake.
Author: Charlaine Harris,  Dead to the World

Quote: My brother spent a large portion of the agonizingly slow drive to school banging his forehead on the stearing wheel.
Author: Michelle Hodkin,  The Unbecoming of Mara Dyer

Quote: This is America. We’re entitled to our opinions.”“Wrong. This is Texas. And my opinion is the only one that counts.
Author: Susan Elizabeth Phillips,  Call Me Irresistible

Quote: As a writer, I need an enormous amount of time alone. Writing is 90 percent procrastination: reading magazines, eating cereal out of the box, watching infomercials. It's a matter of doing everything you can to avoid writing, until it is about four in the morning and you reach the point where you have to write. Having anybody watching that or attempting to share it with me would be grisly.
Author: Paul Rudnick

Quote: There are no secrets to success: don’t waste time looking for them. Success is the result of perfection, hard work, learning from failure, loyalty to those for whom you work, and persistence.
Author: Colin Powell

Quote: And this our life, exempt from public haunt, finds tongues in trees, books in the running brooks, sermons in stones, and good in everything. I would not change it.
Author: William Shakespeare,  As You Like It

Quote: I don't know where people got the idea that characters in books are supposed to be likable. Books are not in the business of creating merely likeable characters with whom you can have some simple identification with. Books are in the business of creating great stories that make you're brain go ahhbdgbdmerhbergurhbudgerbudbaaarr.
Author: John Green

Quote: Just like heaven. Ever’body wants a little piece of lan’. I read plenty of books out here. Nobody never gets to heaven, and nobody gets no land. It’s just in their head. They’re all the time talkin’ about it, but it’s jus’ in their head.
Author: John Steinbeck,  Of Mice and Men

Quote: It was like walking into a treasure trove of books, hoarded by pirate librarians.
Author: Pseudonymous Bosch,  The Name of This Book Is Secret

Quote: As cities grow and technology takes over the world belief and imagination fade away and so do we.
Author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron King

Quote: When scientifically investigating the natural world, the only thing worse than a blind believer is a seeing denier.
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson,  Death by Black Hole: And Other Cosmic Quandaries

Quote: I believe in pink. I believe that laughing is the best calorie burner. I believe in kissing, kissing a lot. I believe in being strong when everything seems to be going wrong. I believe that happy girls are the prettiest girls. I believe that tomorrow is another day and I believe in miracles.
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Quote: You've achieved success in your field when you don't know whether what you're doing is work or play.
Author: Warren Beatty

Quote: Friends are the best to turn to when you're having a rough day.
Author: Justin Bieber

Quote: I just can't think how I would go on without children having lost Edith already... It's too upsetting for me to write about them. Naturally, I still hope, and wait, wait, wait.
Author: Otto Frank

Quote: Wealth is the ability to fully experience life.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: Power is of two kinds. One is obtained by the fear of punishment and the other by acts of love. Power based on love is a thousand times more effective and permanent then the one derived from fear of punishment.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: When I did 'Sex and the City,' it was like, 'Let's do a comedy where the humor is not coming from innuendo but from the a truthful place. This is a show where we're going to be able to say and do what we want.'
Author: Darren Star

Quote: An artist never really finishes his work, he merely abandons it.
Author: Paul Valery

Quote: I have good news and I have bad news. The good news is that your house hasn't burned down, you don't have cancer, and your daughter hasn't been raped or murdered. The bad news is that I ran over your dog. And your son. And his wife. But not before I ran out of gas to achieve all of that.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: Isn't it sad how some people's grip on their lives is so precarious that they'll embrace any preposterous delusion rather than face an occasional bleak truth?
Author: Bill Watterson,  The Complete Calvin and Hobbes

Quote: Sooner or later in life, we will all take our own turn being in the position we once had someone else in.
Author: Ashly Lorenzana

Quote: I would argue that unless the two people are in love, all sex is bad sex, because why eat cotton candy when you can have edible clouds? Sure, it seems sweet at the time, but that’s just a carnival and carnal rush and wears off quickly. But love adds an extra dimension that takes an earthy thing like sex and makes it absolutely heavenly.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Author: Suzanne Collins,  Catching Fire

Author: Suzanne Collins,  Catching Fire

Quote: It is worth it to leave behing my minor life for grander maybes-Miles "Pudge
Author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

Quote: For one day there will be nothing left, yet we will have something. -me-I tried to wait for my life to begin. Something has to happen. Like an amazing boy. I know he's out there. I just have to find him.
Author: Susane Colasanti,  When It Happens

Quote: Sometimes life doesn't happen in chronological order.
Author: Colleen Hoover,  Slammed

Quote: My reasons to liveWere my reasons to dieBut at least they were mineNow I've freedom unboundCut the laces of life
Author: Emilie Autumn

Quote: My reasons to liveWere my reasons to dieBut at least they were mineNow I've freedom unboundCut the laces of life
Author: Emilie Autumn

Quote: Bring something incomprehensible into the world!
Author: Gilles Deleuze,  A Thousand Plateaus: Capitalism and Schizophrenia

Quote: Let yourself be open and life will be easier. A spoon of salt in a glass of water makes the water undrinkable. A spoon of salt in a lake is almost unnoticed.
Author: Buddha Siddhartha Guatama Shakyamuni

Quote: Reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions.
Author: David Hume

Quote: إن كان في حياتك تمّة شئٌ يستحقُ التأجيل ... فليكن التأجيلُ نفسُه
Author: عمر طاهر,  الكلاب لا تأكل الشيكولاتة

Quote: I have never felt that anything really mattered but knowing that you stood for the things in which you believed and had done the very best you could.
Author: Eleanor Roosevelt

Quote: They alone live, who live for others.
Author: Swami Vivekananda

Quote: Do not fear the thorns in your path, for they draw only corrupt blood.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: Dead yesterdays and unborn tomorrows, why fret about it, if today be sweet.
Author: Omar Khayyám

Quote: We cannot change what we are not aware of, and once we are aware, we cannot help but change.
Author: Sheryl Sandberg,  Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead

Quote: Women don't want all that. Women just want a partner who is considerate and attentive, who will spoon with them while reciting Keats, and feed them organic yogurt by candlelight on a seaside cliff at sunset.
Author: Stephen Colbert

Quote: I don't think you should wait. I think you should speak now.
Author: Taylor Swift,  Taylor Swift: Speak Now

Quote: Make every effort to change things you do not like. If you cannot make a change, change the way you have been thinking. You might find a new solution.
Author: Maya Angelou,  Letter to My Daughter

Quote: Anything you're good at contributes to happiness.
Author: Bertrand Russell

Quote: living eulogy.she danced.she sang. she took.she gave.she loved.she created.she dissented. she enlivened.she saw. she grew. she sweated.she changed.she learned. she laughed.she shed her skin.she bled on the pages of her days,she walked through walls,she lived with intention.
Author: Mary Anne Radmacher

Quote: I don't have a lot of domestic instincts,"Ranger said to me, his attention fixing on the unidentifiable glob in my hair, "but I have a real strong urge to take you home and hose you down."I went dry mouth. Connie bit into her lower lip, and Lula fanned herself with a file.
Author: Janet Evanovich,  Eleven on Top

Quote: You know your Lamborghini is on fire, right?
Author: Meg Cabot,  Runaway

Quote: I ate a rainbow in a bowl, because it’s better than eating rain soup. Food and water aren’t supposed to be one and the same.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  So many chairs, and no time to sit

Quote: the purpose of life is the life of purpose
Author: Robin S. Sharma,  The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari

Quote: Veganism is not about giving anything up or losing anything; it is about gaining the peace within yourself that comes from embracing nonviolence and refusing to participate in the exploitation of the vulnerable
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: Veganism is not about giving anything up or losing anything; it is about gaining the peace within yourself that comes from embracing nonviolence and refusing to participate in the exploitation of the vulnerable
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: He who doesn't understand history is doomed to repeat it.
Author: Pittacus Lore,  I Am Number Four

Quote: We've got everything we need right here, and everything we need is enough.
Author: Jack Johnson

Quote: Point me out the happy man and I will point you out either extreme egotism, selfishness, evil -- or else an absolute ignorance.
Author: Graham Greene,  The Heart of the Matter

Quote: I cannot choose but adhere to the word of God, which has possession of my conscience; nor can I possibly, nor will I even make any recantation, since it is neither safe nor honest to act contrary to conscience! Here I stand; I cannot do otherwise, so help me God! Amen.
Author: Martin Luther

Quote: I could not believe in a God that would challenge faith like this.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

Quote: I could not believe in a God that would challenge faith like this.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

Quote: I don’t know what’s in the box, but I love it. Unopened gifts contain hope.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Title is Invisible

Quote: Endings are not always bad. Most times they're just beginnings in disguise.
Author: Kim Harrison,  Something Deadly This Way Comes

Quote: [Poetry] is the liquid voice that can wear through stone.
Author: Adrienne Rich,  What is Found There: Notebooks on Poetry and Politics

Quote: Share your knowledge. It is a way to achieve immortality.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: There is a time for reciting poems and a time for fists.
Author: Roberto Bolaño,  The Savage Detectives

Quote: Some of the biggest challenges in relationships come from the fact that most people enter a relationship in order to get something: they're trying to find someone who's going to make them feel good. In reality, the only way a relationship will last is if you see your relationship as a place that you go to give, and not a place that you go to take.
Author: Anthony Robbins

Quote: She turned to look at him, and he was already looking at her. “I’m going to miss you when I wake up,” she whispered, because she realized that she must have fallen asleep under the sun. Arin was too real for her imagination. He was a dream.“Don’t wake up,” he said.
Author: Marie Rutkoski,  The Winner's Crime

Quote: Writing is a concentrated form of thinking...a young writer sees that with words he can place himself more clearly into the world. Words on a page, that's all it takes to help him separate himself from the forces around him, streets and people and pressures and feelings. He learns to think about these things, to ride his own sentences into new perceptions.
Author: Don DeLillo

Quote: Just in terms of allocation of time resources, religion is not very efficient. There`s a lot more I could be doing on a Sunday morning.
Author: Bill Gates

Quote: Failure is an event, never a person.
Author: William D. Brown

Quote: You say I started out with practically nothing, but that isn't correct. We all start with all there is, it's how we use it that makes things possible.
Author: Henry Ford

Quote: Words bounce. Words, if you let them, will do what they want to do and what they have to do.
Author: Anne Carson,  Autobiography of Red

Quote: He was gorgeous, and I absolutely, no question, had to be drooling. After a quick and hopefully stealthy check – big show, I wasn’t!- I found myself wonder what color his eyes were. Brown maybe. Or even hazel. Either way…wow, just wow. Deer? Headlights? Hi, I’m Ali.
Author: Gena Showalter,  Alice in Zombieland

Quote: Moral codes are like the ocean. Some people live by them, while others, such as myself, would rather live by a lake.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

Quote: You can't stop a teacher when they want to do something. They just do it.
Author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

Quote: I am struck by how sharing our weakness and difficulties is more nourishing to others than sharing our qualities and successes.
Author: Jean Vanier,  Community And Growth

Quote: No, I regret nothing, all I regret is having been born, dying is such a long tiresome business I always found.
Author: Samuel Beckett

Quote: No, I regret nothing, all I regret is having been born, dying is such a long tiresome business I always found.
Author: Samuel Beckett

Quote: I'm always happy when I'm surrounded by water, I think I'm a Mermaid or I was a mermaid.The ocean makes me feel really small and it makes me put my whole life into perspective… it humbles you and makes you feel almost like you’ve been baptized. I feel born again when I get out of the ocean.
Author: Beyoncé Knowles

Quote: Nobody sleeps at the Inn of Innovation. You don't wake up, but you do #startup.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Skinny guys fight till they're burger.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Fight Club

Quote: When someone tells you they’ve just bought a house, they might as well tell you they no longer have a personality. You can immediately assume so many things: that they’re locked into jobs they hate; that they’re broke; that they spend every night watching videos; that they’re fifteen pounds overweight; that they no longer listen to new ideas. It’s profoundly depressing.
Author: Douglas Coupland,  Generation X: Tales for an Accelerated Culture

Quote: We never know when our last day on earth will be. So, love with full sincerity, believe with true faith, and hope with all of your might. Better to have lived in truth and discovered life, than to have lived half heartedly and died long before you ever ceased breathing.
Author: Cristina Marrero

Quote: A deadline is negative inspiration. Still, it's better than no inspiration at all.

Quote: I am approximately 96.694444% in love with you. Of course, that’s just a rough estimate.

Author: Washington Irving

Quote: Reading is going toward something that is about to be, and no one yet knows what it will be.

Quote: I love inscriptions on flyleaves and notes in margins, I like the comradely sense of turning pages someone else turned, and reading passages someone long gone has called my attention to.

Author: Gautama Buddha

Author: John Irving,  A Prayer for Owen Meany

Quote: Your prayer for someone may or may not change them, but it always changes YOU.
Author: Craig Groeschel

Quote: Waking up was a daily cruelty, an affront, and she avoided it by not sleeping.
Author: Gregory Maguire,  A Lion Among Men

Quote: To whom could I put this question (with any hope of an answer)? Does being able to live without someone you loved mean you loved her less than you thought...?
Author: Roland Barthes

Quote: Why worry about minor little details like clean air, clean water, safe ports and the safety net when Jesus is going to give the world an "Extreme Makeover: Planet Edition"right after he finishes putting Satan in his place once and for all?
Author: Arianna Huffington

Quote: Why worry about minor little details like clean air, clean water, safe ports and the safety net when Jesus is going to give the world an "Extreme Makeover: Planet Edition"right after he finishes putting Satan in his place once and for all?
Author: Arianna Huffington

Quote: They never fail who die in a great cause.
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: I'm a Christian first, and a mean-spirited, bigoted conservative second, and don't you ever forget it. You know who else was kind of "divisive"in terms of challenging the status quo and the powers-that-be of his day? Jesus Christ.
Author: Ann Coulter,  If Democrats Had Any Brains, They'd Be Republicans

Quote: Suicide sometimes proceeds from cowardice, but not always; for cowardice sometimes prevents it; since as many live because they are afraid to die, as die because they are afraid to live
Author: Charles Caleb Colton

Quote: To be commanded to love God at all, let alone in the wilderness, is like being commanded to be well when we are sick, to sing for joy when we are dying of thirst, to run when our legs are broken. But this is the first and great commandment nonetheless. Even in the wilderness - especially in the wilderness - you shall love him.
Author: Frederick Buechner,  A Room Called Remember: Uncollected Pieces

Quote: Care more for a grain of faith than a ton of excitement.
Author: Charles Haddon Spurgeon

Quote: I am not an optimist, but a great believer of hope.
Author: Nelson Mandela

Quote: So here is my story, may it bringSome smiles and a tear or so,It happened once upon a time,Far away, and long ago,Outside the night wind keens and wails,Come listen to me, the Teller of Tales!
Author: Brian Jacques,  Lord Brocktree

Quote: So here is my story, may it bringSome smiles and a tear or so,It happened once upon a time,Far away, and long ago,Outside the night wind keens and wails,Come listen to me, the Teller of Tales!
Author: Brian Jacques,  Lord Brocktree

Quote: So runs my dream, but what am I?An infant crying in the nightAn infant crying for the lightAnd with no language but a cry.
Author: Alfred Lord Tennyson,  In Memoriam

Quote: So runs my dream, but what am I?An infant crying in the nightAn infant crying for the lightAnd with no language but a cry.
Author: Alfred Lord Tennyson,  In Memoriam

Quote: I am deliberate and afraid of nothing.
Author: Audre Lorde

Quote: I am deliberate and afraid of nothing.
Author: Audre Lorde

Quote: You know how this is:if I lookat the crystal moon, at the red branchof the slow autumn at my window,if I touchnear the firethe impalpable ashor the wrinkled body of the log,everything carries me to you,as if everything that exists,aromas, light, metals,were little boatsthat sailtoward those isles of yours that wait for me.
Author: Pablo Neruda,  The Captain's Verses

Quote: Poets utter great and wise things which they do not themselves understand.
Author: Plato

Quote: Though we tremble before uncertain futuresmay we meet illness, death and adversity with strengthmay we dance in the face of our fears.
Author: Gloria E. Anzaldúa

Quote: IF YOU DON'T GO AFTER WHAT YOU WANT; YOU COULD SPEND YOUR ENTIRE LIFE SETTLING FOR WHAT YOU CAN GET
Author: Mo Stegall,  Against All Odds I Can Be: 10 Steps to Revolutionize Your Destiny

Quote: I know that I shall meet my fate somewhere among the clouds above; those that I fight I do not hate, those that I guard I do not love.
Author: W.B. Yeats

Quote: Unless I understand the Cross, I cannot understand why my commitment to what is right must be precedence over what I prefer.
Author: Ravi Zacharias,  I, Isaac, Take Thee, Rebekah: Moving from Romance to Lasting Love

Quote: I set out to discover the why of it, and to transform my pleasure into knowledge.
Author: Charles Baudelaire

Quote: You told me I was the best sex you'd ever had in your life...You couldn't get enough...At one point you were so loud I thought sure hotel security was going to beat down the door.
Author: Rachel Gibson,  I'm In No Mood For Love

Quote: Mungkin ada benarnya juga buku - buku itu bilang. Orang - orang yang jatuh cinta terkadang terbelenggu oleh ilusi yang diciptakan oleh hatinya sendiri.
Author: Tere Liye,  Berjuta Rasanya

Quote: In the bible it says you have to forgive seventy times seven. I want you all to know, I'm keeping a chart.
Author: Hillary Rodham Clinton

Quote: كل الكتاب خبثاء ، وكل القراء أغبياء يصدقونهم فيعيشون حياة غير حياتهم ، سرقة مع سبق الإصرار للوقت والعمر الجميل ولايشكوأحد
Author: إبراهيم عبد المجيد,  البلدة الأخرى

Quote: *Appendix usually means "small outgrowth from large intestine,"but in this case it means "additional information accompanying main text."Or are those really the same things? Think carefully before you insult this book.
Author: Pseudonymous Bosch,  The Name of This Book Is Secret

Quote: I believe that reading and writing are the most nourishing forms of meditation anyone has so far found. By reading the writings of the most interesting minds in history, we meditate with our own minds and theirs as well. This to me is a miracle.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Palm Sunday: An Autobiographical Collage

Quote: Isn't that someone we know?"asked Horace. He pointed to where a cloaked figure sat by the side of the road a few hundred meters away, arms wrapped around his knees. Close by him, a small shaggy horse cropped the grass growing at the edge of the drainage ditch that ran beside the road."So it is,"Halt replied. "And he seems to have brought Will with him.
Author: John Flanagan,  Halt's Peril

Quote: She looked away. Her attitude seemed to suggest that she had finished with him, and would be obliged if somebody would come and sweep him up.
Author: P.G. Wodehouse

Quote: Our care of the child should be governed, not by the desire to make him learn things, but by the endeavor always to keep burning within him that light which is called intelligence.
Author: Maria Montessori

Quote: Books can ignite fires in your mind, because they carry ideas for kindling, and art for matches.
Author: Gary D. Schmidt,  Lizzie Bright and the Buckminster Boy

Quote: Books are the most wonderful friends in the world. When you meet them and pick them up, they are always ready to give you a few ideas. When you put them down, they never get mad; when you take them up again, they seem to enrich you all the more.
Author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Life Is Worth Living

Quote: Bloodthirsty little beasts. Never trust a duck.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

Quote: I hated every minute of training, but I said, 'Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.'
Author: Muhammad Ali

Quote: I hated every minute of training, but I said, 'Don't quit. Suffer now and live the rest of your life as a champion.'
Author: Muhammad Ali

Quote: There is no scientific answer for success. You can't define it. You've simply got to live it and do it.
Author: Anita Roddick

Quote: We call that person who has lost his father, an orphan; and a widower that man who has lost his wife. But that man who has known the immense unhappiness of losing a friend, by what name do we call him? Here every language is silent and holds its peace in impotence.
Author: Joseph Roux

Quote: How wonderful that we have met with a paradox. Now we have some hope of making progress.
Author: Niels Bohr

Quote: If you would be a real seeker after truth, it is necessary that at least once in your life you doubt, as far as possible, all things.
Author: Rene Descartes

Quote: I say what I want to say and do what I want to do. There's no in between. People will either love you for it or hate you for it.
Author: Eminem

Quote: At NBC I wasn't really sure if the grandparents were going to get my sense of humor on a particular topic.
Author: Tabitha Soren

Quote: Of what use were the arts if they were only the reproduction and the imitation of life?
Author: Alfred de Vigny

Quote: People took such awful chances with chemicals and their bodies because they wanted the quality of their lives to improve. They lived in ugly places where there were only ugly things to do. They didn't own doodley-squat, so they couldn't improve their surroundings. so they did their best to make their insides beautiful instead.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Breakfast of Champions

Quote: Not forever does the bulbul singIn balmy shades of bowers,Not forever lasts the springNor ever blossom the flowers.Not forever reigneth joy,Sets the sun on days of bliss,Friendships not forever last,They know not life, who know not this.
Author: Khushwant Singh,  Train to Pakistan

Quote: What looks like garbage from one angle might be art from another. Maybe it did take a crisis to get to know yourself; maybe you needed to get whacked hard by life before you understood what you wanted out of it.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Handle with Care

Quote: Timendi causa est nescire - Ignorance is the cause of fear.
Author: Seneca,  Natural Questions

Quote: Timendi causa est nescire - Ignorance is the cause of fear.
Author: Seneca,  Natural Questions

Quote: Life always begins with one step outside of your comfort zone.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Life always begins with one step outside of your comfort zone.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: End? No, the journey doesn't end here. Death is just another path. One that we all must take.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: End? No, the journey doesn't end here. Death is just another path. One that we all must take.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: In his face there came to be a brooding peace that is seen most often in the faces of the very sorrowful or the very wise. But still he wandered through the streets of the town, always silent and alone.
Author: Carson McCullers,  The Heart is a Lonely Hunter

Quote: Happiness is a state of mind, a choice, a way of living; it is not something to be achieved, it is something to be experienced.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Happiness is a state of mind, a choice, a way of living; it is not something to be achieved, it is something to be experienced.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Nothing in the world is permanent, and we’re foolish when we ask anything to last, but surely we’re still more foolish not to take delight in it while we have it. If change is of the essence of existence one would have thought it only sensible to make it the premise of our philosophy.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham,  The Razor's Edge

Quote: Don't let anyone take care of you. Can you maybe leave that for me to do? I mean, take care of you? Feel free to take care of me in return... because I think I'll need you to do that.
Author: Melina Marchetta,  The Piper's Son

Quote: Don't give in to fear. Be strong, like i know you are. An never give up, d'you unnerstand, never. No matter what happens.I stare at him.I won't, I says. I ain't no quitter, Pa.That's my girl.
Author: Moira Young,  Blood Red Road

Quote: It is when you lose sight of yourself, that you lose your way. To keep your truth in sight you must keep yourself in sight and the world to you should be a mirror to reflect to you your image; the world should be a mirror that you reflect upon.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Setiap kamu punya mimpi atau keinginan atau cita-cita,kamu taruh di sini, di depan kening kamujangan menempel, biarkan diaMENGGANTUNG, MENGAMBANG5 cm di depan kening kamujadi dia nggak akan pernah lepas dari mata kamu
Author: Donny Dhirgantoro

Quote: Read. Read anything. Read the things they say are good for you, and the things they claim are junk. You'll find what you need to find. Just read.
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: Read. Read anything. Read the things they say are good for you, and the things they claim are junk. You'll find what you need to find. Just read.
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: At every given moment we are absolutely perfect for what is required for our journey.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Falling in love is painful on the knees.
Author: Jon Bon Jovi

Quote: We are like chameleons, we take our hue and the color of our moral character, from those who are around us.
Author: John Locke

Quote: We are like chameleons, we take our hue and the color of our moral character, from those who are around us.
Author: John Locke

Quote: While I was drying off Maddie after her bath tonight, she said, 'I love you' to me for the first time. It sounded like 'All lub boo,' but I didn't care. To reciprocate, I showed her what an ex-Marine looks like when he cries.
Author: Jim Beaver,  Life's That Way: A Memoir

Quote: Stop thinking about life and choose to live it
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Fifth Mountain

Quote: Men have two greatest fears: the first fear is the fear of being needed, and the second fear is the fear of not being needed.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Lucy: You learn more when you lose Charlie Brown: Well then I must be the smartest person in world!!!
Author: Charles M. Schulz,  Peanuts Treasury

Quote: Understanding is a three edged sword: your side, their side, and the truth.
Author: J. Michael Straczynski

Quote: Night is a time of rigor, but also of mercy. There are truths which one can see only when it’s dark
Author: Isaac Bashevis Singer,  Teibele And Her Demon

Quote: Falsehood is never in words; it is in things.
Author: Italo Calvino,  Invisible Cities

Quote: I think by the time you're grown you're as happy as you're goin to be. You'll have good times and bad times, but in the end you'll be about as happy as you was before. Or as unhappy. I've knowed people that just never did get the hang of it.
Author: Cormac McCarthy,  No Country For Old Men

Quote: We too, must shatter the mirrors. We must look in to ourselves and root out the distortions until that thing which we know in our hearts is perfect and true, stands before us.
Author: Garth Stein,  The Art of Racing in the Rain

Quote: Where ignorance lurks, so too do the frontiers of discovery and imagination
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

Quote: Say I feel all sad and self-indulgent, then get stung by a wasp, my misery feels quite abstract and I long just to be in spiritual pain once more - 'damn you tiny assassin, clad in yellow and black, how I crave my former innocence where melancholy was my only trial'.
Author: Russell Brand,  Articles of Faith

Quote: Fear is the glue that keeps you stuck. Faith is the solvent that sets you free.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Fear is the glue that keeps you stuck. Faith is the solvent that sets you free.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Keep a light, hopeful heart. But ­expect the worst.
Author: Joyce Carol Oates

Quote: The bad news is the butcher’s dead. The good news is there’ll be no need for a funeral, and I’ve got enough meat to last for weeks.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: God gave us crying so other folks could see when we needed help, and help us.
Author: Joshilyn Jackson,  Gods in Alabama

Quote: Death does not concern us, because as long as we exist, death is not here. And when it does come, we no longer exist.
Author: Epicurus

Quote: How terrible,"said Eragon, "to die alone, separate even from the one who is closest to you."Everyone dies alone, Eragon. Whether you are a king on a battlefield or a lowly peasant lying in bed among your family, no one can accompany you into the void.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Eldest

Quote: I know many lives worth living.
Author: Mary Oliver

Quote: His life was gentle; and the elementsSo mixed in him, that Nature might stand upAnd say to all the world, THIS WAS A MAN!
Author: William Shakespeare,  Julius Caesar

Quote: Such sweet compulsion doth in music lie.
Author: John Milton,  The Complete Poetry

Quote: Don't tell me you're not beautiful. You're the kind of beautiful the blind would see if we could figure out some way to give them three seconds of sight.
Author: Shane Koyczan

Quote: What if we just acknowledged that we have a bad relationship, and we stuck it out, anyway? What if we admitted that we make each other nuts, we fight constantly and hardly ever have sex, but we can't live without each other, so we deal with it? And then we could spend our lives together -- in misery, but happy to not be apart.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert

Quote: Reading at meals is considered rude in polite society, but if you expect to succeed as a writer, rudeness should be the second-to-least of your concerns. The least of all should be polite society and what it expects.
Author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

Quote: In general there should be gay characters in YA because a) surprise, there are gay folks everywhere and b) in my opinion as a father, there’s not a damn thing wrong with my child encountering gay folks in her literature, because see point a).
Author: John Scalzi

Quote: I think it is very good when people suffer. To me that is like the kiss of Jesus.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: I type as fast as a ten-legged man who just had eight legs chopped off runs.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Who Moved My Choose?: An Amazing Way to Deal With Change by Deciding to Let Indecision Into Your Life

Quote: I must work harder to achieve my goal of not seeking approval from those whose approval I'm not even sure is important to me.
Author: Lauren Graham,  Someday, Someday, Maybe

Quote: It has taken me years of struggle, hard work, and research to learn to make one simple gesture, and I know enough about the art of writing to realize that it would take as many years of concentrated effort to write one simple, beautiful sentence.
Author: Isadora Duncan

Quote: The struggle of literature is in fact a struggle to escape from the confines of language; it stretches out from the utmost limits of what can be said; what stirs literature is the call and attraction of what is not in the dictionary.
Author: Italo Calvino

Quote: If I told you that my global audience has shot up 100% in the last six months, what would you say? If you were to say, “So you went from one reader to two readers?” you’d be absolutely correct. And after I had congratulated you on your keen guess, I’d thank you for being 50% of my reading base.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: A grandmother pretends she doesn't know who you are on Halloween.
Author: Erma Bombeck

Quote: In high school I tried out for the spelling team, but only because I really wanted a letter jacket.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the story my great-grandfather told my father, who then told my grandfather, who then told me about how The Mythical Mr. Boo, Charles Manseur Fizzlebush Grissham III, better known as Mr. Fizzlebush, and Orafoura are all in fact me...

Quote: Children are living beings - more living than grown-up people who have built shells of habit around themselves. Therefore it is absolutely necessary for their mental health and development that they should not have mere schools for their lessons, but a world whose guiding spirit is personal love.
Author: Rabindranath Tagore

Quote: The road to success is dotted with many tempting parking spaces.
Author: Will Rogers

Quote: In my fool hardy youth, when my friends were dreaming of heroic deeds in the realms of engineering and law, finance and national politics, I dreamt of becoming a librarian.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: We can imagine the books we'd like to read, even if they have not yet been written, and we can imagine libraries full of books we would like to possess, even if they are well beyond our reach, because we enjoy dreaming up a library that reflects every one of our interests and every one of our foibles--a library that, in its variety and complexity, fully reflects the reader we are.
Author: Alberto Manguel

Quote: We can regard our life as a uselessly disturbing episode in the blissful repose of nothingness.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Quote: The main facts in human life are five: birth, food, sleep, love and death.
Author: E.M. Forster

Quote: The main facts in human life are five: birth, food, sleep, love and death.
Author: E.M. Forster

Quote: How would your life be different if…You didn’t allow yourself to be defined by your past? Let today be the day…You stop letting your history interfere with your destiny and awaken to the opportunity to release your greatest self.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: How would your life be different if…You didn’t allow yourself to be defined by your past? Let today be the day…You stop letting your history interfere with your destiny and awaken to the opportunity to release your greatest self.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Atticus had said it was the polite thing to talk to people about what they were interested in, not about what you were interested in.
Author: Harper Lee,  To Kill a Mockingbird

Quote: There are only a few notes. Just variations on a theme.
Author: John Lennon

Quote: Our life is made by the death of others.
Author: Leonardo da Vinci

Quote: Our life is made by the death of others.
Author: Leonardo da Vinci

Quote: Grace doesn't depend on suffering to exist, but where there is suffering you will find grace in many facets and colors.
Author: Wm. Paul Young,  The Shack

Quote: I never approve, or disapprove, of anything now. It is an absurd attitude to take towards life.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: Something that is yours forever is never precious
Author: Chaim Potok,  My Name Is Asher Lev

Quote: I am still in the land of the dying; I shall be in the land of the living soon. (his last words)
Author: John Newton

Quote: I am still in the land of the dying; I shall be in the land of the living soon. (his last words)
Author: John Newton

Quote: You are the only you ... You are the best you. You will always be the second best anyone else.
Author: Leo Buscaglia

Quote: Comedy aims at representing men as worse, Tragedy as better than in actual life.
Author: Aristotle,  Poetics

Quote: Every individual has a place to fill in the world and is important in some respect, whether he chooses to be so or not.
Author: Nathaniel Hawthorne

Quote: Sometimes it falls upon a generation to be great, you can be that generation
Author: Nelson Mandela

Quote: There are two things that men should never weary of, goodness and humility; we get none too much of them in this rough world among cold, proud people.
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  Kidnapped

Quote: We are constantly invited to be who we are.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: Talking with you is sort of the conversational equivalent of an out of body experience.
Author: Bill Watterson

Quote: ... for most practical purposes, Tarbean had two parts: Waterside and Hillside. Waterside is where people are poor. That makes them beggars, thieves and whores. Hillside is where people are rich. That makes them solicitors, politicians and courtesans.
Author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Name of the Wind

Quote: Everyone you have ever loved in your life becomes a part of your soul. They never leave. They're always inside you, and you can bring them out whenever you want.
Author: Nate Kenyon,  Sparrow Rock

Quote: Everyone you have ever loved in your life becomes a part of your soul. They never leave. They're always inside you, and you can bring them out whenever you want.
Author: Nate Kenyon,  Sparrow Rock

Quote: Total paranoia is just total awareness.
Author: Charles Manson

Quote: If there were no eternal consciousness in a man, if at the bottom of everything there were only a wild ferment, a power that twisting in dark passions produced everything great or inconsequential; if an unfathomable, insatiable emptiness lay hid beneath everything, what would life be but despair?
Author: Søren Kierkegaard,  Fear and Trembling

Quote: You would have made a fine warrior, you know that?"I am one. Death is my enemy."Yeah, it is, isn't it."God, it made such sense that he'd bonded with her. She was a fighter… like him. "Your scalpel's your dagger."Yup.
Author: J.R. Ward,  Lover Unbound

Quote: A prison becomes a home when you have the key.
Author: George Sterling

Quote: Knowledge is power is time is money.
Author: Robert Thier,  Storm and Silence

Quote: I have made a ceaseless effort not to ridicule, not to bewail, not to scorn human actions, but to understand them.
Author: Baruch Spinoza

Quote: I have made a ceaseless effort not to ridicule, not to bewail, not to scorn human actions, but to understand them.
Author: Baruch Spinoza

Quote: Few things are more deceptive than memories.
Author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón,  The Shadow of the Wind

Quote: Few things are more deceptive than memories.
Author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón,  The Shadow of the Wind

Quote: There is no point in keeping vengeance or stubbornness. These things"-he sighed- "these things I so regret in my life. Pride. Vanity. Why do we do the things we do? Morrie Schwartz
Author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

Quote: All I do is lie, and that has made me immune to compliments.
Author: David Sedaris

Quote: In our reasonings concerning matter of fact, there are all imaginable degrees of assurance, from the highest certainty to the lowest species of moral evidence. A wise man, therefore, proportions his belief to the evidence.
Author: David Hume,  An Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding

Quote: In our reasonings concerning matter of fact, there are all imaginable degrees of assurance, from the highest certainty to the lowest species of moral evidence. A wise man, therefore, proportions his belief to the evidence.
Author: David Hume,  An Enquiry Concerning Human Understanding

Quote: A lot of people go searching for “Truth.” But they can’t be searching too hard, because very few of them ever think to look under my bed.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

Quote: Coffee, she'd discovered, was tied to all sorts of memories, different for each person. Sunday mornings, friendly get-togethers, a favorite grandfather long since gone, the AA meeting that saved their life. Coffee meant something to people. Most found their lives were miserable without it. Coffee was a lot like love that way. And because Rachel believed in love, she believed in coffee, too.
Author: Sarah Addison Allen,  The Peach Keeper

Quote: The intention that man should be happy is not in the plan of Creation.
Author: Sigmund Freud

Quote: He who binds to himself a joyDoes the winged life destroy;But he who kisses the joy as it fliesLives in eternity's sun rise.
Author: William Blake

Quote: Humility is nothing but truth, and pride is nothing but lying.
Author: St. Vincent de Paul

Quote: A truth that no one knows is still the truth.
Author: Sharon Shinn,  Jenna Starborn

Quote: I'm convinced that most men don't know what they believe, rather, they only know what they wish to believe. How many people blame God for man's atrocities, but wouldn't dream of imprisoning a mother for her son's crime?
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Perfect prayer does not consist in many words, silent remembering and pure intention raises the heart to that supreme Power.
Author: Amit Ray,  Om Chanting and Meditation

Quote: To have found God and still to pursue Him is the soul’s paradox of love.
Author: A.W. Tozer,  The Pursuit of God

Quote: the nurse smiled and patted my arm. “Don’t give up yet. Sometimes when we think God has written The End, what he really means is The Beginning.
Author: Rachel Van Dyken,  Ruin

Quote: Give me one hundred preachers who fear nothing but sin, and desire nothing but God, and I care not a straw whether they be clergymen or laymen; such alone will shake the gates of hell and set up the kingdom of heaven on Earth.
Author: John Wesley

Quote: Of all the ways to lose a person, death is the kindest.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Something has spoken to me in the night...and told me that I shall die, I know not where. Saying: "[Death is] to lose the earth you know for greater knowing; to lose the life you have, for greater life; to leave the friends you loved, for greater loving; to find a land more kind than home, more large than earth.
Author: Thomas Wolfe,  You Can't Go Home Again

Quote: Sometimes it's easy to lose faith in people. And sometimes one act of kindness is all it takes to give you hope again.
Author: Randa Abdel-Fattah,  Does My Head Look Big In This?

Author: Nicholas Sparks,  At First Sight

Quote: Love- the infatuation kind- 'he's so handsome, she's so beautiful'- that can shrivel. As soon as something goes wrong, that kind of love can fly out the window.
Author: Mitch Albom

Quote: Solitude is the soil in which genius is planted, creativity grows, and legends bloom; faith in oneself is the rain that cultivates a hero to endure the storm, and bare the genesis of a new world, a new forest.
Author: Mike Norton,  White Mountain

Quote: Prayer is the mortar that holds our house together.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: The last thing one discovers in composing a work is what to put first.
Author: Blaise Pascal,  Pensées

Quote: I fell in love with her the moment she was late, though neither one of us knew it at the time because she hadn’t arrived yet.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: You deserve someone better than me. Someone young and idealistic…someone who can experience things for the first time along with you. I'm not always kind, and I have more faults than I'd care to name. All I can promise is that I'll want you until my last breath.
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Because You're Mine

Quote: That dress…was a very, very good decision. I could write an entire poem on the virtues of your legs alone. You are a feast for the senses.” I laughed. “I don’t know about a feast. Maybe just an hors d'oeuvre.” He took my hand and wrapped it around his arm. “Not an hors d'oeuvre. The dessert. And I plan to spoil my appetite.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: Who ends up with their first real boyfriend? Yeah, no one.- Courtney
Author: Lauren Barnholdt,  Two-Way Street

Quote: A bond between souls is ancient - older than the planet.
Author: Dianna Hardy,  The Witching Pen

Quote: When I face the desolate impossibility of writing five hundred pages, a sick sense of failure falls on me, and I know I can never do it. Then gradually, I write one page and then another. One day's work is all I can permit myself to contemplate.
Author: John Steinbeck,  Travels with Charley: In Search of America

Quote: A man is accepted into a church for what he believes and he is turned out for what he knows.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: It just happens to be the way that I'm made. I have to write things down to feel I fully comprehend them.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

Quote: Part of the appeal of the fantastic is taking ridiculous ideas very seriously and pretending they're not absurd.
Author: China Miéville

Quote: My tendency to make up stories and lie compulsively for the sake of my own amusement takes up a good portion of my day and provides me with a peace of mind not easily attainable in this economic climate.
Author: Chelsea Handler,  Chelsea Chelsea Bang Bang

Quote: If I ever go to China, I’m going to find a piano and play “Chopsticks”--only not with my fingers, but rather I’ll be using two forks.

Quote: The uniform enhanced his athletic body, and my thoughts drifted to how magnificent he would look with his uniform puddled around his feet.
Author: Maria V. Snyder,  Poison Study

Quote: Ow, Todd? Ow?
Author: Patrick Ness,  The Knife of Never Letting Go

Quote: My education was the liberty I had to read indiscriminately and all the time, with my eyes hanging out.
Author: Dylan Thomas

Quote: The ink of the scholar is more holy than the blood of the martyr.
Author: Anonymous

Quote: God created us for this: to live our lives in a way that makes him look more like the greatness and the beauty and the infinite worth that he really is. This is what it means to be created in the image of God.
Author: John Piper

Quote: No matter what people tell you, words and ideas can change the world.
Author: Robin Williams

Quote: Everyone has determination - it's a question of how you use it. Hers is based on power and success and conquering; she doesn't care what she has to do or who gets hurt in the process. In that way we're very, very different.
Author: Dannii Minogue

Quote: Friendship is the source of the greatest pleasures, and without friends even the most agreeable pursuits become tedious.
Author: Thomas Aquinas

Author: Nancy Reagan

Quote: Challenging the meaning of life is the truest expression of the state of being human.
Author: Viktor E. Frankl

Quote: Where we love is home - home that our feet may leave, but not our hearts.
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes, Sr.

Quote: I think that some books are more successful than others to certain readers. People who read my books for the humor, they're going to love one book. People who read my books for the mystery, they might not like that book quite as much.
Author: Janet Evanovich

Quote: It is through art, and through art only, that we can realise our perfection.

We all want to matter to someone, to leave a mark. Writers just take those thoughts, feelings and desires and express them in such a way that the reader not only reads them but feels them as well.

Author: Joseph Conrad

Quote: The primary thing when you take a sword in your hands is your intention to cut the enemy, whatever the means. Whenever you parry, hit, spring, strike or touch the enemy's cutting sword, you must cut the enemy in the same movement. It is essential to attain this. If you think only of hitting, springing, striking or touching the enemy, you will not be able actually to cut him.
Author: Miyamoto Musashi,  The Book of Five Rings

Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: I want you to learn the lesson of the lotus. This flower springs forth from muddy waters. It raises its delicate petals to the sun and perfumes the world while, at the same time, its roots cling to the elemental muck, the very essence of the mortal experience. Without that soil, the flower would wither and die.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: Fear not the path of Truth for the lack of People walking on it.
Author: Robert F. Kennedy

Quote: I ask you right here please to agree with me that a scar is never ugly. That is what the scar makers want us to think. But you and I, we must make an agreement to defy them. We must see all scars as beauty. Okay? This will be our secret. Because take it from me, a scar does not form on the dying. A scar means, I survived.

Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: I’ve never had anyone’s approval, so I’ve learned to live without it.

Quote: I would teach how science works as much as I would teach what science knows. I would assert (given that essentially, everyone will learn to read) that science literacy is the most important kind of literacy they can take into the 21st century. I would undervalue grades based on knowing things and find ways to reward curiosity. In the end, it's the people who are curious who change the world.
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

Quote: Many people are like garbage trucks. They run around full of garbage, full of frustration, full of anger, and full of disappointment. As their garbage piles up, they look for a place to dump it. And if you let them, they’ll dump it on you. So when someone wants to dump on you, don’t take it personally. Just smile, wave, wish them well, and move on. Believe me. You’ll be happier.
Author: David J. Pollay,  The Law of the Garbage Truck: How to Respond to People Who Dump on You, and How to Stop Dumping on Others

Quote: I'm terrified of getting involved with someone who disappoints me or leaves me empty and alone. I'm terrified of rejection, so I set my expectations so high that they can never be met, and I dig around with a magnifying glass looking for flaws in very person I date. There's always a flaw to exploit, and I'll find it so I never have to get too close.

Not just more knowledgeable - books that provide nothing but information can produce that result. But wiser, in the sense that you are more deeply aware of the great and enduring truths of human life.
Author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

Quote: Two things fill the mind with ever new and increasing admiration and awe, the more often and steadily we reflect upon them: the starry heavens above me and the moral law within me. I do not seek or conjecture either of them as if they were veiled obscurities or extravagances beyond the horizon of my vision; I see them before me and connect them immediately with the consciousness of my existence.
Author: Immanuel Kant,  Critique of Practical Reason

Author: Robert Anton Wilson,  Cosmic Trigger Volume I: Final Secret of the Illuminati

Author: Socrates

Author: J. Maarten Troost,  Getting Stoned with Savages: A Trip Through the Islands of Fiji and Vanuatu

Quote: Take all that you can of this book upon reason, and the balance on faith, and you will live and die a happier man. (When a skeptic expressed surprise to see him reading a Bible)
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Happiness doesn't come from achievements, or money, or any sort of treasure. Happiness is a frame of mind, not a destination. It's appreciating what you've got and building relationships with those around you.

Author: Woody Allen

Quote: But hope is no less realistic than despair. It is still our choice whether to live in light or lie down in darkness.
Author: Rick Yancey,  The Isle of Blood

Quote: Faith, the least exclusive club on Earth, has the craftiest doorman. Every time I've stepped through its wide-open doorway, I find myself stepping out on the street again.
Author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

Quote: Everyone I have lost in the closing of a doorthe click of the lockis not forgotten, theydo not die but remainwithin the soft edgesof the earth, the ashof house fires and cancerin sin and forgivenesshuddled under old blanketsdreaming their way intomy hands, my heartclosing tight like fists.- "Indian Boy Love Song #1
Author: Sherman Alexie,  The Business of Fancydancing

Quote: Poetry is an echo asking a shadow to dance.
Author: Carl Sandburg

Quote: Our birth is but a sleep and a forgetting:The Soul that rises with us, our life's Star,Hath had elsewhere its setting,And cometh from afar:Not in entire forgetfulness,And not in utter nakedness,But trailing clouds of glory do we come
Author: William Wordsworth

Author: Crystal Woods,  Dreaming is for lovers

Quote: I had a dream about you last night. I was alone on a dark night and you came to me as a firefly. I knew it was you because you were the brightest.
Author: Crystal Woods,  Dreaming is for lovers

Quote: The true birthplace is that wherein for the first time one looks intelligently upon oneself; my first homelands have been books, and to a lesser degree schools.
Author: Marguerite Yourcenar,  Memoirs of Hadrian

Author: Colleen Hoover,  Maybe Someday

Quote: يؤلمني أنَّ كلَّ الأشياء ظلَّت وفيةً، إلا أنتِ.
Author: محمد حسن علوان,  سقف الكفاية

Quote: How could I remain unyielding? His words penetrated the flimsy barriers I’d set up around my heart. I’d meant to set up a barbed wire fence, but the barbs ended up being covered with marshmallows. He slipped through my defenses easily. He touched his forehead to my hand, and my marshmallow heart melted.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: She was not sorry. And if it was the wine telling her that, then she would tell the wine the same thing tomorrow. She was not sorry.
Author: Mary Balogh,  Slightly Wicked

Quote: All day and all night my desire for you unwinds like a poisonous snake.
Author: Samar Sen

Quote: One minute of reconciliation is worth more than a whole life of friendship!
Author: Gabriel Garcí­a Márquez,  One Hundred Years of Solitude

Quote: If you die, angel, it means I'm already dead.
Author: Pamela Clare,  Breaking Point

Quote: What I try to do is write. I may write for two weeks ‘the cat sat on the mat, that is that, not a rat,’.... And it might be just the most boring and awful stuff. But I try. When I’m writing, I write. And then it’s as if the muse is convinced that I’m serious and says, ‘Okay. Okay. I’ll come.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: I want everyone to wear what they want and mix it in their own way. That, to me, is what is modern.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: The invisible and the non-existent look very much alike.
Author: Delos McKown

Quote: I'm not a person who thinks they can have it all, but I certainly feel that with a bit of effort and guile I should be able to have more than my fair share.
Author: George Carlin,  When Will Jesus Bring the Pork Chops?

Quote: I want to be a creature that’s half bee, half the letter B. That way I can pollinate the world with my literacy.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want Two apply for a job at our country's largest funeral home, and then wear a suit and noose to the job interview.

Quote: If girlfriends were knees, I'd love to have both of mine replaced. That way, it'd be easier to run around on them.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

Quote: Rewards and punishment is the lowest form of education.
Author: Zhuangzi

Quote: You’re frustrated because you keep waiting for the blooming of flowers of which you have yet to sow the seeds.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: I love science, and it pains me to think that so many are terrified of the subject or feel that choosing science means you cannot also choose compassion, or the arts, or be awed by nature. Science is not meant to cure us of mystery, but to reinvent and reinvigorate it.
Author: Robert M. Sapolsky

Quote: Every sunrise is priceless and you can experience the richness that life holds only when you live life to the full instead of just being an onlooker.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: The story of my recent life.' I like that phrase. It makes more sense than 'the story of my life', because we get so many lives between birth and death. A life to be a child. A life to come of age. A life to wander, to settle, to fall in love, to parent, to test our promise, to realize our mortality- and in some lucky cases, to do something after that realization.
Author: Mitch Albom,  Have a Little Faith: a True Story

Be thankful! It is easy to be thankful when all is well. A Sufi is thankful not only for what he has been given but also for all that has been denied.

Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Bell Jar

Author: Anthony Robbins

Quote: Despair is the price one pays for setting oneself an impossible aim. It is, one is told, the unforgivable sin, but it is a sin the corrupt or evil man never practices. He always has hope. He never reaches the freezing-point of knowing absolute failure. Only the man of goodwill carries always in his heart this capacity for damnation.

Quote: I’ve been doing this a long time, and I’ve come to learn that predictions don’t mean much. Too much lies outside the realm of medical knowledge. A lot of what happens next comes down to you and your specific genetics, your attitude. No, there’s nothing we can do to stop the inevitable, but that’s not the point. The point is that you should try to make the most of the time you have left.

Author: Susan Elizabeth Phillips,  Heaven, Texas

Author: Steve Jobs

As wisdom, it's hopeless. Time Regained is Paradise Lost, and Time Lost is Paradise Regained. Let the dead bury their dead. If you want to live at every moment as it presents itself, you've got to die to every other moment.
Author: Aldous Huxley,  The Genius And The Goddess

Author: Elise Boulding

Quote: Yesterday we obeyed kings and bent our necks before emperors. But today we kneel only to truth, follow only beauty, and obey only love.

Quote: I would cling to unhappiness because it was a known, familiar state. When I was happier, it was because I knew I was on my way back to misery. I've never been convinced that happiness is the object of the game. I'm wary of happiness.
Author: Hugh Laurie

Author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra

Author: Martha Washington

Quote: We are willing to believe anything other than the truth.
Author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón

Quote: Grimly, she realized that clocks don't make a sound that even remotely resembles ticking, tocking. It was more the sound of a hammer, upside down, hacking methodically at the earth. It was the sound of a grave.
Author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

Quote: (on forgiveness) Didn't he and I stand together before an all seeing God convicted of the same murder? For I had murdered him with my heart and my tongue.

Author: A.W. Tozer

Author: George Eliot,  Middlemarch

Quote: Ipsa scientia potestas est.Knowledge itself is power.
Author: Francis Bacon,  Meditations Sacrae and Human Philosophy Meditations Sacrae and Human Philosophy

Quote: I touch you knowing we weren't born tomorrow,and somehow, each of us will help the other live,and somewhere, each of us must help the other die.
Author: Adrienne Rich,  Twenty One Love Poems

Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Letters and Social Aims

Quote: When learning is purposeful, creativity blossoms. When creativity blossoms, thinking emanates. When thinking emanates, knowledge is fully lit. When knowledge is lit, economy flourishes.
Author: A.P.J. Abdul Kalam,  Indomitable Spirit
