Quote: I don't know if God exists, but it would be better for His reputation if He didn't.
Author: Jules Renard

Quote: Death, especially violent death, will turn the meanest bastard in the world into a nice guy. Why is that?
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  The Laughing Corpse

Quote: May each of us remember this truth; 'one cannot forget mother and remember God. One cannot remember mother and forget God.' Why? Because these two sacred persons, God and mother, partners in creation, in love, in sacrifice, in service, are as one.
Author: Thomas S. Monson,  Pathways To Perfection: Discourses Of Thomas S. Monson

Quote: My spirit is healthy, yes. But I tell you, my flesh is healthy too. I am enlightened and free, but I am also lustful and carnal.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: You can see the whole entire world in the eyes of a person who knows how to simply stand there and take all of it into him but then you can look into the eyes of someone else and the whole entire world goes away and all that's left is you.
Author: C. JoyBell C.,  Saint Paul Trois Chateaux: 1948

Quote: Regrets came up and asked me if I’d like to own them. Declined them for the most part but took a few just so I wouldn’t leave this relationship empty handed.
Author: Steve Toltz,  A Fraction of the Whole

Quote: Be a bit of a challenge; not because you're playing games but because you realize you're worth the extra effort.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: Be a bit of a challenge; not because you're playing games but because you realize you're worth the extra effort.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: When you choose a man who thinks eight seconds is a long time, perhaps you need two of them. Hmm?
Author: Cat Johnson

Quote: Who are you?"I asked."You know who I am,"he replied. "I'm yours."~Clea / Sage, pg. 105
Author: Hilary Duff,  Elixir

Quote: Good ideas stay with you until you eventually write the story.
Author: Brian Keene

Quote: the church should just stay out of people's pants.
Author: Alex Sanchez,  The God Box

Quote: Don't tell anyone, but on the pagan day of the sun god Ra, I kneel at the foot of an ancient instrument of torture and consume ritualistic symbols of blood and flesh. ...And if any of you care to join me, come to the Harvard chapel on Sunday, kneel beneath the crucifix, and take Holy Communion.
Author: Dan Brown,  The Lost Symbol

Quote: The trouble with writing fiction is that it has to make sense, whereas real life doesn't.
Author: Iain M. Banks

Quote: There's life for you. Spend the best years of your life studying penmanship and rhetoric and syntax and Beowulf and George Eliot, and then somebody steals your pencil.
Author: Dorothy Parker,  The Portable Dorothy Parker

Quote: I don't wait for moods. You accomplish nothing if you do that. Your mind must know it has got to get down to work.
Author: Pearl S. Buck

Quote: Long before I wrote stories, I listened for stories. Listening for them is something more acute than listening to them. I suppose it’s an early form of participation in what goes on. Listening children know stories are there. When their elders sit and begin, children are just waiting and hoping for one to come out, like a mouse from its hole.
Author: Eudora Welty,  One Writer's Beginnings

Quote: Fifteen men on the Dead Man's Chest Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum! Drink and the devil had done for the rest Yo-ho-ho, and a bottle of rum!
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  Treasure Island

Quote: There is nothing to save, now all is lost,but a tiny core of stillness in the heartlike the eye of a violet.
Author: D.H. Lawrence

Quote: Angelina leaned forward as Sara pulled Miki back to her, "You know what they say about curiosity? That it stabbed the annoying biker girl over and over and over again until she spit up blood.
Author: Shelly Laurenston,  Pack Challenge

Quote: Your level of neuroses will only find love in a made-for-TV movie.
Author: Michelle Hodkin,  The Unbecoming of Mara Dyer

Quote: I like watching people stretch in the park. It's my new favorite pastime since I bought a portable rack.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: If you want to know my story, you have to go back to the beginning. Not the beginning-beginning, but about nine months later. You see, I was born as a poor farm boy. Believe it or not, my parents were so poor that they didn’t even own a farm. Nope. Instead, they had to live in a small apartment in the city.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  American Association for the Advancement of Aardvarks Presents: Dear Natalie

Quote: I’m a powerful being. I caused the night to turn into day. And I didn’t even try! I simply waited. I’ll bet I could even do it in my sleep.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

Quote: Are you okay?"I (Cassie) call up to him."Um. Define okay."(Ben)"Okay means you're not bleeding to death.""I'm okay.
Author: Rick Yancey,  The 5th Wave

Quote: In the war room, love? What if someone comes in?”I stood and removed his shirt. “Then they’ll have a good story to tell.”“Good?” He adopted the pretense of being offended.“Prove me wrong.
Author: Maria V. Snyder,  Fire Study

Quote: The good, the admirable reader identifies himself not with the boy or the girl in the book, but with the mind that conceived and composed that book.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: The good, the admirable reader identifies himself not with the boy or the girl in the book, but with the mind that conceived and composed that book.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: If we spoke with our ears, and listened through our mouth, then a kiss might be the most romantic sound in the world.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  American Association for the Advancement of Aardvarks Presents: Dear Natalie

Quote: This was how it was with travel: one city gives you gifts, another robs you. One gives you the heart’s affections, the other destroys your soul. Cities and countries are as alive, as feeling, as fickle and uncertain as people. Their degrees of love and devotion are as varying as with any human relation. Just as one is good, another is bad.
Author: Roman Payne,  Cities & Countries

Quote: On ne naît pas femme: on le devient.
Author: Simone de Beauvoir,  Le deuxième sexe II

Quote: Do you see the story? Do you see anything? It seems to me I am trying to tell you a dream--making a vain attempt, because no relation of a dream can convey the dream-sensation, that commingling of absurdity, surprise, and bewilderment in a tremor of struggling revolt, that notion of being captured by the incredible which is the very essence of dreams...
Author: Joseph Conrad,  Heart of Darkness

Quote: I became convinced that noncooperation with evil is as much a moral obligation as is cooperation with good.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.,  The Autobiography of Martin Luther King, Jr.

Quote: You can present the material, but you can't make me care.
Author: Bill Watterson,  Homicidal Psycho Jungle Cat

Quote: Caelum non animum mutant qui trans mare currunt.(They change their sky, not their soul, who rush across the sea.)
Author: Horace,  The Odes of Horace: Bilingual Edition

Quote: Your soul is oftentimes a battlefield, upon your reason and your judgment wage war against your passion and your appetite.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: If you want to discover the true character of a person, you have only to observe what they are passionate about.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: An hour spent reading is one stolen from paradise.
Author: Thomas Wharton

Quote: I care more about the people in books than the people I see every day.
Author: Jo Walton,  Among Others

Quote: Highly organized research is guaranteed to produce nothing new.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Dune

Quote: Censorship of anything, at any time, in any place, on whatever pretense, has always been and always will be the last resort of the boob and the bigot.
Author: Eugene O'Neill

Quote: I have gone to [this bookshop] for years, always finding the one book I wanted - and then three more I hadn’t known I wanted.
Author: Mary Ann Shaffer,  The Guernsey Literary and Potato Peel Pie Society

Quote: I don't know the meaning of life. I don't know why we are here. I think life is full of anxieties and fears and tears. It has a lot of grief in it, and it can be very grim. And I do not want to be the one who tries to tell somebody else what life is all about. To me it's a complete mystery.
Author: Charles M. Schulz,  Charles M. Schulz: Conversations

Quote: You better start swimming, or you'll sink like a stone. Because the Time's they are a-changing.
Author: Bob Dylan

Quote: If someone listens, or stretches out a hand, or whispers a kind word of encouragement, or attempts to understand a lonely person, extraordinary things begin to happen.
Author: Loretta Girzaitis

Quote: That's life for you,"said MacDunn. "Someone always waiting for someone who never comes home. Always someone loving some thing more than that thing loves them. And after a while you want to destroy whatever that thing is, so it can't hurt you no more.
Author: Ray Bradbury,  The Fog Horn

Quote: What will be left of all the fearing and wanting associated with your problematic life situation that every day takes up most of your attention? A dash, one or two inches long, between the date of birth and date of death on your gravestone.
Author: Eckhart Tolle

Quote: What will be left of all the fearing and wanting associated with your problematic life situation that every day takes up most of your attention? A dash, one or two inches long, between the date of birth and date of death on your gravestone.
Author: Eckhart Tolle

Quote: When we cannot bear to be alone, it means we do not properly value the only companion we will have from birth to death - ourselves.
Author: Eda J. LeShan

Quote: You know how the tightrope guy at the circus wants everyone to believe his act is an art, but deep down you can see that he's really just hoping he makes it all the way across?
Author: Jodi Picoult,  My Sister's Keeper

Quote: You know how the tightrope guy at the circus wants everyone to believe his act is an art, but deep down you can see that he's really just hoping he makes it all the way across?
Author: Jodi Picoult,  My Sister's Keeper

Quote: Life is hell, at some point we all just have to get used to it.
Author: Alysha Speer,  Sharden

Quote: at your weakest, you end up showing more strength; at your lowest, you are suddenly lifted higher than you’ve ever been. They all border one another, these opposites and show how quickly we can be altered.
Author: Cecelia Ahern,  Thanks for the Memories

Quote: at your weakest, you end up showing more strength; at your lowest, you are suddenly lifted higher than you’ve ever been. They all border one another, these opposites and show how quickly we can be altered.
Author: Cecelia Ahern,  Thanks for the Memories

Quote: Waking up is not a selfish pursuit of happiness, it is a revolutionary stance, from the inside out, for the benefit of all beings in existence.
Author: Noah Levine

Quote: Waking up is not a selfish pursuit of happiness, it is a revolutionary stance, from the inside out, for the benefit of all beings in existence.
Author: Noah Levine

Quote: We’re built of contradictions, all of us. It’s those opposing forces that give us strength, like an arch, each block pressing the next. Give me a man whose parts are all aligned in agreement and I’ll show you madness. We walk a narrow path, insanity to each side. A man without contradictions to balance him will soon veer off.
Author: Mark Lawrence,  King of Thorns

Quote: You kick ass Sam. And don't forget it
Author: Pittacus Lore,  The Power of Six

Quote: You must learn to take a step back and visualize the whole piece. If you focus only on the thread given to you, you lose sight of what it can become.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: لو كان الفقر رجلاً لقتلته !
Author: علي بن أبي طالب

Quote: We can choose to throw stones, to stumble on them, to climb over them, or to build with them.
Author: William Arthur Ward

Quote: Miracles don't happen. You make them happen. They're not wishes or dreams or candles on a cake. They're not impossible. Reality is real. It's totally and completely under my control.
Author: Julie Anne Peters,  Far from Xanadu

Quote: Nothing important is learned; it is simply remembered.
Author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón,  The Angel's Game

Quote: If someone can prove me wrong and show me my mistake in any thought or action, I shall gladly change. I seek the truth, which never harmed anyone: the harm is to persist in one's own self-deception and ignorance.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: If someone can prove me wrong and show me my mistake in any thought or action, I shall gladly change. I seek the truth, which never harmed anyone: the harm is to persist in one's own self-deception and ignorance.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: Whether you know or not, you are the infinite potential of love, peace and joy
Author: Amit Ray

Quote: Writing about the unholy is one way of writing about what is sacred.
Author: Clive Barker

Quote: The immature think that knowledge and action are different, but the wise see them as the same.
Author: Anonymous,  Bhagavad Gita: El Canto del Senor

Quote: The immature think that knowledge and action are different, but the wise see them as the same.
Author: Anonymous,  Bhagavad Gita: El Canto del Senor

Quote: The only real battle in life is between hanging on and letting go.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: The only real battle in life is between hanging on and letting go.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: The only real battle in life is between hanging on and letting go.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: If the mind is to emerge unscathed from this relentless struggle with the unforeseen, two qualities are indispensable: first, an intellect that, even in the darkest hour, retains some glimmerings of the inner light which leads to truth; and second, the courage to follow this faint light wherever it may lead.
Author: Carl von Clausewitz,  On War: Volume 1

Quote: The fates lead him who will; him who won't they drag.
Author: Joseph Campbell

Quote: When you look at the past without God’s eyes, you subject yourself to deception. The past no longer exists and God doesn’t linger there. However, Satan will show you whatever you want to see and believe, so you will be trapped in an emotion that cannot communicate truth, beyond what you want to remember.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: It is difficult to see ourselves as we are. Sometimes we are fortunate enough to have good friends, lovers or others who will do us the good service of telling us the truth about ourselves. When we don't, we can so easily delude ourselves, lose a sense of truth about ourselves, and our conscience loses power and purpose. Mostly, we tell ourselves what we would like to hear. We lose our way.
Author: Jon Katz

Quote: I may be alive now, but in a series of moments I won’t be. And let it be said about me: He didn’t waste his time talking to conch shells, but he did listen to what they had to say about the ocean.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the story my great-grandfather told my father, who then told my grandfather, who then told me about how The Mythical Mr. Boo, Charles Manseur Fizzlebush Grissham III, better known as Mr. Fizzlebush, and Orafoura are all in fact me...

Quote: When we are collecting books, we are collecting happiness.
Author: Vincent Starrett

Quote: When we are collecting books, we are collecting happiness.
Author: Vincent Starrett

Quote: I only feel like myself when I am alone.
Author: Peter Cameron,  Someday This Pain Will Be Useful to You

Quote: hindi dahil sa hindi mo naiintindihan ang isang bagay ay kasinungalingan na ito. at hindi lahat ng kaya mong intindihin ay katotohanan.
Author: Bob Ong,  Ang Paboritong Libro ni Hudas

Quote: After all the world is indeed beautiful and if we were any other creature than man we might be continuously happy in it.
Author: Sebastian Barry,  The Secret Scripture

Quote: You know, lieutenant, you wear your weapon the way other women wear pearls.""It's not a fashion accessory.
Author: J.D. Robb,  Naked in Death

Quote: In an age of hope men looked up at the night sky and saw “the heavens."In an age of hopelessness they call it simply “space.
Author: Peter Kreeft

Quote: You must know that you are worth much to me whether you accomplish anything or not. Even if you are rejected in the world's eyes, you are valuable to me.
Author: Stormie Omartian,  Stormie: A Story of Forgiveness and Healing

Quote: We read the Golden Rule and judge it to be a brilliant distillation of many of our ethical impulses. And then we come across another of God’s teachings on morality: if a man discovers on his wedding night that his bride is not a virgin, he must stone her to death on her father’s doorstep (Deuteronomy 22:13-21).
Author: Sam Harris

Quote: we unwittingly project onto God our own attitudes and feelings toward ourselves... But we cannot assume that He feels about us the way we feel about ourselves -- unless we love ourselves compassionately, intensely, and freely.
Author: Brennan Manning,  Abba's Child: The Cry of the Heart for Intimate Belonging

Quote: Why would an all-powerful creator decide to plant his carefully crafted species on islands and continents in exactly the appropriate pattern to suggest, irresistibly, that they had evolved and dispersed from the site of their evolution?
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The Greatest Show on Earth: The Evidence for Evolution

Quote: In the year 2006, a person can have sufficient intellectual and material resources to build a nuclear bomb and still believe that he will get seventy-two virgins in Paradise.
Author: Sam Harris

Quote: In the year 2006, a person can have sufficient intellectual and material resources to build a nuclear bomb and still believe that he will get seventy-two virgins in Paradise.
Author: Sam Harris

Quote: The past attracts me, the present frightens me, because the future is death.
Author: Guy de Maupassant,  The Complete Short Stories of Guy de Maupassant, Part One

Quote: ففي قرارة نفسي اليومإيمان عميق جدًاإيمان لا يتزعزعبأنَّ المحبة وحدها هي المفتاح
Author: ميخائيل نعيمة,  نجوى الغروب

Quote: We regard God as an airman regards his parachute; it's there for emergencies but he hopes he'll never have to use it.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Problem of Pain

Quote: There is something more powerful than any army. Something strong enough to topple kings, and even Darklings. Do you know what that thing is?”I shook my head, inching away from him.“Faith,” he breathed, his black eyes wild. “Faith.
Author: Leigh Bardugo,  Shadow and Bone

Quote: Sing your life; any fool can think of words that rhyme.
Author: Morrissey

Quote: Out of love,No regrets--Though the goodnessBe wasted forever.Out of love,No regrets--Though the returnBe never.
Author: Langston Hughes,  Selected Poems

Quote: Love is a clash of lightnings
Author: Pablo Neruda,  100 Love Sonnets

Quote: Give a girl a boyfriend and she becomes a total expert on relationships
Author: Cecily von Ziegesar,  You Know You Love Me

Quote: When something can be read without effort, great effort has gone into its writing.
Author: Enrique Jardiel Poncela

Quote: Knowledge, like all things, is best in moderation,"intoned the Will. "Knowing everything means you don't need to think, and that is very dangerous.
Author: Garth Nix,  Lady Friday

Quote: As the future ripens in the past,so the past rots in the future --a terrible festival of dead leaves.
Author: Anna Akhmatova,  Poems of Akhmatova

Quote: You’re my best friend,You’re my love,You’re my life.I can’t wait tomake youmy wife!Love, Ryan
Author: Tina Reber,  Love Unrehearsed

Quote: A romantic man often feels more uplifted with two women than with one: his love seems to hit the ideal mark somewhere between two different faces.
Author: Elizabeth Bowen,  The Death of the Heart

Quote: What were you thinking?"I demanded once we were moving to the music. I was trying to ignore his hands. "Do you know how much trouble you may have gotten me in?"Adrian grinned. "Nah. They all feel bad for you. You'll achieve martyrdom after dancing with a mean, wicked vampire. Job security with the Alchemists.
Author: Richelle Mead,  The Indigo Spell

Quote: Patience is a virtue and the best things in life are worth waiting for.
Author: Julie Spira,  The Perils of Cyber-Dating: Confessions of a Hopeful Romantic Looking for Love Online

Quote: Darkness feeds on apathy.
Author: Dan Brown,  The Lost Symbol

Quote: I knew you would do me good in some way, at some time--I saw it in your eyes when I first beheld you.
Author: Charlotte Brontë

Quote: It doesn’t matter. I love you. That’s it. That’s all. I hope to hell it’s enough.
Author: Maya Banks,  No Place to Run

Quote: Anyone who says he knows God's intention is showing a lot of very human ego.
Author: Michael Crichton,  Next

Quote: Silence is the language of Om. We need silence to be able to reach our Self. Both internal and external silence is very important to feel the presence of that supreme Love.
Author: Amit Ray,  Om Chanting and Meditation

Quote: I think you don't grow up until you stop worrying about other people's purposes or lack of them and find the purposes you believe in for yourself.
Author: Orson Scott Card,  Xenocide

Quote: Peace of mind comes when we exercise our right to be honest, especially with ourselves.
Author: Jack R. Rose,  The Cedar Post

Quote: No one wakes up in the morning and says, 'I want to gain 150 pounds and I will start right now!
Author: Tricia Cunningham,  The Reverse Diet: Lose 20, 50, 100 Pounds or More by Eating Dinner for Breakfast and Breakfast for Dinner

Quote: A few weeks after the worst day, I started writing lots of letters. I don't know why, but it was one of the only things that made my boots lighter.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

Quote: The rabbit of Easter. He bring of the chocolate.
Author: David Sedaris,  Me Talk Pretty One Day

Quote: The rabbit of Easter. He bring of the chocolate.
Author: David Sedaris,  Me Talk Pretty One Day

Quote: When I’m writing my own stuff, it’s like swimming upstream. Or … falling down a cliff and grabbing at branches, trying to invent the branches as I fall.
Author: Rainbow Rowell,  Fangirl

Quote: I believe that the government that governs best is a government that governs least, and by these standards we have set up a fabulous government in Iraq.
Author: Stephen Colbert

Quote: People are always insinuating that I’m rude. They say things like “Shh,” and “Careful what you say,” and “I think that guy’s listening in on our conversation.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: If writers write, then rangers range. And I’d like to wake up every morning and be a mother, so I could eat my own clothes.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  There are Two Typos of People in This World: Those Who Can Edit and Those Who Can't

Quote: No passion in the world is equal to the passion to alter someone else's draft.
Author: H.G. Wells

Quote: Teachers are the one and only people who save nations.
Author: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk

Quote: The line between failure and success is so fine. . . that we are often on the line and do not know it.
Author: Elbert Hubbard

Quote: When I was a child, books were everything. And so there is in me, always, a nostalgic, yearning for the lost pleasure of books. It is not a yearning that one ever expects to be fulfilled.
Author: Diane Setterfield,  The Thirteenth Tale

Quote: I think that every reader on earth has a list of cherished books as unique as their fingerprints....I think that, as you age, you tend to gravitate towards the classics, but those aren't the books that give you the same sort of hope for the world that a cherished book does.
Author: Douglas Coupland

Quote: You have to open up to the world and learn optimism...Contentment with the past, happiness with the present, and hope for the future. Learned optimisim.
Author: Jennifer Crusie,  Agnes and the Hitman

Quote: Above all, do not attempt to use science (I mean, the real sciences) as a defence against Christianity. They will positively encourage him to think about realities he can’t touch and see.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  Screwtape Letters

Quote: Standing there, staring at the long shelves crammed with books, I felt myself relax and was suddenly at peace.
Author: Helene Hanff,  Q's Legacy

Quote: I always like a woman in power in politics. I think they're pretty inspirational in terms of looks to begin with. It's very calculated.
Author: Chris Benz

Quote: Prospering just doesn't have to do with money.
Author: Joel Osteen

Quote: I have friends in overalls whose friendship I would not swap for the favor of the kings of the world.
Author: Thomas A. Edison

Quote: I want to state upfront, unequivocally and without doubt: I do not believe that any racial, ethnic or gender group has an advantage in sound judging. I do believe that every person has an equal opportunity to be a good and wise judge, regardless of their background or life experiences.
Author: Sonia Sotomayor

Quote: Every time you dive, you hope you'll see something new - some new species. Sometimes the ocean gives you a gift, sometimes it doesn't.
Author: James Cameron

Quote: When someone fears losing your affection, he or she will strive to keep it. Perhaps you have strived to keep someone's affection, too. Fear of loss is not love.
Author: Gary Zukav

Quote: I don't paint things. I only paint the difference between things.
Author: Henri Matisse

Quote: Well, the most terrible fear that anybody should have is not war, is not a disease, not cancer or heart problems or food poisoning - it's a man or a woman without a sense of humor.
Author: Jonathan Winters

Quote: Yellow flowers are like physical manifestations of sunlight. I’m growing a garden of sunglasses just to help save eyesight and make the world a little bit cooler.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: There're things we keep hidden from one another. Things we hide from ourselves. Things that are kept hidden from us. And things no one knows. You always learn the damnedest things at the worst possible times.
Author: Jim Butcher,  Changes

Quote: Timid men prefer the calm of despotism to the tempestuous sea of Liberty.
Author: Thomas Jefferson

Quote: It was time to take the pumpkin out of the pot and eat it. In the final analysis, that was what solved these big problems of life. You could think and think and get nowhere, but you still had to eat your pumpkin. That brought you down to earth. That gave you a reason for going on. Pumpkin.
Author: Alexander McCall Smith,  The No. 1 Ladies' Detective Agency

Quote: Live. How many of us need to be reminded that living has nothing to do with trying to be as good as someone else, or trying to fit into some category, or filling in the blanks on some stupid checklist. That it has nothing to do with punishing yourself for past mistakes.
Author: Suzanne Selfors,  Coffeehouse Angel

Quote: Things Happen and once they start happening you pretty much just to hold on for dear life and see where they drop you when they stop.
Author: Meg Rosoff,  How I Live Now

Quote: Most people gaze neither into the past nor the future; they explore neither truth nor lies. They gaze at the television.
Author: Radiohead

Quote: Most people gaze neither into the past nor the future; they explore neither truth nor lies. They gaze at the television.
Author: Radiohead

Quote: If you envy successful people, you create a negative force field of attraction that repels you from ever doing the things that you need to do to be successful. If you admire successful people, you create a positive force field of attraction that draws you toward becoming more and more like the kinds of people that you want to be like.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: If you envy successful people, you create a negative force field of attraction that repels you from ever doing the things that you need to do to be successful. If you admire successful people, you create a positive force field of attraction that draws you toward becoming more and more like the kinds of people that you want to be like.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: No matter where life takes me, you'll find me with a smile. Presumed to be happy, always laughing like a child. I never thought life could be this sweet! It's got me cheesing from cheek to cheek!
Author: Mac Miller

Quote: For he that diligently seeketh shall find; and the mysteries of God shall be unfolded unto them, by the power of the Holy Ghost, as well in these times as in times of old as in times to come; wherefore, the course of the Lord is one eternal round"- 1 Nephi 10:19
Author: Joseph Smith Jr.,  The Book of Mormon

Quote: Hope springs forever.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  The Tales of Beedle the Bard

Quote: Now I'm told this is life, and pain's just a simple compromise.
Author: Hayley Williams

Quote: Windmill or no windmill, he said, life would go on as it had always gone on--that is, badly.
Author: George Orwell,  Animal Farm

Author: George Orwell,  Animal Farm

Quote: Nothing great will ever be achieved without great men, and men are great only if they are determined to be so.
Author: Charles de Gaulle

Quote: Tragedy and adversary are the stones we sharpen our swords against so we can fight new battles.
Author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Infinity

Quote: Buy a pup and your money will buyLove unflinching that cannot lie.
Author: Rudyard Kipling

Quote: Patience ensures victory.
Author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S

Quote: With an eye made quiet by the power of harmony, and the deep power of joy, we see into the life of things.
Author: William Wordsworth

Quote: I'm not going to die, I'm going home like a shooting star.
Author: Sojourner Truth

Quote: Respect for self is the beginning of cultivating virtue in men and women.
Author: Gordon B. Hinckley

Quote: Here is my final point. About drugs, about alcohol, about pornography and smoking and everything else. What business is it of yours what I do, read, buy, see, say, think, who I fuck, what I take into my body - as long as I do not harm another human being on this planet?
Author: Bill Hicks

Quote: Bukan mudah untuk berubah... dari tanpa arah ke sejadah, dari tepi jalanan ke sujud menghadap Tuhan.

Author: George Santayana,  Soliloquies in England & Later Soliloquies

Quote: Philosophy is really nostalgia, the desire to be at home.
Author: Novalis

Quote: Some people say—not to my face, mind you—that I’m a cowardly son of a bitch. And that is simply not true. My mom is not a bitch.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: Happiness is not a state to arrive at, but a manner of traveling.
Author: Margaret Lee Runbeck

Quote: Marriage becomes hard work once you have poured the entirety of your life’s expectations for happiness into the hands of one mere person. Keeping that going is hard work.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Committed: A Skeptic Makes Peace with Marriage

Quote: Too many people out there tell us what we can and cannot do but…they don’t know who we are, what’s put in us.
Author: Alex Rogers,  I'm Only Human After All

Quote: Too many people out there tell us what we can and cannot do but…they don’t know who we are, what’s put in us.

Quote: Learn from your history, but don’t live in it.

Quote: We have no more right to consume happiness without producing it than to consume wealth without producing it.
Author: George Bernard Shaw,  Candida

Quote: How you spend your time is more important than how you spend your money. Money mistakes can be corrected, but time is gone forever.
Author: David Norris

Quote: This time it is real — all must die, and where could mountaineer find a more glorious death!
Author: John Muir,  My First Summer in the Sierra

Quote: We're here for a reason. I believe a bit of the reason is to throw little torches out to lead people through the dark.
Author: Whoopi Goldberg

Quote: God isn't about making good things happen to you, or bad things happen to you. He's all about you making choices--exercising the gift of free will. God wants you to have good things and a good life, but He won't gift wrap them for you. You have to choose the actions that lead you to that life.
Author: Jim Butcher

Quote: The times are chaotic. For me, I would hope that people look at [Angel] and gain strength by it. With everything that I do, I hope that they see people struggling to live decent, moral lives in a completely chaotic world. They see how hard it is, how often they fail, and how they get up and keep trying. That, to me, is the most important message I'm ever going to tell.
Author: Joss Whedon

Quote: We look into each other's eyes as we shake. His are still full of death and horror, but in them I see my face reflected, and inside my tiny eyes inside his, I think I see some hope.
Author: Ned Vizzini,  It's Kind of a Funny Story

Quote: One of the inescapable encumbrances of leading an interesting life is that there have to be moments when you almost lose it.
Author: Jimmy Buffett,  A Pirate Looks at Fifty

Quote: Have faith have faith. When you have nothing else have faith.
Author: Francine Rivers,  A Voice in the Wind

Quote: How many times can a heart be shattered and still be pieced back together? How many times before the damage is irreparable?
Author: Gwenn Wright,  The BlueStocking Girl

Quote: How do you mourn something that never really belonged to you?

Quote: Farewell is said by the living, in life, every day. It is said with love and friendship, with the affirmation that the memories are lasting if the flesh is not.
Author: R.A. Salvatore,  The Legacy

Quote: Faith is the very first thing you should pack in a hope chest.
Author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

Quote: Faith is the very first thing you should pack in a hope chest.
Author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

Quote: Tell me what’s the differencebetween hope and waitingbecause my heart doesn’t knowIt constantly cuts itself on the glass of waitingIt constantly gets lost in the fog of hope
Author: Anna Kamieńska

Quote: Courage will now be your best defence against the storm that is at hand-—that and such hope as I bring.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: Still, she knows one thing for certain: never judge a relationship unless you are the one wrapped up in its arms.
Author: Alice Hoffman,  Local Girls

Quote: I've found that when you're wrapped up in the process of dating and want so badly to have something work out with someone -anyone- it's easy to forget that your choices aren't limited to one person or the other. There's also the choice I always forget about: To not choose anyone in order to keep myself open to someone who IS right for me.
Author: Rachel Machacek,  The Science of Single: One Woman's Grand Experiment in Modern Dating, Creating Chemistry, and Finding L ove

Quote: Ya Tuhan, aku sempurna tertikam oleh ilusiku sendiri. Pengkhianatan oleh hatiku yang sibuk meguntai simpul pertanda cinta.
Author: Tere Liye,  Berjuta Rasanya

Quote: If I gave you a pity position it wouldn't be in my office.
Author: Janet Evanovich,  Eleven on Top

Quote: I know this woman.”“Who the hell is she?”He stared both his brothers down. “She’s mine.
Author: Maya Banks,  No Place to Run

Quote: Hey!” I said, indignation filling me. “I’m immortal! Doesn’t that mean I won’t get saggy boobs and gray hair? Because if it doesn’t mean that, I want a refund—

Quote: The love between a writer and a reader is never celebrated.
Author: Patricia Duncker,  Hallucinating Foucault

Quote: Always mystify, torture, mislead, and surprise the audience as much as possible.
Author: Don Roff

Quote: People always ask me"Son what does it takeTo reach out and touch your dreams?"To them I always sayAre you hungry?Are you thirsty?Is it a fire that burns you up inside?How bad do you want it?How bad do you need it?Are you eating, sleeping, dreamingWith that one thing on your mind?How bad do you want it?How bad do you need it?Cause if you want it allYou've got to lay it all out on the line
Author: Tim McGraw,  Tim McGraw -- Live Like You Were Dying: Piano/Vocal/Chords

Quote: Love me when I least deserve it, because that's when I really need it.
Author: Swedish Proverb

Quote: Imagination is Everything!

Quote: Mr. Right is coming, but he's in Africa and he's walking.

Quote: My couch is coffee-colored. I can thank Starbucks and clumsiness for that.

Quote: Her lips full and inviting, she has an infectious laugh and glassy cackle in her eyes, and a 2000 volt sexual charisma that beckons me like a fluff girl on scuffed knees.
Author: Brett Tate

Quote: We had a blast at my magical birthday party. There were midgets, fairies, glass slippers, and I actually got to ride in a pumpkin.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

It is high time we realized that it is pointless to praise the light and preach it if nobody can see it. It is much more needful to teach people the art of seeing.
Author: C.G. Jung

Author: Carroll Bryant

Quote: It has long been my belief that everyone's library contains an Odd Shelf. On this shelf rests a small, mysterious corpus of volumes whose subject matter is completely unrelated to the rest of the library, yet which, upon closer inspection, reveals a good deal about its owner.
Author: Anne Fadiman,  Ex Libris: Confessions of a Common Reader

Author: Jean M. Auel

Stack them around your bedroom and use them as places to rest bowls of cookies.Watch exercise shows on television, but don't do the exercises. Author: SARK

Quote: I challenge every one of you who can hear me to rise to the divinity within you. Do we really realize what it means to be a child of God, to have within us something of the divine nature?
Author: Gordon B. Hinckley

Courage is taking action.....no matter what. So you're afraid? Be afraid. Be scared silly to the point you're trembling and nauseous, but do it anyway!

Author: Jorge Luis Borges,  Labyrinths: Selected Stories and Other Writings

There are wars and defeats and victories of the human race that are not military and that are not recorded in the annals of history. Remember that while you're trying to decide what to do.
Author: John Edward Williams,  Stoner

Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  God Bless You, Mr. Rosewater

Author: Hamza Yusuf

Quote: Why not let people differ about their answers to the great mysteries of the Universe? Let each seek one's own way to the highest, to one's own sense of supreme loyalty in life, one's ideal of life. Let each philosophy, each world-view bring forth its truth and beauty to a larger perspective, that people may grow in vision, stature and dedication.
Author: Algernon Black

Quote: Once in a while it really hits people that they don't have to experience the world in the way they have been told to.
Author: Alan Keightley

Quote: Happiness is such a fragile thing, isn't it? So easily burst, like a bubble blown by a child, and always on the verge of being carried away.
Author: Nenia Campbell,  Endgame

Quote: For my part, whatever anguish of spirit it may cost, I am willing to know the whole truth; to know the worst and to provide for it.
Author: Patrick Henry

Quote: You know there's no such thing as a complete lie. There's always some truth in there.
Author: David Levithan,  Will Grayson, Will Grayson

Quote: Before speaking, consult your inner-truth barometer, and resist the temptation to tell people only what they want to hear.
Author: Wayne W. Dyer

Quote: We need never be without hope because we can never be irreparably broken.
Author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

Author: Cristina Marrero,  The Unsung Love Story

Author: William Hazlitt,  Essays of William Hazlitt: Selected and Edited, with Introduction and Notes, by Frank Carr

Quote: She did not care very much for other little girls, but if she had plenty of books she could console herself.
Author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  A Little Princess

Quote: And if humanity is the last war, then I am the battlefield.
Author: Rick Yancey,  The 5th Wave

Quote: I remember discussions with Bohr which went through many hours till very late at night and ended almost in despair; and when at the end of the discussion I went alone for a walk in the neighbouring park I repeated to myself again and again the question: Can nature possibly be so absurd as it seemed to us in these atomic experiments?
Author: Werner Heisenberg

Quote: As to diseases, make a habit of two things — to help, or at least, to do no harm.
Author: Hippocrates

Quote: As we live and as we are, Simplicity - with a capital "S"- is difficult to comprehend nowadays. We are no longer truly simple. We no longer live in simple terms or places. Life is a more complex struggle now. It is now valiant to be simple: a courageous thing to even want to be simple. It is a spiritual thing to comprehend what simplicity means.
Author: Frank Lloyd Wright,  The Natural House

Quote: Still, he figured, sometimes you've got to do what you've got to do, and then sometimes you've just got to run like hell after it's done.
Author: Derek Landy,  Death Bringer

Quote: Know that the same spark of life that is within you, is within all of our animal friends, the desire to live is the same within all of us...
Author: Rai Aren,  Secret of the Sands

Quote: If you have nothing in life but a good friend, you're rich.
Author: Michelle Kwan

Quote: All teachings are mere references. The true experience is living your own life. Then, even the holiest of words are only words.
Author: Ming-Dao Deng

Quote: People see stories everywhere...We take random events and we put them together in a pattern so we can comfort ourselves with a story, no matter how much it obviously isn't true...We have to lie to ourselves to live. Otherwise, we'd go crazy.
Author: Patrick Ness,  More Than This

Quote: But, in her life, nothing was going to happen. Such was the will of God! The future was a dark corridor, and at the far end the door was bolted.
Author: Gustave Flaubert,  Madame Bovary

Quote: Faith don't come in a bushel basket, Missy. It come one step at a time. Decide to trust Him for one little thing today, and before you know it, you find out He's so trustworthy you be putting your whole life in His hands.
Author: Lynn Austin,  Candle in the Darkness

Quote: Enjoy the limitless bliss consciousness here and now. The reality of you lies much beyond your sensory perceptions and boundaries.
Author: Amit Ray

Quote: If you can’t believe in miracles, then believe in yourself. When you want something bad enough, let that drive push you to make it happen. Sometimes you’ll run into brick walls that are put there to test you. Find a way around them and stay focused on your dream. Where there’s a will, there’s a way.
Author: Isabel Lopez,  Isabel's Hand-Me-Down Dreams

Quote: There are in this world blessed souls, whose sorrows all spring up into joys for others; whose earthly hopes, laid in the grave with many tears, are the seed from which spring healing flowers and balm for the desolate and the distressed.
Author: Harriet Beecher Stowe,  Uncle Tom's Cabin

Quote: What's right isn't always popular, and whats popular isn't always right.
Author: Sharon M. Draper

Quote: Republicans are for both the man and the dollar, but in case of conflict the man before the dollar.
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: On Wednesday, when the sky is blue,and I have nothing else to do,I sometimes wonder if it's true That who is what and what is who."- Winnie-the-Pooh
Author: A.A. Milne

Quote: Like a missing tooth, sometimes an absence is more noticeable than a presence.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Lone Wolf

Author: Gloria E. Anzaldúa

Author: Nancy D. Solomon

Quote: A child who does not think about what happens around him and is content with living without wondering whether he lives honestly is like a man who lives from a scoundrel's work and is on the road to being a scoundrel.
Author: José Martí

Author: Sharon Maas,  Of Marriageable Age

Quote: Everyone has a hidden agenda. Except me!
Author: Michael Crichton

Author: Maya Angelou

Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Choke

Quote: It is the certainty that they possess the truth that makes men cruel.
Author: Anatole France

Quote: And, at such a time, for a few of us there will always be a tugging at the heart—knowing a precious moment had gone and we not there. We can ask and ask but we can’t have again what once seemed ours for ever—the way things looked, that church alone in the fields, a bed on belfry floor, a remembered voice, a loved face. They’ve gone and you can only wait for the pain to pass.
Author: J.L. Carr,  A Month in the Country

Quote: It takes a lot of rehearsing for a man to be himself.
Author: William Saroyan

Quote: Money does not buy you happiness, but lack of money certainly buys you misery.
Author: Daniel Kahneman,  Well-Being: Foundations of Hedonic Psychology: Foundations of Hedonic Psychology

Quote: Sometimes you get everything you ever wanted, only it doesn't look like what you wanted anymore.
Author: Leila Sales,  Past Perfect

Quote: The truth doesn't always make a good story, does it?
Author: Lev Grossman,  The Magicians

Quote: There’s truth and honor in a mustache. And that’s why I started flying one on the flagpole outside of my house.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

Quote: Truly amazing, what people can get used to, as long as there are a few compensations.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  The Handmaid's Tale

Quote: No words for a long time. Which is fine, because even the most important ones-- I love you. I'm sorry. Forgive me? I'm here-- are only stand-ins for what you can say better without talking at all.
Author: Huntley Fitzpatrick,  My Life Next Door

Quote: Everyone is down on pain, because they forget something important about it: Pain is for the living. Only the dead don't feel it.
Author: Jim Butcher,  White Night

Quote: The cries of the dead are terrible indeed; you should try not to hear them.
Author: Philip K. Dick,  VALIS

Quote: And as Voltaire, one of our nation’s Founding Fathers, once said, “I do not agree with what you have to say, but at your death I’ll defend what you rightfully should have said.

Quote: We know enough at this moment to say that the God of Abraham is not only unworthy of the immensity of creation; he is unworthy even of man.
Author: Sam Harris

Quote: Did I hear God call me an idiot?
Author: Wm. Paul Young,  The Shack

Quote: What will I be doing in twenty years' time? I'll be dead, darling! Are you crazy?
Author: Freddie Mercury

Quote: Faith and science, I have learned, are two sides of the same coin, separated by an expanse so small, but wide enough that one side can't see the other. They don't know they are connected.
Author: Mary E. Pearson,  The Adoration of Jenna Fox

Quote: True faith manifests itself through our actions.
Author: Francis Chan,  Crazy Love: Overwhelmed by a Relentless God

Quote: He could build a city. Has a certain capacity. There’s a niche in his chestwhere a heart would fit perfectlyand he thinks if he could just maneuver one into place –well then, game over.
Author: Richard Siken

Quote: Much Madness Is Divinest SenseMuch Madness is divinest Sense —To a discerning Eye —Much Sense — the starkest Madness —'Tis the MajorityIn this, as All, prevail —Assent — and you are sane —Demur — you're straightway dangerous —And handled with a Chain —
Author: Emily Dickinson,  The Complete Poems

Quote: Dawn is meant for Lovers. And so is dusk and anytime in between. Count me in. And out. In, out, in, out, and I just came, I saw, I conked out.-Amanda Mosher and Jarod Kintz
Author: Amanda Mosher,  liQUID PROse QUOtes

Quote: You're only human. You live once and life is wonderful so eat the damn red velvet cupcake!
Author: Emma Stone

Quote: because two bodies, naked and entwined,leap over time, they are invulnerable,nothing can touch them, they return to the source,there is no you, no I, no tomorrow,no yesterday, no names, the truth of twoin a single body, a single soul,oh total being...
Author: Octavio Paz,  Sunstone/Piedra De Sol

Quote: So I find words I never thought to speakIn streets I never thought I should revisitWhen I left my body on a distant shore.
Author: T.S. Eliot

Quote: In love, women are professionals, men are amateurs
Author: François Truffaut

Quote: I don’t understand how I could have believed you were a warm, affectionate, and tenderhearted person! You’re obviously as prickly as a porcupine and any man who comes close to you will end up with a face full of quills!
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: The thoughts that occur to me while I’m running are like clouds in the sky. Clouds of all different sizes. They come and they go, while the sky remains the same sky always. The clouds are mere guests in the sky that pass away and vanish, leaving behind the sky.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  What I Talk About When I Talk About Running

Quote: The fact that my continuous and public rejection of Christianity does not worry me in the least should suggest to you just how inadequate I think your reasons for being a Christian are.
Author: Sam Harris,  Letter to a Christian Nation

Quote: It took me fifteen years to discover that I had no talent for writing, but I couldn't give it up because by that time I was too famous.
Author: Robert Benchley

Quote: The best fame is a writer's fame. It's enough to get a table at a good restaurant, but not enough to get you interrupted when you eat.
Author: Fran Lebowitz

Quote: Every villian is a hero in his own mind.
Author: Tom Hiddleston

Quote: We are not human beings on a spiritual journey. We are spiritual beings on a human journey.
Author: Stephen R. Covey

Quote: I always felt that Jim Morrison was a terrible name for the front man of The Doors. No, for a band called The Doors, a name like Rusty Hinge would have been more appropriate.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the story my great-grandfather told my father, who then told my grandfather, who then told me about how The Mythical Mr. Boo, Charles Manseur Fizzlebush Grissham III, better known as Mr. Fizzlebush, and Orafoura are all in fact me...

Quote: I just started working the graveyard shift at the cemetery. Come to think of it, every shift at the cemetery is the graveyard shift.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: He started to touch the mechanism under the keyboard, then pulled his hand back with a snap."Ah,"he said. "Must deactivate the security....Turn around, please.""What?""Turn around, Claire. It's a secure password!""You have GOT to be kidding.""Why ever would I joke about that? Please turn.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Ghost Town

Quote: The lampshade on my head is for my bright ideas. I won't be able to convey them until Monday, when my curtain gets out of the dry cleaners.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: Writing novels is much the same. You gather up bones and make your gate, but no matter how wonderful the gate might be, that alone doesn't make it a living breathing novel. A story is not something of this world. A real story requires a kind of magical baptism to link the world on this side with the world on the other side.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Sputnik Sweetheart

Quote: There are a thousand thoughts lying within a man that he does not know till he takes up the pen to write.
Author: William Makepeace Thackeray,  The History of Henry Esmond, Esq.

Quote: Nearly' only counts in horseshoes and hand-grenades.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  The Graveyard Book

Quote: The many great gardens of the world, of literature and poetry, of painting and music, of religion and architecture, all make the point as clear as possible: The soul cannot thrive in the absence of a garden. If you don't want paradise, you are not human; and if you are not human, you don't have a soul.
Author: Thomas More

Quote: I cannot say this too strongly: Do not compare yourselves to others. Be true to who you are, and continue to learn with all your might.
Author: Daisaku Ikeda,  Discussions on Youth

Quote: Books wrote our life story, and as they accumulated on our shelves (and on our windowsills, and underneath our sofa, and on top of our refrigerator), they became chapters in it themselves.
Author: Anne Fadiman,  Ex Libris: Confessions of a Common Reader

Quote: These are all novels, all about people that never existed, the people that read them it makes them unhappy with their own lives. Makes them want to live in other ways they can never really be.
Author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

Quote: Avoidable human misery is more often caused not so much by stupidity as by ignorance, particularly our ignorance about ourselves.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

Quote: Censoring books that deal with difficult, adolescent issues does not protect anybody. Quite the opposite. It leaves kids in the darkness and makes them vulnerable. Censorship is the child of fear and the father of ignorance. Our children cannot afford to have the truth of the world withheld from them
Author: Laurie Halse Anderson

Quote: Coming to Nashville has been so motivating and inspirational. Just watching people live and breathe their music and create something that they can feel from start to finish.
Author: Madi Diaz

Quote: Lay this unto your breast: Old friends, like old swords, still are trusted best.
Author: John Webster

Quote: I'm taking all the negatives in my life, and turning them into a positive.
Author: Pitbull

Quote: Chemistry is one of these crazy things you can't teach or learn or you can't fake. You go in hoping it will work, hope that you will connect with the other actors. I was fortunate on 'Modern Family' and 'The Procession.' They are great people, very easy to like.
Author: Jesse Tyler Ferguson

Quote: And I loved Fats Waller. I love his instrumental abilities, his vocal abilities and his sense of humor.
Author: Paul McCartney

Quote: And I loved Fats Waller. I love his instrumental abilities, his vocal abilities and his sense of humor.
Author: Paul McCartney

Quote: Art is pattern informed by sensibility.
Author: Herbert Read

Quote: Always have a sense of humor about life - you'll need it - but always be courteous to boot.
Author: Peter Jennings

Quote: I'm a completely worthless woman and no man should risk his life for me.
Author: Greta Garbo

Quote: Yet if I was asked to do this again - in fact, if I was ever asked to repeat any of my experiences - I'd have to say, fuck it, bring them on. I've no regrets.This is what it means to be alive.
Author: John Barrowman

Quote: Regret is counterproductive. It's looking back on a past that you can't change. Questioning things as they occur can prevent regret in the future.
Author: Colleen Hoover,  Slammed

Quote: All the natural movements of the soul are controlled by laws analogous to those of physical gravity. Grace is the only exception. Grace fills empty spaces, but it can only enter where there is a void to receive it, and it is grace itself which makes this void. The imagination is continually at work filling up all the fissures through which grace might pass.
Author: Simone Weil,  Gravity and Grace

Quote: Life's just a bunch of accidents, connected by one perfect end.
Author: Daniel C. Tomas

Quote: Do not forget that the value and interest of life is not so much to do conspicuous things...as to do ordinary things with the perception of their enormous value.
Author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin

Quote: I do not cling to life sufficiently to fear death.
Author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Three Musketeers

Quote: I do not cling to life sufficiently to fear death.
Author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Three Musketeers

Quote: In a dog's life, some plaster would fall, some cushions would open, some rugs would shred. Like any relationship, this one had its costs. They were costs we came to accept and balance against the joy and amusement and protection and companionship he gave us.
Author: John Grogan,  Marley and Me: Life and Love With the World's Worst Dog

Quote: The demon that you can swallow gives you its power, and the greater life’s pain, the greater life’s reply.
Author: Joseph Campbell,  The Power of Myth

Quote: But then, life is a constant withering of possibilities. Some are stolen with the lives of people you love. Others are let go, with regret and reluctance and deep, deep sorrow. But there is compensation for lives unlived in the intoxicating joy of knowing that the life you have - right here, right now - if the one you have chosen. There is power in that, and hope.
Author: Emily Maguire,  Taming the Beast

Author: Shiv Khera,  You Can Win: A Step by Step Tool for Top Achievers

Quote: Make your interactions with people transformational, not just transactional.
Author: Patti Smith

Quote: Small mistakes tend to lead to large ones. Ours is a lifetime appoinment, and all you have is your reputation. Once it's gone, it doesn't comeback.
Author: David Baldacci,  The Simple Truth

Quote: We are faced with the fact, my friends, that tomorrow is today. Procrastination is still the thief of time. Over the bleached bones and jumbled residues of numerous civilizations are written the pathetic words ‘Too Late’.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.

Quote: I want all my senses engaged. Let me absorb the world's variety and uniqueness.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: See what I mean? You gotta be crazy. Ain't no time to be sane.
Author: Robin Williams

Quote: I've learned one thing: you can only really get to know a person after a row. Only then can you judge their true character!
Author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

Quote: What fire does not destroy, it hardens
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: This place has only three exits, sir: Madness, and Death.
Author: René Daumal

Quote: Comfort is no test of truth. Truth is often far from being comfortable.
Author: Swami Vivekananda

Quote: Aw I don't wanta go to no such thing, I just wanta drink in alleys.'...But you'll miss all that, just for some old wine.'There's wisdom in wine, goddam it!' I yelled. 'Have a shot!
Author: Jack Kerouac,  The Dharma Bums

Quote: It's funny whom we end up choosing to love and who ends up choosing to love us. It's rarely the people we think it should be.
Author: Robin Jones Gunn,  Gardenias for Breakfast

Quote: Accomplishments don’t erase shame, hatred, cruelty, silence, ignorance, discrimination, low self-esteem or immorality. It covers it up, with a creative version of pride and ego. Only restitution, forgiving yourself and others, compassion, repentance and living with dignity will ever erase the past.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: There is no truth on this island of yours. Rather, there are as many truths as there are stars in the sky; and every one of them different.
Author: Juliet Marillier,  Daughter of the Forest

Quote: God is the supreme uncreated light of which Wisdom is born, but there was never a time when God's Wisdom did not exist.
Author: Merritt Y. Hughes,  Ten Perspectives on Milton

Quote: God is the supreme uncreated light of which Wisdom is born, but there was never a time when God's Wisdom did not exist.
Author: Merritt Y. Hughes,  Ten Perspectives on Milton

Quote: Sky is not a limit for me; because I have no limit for myself in life. Because life is a world full of risk taking and possibilities. No matter how hard or easy life is; I will always find a way to enjoy myself; even in the mist of circumstances; because problems is a sense of adventure in sheep's clothing.
Author: Temitope Owosela

Author: Lauren Oliver,  Hana

Quote: In the midst of happiness or despairin sorrow or in joyin pleasure or in pain:Do what is right and you will be at peace.
Author: Jess Rothenberg,  The Catastrophic History of You and Me

Quote: We will never be happy until we make God the source of our fulfillment and the answer to our longings. He is the only one who should have power over our souls.
Author: Stormie Omartian,  The Power of a Praying Woman

Quote: Truth is neither in the scripture nor in the words of prophets. It is in your heart, feel it, discover it and expand with it.
Author: Amit Ray,  OM Sutra: The Pathway to Enlightenment

Quote: We are all happy if we but knew it.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky

Quote: All cannot be lost when there is still so much being found
Author: Lemony Snicket

Quote: Eyes, look your last! Arms, take your last embrace! And, lips, oh you the doors of breath, seal with a righteous kiss a dateless bargain to engrossing death!
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: Eyes, look your last! Arms, take your last embrace! And, lips, oh you the doors of breath, seal with a righteous kiss a dateless bargain to engrossing death!
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: While there is tea, there is hope."(Sweet Lavender)
Author: Arthur Wing Pinero

Quote: Personally, I do not want to make you a man. Men are so very frail. Men break. Men die. No, I’ve always wished to make a god.
Author: Pierce Brown,  Red Rising

Quote: Hope is not the conviction that something will turn out well, but the certainty that something makes sense, regardless of how it turns out.
Author: Václav Havel

Quote: She was a wolf. She was death, devourer of the worlds.
Author: Sarah J. Maas,  Queen of Shadows

Quote: This is what youth must figure out:Girls, love, and living.The having, the not having,The spending and giving,And the meloncholy time of not knowing.This is what age must learn about:The ABC of dying.The going, yet not going,The loving and leaving,And the unbearable knowing and knowing
Author: E.B. White

Quote: My heart leaps up when I beholdA rainbow in the sky:So was it when my life began;So is it now I am a man;
Author: William Wordsworth

Quote: Poetry and art and knowledge are sacred and pure.
Author: George Eliot,  The Mill on the Floss

Quote: Poetry and art and knowledge are sacred and pure.
Author: George Eliot,  The Mill on the Floss

Quote: O stand, stand at the window As the tears scald and start;You shall love your crooked neighbour With your crooked heart.
Author: W.H. Auden,  As I Walked Out One Evening: Songs, Ballads, Lullabies, Limericks & Other Light Verse

Quote: I sip my coffee like I fall in love—alone in a field of flowers, writing poetry for the mailman, who delivers love letters, but never gets any.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I sip my coffee like I fall in love—alone in a field of flowers, writing poetry for the mailman, who delivers love letters, but never gets any.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: You + Mesaw this...AMERICAThank you for finding America with me
Author: Morgan Matson,  Amy and Roger's Epic Detour

Quote: And I know that when you get hurt, your first instinct is to run. But I also realized something else. No one has ever followed you when you did run. But I'm going to follow, and I'm going to keep following until you realize that you can trust me. I'm not going to let you run away from something that could be so great. That is so great. Marty, I love you.- Nate
Author: Kathy Love,  Wanting Something More

Quote: Grant me, O Lord my God, a mind to know you, a heart to seek you, wisdom to find you, conduct pleasing to you, faithful perseverance in waiting for you, and a hope of finally embracing you. Amen.
Author: Thomas Aquinas

Quote: The religion of one age is the literary entertainment of the next.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: The real problem with stories - if you keep them going long enough, they always end in death.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 1: Preludes and Nocturnes

Quote: The worst part of writing fiction is the fear of wasting your life behind a keyboard. The idea that, dying, you'll realize you only lived on paper. Your only adventures were make-believe, and while the world fought and kissed, you sat in some dark room masturbating and making money.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Stranger than Fiction

Quote: Only you can take inner freedom away from yourself, or give it to yourself. Nobody else can.
Author: Michael A. Singer,  The Untethered Soul: The Journey Beyond Yourself

Quote: ..."vers libre,"(free verse) or nine-tenths of it, is not a new metre any more than sleeping in a ditch is a new school of architecture.
Author: G.K. Chesterton,  Fancies Versus Fads

Quote: ..."vers libre,"(free verse) or nine-tenths of it, is not a new metre any more than sleeping in a ditch is a new school of architecture.
Author: G.K. Chesterton,  Fancies Versus Fads

Quote: He is your friend who pushes you nearer to God.
Author: Abraham Kuyper

Quote: Real intimacy is a sacred experience. It never exposes its secret trust and belonging to the voyeuristic eye of a neon culture. Real intimacy is of the soul, and the soul is reserved.
Author: John O'Donohue,  Anam Cara: A Book of Celtic Wisdom

Quote: I don't dream at night, I dream at day, I dream all day; I'm dreaming for living.
Author: Steven Spielberg

Quote: The relation between what we see and what we know is never settled. Each evening we see the sun set. We know that the earth is turning away from it. Yet the knowledge, the explanation, never quite fits the sight.
Author: John Berger,  Ways of Seeing

Quote: Whereever you end up;"Jack whispered into my ear."I wish you clear skies. Always
Author: Wendy Mass,  Every Soul a Star

Quote: I have stretched ropes from steeple to steeple; Garlands from window to window; Golden chains from star to star ... And I dance.
Author: Arthur Rimbaud,  Complete Works

Quote: Blood was its Avatar and its seal.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: When her boyfriend broke his leg, I knew it was my chance to ask her to dance. So I put down my baseball bat and approached her like Babe Ruth.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I have a Rubik’s Cube for a heart, and my love for you is no puzzle. Through twists and spins, life can only get more colorful.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I have a Rubik’s Cube for a heart, and my love for you is no puzzle. Through twists and spins, life can only get more colorful.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: This Valentine’s Day rent a poem for your loved. They come in three sizes—small, medium, and romantic. Free refills available to Premium Members.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I let coffee drip into my mouth the same way I fall in love—slowly, as I wring out my shirt before going to scrub off the 32-ounce spill. I’m as romantic as a free-refill station that’s out of sugar, cream, and stirring sticks.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Sometimes the door closes on a relationship, not because we failed but because something bigger than us says this no longer fits our life. So, lock the door, shed a tear, turn around and look for the new door that's opened. It's a sign that you're no longer that person you were, it's time to change into who you are. It's going to be okay.
Author: Lee Goff

Quote: She couldn't be on his wavelength all the time. That's all. When you could recognize that and deal with it, you were on your way to an adult relationship.
Author: Stephen King,  The Stand

Quote: The wind is my favorite color. It reminds me of the love she painted on my life as she blew past me.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: The wind is my favorite color. It reminds me of the love she painted on my life as she blew past me.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: The moment you stop chasing happiness, you become happy.
Author: Sandy Hyatt-James

Quote: When you give yourself to me, completely, I will bite you. Until then, my love, I will only nibble on you.”~Cole
Author: Tina Carreiro,  Power of the Moon

Quote: She laid her head against his collarbone, and he kissed her temple. To her shock, she felt a shudder roll through his body about the same time she registered wetness against her skin. Tears. His tears.She started to turn around, but he tightened his grip.“Stay,” he said in a choked voice. “Just let me hold you, baby. Just let me hold you.
Author: Maya Banks,  The Darkest Hour

Quote: No, women like you don't write. They carve onion sculptures and potato statues. They sit in dark corners and braid their hair in new shapes and twists in order to control the stiffness, the unruliness, the rebelliousness.
Author: Edwidge Danticat,  Krik? Krak!

Quote: I like the silent church before the service begins, better than any preaching.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  Self-Reliance and Other Essays

Quote: The more you read, the less apt you are to make a fool of yourself with your pen or word processor.
Author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

Quote: You can t coast uphill.
Author: Roger Crawford

Quote: A letter is a soul, so faithful an echo of the speaking voice that to the sensitive it is among the richest treasures of love.
Author: Honoré de Balzac,  Père Goriot

Quote: In a weak moment, I have written a book.
Author: Margaret Mitchell

Quote: All I'm writing is just what I feel, that's all. I just keep it almost naked. And probably the words are so bland.
Author: Jimi Hendrix

Quote: Does it hurt?”He bent his head and lightly kissed her forehead. “Only when I laugh.”“I’ll try not to be funny.”“Epic fail, beautiful.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Last Breath

Quote: Her voice was now so shrill only bats would be able to hear it soon, but she had reached a level of indignation that rendered her temporarily speechless..
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: There had to be a circle of Hell where you were eternally fourteen, eternally in junior high. One of the lower circles.
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Bloody Bones

Quote: After climbing off his bike, I smacked his shoulder. “Did you forget I was with you? Are you trying to get me killed?”“It’s hard to forget you’re behind me when your thighs are squeezing the life out of me.” A smirk came with his next thought. “I couldn’t think of a better way to die, actually.”“There is something very wrong with you.
Author: Jamie McGuire,  Beautiful Disaster

Quote: I was going to change my clothes, but I changed my mind instead.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

Quote: I was going to change my clothes, but I changed my mind instead.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

Quote: The easiest way to get from point A to point B is with a vehicle that runs on alphabet soup.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Great Listener Seeks Mute Women

Quote: We set out to save the Shire, Sam and it has been saved - but not for me.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: You are here in order to enable the world to live more amply, with greater vision, with a finer spirit of hope and achievement. You are here to enrich the world.
Author: Woodrow Wilson

Quote: To be really mediæval one should have no body. To be really modern one should have no soul. To be really Greek one should have no clothes.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  Complete Works of Oscar Wilde

Quote: Tears had poured from her eyes without any change in her facial expression. It’s pure pain and pure surrender when your soul cries without any fight from your body and that’s how I knew she was deeply affected.
Author: Renee Carlino,  Sweet Thing

Quote: Literary detection and firearms don't really go hand in hand; pen mighter than the sword and so forth.
Author: Jasper Fforde,  The Eyre Affair

Quote: Books are the ultimate Dumpees: put them down and they'll wait for you forever; pay attention to them and they always love you back.
Author: John Green,  An Abundance of Katherines

Quote: Every intelligent being, whether it breathes or not, coughs nervously at some time in its life.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  The Color of Magic

Quote: The man of science has learned to believe in justification, not by faith, but by verification.
Author: Thomas Henry Huxley,  Collected Essays Of Thomas Henry Huxley

Quote: We must laugh and cry, enjoy and suffer, in a word, vibrate to our full capacity … I think that’s what being really human means.
Author: Gustave Flaubert

Quote: I wanted to cry because I needed you there with me so bad. I knew in that moment that I was in love with you. I was in love with the way you loved me. When you wrapped your arms around me and held me, I knew that no matter what happened with my life, you were my home. You stole the biggest piece of my heart that night.
Author: Colleen Hoover,  Hopeless

Quote: What can we see, read, acquire, but ourselves. Take the book, my friend, and read your eyes out, you will never find there what I find.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Life lived in the absence of the psychedelic experience that primordial shamanism is based on is life trivialized, life denied, life enslaved to the ego.
Author: Terence McKenna

Quote: Don't stay in bed, unless you can make money in bed.
Author: George Burns

Quote: The truth was, history repeated itself on a daily basis; mistakes were made over and over. People were haunted by what they had done, and by what they hadn't had time to do.
Author: Jodi Picoult

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... you kept meowing at people and licking yourself it was not unlike you normally.
Author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... you kept meowing at people and licking yourself it was not unlike you normally.
Author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... you kept meowing at people and licking yourself it was not unlike you normally.
Author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: Hurl yourself at goals above your head and bear the lacerations that come when you slip and make a fool of yourself. Try always, as long as you have breath in your body, to take the hard way–and work, work, work to build yourself into a rich, continually evolving entity.
Author: Sylvia Plath

Quote: The discovery of what is true and the practice of that which is good are the two most important aims of philosophy.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: الكتب كالبشر .. قليل منها يلعب دورا عظيما
Author: فولتير

Quote: Thus, when we plead for the gift of charity, we aren't asking for lovely feelings toward someone who bugs us or someone who has injured or wounded us. We are actually pleading for our very natures to be changed, for our character and disposition to become more and more like the Savior's, so that we literally feel as He would feel and thus do what He would do.
Author: Sheri Dew,  If Life Were Easy, It Wouldn't Be Hard: And Other Reassuring Truths

Quote: The Study of philosophy is not that we may know what men have thought, but what the truth of things is.
Author: Thomas Aquinas

Quote: Truth is neither ojectivity nor the balanced view; truth is a selfless subjectivity.
Author: Knut Hamsun,  Hunger

Quote: Masalah adalah apa yang kamu anggap masalah
Author: Pidi Baiq

Quote: The brightest light casts the darkest shadow.
Author: Jess C. Scott,  The Darker Side of Life

Quote: The brightest light casts the darkest shadow.
Author: Jess C. Scott,  The Darker Side of Life

Quote: Don't count your owls before they are delivered.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

Quote: I was flipping channels, watching this cheerleading program on MTV. They took a field hockey girl and “transformed” her into a cheerleader by the end of the show. I was just wondering: what if she liked field hockey better?
Author: Jess C. Scott,  EyeLeash: A Blog Novel
