Quote: A disciplined mind leads to happiness, and an undisciplined mind leads to suffering.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV,  The Art of Happiness

Quote: Communication is a skill that you can learn. It's like riding a bicycle or typing. If you're willing to work at it, you can rapidly improve the quality of very part of your life.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: If you have done something meritorious, you experience pleasure and happiness; if wrong things, suffering. A happy or unhappy life is your own creation. Nobody else is responsible. If you remember this, you won’t find fault with anybody. You are your own best friend as well as your worst enemy. (99)
Author: Swami Satchidananda,  The Yoga Sutras

Quote: If we submit everything to reason our religion will be left with nothing mysterious or supernatural. If we offend the principles of reason our religion will be absurd and ridiculous . . . There are two equally dangerous extremes: to exclude reason, to admit nothing but reason.
Author: Blaise Pascal,  Pensées

Quote: If we submit everything to reason our religion will be left with nothing mysterious or supernatural. If we offend the principles of reason our religion will be absurd and ridiculous . . . There are two equally dangerous extremes: to exclude reason, to admit nothing but reason.
Author: Blaise Pascal,  Pensées

Quote: We must cease striving and trust God to provide what He thinks is best and in whatever time He chooses to make it available. But this kind of trusting doesn't come naturally. It's a spiritual crisis of the will in which we must choose to exercise faith.
Author: Charles R. Swindoll

Quote: We must cease striving and trust God to provide what He thinks is best and in whatever time He chooses to make it available. But this kind of trusting doesn't come naturally. It's a spiritual crisis of the will in which we must choose to exercise faith.
Author: Charles R. Swindoll

Quote: The difference between hope and despair is a different way of telling stories from the same facts.
Author: Alain de Botton

Quote: With one long breath, caught and held in his chest, he fought his sadness over his solitary life. Don't cry, you idiot! Live or die, but don't poison everything...
Author: Saul Bellow,  Herzog

Quote: We have only a little time to please the living. But all eternity to love the dead.
Author: Sophocles,  Antigone

Quote: God does not require that we be successful only that we be faithful.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: God does not require that we be successful only that we be faithful.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: Mendacity is a system that we live in,"declares Brick. "Liquor is one way out an'death's the other.
Author: Tennessee Williams,  Cat on a Hot Tin Roof

Quote: Because no one needs to live for ever. I think that sometimes you can outstay your welcome.
Author: Gemma Malley,  The Declaration

Quote: Any way I slice reality it comes out poorly, and I feel an urge to not exist, something I have never felt before; and now here it comes with conviction, almost panic. I mentally bless and exonerate anyone who has kicked a chair out from beneath her or swallowed opium in large chunks. My mind has met their environment, here in the void. I understand perfectly.
Author: Suzanne Finnamore,  Split: A Memoir of Divorce

Quote: I forgive you,"I said. I said what I had to. I would die by pieces to save myself from real death.
Author: Alice Sebold,  Lucky

Quote: . . . All artists’ work is autobiographical. Any writer’s work is a map of their psyche. You can really see what their concerns are, what their obsessions are, and what interests them.
Author: Kim Addonizio

Quote: . . . All artists’ work is autobiographical. Any writer’s work is a map of their psyche. You can really see what their concerns are, what their obsessions are, and what interests them.
Author: Kim Addonizio

Quote: Stars open among the lilies.Are you not blinded by such expressionless sirens?This is the silence of astounded souls.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  Crossing the Water

Quote: Our state cannot be severed, we are one,One flesh; to lose thee were to lose myself.
Author: John Milton,  Paradise Lost

Quote: To see a World in a grain of sand,And a Heaven in a wild flower,Hold Infinity in the palm of your hand,And Eternity in an hour.
Author: William Blake,  Auguries of Innocence

Quote: You gave me hyacinths first a year ago; They called me the hyacinth girl.' —Yet when we came back, late, from the Hyacinth garden, Your arms full, and your hair wet, I could not Speak, and my eyes failed, I was neither Living nor dead, and I knew nothing, Looking into the heart of light, the silence. Od' und leer das Meer.
Author: T.S. Eliot,  The Waste Land and Other Writings

Quote: Either we shall find what it is we are seeking or at least we shall free ourselves from the persuasion that we know what we do not know.
Author: Plato,  The Republic

Quote: At two o'clock in the morning, if you open your window and listen,You will hear the feet of the Wind that is going to call the sun.And the trees in the Shadow rustle and the trees in the moonlight glisten,And though it is deep, dark night, you feel that the night is done.
Author: Rudyard Kipling

Quote: Like poetry, fashion does not state anything. It merely suggests
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Like poetry, fashion does not state anything. It merely suggests
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: If I were hairy, would you vacuum my chest before we made love? I’d probably have enough chip crumbs in it to feed the homeless, because I’m a charitable kind of guy.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: We had been friends. We could not become strangers. It left only one thing: we must be enemies.
Author: John Christopher,  The Prince in Waiting

Quote: So many women are fighting to receive my love that Chuck Norris had to intervene, and instantly he was defeated by desire. #OutBoastKanye
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Over time as most people fail the survivor's exacting test of trustworthiness, she tends to withdraw from relationships. The isolation of the survivor thus persists even after she is free.
Author: Judith Lewis Herman,  Trauma and Recovery

Quote: Miss Mitchell had a lovely voice, it was true, but Miss Mitchell speaking Italian was something celestial. Her ruby mouth opening and closing, the delicate way she almost sang the words, her tongue peeking out to wet her lips from time to time...Professor Emerson had to remind himself to close his mouth after it had dropped open.
Author: Sylvain Reynard,  Gabriel's Inferno

Quote: Long dormant feelings poured through my dried-up limbs and wound through me, slowly filling the emptiness. Like an irrigated field, I felt myself blossom and grow with new vigor. He was the sun, and the tenderness he showed me was life-giving water.
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: You sleep okay, sweetie?” “Miss my teddy,” Billie replied. Personally, I thought Detective Mitch Lawson was far superior to a tiny pink teddy bear but I wasn’t six years old.
Author: Kristen Ashley,  Law Man

Quote: When I'm with you, bells go off in my head like a moving truck that's backing up.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Vanishing Acts

Quote: I think religion is a neurological disorder.
Author: Bill Maher

Quote: Virtually every writer I know would rather be a musician.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: Don't you wish you had a job like mine? All you have to do is think up a certain number of words! Plus, you can repeat words! And they don't even have to be true!
Author: Dave Barry

Quote: I want to replace my knees with miniature Rube Goldberg machines. That way you'll know how difficult it is for me to simply walk out of your life.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want Two apply for a job at our country's largest funeral home, and then wear a suit and noose to the job interview.

Quote: Our love was covered in fur, yet I was the only one who wanted to pet it.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: You've brushed your teeth,"He says, staring at me."I used your toothbrush."His lips quirk up in a half smile. "Oh Anastasia Steele, what am I going to do with you?
Author: E.L. James,  Fifty Shades of Grey

Quote: I want to write a book called, "Bonfires and Bras,"which follows around a young, braless feminist who struggles to adopt in air conditioned rooms, as her hardened nipples cause her excess embarrassment.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  I Want

Quote: I am always ready to learn although I do not always like being taught.
Author: Winston S. Churchill

Quote: You didn't need a college degree to become one of the people who knew what was really going on. If you paid attention, you could pick things up on your own.
Author: Jeannette Walls,  The Glass Castle

Quote: Who you are tomorrow begins with what you do today.
Author: Tim Fargo

Quote: We live in a system that espouses merit, equality, and a level playing field, but exalts those with wealth, power, and celebrity, however gained.
Author: Derrick A. Bell,  Ethical Ambition: Living a Life of Meaning and Worth

Quote: The heart has its reasons but the mind makes the excuses.
Author: Amit Abraham

Quote: The most fruitful and natural exercise for our minds is, in my opinion, conversation.
Author: Michel de Montaigne,  The Essays: A Selection

Quote: Just as in the body, eye and ear develop as organs of perception, as senses for bodily processes, so does a man develop in himself soul and spiritual organs of perception through which the soul and spiritual worlds are opened to him. For those who do not have such higher senses, these worlds are dark and silent, just as the bodily world is dark and silent for a being without eyes and ears.
Author: Rudolf Steiner,  Theosophy: An Introduction to the Spiritual Processes in Human Life and in the Cosmos

Quote: When you plant a seed of love, it is you that blossoms.
Author: Ma Jaya Sati Bhagavati,  The 11 Karmic Spaces: Choosing Freedom from the Patterns That Bind You

Quote: Science is all about proving theories and understanding the universe. Science folds everything into neat logical well-explained packages. The fey are magical capricious illogical and unexplainable. Science cannot prove the existence of faeries so naturally we do not exist. That type of nonbelief is fatal to faries.
Author: Julie Kagawa,  The Iron King

Quote: A blade of grass is a commonplace on Earth; it would be a miracle on Mars. Our descendants on Mars will know the value of a patch of green. And if a blade of grass is priceless, what is the value of a human being?
Author: Carl Sagan,  Pale Blue Dot: A Vision of the Human Future in Space

Quote: Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy started because of a thumb's up I gave to Douglas Adams on his birthday as I said, "Happy 42."#OutBoastKanye
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Rap music's been around for too long now to be inspirational. The words are, but the music isn't.
Author: Alexander McQueen

Quote: Success is the result of perfection, hard work, learning from failure, loyalty, and persistence.
Author: Colin Powell

Quote: Never contract friendship with a man that is not better than thyself.
Author: Confucius

Quote: It is better to create than to learn! Creating is the essence of life.
Author: Julius Caesar

Quote: He who has faith has... an inward reservoir of courage, hope, confidence, calmness, and assuring trust that all will come out well - even though to the world it may appear to come out most badly.
Author: B. C. Forbes

Quote: Any kind of novelty or excitement drives up dopamine in the brain, and dopamine is associated with romantic love.
Author: Helen Fisher

Quote: No heirloom of humankind captures the past as do art and language.
Author: Theodore Bikel

Quote: True humor springs not more from the head than from the heart. It is not contempt; its essence is love. It issues not in laughter, but in still smiles, which lie far deeper.
Author: Thomas Carlyle

Quote: A few years ago it dawned on me that everybody past a certain age ... pretty much constantly dreams of being able to escape from their lives. They don't want to be who they are any more. They want out. This list includes Thurston Howell the Third, Ann-Margret, the cat members of Rent, Václav Havel, space shuttle astronauts and Snuffleupagus. It's universal.
Author: Douglas Coupland,  The Gum Thief

Quote: Love expands your soul with something inexplicably fulfilling. If you die without ever having experienced it, you will miss life's only true joy
Author: Adele Ashworth,  Winter Garden

Author: Adele Ashworth,  Winter Garden

Quote: Just because you're scarred for life doesn't mean you should be scared to live.
Author: Brian Celio

Quote: Heaven is an idea constructed by man to help him cope with the fact that life on earth is both brutally short and, paradoxically, far too long.
Author: Andrew Davidson,  The Gargoyle

Quote: But he won’t let the pain blot out the humor no more’n he’ll let the humor blot out the pain.
Author: Ken Kesey,  One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

Quote: I look back to where my life had been. It's always risky to think of letting go. That's why this is the perfect ending. Nothing left to reconcile.
Author: Loretta Ellsworth,  In a Heartbeat

Quote: It is better to fill your head with useless knowledge than no knowledge at all.
Author: Jim Hinckley,  Route 66 Backroads: Your Guide to Scenic Side Trips & Adventures from the Mother Road

Quote: If you don't feel as close to God today as you did yesterday, who moved?
Author: Chris Heimerdinger,  Feathered Serpent, Part 1

Quote: People need not fear the unknown if they are capable of achieving what they need and want.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

Quote: Thinking only begins at the point where we have come to know that Reason, glorified for centuries, is the most obstinate adversary of thinking.
Author: Martin Heidegger

Author: Martin Heidegger

Quote: All things one has forgotten scream for help in dreams.
Author: Elias Canetti

Quote: Hearts can't be broken because they're made of marzipan.
Author: Kerstin Gier,  Smaragdgrün

Quote: Hearts can't be broken because they're made of marzipan.
Author: Kerstin Gier,  Smaragdgrün

Quote: The premise of the Taker story is 'the world belongs to man'. … The premise of the Leaver story is 'man belongs to the world'.
Author: Daniel Quinn,  Ishmael: An Adventure of the Mind and Spirit

Quote: Only those are fit to live who do not fear to die; and none are fit to die who have shrunk from the joy of life and the duty of life. Both life and death are parts of the same Great Adventure.
Author: Theodore Roosevelt

Quote: The best remedy for those who are afraid, lonely or unhappy is to go outside, somewhere where they can be quite alone with the heavens, nature and God.
Author: Anne Frank,  The Diary of a Young Girl

Quote: The world is your exercise book, the pages on which you do your sums. It is not reality, though you may express reality there if you wish. You are also free to write lies, or nonsense, or to tear the pages.
Author: Richard Bach,  Illusions: The Adventures of a Reluctant Messiah

Quote: Exuberance is beauty.
Author: William Blake

Quote: عندما تتأمل الوجود من حولك، انظر إليه كأنك تراه لأول مرة. إن الاعتياد على الأشياء التي حولنا يمثل حجابا بيننا وبين حقيقتها، يسمونه «حجاب الاعتياد».
Author: عمرو شريف,  رحلة عقل

Quote: There are heroisms all round us waiting to be done.
Author: Arthur Conan Doyle

Quote: Life is a journey, not a destination; there are no mistakes, just chances we've taken.
Author: India.Arie

Quote: Courage doesn't always roar. Sometimes courage is the quietvoice at the end of the day saying, "I will try again tomorrow.
Author: Mary Anne Radmacher

Quote: Almost everything that distinguishes the modern world from earlier centuries is attibutable to science, which achieved its most spectacular triumphs in the seventeenth century.
Author: Bertrand Russell,  A History of Western Philosophy

Quote: Almost everything that distinguishes the modern world from earlier centuries is attibutable to science, which achieved its most spectacular triumphs in the seventeenth century.
Author: Bertrand Russell,  A History of Western Philosophy

Quote: Work is a blessing. God has so arranged the world that work is necessary, and He gives us hands and strength to do it. The enjoyment of leisure would be nothing if we had only leisure. It is the joy of work well done that enables us to enjoy rest, just as it is the experiences of hunger and thirst that make food and drink such pleasures.
Author: Elisabeth Elliot,  Discipline: The Glad Surrender

Quote: Champions are made from something they have deep inside of them-a desire, a dream, a vison.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: when you came you cried and everybody smiled with joy; when you go smile and let the world cry for you.
Author: Rabindranath Tagore

Quote: when you came you cried and everybody smiled with joy; when you go smile and let the world cry for you.
Author: Rabindranath Tagore

Quote: Give the pupils something to do, not something to learn; and the doing is of such a nature as to demand thinking; learning naturally results.
Author: John Dewey

Quote: Leap and the net will appear
Author: John Burroughs

Quote: Sometimes... Reason and Love are met with a violent ignorance that even what's right gets lost. Our heart bleeds, but when does the blood shed end and the healing begin?
Author: Solange nicole

Quote: The thing is, it's really hard to be roommates with people if your suitcases are much better than theirs--if yours are really good ones and theirs aren't. You think if they're intelligent and all, the other person, and have a good sense of humor, that they don't give a damn whose suitcases are better, but they do. They really do.
Author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

Quote: At any given moment the choice to be happy is present- we just have to choose to be happy.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: At any given moment the choice to be happy is present- we just have to choose to be happy.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Much of what we called "depression"was really dissatisfaction, a result of setting a bar impossibly high or expecting treasures we weren't willing to work for.
Author: Mitch Albom,  Have a Little Faith: a True Story

Author: Mitch Albom,  Have a Little Faith: a True Story

Quote: Indeed there has never been any explanation of the ebb and flow in our veins--of happiness and unhappiness.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Jacob's Room

Quote: Happiness does not depend on outward circumstances, but on the state of the heart.
Author: J.C. Ryle,  A Call to Prayer

Quote: Free yourself from the burden of feeling the need to hold on to anything. Let go… you are a part of everything.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Free yourself from the burden of feeling the need to hold on to anything. Let go… you are a part of everything.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Each morning when I open my eyes I say to myself: I, not events, have the power to make me happy or unhappy today.
Author: Groucho Marx

Quote: Scared and sacred are spelled with the same letters. Awful proceeds from the same root word as awesome. Terrify and terrific. Every negative experience holds the seed of transformation.
Author: Alan Cohen

Quote: I find no importance in showing others that I am happy; it's not important to me that they know or think that I am happy but what is important to me is that I am happy. I am interested in being happy, not in making others think or know that I am.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Once you choose hope, anything's possible.
Author: Christopher Reeve

Quote: Our heaven is their hell, said God. I like a balanced universe.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  The Tent

Quote: Even the merest gesture is holy if it is filled with faith.
Author: Franz Kafka

Quote: I perceive God everywhere in His works. I sense Him in me; I see Him all around me.
Author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

Quote: I perceive God everywhere in His works. I sense Him in me; I see Him all around me.
Author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

Quote: Failure is a greater teacher than success
Author: Clarissa Pinkola Estés,  Women Who Run With the Wolves: Myths and Stories of the Wild Woman Archetype

Quote: God is the color of water. Water doesn't have a color.
Author: James McBride,  The Color of Water: A Black Man's Tribute to His White Mother

Author: James McBride,  The Color of Water: A Black Man's Tribute to His White Mother

Quote: Science can teach us, and I think our hearts can teach us, no longer to look around for imaginary supporters, no longer to invent allies in the sky, but rather to look to our own efforts here below to make the world a fit place to live.
Author: Bertrand Russell,  Why I Am Not a Christian and Other Essays on Religion and Related Subjects

Quote: Prayer will make a man cease from sin, or sin will entice a man to cease from prayer.
Author: John Bunyan

Quote: Not only had my brother disappeared, but--and bear with me here--a part of my very being had gone with him. Stories about us could, from them on, be told from only one perspective. Memories could be told but not shared.
Author: John Corey Whaley,  Where Things Come Back

Quote: I guess I just couldn't see standing there -- alive, talking, thinking, breathing, being -- one second, and dead the next. It really bothered me. Death by violence isn't the same as dying any other way, accident or disease or old age. It just ain't the same.
Author: S.E. Hinton,  That Was Then, This Is Now

Quote: More than anything, he wanted to return to the house with the same look of peace that he'd seen on Pastor Harris's face, but he trudged through the sand, he couldn't help feeling like an amateur, someone searching for God's truths like a child searching for seashells.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Last Song

Quote: Hope?” he says. “There is always hope, John. New developments have yet to present themselves. Not all the information is in. No. Don’t give up hope just yet. It’s the last thing to go. When you have lost hope, you have lost everything. And when you think all is lost, when all is dire and bleak, there is always hope.
Author: Pittacus Lore,  I Am Number Four

Quote: Aura, I'm really patient, but I'm not a bloody saint.
Author: Jeri Smith-Ready,  Shade

Quote: Aura, I'm really patient, but I'm not a bloody saint.
Author: Jeri Smith-Ready,  Shade

Quote: History dressed up in the glow of love’s kiss turned grief into beauty.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: They say that somewhere in Africa the elephants have a secret grave where they go to lie down, unburden their wrinkled gray bodies, and soar away, light spirits at the end.
Author: Robert McCammon,  Boy's Life

Quote: We suffer each other to have each other a while.
Author: Li-Young Lee

Quote: Poetry is the synthesis of hyacinths and biscuits.
Author: Carl Sandburg

Quote: So come to the pond, or the river of your imagination, or the harbor of your longing,and put your lips to the world.And live your life.
Author: Mary Oliver,  Red Bird

Quote: Sometimes, looking at the many books I have at home, I feel I shall die before I come to the end of them, yet I cannot resist the temptation of buying new books. Whenever I walk into a bookstore and find a book on one of my hobbies — for example, Old English or Old Norse poetry — I say to myself, “What a pity I can’t buy that book, for I already have a copy at home.
Author: Jorge Luis Borges,  This Craft of Verse

Quote: dealing with any man means dealing with multiple personalities.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Serpent's Shadow

Quote: He wanted to be a poet,' someone else put in while Maggie hugged Tim and patted his back. 'Said he'd only lacked the words to be one.
Author: Nora Roberts,  Born in Fire

Author: Nora Roberts,  Born in Fire

Quote: When I hear your name, I involuntarily clench my butt cheeks. Is that love? I don’t know—I’m not Nicholas Sparks.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Title is Invisible

Quote: Between Portland and Seattle is a mint factory, and they made sweets like we made sweet love, and America needs more manufacturers like us.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I wished the kiss could have gone on forever. Breaking the embrace, he ran a few fingers through my hair and down my cheek. He stepped back toward the door."I'll see you later, Roza""At our next practice?"I asked. "We are starting those up again, right? I mean, you still have things to teach me.""Yes. Lots of things.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Frostbite

Quote: The Night World isn't a place. It's all around us. The creatures of Night World are beautiful and deadly and irresitable to humans. Your best friend could be one-so could your crush.
Author: L.J. Smith

Quote: Here’s what I know: death abducts the dying, but grief steals from those left behind.
Author: Katherine Owen,  Seeing Julia

Quote: Come to think of it, she did not speak a word. Yet I could have sworn she had the most beautiful voice.
Author: Julie Klassen,  The Silent Governess

Quote: You don’t annoy me.” Carefully he rebuttoned the placket of her shirt. “I thought you did, at first. But now I realize it was more like the feeling you get when your foot’s been asleep. And when you start moving, the blood coming back into it is uncomfortable . . . but also good. Do you understand what I mean?”“Yes. I make your feet tingle.”A smile came to his lips. “Among other things.
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Love in the Afternoon

Quote: The argument goes something like this: "I refuse to prove that I exist,"says God, "for proof denies faith, and without faith I am nothing.
Author: Douglas Adams,  The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy

Quote: One can be absolutely truthful and sincere even though admittedly the most outrageous liar.
Author: Henry Miller

Quote: You have to salvage what you can, even if you're the one who buried it in the first place.
Author: Kelly Link,  Pretty Monsters: Stories

Quote: How quick and rushing life can sometimes seem, when at the same time it's so slow and sweet and everlasting.
Author: Graham Swift,  Tomorrow

Quote: Religion is what keeps the poor from murdering the rich.
Author: Napoléon Bonaparte

Quote: So many people will tell you ”no”, and you need to find something you believe in so hard that you just smile and tell them ”watch me”. Learn to take rejection as motivation to prove people wrong. Be unstoppable. Refuse to give up, no matter what. It’s the best skill you can ever learn.
Author: Charlotte Eriksson

Quote: Elevate your inside game. A negative attitude is below the horizon...a place for lonesome hearts.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: I...have always known that my destiny was, above all, a literary destiny — that bad things and some good things would happen to me, but that, in the long run, all of it would be convertedinto words. Particularly the bad things, since happiness does not need to be transformed: happiness is its own end.
Author: Jorge Luis Borges,  Seven Nights

Quote: A letter is always better than a phone call. People write things in letters they would never say in person. They permit themselves to write down feelings and observations using emotional syntax far more intimate and powerful than speech will allow.
Author: Alice Steinbach,  Educating Alice: Adventures of a Curious Woman

Quote: Being a writer is a good, good thing.
Author: Shannon Hale

Quote: Being a writer is a good, good thing.
Author: Shannon Hale

Quote: WHAT DO WE WANT?! PATIENCE! WHEN DO WE WANT IT?! NOW!
Author: Al Franken

Quote: Fashion does not have to prove that it is serious. It is the proof that intelligent frivolity can be something creative and positive
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Lack of confidence, sometimes alternating with unrealistic dreams of heroic success, often leads to procrastination, and many studies suggest that procrastinators are self-handicappers: rather than risk failure, they prefer to create conditions that make success impossible, a reflex that of course creates a vicious cycle.
Author: James Surowiecki

Quote: The secret to success is constancy of purpose.
Author: Benjamin Disraeli

Quote: Now I am going to reveal to you something which is very pure, a totally white thought. It is always in my heart; it blooms at each of my steps... The Dance is love, it is only love, it alone, and that is enough... I, then, it is amorously that I dance: to poems, to music but now I would like to no longer dance to anything but the rhythm of my soul.
Author: Isadora Duncan

Quote: NEVER be surprised by your own success!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Sidda can't help herself. She just loves books. Loves the way they feel, the way they smell, loves the black letters marching across the white pages...
Author: Rebecca Wells,  Little Altars Everywhere

Quote: Reading is important.Books are important.Librarians are important. (Also, libraries are not child-care facilities, but sometimes feral children raise themselves among the stacks.)
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: I took the volume to a table, opened its soft, ivory pages... and fell into it as into a pool during dry season.
Author: Janet Fitch,  White Oleander

Quote: I think it’s the books that you read when you’re young that live with you forever.
Author: J.K. Rowling

Quote: Without story books is like a person with no soul.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: The paperback is very interesting but I find it will never replace the hardcover book -- it makes a very poor doorstop.
Author: Alfred Hitchcock

Quote: Authors do not choose a story to write, the story chooses us.
Author: Richard P. Denney

Quote: I have my own theory: ignorance is bliss. The less you know, the more confident you can be in tackling things.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: I hate books; they only teach us to talk about things we know nothing about.
Author: Jean-Jacques Rousseau

Quote: The significant problems we have cannot be solved at the same level of thinking with which we created them.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: For masterpieces are not single and solitary births; they are the outcome of many years of thinking in common, of thinking by the body of the people, so that the experience of the mass is behind the single voice.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  A Room of One's Own

Quote: Some books are so familiar that reading them is like being home again.
Author: Louisa May Alcott

Quote: There are many horrible sights in the multiverse. Somehow, though, to a soul attuned to the subtle rhythms of a library, there are few worse sights than a hole where a book ought to be.Someone had stolen a book.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Guards! Guards!

Quote: The most beautiful experience we can have is the mysterious. It is the fundamental emotion that stands at the cradle of true art and true science. Whoever does not know it and can no longer wonder, is as good as dead, and his eyes are dimmed (Albert Einstein)
Author: Deborah Harkness,  A Discovery of Witches

Quote: The life of every individual, viewed as a whole and in general, and when only its most significant features are emphasized, is really a tragedy; but gone through in detail it has the character of a comedy.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer,  The World as Will and Representation, Vol 1

Quote: Maybe marriage, like life, isn't only about the big moments, whether they be good or bad. Maybe it's all the small things—like being guided slowly forward, surely, day after day—that stretches out to strengthen even the most tenuous bond.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  This Lullaby

Quote: Life is dear to every living thing; the worm that crawls upon the ground will struggle for it.
Author: Solomon Northup,  Twelve Years a Slave

Quote: If we do not find anything very pleasant, at least we shall find something new.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: Lena knew she had spent too much of her life in a state of passive dread, just waiting for something bad to happen. In a life like that, relief was as close as you got to happiness.
Author: Ann Brashares,  The Second Summer of the Sisterhood

Quote: I can do this… I can start over. I can save my own life and I’m never going to be alone as long as I have stars to wish on and people to still love.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: I am overwhelmed by the grace and persistence of my people.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: The best way to prepare for death is to live life to its fullest.
Author: John Bytheway

Quote: Beware of speaking too much, for it increases mistakes and engenders boredom.
Author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S

Quote: It is wisdom to recognize necessity when all other courses have been weighed, though as folly it may appear to those who cling to false hope.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Fellowship of the Ring

Quote: Although you may not stumble across a Martian in the garden, you might stumble across yourself. The day that happens, you'll probably also scream a little. And that'll be perfectly all right, because it's not every day you realize you're a living planet dweller on a little island in the universe.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  The Solitaire Mystery

Quote: To plant a garden is to believe in tomorrow.
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Quote: To plant a garden is to believe in tomorrow.
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Quote: Each of us is an innkeeper who decides if there is room for Jesus!
Author: Neal A. Maxwell

Quote: Science must not impose any philosophy, any more than the telephone must tell us what to say.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: Science must not impose any philosophy, any more than the telephone must tell us what to say.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: Be loved, be admired, be necessary; be somebody.
Author: Simone de Beauvoir,  Memoirs of a Dutiful Daughter

Quote: I never thought of it like that. I always thought of you as a part of me, like my own eyes or my own hands. You don't go around thinking 'I love my eyes, I love my hands', do you? But think what it would be like to live without your eyes or your hands. To be mad, or to be blind. I can't talk about it. It's how I feel.
Author: Elizabeth Marie Pope,  The Perilous Gard

Quote: Men ought either to be well treated or crushed, because they can avenge themselves of lighter injuries, of more serious ones they cannot; therefore the injury that is to be done to a man ought to be of such a kind that one does not stand in fear of revenge.
Author: Niccolò Machiavelli,  The Prince

Quote: It is not given to us to know what difference we can make, and perhaps we can make no difference at all. But that is no reason not to make the attempt,"said Saliman quietly. "The Light shines more brightly in the darkness.
Author: Alison Croggon,  The Crow

Quote: A student, filled with emotion and crying, implored, "Why is there so much suffering?"Suzuki Roshi replied, "No reason.
Author: Shunryu Suzuki,  Zen Is Right Here: Teaching Stories and Anecdotes of Shunryu Suzuki, Author of "ZEN Mind, Beginner's Mind"

Quote: Therefore do not deceive yourself! Of all deceivers fear most yourself!
Author: Søren Kierkegaard

Quote: For too many centuries women have been being muses to artists. I wanted to be the muse, I wanted to be the wife of the artist, but I was really trying to avoid the final issue — that I had to do the job myself.
Author: Anaïs Nin

Quote: Granny was an old-fashioned witch. She didn’t do good for people, she did right by them.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Carpe Jugulum

Quote: I've learned .... That when you harbor bitterness, happiness will dock elsewhere.
Author: Andy Rooney

Quote: Life is about balance. The good and the bad. The highs and the lows. The thing everyone should realize is that the key to happiness is being happy by yourself and for yourself. Happiness comes from within. You have the power to change your own mindset so that all the negative, horrible thoughts that try to invade your psyche are replaced with happy, positive, wonderful thoughts.
Author: Ellen DeGeneres,  Seriously... I'm Kidding

Quote: When you fail, that is when you get closer to success.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: When you fail, that is when you get closer to success.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: It’s not about working for money, it’s about having money work for you.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: It’s not about working for money, it’s about having money work for you.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: I'm not mean, I'm honest. Nobody is ever straightforward. But sometimes people need to hear the truth.
Author: Jessica Warman,  Breathless

Quote: How simple and frugal a thing is happiness: a glass of wine, a roast chestnut, a wretched little brazier, the sound of the sea. . . . All that is required to feel that here and now is happiness is a simple, frugal heart.
Author: Nikos Kazantzakis

Quote: Last weekend a young man asked me how I remain so positive. “It seems all the negativity in the world doesn’t affect you,” he said. I had no more than a minute with the young man so I offered this: It’s all about where you choose to put your attention, and I choose to be happy.
Author: Jason Mraz

Quote: There's a divinity that shapes our ends,Rough-hew them how we will.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Hamlet

Quote: God is the same, even though He has a thousand names; it is up to us to select a name for Him.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept

Quote: When you are down to nothing, God is up to somethng. It is up to you to reach out to find what God is up to for you.
Author: Robert Schuler

Quote: There is hope in forgiveness
Author: John Piper,  A Sweet and Bitter Providence: Sex, Race, and the Sovereignty of God

Quote: Death? Why all this fuss about death? Use your imagination, try to visualize a world without death! Death is the essential condition to life, not an evil.
Author: Charlotte Perkins Gilman

Quote: Nevertheless, life and death are mysterious states, and we know little of the resources of either.
Author: Joseph Sheridan Le Fanu,  Carmilla

Quote: Belief doesn't rest on proof or existence...it rests on faith...without faith there is nothing.
Author: Colleen McCullough,  The Thorn Birds

Quote: You do not need to work to become spiritual. You are spiritual; you need only to remember that fact. Spirit is within you. God is within you. (67)
Author: Julia Cameron,  God is No Laughing Matter

Quote: Was there ever a more horrible blasphemy than the statement that all the knowledge of God is confined to this or that book? How dare men call God infinite, and yet try to compress Him within the covers of a little book!
Author: Swami Vivekananda,  Raja-Yoga

Quote: Was there ever a more horrible blasphemy than the statement that all the knowledge of God is confined to this or that book? How dare men call God infinite, and yet try to compress Him within the covers of a little book!
Author: Swami Vivekananda,  Raja-Yoga

Quote: I found my God in music and the arts, with writers like Hermann Hesse, and musicians like Muddy Waters, Howlin' Wolf, and Little Walter. In some way, in some form, my God was always there, but now I have learned to talk to him.
Author: Eric Clapton

Quote: But he was pierced for our transgressions,  he was crushed for our iniquities;  the punishment that brought us peace was upon him,  and by his wounds we are healed.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: For to fear death, my friends, is only to think ourselves wise without really being wise, for it is to think that we know what we do not know. For no one knows whether death may not be the greatest good that can happen to man.
Author: Plato,  Apology

Quote: O Allah, You know me better than I know myself, and I know myself better than these people who praise me. Make me better than what they think of me, and forgive those sins of mine of which they have no knowledge, and do not hold me responsible for what they say.
Author: Abu Bakr al-Siddiq

Quote: youth is easily deceived because it is quick to hope.
Author: Aristotle

Quote: The only true borders lie between day and night, between life and death, between hope and loss.
Author: Erin Hunter

Quote: Death always wins.
Author: Kelly Creagh,  Nevermore

Quote: ...the dead have a way of becoming saints in the eyes of their survivors...
Author: Rachel Vincent,  My Soul to Take

Quote: Faith is not the clinging to a shrine but an endless pilgrimage of the heart.
Author: Abraham Joshua Heschel

Quote: ‎"If there is no God, then man and the universe are doomed. Like prisoners condemned to death, we await our unavoidable execution. There is no God, and there is no immortality. And what is the consequence of this? It means that life itself is absurd. It means that the life we have is without ultimate significance, value, or purpose.
Author: William Lane Craig,  Reasonable Faith

Quote: ‎"If there is no God, then man and the universe are doomed. Like prisoners condemned to death, we await our unavoidable execution. There is no God, and there is no immortality. And what is the consequence of this? It means that life itself is absurd. It means that the life we have is without ultimate significance, value, or purpose.
Author: William Lane Craig,  Reasonable Faith

Quote: As our circle of knowledge expands, so does the circumference of darkness surrounding it.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: And a new philosophy emerged called quantum physics, which suggest that the individual’s function is to inform and be informed. You really exist only when you’re in a field sharing and exchanging information. You create the realities you inhabit.
Author: Timothy Leary,  Chaos & Cyber Culture

Quote: And a new philosophy emerged called quantum physics, which suggest that the individual’s function is to inform and be informed. You really exist only when you’re in a field sharing and exchanging information. You create the realities you inhabit.
Author: Timothy Leary,  Chaos & Cyber Culture

Quote: You are an Universe of Universes and your soul a source of songs.
Author: Rubén Darío

Quote: You are an Universe of Universes and your soul a source of songs.
Author: Rubén Darío

Quote: You are an Universe of Universes and your soul a source of songs.
Author: Rubén Darío

Quote: Perhaps love is a minor madness. And as with madness, it's unendurable alone. The one person who can relieve us is of course the sole person we cannot go to: the one we love. So instead we seek out allies, even among strangers and wives, fellow patients who, if they can't touch the edge of our particular sorrow, have felt something that cuts nearly as deep.
Author: Andrew Sean Greer,  The Story of a Marriage

Quote: Many much-learned men have no intelligence.
Author: Democritus

Quote: come back so i can say yes this time do it again now that i know what to call what you didthis time i'll be ready i like it rough now and i'm done with romance i never met another man who loved me so much at first sight he had to hurt me to do it
Author: Daphne Gottlieb,  Why Things Burn

Quote: I never tell my boyfriend that I'm busy when I'm not. No matter how effective they are, cheap techniques like that just don't agree with me. So it's always okay, it's always all right. In my opinion the surest way to hook a man is to be as open with him as possible.
Author: Banana Yoshimoto,  Asleep

Quote: It's as if every conversation with a woman was a test, and men always failed it, because they always lacked the key to the code and so they never quite understood what the conversation was really about.
Author: Orson Scott Card,  Enchantment

Quote: She leaned into me, and when I closed my eyes, I knew I wanted nothing more than to hold her this way forever.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  Dear John

Quote: Sometimes limbs must be re-broken to set properly, her heart too needed to shatter anew before it could truly heal.
Author: Sherry Thomas,  Not Quite a Husband

Quote: Writing about music is like dancing about architecture - it's really a stupid thing to want to do.
Author: Elvis Costello

Quote: الناس يصرون علي رؤيتي علي صوره تخالف تماما ما أنا عليه و إنهم لن يروا أبدا في مكاني سوي الشخص الذي صاغوه لأنفسهم وشكلوه وفق هواهم ليكرهوه كما يشاءون ، و إذن فإنني أكون مخطئا لو أنني تأثرت من الطريقه التي يرونني بها إذ لا يجب أن أعيرها أي اهتمام حقيقي لأنني لست أنا من يرونه علي هذه الصوره!
Author: جان جاك روسو

Quote: What is the purpose of writing? For me personally, it is really to explain the mystery of life, and the mystery of life includes, of course, the personal, the political, the forces that make us what we are while there's another force from inside battling to make us something else.
Author: Nadine Gordimer

Quote: You look angry,"he said."You put me on hold.""For a very good reason.""You put me,"she said very, very slowly, "on hold.
Author: Derek Landy,  Kingdom of the Wicked

Quote: A mind possessed by unmade books.
Author: Michael Faudet

Quote: The fact that you are still alive assures you that God has something for you to accomplish.
Author: Rodney A. Winters,  Go Into the House

Quote: The fact that you are still alive assures you that God has something for you to accomplish.
Author: Rodney A. Winters,  Go Into the House

Quote: You’re far too prickly tempered to be a mistress. You’re far better suited as a wife.
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Married By Morning

Quote: Hatsuharu Sohma: [after tripping Kyo] If I hadn't had tripped you, you wouldn't have stopped now would you.[addressing the audience]Hatsuharu Sohma: By the way what I just did was very dangerous. And if it had been anyone but Kyo they probably would have been hurt pretty badly, so don't try it at home.Kyo Sohma: Don't try it here and who are you even talking to?
Author: Natsuki Takaya

Quote: In the end, fiction is the craft of telling truth through lies.
Author: Lauren Groff

Quote: one does not only wish to be understood when one writes; one wishes just as surely not to be understood.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: And so that means...""We have to rob the Henley,"Simon said.Kat sank onto a truly uncomfortable sofa. "Again.
Author: Ally Carter,  Perfect Scoundrels

Quote: Fortunate are those who take the first steps.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  By the River Piedra I Sat Down and Wept

Quote: The finest thing under the sun and moon is the human soul. I marvel at the small miracles of kindness that pass between humans, I marvel at the growth of conscience, at the persistence of reason in the face of all superstition or despair. I marvel at human endurance.
Author: Anne Rice,  Pandora

Quote: Ours is a world of nuclear giants and ethical infants. We know more about war than we know about peace, more about killing than we know about living. We have grasped the mystery of the atom and rejected the Sermon on the Mount.
Author: Omar Nelson Bradley

Quote: In a very real sense we have two minds, one that thinks and one that feels
Author: Daniel Goleman,  Emotional Intelligence: Why It Can Matter More Than IQ

Quote: Buying a book is not about obtaining a possession, but about securing a portal.
Author: Laura Miller,  The Magician's Book: A Skeptic's Adventures in Narnia

Quote: I know many books which have bored their readers, but I know of none which has done real evil.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: I am very conscious of who I am as an artist and as an inspirational person.
Author: R. Kelly

Quote: My mother was the most beautiful woman I ever saw. All I am I owe to my mother. I attribute all my success in life to the moral, intellectual and physical education I received from her.
Author: George Washington

Quote: My mother was the most beautiful woman I ever saw. All I am I owe to my mother. I attribute all my success in life to the moral, intellectual and physical education I received from her.
Author: George Washington

Quote: There is some self-interest behind every friendship. There is no friendship without self-interests. This is a bitter truth.
Author: Chanakya

Quote: Today is life-the only life you are sure of. Make the most of today. Get interested in something. Shake yourself awake. Develop a hobby. Let the winds of enthusiasm sweep through you. Live today with gusto.
Author: Dale Carnegie

Quote: Middle age is when you're sitting at home on a Saturday night and the telephone rings and you hope it isn't for you.
Author: Ogden Nash

Quote: I was lucky enough to be fairly quick at understanding what was taught, but unlucky enough not to be really interested in it, so I always got my exams but never had the scholar's love of learning for its own sake.
Author: Maeve Binchy

Quote: Contrary to general belief, an artist is never ahead of his time but most people are far behind theirs.
Author: Edgard Varese

Quote: Two young actresses I admire are Emma Stone and Emma Watson, because they are intelligent, talented actresses and have a great sense of humor. They have learned to balance what they love in life - acting, school and everything else.
Author: Kara Hayward

Quote: It’s very simple. As you grow, you learn more. If you stayed at twenty-two, you’d always be as ignorant as you were at twenty-two. Aging is not just decay, you know. It’s growth. It’s more than the negative that you’re going to die, it’s also the positive that you understand you’re going to die, and that you live a better life because of it.
Author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

Quote: Sometimes it seemed to him that his life was delicate as a dandelion. One little puff from any direction, and it was blown to bits.
Author: Katherine Paterson,  Bridge to Terabithia

Quote: To treat a person like a carpet, it is necessary that one do the walking, and one allow himself to be walked on.--Shin'a'in saying
Author: Mercedes Lackey,  Owlflight

Quote: Live for each second without hesitation
Author: Elton John

Quote: Arrogance on the part of the meritorious is even more offensive to us than the arrogance of those without merit: for merit itself is offensive.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: We sinned for no reason but an incomprehensible lack of love, and He saved us for no reason but an incomprehensible excess of love.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: We sinned for no reason but an incomprehensible lack of love, and He saved us for no reason but an incomprehensible excess of love.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: We sinned for no reason but an incomprehensible lack of love, and He saved us for no reason but an incomprehensible excess of love.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: All paths are the same: they lead nowhere. ... Does this path have a heart? If it does, the path is good; if it doesn't, it is of no use. Both paths lead nowhere; but one has a heart, the other doesn't. One makes for a joyful journey; as long as you follow it, you are one with it. The other will make you curse your life. One makes you strong; the other weakens you.
Author: Carlos Castaneda,  The Teachings of Don Juan: A Yaqui Way of Knowledge

Quote: He wept because he was afraid now that he could not save Gabriel. He no longer cared about himself
Author: Lois Lowry,  The Giver

Quote: The Universe doesn't like secrets. It conspires to reveal the truth, to lead you to it.
Author: Lisa Unger,  Beautiful Lies

Quote: The Universe doesn't like secrets. It conspires to reveal the truth, to lead you to it.
Author: Lisa Unger,  Beautiful Lies

Quote: How could they see anything but the shadows if they were never allowed to move their heads?
Author: Plato,  The Allegory of the Cave

Quote: The man who alters his way of thinking to suit others is a fool.
Author: Marquis de Sade,  Justine, Philosophy in the Bedroom, and Other Writings

Quote: There's no reason to have a plan B because it distracts from plan A.
Author: Will Smith

Quote: There's no reason to have a plan B because it distracts from plan A.
Author: Will Smith

Quote: Forget yourself and go to work.
Author: Bryant S. Hinckley

Quote: To accomplish great things, we must not only act but also dream, not only plan, but also believe!
Author: Anatole France

Quote: Dislike in yourself what you dislike in others.
Author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S

Quote: By what men think, we create the world around us, daily new.
Author: Marion Zimmer Bradley,  The Mists of Avalon

Quote: By what men think, we create the world around us, daily new.
Author: Marion Zimmer Bradley,  The Mists of Avalon

Quote: It doesn't matter who you are, where you come from. The ability to triumph begins with you - always.
Author: Oprah Winfrey

Quote: Friends are like bras, attached near your heart for support. Foes are like panties, deported, every now and then, when they get dirty.
Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

Quote: Friends are like bras, attached near your heart for support. Foes are like panties, deported, every now and then, when they get dirty.
Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

Quote: People ought to fight to keep their law as to defend the citys walls.
Author: Heraclitus,  Fragments

Quote: People ought to fight to keep their law as to defend the citys walls.
Author: Heraclitus,  Fragments

Quote: In the end mortals always expired before faeries. They were such finite creatures. Their first heartbeat and breath were but a blink from death. To add the weight of nourishing his insatiable court in a time of peace was to hasten that unconscionably.
Author: Melissa Marr,  Ink Exchange

Quote: as soon as we renounce fiction and illusion, we lose reality itself; the moment we subtract fictions from reality, reality itself loses its discursive-logical consistency.
Author: Slavoj Žižek,  Tarrying with the Negative: Kant, Hegel, and the Critique of Ideology

Quote: Who is to decide which is the grimmer sight: withered hearts, or empty skulls?
Author: Honoré de Balzac,  Père Goriot

Quote: Because philosophy arises from awe, a philosopher is bound in his way to be a lover of myths and poetic fables. Poets and philosophers are alike in being big with wonder.
Author: Thomas Aquinas

Quote: Because philosophy arises from awe, a philosopher is bound in his way to be a lover of myths and poetic fables. Poets and philosophers are alike in being big with wonder.
Author: Thomas Aquinas

Quote: Wise men, when in doubt whether to speak or to keep quiet, give themselves the benefit of the doubt, and remain silent.
Author: Napoleon Hill

Quote: I wish I had never been born,"she said. "What are we born for?""For infinite happiness,"said the Spirit. "You can step out into it at any moment...
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Great Divorce

Quote: The lessons of life amount not to wisdom, but to scar tissue and callus.
Author: Wallace Stegner,  The Spectator Bird

Quote: Experience teaches us that it is much easier to prevent an enemy from posting themselves than it is to dislodge them after they have got possession.
Author: George Washington

Quote: I like living in my head because in there, everyone is kind and innocent. Once you start integrating yourself into the world, you realize that people are nasty, mean creatures. They're worse than zombies. People try to crush your soul and destroy your happiness, but zombies just want to have a little nibble of your brain.
Author: J. Cornell Michel,  Jordan's Brains: A Zombie Evolution

Quote: If you're not making someone else's life better, then you're wasting your time. Your life will become better by making other lives better.
Author: Will Smith

Quote: ...we will stand amazed to see the topside of the tapestry and how God beautifully embroidered each circumstance into a pattern for our good and His glory.
Author: Joni Eareckson Tada

Quote: Truthfulness so often goes with ruthlessness.
Author: Dodie Smith,  I Capture the Castle

Quote: The most wonderful and the strongest things in the world, you know, are just the things which no one can see.
Author: Charles Kingsley,  The Water-Babies

Quote: I remember watching it all and getting the tickling in my chest and thinking to myself: This is what happiness feels like.
Author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

Quote: Have you noticed how nobody ever looks up? Nobody looks at chimneys, or trees against the sky, or the tops of buildings. Everybody just looks down at the pavement or their shoes. The whole world could pass them by and most people wouldn't notice.
Author: Julie Andrews Edwards,  The Last of the Really Great Whangdoodles

Quote: If you are neutral in situations of injustice, you have chosen the side of the oppressor.
Author: Desmond Tutu

Quote: If you are neutral in situations of injustice, you have chosen the side of the oppressor.
Author: Desmond Tutu

Quote: Ignorance is hardly unusual, Miss Davar. The longer I live, the more I come to realize that it is the natural state of the human mind. There are many who will strive to defend its sanctity and then expect you to be impressed with their efforts.
Author: Brandon Sanderson,  The Way of Kings

Quote: Ignorance is hardly unusual, Miss Davar. The longer I live, the more I come to realize that it is the natural state of the human mind. There are many who will strive to defend its sanctity and then expect you to be impressed with their efforts.

Quote: At times the whole world seems to be in conspiracy to importune you with emphatic trifles. Friend, client, child, sickness, fear, want, charity, all knock at once at thy closet door and say,—'Come out unto us.' But keep thy state; come not into their confusion. The power men possess to annoy me I give them by a weak curiosity. No man can come near me but through my act.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  The Essays of Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: To know you are ignorant is the beginning of wisdom.
Author: Marion Zimmer Bradley

Quote: I can only say that I am nothing but a poor sinner, trusting in Christ alone for salvation.
Author: Robert E. Lee

Quote: I can only say that I am nothing but a poor sinner, trusting in Christ alone for salvation.
Author: Robert E. Lee

Quote: I know now, after fifty years, that the finding/losing, forgetting/remembering, leaving/returning, never stops. The whole of life is about another chance, and while we are alive, till the very end, there is always another chance.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Why Be Happy When You Could Be Normal?

Quote: Failure is just part of the process, and it's not just okay; it's better than okay. God doesn't want failure to shut us down. God didn't make it a three-strikes-and-you're-out sort of thing. It's more about how God helps us dust ourselves off so we can swing for the fences again. And all of this without keeping a meticulous record of our screw-ups.
Author: Bob Goff,  Love Does: Discover a Secretly Incredible Life in an Ordinary World

Quote: Like when you sit in front of a fire in winter — you are just there in front of the fire. You don't have to be smart or anything. The fire warms you.
Author: Desmond Tutu

Quote: Like when you sit in front of a fire in winter — you are just there in front of the fire. You don't have to be smart or anything. The fire warms you.
Author: Desmond Tutu

Quote: Nobody wants to look like a fool. Nine times out of ten, thatreason alone keeps people from allowing themselves to believe.
Author: Darynda Jones,  First Grave on the Right

Quote: He was a wise man who invented God.
Author: Plato

Quote: He was a wise man who invented God.
Author: Plato

Quote: I've changed my ways a little, I cannot nowRun with you in the evenings along the shore,Except in a kind of dream, and you, if you dream a moment,You see me there.
Author: Robinson Jeffers

Quote: I know too well how dangerous hope can be, how it grows and sometimes dies, taking its host with it. It's more powerful than anything Dr.Fibs keeps in his labs, more precious than all the secrets inside Sublevel Two.
Author: Ally Carter,  Only the Good Spy Young

Quote: I know too well how dangerous hope can be, how it grows and sometimes dies, taking its host with it. It's more powerful than anything Dr.Fibs keeps in his labs, more precious than all the secrets inside Sublevel Two.
Author: Ally Carter,  Only the Good Spy Young

Quote: Conscious faith is freedom. Emotional faith is slavery. Mechanical faith is foolishness.
Author: G.I. Gurdjieff

Quote: When you see people only as personalities, rather than souls with life missions to fulfill, you forever limit the growth and possibilities of what God has in store for another person.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Alas, how terrible is wisdomwhen it brings no profit to the man that's wise!This I knew well, but had forgotten it,else I would not have come here.
Author: Sophocles,  Oedipus Rex

Quote: You talk when you cease to be at peace with your thoughts;And when you can no longer dwell in the solitude of your heart you live in your lips, and sound is a diversion and a pastime.And in much of your talking, thinking is half murdered.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: ...if you do not even understand what words say,how can you expect to pass judgementon what words conceal?
Author: H.D.,  Trilogy: The Walls Do Not Fall / Tribute to the Angels / The Flowering of the Rod

Quote: Since then, at an uncertain hour, That agony returns: And till my ghastly tale is told, This heart within me burns.
Author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge,  The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

Quote: Being human means throwing your whole life on the scales of destiny when need be, all the while rejoicing in every sunny day and every beautiful cloud.
Author: Rosa Luxemburg

Quote: Terkadang,yang tak bisa kamu lupakan adalah seseorang yang tak pernah bisa kamu miliki.
Author: Christian Simamora,  All You Can Eat

Quote: Terkadang,yang tak bisa kamu lupakan adalah seseorang yang tak pernah bisa kamu miliki.
Author: Christian Simamora,  All You Can Eat

Quote: Sonetimes the hardest person to forgive is yourself.
Author: Sarah Sundin

Quote: Looks like Kelsey wins the award for early riser. And doesn’t she look purtier than a pat of butter meltin’ all over a stack of griddle cakes?
Author: Colleen Houck

Quote: I dodged behind Mac for cover and refused to take the bait. I glanced at my nonexistent watch. 'Oops, look at the time. Guess I have to be going now. Let's not do this again sometime, okay?'Before I could move, Pritkin was there, jamming the medallion into the skin of my upper arm.'Ow!'He looked at me expectantly. I glared at him. 'That hurt!'What do you see?'A big red mark,
Author: Karen Chance,  Claimed By Shadow

Quote: I was hugely impressed... was the ultimate example of a man who knew what he didn't know, was perfectly willing to admit it, and didn't want to leave until he understood. That's heroic to me. I wish every grad student had that attitude.
Author: Randy Pausch,  The Last Lecture

Quote: Aubrey, crouching on a nearby counter, watched me with squinty eyes, apparently pondering why anyone would willingly immerse themselves in water ever, let alone for extended periods of time.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Succubus Blues

Quote: A good book isn't written, it's rewritten.
Author: Phyllis A. Whitney,  Guide to Fiction Writing

Quote: I write because I must. It's not a choice or a pastime, it's an unyeilding calling and my passion.
Author: Elizabeth Reyes

Quote: An author in his book must be like God in the universe, present everywhere and visible nowhere.
Author: Gustave Flaubert

Quote: Write,' she said, 'as if you'll never be read. That way you'll be sure to tell the truth.
Author: Lori Lansens,  The Girls

Quote: Buddha had said:"Each of us is a God. Each of us knows all. We need only open our minds to hear our own wisdom.
Author: Dan Brown,  Angels & Demons

Quote: I decided that it was not wisdom that enabled [poets] to write their poetry, but a kind of instinct or inspiration, such as you find in seers and prophets who deliver all their sublime messages without knowing in the least what they mean.
Author: Socrates

Quote: Those who would renegotiate the boundaries between church and state must therefore answer a difficult question: why would we trade a system that has served us so well for one that has served others so poorly?
Author: Sandra Day O'Connor

Quote: A person who publishes a book willfully appears before the populace with his pants down. If it is a good book nothing can hurt him. If it is a bad book nothing can help him.
Author: Edna St. Vincent Millay

Quote: Betrayal and dishonor is usually an inside job. Keep it 'sucka-free', loved one!
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: The worst moment for the atheist is when he is really thankful and has nobody to thank.
Author: Dante Gabriel Rossetti

Quote: Don't measure the size of the mountain; talk to the One who can move it.
Author: Max Lucado

Quote: No,” Shane said. “I’m not leaving you two here alone. We stick together.”“I’m still not kissing you,” Michael said.“Tease.
Author: Rachel Caine,  Last Breath

Quote: CPR dummy looked like him and had clearly been stabbed. Repeatedly. In the groin. He thought she might have used the dummy for target practice, and tried not to be offended. Key word: tried.
Author: Gena Showalter,  The Darkest Secret

Quote: Read everything. Read fiction and non-fiction, read hot best sellers and the classics you never got around to in college.
Author: Jennifer Weiner

Quote: Writing is really a way of thinking--not just feeling but thinking about things that are disparate, unresolved, mysterious, problematic or just sweet.
Author: Toni Morrison

Quote: We may place blame, give reasons, and even have excuses; but in the end, it is an act of cowardice to not follow your dreams.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: Education: the inculcation of the incomprehensible into the indifferent by the incompetent.
Author: John Maynard Keynes

Quote: It is the mark of a truly educated man to know what not to read.
Author: Ezra Taft Benson

Quote: We must be careful not to discourage our twelve-year-olds by making them waste the best years of their lives preparing for examinations.
Author: Freeman Dyson,  Infinite in All Directions

Quote: It is a common condition of being poor...you are always afraid that the good things in your life are temporary, that someone can take them away, because you have no power beyond your own brute strength to stop them.
Author: Rick Bragg

Quote: There's no need to curse God if you're an ugly duckling. He chooses those strong enough to endure it so that they can guide others who've felt the same.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: I like trains. I like their rhythm, and I like the freedom of being suspended between two places, all anxieties of purpose taken care of: for this moment I know where I am going.
Author: Anna Funder,  Stasiland: Stories from Behind the Berlin Wall

Quote: Be above it! Make the world serve your purpose, but do not serve it!
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: Lord help my poor soul.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: When the mind is exhausted of images, it invents its own.
Author: Gary Snyder,  Earth House Hold

Quote: There is nothing more important to true growth than realizing that you are not the voice of the mind - you are the one who hears it.
Author: Michael A. Singer,  The Untethered Soul: The Journey Beyond Yourself

Quote: Eyes can only capture objects that already seen in mind.And mind can only see things that already written in heart.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Even bad books are books and therefore sacred.
Author: Günter Grass,  The Tin Drum

Quote: How many cities have revealed themselves to me in the marches I undertook in the pursuit of books!
Author: Walter Benjamin,  Illuminations: Essays and Reflections

Quote: We buy books because we believe we're buying the time to read them.[Inside Out (VH1)]
Author: Warren Zevon

Quote: Always think extra hard before crossing over to a bad side, if you were weak enough to cross over, you may not be strong enough to cross back!
Author: Victoria Addino

Quote: As we expand our knowledge of good books, we shrink the circle of men whose company we appreciate.
Author: Ludwig Feuerbach

Quote: Science is what we understand well enough to explain to a computer; art is everything else.
Author: Donald Ervin Knuth,  Things a Computer Scientist Rarely Talks About

Quote: There are good books which are only for adults.There are no good books which are only for children.
Author: W.H. Auden

Quote: Hard-covered books break up friendships. You loan a hard covered book to a friend and when he doesn’t return it you get mad at him. It makes you mean and petty. But twenty-five cent books are different.
Author: John Steinbeck

Quote: Life, it turns out, goes on. There is no cosmic rule that grants you immunity from the details just because you have come face-to-face with a catastrophe. The garbage can still overflow, the bills arrive in the mail, telemarketers, interrupt dinner.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Perfect Match

Quote: Hide your craziness behind a beautiful smile. That's all you need.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Sometimes, some lies that spoken with high confidencecould be more receptive than facts that spoken with doubt.
Author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

Quote: Sometimes, some lies that spoken with high confidencecould be more receptive than facts that spoken with doubt.
Author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

Quote: That is the challenge Companion. To take what has happened to you and learn from it. Nothing is quite so destructive as pity, especially self-pity. No event in life is so terrible that one cannot rise above it.
Author: Robin Hobb,  Ship of Destiny

Quote: Life is a dream for the wise, a game for the fool, a comedy for the rich, a tragedy for the poor.
Author: Sholem Aleichem

Quote: Mr. Smith yelled at the doctor,What have you done to my boy?He's not flesh and blood,he's aluminum alloy!"The doctor said gently,What I'm going to saywill sound pretty wild.But you're not the father of this strange looking child.You see, there still is some questionabout the child's gender,but we think that its fatheris a microwave blender.
Author: Tim Burton,  The Melancholy Death of Oyster Boy and Other Stories

Quote: Your nightmares follow you like a shadow, forever.
Author: Aleksandar Hemon,  The Lazarus Project

Quote: Applaud my idiocy.
Author: Conan O'Brien

Quote: Because saving the people you love isn't stupid. It isn't even a choice
Author: Kami Garcia,  Beautiful Chaos

Quote: Never let yourself be persuaded that any one Great Man, any one leader, is necessary to the salvation of America. When America consists of one leader and 158 million followers, it will no longer be America.
Author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

Quote: The truth always carries the ambiguity of the words used to express it.
Author: Frank Herbert,  God Emperor of Dune

Quote: The truth always carries the ambiguity of the words used to express it.
Author: Frank Herbert,  God Emperor of Dune

Quote: Forget the place you're trying to get to and see the beauty in right now...
Author: Evanescence

Quote: Forget the place you're trying to get to and see the beauty in right now...
Author: Evanescence

Quote: Money can't buy happiness, but it certainly is a stress reliever.
Author: Besa Kosova

Quote: Money can't buy happiness, but it certainly is a stress reliever.
Author: Besa Kosova

Quote: We are all flawed, my dear. Every one of us. And believe me, we've all made mistakes. You've just got to take a good hard look at yourself, change what needs to be changed, and move one, pet.
Author: Lauren Myracle,  Let It Snow

Quote: Light is more important than the lantern,The poem more important than the notebook
Author: Nizar Qabbani

Quote: I hope you find true meaning, contentment, and passion in your life. I hope you navigate the difficult times and come out with greater strength and resolve. I hope you find whatever balance you seek with your eyes wide open. And I hope that you - yes, you - have the ambition to lean in to your career and run the world. Because the world needs you to change it.
Author: Sheryl Sandberg,  Lean In: Women, Work, and the Will to Lead

Quote: The Highest Thought is always that thought which contains joy. The Clearest Words are those words which contain truth. The Grandest Feeling is that feeling which you call love.
Author: Neale Donald Walsch

Quote: A wise man always has something to say, whereas a fool always needs to say something.
Author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S

Quote: A wise man always has something to say, whereas a fool always needs to say something.
Author: Hazrat Ali Ibn Abu-Talib A.S

Quote: Every search begins with beginner’s luck. And every search ends with the victor’s being severely tested.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: It’s funny, for all it took was a broken heart and that alone was enough, enough for her to do everything she ever dreamed of.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: Gradually the healing took place, seeming as it always does that it wasn't taking place.
Author: Ursula K. Le Guin

Quote: The first thing you have to know about writing is that it is something you must do everyday. There are two reasons for this rule: Getting the work done and connecting with your unconscious mind.
Author: Walter Mosley

Quote: Do not neglect to show hospitality to strangers, for by doing that some have entertained angels without knowing it.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: So much for endings. Beginnings are always more fun. True connoisseurs, however, are known to favor the stretch in between, since it's the hardest to do anything with. That's about all that can be said for plots, which anyway are just one thing after another, a what and a what and a what.
Author: Margaret Atwood

Quote: It's what you learn after you know it all that counts.
Author: John Wooden

Quote: So that the new generation that will be born can enjoy happiness. To pay the cost we will have to shoulder corpses and cross a river of blood(Riza Hawkeye -- Fullmetal Alchemist)
Author: Hiromu Arakawa

Quote: There are 10,000 books in my library, and it will keep growing until I die. This has exasperated my daughters, amused my friends and baffled my accountant. If I had not picked up this habit in the library long ago, I would have more money in the bank today; I would not be richer.
Author: Pete Hamill

Quote: How can a society that exists on instant mashed potatoes, packaged cake mixes, frozen dinners, and instant cameras teach patience to its young?
Author: Paul Sweeney

Quote: Your life begins to change the day you take responsibility for it.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Author: Dirk Wittenborn,  Fierce People

Author: Dirk Wittenborn,  Fierce People

Quote: When you stop existing and you start truly living, each moment of the day comes alive with the wonder and synchronicity.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Scholars, theologians, and even poets have yet to be able to truly describe and touch upon the beauty, romance, and magic of a relationship built on 100% authenticity
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: I am so wise I had my mouth sewn shut.
Author: John Berryman

Quote: Knowledge is merely brilliance in organization of ideas and not wisdom. The truly wise person goes beyond knowledge.
Author: Confucius

Quote: The primary cause of unhappiness is never the situation, but you thoughts about it. Be aware of the thoughts you are thinking.
Author: Eckhart Tolle,  A New Earth: Awakening to Your Life's Purpose

Quote: Even if happiness forgets you a little bit, never completely forget about it.
Author: Jacques Prévert

Quote: Yes, I want money more than anything else in the world.”“Then you’ve made the only choice. But there’s a penalty attached, as there is to most things you want. It’s loneliness.
Author: Margaret Mitchell,  Gone With the Wind

Quote: Truth does not sit in a cave and hide like a lie. It wanders around proudly and roars loudly like a lion.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: But my memories are like a fire in winter—whenever I'm cold I can warm my hands at them.—Ditta
Author: Madeleine L'Engle,  The Joys of Love

Quote: They're just words. And words alone don't really mean anything. It's what you feel and what you believe when you say them that matter.
Author: Dana Reinhardt,  How to Build a House

Quote: Sex is mathematics. Individuality no longer an issue. What does intelligence signify? Define reason. Desire - meaningless. Intellect is not a cure. Justice is dead.
Author: Bret Easton Ellis

Quote: I've heard it said that God is in the details. It's the same with the truth. Leave out the details, the crucial heart, and you can damn someone with the bare bones of it.
Author: Libba Bray,  A Great and Terrible Beauty

Quote: We are a noisy and blessed little family
Author: Nancy E. Turner,  These Is My Words: The Diary of Sarah Agnes Prine, 1881-1901

Quote: I love the recklessness of faith. First you leap, and then you grow wings.
Author: William Sloane Coffin Jr.,  Credo

Quote: In the midst of winter, I find within me the invisible summer...
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  The Kingdom of God Is Within You

Quote: God’s word is not just to be heard and repeated, it is to be breathed, lived, and emulated with each action.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Author: Rosamund Lupton,  Sister

Quote: I planned my death carefully, unlike my life, which meandered along from one thing to another, despite my feeble attempts to control it.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  Lady Oracle

Quote: Faith is like love: it does not let itself be forced.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Quote: The majority of my patients consisted not of believers but of those who had lost their faith.
Author: C.G. Jung

Quote: We never know how God will answer our prayers, but we can expect that He will get us involved in His plan for the answer. If we are true intercessors, we must be ready to take part in God’s work on behalf of the people for whom we pray.
Author: Corrie ten Boom
