Quote: In the view of such harmony in the cosmos which I, with my limited human mind, am able to recognize, there are yet people who says there is no God. But what makes me really angry is that they quote me for support of such views. (The Expanded Quotable Einstein, Princeton University, page 214)
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: Absence is a house so vast that inside you will pass through its walls and hang pictures on the air.
Author: Pablo Neruda

Quote: Glenn used to say the reason you can't really imagine yourself being dead was that as soon as you say, 'I'll be dead,' you've said the word I, and so you're still alive inside the sentence. And that's how people got the idea of the immortality of the soul - it was a consequence of grammar.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  The Year of the Flood

Quote: Do not fight the thing in detail: turn from it. Look ONLY at your Lord. Sing. Read. Work.
Author: Amy Carmichael,  Gold by Moonlight

Quote: To be unbroken, what would that be?If words that were spoken, had not shattered me
Author: ZOEgirl,  Zoegirl - Different Kind of Free

Quote: But you're dead,' said Harry.'Oh, yes,' said Dumbledore matter-of-factly.'Then... am I dead too?''Ah,' said Dumbledore, smiling still more broadly. 'That is the question, isn't it? On the whole, dear boy, I think not.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows

Quote: Faith is not about finding meaning in the world, there may be no such thing -- faith is the belief in our capacity to create meaningful lives.
Author: Terry Tempest Williams,  Leap

Quote: Faith is not about finding meaning in the world, there may be no such thing -- faith is the belief in our capacity to create meaningful lives.
Author: Terry Tempest Williams,  Leap

Quote: Death has his favorites, like anyone. Those who are beloved of Death will not die.
Author: Holly Black,  The Coldest Girl in Coldtown

Quote: Parting is inevitably painful, even for a short time. It's like an amputation, I feel a limb is being torn off, without which I shall be unable to function. And yet, once it is done... life rushes back into the void, richer, more vivid and fuller than before.
Author: Anne Morrow Lindbergh

Quote: Pain was good. If I hurt, it meant I wasn't dead.
Author: Kristin Cast,  Hunted

Quote: Death is not the worst thing; rather, when one who craves death cannot attain even that wish.
Author: Sophocles,  Electra

Quote: Hard work is only a prison sentence when you lack motivation
Author: Malcolm Gladwell,  Outliers: The Story of Success

Quote: When angels visit us, we do not hear the rustle of wings, nor feel the feathery touch of the breast of a dove; but we know their presence by the love they create in our hearts.
Author: Mary Baker Eddy,  Poems by Mary Baker Eddy

Quote: My nerves are bad to-night. Yes, bad. Stay with me. 'Speak to me. Why do you never speak? Speak. 'What are you thinking of? What thinking? What? 'I never know what you are thinking. Think.
Author: T.S. Eliot,  The Waste Land

Quote: For the moon never beams without bringing me dreamsOf the beautiful Annabel Lee;And the stars never rise but i feel the bright eyesOf the beautiful Annabel Lee.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe,  Annabel Lee

Quote: Now begins to rise in me the familiar rhythm; words that have lain dormant now lift, now toss their crests, and fall and rise, and falls again. I am a poet, yes. Surely I am a great poet.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  The Waves

Quote: She has a body for years, and I have an astronaut tan. When we make love it will be like (x + 2)(2x -1) = 0, solve for x.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Stranger, pause and look;From the dust of agesLift this little book,Turn the tattered pages,Read me, do not let me die!Search the fading letters findingSteadfast in the broken bindingAll that once was I!
Author: Edna St. Vincent Millay,  Collected Poems

Quote: Some hae meat and canna eat,And some wad eat that want it,But we hae meat and we can eat,And sae the Lord be thankit.
Author: Robert Burns

Quote: Like a shot from a movie, the morning sun shone brilliantly around him like a god—his dark hair glinted warmly in the light, and his eyes gleamed bluer than the south Pacific Ocean.Taylor's mind went blank. And suddenly, she couldn't remember why the hell she ever had been angry with Jason Andrews.But then he spoke."Sleeping in this morning, Ms. Donovan?"he drawled.Moment over.
Author: Julie James,  Just the Sexiest Man Alive

Quote: I love you, Clary,"he said without looking at her. He was staring out into the church, at the row of lighted candles, their fold reflected in his eyes. "More than I ever--"He broke off. "God. More than I probably should. You know that, don't you?
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Fallen Angels

Quote: Here was a boy who liked flaws, who saw them not as failings but as strengths. Who knew such a person could exist, or what would have happened if we'd found each other under different circumstances? Maybe in a perfect world. But not in this one.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  The Truth About Forever

Quote: No, not really. But …” Okay, I couldn’t help but gloat a little. “She likes me.”Samedi didn’t even look at me. “Well of course, you’ve had that bloody uniform on all day. I was half ready to tell you how much I liked you.
Author: Lia Habel,  Dearly, Departed

Quote: If you were mine, I'd never leave you, Prudence. I couldn't.
Author: Anne Gracie,  The Perfect Rake

Quote: Vane’s lips tightened to suppress a smile. “Why so hostile, love?”“You whacked me on the head with a ball!”“You deserved it.
Author: Priya Ardis,  My Merlin Awakening

Quote: Human knowledge consists not only of libraries of parchment and ink - it is also comprised of the volumes of knowledge that are written on the human heart, chiselled on the human soul, and engraved on the human psyche.
Author: Michael Jackson

Quote: I believe that it is impossible for two individuals not committed to their own and each other’s well being to sustain a healthy and enduring relationship.
Author: bell hooks,  Breaking Bread: Insurgent Black Intellectual Life

Quote: Writing is a dying form. One reads of this every day.
Author: Lemony Snicket

Quote: Inspiration comes of working every day.
Author: Charles Baudelaire

Quote: It's harder to write in the third person but the advantage is you move around better.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: The secret of a good sermon is to have a good beginning and a good ending; and to have the two as close together as possible.
Author: George Burns

Quote: All the cunning of the devil is exercised in trying to tear us away from the word.
Author: Martin Luther

Quote: Half of what I write is garbage, but if I don't write it down it decomposes in my head.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: Always try and be a better person than you were yesterday, cause we aren't guaranteed tomorrow.
Author: Tina A. Morgan

Quote: We are wiser than we know.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: If you have to say or do something controversial, aim so that people will hate that they love it and not love that they hate it.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Nothing like having a warrant for your execution to get a girl motivated.
Author: Maria V. Snyder,  Fire Study

Quote: It’s been said that men think only about sex and food. And some men, like my uncle Lester, think about sex with food. Needless to say the church has ordered him to cease bringing his own food to the potlucks.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: You don't need to wait for inspiration to write. It's easier to be inspired while writing that while not writing...
Author: Josip Novakovich,  Fiction Writer's Workshop

Quote: You don't need to wait for inspiration to write. It's easier to be inspired while writing that while not writing...
Author: Josip Novakovich,  Fiction Writer's Workshop

Quote: This morning, as I was driving to work, I mistook a big brown box on the side of the road for a deer. It was dark, and I swerved at the last second, and even though it wasn’t a deer, I still managed to nail that son of a bitch.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: When I hear Jazz, my first instinct is to lean over to the guy next to me and whisper, "Fourth floor, please.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the story my great-grandfather told my father, who then told my grandfather, who then told me about how The Mythical Mr. Boo, Charles Manseur Fizzlebush Grissham III, better known as Mr. Fizzlebush, and Orafoura are all in fact me...

Quote: Every time you try to flirt with her, a puppy dies.
Author: Maureen Johnson,  Suite Scarlett

Quote: Sort of' is such a harmless thing to say... sort of. It's just a filler. Sort of... it doesn't really mean anything. But after certain things, sort of means everything. Like... after "I love you"... or "You're going to live"... or "It's a boy!
Author: Demetri Martin

Quote: Careful with the accusations of insanity, oh my lady whose home is a tower with windows of brick, all for the sake of some skinny-ankled, laugh-prone boy of a khan.
Author: Shannon Hale,  Book of a Thousand Days

Quote: Perfection' is man's ultimate illusion. It simply doesn't exist in the universe.... If you are a perfectionist, you are guaranteed to be a loser in whatever you do.
Author: David D. Burns

Quote: Make the choice to embrace this day. Do not let your TODAY be stolen by the ghost of yesterday or the "To-Do"list of tomorrow! It’s inspiring to see all the wonderfully amazing things that can happen in a day in which you participate.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: It is more than probable that I am not understood; but I fear, indeed, that it is in no manner possible to convey to the mind of the merely general reader, an adequate idea of that nervous intensity of interest with which, in my case, the powers of meditation (not to speak technically) busied and buried themselves, in the contemplation of even the most ordinary objects of the universe.
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: As Aristotle said, 'Excellence is a habit.' I would say furthermore that excellence is made constant through the feeling that comes right after one has completed a work which he himself finds undeniably awe-inspiring. He only wants to relax until he's ready to renew such a feeling all over again because to him, all else has become absolutely trivial.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Our business in life is not to succeed, but to continue to fail in good spirits.
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson

Quote: The decision to empty my mind was a no-brainer.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: To win the big stakes in this changed world, you must catch the spirit of the great pioneers of the past, whose dreams have given to civilization all that it has of value, the spirit that serves as the life-blood of our own country – your opportunity and mine, to develop and market our talents.
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

Quote: Yo soy carne muerta. Translation: I am dead meat.
Author: Kiersten White,  Paranormalcy

Quote: I'm not really sure what makes a book a 'classic' to begin with, but I think it has to be at least fifty years old and some person or animal has to die at the end.
Author: Jeff Kinney

Quote: The public library is where place and possibility meet.
Author: Stuart Dybek

Quote: As you grow ready for it, somewhere or other you will find what is needful for you in a book.
Author: George MacDonald,  The Marquis of Lossie

Quote: لا توجد أي دولة في العالم انطلقت في المجال التكنولوجي دون الاعتماد على اللغة الأم.
Author: المهدي المنجرة

Quote: My books are friends that never fail me."(Letter to his mother, Margaret A. Carlyle; 17 March 1817)
Author: Thomas Carlyle

Quote: Learning became her. She loved the smell of the book from the shelves, the type on the pages, the sense that the world was an infinite but knowable place. Every fact she learned seemed to open another question, and for every question there was another book.
Author: Robert Goolrick,  A Reliable Wife

Quote: Down there between our legs, it's like an entertainment complex in the middle of a sewage system. Who designed that?
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson,  Space Chronicles: Facing the Ultimate Frontier

Quote: Every great advance in science has issued from a new audacity of imagination.
Author: John Dewey,  The Quest for Certainty: A Study of the Relation of Knowledge and Action

Quote: Every song you're trying to find something that going to connect in different ways but for me the songs that I'm really drawn to are inspirational, songs that lift you and that everybody can relate to no matter where you're from.
Author: Rodney Atkins

Quote: Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing or learning to do.
Author: Pele

Quote: Success is no accident. It is hard work, perseverance, learning, studying, sacrifice and most of all, love of what you are doing or learning to do.
Author: Pele

Quote: Our friends interpret the world and ourselves to us, if we take them tenderly and truly.
Author: Amos Bronson Alcott

Quote: What do you want a meaning for? Life is a desire, not a meaning.
Author: Charlie Chaplin

Quote: For love would be love of the wrong thing; there is yet faith, But the faith and the love and the hope are all in the waiting.
Author: T. S. Eliot

Quote: However it is debased or misinterpreted, love is a redemptive feature. To focus on one individual so that their desires become superior to yours is a very cleansing experience.
Author: Jeanette Winterson

Quote: When I judge art, I take my painting and put it next to a God made object like a tree or flower. If it clashes, it is not art.
Author: Paul Cezanne

Quote: I would say that Emma Stone and Emma Watson are two very talented young actresses who are very intelligent and have a great sense of humor and have learned to balance what they love with their acting career, and I think that's really a great thing.
Author: Kara Hayward

Quote: Sometimes, love brings you together even as life keeps you apart.
Author: Mitch Albom,  The First Phone Call from Heaven

Quote: Start here & go until you die, he said. What's so complicated about that?
Author: Brian Andreas

Quote: If I never went home, what exactly would I be missing? I pictured my cold cavernous house, my friendless town full of bad memories, the utterly unremarkable life that had been mapped out for me. It had never once occurred to me, I realized, to refuse it.
Author: Ransom Riggs,  Miss Peregrine’s Home for Peculiar Children

Quote: It’s funny how you can live somewhere your whole life, but not really see it.
Author: Kami Garcia,  Beautiful Creatures

Quote: Because inside me is a beast that snarls, and growls, and strains toward freedom.. and as hard as I try, I cannot kill it.
Author: Veronica Roth,  Insurgent

Quote: The world has enough women who know how to be smart. It needs women who are willing to be simple. The world has enough women who know how to be brilliant. It needs some who will be brave. The world has enough women who are popular. It needs more who are pure. We need women, and men, too, who would rather be morally right than socially correct.
Author: Peter Marshall

Quote: The world has enough women who know how to be smart. It needs women who are willing to be simple. The world has enough women who know how to be brilliant. It needs some who will be brave. The world has enough women who are popular. It needs more who are pure. We need women, and men, too, who would rather be morally right than socially correct.

Quote: My biggest fault is that the faults I was born with grow bigger each year.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  A Wild Sheep Chase

Quote: In the end,The treasure of life is missed by those who hold on and gained by those who let go.
Author: Lao Tzu

Quote: True love is boundless like the ocean and, swelling within one, spreads itself out and, crossing all boundaries and frontiers, envelops the whole world.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: By reading the scriptures I am so renewed that all nature seems renewed around me and with me. The sky seems to be a pure, a cooler blue, the trees a deeper green. The whole world is charged with the glory of God and I feel fire and music under my feet.
Author: Thomas Merton

Quote: I was always looking outside myself for strength and confidence, but it comes from within. It is there all the time.
Author: Anna Freud

Quote: The shame of being a man - is there any better reason to write?
Author: Gilles Deleuze

Quote: The shame of being a man - is there any better reason to write?
Author: Gilles Deleuze

Quote: You become mature when you become the authority of your own life.
Author: Joseph Campbell,  A Joseph Campbell Companion: Reflections on the Art of Living

Quote: You become mature when you become the authority of your own life.
Author: Joseph Campbell,  A Joseph Campbell Companion: Reflections on the Art of Living

Quote: I am buoyant and expansive and uncontainable--but I always was so, only I never knew it!
Author: Chitra Banerjee Divakaruni,  The Palace of Illusions

Quote: Live your life, no matter what that life is.
Author: Corey Taylor,  Seven Deadly Sins: Settling the Argument Between Born Bad and Damaged Good

Quote: What we can do, we must do: we must use what we are given, and we must use it the best we can, however much or little help we have for the task. What you have been given is a hard thing--a very hard thing... But my darling, what if there were no one who could do the difficult things?
Author: Robin McKinley,  Sunshine

Quote: We may run, walk, stumble. drive, or fly, but let us never lose sight of the reason for the journey, or miss a chance to see a rainbow on the way.
Author: Gloria Gaither

Quote: We may run, walk, stumble. drive, or fly, but let us never lose sight of the reason for the journey, or miss a chance to see a rainbow on the way.
Author: Gloria Gaither

Quote: العدالة والشرف والصدق كلام له معنى وله مضمون وجميل وممكن وحقيقى، بدليل إن الإنسان إللى مايقدرش عليه بيدعيه ويمثله، ودليل إنه بيكلف بعض الناس حياتهم
Author: فؤاد حداد,  الأعمال الكاملة ( على الطريق الرمضانى ) - الجزء الثاني

Quote: People in general would rather die than forgive. It's that hard. If God said in plain language. "I'm giving you a choice, forgive or die,"a lot of people would go ahead and order their coffin.
Author: Sue Monk Kidd

Quote: Love and compassion are the mother and father of a smile. We need to create more smiles in our world today. Smiles, after all, pave the way to a happy world.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Love and compassion are the mother and father of a smile. We need to create more smiles in our world today. Smiles, after all, pave the way to a happy world.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: All men are created equal. It is what you do from there that makes the difference. We are all free agents in life. We make our own decisions. We control our own destiny.
Author: Glenn Beck

Quote: Some day people will ask me what is the key to my success...and I will simply say, "good Karma.
Author: K. Crumley

Quote: Journeys end in lovers meeting, Every wise man's son doth know.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Twelfth Night

Quote: Who we were and who we are are four different people, and the me from now doesn't relate to the me from then, let alone to the you from now.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Who we were and who we are are four different people, and the me from now doesn't relate to the me from then, let alone to the you from now.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: How sad it was, Carmen thought, that you acted awful when you were desperately sad and hurt and wanted to be loved. How tragic then, the way everyone avoided you and tiptoed around you when you really needed them. Carmen knew this vicious predicament as well as anyone in the world. How bitter it felt when you acted badly to everyone and ended up hating yourself the most.
Author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

Quote: You know, people ask me. They say 'Dan, three years later do you really want to be drawing cat whiskers on your face?' but they don't understand. The cat whiskers, they come from within.
Author: Dan Howell

Quote: Sometimes I think of you and I feel giddy. Memory makes me lightheaded, drunk on champagne. All the things we did. And if anyone has said this was the price I would have agreed to pay it. That surprises me; that with the hurt and the mess comes a shift of recognition. It was worth it. Love is worth it.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Written on the Body

Quote: All sins are forgiven once you start making a lot of money.
Author: RuPaul

Quote: The moon will guide you through the night with her brightness, but she will always dwell in the darkness, in order to be seen.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: The moon will guide you through the night with her brightness, but she will always dwell in the darkness, in order to be seen.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: The moon will guide you through the night with her brightness, but she will always dwell in the darkness, in order to be seen.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Fiction just makes it all more interesting. Truth is so boring.
Author: Charlaine Harris,  Dead as a Doornail

Quote: If you want to fly on the sky, you need to leave the earth. If you want to move forward, you need to let go the past that drags you down.
Author: Amit Ray,  World Peace: The Voice of a Mountain Bird

Quote: It's only words... unless they're true.
Author: David Mamet

Quote: Inside each of us resides the truth, I began, the absolute truth. But sometimes the truth is hidden in a hall of mirrors. Sometimes we believe we are viewing the real thing, when in fact we are viewing a facsimile, a distortion.
Author: Garth Stein,  The Art of Racing in the Rain

Quote: She has man's brain--a brain that a man should have were he much gifted--and woman's heart. The good God fashioned her for a purpose, believe me when He made that so good combination.
Author: Bram Stoker,  Dracula

Quote: She has man's brain--a brain that a man should have were he much gifted--and woman's heart. The good God fashioned her for a purpose, believe me when He made that so good combination.
Author: Bram Stoker,  Dracula

Quote: She has man's brain--a brain that a man should have were he much gifted--and woman's heart. The good God fashioned her for a purpose, believe me when He made that so good combination.
Author: Bram Stoker,  Dracula

Quote: We were given the Scriptures to humble us into realizing that God is right, and the rest of us are just guessing.
Author: Rich Mullins

Quote: Energy is neither created nor destroyed. It just changes shape.
Author: Sheri Reynolds

Quote: The death of dogma is the birth of morality.
Author: Immanuel Kant

Quote: I'm not afraid of death. Death's afraid of me.
Author: Lee Child,  61 Hours

Quote: I pity you all... Most of you will die---scratch that---ALL of you.
Author: Gerard Way,  The Umbrella Academy, Vol. 2: Dallas

Quote: God is not an employer looking for employees. He is an Eagle looking for people who will take refuge under his wings. He is looking for people who will leave father and mother and homeland or anything else that may hold them back from a life of love under the wings of Jesus.
Author: John Piper,  A Sweet and Bitter Providence: Sex, Race, and the Sovereignty of God

Quote: We are all butterflies. Earth is our chrysalis.
Author: LeeAnn Taylor

Quote: If you understood him, it would not be God.
Author: Augustine of Hippo

Quote: But maybe it's what the world needs. A little less sense, and a little more faith.
Author: Rachel Joyce,  The Unlikely Pilgrimage of Harold Fry

Quote: When I read obituaries I always note the age of the deceased. Automatically I relate this figure to my own age. Four years to go, I think. Nine more years. Two years and I'm dead. The power of numbers is never more evident than when we use them to speculate on the time of our dying.
Author: Don DeLillo,  White Noise

Quote: Her absence is like the sky, spread over everything.But no, that is not quite accurate. There is one place where her absence comes locally home to me, and it is a place I can't avoid. I mean my own body. It had such a different importance while it was the body of H.'s lover. Now it's like an empty house.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  A Grief Observed

Quote: Everybody has got to die, but I have always believed an exception would be made in my case.
Author: William Saroyan

Quote: A poet who reads his verse in public may have other nasty habits.
Author: Robert A. Heinlein

Quote: I can't even enjoy a blade of grass unless I know there's a subway handy, or a record store or some other sign that people do not totally regret life. It's more important to confirm the least sincere. The clouds get enough attention as it is...
Author: Frank O'Hara

Quote: A man who knows how little he knows is well, a man who knows how much he knows is sick. If, when you see the symptoms, you can tell, Your cure is quick.A sound man knows that sickness makes him sick and before he catches it his cure is quick.
Author: Lao Tzu,  The Chinese Translations

Quote: A lot we have in our head,But things of heart are not yet dead,They have done none, but just fled,Out of us, Forgotten, just been bled..
Author: Numey

Quote: With the cure, relationships are all the same, and rules and expectations are defined. Without the cure, relationships must be reinvented every day, languages constantly decoded and deciphered. Freedom is exhausting.
Author: Lauren Oliver,  Requiem

Quote: Acquiring knowledge is a form of imitation.
Author: Jiddu Krishnamurti

Quote: Existence, after losing her, would be hell
Author: Emily Brontë,  Wuthering Heights

Quote: WORTH IT and perfect are different things. No one’s perfect, yet in romance, everyone becomes WORTH IT. And that’s the trick.
Author: Maureen Johnson

Quote: I look for you in every life, but I don't always find you. And sometimes I find you too late.
Author: Kirsten Miller,  The Eternal Ones

Quote: [Ranger] "How's your mental health?"he asked. "I heard about Soder."[Stephanie] "I'm rattled.""I have a cure."Oh, boy.He put the truck in gear and headed for the exit. "I know what you're thinking,"he said. "And that wasn't where I was going. I was going to suggest work.""I knew that."He looked over at me and grinned. "You want me bad."I did. God help me.
Author: Janet Evanovich

Quote: Blake took her face in his hands. “You let me touch you. Kiss you. Your skin? It feels like piano keys. My hands know just where to go.
Author: Debra Anastasia,  Poughkeepsie

Quote: I find myself fascinated by a man who admits to enjoying fairy tales and uses the word "impinge"- barely misses a beat while indulging in a brief girl-on-girl fantasy. You're a man of layers, Ford."Me and Shrek, we're onions.
Author: Nora Roberts,  Tribute

Quote: I can't play bridge. I don't play tennis. All those things that people learn, and I admire, there hasn't seemed time for. But what there is time for is looking out the window.
Author: Alice Munro

Quote: Dive again and again into the river of uncertainty. Create in the dark, only then can you recognize the light.
Author: Jyrki Vainonen

Quote: I have always held the old-fashioned opinion that the primary object of work of fiction should be to tell a story.
Author: Wilkie Collins,  The Woman in White

Quote: Your cravings as a human animal do not become a prayer just because it is God whom you ask to attend to them.
Author: Dag Hammarskjöld,  Markings

Quote: If there is no laughter, Jesus has gone somewhere else. If there is no joy and freedom, it is not a church: it is simply a crowd of melancholy people basking in a religious neurosis. If there is no celebration, there is no real worship.
Author: Steve Brown,  Approaching God: Accepting the Invitation to Stand in the Presence of God

Quote: A bad book is as much of a labor to write as a good one; it comes as sincerely from the author's soul.
Author: Aldous Huxley,  Point Counter Point

Quote: 01210 is a pyramid, & worms move like handicapped snakes. My dream belongs in a wheelchair, because I just spilled coffee all over my sleep.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I'm so excited. I just bought a new file cabinet, some manila folders, some sticky note pads, and a few highlighters, and I think I'm finally ready to enter into organized crime.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

Quote: Look at him,” she said, shaking her head. “Travis Maddox: Mr. Mom.
Author: Jamie McGuire,  Beautiful Disaster

Quote: I felt my cheeks turn red, and she laughed out loud. But I didn't mind too much, because the last thing she saw was my middle finger aimed in her direction as I stepped outside
Author: Jessica Verday,  The Hollow

Quote: I am the bathtub of love, but all Agatha ever wanted was a shower.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: Whatever you do, in the privacy of your own rain shower, is your own business
Author: Gregory David Roberts,  Shantaram

Quote: I don’t need love. I live in a forest. The quiet is my companion. The cold is my warmth. My heart once suffered from frostbite, but I removed and replaced it with a fuel pump.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: Those who trust us educate us.
Author: George Eliot,  Daniel Deronda

Quote: Learn to say no to demands, requests, invitations, and activities that leave you with no time for yourself. Until I learned to say no, and mean it, I was always overloaded by stress. You may feel guilty and selfish at first for guarding your down- time, but you’ll soon find that you are a much nicer, more present, more productive person in each instance you do choose to say yes.
Author: Holly Mosier

Quote: This is why I'm here on this planet, at this time, Francesca. Not to travel or make pictures, but to love you. I know that now. I have been falling from the rim of a great, high place, somewhere back in time, for many more years than I have lived in this life. And through all of those years, I have been falling toward you.
Author: Robert James Waller

Quote: College is the best time of your life. When else are your parents going to spend several thousand dollars a year just for you to go to a strange town and get drunk every night?
Author: David Wood

Quote: Education is what survives when what has been learnt has been forgotten.
Author: B.F. Skinner

Quote: I peed on the floor to get hired. Now I’m the janitor.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

Quote: We have sold ourselves into a fast food model of education, and it's impoverishing our spirit and our energies as much as fast food is depleting our physical bodies.
Author: Ken Robinson

Quote: Childhood is the one story that stands by itself in every soul.
Author: Ivan Doig,  The Whistling Season

Quote: Any formal attack on ignorance is bound to fail because the masses are always ready to defend their most precious possession - their ignorance.
Author: Hendrik Willem van Loon

Quote: Thinking of the stars night after night I begin to realize 'The stars are words' and all the innumerable worlds in the Milky Way are words, and so is this world too. And I realize that no matter where I am, whether in a little room full of thought, or in this endless universe of stars and mountains, it’s all in my mind.
Author: Jack Kerouac,  Lonesome Traveler

Quote: There are no forbidden questions in science, no matters too sensitive or delicate to be probed, no sacred truths.
Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: It [the book] was spinning a magic spell around her heart, sticky as a spider's web and enchantingly beautiful..
Author: Cornelia Funke,  Inkheart

Quote: If you have read 6,000 books in your lifetime, or even 600, it's probably because at some level you find 'reality' a bit of a disappointment.
Author: Joe Queenan,  One for the Books

Quote: As a child, I was aware that, at night, infrared vision would reveal monsters hiding in the bedroom closet only if they were warm-blooded. But everybody knows that your average bedroom monster is reptilian and cold-blooded.
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson,  Death by Black Hole: And Other Cosmic Quandaries

Quote: I think imagination is at the heart of everything we do. Scientific discoveries couldn't have happened without imagination. Art, music, and literature couldn't exist without imagination. And so anything that strengthens imagination, and reading certainly does that, can help us for the rest of our lives.
Author: Lloyd Alexander

Quote: I could read the great books but the great books don't interest me.
Author: Charles Bukowski,  The Last Night of the Earth Poems

Quote: Sadly, my socks are like snowflakes, no two are exactly alike.
Author: Graham Parke

Quote: Books do furnish a room.
Author: Anthony Powell,  Dance to the Music of Time

Quote: At moments when life is at its worst there are two things you can do: 1.) break down,lose hope and refuse to go on while lying face down on the ground banging your fists and kicking your legs, or 2.) laugh. Bobby and I did the latter.
Author: Cecelia Ahern

Quote: Go boldly and honestly through the world. Learn to love the fact that there is nobody else quite like you.
Author: Daniel Radcliffe

Quote: Go boldly and honestly through the world. Learn to love the fact that there is nobody else quite like you.
Author: Daniel Radcliffe

Quote: We'll Go No More A-rovingSo, we'll go no more a-rovingSo late into the night,Though the heart still be as loving,And the moon still be as bright.For the sword outwears its sheath,And the soul wears out the breast,And the heart must pause to breathe,And love itself have rest.Though the night was made for loving,And the day returns too soon,Yet we'll go no more a-rovingBy the light of the moon.
Author: George Gordon Byron,  Poetical Works

Quote: We'll Go No More A-rovingSo, we'll go no more a-rovingSo late into the night,Though the heart still be as loving,And the moon still be as bright.For the sword outwears its sheath,And the soul wears out the breast,And the heart must pause to breathe,And love itself have rest.Though the night was made for loving,And the day returns too soon,Yet we'll go no more a-rovingBy the light of the moon.
Author: George Gordon Byron,  Poetical Works

Quote: The flesh surrenders itself. Eternity takes back its own. Our bodies stirred these waters briefly, danced with a certain intoxication before the love of life and self, dealt with a few strange ideas, then submitted to the instruments of Time. What can we say of this? I occurred. I am not...yet, I occurred.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Dune Messiah

Quote: The flesh surrenders itself. Eternity takes back its own. Our bodies stirred these waters briefly, danced with a certain intoxication before the love of life and self, dealt with a few strange ideas, then submitted to the instruments of Time. What can we say of this? I occurred. I am not...yet, I occurred.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Dune Messiah

Quote: Regardless of Sunshine or Rain, Be Thankful for another GREAT day…and treat Life as the ULTIMATE Gift.... Because IT IS :)
Author: Pablo

Quote: Regardless of Sunshine or Rain, Be Thankful for another GREAT day…and treat Life as the ULTIMATE Gift.... Because IT IS :)
Author: Pablo

Quote: Life is as dear to a mute creature as it is to man. Just as one wants happiness and fears pain, just as one wants to live and not die, so do other creatures.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: She shrugged. "You can be happy for someone else's good fortune, but that doesn't mean you forget your own bad luck.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Plain Truth

Quote: If everyone started off the day singing, just think how happy they'd be.
Author: Lauren Myracle,  Shine

Quote: In the end, the end of a life only matters to friends, family, and other folks you used to know. For everyone else, it's just another end.
Author: Gabrielle Zevin

Quote: Above all things physical, it is more important to be beautiful on the inside - to have a big hear and an open mind and a spectacular spleen.
Author: Ellen DeGeneres,  Seriously... I'm Kidding

Quote: In life, you need either inspiration or desperation.
Author: Anthony Robbins

Quote: Given a choice between life and death, choose life. Given a choice between right and wrong, choose what's right. And given a choice between a terrible truth and a beautiful lie, choose the truth every time.
Author: Mira Grant,  Blackout

Quote: Given a choice between life and death, choose life. Given a choice between right and wrong, choose what's right. And given a choice between a terrible truth and a beautiful lie, choose the truth every time.
Author: Mira Grant,  Blackout

Quote: A woman can't do anything about her appearance. Either she's pretty or she isn't. But her character is quite another matter.
Author: Julie Garwood,  The Prize

Quote: ...You find a way, somehow to get through the most horrible things, things you think would kill you. You find a way and you move through the days, one by one, in shock, in despair, but you move. The days pass, one after the other, and you go along with them - occasionally stunned, and not entirely relieved, to find that you are still alive.
Author: Michelle Richmond,  The Year of Fog

Quote: One day you will wake up & there won’t be any more time to do the things you’ve always wanted. Do it now.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: You will see that the things you desire most are the very things that bring you the greatest sorrow.
Author: Christopher Pike,  Phantom

Quote: Trying is always enough.
Author: Patricia Briggs,  Dragon Bones

Quote: Those who lack the courage will always find a philosophy to justify it.
Author: Albert Camus

Quote: Be creative, be useful, be practical, be generous and finish big
Author: Lisa Genova

Quote: If you know that I am an unbeliever, then you know me better than I do myself. I may be an unbeliever, but I am an unbeliever who has a nostalgia for a belief.
Author: Pier Paolo Pasolini

Quote: If you know that I am an unbeliever, then you know me better than I do myself. I may be an unbeliever, but I am an unbeliever who has a nostalgia for a belief.
Author: Pier Paolo Pasolini

Quote: Everybody’s gotta learn, nobody’s born knowing.
Author: Harper Lee

Quote: When something seems wrong in your life, the only way to have resolution with it is to let it go. Trying to make it right keeps it wrong.
Author: Beth Johnson

Quote: He who knows, does not speak. He who speaks, does not know.
Author: Lao Tzu,  Tao Te Ching

Quote: I think that when the lies are all told and forgot the truth will be there yet. It dont move about from place to place and it dont change from time to time. You cant corrupt it any more than you can salt salt.
Author: Cormac McCarthy,  No Country For Old Men

Quote: A revolution is coming – a revolution which will be peaceful if we are wise enough; compassionate if we care enough; successful if we are fortunate enough – but a revolution which is coming whether we will it or not. We can affect its character; we cannot alter its inevitability.[Report to the United States Senate on his trip to Latin America and the Alliance for Progress, May 9-10 1966]
Author: Robert F. Kennedy

Quote: To be happy--one must find one's bliss
Author: Gloria Vanderbilt

Quote: Dreams are the bright creatures of poem and legend, who sport on earth in the night season, and melt away in the first beam of the sun, which lights grim care and stern reality on their daily pilgrimage through the world.
Author: Charles Dickens,  Nicholas Nickleby

Quote: But what is Hope? Nothing but the paint on the face of Existence; the least touch of truth rubs it off, and then we see what a hollow-cheeked harlot we have got hold of.
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: Each child’s story is worthy of telling. There shouldn’t be a sliding scale of death. The weight of it is crushing.
Author: Anderson Cooper,  Dispatches from the Edge: A Memoir of War, Disasters, and Survival

Quote: By daily dying, I have come to be.
Author: Theodore Roethke,  The Collected Poems

Quote: By daily dying, I have come to be.
Author: Theodore Roethke,  The Collected Poems

Quote: Death, a necessary end, will come when it will come
Author: William Shakespeare,  Julius Caesar

Quote: Once I was free in the shackles of sin:Free to be tempted, just bound to give in;Free to be captive to any desire;Free to eternally burn in hell’s fire.‘Til Someone bought me and called me His slave:Bound by commands I am free to obey;Captive by beauty I’m free to adore--Sentenced to sit at His feet evermore.
Author: John F. MacArthur Jr.

Quote: The idea of the future, pregnant with an infinity of possibilities, is thus more fruitful than the future itself, and this is why we find more charm in hope than in possession, in dreams than in reality.
Author: Henri Bergson,  Time and Free Will

Quote: Make peace with silence, and remind yourself that it is in this space that you'll come to remember your spirit. When you're able to transcend an aversion to silence, you'll also transcend many other miseries. And it is in this silence that the remembrance of God will be activated.
Author: Wayne W. Dyer

Quote: If God really existed, it would be necessary to abolish Him.
Author: Mikhail Bakunin

Quote: Death and what came after death was no great mystery to Sabriel. She just wished it was.
Author: Garth Nix,  Sabriel

Quote: For every thing that lives is Holy.
Author: William Blake,  The Marriage of Heaven and Hell

Quote: The fact of God is necessary for the fact of man. Think God away and man has no ground of existence.
Author: A.W. Tozer

Quote: Many Spirit-filled authors have exhausted the thesaurus in order to describe God with the glory He deserves. His perfect holiness, by definition, assures us that our words can't contain Him. Isn't it a comfort to worship a God we cannot exaggerate?
Author: Francis Chan,  Crazy Love: Overwhelmed by a Relentless God

Quote: Did you get notes for me?""No", Ronan replied,"I thought you were dead in a ditch.
Author: Maggie Stiefvater,  The Raven Boys

Quote: Horses change lives. They give out young people confidence and self-esteem. They provide peace and tranquility to troubled souls, they give us hope.
Author: Toni Robinson

Quote: Poetry is nearer to vital truth than history.
Author: Plato

Quote: I fall in love with you four times a year: winter, spring, summer, and fall. The leaves may change, but how I feel about you does not.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I fall in love with you four times a year: winter, spring, summer, and fall. The leaves may change, but how I feel about you does not.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I fall in love with you four times a year: winter, spring, summer, and fall. The leaves may change, but how I feel about you does not.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I fall in love with you four times a year: winter, spring, summer, and fall. The leaves may change, but how I feel about you does not.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: see beyond the eyes can see, believe beyond the inspiration!
Author: Felix Y. Siauw,  Beyond The Inspiration

Quote: I think of you only twice a day - when I am alone and when I am with someone else.
Author: Amit Kalantri,  I Love You Too

Quote: And, she was able to tell herself with some satisfaction, the man in question - one Colin Bridgerton - felt precisely the same way........His earth shook, his heart leaped, and Penelope knew without a doubt that his breath was taken away as well. For a good ten seconds.Falling off a horse tended to do that to a man.
Author: Julia Quinn,  Romancing Mister Bridgerton

Quote: I'm... I'm so in love with you that I can't even stand it! Sasuke! Stay with me, and I'll never let you regret it! We'll have fun every day, and... And you'll be happy! I'll make sure of it! I'll do anything for you, Sasuke! Just, please... Please, please don't go! I'll even help you take revenge! I mean, I'll manage it somehow, so... So please... Stay with me.
Author: Masashi Kishimoto,  Naruto, Vol. 21: Pursuit

Quote: He felt like home.
Author: JoAnne Kenrick,  When A Mullo Loves A Woman

Quote: It's like you have a plan and someone comes along and makes you want to change it all, but you still like your first plan, no matter how fantastic the second one makes you feel.
Author: Melina Marchetta,  Saving Francesca

Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Secrets of a Summer Night

Quote: She is the crescendo, the final, astonishing work of God. Woman. In one last flourish creation comes to a finish with Eve. She is the Master's finishing touch.
Author: John Eldredge

Quote: Hades was the personification of dark and dangerous--a living, breathing Batman.
Author: P.C. Cast,  Goddess of Spring

Quote: People who write fiction, if they had not taken it up, might have become very successful liars.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: Read – and be curious. And if somebody says to you: 'Things are this way. You can't change it' - don't believe a word.
Author: Cornelia Funke

Quote: [On writing:] "There's a great quote by Julius Irving that went, 'Being a professional is doing the things you love to do, on the days you don't feel like doing them.'"(One On 1, interview with Budd Mishkin; NY1, March 25, 2007.)
Author: David Halberstam,  Everything They Had: Sports Writing

Quote: I'd like to emphasize that when a reader finishes a great novel, he will immediately begin looking for another. If someone loves your book, it increases the chance that he or she will look at mine. So there is no competition between writers. Another writer's success helps build a larger readership for all of us.
Author: David Farland

Quote: The word "education"comes from the root e from ex, out, and duco, I lead. It means a leading out. To me education is a leading out of what is already there in the pupil's soul.
Author: Muriel Spark,  The Prime of Miss Jean Brodie

Quote: Be an opener of doors
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Second-hand books are wild books, homeless books; they have come together in vast flocks of variegated feather, and have a charm which the domesticated volumes of the library lack. Besides, in this random miscellaneous company we may rub against some complete stranger who will, with luck, turn into the best friend we have in the world.

"And here I was prepared to be impressed.

Quote: She is too fond of books, and it has turned her brain

Author: Colin Powell

Quote: Friendship multiplies the good of life and divides the evil.

Author: Bertrand Russell

Author: Linus Pauling

Author: David Gemmell,  Sword in the Storm

Author: Richard Bach

Quote: Because he could not afford to fail, he could not afford to trust.

Quote: Only a blind man can easily define what light is. When you do not know, you are bold. Ignorance is always bold; knowledge hesitates. And the more you know, the more you feel that the ground underneath is dissolving. The more you know, the more you feel how ignorant you are.

Quote: It's b******* to think of friendship and romance being different. They're not. They're just variations of the same love. Variatons of the same desire to be close.

Quote: my good qualities are under your protection, and you are to exaggerate them as much as possible; and, in return, it belongs to me to find occasion for teasing and quarreling with you as often as may be...
Author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

Quote: There is only that moment, and the incredible certainty that everything under the sun has been written by one hand only. It is the hand that evokes love, and creates a twin soul for every person in the world. Without such love, one's dreams would have no meaning.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

Quote: Some people still think knowledge is power.

Quote: I love you, Katherine James. I love you with everything I am. You're the best thing that has ever happened to me. Remember that."Gabe Rossiter
Author: Pamela Clare,  Naked Edge

Quote: Love knows no limit to its endurance, no end to its trust, no fading of its hope; it can outlast anything. Love still stands when all else has fallen.
Author: Blaise Pascal

Quote: A true opium of the people is a belief in nothingness after death - the huge solace of thinking that for our betrayals, greed, cowardice, murders we are not going to be judged.

Author: James Ross

Author: Joyce Carol Oates

Quote: I think the best time to stare off into space is when you’re going 65 on a motorcycle, provided you’re wearing your astronaut’s helmet.

Quote: If I could store any character quality in a cookie jar, I’d store patience. Chocolate-chip patience cookies. And I’d eat them all at one sitting.

Quote: If you pursue happiness, you are an ordinary person. If happiness pursues you, you are an extraordinary person. Do not chase happiness; let it chase you.
Author: Peter Deunov

Quote: Don't wait for other people to be loving, giving, compassionate, grateful, forgiving, generous, or friendly... lead the way!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Don't wait for other people to be loving, giving, compassionate, grateful, forgiving, generous, or friendly... lead the way!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: To like many people spontaneously and without effort is perhaps the greatest of all sources of personal happiness.
Author: Bertrand Russell

Quote: The more you know, the less you need.
Author: Yvon Chouinard,  Let My People Go Surfing: The Education of a Reluctant Businessman

Quote: There are two kinds of fools. One says, "This is old, and therefore good."And one says, "This is new, and therefore better.
Author: John Brunner,  The Shockwave Rider

Quote: When one experiences truth, the madness of finding fault with others disappears.
Author: S.N. Goenka

Quote: And, as always happens, and happens far too soon, the strange and wonderful becomes a memory and a memory becomes a dream. Tomorrow it's gone.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Wintersmith

Quote: What good is money if it can't buy happiness?
Author: Agatha Christie,  The Man in the Brown Suit

Quote: Faith is a fine inventionWhen gentlemen can see,But microscopes are prudentIn an emergency.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: Faith is a fine inventionWhen gentlemen can see,But microscopes are prudentIn an emergency.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: There’s something really cool about knowing that your destiny is SO big that you’re not meant to share it with anyone. At least not yet.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: There’s something really cool about knowing that your destiny is SO big that you’re not meant to share it with anyone. At least not yet.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: Neither of the two people in the room paid any attention to the way I came in, although only one of them was dead.
Author: Raymond Chandler,  The Big Sleep

Quote: هناك أشياء كثيرة تجعل الأوطان مقابر
Author: بدرية البشر,  الأرجوحة

Quote: I'm bored with it all. - Last Words
Author: Winston S. Churchill

Quote: Of course you don't believe in fairies. You're fifteen. You think I believed in fairies at fifteen? Took me until I was at least a hundred and forty. Hundred and fifty, maybe. Anyway, he wasn't a fairy. He was a librarian. All right?
Author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 6: Fables and Reflections

Quote: ...God created the world in six days. On the seventh day, he rested. On the eighth day, he started getting complaints. And it hasn't stopped since.
Author: James Scott Bell,  Sins of the Fathers

Quote: Hope will lie to you, but lust is what it is; it never lies.
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Flirt

Quote: God never talks. But the devil keeps advertising, Father. The devil does a lot of commercials.
Author: William Peter Blatty,  The Exorcist

Quote: I said, 'I need to know how he died.'He flipped back and pointed at, 'Why?'So I can stop inventing how he died. I'm always inventing.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Extremely Loud and Incredibly Close

Quote: Flowers that grow where old ones have withered serve to remind us that death will one day come to us all.
Author: Arthur Golden,  Memoirs of a Geisha

Quote: The deep roots never doubt spring will come.
Author: Marty Rubin

Quote: Maybe you should say goodbye, Cal.''No.''It might be important.''It might make her die.
Author: Jenny Downham,  Before I Die

Quote: At the end of the day, it's not about what you have or even what you've accomplished. It's about what you've done with those accomplishments. Its about who you've lifted up, who you've made better. It about what you've given back"(23).
Author: Denzel Washington,  A Hand to Guide Me

Quote: For if we're destroyed, the knowledge is dead...We're nothing more than dust jackets for books...so many pages to a person...
Author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

Quote: Look for the heart in a man before you look at what he has.
Author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett,  Friends 2 Lovers: The Unthinkable

Quote: We all suffer under a curse, the curse that we know more than we can endure, and there is nothing, absolutely nothing we can do about the force and the lure of this knowledge.
Author: Anne Rice,  Vittorio, The Vampire

Quote: The poet doesn't invent. He listens.
Author: Jean Cocteau

Quote: You Stole my loneliness. I may have given you wings, but you've become my gravity. I'll never be free of your force.
Author: Pepper Winters,  Tears of Tess

Quote: He gave her a quick, casual kiss on the cheek first. Then came the hug, and it was the hug that always made Laurel’s heart mush. Serious grip, cheek to the hair, eyes closed, just a little sway. Del’s hugs mattered, she thought, and made him impossible to resist.
Author: Nora Roberts,  Savor the Moment

Quote: So you actually need spectacles,” Leo finally said.“Of course I do,” Marks said crossly. “Why would I wear spectacles if I didn’t need them?”“I thought they might be part of your disguise.”“My disguise?”“Yes, Marks, disguise. A noun describing a means of concealing someone’s identity. Often used by clowns and spies. And now apparently governesses. Good God, can anything be ordinary for my family?
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Married By Morning

Quote: More than anything."Rob persisted. "You'd crawl on your belly over broken glass for her. Easy.
Author: L.J. Smith,  The Passion

Quote: So, Beav, tell me about yourself.""I'm Blue.""Sweetheart, if I had your dubious taste in men, I wouldn't be too happy, either.""My name is Blue. Blue Bailey.
Author: Susan Elizabeth Phillips,  Natural Born Charmer

Quote: You never get mad,” she said when their server left the table. “Except at me.”“That’s not true,” he said tightly. “Torie can get me going.”“Torie doesn’t count. You were obviously her mother in a previous life.
Author: Susan Elizabeth Phillips,  Call Me Irresistible

Quote: I don't think writers are sacred, but words are. They deserve respect. If you get the right ones in the right order, you might nudge the world a little or make a poem that children will speak for you when you are dead.
Author: Tom Stoppard,  The Real Thing: A Play

Quote: We are gods with anuses.
Author: Ernest Becker,  The Denial of Death

Quote: To produce a mighty book, you must choose a mighty theme.
Author: Herman Melville

Quote: فكم من الأشياء قد تحدث لنا بسبب ما نقرأ.ذلك أن ثمة قراءات تفعل بنا فعل الكتابة، وتوصلنا إلى حيث لا نتوقع !
Author: أحلام مستغانمي

Quote: No iron can stab the heart with such force as a period put just at the right place.
Author: Isaac Babel,  The Collected Stories of Isaac Babel

Quote: If we are not allowed to deal with small problems, we will be destroyed by slightly larger ones. When we come to understand this, we live our lives not avoiding problems, but welcoming them them as challenges that will strengthen us so that we can be victorious in the future.
Author: Jim Stovall,  The Ultimate Gift

Quote: Whatever the mind of man can conceive and believe, it can achieve
Author: W. Clement Stone

Quote: He who is best prepared can best serve his moment of inspiration.
Author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

Quote: I like stepping into the future. Therefore, I look for doorknobs.
Author: Mark Rosen

Quote: Someone has to write all those stories: why not me?
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert

Quote: I also don't trust Caribou anymore. They're out there, on the tundra, waiting... Something's going down. I'm right about this.
Author: Joss Whedon

Quote: Our age not only does not have a very sharp eye for the almost imperceptible intrusions of grace, it no longer has much feeling for the nature of the violences which precede and follow them.
Author: Flannery O'Connor,  Mystery and Manners: Occasional Prose

Quote: The plain fact is that education is itself a form of propaganda - a deliberate scheme to outfit the pupil, not with the capacity to weigh ideas, but with a simple appetite for gulping ideas ready-made. The aim is to make 'good' citizens, which is to say, docile and uninquisitive citizens.
Author: H.L. Mencken

Quote: You only have to do a very few things right in your life so long as you don't do too many things wrong.
Author: Warren Buffett

Quote: Like most North Americans of his generation, Hal tends to know way less about why he feels certain ways about the objects and pursuits he's devoted to than he does about the objects and pursuits themselves. It's hard to say for sure whether this is even exceptionally bad, this tendency.
Author: David Foster Wallace,  Infinite Jest

Quote: If you don’t know exactly where you’re going, how will you know when you get there?
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Don't be afraid to give up the good to go for the great.
Author: John D. Rockefeller

Quote: He was a gentle and sensitive soul, and therefore had a short temper, which is why he went straight after everything with an ax...
Author: Bohumil Hrabal,  I Served the King of England

Quote: When we feel, a kind of lyric is sung in our heart. When we think, a kind of music is played in our mind. In harmony, both create a beautiful symphony of life.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: You can have regret from yesterday, fear tomorrow, but peace today by sharing your heart’s deepest feelings. A life spent being fearful of showing your soul is a life not worth living.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: We are survival machines – robot vehicles blindly programmed to preserve the selfish molecules known as genes. This is a truth which still fills me with astonishment.
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The Selfish Gene

Quote: The ultimate luxury is to reread: to revisit a book to see how time has treated it, how memory has distorted it, or how my own passing years have cast a new light on it.
Author: Michael Upchurch

Quote: In other words, it's one of those books you thrust on your partner with an incredulous cry of "This is me!
Author: Nick Hornby,  The Polysyllabic Spree

Quote: One general law, leading to the advancement of all organic beings, namely, multiply, vary, let the strongest live and the weakest die.
Author: Charles Darwin,  The Origin of Species

Quote: The imaginary is not formed in opposition to reality as its denial or compensation; it grows among signs, from book to book, in the interstice of repetitions and commentaries; it is born and takes shape in the interval between books. It is the phenomena of the library.
Author: Michel Foucault

Quote: Ultimately, the number of books always exceeds the space they are granted.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: To sit alone in the lamplight with a book spread out before you and hold intimate converse with men of unseen generations - such is pleasure beyond compare.
Author: Yoshida Kenkō,  Essays in Idleness: The Tsurezuregusa of Kenko

Quote: But the not-very-highbrow truth of the matter was that the reading was how I got my ya-yas out.For the sake of my bookish reputation I upgraded to Tolstoy and Steinbeck before I understood them, but my dark secret was that really, I preferred the junk. The Dragonriders of Pern, Flowers in the Attic, The Clan of the Cave Bear. This stuff was like my stash of Playboys under the mattress.
Author: Julie Powell,  Julie and Julia: 365 Days, 524 Recipes, 1 Tiny Apartment Kitchen: How One Girl Risked Her Marriage, Her Job, and Her Sanity to Master the Art of Living

Quote: I'm told there's no going back. So I'm choosing forward.
Author: David Levithan,  Dash & Lily's Book of Dares

Quote: Don't be trapped by dogma — which is living with the results of other people's thinking.
Author: Steve Jobs

Quote: Everyone is in such a hurry. People haven’t found meaning in their lives, so they’re running all the time looking for it. They think the next car, the next house, the next job. Then they find those things are empty, too, and they keep running. Once you start running, it’s hard to slow yourself down.
Author: Mitch Albom

Quote: I wonder if being sane means disregarding the chaos that is life, pretending only an infinitesimal segment of it is reality.
Author: Rabih Alameddine,  Koolaids: The Art of War

Quote: There's so much destruction all over the world - and all you can do is complain about ME!
Author: Morrissey

Quote: In football everything is complicated by the presence of the opposite team.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre

Quote: Orang yang tidak pernah dibakar panas mentari, mustahil menghargai rimbun berteduh - peribahasa Turki.
Author: Hasrizal Abdul Jamil,  Secangkir Teh Pengubat Letih

Quote: You are a wonderful creation. You know more than you think you know, just as you know less than you want to know.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: You are a wonderful creation. You know more than you think you know, just as you know less than you want to know.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: And to all this she must yet add something more substantial, in the improvement of her mind by extensive reading.
Author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

Quote: My advice to you is get married: if you find a good wife you'll be happy; if not, you'll become a philosopher.
Author: Socrates

Quote: My advice to you is get married: if you find a good wife you'll be happy; if not, you'll become a philosopher.
Author: Socrates

Quote: Earthlings went on being friendly, when they should have been thinking instead.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Breakfast of Champions

Quote: The only way to avoid being miserable is not to have enough leisure to wonder whether you are happy or not.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: I want him to be happy. And I want you to be happy, too. Even if you can only find that happiness without me.
Author: S.J. Watson,  Before I Go to Sleep

Quote: It will hurt."said Petra. "But let's make the most of what we have, and not let future pain ruin present happiness.
Author: Orson Scott Card,  Shadow Puppets

Quote: In the end, your past is not my past and your truth is not my truth and your solution - is not my solution.
Author: Zadie Smith,  White Teeth

Quote: There is an inmost center in us all, where truth abides in fullness;....and, to know, rather consists in opening out a way where the imprisoned splendor may escape, then in effecting entry for a light supposed to be without.
Author: Robert Browning

Quote: Belief means not wanting to know what is true.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: The most important thing is this: to sacrifice what you are now for what you can become tomorrow.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: The most important thing is this: to sacrifice what you are now for what you can become tomorrow.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Call no man happy, said Shadow, until he is dead
Author: Neil Gaiman,  American Gods

Quote: Call no man happy, said Shadow, until he is dead
Author: Neil Gaiman,  American Gods

Quote: If my work has a theme, I suspect it is a simple one: that most human beings are inescapably alone, and therein lies their tragedy.
Author: Richard Yates

Quote: I don't think two people could have been happier than we have been.
Author: Michael Cunningham,  The Hours

Quote: And when all your faith is gone let it be me, if it's a friend you need let it be me
Author: Ray Lamontagne

Quote: And when all your faith is gone let it be me, if it's a friend you need let it be me
Author: Ray Lamontagne

Quote: And when all your faith is gone let it be me, if it's a friend you need let it be me
Author: Ray Lamontagne

Quote: My father chose my name , and my last name was chosen by my ancestors . That’s enough, I myself choose my way
Author: Ali Shariati

Author: Ali Shariati

Quote: My father chose my name , and my last name was chosen by my ancestors . That’s enough, I myself choose my way
Author: Ali Shariati

Quote: God's only excuse is that he does not exist
Author: Stendhal

Quote: Because hope comes from in you, and wishes are just magic.
Author: Laini Taylor,  Daughter of Smoke & Bone

Quote: Is there a chance?A fragment of light at the end of the tunnel?A reason to fight?Is there a chance you may change your mind?Or are we ashes and wine?
Author: A Fine Frenzy

Quote: My nature has always been to fight. My faith forces me to forgive.
Author: Cindy Martinusen Coloma,  Caleb + Kate

Quote: I said to myself, 'I want to die decently'.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre,  The Wall

Quote: Faith is what makes life bearable, with all its tragedies and ambiguities and sudden, startling joys.
Author: Madeleine L'Engle,  Walking on Water: Reflections on Faith and Art

Quote: Is that what death would feel like? The nicest, warmest, heaviest never-ending nap? If that’s what it’s like, I wouldn’t mind.
Author: Gayle Forman,  If I Stay

Quote: The meme for blind faith secures its own perpetuation by the simple unconscious expedient of discouraging rational inquiry.
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The Selfish Gene

Quote: Believe to the end, even if all men went astray and you were left the only one faithful; bring your offering even then and praise God in your loneliness.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

Quote: The world looks like something God had just imaged for his own pleasure, doesn't it?
Author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of Green Gables

Quote: There is a certain right by which we many deprive a man of life, but none by which we may deprive him of death; this is mere cruelty.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Human, All Too Human

Quote: Relax. They're not going to kill us. They're going to TRY and kill us. And that is a very different thing.
Author: Steve Voake,  The Dreamwalker's Child

Quote: The irony is that while God doesn't need us but still wants us, we desperately need God but don't really want Him most of the time. He treasures us and anticipates our departure from this earth to be with Him-and we wonder, indifferently, how much we have to do for Him to get by.
Author: Francis Chan,  Crazy Love: Overwhelmed by a Relentless God

Quote: IT IS BY CHOICE AND NOT BY CHANCES THAT WE CHANGE OUR CIRCUMSTANCES.
Author: Nadia Sahari,  Breakaway: How I Survived Abuse

Quote: The gods have become our diseases.
Author: C.G. Jung

Quote: Science only goes so far, then comes God.- Noah Calhoun-
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

Quote: Science only goes so far, then comes God.- Noah Calhoun-
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Notebook

Quote: Appreciate every little beautiful moment in every day of your life. Give it a try and you'll see the world from another perspective.
Author: Thea Kristine May

Quote: Appreciate every little beautiful moment in every day of your life. Give it a try and you'll see the world from another perspective.
Author: Thea Kristine May

Quote: Even when muddy your wings sparkle bright wonders that heal broken worlds.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: Even when muddy your wings sparkle bright wonders that heal broken worlds.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: The coward says in his heart “There is no love.” Because, standing in the shadows of the big, grand, and powerful existence of love, his small spirit is left feeling even smaller and less significant. And so he chooses to deny the existence of love altogether. Because he is too small to have it.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Our fingerprints don't fade from the lives we've touched.
Author: Will Fetters,  Memoirs

Quote: Follow, poet, follow rightTo the bottom of the night,With your unconstraining voiceStill persuade us to rejoice;With the farming of a verseMake a vineyard of the curse,Sing of human unsuccessIn a rapture of distress;In the deserts of the heartLet the healing fountain start,In the prison of his daysTeach the free man how to praise.
Author: W.H. Auden,  Another Time

Quote: When you want to share something with another person more than anything, it is one of the most difficult things to realize that you can never have it. Accepting this realization is even more difficult. Loving someone does mean saying goodbye to them in some cases, though we will fight that until the oftentimes bitter end before doing the right thing.
Author: Ashly Lorenzana

Quote: A book of verses underneath the boughA flask of wine, a loaf of bread and thouBeside me singing in the wildernessAnd wilderness is paradise now.
Author: Omar Khayyám,  Edward Fitzgerald's The Rubaiyat of Omar Khayyam

Quote: Nothingwould beeasier withoutyou,because youare everything,all of it-sprinkles, quarks, giantdonuts, eggs sunny-side up-youare the ever-expandinguniverseto me.
Author: Kate DiCamillo,  Flora and Ulysses: The Illuminated Adventures

Quote: The snag about marriage is, it isn´t worth the divorce.
Author: Suzanne Finnamore,  Split: A Memoir of Divorce

Quote: A pitcher throws baseballs, but a pitcher also holds liquid. My emotions are so fluid I wonder how large the pitcher would have to be to hold my heart. Probably 6’3”.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Curiosity is the most powerful thing you own.
Author: James Cameron

Quote: My love for you won't stop with my leaving. Come an evening over the years, when you step outside your door and hear the wind blowing through the cottonwoods, that'll be me, thinking of you, whispering your name, and loving you.
Author: Penelope Williamson

Quote: We could go back to your house. I can stay with you always. We can know each others bodies in every way, night after night. I could love you. I could work, you would not be poor. I would help you.
Author: Charlaine Harris,  Dead to the World

Quote: I looked at Micah, who shrugged. I looked at Rafael, who shook his head. Nice that none of us knew why he was undressing.
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Narcissus in Chains

Quote: I watched you while you were sleeping and you looked completely at peace. I wish I could feel that. I wish I could close my eyes and feel at peace. But I can’t. I can’t feel anything if I’m notwith you, and even then all I can do is want something that I don’t think I can ever have, at least not now. So I left this, and my peace, with you. Stark.
Author: P.C. Cast,  Hunted

Quote: But she woke up just then, and in the moonlight covered herself with a blanket. She smiled at him drowsily and called him "Yero, my hero,"and that melted his heart.
Author: Gregory Maguire,  Wicked: The Life and Times of the Wicked Witch of the West

Quote: There is no law stronger than that ofmagic. - Kian
Author: Kailin Gow,  Bitter Frost

Quote: No more, no less. I'm an idiot. I really need to let this crush go.
Author: Pittacus Lore,  The Rise of Nine

Quote: Writing is an exploration. You start from nothing.
Author: E.L. Doctorow

Quote: This is the mythosphere. It's made up of all the stories, theories and beliefs, legends, myths and hopes, that are generated here on Earth. As you can see, it's constantly growing and moving as people invent new tales to tell or find new things to believe. The older strands move out to become these spirals, where things tend to become quite crude and dangerous. They've hardened off, you see.
Author: Diana Wynne Jones

Quote: We no longer know each other. Hell, I barely know myself these days. I brush my teeth and look in the mirror and think, “Who is this guy taking care of my oral hygiene?
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: There is no excuse for anyone to write fiction for public consumption unless he has been called to do so by the presence of a gift. It is the nature of fiction not to be good for much unless it is good in itself.
Author: Flannery O'Connor,  Mystery and Manners: Occasional Prose

Quote: Think of yourself as a brand. You need to be remembered. What will they remember you for? What defines you? If you have it in you, do something that defines you. Invent something, develop a unique skill, get noticed for something — it creates a talking point.
Author: Chris Arnold

Quote: My pen shall heal, not hurt.
Author: L.M. Montgomery,  Emily Climbs

Quote: CONFESSION NO. 18 Girls just want to have fun…and live to tell about it the next day.
Author: Ronda Thompson,  Confessions of a Werewolf Supermodel

Quote: I write out of revenge.
Author: William Goldman

Quote: When asked why I don't believe in God I reply, quite simply, "vaginas".
Author: Robert Clark

Quote: He's turned his life around. He used to be depressed and miserable. Now he's miserable and depressed.
Author: David Frost

Quote: It's sick and twisted and violent. Other than that it is totally G rated.
Author: Elizabeth Cruickshank

Quote: I am the archaeologist of love. I’m digging for the bones of a loved one I shot and buried decades ago.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

Quote: 88. People wonder why so many writers come to live in Paris. I’ve been living ten years in Paris and the answer seems simple to me: because it’s the best place to pick ideas. Just like Italy, Spain.. or Iran are the best places to pick saffron. If you want to pick opium poppies you go to Burma or South-East Asia. And if you want to pick novel ideas, you go to Paris.
Author: Roman Payne,  Crepuscule

Quote: A good story cannot be devised; it has to be distilled.
Author: Raymond Chandler

Quote: They're so cold, these scholars!May lightning strike their foodso that their mouths learn howto eat fire!
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: It is always a much easier task to educate uneducated people than to re-educate the mis-educated.
Author: Herbert M. Shelton,  Getting Well

Quote: The purpose of influence is to "speak up for those who have no influence."(Pr.31:8) It's not about you.
Author: Rick Warren

Quote: When you touch the celestial in your heart, you will realize that the beauty of your soul is so pure, so vast and so devastating that you have no option but to merge with it. You have no option but to feel the rhythm of the universe in the rhythm of your heart.
Author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

Quote: Who wants to be used? I love to read, so books are my main friends. They're always available, always friendly, and always interesting, and they never make me choose sides.
Author: Lurlene McDaniel

Quote: I don't want anyone writing in to point out that I spend too much money on books, many of which I will never read. I know that already. I certainly intend to read all of them, more or less. My intentions are good. Anyway, it's my money. And I'll bet you do it too.
Author: Nick Hornby,  The Polysyllabic Spree

Quote: A book is a mirror: if an ape looks into it an apostle is hardly likely to look out.
Author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg,  Sudelbücher.

Quote: Should it matter what genre it is if the book is good?
Author: Colleen Hoover,  Hopeless

Quote: The flow of Guiness into the studio was inspirational as well as nutritive.
Author: Carter Burwell

Quote: For success, attitude is equally as important as ability.
Author: Walter Scott

Quote: Silences make the real conversations between friends. Not the saying but the never needing to say is what counts.
Author: Margaret Lee Runbeck

Quote: You can only learn so much from books. You can only learn so much from education. Ultimately, it is the wisdom of God that will carry you through in the toughest situations of life.
Author: Ravi Zacharias

Quote: In the night of death, hope sees a star, and listening love can hear the rustle of a wing.
Author: Robert Green Ingersoll

Quote: I love to get behind the wheel and get competitive.
Author: Jason Statham

Quote: A work of art is the unique result of a unique temperament.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Whatever else an American believes or disbelieves about himself, he is absolutely sure he has a sense of humor.
Author: E. B. White

Quote: Life was a swarm of accidents waiting in the treetops, descending upon any living thing that passed, ready to eat them alive. You swam in a river of chance and coincidence. You clung to the happiest accidents- the rest you let float by.
Author: David Wroblewski,  The Story of Edgar Sawtelle

Quote: There are some places in life where you can only go alone. Embrace the beauty of your solo journey.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: There are some places in life where you can only go alone. Embrace the beauty of your solo journey.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: There are some places in life where you can only go alone. Embrace the beauty of your solo journey.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: My name is a half an hour early, but my body is on time.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: Everyday it gets easier to connect with an electronic device that it is to connect with real people.
Author: Pablo

Quote: Everyday it gets easier to connect with an electronic device that it is to connect with real people.
Author: Pablo

Quote: You said you want to became Hokage. I have become the Kazekage. If you are willing to bear the name Kage, you have to do what you must do.
Author: Masashi Kishimoto

Quote: An entire life spent reading would have fulfilled my every desire; I already knew that at the age of seven. The texture of the world is painful, inadequate; unalterable, or so it seems to me. Really, I believe that an entire life spent reading would have suited me best. Such a life has not been granted me...
Author: Michel Houellebecq,  Whatever
