Author: Billy Collins,  The Trouble With Poetry - And Other Poems

Quote: Lord, may the pain be ours, And the weakness that it brings, But at least give us the strength, Of not showing it to anyone!
Author: Fernando Pessoa,  Poems of Fernando Pessoa

Quote: Exhaust the little moment. Soon it dies.And be it gash or gold it will not comeAgain in this identical disguise.
Author: Gwendolyn Brooks,  Annie Allen

Quote: And to 'scape stormy days, I choose an everlasting night.
Author: John Donne,  The Complete English Poems

Quote: If I were splat proof, I wouldn’t be afraid of heights. Also, I wish I had a bouncy ball for a heart, so I could love fearlessly.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: I loved her, she loved him, and he loved himself. Now she loves me, he loves her, and I love myself as I am—without her in my life.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Every great movement of God can be traced to a kneeling figure.

Quote: In the realm of love and sex, it’s girls who are in the position of working hard to adapt themselves to the needs and fantasies of the mercurial males whose approval and attention they seek.
Author: Meenakshi Gigi Durham,  The Lolita Effect: The Media Sexualization of Young Girls and What We Can Do About It

Quote: I like my coffee like Colfax Avenue mixed with Atlantic Boulevard, and if you're buying then I'm driving. Let's sip this romance slowly.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: A soul mate is not found. A soul mate is recognized.
Author: Vironika Tugaleva,  The Love Mindset

Quote: ...what is romance, but a mutual pact of delusion? When the pact ends, there's nothing left.
Author: Zoë Heller,  What Was She Thinking? [Notes on a Scandal]

Quote: I love these pet names,"she said, gazing soulfully up into his eyes, "Nitwit. Sap skull. Termagant. How they make my heart flutter!
Author: Loretta Chase,  Lord of Scoundrels

Quote: And if you ever - and I do mean ever - try to leave me, I’m goin’ with you.
Author: Catherine Anderson,  Cherish

Quote: Someone once told me love isn’t perfect—or predictable.
Author: Lauren Morrill,  Meant to Be

Quote: An original writer is not one who imitates nobody, but one whom nobody can imitate.
Author: François-René de Chateaubriand,  The Genius of Christianity or the Spirit and Beauty of the Christian Religion

Quote: Aha! Today I shall become an author! And I will auth and auth and auth and make a squillion dollars, whoopee!
Author: Brian Jacques

Quote: We do not write because we want to; we write because we have to.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham

Quote: Cheekbones that cut like ice and eyes like liquid scotch. Loren Hale is an alcoholic beverage and he doesn't even know it.
Author: Krista Ritchie,  Addicted to You

Quote: I think that perhaps if I had had to slow down the ideas so that I could capture them on paper I might have stifled some of them.
Author: J.K. Rowling

Quote: If goodness has causes, it is not goodness; if it has effects, a reward, it is not goodness either. So goodness is outside the chain of cause and effect.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Quote: A good book will pull you in from the beginning and take you on a journey you'll never forget.
Author: Lauren Hammond

Quote: Let us cry for the spilt milk, by all means, if by doing so we learn how to avoid spilling any more. Let us cry for the spilt milk, and remember how, and where, and why, we spilt it. Much wisdom is learnt through tears, but none by forgetting our lessons.
Author: María Amparo Ruiz de Burton,  The Squatter and the Don

Quote: Others may write from the head, but he writes from the heart, and the heart will always understand him.
Author: Washington Irving,  the legend of Sleepy Hollow and Other Stories

Quote: Boredom is the fear of self.
Author: Marie Joséphine de Suin

Quote: I watched my life as if it were happening to someone else. My son died. And I was hurt, but I watched my hurt, and even relished it, a little, for now I could write a real death, a true loss. My heart was broken by my dark lady, and I wept, in my room, alone; but while I wept, somewhere inside I smiled.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  The Sandman, Vol. 10: The Wake

Quote: But the truth is, it's not the idea, it's never the idea, it's always what you do with it."(Online journal entry for January 31, 2009)
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: I’m an atheist, and a militant atheist when religion starts impacting on legislation.
Author: Daniel Radcliffe

Quote: If love came in a cardboard tube, I’d probably send it priority mail. But I’d make you pay for shipping.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: The faith of religion is belief on insufficient evidence.
Author: Sam Harris

Quote: There was the smell of old books, a smell that has a way of making all libraries seem the same. Some say that smell is asbestos.
Author: Scott Douglas,  Quiet, Please: Dispatches From A Public Librarian

Quote: When Eve ate the apple her knowledge increased. But God liked dumb women so Paradise ceased. Gwen Goodnight. Her Work.
Author: Jennifer Crusie,  Faking It

Quote: Religion is the opium of the poor
Author: Ernest Hemingway

"Someone can come up and be like 'Hey babe, what's your sign?' and I'll just point to my shirt."Rayne laughs appreciatively and tosses me the tank top. "Of course they might think you're pointing to your boobs in a 'have at 'em, big boy' kind of way.
Author: Mari Mancusi,  Boys that Bite

Quote: A mother’s love: the sacred relationship of affording a nanny so as to be tolerated as a granny.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: The main rule of writing is that if you do it with enough assurance and confidence, you’re allowed to do whatever you like. (That may be a rule for life as well as for writing. But it’s definitely true for writing.) So write your story as it needs to be written. Write it honestly, and tell it as best you can. I’m not sure that there are any other rules. Not ones that matter.
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: When you sit down to write, write. Don't do anything else except go to the bathroom, and only do that if it absolutely cannot be put off.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: I write description in longhand because that's hardest for me and you're closer to the paper when you work by hand, but I use the typewriter for dialogue because people speak like a typewriter works.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: Fancies are like shadows...you can't cage them, they're such wayward, dancing things.
Author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of Avonlea

Quote: School has become the world religion of a modernized proletariat, and makes futile promises of salvation to the poor of the technological age.
Author: Ivan Illich,  Deschooling Society

Quote: Lahat ng mga salitang yan may dating sa'yo. Sabi kasi ng isip mo.
Author: Bob Ong,  Stainless Longganisa

Quote: The direction in which education starts a man will determine his future life
Author: Plato

Quote: Students never appreciate their teachers while they are learning. It is only later, when they know more of the world, that they understand how indebted they are to those who instructed them. Good teachers expect no praise or love from the young. They wait for it, and in time, it comes.
Author: Darren Shan,  Vampire Mountain

Quote: Her future, she thought, was likely to be worse than her past, for after her years of contented renunciation, she had slipped back into desire and longing; she found joyless days of distasteful occupation harder and harder; she found the image of the intense and varied life she yearned for, and despaired of, becoming more and more importunate.
Author: George Eliot,  The Mill on the Floss

Quote: But my dreaming self refuses to be consoled. It continues to wander, aimless, homeless, alone. It cannot be convinced of its safety by any evidence drawn from my waking life.
Author: Margaret Atwood

Quote: Forgiveness is healing—everything is energy—thoughts create—we are all connected—what you resist persists—true love never dies—the soul’s immortality is the only true immortality—
Author: Alyson Noel,  Everlasting

Quote: Don't tell them too much about your soul. They're waiting for just that.
Author: Jack Kerouac,  Windblown World: The Journals of Jack Kerouac 1947-1954

Quote: ‎If heart filled with purity,then mind found the beauty.
Author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

Quote: It's very, very dangerous to lose contact with living nature.
Author: Albert Hofmann

Quote: I remember the hours I had spent in Father's library, drugging myself with books so I could forget my doom for an hour..
Author: Rosamund Hodge,  Cruel Beauty

Quote: Woe be to him that reads but one book.

Quote: Now begin in the middle, and later learn the beginning; the end will take care of itself.
Author: Harlan Ellison

Quote: Lolita is famous, not I. I am an obscure, doubly obscure, novelist with an unpronounceable name.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: There is a philosophy that says that if something is unobservable -- unobservable in principle -- it is not part of science. If there is no way to falsify or confirm a hypothesis, it belongs to the realm of metaphysical speculation, together with astrology and spiritualism. By that standard, most of the universe has no scientific reality -- it's just a figment of our imaginations.
Author: Leonard Susskind,  The Black Hole War: My Battle with Stephen Hawking to Make the World Safe for Quantum Mechanics

Quote: Knowing I lov'd my books, he furnish'd me From mine own library with volumes that I prize above my dukedom.
Author: William Shakespeare

Quote: A book read by a thousand different people is a thousand different books.
Author: Andrei Tarkovsky

Quote: The government will see that human spaceflight is useful - for science and the economy - and inspirational.
Author: Helen Sharman

Quote: The road to success is not easy to navigate, but with hard work, drive and passion, it's possible to achieve the American dream.
Author: Tommy Hilfiger

Quote: It's the friends you can call up at 4 a.m. that matter.
Author: Marlene Dietrich

Quote: Cultures, along with the religions that shape and nurture them, are value systems, sets of traditions and habits clustered around one or several languages, producing meaning: for the self, for the here and now, for the community, for life.
Author: Tariq Ramadan

Quote: The Gospel offers forgiveness for the past, new life for the present, and hope for the future.
Author: John Sentamu

Quote: I love myself, the way I look, my body, but sometimes I can't help but feel insecure.
Author: Lea Michele

Quote: Art is parasitic on life, just as criticism is parasitic on art.
Author: Harry S Truman

Quote: Humor can help you cope with the unbearable so that you can stay on the bright side of things until the bright side actually comes along.
Author: Allen Klein

Quote: Is there any good news?' Tesla said.Who ever promised that? Who ever said there'd be  good  news?
Author: Clive Barker,  The Great and Secret Show

Quote: Is there any good news?' Tesla said.Who ever promised that? Who ever said there'd be  good  news?
Author: Clive Barker,  The Great and Secret Show

Quote: For what it’s worth: it’s never too late to be whoever you want to be. I hope you live a life you’re proud of, and if you find that you’re not, I hope you have the strength to start all over again.
Author: Eric Roth

Quote: CLAUDIA: I love you as high as the sky and as deep as the sea.MICHAEL: Multiply my love by infinity and take it to the depths of forever, and you still have only a glimpse of how much I feel for you. I love you more.
Author: Mary Ting,  Crossroads

Quote: Cannibals? Who is not a cannibal? I tell you it will be more tolerable for the Fejee that salted down a lean missionary in his cellar against a coming famine; it will be more tolerable for that provident Fejee, I say, in the day of judgement, than for thee, civilized and enlightened gourmand, who nailest geese to the ground and feastest on their bloated livers in thy pate de fois gras.
Author: Herman Melville,  Moby Dick

Quote: A prince must not have any other object nor any other thought… but war, its institutions, and its discipline; because that is the only art befitting one who commands.
Author: Niccolò Machiavelli,  The Prince

Quote: The final belief is to believe in a fiction, which you know to be a fiction, there being nothing else. The exquisite truth is to know that it is a fiction and that you believe in it willingly.
Author: Wallace Stevens,  Opus Posthumous: Poems, Plays, Prose

Quote: No man was ever yet a great poet, without at the same time being a profound philosopher.
Author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

Quote: No man was ever yet a great poet, without at the same time being a profound philosopher.
Author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge

Quote: I used to think I knew what was right and what was wrong, and who the good guys are, and who the bad guys are. Then the world got very gray, and I didn't know anything for a long time
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton,  Incubus Dreams

Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Jangan pikirkan kamu akan sampai di mana dan kapan. Tidak ada yang tahu.Your strength is simply your will to go on.Supernova: Partikel

Quote: One has to take a somewhat bold and dangerous line with this existence: especially as, whatever happens, we are bound to lose it.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Untimely Meditations

Quote: Today is the only day in which we have any power.

Author: Ahmad Fuadi

Quote: I felt as if I were walking with destiny, and that all my past life had been but a preparation for this hour and for this trial... I thought I knew a good deal about it all, I was sure I should not fail.
Author: Winston S. Churchill,  The Second World War

Quote: I can't say this strongly enough, but our feelings about ourselves are actually the most important barometer for determining the condition of our lives!
Author: Anita Moorjani,  Dying to Be Me: My Journey from Cancer, to Near Death, to True Healing

Quote: A miracle, my friend, is an event which creates faith.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: You teach people how to treat you.
Author: Oprah Winfrey

Quote: ‎"Belki de hayat yanlış anlayınca güzeldi. Sadece yanlış anlayınca. Ama her şeyi.
Author: Hakan Günday,  Az

Quote: Nothing exists but you. And you are but a thought.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Learning without thinking is useless, but thinking without learning is very dangerous!
Author: Sukarno,  Di Bawah Bendera Revolusi : Jilid 1

Quote: What is a personal calling? It is God's blessing, it is the path that God chose for you here on Earth. Whenever we do something that fills us with enthusiasm, we are following our legend. However, we don't all have the courage to confront our own dream.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Be happy for no reason, like a child. If you are happy for a reason, you’re in trouble, because that reason can be taken from you.
Author: Deepak Chopra

Quote: Wonder is the beginning of wisdom in learning from books as well as from nature.
Author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Bestselling Guide to Reading Books and Accessing Information

Author: Aldous Huxley,  Brave New World Revisited

Author: William Safire

Quote: Happiness lies for those who cry, those who hurt, those who have searched, and those who have tried for only they can appreciate the importance of people who have touched their lives.
Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: You are beautiful. Your beauty, just like your capacity for life, happiness, and success, is immeasurable.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: When you think of the long and gloomy history of man, you will find more hideous crimes have been committed in the name of obedience than have ever been committed in the name of rebellion.
Author: C.P. Snow

Quote: At times anger will trigger harsh words. After a cooling period wisdom sets in; finally, the ability to speak from the heart with love and compassion.
Author: Ana Monnar,  Relax: New And Selected Poems: New And Selected Poems

Quote: A woman who surrenders her freedom need not surrender her dignity.
Author: Wally Lamb,  The Hour I First Believed

Quote: The only horrible thing in the world is ennui.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: An important decision I made was to resist playing the Blame Game. The day I realized that I am in charge of how I will approach problems in my life, that things will turn out better or worse because of me and nobody else, that was the day I knew I would be a happier and healthier person. And that was the day I knew I could truly build a life that matters.
Author: Steve Goodier

Quote: An ordinary man can surround himself with two thousand books and thenceforward have at least one place in the world in which it is always possible to be happy.
Author: Augustine Birrell

Quote: You are an ocean in a drop of dew,all the universes in a thin sack of blood.What are these pleasures then,these joys, these worldsthat you keep reaching for,hoping they will make you more alive?
Author: Rumi

Quote: Bitter your acts, bitter am I,Kindness your deeds, kindness am I,Pleasant and gentle, so you are,Fine honeyed lips and sweet talker.
Author: Rumi,  Love: The Joy That Wounds: The Love Poems of Rumi

Quote: The business of being happy requires making a conscious choice. People think being happy will just happen to them someday, if only they do this or that right. But it doesn't - you have to choose it. You choose happiness, you don't wait for it to choose you.
Author: Bethenny Frankel,  A Place of Yes: 10 Rules for Getting Everything You Want Out of Life

Quote: You must remember this feeling, Jon.The feeling of being happy. It doesn't happen often but when it does, you must grab it with both hands and hold it close. Let it overwhelm you. Don'tover analyse any emotion. But remember it. Always remember it.
Author: pleasefindthis,  Intentional Dissonance

Quote: The whole problem with the world is that fools and fanatics are always so certain of themselves, and wiser people so full of doubts.
Author: Bertrand Russell

Quote: What would it be like to look in the mirror and actually accept what you see? Not loathe the reflection, or despise it, or be resigned to it? But to like it?
Author: Justina Chen,  North of Beautiful

Quote: Whatever demon invented stiletto-heeled boots should roast in hell...
Author: Cherise Sinclair,  Lean on Me

Quote: The master of the garden is the one who waters it, trims the branches, plants the seeds, and pulls the weeds. If you merely stroll through the garden, you are but an acolyte.
Author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

Quote: The master of the garden is the one who waters it, trims the branches, plants the seeds, and pulls the weeds. If you merely stroll through the garden, you are but an acolyte.
Author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

Quote: I bought you a gift. It’s something I’ve always wanted, but I’m not quite sure you’ll like it. So if you don’t want it just tell me and I’ll be happy to keep it. After all, I’m only interested in making you happy.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: Don't put off happiness you can have today. Tomorrow is a hope, not a promise
Author: Debra Anastasia

Quote: Don't put off happiness you can have today. Tomorrow is a hope, not a promise
Author: Debra Anastasia

Quote: Chaos is more freedom; in fact, total freedom. But no meaning.
Author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

Quote: Perhaps wisdom is simply a matter of waiting, and healing a question of time. And anything good you've ever been given is yours forever.
Author: Rachel Naomi Remen

Quote: Don't despair: despair suggests you are in total control and know what is coming. You don't - surrender to events with hope.
Author: Alain de Botton

Quote: At times one remains faithful to a cause only because its opponents do not cease to be insipid.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Time was the most precious thing in the world to me, and I’d just given her all of it. Because I was falling for her. Because I cared for her. Because I wanted to give her something to remember me by, even if it would eventually fade like its namesake. Time… what an absolute horror-inducing word
Author: Rachel Van Dyken,  Ruin

Quote: I have nothing now but praise for my life. I'm not unhappy. I cry a lot because I miss people. They die and I can't stop them. They leave me and I love them more...
Author: Maurice Sendak

Quote: My pride shut me up, my hurt shut me down, and together they ganged up on my hope and let her get away.
Author: David Levithan,  Nick & Norah's Infinite Playlist

Quote: Mind led bodyto the edge of the precipice.They stared in desireat the naked abyss.If you love me, said mind,take that step into silence.If you love me, said body,turn and exist.
Author: Anne Stevenson

Quote: Mind led bodyto the edge of the precipice.They stared in desireat the naked abyss.If you love me, said mind,take that step into silence.If you love me, said body,turn and exist.
Author: Anne Stevenson

Quote: The monster nevers dies.
Author: Stephen King,  Cujo

Quote: The primary purpose of prayer is not to make requests. The primary purpose is to praise, to sing, to chant. Because the essence of prayer is a song, and man cannot live without a song. Prayer may not save us. But prayer may make us worthy of being saved.
Author: Abraham Joshua Heschel,  Moral Grandeur and Spiritual Audacity: Essays

Quote: What looks like politics, and imagines itself to be political, will one day unmask itself as a religious movement.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard

Quote: What looks like politics, and imagines itself to be political, will one day unmask itself as a religious movement.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard

Quote: At times I believed that the last page of my book and the last page of my life were one and the same, that when my book ended I'd end, a great wind would sweep through my rooms carrying the pages away, and when the air cleared of all those fluttering white sheets the room would be silent, the chair where I sat empty.
Author: Nicole Krauss,  The History of Love

Quote: At times I believed that the last page of my book and the last page of my life were one and the same, that when my book ended I'd end, a great wind would sweep through my rooms carrying the pages away, and when the air cleared of all those fluttering white sheets the room would be silent, the chair where I sat empty.
Author: Nicole Krauss,  The History of Love

Quote: I have said that the soul is not more than the body,And I have said that the body is not more than the soul,And nothing, not God, is greater to one than one's-self is,
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: I have said that the soul is not more than the body,And I have said that the body is not more than the soul,And nothing, not God, is greater to one than one's-self is,
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: The humble sinner will sometimes be interpreted as one of the filthiest in the eyes of man yet immersed in the eyes of God, and this is due to the volition of honesty regarding his own corruption.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Sure, I had hopes and dreams before working at @McDonalds. I used to want to be a dancer and a gardener and grow movement on a farm in Iowa.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: CONCERNED BUT NOT CONSUMED!
Author: Ron Sanders

Quote: CONCERNED BUT NOT CONSUMED!
Author: Ron Sanders

Quote: CONCERNED BUT NOT CONSUMED!
Author: Ron Sanders

Quote: The opposite of the religious fanatic is not the fanatical atheist but the gentle cynic who cares not whether there is a god or not.
Author: Eric Hoffer

Quote: You're dead, George. You just don't have the sense to lie down.
Author: Stephen King,  The Dark Half

Quote: Men die. It's practically what they're for.
Author: Catherynne M. Valente,  Deathless

Quote: Whatever negative things people think and say about you is enough to bring you down provided you belief that it carries a weight that can push you hard. Don't agree to accept what critics say; be prepared to silence them by doing what they think you can't do!
Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

Quote: Hell is truth known too late.
Author: J.C. Ryle,  Practical Religion

Quote: One of the most beneficial and valuable gifts we can give to ourselves in this life: is allowing ourselves to be surprised! It is okay if life surprises you. Its a good thing!
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: It's always seemed to me that flirtation is a man's device for avoiding responsibility. He can say whatever he wants and knows he won't be taken seriously.
Author: G.G. Vandagriff,  The Last Waltz

Quote: You see how I tryTo reach with wordsWhat matters mostAnd how I fail.
Author: Czesław Miłosz

Quote: I should combine a car bumper with a belt, for a fashion accessory that’s safe for office romances. Powdered love poetry sold separately.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Even this late it happens:the coming of love, the coming of light.
Author: Mark Strand,  Selected Poems

Quote: Sometimes with one I love, I fill myself with rage, for fear I effuse unreturn'd love; But now I think there is no unreturn'd love—the pay is certain, one way or another; (I loved a certain person ardently, and my love was not return'd; Yet out of that, I have written these songs.)
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: Twas the night before Thanksgiving. All the food's in the oven. And I'm in the bedroom performin' self lovin'.
Author: Craig Ferguson

Quote: It is time to float on the waters of the night. Time to wrap my arms around this book and press it to my chest, life preserver in a sea of unremarkable men and women, anonymous faces on the street, a hundred thousand unalphabetized things, a million forgotten hours.
Author: Billy Collins,  Picnic, Lightning

Quote: It is time to float on the waters of the night. Time to wrap my arms around this book and press it to my chest, life preserver in a sea of unremarkable men and women, anonymous faces on the street, a hundred thousand unalphabetized things, a million forgotten hours.
Author: Billy Collins,  Picnic, Lightning

Quote: Love me like a wrong turn on a bad roadlate at night.
Author: Kim Addonizio

Quote: Love me like a wrong turn on a bad roadlate at night.
Author: Kim Addonizio

Quote: I fell for you like the stars fall from the sky. Flames and light and twinkle dust, our burning love showered the night. The dust has been collecting since the day you left, and I dare not leave even one fingerprint in it, because one should never try to touch the past.-Crystal Woods and Jarod Kintz
Author: Crystal Woods,  liQUID PROse QUOtes

Quote: You may not be here with me now, but you've never left me, because I keep you close to my heart, and always on my mind. And I will sit under your shade forever, until I become a part of you, the way you are a part of me.-Jarod Kintz and Crystal Woods
Author: Jarod Kintz,  liQUID PROse QUOtes

Quote: Alone, alone, all, all alone, Alone on a wide wide sea! And never a saint took pity on My soul in agony.
Author: Samuel Taylor Coleridge,  The Rime of the Ancient Mariner

Quote: I use two yards of wrapping paper per one inch of present. Luckily I gave you the gift of love, so I was able to wrap it in tinfoil. Uncover before reheating.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: Relationship gurus always said that an attraction based on friendship and mutual respect was far more likely to stay the course - and the bastards were right.
Author: Marian Keyes,  The Other Side of the Story

Quote: I have never bought into the idea that blood is thicker than water. Love and respect are meant to be earned from our children, our spouses, our families, and our friends.
Author: Raquel Cepeda,  Bird of Paradise: How I Became Latina

Quote: He announces that lately he keeps losing things. "Like your wife and child,"I want to say, but don´t. At fourty, I´ve learned not to say everything clever, not to score every point.
Author: Suzanne Finnamore,  Split: A Memoir of Divorce

Quote: Most people think everybody feels about them much more violently than they actually do; they think other people's opinions of them swing through great arcs of approval or disapproval.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  Tender Is the Night

Quote: Reports that say that something hasn't happened are always interesting to me, because as we know, there are known knowns; there are things we know we know. We also know there are known unknowns; that is to say we know there are some things we do not know. But there are also unknown unknowns- the ones we don't know we don't know.
Author: Donald Rumsfeld

Quote: in times like the present, men should utter nothing for which they would not willingly be responsible through time and eternity.
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: You might think that a boy is just your friend, but then if you find out that maybe he likes you (in a boyfriend way), everything changes instantly. (47)
Author: Charise Mericle Harper,  Flashcards of My Life

Quote: You will be a great queen when you come back, you know. And someday you'll love me the way you love your wolf.
Author: Carrie Jones,  Entice

Quote: Goodness had nothing to do with it.
Author: Mae West,  She Done Him Wrong

Quote: Never be afraid to tell me anything,” he whispered against her hair. “No matter how ashamed you might feel. I’ll never judge you, Rachel. I love you.
Author: Maya Banks,  The Darkest Hour

Quote: Want to know the best part of being a warlord?' came a hoarse whisper.I bit my lip, puzzled by the question.Keir’s mouth curled up slowly into a smile. 'I always get what I want.
Author: Elizabeth Vaughan,  Warprize

Quote: It all comes down to who is by your side and who is willing to stand up for love even when it seems impossible.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  A Walk to Remember

Quote: Someone said, 'The dead writers are remote from us because we know so much more than they did.' Precisely, and they are that which we know.
Author: T.S. Eliot,  Selected Essays

Quote: The soil needs the seed and the seed needs the soil. The one only has meaning with the other. It is the same thing with human beings. When male knowledge joins with female transformation, then the great magical union is created, and its name is wisdom. Wisdom means both to know and to transform.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

Quote: Often the hands will solve a mystery that the intellect has struggled with in vain.
Author: C.G. Jung

Quote: A break up is the closest thing to bereavement
Author: Lindsey Kelk,  I Heart New York

Quote: The split in America, rather than simply economic, is between those who embrace reason, who function in the real world of cause and effect, and those who, numbed by isolation and despair, now seek meaning in a mythical world of intuition, a world that is no longer reality-based, a world of magic.
Author: Chris Hedges,  American Fascists: The Christian Right and the War on America

Author: Chris Hedges,  American Fascists: The Christian Right and the War on America

Quote: I wasn't born to cook or clean,but to read and write,if you don't like me the way I am,then go fly a kite.
Author: Besa Kosova

Quote: Stuff your brain with knowledge.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Stuff your brain with knowledge.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Stuff your brain with knowledge.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Anyone who is going to be a writer knows enough at fifteen to write several novels.
Author: May Sarton

Quote: Think of what starlight And lamplight would lack Diamonds and fireflies If they couldn’t lean against Black. . . .
Author: Mary O'Neill,  Hailstones and Halibut Bones

Quote: I have been called arrogant myself in my time, and hope to earn the title again, but to claim that I am privy to the secrets of the universe and its creator - that's beyond my conceit.
Author: Christopher Hitchens

Quote: Moods can be contagious. Don't catch or spread a bad mood.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: Moods can be contagious. Don't catch or spread a bad mood.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: They may try to stop you by their words and deeds, but like air you will rise above it all. You are unstoppable
Author: Bernard Kelvin Clive,  Your Dreams Will Not Die

Quote: I've come to realize that sometimes, what you love most is what you have to fight the hardest to keep.
Author: Kirsten Hubbard,  Wanderlove

Quote: Everything you need is already within you. The beauty of life is that your DESTINY lies always in your hands. The time has come for you to STEP UP and BE GREAT
Author: Pablo

Quote: salvation is for the feeble, that's what I think. I don't want salvation, I want life, all of life, the miserable as well as the superb.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Jitterbug Perfume

Quote: I need words that mean more than they mean, words not just with height and width, but depth and weight and, and other dimensions that I cannot even name.
Author: Lois McMaster Bujold,  The Curse of Chalion

Quote: Solitude is the house of peace.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: I am, he thought dimly, watching a vampire take a piss.
Author: Stephen King

Quote: Plus, in one of his e-mails, the guy said he didn't like pancakes. What kind of asshole doesn't like pancakes?
Author: A.J. Jacobs,  The Guinea Pig Diaries: My Life as an Experiment

Quote: On savings: A dollar here, a dollar there. Over time, it adds up to two dollars.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

Quote: I hate when I'm at the grocery store and the person checking me out asks, "Paper or plastic?"It's offensive. As if I'm going to sleep with her just because she has a clever pick up line.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  It Occurred to Me

Quote: Love is an empty bottle, and it makes my heart thirsty thinking how fast I chugged it
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: My advice to writers just starting out? Don't use semi-colons! They are transvestite hermaphrodites, representing exactly nothing. All they do is suggest you might have gone to college.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Armageddon in Retrospect

Quote: It is dark. You cannot see. Only the hint of stars out the broken window. And a voice as old as the Snake from the Garden whispers, 'I will hold your hand.
Author: John Wick

Quote: The recipe for great art has always been misery and a good bowel movement.
Author: Don Roff

Quote: As with many people, Charles, who could not talk, wrote with fullness. He set down his loneliness and his perplexities, and he put on paper many things he did not know about himself.
Author: John Steinbeck,  East of Eden

Quote: Learning is not cumpulsory... neither is survival.
Author: W. Edwards Deming

Quote: We can best help children learn, not by deciding what we think they should learn and thinking of ingenious ways to teach it to them, but by making the world, as far as we can, accessible to them, paying serious attention to what they do, answering their questions -- if they have any -- and helping them explore the things they are most interested in.
Author: John Holt

Quote: If football players wanted to protect their brains from injury they’d wear astronaut helmets. After all, astronauts have massive IQ’s, so wearing their protective headgear seems like a smart choice.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: My skull needs a tornado inside, to clean out my thoughts. I’ll call Kansas tomorrow to see if I can rent one for the day.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: The great aim of education is not knowledge but action.
Author: Herbert Spencer

Quote: Merely having an open mind is nothing. The object of opening the mind, as of opening the mouth, is to shut it again on something solid.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: You have to wait for your mind to catch up with whatever it is it’s working on; then you can write a novel.
Author: James M. Cain

Quote: If you want to give yourself a fair chance to succeed, never expect too much too soon
Author: Po Bronson

Quote: Early success is a terrible teacher. You're essentially being rewarded for a lack of preparation, so when you find yourself in a situation where you must prepare, you can't do it. You don't know how.
Author: Chris Hadfield,  An Astronaut's Guide to Life on Earth

Quote: Don't tie your success to anything other than what's inside you
Author: Debra Anastasia,  Poughkeepsie

Quote: One learns from books and example only that certain things can be done. Actual learning requires that you do those things.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Children of Dune

Quote: If you do not have persistence then no amount of education, talent or genius can make up for it.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: …the greatest service we can do to education today is to teach fewer subjects. No one has time to do more than a very few things well before he is twenty, and when we force a boy to be a mediocrity in a dozen subjects, we destroy his standards, perhaps for life.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  Surprised by Joy: The Shape of My Early Life

Quote: It's no use saying, "We are doing our best."You have got to succeed in doing what is necessary.
Author: Winston S. Churchill

Quote: Tell me I didn't imagine it, Leo. Tell me that even though our bodies were in seperate states, our star selves shared an enchanted place. Tell me that right around noon today (eastern time) you had the strangest sensation: a tiny chill on your shoulder...a flutter in the heart...a shadow of strawberry-banana crossing your tongue...tell me you whispered my name.
Author: Jerry Spinelli

Quote: Books are the compasses and telescopes and sextants and charts which other men have prepared to help us navigate the dangerous seas of human life.
Author: Jesse Lee Bennett

Quote: Consciousness cannot be accounted for in physical terms. For consciousness is absolutely fundamental. It cannot be accounted for in terms of anything else.
Author: Erwin Schrödinger

Quote: Did you ever hear anyone say, 'That work had better be banned because I might read it and it might be very damaging to me'?
Author: Joseph Henry Jackson

Quote: Every face, every shop, bedroom window, public-house, and dark square is a picture feverishly turned--in search of what? It is the same with books. What do we seek through millions of pages?
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Jacob's Room

Quote: Always have an air of expectancy.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: This must be what an addict feels like, I think, trying to fight the pull of one last, quick read. My fingers itch toward the binding, and finally, with a sigh of regret, I just grab the book and open it, hungrily reading the story.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Between the Lines

Quote: The thing about Tolkien, about The Lord of the Rings, is that it's perfect. It's this whole world, this whole process of immersion, this journey. It's not, I'm pretty sure, actually true, but that makes it more amazing, that someone could make it all up. Reading it changes everything.
Author: Jo Walton,  Among Others

Quote: The way to find out about our place in the universe is by examining the universe and by examining ourselves - without preconceptions, with as unbiased a mind as we can muster.
Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: And what would happen if we never read the classics? There comes a point in life, it seems to me, where you have to decide whether you're a Person of Letters or merely someone who loves books, and I'm beginning to see that the book lovers have more fun.
Author: Nick Hornby,  Housekeeping vs. the Dirt

Quote: History repeats, but science reverberates.
Author: Siddhartha Mukherjee,  The Emperor of All Maladies: A Biography of Cancer

Quote: They keep saying that sea levels are rising an' all this. It's nowt to do with the icebergs melting, it's because there's too many fish in it. Get rid of some of the fish and the water will drop. Simple. Basic science.
Author: Karl Pilkington,  The Ricky Gervais Show - First, Second and Third Seasons

Quote: People wrap themselves in their beliefs. And they do it in such a way that you can't set them free. Not even the truth will set them free.
Author: Michael Specter

Quote: Leave me with my leftover meatloaf and my Yesterday Sandwich. I’ll be in love tomorrow, if you come back with the ketchup.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. And the ageless sages.

Quote: I felt alone on the planet, drifting through the cosmos. With both hands I reached out to the night. There was no answer. Or maybe I just couldn't hear it.
Author: Jerry Spinelli,  Love, Stargirl

Quote: My body is an ugly masterpiece that lives off the beauty of sound.
Author: Chad Sugg

Quote: To pursue wisdom is to live in such a way that one is prepared to face death when it comes. (247)
Author: Gregory Bassham,  The Ultimate Harry Potter and Philosophy: Hogwarts for Muggles

Quote: Why' is a crooked letter and can't be made straight.
Author: Stephen King,  The Gunslinger

Quote: Only by examining our personal biases can we truly grow as artists; only by cultivating empathy can we truly grow as people.
Author: Jen Knox,  After the Gazebo

Quote: Only by examining our personal biases can we truly grow as artists; only by cultivating empathy can we truly grow as people.

Quote: When you're strong and good, then you're Bad.
Author: Michael Jackson

Quote: I suppose we'll never know what really happened in that room, though he did tell police, "I did it because I'm a dirty dog."This is not a very convincing alibi. He may as well have said, "I got 99 problems, but a bitch ain't one.
Author: Chuck Klosterman,  Killing Yourself to Live: 85% of a True Story

Quote: We are built for the valley, for the ordinary stuff we are in, and that is where we have to prove our mettle.
Author: Oswald Chambers

Quote: It's only natural to feel lonely after the enjoyable moments pass. But as you experience new joys those feelings of sorrow will start to fade.
Author: Mizu Sahara

Quote: It's sad if people think that's (homemaking) a dull existance, [but] you can't just buy an apartment and furnish it and walk away. It's the flowers you choose, the music you play, the smile you have waiting. I want it to be gay and cheerful, a haven in this troubled world. I don't want my husband and children to come home and find a rattled woman. Our era is already rattled enough, isn't it?
Author: Audrey Hepburn

Quote: If someone tells you you're not beautiful, turn around and walk away so they canhave a great view of your fabulous ass.
Author: Miley Cyrus

Quote: I don't ask for the meaning of the song of a bird or the rising of the sun on a misty morning. There they are, and they are beautiful.
Author: Pete Hamill

Quote: Philosophers can debate the meaning of life, but you need a Lord who can declare the meaning of life.
Author: Max Lucado,  Traveling Light: Releasing the Burdens You Were Never Intended to Bear

Quote: Philosophers can debate the meaning of life, but you need a Lord who can declare the meaning of life.
Author: Max Lucado,  Traveling Light: Releasing the Burdens You Were Never Intended to Bear

Quote: We...sin not because we want what is evil, but because we want what isn't good enough.
Author: Scott Hahn,  Lord, Have Mercy: The Healing Power of Confession

Quote: We...sin not because we want what is evil, but because we want what isn't good enough.
Author: Scott Hahn,  Lord, Have Mercy: The Healing Power of Confession

Quote: Because each of you has his or her own death, you carry it with you in a secret place from the moment you're born, it belongs to you and you belong to it.
Author: José Saramago

Quote: Because each of you has his or her own death, you carry it with you in a secret place from the moment you're born, it belongs to you and you belong to it.
Author: José Saramago

Quote: When did wishing someone a Merry Christmas become politically incorrect?
Author: Suzanne Woods Fisher,  A Lancaster County Christmas

Quote: Life is so short. The only person you hurt when you stay angry or hold grudges is you. Forgive everyone, including yourself.
Author: Tom Giaquinto

Quote: and we laugh and laugh andall I know isat this moment I feel likeI can do anything I wantand be anyone I wantand go anywhere on the globeand still call it home
Author: Kirsten Smith,  The Geography of Girlhood

Quote: What would a narrative of happiness be like? All that can be described is what prepares it, and then what destroys it.
Author: André Gide,  The Immoralist

Quote: What a sad story, I thought for so long. Not that I now think it was happy. But I think it is true, and thus the question of whether it is sad or happy has no meaning whatever.
Author: Bernhard Schlink,  The Reader

Quote: They say that patriotism is the last refuge to which a scoundrel clings steal a little and they throw you in jail. Steal a lot and then they make you king.
Author: Bob Dylan

Quote: They say that patriotism is the last refuge to which a scoundrel clings steal a little and they throw you in jail. Steal a lot and then they make you king.
Author: Bob Dylan

Quote: The truth is seldom welcome, especially at dinner.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  Morning in the Burned House

Quote: It don't do you no nevermind to tell nobody nothing.
Author: Thomas McGuane

Quote: Misfortunes make us wise
Author: Mary Norton,  The Borrowers Afield

Quote: Never pause unless you have a reason for it, but when you pause, pause as long as you can.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham,  Theatre

Quote: truth is that which makes a people certain, clear, and strong.
Author: Martin Heidegger

Quote: Happiness doesn't always come from a pursuit. Sometimes it comes when we least expect it.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: And hard times are good in their own way, too. Because the only way you can achieve true happiness is if you experience true sadness as well. It's all about light and shade. Balance.
Author: Gabrielle Williams,  Beatle Meets Destiny

Quote: Science, my boy, is made up of mistakes, but they are mistakes which it is useful to make, because they lead little by little to the truth.
Author: Jules Verne,  Journey to the Center of the Earth

Author: Friedrich Schiller

Quote: Mine was a patchwork God, sewn together from bits of rag and ribbon, Eastern and Western, pagan and Hebrew, everything but the kitchen sink and Jesus.
Author: Anne Lamott,  Traveling Mercies: Some Thoughts on Faith

Quote: If there's a God out there, then i would hope he has more important things to attend to than my drinking scotch or eating pork.
Author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner: A Portrait of the Marc Forster Film

Quote: He hath never failed thee yet.Never will His love forget.O fret not thyself nor letThy heart be troubled,Neither let it be afraid.
Author: Amy Carmichael

Quote: Death is another bar which lies several steps below the normal world. I'm at its threshold, but not yet in it. Its doorway is doorless.
Author: Kathy Acker,  Pussy, King of the Pirates

Quote: On every level of life, from housework to heights of prayer, in all judgment and efforts to get things done, hurry and impatience are sure marks of the amateur.
Author: Evelyn Underhill

Quote: Think of God and not religion, of ecstasy and not mysticism. The difference between the theoretician of faith and the believer is as great as between the psychiatrist and the psychotic.
Author: Emil Cioran

Quote: Think of God and not religion, of ecstasy and not mysticism. The difference between the theoretician of faith and the believer is as great as between the psychiatrist and the psychotic.
Author: Emil Cioran

Quote: If you love someone, you're not supposed to want them to come back. Better a peaceful sleep in the earth than the life of a zombie--not really dead but not really alive, either.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Zombies Vs. Unicorns

Quote: It is not needful for our dreams to be very grand nor very big. It is only needful for our dreams to be very shiny.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: You know, there are good reasons to learn how to read. Poetry isn't one of them. I mean, so what if two roads go two ways in a wood? So what? Who cares if it made all that big a difference? What difference? And why should I have to guess what the difference is? Isn't that what he's supposed to say?Why can't poets just say what they want to say and then shut up?
Author: Gary D. Schmidt,  Okay for Now

Quote: No one wants to read poetry. You have to make it impossible for them to put the poem down--impossible for them to stop reading it, word after word. You have to keep them from closing the book.
Author: Muriel Rukeyser

Quote: No one wants to read poetry. You have to make it impossible for them to put the poem down--impossible for them to stop reading it, word after word. You have to keep them from closing the book.
Author: Muriel Rukeyser

Quote: Resolve, and thou art free.
Author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow,  Flower-de-Luce, and the Masque of Pandora

Quote: That was the day that I promised I'd never sing of love that does not exist. but darling, You are the only exception
Author: Hayley Williams

Quote: To love everyone unconditionally does not mean to give everyone your unconditional time. Sometimes, to love completely, we must never see someone again. This, too, is love. This is giving someone the freedom to exist and be happy, even if it must be without you.
Author: Vironika Tugaleva

Quote: There’s nothing you can’t do if you want it bad enough.
Author: Danielle Sibarium,  For Always

Quote: I am—yet what I am none cares or knows; My friends forsake me like a memory lost: I am the self-consumer of my woes— They rise and vanish in oblivious host, Like shadows in love’s frenzied stifled throes And yet I am, and live—like vapours tossed
Author: John Clare,  "I Am": The Selected Poetry of John Clare

Quote: Uh-uh, dude. I tried it your way with the dating and the girls and the kissing and the drama, and man, I didn't like it. Plus, my best friend is a walking cautionary tale of what happens to you when romantic relationships don't involve marriage. Like you always say, kafir, everything ends in breakup, divorce, or death. I want to narrow my misery options to divorce or death - that's all.
Author: John Green,  An Abundance of Katherines

Quote: Fiction is a solution, the best solution, to the problem of existential solitude.
Author: Jonathan Franzen,  The Corrections

Quote: A man who denies his past is a man who truly denies himself a future, for he refuses to know himself, and to deny knowledge of oneself is to stumble through life as handicapped as the blind mute.
Author: Tobsha Learner,  The Witch of Cologne

Quote: A man who denies his past is a man who truly denies himself a future, for he refuses to know himself, and to deny knowledge of oneself is to stumble through life as handicapped as the blind mute.
Author: Tobsha Learner,  The Witch of Cologne

Quote: Everybody deserves love, but nobody is entitled to it.
Author: Katerina Stoykova Klemer

Quote: Il pleure dans mon coeurComme il pleut sur la ville.Tears are shed in my heart like the rain on the town.
Author: Paul Verlaine,  One Hundred and One Poems by Paul Verlaine: A Bilingual Edition

Quote: Segala luka & kecewa tampaknya kan malu & meniada: ketika kita insyafi bahwa Allah Yang Maha Mengatur tak pernah keliru, tak pernah aniaya
Author: Salim Akhukum Fillah

Quote: Love's mysteries in souls do grow,But yet the body is his book.
Author: John Donne,  The Complete English Poems

Quote: Love's mysteries in souls do grow,But yet the body is his book.
Author: John Donne,  The Complete English Poems

Quote: While she could hardly fathom what had just happened to her that night, she reached some conclusions before she fell asleep, certain things now made perfect sense; Moon River didn’t sound so syrupy, mistletoe wasn’t such a bad idea, and perhaps dating was not such a frivolous waste of time after all.
Author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

Quote: When they see us dance. When they see how you look at me. When they see how I smile at you.
Author: Philippa Gregory,  The Other Boleyn Girl

Quote: You've got an awfully kissable mouth.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  Gatsby Girls

Quote: You've got an awfully kissable mouth.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald,  Gatsby Girls

Quote: Some people like the Jews, and some do not. But no thoughtful man can deny the fact that they are, beyond any question, the most formidable and most remarkable race which has appeared in the world.— Winston S. Churchill
Author: Ellen Brazer,  Clouds Across the Sun

Quote: If I am never to have you again after this night, this moment, you will remain the wife of my soul. Keeper of my heart.
Author: Penelope Williamson,  A Wild Yearning

Quote: I stare at her for a long moment. I want to kiss her. I want to kiss her more than I've ever wanted anything in my life.
Author: Sara Gruen,  Water for Elephants

Quote: How much time do I get in exchange for that rose?”For the rose, a short engagement. For the speech, you get a lifetime.”I can live with that,” he said, and kissed her.
Author: Laura Lee Guhrke,  Guilty Pleasures

Quote: With every breath I take, I will always love you.
Author: Jennifer L. Armentrout,  Every Last Breath

Quote: Writer's block is just a symptom of feeling like you have nothing to say, combined with the rather weird idea that you should feel the need to say something. Why? If you have something to say, then say it. If not, enjoy the silence while it lasts. The noise will return soon enough.
Author: Hugh MacLeod,  Ignore Everybody: and 39 Other Keys to Creativity

Quote: It's such a silly little thing, the heart.
Author: Ned Vizzini,  It's Kind of a Funny Story

Quote: Cael, come on. Stop licking the dude. That's gross."Letty let out a snort. "Please, like you don't lick dudes.""That's different,"Dex explained with a grimace. "None of those dudes were Ash. Besides, last time I checked, Ash was allergic to nuts.
Author: Charlie Cochet,  Hell & High Water

Quote: Don’t overact the story of your name. Overact the story of your work.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Anything we fully do is an alone journey.
Author: Natalie Goldberg

Quote: When you have a good romance, find ways to make their lives miserable and hellish...Do you think 'Titanic' would have been so popular if they had both lived? Not a prayer.
Author: Orson Scott Card

Quote: Iniisip ni Lucas kung gaano kalaki ang kapangyarihan ng isang writer. Sa pamamagitan ng mga salita ay kaya niyang patigilin ang dyip, ilabas ang lihim ng mga pasahero, pabuhusin ang ulan upang linisin ang mga basura sa palibot, ikulong ang mga opisyal na corrupt at tuluyang i-delete sa bansa ang kahirapan.
Author: Ricky Lee,  Para Kay B

Quote: The worst thing you can do is censor yourself as the pencil hits the paper. You must not edit until you get it all on paper. If you can put everything down, stream-of-consciousness, you'll do yourself a service.
Author: Stephen Sondheim

Quote: Senses of humor define people, as factions, deeper rooted than religious or political opinions. When carrying out everyday tasks, opinions are rather easy to set aside, but those whom a person shares a sense of humor with are his closest friends. They are always there to make the biggest influence.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: I try hard not to judge anyone, and I try to bless everyone who is a part of my life, particularly anyone with whom I am having any problems
Author: Jim Henson,  It's Not Easy Being Green: And Other Things to Consider

Quote: To only responsible choice I can make is to be love and happiness."Vincellent"Love the world as you love yourself".Lao Tze"The next step in mans evolution will be the survival of the wisest.
Author: Deepak Chopra

Quote: I imagine what would happen if everyone turned their regrets into wishes, went around shouting them.
Author: Nina LaCour

Quote: You can't hide the thunderbolt. When it hits you, everybody can see it. Christ, man, don't be ashamed of it, some men pray for the thunderbolt. You're a very lucky fellow. - Calo
Author: Mario Puzo,  The Godfather

Quote: Novels give you the matrix of emotions, give you the flavour of a time in a way formal history cannot.
Author: Doris Lessing

Quote: You can approach the act of writing with nervousness, excitement, hopefulness, or despair ... Come to it any way but lightly.
Author: Stephen King,  On Writing: A Memoir of the Craft

Quote: Having beef with someone is unnecessary and avoidable. Whatever the issue, if not positive, it is an opportunity to cut the excess fat from an unhealthy dietary network. Simply excuse yourself from the table of negativity and lean forward in peace.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Indeed, it's futile to try and use Holy Scripture to support any political position. I deeply distrust anyone who does. Just look at what an Islamic Republic is like.
Author: Christopher Hitchens

Quote: Nerd life is just so much better than regular life.
Author: John Green

Quote: Marc’s hand tightened visibly around Kevin’s fingers, his digits going white. Again. Both men clenched their jaws, Kevin in pain, and Marc in an obvious effort to control his temper and keep from breaking Kevin’s hand. Off. Why couldn’t guys find a more original way to test each other’s manly prowess? Arm wrestling might have been more subtle. Or maybe comparing the length of their…canines.
Author: Rachel Vincent,  Rogue

Quote: 1. You left a multipack of Mars Bars on top of your wardrobe. Can I have one? Dad x2. I had three. Hope that's OK. Dad x3. I'm just going to have one more. Dad x4. Harriet, your Dad's made himself sick on an entire multipack of Mars Bars again. Please don't leave sweets where we can find them. A x
Author: Holly Smale,  Model Misfit

Quote: I blew the love trumpet until my cheeks were blue. Then I paid 34 bucks for a taxicab ride home so I could admire my receding hairline in the mirror.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

Quote: Want to dance? We have music this time. And I don't have to punch you when we finish.
Author: Amy Tintera

Quote: When I was a little boy, they called me a liar, but now that I am grown up, they call me a writer.
Author: Isaac Bashevis Singer

Quote: When the writer (or the artist in general) says he has worked without giving any thought to the rules of the process, he simply means he was working without realizing he knew the rules.
Author: Umberto Eco,  Postscript to the Name of the Rose

Quote: There is a rule for fantasy writers: The more truth you mix in with a lie, the stronger it gets.
Author: Diane Duane

Quote: A good science fiction story should be able to predict not the automobile but the traffic jam.
Author: Frederik Pohl

Quote: You must understand that when you are writing a novel you are not making anything up. It's all there and you just have to find it.
Author: Thomas Harris,  Red Dragon

Quote: The problem with today’s world is that everyone believes they have the right to express their opinion AND have others listen to it. The correct statement of individual rights is that everyone has the right to an opinion, but crucially, that opinion can be roundly ignored and even made fun of, particularly if it is demonstrably nonsense!
Author: Brian Cox

Quote: Too often we give children answers to remember rather than problems to solve.
Author: Roger Lewin

Quote: There is no try. There is only do.
Author: John Green,  The Fault in Our Stars

Quote: We need the courage to learn from our past and not live in it.
Author: Sharon Salzberg,  The Force of Kindness: Change Your Life with Love & Compassion

Quote: In those days a boy on the classical side officially did almost nothing but classics. I think this was wise; the greatest service we can to education today is to teach few subjects. No one has time to do more than a very few things well before he is twenty, and when we force a boy to be a mediocrity in a dozen subjects we destroy his standards, perhaps for life.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: As every divided kingdom falls, so every mind divided between many studies confounds and saps itself.
Author: Leonardo da Vinci

Quote: The illusion is we are only physical.
Author: Vanna Bonta,  Flight: A Quantum Fiction Novel

Quote: Certainly the determining acts of her life were not ideally beautiful. They were the mixed result of young and novel impulse struggling amidst the conditions of an imperfect social state, in which great feelings will often take the aspect of error, and great faith the aspect of illusion.
Author: George Eliot,  Middlemarch

Quote: To understand life is to understand ourselves, and that is both the beginning and the end of education.
Author: Jiddu Krishnamurti,  Education and the Significance of Life

Quote: Been there, done that, got the t-shirt.Sold my soul and yeah, the truth hurts.
Author: Marina Diamandis Marina and the Diamonds

Quote: The only ethical principle which has made science possible is that the truth shall be told all the time. If we do not penalize false statements made in error, we open up the way for false statements by intention. And a false statement of fact, made deliberately, is the most serious crime a scientist can commit.
Author: Dorothy L. Sayers,  Gaudy Night

Quote: We don't want to conquer the cosmos, we simply want to extend the boundaries of Earth to the frontiers of the cosmos.
Author: Stanisław Lem,  Solaris

Quote: Always strive to aim for the highest peak of the goals in life you have set, this way if you manage to reach even half way toward a goal, landing in the middle is not such a bad place to end up.
Author: Victoria Addino

Quote: Write it down, boy. If you come across a passage in your reading that you’d like to remember, write it down in your little book; then you can read it again, memorize it, and have it whenever you wish.
Author: Keith Donohue

Quote: Economics was like psychology, a pseudoscience trying to hide that fact with intense theoretical hyperelaboration. And gross domestic product was one of those unfortunate measurement concepts, like inches or the British thermal unit, that ought to have been retired long before.
Author: Kim Stanley Robinson,  Blue Mars

Quote: Books swept me away, this way and that, one after the other; I made endless vows according to their lights for I believed them.
Author: Annie Dillard

Quote: One planet, one experiment.
Author: Edward O. Wilson

Quote: Creative people see Prometheus in a mirror, never Pandora.
Author: David Brin,  Brightness Reef

Quote: We can allow satellites, planets, suns, universe, nay whole systems of universe, to be governed by laws, but the smallest insect, we wish to be created at once by special act.
Author: Charles Darwin,  Notebooks

Quote: A book is an arrangement of twenty-six phonetic symbols, ten numerals, and about eight punctuation marks, and people can cast their eyes over these and envision the eruption of Mount Vesuvius or the Battle of Waterloo.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: Spirituality exist in testing and experiencing the depth of inner peace consistently.
Author: Amit Ray

Quote: Here’s the life lesson I’ve learned, Fifi: Some people are born to play the hero, and some are born to play the bad guy. Fighting your destiny only makes life harder than it needs to be. Besides, people remember the villain long after they’ve forgotten the hero.
Author: Susan Elizabeth Phillips

Quote: Ah, if everyone was as sensitive as you! There's no girl who hasn't gone through that. And it's all so unimportant!
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Quote: Tell your story. Don't try and tell the stories that other people can tell. Any starting writer starts out with other people's voices. But as quickly as you can start telling the stories that only you can tell, because there will always be better writers than you and there will always be smarter writers than you, but you are the only you.
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: the serpent if it wants to become the dragon must eat itself.
Author: Francis Bacon

Quote: All things fade and quickly turn to myth.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: You will find, that when you have someone to love, that the face is less important than the brain, and the body is less important than the heart.
Author: Adrian Tan

Quote: An honest religious thinker is like a tightrope walker. He almost looks as though he were walking on nothing but air. His support is the slenderest imaginable. And yet it really is possible to walk on it.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

Quote: An honest religious thinker is like a tightrope walker. He almost looks as though he were walking on nothing but air. His support is the slenderest imaginable. And yet it really is possible to walk on it.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

Quote: I'm probably 20 percent atheist and 80 percent agnostic. I don't think anyone really knows. You'll either find out or not when you get there, until then there's no point thinking about it.
Author: Brad Pitt

Quote: I'm probably 20 percent atheist and 80 percent agnostic. I don't think anyone really knows. You'll either find out or not when you get there, until then there's no point thinking about it.
Author: Brad Pitt

Quote: The more powerful the class, the more it claims not to exist.
Author: Guy Debord,  The Society of the Spectacle

Quote: And last are the few whose delight is in meditation and understanding; who yearn not for goods, nor for victory, but for knowledge; who leave both market and battlefield to lose themselves in the quiet clarity of secluded thought; whose will is a light rather than a fire, whose haven is not power but truth: these are the men of wisdom, who stand aside unused by the world.
Author: Will Durant,  The Story of Philosophy

Quote: One of the simplest ways to stay happy is letting go of the things that makes you sad.
Author: daily dose

Quote: I like Dancing of Indian girls more than my parents’ prayers . Because they dance with love and passion . But my parents just say their prayers because they got used to it .
Author: Ali Shariati

Quote: I like Dancing of Indian girls more than my parents’ prayers . Because they dance with love and passion . But my parents just say their prayers because they got used to it .
Author: Ali Shariati

Quote: In other words, our opinions and our thoughts and feelings, anything we experience, need not define us forever.
Author: Nicholas Sparks,  The Longest Ride

Quote: If you write it down, you can make it happen.
Author: Staness Jonekos

Quote: If you write it down, you can make it happen.
Author: Staness Jonekos

Quote: Call no man happy until he is dead.
Author: Solon

Quote: Call no man happy until he is dead.
Author: Solon

Quote: The mark of your ignorance is the depth of your belief in injustice and tragedy. What the caterpillar calls the end of the world, the master calls a butterfly.
Author: Richard Bach

Quote: It's not about what you've done; it's how you've experienced whatever has happened to you. Matt Lawrence in The Overachievers
Author: Alexandra Robbins

Quote: Cram them full of non-combustible data, chock them so damned full of 'facts' they feel stuffed, but absolutely 'brilliant' with information. Then they’ll feel they’re thinking, they’ll get a sense of motion without moving. And they’ll be happy, because facts of that sort don’t change. Don’t give them any slippery stuff like philosophy or sociology to tie things up with. That way lies melancholy.
Author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

Quote: If you want the rainbow, you have to put up with the rain.
Author: Dolly Parton

Quote: Each person you meetis an aspect of yourself,clamoring for love.
Author: Eric Micha'el Leventhal

Quote: Each person you meetis an aspect of yourself,clamoring for love.
Author: Eric Micha'el Leventhal

Quote: To buy a cake... to howl at the moon... to know true happiness... I am happy.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: To buy a cake... to howl at the moon... to know true happiness... I am happy.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Education is beautification of the inner world and the outer world.
Author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

Quote: Education is beautification of the inner world and the outer world.
Author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

Quote: Education is beautification of the inner world and the outer world.
Author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

Quote: It is very hard to say the exact truth, even about your own immediate feelings – much harder than to say something fine about them which is not the exact truth.
Author: George Eliot,  Adam Bede

Quote: I do want more. I am not content with being happy. I was not made for it. It is not my destiny. My destiny is the opposite.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Steppenwolf

Quote: Perhaps some people really are born unhappy. I surely hope not. Speaking for my sister and myself: We were born with the capacity and determination to be utterly happy all the time. Perhaps even in this we were freaks. Hi ho.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Slapstick or Lonesome No More!

Quote: Why do people respect the package rather than the man?
Author: Michel de Montaigne,  The Complete Essays

Quote: Male egos require constant stroking. Every task is an achievement, every success epic. That is why women cook, but men are chefs: we make cheese on toast, they produce pain de fromage.
Author: Belle de Jour,  The Further Adventures of a London Call Girl

Quote: When a small child, I thought that success spelled happiness. I was wrong, happiness is like a butterfly which appears and delights us for one brief moment, but soon flits away.
Author: Anna Pavlova

Quote: When a small child, I thought that success spelled happiness. I was wrong, happiness is like a butterfly which appears and delights us for one brief moment, but soon flits away.
Author: Anna Pavlova

Quote: You don't have to be part of a couple to be happy, you know.
Author: Phyllis Reynolds Naylor,  Alice Alone

Quote: We can't be so desperate for love that we forget where we can always find it; within.
Author: Alexandra Elle

Quote: We can't be so desperate for love that we forget where we can always find it; within.
Author: Alexandra Elle

Quote: It's one thing to think you're worthless, and quite another for somebody else to tell you that you are.
Author: Jennifer Echols,  Dirty Little Secret

Quote: Stand up for what is right even if you stand alone.
Author: Suzy Kassem

Quote: Instead of being encouraged to feel completely protected, loved, honored, and respected by the Divine Force, you've been taught that you're being judged. Because you've been taught that, you feel guilt and fear. But guilt and fear do not open you connection to the Divine; they only serve to close your heart. The reality is that God's way is love, and you can see this for yourself.
Author: Michael A. Singer,  The Untethered Soul: The Journey Beyond Yourself

Quote: Instead of being encouraged to feel completely protected, loved, honored, and respected by the Divine Force, you've been taught that you're being judged. Because you've been taught that, you feel guilt and fear. But guilt and fear do not open you connection to the Divine; they only serve to close your heart. The reality is that God's way is love, and you can see this for yourself.
Author: Michael A. Singer,  The Untethered Soul: The Journey Beyond Yourself

Quote: We fall from womb to tomb, from one blackness and toward another, remembering little of the one and knowing nothing of the other ... except through faith.
Author: Stephen King,  Danse Macabre

Quote: We fall from womb to tomb, from one blackness and toward another, remembering little of the one and knowing nothing of the other ... except through faith.
Author: Stephen King,  Danse Macabre

Quote: God, who foresaw your tribulation, has specially armed you to go through it, not without pain but without stain.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: Nature and Nature's laws lay hid in night:God said, Let Newton be! and all was light.
Author: Alexander Pope

Quote: Nature and Nature's laws lay hid in night:God said, Let Newton be! and all was light.
Author: Alexander Pope

Quote: It is interesting that Hindus, when they speak of the creation of the universe do not call it the work of God, they call it the play of God, the Vishnu lila, lila meaning play. And they look upon the whole manifestation of all the universes as a play, as a sport, as a kind of dance — lila perhaps being somewhat related to our word lilt
Author: Alan W. Watts,  Zen and the Beat Way

Quote: For in Paris, whenever God puts a pretty woman there (the streets), the Devil, in reply, immediately puts a fool to keep her.
Author: Jules Barbey d'Aurevilly,  Les Diaboliques

Quote: And God said, Behold, I have given you every herb bearing seed, which is upon the face of all the earth, and every tree, in the which is the fruit of a tree yielding seed; to you it shall be for meat.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: As Emmanuel, Cardinal Suhard says, "To be a witness does not consist in engaging in propaganda, nor even in stirring people up, but in being a living mystery. It means to live in such a way that one's life would not make sense if God did not exist.
Author: Madeleine L'Engle,  Walking on Water: Reflections on Faith and Art

Quote: To many people, free will is a license to rebel not against what is unjust or hard in life but against what is best for them and true.
Author: Dean Koontz,  The Darkest Evening of the Year

Quote: Now comes the mystery! (last words)
Author: Henry Ward Beecher

Quote: true apothecary thy drugs art quick
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: Nothing is predestined. The obstacles of your past can become the gateways that lead to new beginnings.
Author: Ralph H. Blum

Quote: You got a God. Don't make no difference if you don' know what he looks like.
Author: John Steinbeck,  The Grapes of Wrath

Quote: Coincidence is God's way of being anonymous.
Author: Laura Pedersen,  Best Bet

Quote: Coincidence is God's way of being anonymous.
Author: Laura Pedersen,  Best Bet

Quote: Michael had once read to her how God had cast a man and woman out of paradise. Yet, for all their human faults and failures. God had shown them the way back in.
Author: Francine Rivers,  Redeeming Love

Quote: We all ought to understand we're on our own. Believing in Santa Claus doesn't do kids any harm for a few years but it isn't smart for them to continue waiting all their lives for him to come down the chimney with something wonderful. Santa Claus and God are cousins.
Author: Andy Rooney,  Sincerely, Andy Rooney

Quote: I may not be where I want to be but I'm thankful for not being where I used to be.
Author: Habeeb Akande

Quote: You and I were created by God to be so much more than normal…Following the crowd is not a winning approach to life. In the end it’s a loser’s game, because we never become who God created us to be by trying to be like everybody else.
Author: Tim Tebow,  Through My Eyes

Quote: It has been said that life has treated me harshly; and sometimes I have complained in my heart because many pleasures of human experience have been withheld from me…if much has been denied me, much, very much, has been given me…
Author: Helen Keller,  The Open Door

Quote: Just when normal life felt almost possible - when the world held some kind of order, meaning, even loveliness (the prismatic spray of light through an icicle; the stillness of a sunrise), some small thing would go awry and the veil of optimism was torn away, the barren world revealed. They learned, somehow, to wait those times out. There was no cure, no answer, no reparation.
Author: David Wroblewski,  The Story of Edgar Sawtelle

Quote: I never understood why when you died, you didn't just vanish, everything should just keep going on the way it was only you just wouldn't be there. I always thought I'd like my own tombstone to be blank. No epitaph, and no name. Well, actually, I'd like it to say 'figment'.
Author: Andy Warhol

Quote: Be a man!... What good is religion if it collapses under calamity? Think of what earthquakes and floods, wars and volcanoes, have done before to men! Did you think that God had exempted [us]? He is not an insurance agent.
Author: H.G. Wells,  The War of the Worlds

Quote: Remember me, even if it's only in a corner and secretly. Don't let me go.

Quote: My wallpaper and I are fighting a duel to the death. One or the other of us has to go.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: One fine day, in the middle of the night, two dead boys got up to fight. Back to back they faced each other. They pulled out their swords and shot one another. One deaf cop, on the beat heard the noise, and came and shot the two dead boys.
Author: Holly Black,  Valiant

Quote: We are all instruments pulling the bows across our own lungs. Windmills, still startling in every storm. Have you ever seen a newborn blinking at the light? I wanna do that every day. I wanna know what the kite called itself when it got away, when it escaped into the night...
Author: Andrea Gibson

Quote: My brain hums with scraps of poetry and madness.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Selected Letters of Virginia Woolf

Quote: You shall create beauty not to excite the sensesbut to give sustenance to the soul.
Author: Gabriela Mistral

Quote: It is strange how a scrap of poetry works in the mind and makes the legs move in time to it along the road.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  A Room of One's Own

Quote: I've got mixed feelings about poetry cause done well poetry is fantastic. But not many people are capable of doing it well. I think you should have some kind of license to perform poetry. A poetic license perhaps.
Author: Craig Ferguson

Quote: Our love was bornoutside the walls,in the wind,in the night,in the earth,and that's why the clay and the flower,the mud and the rootsknow your name.
Author: Pablo Neruda

Quote: forsan et haec olim meminisse iuvabit.and perhaps it will be pleasing to have remembered these things one day
Author: Virgil,  Eclogues. Georgics. Aeneid: Books 1-6

Quote: We have seen the best minds of our generation destroyed by boredom at poetry readings.
Author: Lawrence Ferlinghetti,  Wild Dreams of a New Beginning

Quote: She dealt her pretty words like Blades --How glittering they shone --And every One unbared a NerveOr wantoned with a Bone --She never deemed -- she hurt --That -- is not Steel's Affair --A vulgar grimace in the Flesh --How ill the Creatures bear --To Ache is human -- not polite --The Film upon the eyeMortality's old Custom --Just locking up -- to Die.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: won't you celebrate with mewhat i have shaped intoa kind of life? i had no model.born in babylonboth nonwhite and womanwhat did i see to be except myself?i made it uphere on this bridge betweenstarshine and clay,my one hand holding tightmy other hand; come celebratewith me that everydaysomething has tried to kill meand has failed.
Author: Lucille Clifton
