Author: Napoleon Hill

Quote: even in the loneliest momentsi have been therefor myself.
Author: Sanober Khan

Quote: Love shall be our token; love be yours and love be mine.
Author: Christina Rossetti

Quote: Chairs have legs. Four of them, like my father. Meow.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  If you bring the booze and food, I'll bring the thirst and hunger

Quote: An expert is someone who knows some of the worst mistakes that can be made in his subject, and how to avoid them.
Author: Werner Heisenberg

Quote: The complexities of adult life get in the way of the truth.
Author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

Quote: A wise man first thinks and then speaks and a fool speaks first and then thinks.
Author: Hazrat Ali ibn Abu-Talib

Quote: With my ninth mind I resurrect my firstand dance slow to the music of my soul made new.
Author: Aberjhani,  Visions of a Skylark Dressed in Black

Quote: Good poetry makes the universe reveal a secret.
Author: حافظ

Quote: In fact she herself once blamed meKyprogeneiabecause I prayed this word:I want.
Author: Sappho,  If Not, Winter: Fragments of Sappho

Quote: Bones,” I sighed. “Know something? I’m not afraid of you, but you scareme….” His outline blurred again.“You scare me, too, Kitten,” he might have replied, but I couldn’t be sure.
Author: Jeaniene Frost,  Halfway to the Grave

Quote: One has only to set a loved human being against the fact that we are all in peril all the time to get back a sense of proportion. What does anything matter compared to the reality of love and its span, so brief at best, maintained against such odds?
Author: May Sarton,  Journal of a Solitude

Quote: Sometimes the hardest one to see . . .is the one standing right before you.
Author: Lenore Wolfe

Quote: I suppose we must work on being gracious and grateful until we can do for ourselves. Someday the wheel of fate will put us in a position to be of use to them, and we will remember how much easier it is to give help than it is to accept it.
Author: Patricia Briggs,  River Marked

Quote: Of what a strange nature is knowledge! It clings to a mind when it has once seized on it like a lichen on a rock."- Frankenstein p115
Author: Mary Shelley,  Frankenstein

Quote: To know much and taste nothing-of what use is that?
Author: Bonaventure

Quote: To know much and taste nothing-of what use is that?
Author: Bonaventure

Quote: Maybe you are already lost and just do not know it.
Author: Christine Feehan,  Dark Demon

Quote: God is even in a single parent household.
Author: Karen Salmansohn,  Even God is Single:

Quote: I don't talk with everybody because i am not everybody, i am single.
Author: Michael Bassey Johnson

Quote: Ask anyone and they'll most likely say their family is crazy, and if they don't say their family is crazy, their friends are crazy. That's because everyone is crazy after taking the mask off. People are most themselves when not really trying to fit in, when either alone or around those already closest to them, and that is crazy.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Doubt not, O poet, but persist. Say 'It is in me, and shall out.' Stand there, balked and dumb, stuttering and stammering, hissed and hooted, stand and strive, until at last rage draw out of thee that dream-power which every night shows thee is thine own; a power transcending all limit and privacy, and by virtue of which a man is the conductor of the whole river of electricity.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  The Essays of Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: All days are nights to see till I see thee, And nights bright days when dreams do show thee me.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Shakespeare's Sonnets

Quote: I can't take anything you don't give me. Stop giving me power over your life.
Author: Chelsea M. Cameron,  Deeper We Fall

Quote: You're okay now... You're okay because I'll be holding you like this from now on.
Author: Matsuri Hino

Quote: It's taken me all this time, all this loss, to realize what really matters is now.
Author: Suzanne Young,  The Treatment

Quote: When they’re together, the world could fall apart around them and they’d never notice or care as long as they have each other.About Alex and Brittany.
Author: Simone Elkeles,  Rules of Attraction

Quote: Romance has been elegantly defined as the offspring of fiction and love.
Author: Benjamin Disraeli

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... you were there.
Author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: Do those people who hold up the Bible as an inspiration tomoral rectitude have the slightest notion of what is actually writtenin it?
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The God Delusion

Quote: Do those people who hold up the Bible as an inspiration tomoral rectitude have the slightest notion of what is actually writtenin it?
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The God Delusion

Quote: When you can write music that endures, bravo. Until then, keep quiet and study the work of those who can.
Author: Jennifer Donnelly,  Revolution

Quote: …words have been all my life, all my life--this need is like the Spider's need who carries before her a huge Burden of Silk which she must spin out--the silk is her life, her home, her safety--her food and drink too--and if it is attacked or pulled down, why, what can she do but make more, spin afresh, design anew….
Author: A.S. Byatt,  Possession

Quote: In Hollywood, no one knows anything.
Author: William Goldman

Quote: The ability to dream is all I have to give. That is my responsibility; that is my burden. And even I grow tired.
Author: Harlan Ellison,  Stalking the Nightmare

Quote: I'm not out to disturb anybody's faith. I happen to be happy and comfortable with a belief system that has a dual deity and operates on a lunar schedule. It suits my needs. If you happen to be happy and comfortable with a belief system that features a single masculine deity and operates on a solar schedule, fine. I don't give a fat damn. What matters is what you do, not who's name you do it in.
Author: Mercedes Lackey,  Burning Water

Quote: (An unhappy childhood was not) an unsuitable preparation for my future, in that it demanded a constant wariness, the habit of observation, and the attendance on moods and tempers; the noting of discrepancies between speech and action; a certain reserve of demeanour; and automatic suspicion of sudden favours.
Author: Rudyard Kipling,  Something of Myself

Quote: Writing, the art of communicating thoughts to the mind through the eye, is the great invention of the world...enabling us to converse with the dead, the absent, and the unborn, at all distances of time and space.
Author: Abraham Lincoln,  Speeches And Letters Of Abraham Lincoln, 1832 1865

Quote: God pity the poor novelist.
Author: Steven Millhauser,  Edwin Mullhouse: The Life and Death of an American Writer 1943-1954 by Jeffrey Cartwright

Quote: ... human beings fear the unknown. So, whatever's freaking you out, grab it by the balls and say hello.
Author: Justin Halpern,  I Suck at Girls

Quote: Every perfect traveler always creates the country where he travels.
Author: Nikos Kazantzakis

Quote: When you're a writer, the question people always ask you is, "Where do you get your ideas?"Writers hate this question. It's like asking Humphrey Bogart in The African Queen, "Where do you get your leeches?"You don't get ideas. Ideas get you.
Author: Connie Willis

Quote: Inspirations never go in for long engagements; they demand immediate marriage to action.
Author: Brendan Francis Brown

Quote: Inspirations never go in for long engagements; they demand immediate marriage to action.
Author: Brendan Francis Brown

Quote: For me, religion is like a rhinoceros: I don't have one, and I'd really prefer not to be trampled by yours.
Author: Silas Sparkhammer

Quote: Fiction that adds up, that suggests a "logical consistency,"or an explanation of some kind, is surely second-rate fiction; for the truth of life is its mystery.
Author: Joyce Carol Oates,  The Journal of Joyce Carol Oates: 1973-1982

Quote: I need Christ, not something that resembles Him.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  A Grief Observed

Quote: We are all connected. When one arm or foot is poisoned, the whole body becomes infected.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: a good writer should draw the reader in by starting in the middle of the story with a hook, then go back and fill in what happened before the hook. Once you have the reader hooked, you can write whatever you want as you slowly reel them in.
Author: Roland Smith,  Peak

Quote: religion is about having the right answers, and some of their answers are right... but i am about the process that takes you to the living answer... it will change you from the inside. there are a lot of smart people who are able to say a lot of right things from their brain because they have been told what the right answers are, but they don't know me at all.
Author: Wm. Paul Young

Quote: You cannot build a dream on a foundation of sand. To weather the test of storms, it must be cemented in the heart with uncompromising conviction.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: My life looked good on paper - where, in fact, almost all of it was being lived.
Author: Martin Amis,  Experience: A Memoir

Quote: But the purpose of a story is to teach and to please at once, and what it teaches is how to recognize the snares of the world.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Island of the Day Before

Quote: Success is not what you have done compared to what others have done. Success is what you have done compared to what you were supposed to do.
Author: Tony Evans

Quote: To do more for the world than the world does for you - that is success.
Author: Henry Ford

Quote: Without friends you have nothing!
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: The true test of one's mettle is how many times you will try before you give up.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: Spend the years of learning squanderingCourage for the years of wanderingThrough a world politely turningFrom the loutishness of learning.
Author: Samuel Beckett,  Collected Poems in English and French

Quote: First I lost my heart. Then I lost my mind.
Author: Jennifer Salvato Doktorski,  How My Summer Went Up in Flames

Quote: Anyone who is considered funny will tell you, sometimes without even your asking, that deep inside they are very serious, neurotic, introspective people.
Author: Wendy Wasserstein

Quote: It is easier for one to take risks and to chase his dreams with a mindset that he has nothing to lose. In this lies the immense passion, the great advantage of avoiding a materialistic, pleasure-filled way of life.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Twelve-year-olds are eager to turn everything into arguments but don't have the cognitive skills to win them.
Author: Linda Perlstein

Quote: Nobody can decide for himself whether he is going to be a human being. The only question open to him is whether he will be an ignorant undeveloped one or one who has sought to reach the highest point he is capable of attaining.
Author: Robert Maynard Hutchins,  The Great Conversation: The Substance Of A Liberal Education

Quote: I was ripped from my body, I was less than spirit, less than the meanest ghost . . . but still, I was alive.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

Quote: The tragedy is that what you disapprove of in others is the very thing you disapprove of in yourself.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: Even if you're on the right track, you'll get run over if you just sit there.
Author: Will Rodgers,  The Wit and Wisdom of Will Rogers in His Own Voice

Quote: When you are just EXISTING, life happens to you… and you manage; when you are truly LIVING, you happen to life… and you lead.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: We make our purpose.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Varieties of Scientific Experience: A Personal View of the Search for God

Quote: I am a fugitive and a vagabond, a sojourner seeking signs.
Author: Annie Dillard,  Pilgrim at Tinker Creek

Quote: That is the eternal folly of man. To be chasing after the sweet flesh, without realizing that it is simply a pretty cover for the bones.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  American Gods

Quote: We are built to be effective animals, not happy ones.
Author: Robert Wright,  The Moral Animal: Why We Are the Way We Are: The New Science of Evolutionary Psychology

Quote: One possibility is: God is nothing but the power of the universe to organize itself.
Author: Lee Smolin

Quote: [Flaubert] didn’t just hate the railway as such; he hated the way it flattered people with the illusion of progress. What was the point of scientific advance without moral advance? The railway would merely permit more people to move about, meet and be stupid together.
Author: Julian Barnes,  Flaubert's Parrot

Quote: If you see an antimatter version of yourself running towards you, think twice before embracing.
Author: J. Richard Gott III,  Time Travel in Einstein's Universe: The Physical Possibilities of Travel Through Time

Quote: Thus, as far as he is a scientific man, as far as he knows anything, he is a materialist; outside his science, in spheres about which he knows nothing, he translates his ignorance into Greek and calls it agnosticism.
Author: Friedrich Engels,  Socialism: Utopian and Scientific

Quote: I will always find a way and a way will always find me.
Author: Charles F. Glassman,  Brain Drain The Breakthrough That Will Change Your Life

Quote: Books, for me, are a home. Books don't make a home - they are one, in the sense that just as you do with a door, you open a book, and you go inside. Inside there is a different kind of time and space. There is warmth there too - a hearth. I sit down with a book and I am warm.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Why Be Happy When You Could Be Normal?

Quote: There isn’t any particular relationship between the messages, except that the author has chosen them carefully, so that, when seen all at once, they produce an image of life that is beautiful and surprising and deep. There is no beginning, no middle, no end, no suspense, no moral, no causes, no effects. What we love in our books are the depths of many marvelous moments seen all at one time.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Slaughterhouse-Five

Quote: Books are both our luxuries and our daily bread.
Author: Henry Stevens

Quote: Science teaches to think but love teaches to smile.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Your ordinary acts of love and hope point to the extraordinary promise that every human life is of inestimable value.
Author: Desmond Tutu

Author: Desmond Tutu

Quote: Love is the only force capable of transforming an enemy into friend.
Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

Author: Martin Luther King, Jr.

Author: Lady Gaga

Author: Queen Elizabeth I,  Letters

Author: Zig Ziglar

Quote: Always try to be joyful and proactively benign to the people. By doing so everyday, people have no control at all over my mood.

Quote: We can no more justify using nonhumans as human resources than we can justify human slavery. Animal use and slavery have at least one important point in common: both institutions treat sentient beings exclusively as resources of others. That cannot be justified with respect to humans; it cannot be justified with respect to nonhumans—however “humanely” we treat them.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Author: Bronnie Ware,  The Top Five Regrets of the Dying: A Life Transformed by the Dearly Departing

The odd thing is most of the things that stop an inexperienced writer are so far from the truth as to be nearly beside the point. When you feel glosbal doubt about your talent, that is your talent. People who have no talent don't have any doubt.

Quote: In spite of where we were, how we had gotten here and why we had come, I felt that at this moment of our lives, this place was exactly where we belonged. We were not drifting but rising, rising toward something right and of significance.
Author: Dean Koontz

Quote: Homeschooling and public schooling are as opposite as two sides of a coin. In a homeschooling environment, the teacher need not be certified, but the child MUST learn. In a public school environment, the teacher MUST be certified, but the child need NOT learn.
Author: Gene Royer

Quote: There was something much greater she needed to feed her soul, and perhaps one day soon she would go...
Author: Danielle Steel,  Wanderlust

Quote: Intelligence is the capacity to perceive the essential, the what is; and to awaken this capacity, in oneself and in others, is education.
Author: Jiddu Krishnamurti,  Education and the Significance of Life

Quote: My survival was up to me. I had nothing and I had no one. What I did have, I told myself, was my mind, my imagination, my memory, my feelings, my spirit. These were important and powerful things.
Author: John Marsden,  A Killing Frost

Quote: ... how terrible is the pain of the mind and heart when the freedom of mankind is suppressed!
Author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

Quote: To summarize, using money to motivate people can be a double-edged sword. For tasks that require cognitive ability, low to moderate performance-based incentives can help. But when the incentive level is very high, it can command too much attention and thereby distract the person’s mind with thoughts about the reward. This can create stress and ultimately reduce the level of performance.
Author: Dan Ariely,  The Upside of Irrationality: The Unexpected Benefits of Defying Logic at Work and at Home

Quote: Have you found someone to share your heart with? Are you giving to your community? Are you at peace with yourself? Are you trying to be as human as you can be?
Author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

Quote: To change the world takes time; to change yourself takes courage.
Author: R.S. Lowel

Quote: A good book is always on tap; it may be decanted and drunk a hundred times, and it is still there for further imbibement.
Author: Holbrook Jackson

Quote: In a library, no empty shelf remains empty for long.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: The wonderful thing about books is that they allow us to enter imaginatively into someone else’s life. And when we do that, we learn to sympathize with other people. But the real surprise is that we also learn truths about ourselves, about our own lives, that somehow we hadn’t been able to see before.
Author: Katherine Paterson

Quote: Science is the most reliable guide in life.
Author: Mustafa Kemal Atatürk

Quote: Nobody is driven by abstractions like 'seeking truth.
Author: Michael Crichton,  Jurassic Park

Quote: I like books whose virtue is all drawn together in a page or two. I like sentences that don't budge though armies cross them.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Jacob's Room

Quote: Where There is a willthere is a willto search and discover a better dayWhere a positive heartis all you needto rise beyondand succeedWhere young minds grow and respect each other based on their deedsand not their colorwhen times are dimsay as I say"Where there's a willthere's a way!
Author: Tupac Shakur,  The Rose That Grew from Concrete

Quote: Napoleon, when hearing about Laplace's latest book, said, 'M. Laplace, they tell me you have written this large book on the system of the universe, and have never even mentioned its creator.'Laplace responds, 'Je n'avais pas besoin de cette hypothèse-là. (I had no need of that hypothesis.)
Author: Pierre-Simon Laplace

Quote: Man moves in a world that is nothing more or less than his consciousness objectified.–Neville Goddard
Author: Neville Goddard

Quote: Theology, philosophy, metaphysics, and quantum physics are merely ways for God to have his smart people believe in him
Author: Jeremy Aldana

Quote: Theology, philosophy, metaphysics, and quantum physics are merely ways for God to have his smart people believe in him
Author: Jeremy Aldana

Quote: Man is not born to solve the problem of the universe, but to find out what he has to do; and to restrain himself within the limits of his comprehension.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: I think it was the institution...I was trying to master it.
Author: E. Lockhart,  The Disreputable History of Frankie Landau-Banks

Quote: Whatever I learned,Whatever I knew,Seems like those faded years of childhood that flew,Away in some dilemma,Always in some confusion,The purpose of this life,Seems like an illusion!
Author: Mehek Bassi,  Chained: Can you escape fate?

Author: Mehek Bassi,  Chained: Can you escape fate?

Quote: Language disguises thought.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein,  Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus

Quote: Wherever there is a human being, there is an opportunity for crisis.
Author: Seneca

Quote: A miracle is often the willingness to see the common in an uncommon way.
Author: Noah Benshea,  Jacob the Baker: Gentle Wisdom For a Complicated World

Quote: Calling sex by its name thereafter [the 17th c.] became more difficult and more costly. As if in order to gain mastery of it in reality, it had first been necessary to subjugate it at the level of language, control its free circulation in speech, expunge it from the things that were said, and extinguish the words that rendered it too visibly present.
Author: Michel Foucault

Quote: If it is bread that you seek, you will have bread. If it is the soul you seek, you will find the soul. If you understand this secret, you know you are that which you seek.
Author: Rumi

Quote: Dubium sapientiae initium. (Doubt is the origin of wisdom.)
Author: René Descartes,  Meditations on First Philosophy

Quote: Sitting still is a pain in the ass.
Author: Noah Levine,  Against the Stream: A Buddhist Manual for Spiritual Revolutionaries

Quote: Sitting still is a pain in the ass.
Author: Noah Levine,  Against the Stream: A Buddhist Manual for Spiritual Revolutionaries

Quote: Quis custodiet ipsos custodes? - Who watches the watchmen?
Author: Alan Moore,  Watchmen

Quote: Saepe creat molles aspera spina rosas"- "Often the prickly thorn produces tender roses
Author: Ovid

Quote: But is all this true?"said Brutha.Didactylos shrugged. "Could be. Could be. We are here and it is now. The way I see it is, after that, everything tends towards guesswork.""You mean you don't KNOW it's true?"said Brutha."I THINK it might be,"said Didactylos. "I could be wrong. Not being certain is what being a philosopher is all about.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Small Gods

Quote: Observe the movements of the stars as if you were running their courses with them, and let your mind constantly dwell on the changes of the elements into each other. Such imaginings wash away the filth of life on the ground.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: The maturity of man—that means, to have reacquired the seriousness that one had as a child at play
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Beyond Good and Evil

Quote: In a dark time, the eye begins to see.
Author: Theodore Roethke

Quote: Compassion is all inclusive. Compassion knows no boundaries. Compassion comes with awareness, and awareness breaks all narrow territories.
Author: Amit Ray,  Nonviolence: The Transforming Power

Quote: It is only possible to live happily ever after on a daily basis.
Author: Margaret Wander Bonanno

Quote: It is only possible to live happily ever after on a daily basis.
Author: Margaret Wander Bonanno

Quote: Hearts will break and people will hurt you, darling.” Her mother said. “But when you let those people control your outlook on the life, you only allow them to have a greater hold on your happiness. Once you accept the fact that every day is a new day to begin again, life becomes a much easier path to walk.
Author: Courtney Giardina,  Holding on to Georgia

Quote: if it makes you happy, then why the hell are you so sad?
Author: Sheryl Crow

Quote: You know what my father told me when I was little, one day, when he found me crying? He told me that God gave people a fixed number of tears and are of two kinds: tears of sadness and tears of happiness. And that I should not waste my tears elsewhere, but keep them for the moments of happiness. Would be a shame to not have tears to cry then ...
Author: Irina Binder,  Fluturi

Quote: You will realize one day that all the money in the world cannot buy you happiness. Nor can it make you a person of good character.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

Quote: I've always believed that happiness is just around the corner. The trick is fining the right corner.
Author: Eric Weiner,  The Geography of Bliss: One Grump's Search for the Happiest Places in the World

Quote: What the world stigmatizes as romantic is often more nearly allied to the truth than is commonly supposed.
Author: Anne Brontë

Quote: Man is a demon, man is a god. Both true.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: Man is a demon, man is a god. Both true.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: The individual appears for an instant, joins the community of thought, modifies it and dies; but the species, that dies not, reaps the fruit of his ephemeral existence.
Author: A.S. Byatt,  Possession

Quote: The individual appears for an instant, joins the community of thought, modifies it and dies; but the species, that dies not, reaps the fruit of his ephemeral existence.
Author: A.S. Byatt,  Possession

Quote: People, he thought, were as hungry for a sight of joy as he had always been--for a moment's relief from that gray load of suffering which seemed so inexplicable and unnecessary. He had never been able to understand why men should be unhappy.
Author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

Quote: I learned from a very young age that if I persued the things that truly excited me, that they would reward in more important ways, like happiness.
Author: Brandon Boyd

Quote: I do not care about happiness simply because I believe that joy is something worth fighting for.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: The decision is mine, and I choose happiness
Author: Malori Howell

Quote: Pure joy is rare. That’s why for every meal I eat a really bloody steak.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: It's a strange truth that no matter how persuaded we might be of our own correctness, the discomfiting realization that others disagree with us causes a paralyzing inability to argue the case convincingly.
Author: Brittney Ryan,  The Legend of Holly Claus

Quote: The truth that makes men free is for the most part the truth which men prefer not to hear.
Author: Herbert Agar

Quote: Faith is believing in something you know isn't true.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Half Asleep in Frog Pajamas

Quote: Faith is believing in something you know isn't true.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Half Asleep in Frog Pajamas

Quote: Faith is believing in something you know isn't true.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Half Asleep in Frog Pajamas

Quote: There is no happiness in love, except at the end of an English novel.
Author: Anthony Trollope,  Barchester Towers

Quote: Kant thought things, not because they were true, but because he was Kant.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham,  Of Human Bondage

Quote: In Western Civilization, our elders are books.
Author: Gary Snyder,  The Practice of the Wild: Essays

Quote: In Western Civilization, our elders are books.
Author: Gary Snyder,  The Practice of the Wild: Essays

Quote: We can be friends. We can be anything we want to be.
Author: Muriel Barbery,  The Elegance of the Hedgehog

Quote: We can be friends. We can be anything we want to be.
Author: Muriel Barbery,  The Elegance of the Hedgehog

Quote: I want to reconcile the violence in your heart.I want to recognize your beauty's not just a mask.I want to exorcise the demons from your past.I want to satisfy the undisclosed desires in your heart.
Author: Matthew Bellamy

Quote: knowledge, absolutely sure of its infallibility, is faith
Author: Yevgeny Zamyatin,  We

Quote: knowledge, absolutely sure of its infallibility, is faith
Author: Yevgeny Zamyatin,  We

Quote: knowledge, absolutely sure of its infallibility, is faith
Author: Yevgeny Zamyatin,  We

Quote: Where I will find peace other than in oblivion?
Author: Sorin Cerin,  Wisdom Collection: The Book of Wisdom

Quote: For what it's worth: it's never too late to be whoever you want to be. I hope you live a life you're proud of, and if you find you're not, I hope you have the strength to start over again.
Author: F. Scott Fitzgerald

Quote: the first quality of an honest man is contempt for religion, which would have us afraid of the most natural thing in the world, which is death; and would have us hate the one beautiful thing destiny has given us, which is life.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Island of the Day Before

Quote: the first quality of an honest man is contempt for religion, which would have us afraid of the most natural thing in the world, which is death; and would have us hate the one beautiful thing destiny has given us, which is life.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Island of the Day Before

Quote: The earth is but one country and mankind its citizens
Author: Bahá'u'lláh,  The Kitab-i-Aqdas: The Most Holy Book

Quote: We cry coming into the world, as everyone around us laughs with joy. And we laugh with joy leaving this world, when everyone around us cries.
Author: Wendy Corsi Staub,  Awakening

Quote: You don't have to stop thinking and asking questions to believe in God, child. If He'd wanted a flock of eight billion sheep, He wouldn't have given us opposable thumbs, much less free will.
Author: Hillary Jordan,  When She Woke

Quote: You don't have to stop thinking and asking questions to believe in God, child. If He'd wanted a flock of eight billion sheep, He wouldn't have given us opposable thumbs, much less free will.
Author: Hillary Jordan,  When She Woke

Quote: May the God who gives endurance and encouragement give you a spirit of unity among yourselves as you follow Christ Jesus, so that with one heart and mouth you may glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: Because I don't think God trusts just anybody with so much heartache. The world has not yet seen what God can do with a man who gives both halves of a broken heart to him. And I don't doubt that a man like that can change the world...or at least a little part of it.
Author: Chris Fabry,  Almost Heaven

Author: Chris Fabry,  Almost Heaven

Quote: What mancan you show me who places any value on his time, who reckons the worth of each day, who understands that he isdying daily? For we are mistaken when we look forward to death; the major portion of death has already passed,Whatever years be behind us are in death's hands.
Author: Seneca,  Letters from a Stoic

Quote: The Chinese used gunpowder to make fireworks for celebrations, and the white man came along and said, Holy shit, we can use this to kill people. What better way to celebrate than that?
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

Quote: We speak, but it is God who teaches.
Author: Augustine of Hippo

Quote: In some not too distant tomorrow the radiant stars of love and brotherhood will shine over our great nation with all their scintillating beauty.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.,  The Autobiography of Martin Luther King, Jr.

Quote: Maybe love was meant to save us from ourselves.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: Maybe love was meant to save us from ourselves.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: Bushido is realized in the presence of death. This means choosing death whenever there is a choice between life and death. There is no other reasoning.
Author: Tsunetomo Yamamoto,  Hagakure: The Book of the Samurai

Quote: The peace of the celestial city is the perfectly ordered and harmonious enjoyment of God, and of one another in God. (City of God, Book 19)
Author: Augustine of Hippo

Quote: The greatest thing a man can do in this world, is to make the most possible out of the stuff that has been given him. This is success, and there is no other.
Author: Orison Swett Marden,  Learn to Expect a Great Deal of Life

Quote: To love someone is to desire and work toward their becoming the best version of themselves. The one person in all the universe who can do this perfectly for you is God.
Author: John Ortberg Jr.,  The Me I Want to Be: Becoming God's Best Version of You

Quote: Cynicism is when a small mind and a hurt heart rejects the hope, love, and truth of a big and caring God.
Author: Jayce O'Neal

Quote: To be convinced in our hearts that we have forgiveness of sins and peace with God by grace alone is the hardest thing.
Author: Martin Luther,  Commentary on Galatians

Quote: Dreams are tawdry when compared with the leading of God, and not worthy of the aura of wonder we usually surround them with. God only doeth wonders. He does nothing else. His hand can work nothing less.
Author: Jim Elliot

Quote: There is a certain seductiveness about dead things. You can ill treat, alter and recolour what's dead. It won’t complain.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit

Quote: There is a certain seductiveness about dead things. You can ill treat, alter and recolour what's dead. It won’t complain.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Oranges Are Not the Only Fruit

Quote: Tous mes anciens amours vont me revenir.'- All my old loves will be returned to me
Author: Carolyn Turgeon,  Godmother: The Secret Cinderella Story

Quote: I had a standing agreement with god. I'd agree to believe in him, barely, so long as he let me sleep in on Sundays.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Vampire Academy

Quote: In joined hands there is still some token of hope, in the clinched fist none.
Author: Victor Hugo,  The Toilers of the Sea

Quote: Only those who still have hope can benefit from tears.
Author: Nathanael West,  The Day of the Locust

Quote: And now that its ruby eyes are set into the gold, you cannot see their tear-shape, so they seem to be laughing rather than crying. It is a constant reminder to me of the human ability to create something beautiful even when things are at the darkest.
Author: Cressida Cowell,  How to Twist a Dragon's Tale

Quote: And now that its ruby eyes are set into the gold, you cannot see their tear-shape, so they seem to be laughing rather than crying. It is a constant reminder to me of the human ability to create something beautiful even when things are at the darkest.
Author: Cressida Cowell,  How to Twist a Dragon's Tale

Quote: God makes each one of us for the time into which we are born. He creates us for a purpose. Our job is to know Him well, discover what He created us to do, and then do it for all we're worth for the rest of our lives. Ask God to show you your purpose. He will answer.
Author: Robin Lee Hatcher,  Fit to Be Tied

Quote: He hesitated, remembering something Finnikin had said to him on their journey. That somehow, even in the worst of times, the tiniest fragments of good survive. It was the grip in which one held those fragments that counted.
Author: Melina Marchetta,  Finnikin of the Rock

Quote: Death is harder on those who are left behind.
Author: Robert La Fosse,  Nothing To Hide

Quote: ...what happens when you returnand find nothingbut a hollowed shell,shingles and floor,walls and echoesand the light that lead you herehas now burned outand the ones who built ithave traveled afarand you cant go to them,no matter what shoes you wear.
Author: Kellie Elmore,  Magic in the Backyard

Quote: In the Cross is salvation; in the Cross is life; in the Cross is protection against our enemies; in the Cross is infusion of heavenly sweetness; in the Cross is strength of mind; in the Cross is joy of spirit; in the Cross is excellence of virtue; in the Cross is perfection of holiness. There is no salvation of soul, nor hope of eternal life, save in the Cross.
Author: Thomas à Kempis,  The Inner Life

Quote: The older I grow and the more I abandon myself to God's will, the lessI value intelligence that wants to know and will that wants to do; andas the only element of salvation I recognize faith, which can wait patiently,without asking too many questions.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Name of the Rose

Quote: Faith is only as good as the one in whom it's invested.
Author: Lee Strobel,  The Case for the Real Jesus: A Journalist Investigates Current Attacks on the Identity of Christ

Quote: The truth is that I feel totally helpless, or totally inconsolable, to be more honest. I’m not trying to hide it, but it’s something you’re not to worry about.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  The Orange Girl

Quote: Our knowledge of life is limited to death
Author: Erich Maria Remarque,  All Quiet on the Western Front

Quote: My words are the garment of what I shall never be Like the tucked sleeve of a one-armed boy.
Author: W.S. Merwin,  The Lice

Quote: Flutter like a hummingbird, Dive like an eagle, Ain't no bird that's my equal. - Twilight
Author: Kathryn Lasky,  The Capture

Quote: Thus, though we cannot make our sun Stand still, yet we will make him run.
Author: Andrew Marvell,  To His Coy Mistress

Quote: [I]t was with a good end in mind – that of acquiring the knowledge of good and evil – that Eve allowed herself to be carried away and eat the forbidden fruit. But Adam was not moved by this desire for knowledge, but simply by greed: he ate it because he heard Eve say it tasted good.
Author: Moderata Fonte,  The Worth of Women: Wherein Is Clearly Revealed Their Nobility and Their Superiority to Men

Quote: Women were excited after sex, wired becasue in their minds the relationship was on beginning. Men went to sleep m the because for the orgasm had arrived and the relationship was done.
Author: Eric Jerome Dickey,  Pleasure

Quote: If you are of the opinion that the contemplation of suicide is sufficient evidence of a poetic nature, do not forget that actions speak louder than words.
Author: Fran Lebowitz,  Metropolitan Life/Social Studies

Quote: One need not be a Chamber — to be Haunted — One need not be a House — The Brain has Corridors — surpassing Material Place —
Author: Emily Dickinson,  Selected Poems

Quote: Some people are oil and water.
Author: John Christopher,  The Pool of Fire

Quote: There are only two ways to live your life. One as if all that matters is to have someone love and accept you. The other is as though loving and accepting another person is all that matters. Often, when you choose the second you get the first.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: We aren't suggesting that mental instability or unhappiness makes one a better poet, or a poet at all; and contrary to the romantic notion of the artist suffering for his or her work, we think these writers achieved brilliance in spite of their suffering, not because of it.
Author: Dorianne Laux,  The Poet's Companion: A Guide To The Pleasures Of Writing Poetry

Quote: We aren't suggesting that mental instability or unhappiness makes one a better poet, or a poet at all; and contrary to the romantic notion of the artist suffering for his or her work, we think these writers achieved brilliance in spite of their suffering, not because of it.

Quote: When I turn back to Jase, he’s again beaming at me. “You’re nice.” He sounds pleased, as if he hadn’t expected this aspect of my personality.
Author: Huntley Fitzpatrick,  My Life Next Door

Quote: Right. Because if you have trouble putting ketchup and mustard on a hot dog, you should totally move on to saving lives.
Author: Huntley Fitzpatrick,  My Life Next Door

Quote: Love is photogenic, it develops in the dark.
Author: Lorraine Gokul

Quote: There is nothing right or wrong in love. Where there is love, then there is nothing but only love.
Author: Sara Naveed,  Undying Affinity

Quote: Even at the time—twenty years old—I said to myself: better to go hungry, to go to prison, to be a tramp, than to sit at an office desk ten hours a day. There is no particular daring in this vow, but I have not broken it and shall not do so. The wisdom of my grandfathers sat in my head: we are born for the pleasure of work, fighting, love, we are born for that and nothing else. (Guy de Maupassant)
Author: Isaac Babel,  Red Cavalry and Other Stories

Quote: We make time for what we truly value. We build habits and routines around the things that really matter to us. This is an important principle to understand as we seek to build our lives around the gospel. Do you want a cross centered life? A cross centered life is made up of cross centered days.
Author: C.J. Mahaney

Quote: People fear anyone who differs from what is considered normal, and in a small town the idea of normal can be as narrow as the streets.
Author: Elizabeth Chandler,  The Back Door of Midnight

Quote: Ideas come at any moment -- except when you demand them. Most ideas come while I'm physically active, at the gym, with friends, gardening, so I always carry pen and paper.My first draft is always written in longhand. But once the first dozen chapters, more like short stories, are written, then momentum builds until I can't leave the project until it's done.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk

Quote: I think the attempt to defend belief can unsettle it, in fact, because there is always an inadequacy in argument about ultimate things.
Author: Marilynne Robinson,  Gilead

Quote: Uniqueness is what makes you the most beautiful.
Author: Lea Michele

Quote: When we feel unsafe with someone and still stay with him, we damage our ability to discern trustworthiness in those we will meet in the future.
Author: David Richo

Quote: The universe is made up of stories, not atoms.
Author: Muriel Rukeyser

Quote: If the town were a black hole, I was the helpless star being sucked into oblivion. It was an oblivion I craved.
Author: J.D. Stroube,  Caged in Darkness

Quote: Five tender apricots in a blue bowl, a brief and exact promise of things to come.
Author: Frances Mayes,  In Tuscany

Quote: Both friend and enemy reside within us. One lives by the rule of compassion, the other by the rule of hard knocks. Though potential influence of either extreme is inevitable, our actions bear witness to the one we embrace.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: One who will not accept solitude, stillness and quiet recurring moments...is caught up in the wilderness of addictions; far removed from an original state of being and awareness. This is 'dis-ease.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Only a very few can be learned, but all can be Christian, all can be devout, and – I shall boldly add – all can be theologians.
Author: Desiderius Erasmus

Quote: Only a very few can be learned, but all can be Christian, all can be devout, and – I shall boldly add – all can be theologians.
Author: Desiderius Erasmus

Quote: I always tell my Western friends that it is best to keep your own tradition. Changing religion is not easy and sometimes causes confusion. You must value your tradition and honor your own religion.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: Decide that you like college life. In your dorm you meet many nice people. Some are smarter than you. And some, you notice, are dumber than you. You will continue, unfortunately, to view the world in exactly these terms for the rest of your life.
Author: Lorrie Moore,  Self-Help

Quote: Man is nothing else but what he purposes, he exists only in so far as he realizes himself, he is therefore nothing else but the sum of his actions, nothing else but what his life is.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre

Quote: Mirrors are perpetually deceitful. They lie and steal your true self. They reveal only what your mind believes it sees
Author: Dee Remy,  There Once Was A Boy

Quote: Education leads to enlightenment. Enlightenment opens the way to empathy. Empathy foreshadows reform.
Author: Derrick A. Bell,  Faces At The Bottom Of The Well: The Permanence Of Racism

Quote: Some say if you want success surround yourself with successful people. I say if you want true and lasting success surround yourself with people of integrity.
Author: Charles F. Glassman,  Brain Drain The Breakthrough That Will Change Your Life

Quote: As you can see, there are quite a number of things taught in school that one has to unlearn or at least correct.
Author: Ambeth R. Ocampo,  Rizal without the Overcoat

Quote: We are given to the great, for great purpose, to great ends. We are given to the grave, for grave purposes, to grave ends.
Author: Kami Garcia

Quote: To think what is true, to sense what is beautiful and to want what is good, hereby the spirit finds purpose of a life in reason.
Author: Johann Gottfried Herder

Quote: Musically, he was like an old man in a boy's skin.
Author: Eric Clapton

Quote: You may die a hundred deaths without a break in the mental turmoil. Or, you may keep your body and die only in the mind. The death of the mind is the birth of wisdom.
Author: Nisargadatta Maharaj,  I Am That: Talks with Sri Nisargadatta Maharaj

Quote: Just about a month from now I'm set adrift, with a diploma for a sail and lots of nerve for oars.
Author: Richard Halliburton

Quote: NOT UNTIL I MET YOUNot until I felt your sunshine,Did I realize that I had been in the shade.Not until I saw all your colors,Did I realize that mine had faded.Not until I heard your dreams,Did I realize that I was still sleeping.And not until I experienced my life with you,Did I realize that I was barelyBreathing.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: But if one observes, one will see that the body has its own intelligence; it requires a great deal of intelligence to observe the intelligence of the body.
Author: Jiddu Krishnamurti,  The Flight of the Eagle

Quote: How we relate with other people is dependent on how we rate ourselves and what we think about ourselves.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Each person has got a voice inside them. Communicate with it and take hold of it. Do not let it push and shove you around – you are its master!
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Books remember all the things you cannot contain.
Author: Elizabeth McCracken,  The Giant's House

Quote: The prefect evening...lying down on the couch beside the bookcase and reading himself sleepy...Jim lying opposite him at the other end of the couch, also reading; the two of them absorbed in their books yet so completely aware of each other's presence.
Author: Christopher Isherwood,  A Single Man

Quote: What intrigued me more than anything else was finding out the way in which everything, all of creation - all of it! - was held together by invisible chemical bonds, and I found a strange, inexplicable comfort in knowing that somewhere, even though we couldn't see it in our own world, there was a real stability.
Author: Alan Bradley,  The Sweetness at the Bottom of the Pie

Quote: ‎By 2100, our destiny is to become like the gods we once worshipped and feared. But our tools will not be magic wands and potions but the science of computers, nanotechnology, artificial intelligence, biotechnology, and most of all, the quantum theory.
Author: Michio Kaku,  Physics of the Future: How Science Will Shape Human Destiny and Our Daily Lives by the Year 2100

Quote: DNA neither cares nor knows. DNA just is. And we dance to its music.
Author: Richard Dawkins,  River Out of Eden: A Darwinian View of Life

Quote: Flexibility requires an open mind and a welcoming of new alternatives.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: The lifetime of a human being is measured by decades, the lifetime of the Sun is a hundred million times longer. Compared to a star, we are like mayflies, fleeting ephemeral creatures who live out their lives in the course of a single day.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: Though money cannot acquire you happiness, it does not mean that both money and happiness cannot exist together.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Our private tastes in books showed a hint of our secret selves.
Author: Nova Ren Suma,  The Walls Around Us

Quote: In your hands winteris a book with cloud pagesthat snow pearls of love.
Author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

Quote: -- that books were mirrors, reflective in sometimes unpredictable ways.
Author: Wally Lamb,  I Know This Much Is True

Quote: Old books that we have known but not possessed cross our path and invite themselves over. New books try to seduce us daily with tempting titles and tantalizing covers.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: For a gallant spirit there can never be defeat.
Author: Wallis Simpson

Quote: Friendship... is not something you learn in school. But if you haven't learned the meaning of friendship, you really haven't learned anything.
Author: Muhammad Ali

Quote: Instead of trying to make your life perfect, give yourself the freedom to make it an adventure, and go ever upward.
Author: Drew Houston

Quote: A manager is a guide. He takes a group of people and says, 'With you I can make us a success; I can show you the way.'
Author: Arsene Wenger

Quote: As we leave the Moon at Taurus-Littrow, we leave as we came, and God willing, as we shall return, with peace and hope for all mankind.
Author: Eugene Cernan

Quote: To love another person is to see the face of God.
Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: Pitching is the art of instilling fear.
Author: Sandy Koufax

Quote: Let's not call physical comedy falling down and pratfalls. All humor is physical, no matter how you dish it out. It's timing, like a dancer or an athlete would have.
Author: Chevy Chase

Quote: The fossil record implies trial and error, the inability to anticipate the future, features inconsistent with a Great Designer (though not a Designer of a more remote and indirect temperament.)
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: The fossil record implies trial and error, the inability to anticipate the future, features inconsistent with a Great Designer (though not a Designer of a more remote and indirect temperament.)
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: Man's naked form belongs to no particular moment in history; it is eternal, and can be looked upon with joy by the people of all ages.
Author: Auguste Rodin

Quote: Man's naked form belongs to no particular moment in history; it is eternal, and can be looked upon with joy by the people of all ages.
Author: Auguste Rodin

Quote: The illness of a doctor is always worse than the illnesses of his patients.The patients only feel, but the doctor, as well as feeling, has a pretty good idea of the destructive effect of the disease on his constitution.This is a case in which knowledge brings death nearer.
Author: Maxim Gorky,  Literary Portraits

Quote: ... the most important concept ever put forth was that matter, ALL matter, with no exceptions from stone to star to starfish to student to sovereign, is as divine as all else in the cosmos, for all flows from Consciousness, the Word that came before the World - and all, in time, will flow back.
Author: Ki Longfellow,  Flow Down Like Silver: Hypatia of Alexandria

Quote: Isn't wine prohibited here?"the boy asked. "It's not what enters men's mouths that's evil,"said the alchemist. "It's what comes out of their mouths that is.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

Quote: Isn't wine prohibited here?"the boy asked. "It's not what enters men's mouths that's evil,"said the alchemist. "It's what comes out of their mouths that is.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

Quote: Beauty as we feel it is something indescribable; what it is or what it means can never be said.
Author: George Santayana

Quote: We are citizens of the world. The tragedy of our times is that we do not know this.
Author: Woodrow Wilson

Quote: A toast, Jedediah, to love on my terms. Those are the only terms anybody ever knows - his own.
Author: Orson Welles,  Citizen Kane

Quote: If you alone found out what the lie was, then you're probably right—it would make no great difference. But if you ALL found out what the lie was, it might conceivably make a very great difference indeed.
Author: Daniel Quinn,  Ishmael: An Adventure of the Mind and Spirit

Quote: No man is crushed by misfortune unless he has first been deceived by prosperity
Author: Seneca,  Dialogues and Letters

Quote: Love isn't always a physical emotion. Sometimes it's the ones who never got to actually hold you in their arms that appreciate you for who you are
Author: Sarah Sprague

Quote: Love isn't always a physical emotion. Sometimes it's the ones who never got to actually hold you in their arms that appreciate you for who you are
Author: Sarah Sprague

Quote: Then the lover, who is true and no counterfeit, must of necessity be loved by his love.
Author: Plato

Quote: I refuse to let the standards of evil people chip away at my capacity for integrity.
Author: Stefan Molyneux

Quote: This city belongs to ghosts, to murderers, to sleepwalkers. Where are you, in what bed, in what dream?
Author: Marguerite Yourcenar

Quote: From a certain point onward there is no longer any turning back.
Author: Franz Kafka

Quote: And, drunk with my own madness, I shouted at him furiously, "Make life beautiful! Make life beautiful!
Author: Charles Baudelaire

Quote: And, drunk with my own madness, I shouted at him furiously, "Make life beautiful! Make life beautiful!
Author: Charles Baudelaire

Quote: We are often taught to look for the beauty in all things, so in finding it, the layman asks the philosopher while the philosopher asks the photographer.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: There is no future without a past, because what is to be cannot be imagined except as a form of repetition.
Author: Siri Hustvedt,  The Summer Without Men

Quote: Love gives you eyes.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: Where lowland is, that's where water goes. All medicine wants is pain to cure.
Author: Rumi

Quote: The thing about living alone is that it gives you a lot of time to think. You don't necessarily reach any conclusions, because wisdom is largely a function of intelligence and self-awareness, not time on your hands. But you do become very good at thinking yourself into endless loops of desperation in half the time it would take a normal person.
Author: Jonathan Tropper,  One Last Thing Before I Go

Quote: People will always notice something about you. It might be the way you walk or the way you talk, or just simply your personality. Live each day in the way you want to be remembered. Live in such a way that people will be inspired by those unique qualities that you have and strive to live better lives for themselves.
Author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

Live in such a way that people will be inspired by those unique qualities that you have and strive to live better lives for themselves.
Author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

Quote: I want that. I want that awful intense and serious unhappiness, cos then I might feel better, and then I might be happy.
Author: David Thewlis,  The Late Hector Kipling

Quote: I want that. I want that awful intense and serious unhappiness, cos then I might feel better, and then I might be happy.
Author: David Thewlis,  The Late Hector Kipling

Quote: She still cared for me, and the best way I could make amends to her was to be happy.I do have a knack for finding great women.
Author: Craig Ferguson,  American on Purpose: The Improbable Adventures of an Unlikely Patriot

Quote: Scepticism is the first step towards truth.
Author: Denis Diderot,  Pensées philosophiques

Quote: In the future, when something comes up, you tell exactly how it happened but write down for yourself the way you think it should have happened. Tell the truth and write the story. Then you won't get mixed up. It was the best advice Francie every got.
Author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

Quote: Every time we start thinking we're the center of the universe, the universe turns around and says with a slightly distracted air, 'I'm sorry. What'd you say your name was again?
Author: Margaret Maron,  Bootlegger's Daughter

Quote: Our purest form of joy comes when people we envy get hurt. That most genuine form of joy.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Haunted

Quote: If you're not getting happier as you get older, then you're fuckin' up
Author: Ani DiFranco

Quote: Everyone has a right to be a little happy, asshole.
Author: John Irving,  Last Night in Twisted River

Quote: The stories people tell you about themselves seem to retain the possibility of being false. But what you discover about them by yourself seems to be the truth.
Author: John Verdon,  Shut Your Eyes Tight

Quote: There are two paths of which one may choose in the walk of life; one we are born with, and the one we consciously blaze. One is naturally true, while the other is a perceptive illusion. Choose wisely at each fork in the road.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: There are two paths of which one may choose in the walk of life; one we are born with, and the one we consciously blaze. One is naturally true, while the other is a perceptive illusion. Choose wisely at each fork in the road.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: This, the language of deception, we both understand. We were born to it, along with the curses.
Author: Holly Black,  Red Glove

Quote: I would have offered you a forest of truth, but you wish to speak of a single leaf
Author: David Gemmell,  Fall of Kings

Quote: You must accept the truth from whatever source it comes.
Author: Maimonides

Quote: Religious structure often dilutes the spiritual experience.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: It was so much easier to be angry. Being angry made him feel strong, even though-- and this contradiction did nothing to diminish his anger-- he was angry only because his position was so weak.
Author: Lev Grossman,  The Magicians

Quote: Leigh did what any sane female faced with such an e-mail would do: deleted it to resist the temptation of replying, cleared her trash to resist the temptation of recalling it, and then called tech support to restore all her recently deleted e-mails. (Chasing Harry Winston)
Author: Lauren Weisberger

Quote: Everyone's allowed to be in love with the wrong person at some point. In fact, it's a mistake not to be.
Author: Harriet Evans,  Happily Ever After

Quote: I really like you better aimless and lost among people, a little crazy, oddball, not looking like yourself. So that I don't know you at all and the nearer I get to you the more you separate yourself from me-- I get dizzy trying to follow you and I have to work really hard-- and that's what I want!
Author: Alia Mamdouh,  The Loved Ones: A Modern Arabic Novel

Quote: In practical life we are compelled to follow what is most probable ; in speculative thought we are compelled to follow truth.
Author: Baruch Spinoza,  The Letters

Quote: In practical life we are compelled to follow what is most probable ; in speculative thought we are compelled to follow truth.
Author: Baruch Spinoza,  The Letters

Quote: Faith is the cure that heals all troubles. Without faith there is no hope and no love. Faith comes before hope, and before love. (Sheikh Muhammad ibn Zaidi bani Tihama)
Author: Paul Torday,  Salmon Fishing In The Yemen

Quote: I can't die yet, doctor. Not yet. I have things to do. Afterwords I'll have a whole lifetime in which to die.
Author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón,  The Angel's Game

Quote: If I convert it's because it's better that a believer dies than that an atheist does.
Author: Christopher Hitchens,  Mortality

Quote: If I convert it's because it's better that a believer dies than that an atheist does.
Author: Christopher Hitchens,  Mortality

Quote: For he who loves God without faith reflects on himself, while the person who loves God in faith reflects on God.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard,  Fear and Trembling

Quote: For he who loves God without faith reflects on himself, while the person who loves God in faith reflects on God.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard,  Fear and Trembling

Quote: Music is, to me, proof of the existence of God. It is so extraordinarily full of magic, and in tough times of my life I can listen to music and it makes such a difference.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: Matthew 10:34“Do not suppose that I have come to bring peace to the earth. I did not come to bring peace, but a sword.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

Quote: A breeze blows up, touching my cheek like a little child's kiss. It flutters a piece of paper. "Trash, out there? Must belong to one of us."We move closer, and when I reached for it, I find...... a perfect paper airplane.
Author: Ellen Hopkins

Quote: For all works and things, which are either commanded or forbidden by God and thus have been instituted by the supreme Majesty, are 'musts.' Nevertheless, no one should be dragged to them or away from them by the hair, for I can drive no man to heaven or beat him into it with a club.
Author: Martin Luther

Quote: For all works and things, which are either commanded or forbidden by God and thus have been instituted by the supreme Majesty, are 'musts.' Nevertheless, no one should be dragged to them or away from them by the hair, for I can drive no man to heaven or beat him into it with a club.

Quote: To hope under the most extreme circumstances is an act of defiance that permits a person to live his life on his own terms. It is part of the human spirit to endure and give a miracle a chance to happen.
Author: Jerome Groopman

Quote: Have faith in the Yankees my son. Think of the great DiMaggio.
Author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Old Man and the Sea

Quote: I really believe that there is an invisible red thread tied between him and me, and that it has stretched and tangled for years — across oceans and lifetimes. I know that it won’t break because our souls are tied.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: I really believe that there is an invisible red thread tied between him and me, and that it has stretched and tangled for years — across oceans and lifetimes. I know that it won’t break because our souls are tied.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl
