Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: Never pity missionaries; envy them. They are where the real action is -- where life and death, sin and grace, Heaven and Hell converge.
Author: Robert C. Shannon

Quote: Only those few who are able to surpass their fear of death completely can fully experience the highest forms of life; not the mundane life of the mortal, but the godly life of the resurrected.
Author: Zeena Schreck

Quote: The ultimate weapon is Lady Gaga’s music. Why kill the enemy when you can play her music and they’ll want to kill themselves?
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Who Moved My Choose?: An Amazing Way to Deal With Change by Deciding to Let Indecision Into Your Life

Quote: Sometimes new opportunity means new opposition. Not everything God asks us to do will be comfortable.
Author: Joyce Meyer

Quote: So,"he asked. "How's death?""Hard,"she said. "It just keeps going.
Author: Neil Gaiman,  American Gods

Quote: Men always makes gods in their own image.
Author: Xenophanes

Quote: God's creatures who cried themselves to sleep stirred to cry again.
Author: Thomas Harris,  The Silence of the Lambs

Quote: Summertime. It was a song. It was a season. I wondered if that season would ever live inside of me.
Author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz,  Last Night I Sang to the Monster

Quote: Damn it! How will I ever get out of this labyrinth?
Author: Simón Bolívar

Quote: Damn it! How will I ever get out of this labyrinth?
Author: Simón Bolívar

Quote: Any fool can hope when success lies plainly in view. It wants genuine strength to hope when matters are hopeless.
Author: Michael Flynn,  Eifelheim

Quote: Any fool can hope when success lies plainly in view. It wants genuine strength to hope when matters are hopeless.
Author: Michael Flynn,  Eifelheim

Quote: There’s always a choice. That’s God’s way, always will be. Your will is still free. Do as you will. There’s no set of leg-irons on you. But... this is what God wants of you.
Author: Stephen King,  The Stand

Quote: How do you know when you're God?""When I pray to him I find I am talking to myself.
Author: Peter Barnes,  The Ruling Class: A Baroque Comedy

Quote: [She wasn't] a logically reasoning woman, but God is good, and hearts may count in heaven as high as heads.
Author: Charles Dickens,  Our Mutual Friend

Quote: Let me go: take back thy gift:Why should a man desire in any wayTo vary from the kindly race of men,Or pass beyond the goal of ordinanceWhere all should pause, as is most meet for all?...Why wilt thou ever scare me with thy tears,And make me tremble lest a saying learnt,In days far-off, on that dark earth, be true?‘The Gods themselves cannot recall their gifts.’- Tithonus
Author: Alfred Lord Tennyson

Quote: The Coming of LightEven this late it happens:the coming of love, the coming of light. You wake and the candles are lit as if by themselves, stars gather, dreams pour into your pillows, sending up warm bouquets of air.Even this late the bones of the body shine and tomorrow’s dust flares into breath.
Author: Mark Strand,  The Late Hour

Quote: The Coming of LightEven this late it happens:the coming of love, the coming of light. You wake and the candles are lit as if by themselves, stars gather, dreams pour into your pillows, sending up warm bouquets of air.Even this late the bones of the body shine and tomorrow’s dust flares into breath.
Author: Mark Strand,  The Late Hour

Quote: All that we call human history--money, poverty, ambition, war, prostitution, classes, empires, slavery--[is] the long terrible story of man trying to find something other than God which will make him happy.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  Mere Christianity

Quote: One who has hope lives differently.
Author: Pope Benedict XVI

Quote: God created heaven on earth but man created hell.
Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Quote Me Everyday

Quote: ...and when is enough proof enough?
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer,  Everything Is Illuminated

Quote: We are not asked to SEE,"said Amy. "Why need we when we KNOW?"We know--not the answer to the inevitable Why, but the incontestable fact that it is for the best. "It is an irreparable loss, but is it faith at all if it is 'hard to trust' when things are entirely bewildering?
Author: Elisabeth Elliot,  A Chance to Die: The Life and Legacy of Amy Carmichael

Quote: I often wonder if God recognizes His own son the way we've dressed him up, or is it dressed him down?
Author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

Quote: It is of great significance if there is a person who truly prays in a family. Prayer attracts God's Grace and all the members of the family feel it, even those whose hearts have grown cold. Pray always.
Author: Thaddeus of Vitovnica,  Our Thoughts Determine Our Lives: The Life and Teachings of Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica

Quote: [W]hen someone finds himself quite unjustly attacked and hated on all sides, there is no need for such a person to feel dismayed by misfortune. See how Fortune, who has harmed many a one, is so inconstant, for God, Who opposes all wrong deeds, raises up those in whom hope dwells.
Author: Christine de Pizan,  Ditié de Jehanne d'Arc

Quote: In silence the three of them looked at the sunset and thought about God.
Author: Maud Hart Lovelace,  Betsy-Tacy and Tib

Quote: Logic is immaturity weaving its nets of gossamer wherewith it aims to catch the behemoth of knowledge. Logic is a crutch for the cripple, but a burden for the swift of foot and a greater burden still for the wise.
Author: Mikhail Naimy,  The Book of Mirdad: The Strange Story of a Monastery Which Was Once Called the Ark

Quote: I would suggest that science is, at least in my part, informed worship.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Varieties of Scientific Experience: A Personal View of the Search for God

Quote: I would suggest that science is, at least in my part, informed worship.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Varieties of Scientific Experience: A Personal View of the Search for God

Quote: I have found the paradox that if I love until it hurts, then there is no hurt, but only more love.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: Nothing is generous. New knowledge is a valuable commodity. The more truth we have to work with, the richer we are.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Cat's Cradle

Quote: I watched the spinning stars, grateful, sad and proud, as only a man who has outlived his destiny and realizes he might yet forge himself another, can be.
Author: Roger Zelazny,  Isle of the Dead

Quote: The sum of things to be known is inexhaustible, and however long we read, we shall never come to the end of our story-book."(Introductory lecture as professor of Latin at University College, London, 3 October 1892)
Author: A.E. Housman,  Selected Prose

Quote: Judgement can do without knowledge: but not knowledge without judgement.
Author: Michel de Montaigne,  The Complete Essays

Quote: Where are you?"he asked. "I'm right here"she said. "I know, but it feels like one percent of you is somewhere else, where is that one percent?"he said. "I don't know....I think I'm always like that..."she answered. "I like that.""You do?""Yes, because that way, I have to always look for the one percent to find it.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Errors, like straws, upon the surface flow; He who would search for pearls, must dive below.
Author: John Dryden,  All for Love

Quote: Verily, knowledge is a lock and its key is the question.
Author: Imam Ja'Far Al-Sadiq

Quote: And the Raven, never flitting, still is sitting, still is sitting On the pallid bust of Pallas just above my chamber door; And his eyes have all the seeming of a demon's that is dreaming, And the lamp-light o'er him streaming throws his shadow on the floor:And my soul from out that shadow that lies floating on the floor Shall be lifted — nevermore!
Author: Edgar Allan Poe,  Edgar Allan Poe: Selected Poems

Quote: Relationships are so much like the United States - they only really thrive when faced with an external threat.
Author: Laura Pedersen,  Best Bet

Quote: I lock my door upon myself, And bar them out; but who shall wall Self from myself, most loathed of all?
Author: Christina Rossetti,  The Complete Poems

Quote: Ali ipak uz mene se može, mada je neobično, Sa mnom je opasno hteti, ja nikad ne odustajem.
Author: Miroslav Antić

Quote: Birds are flyin' south for winter.Here's the Weird-Bird headin' north,Wings a-flappin', beak a-chatterin',Cold head bobbin' back 'n' forth.He says, "It's not that I like iceOr freezin' winds and snowy ground.It's just sometimes it's kind of niceTo be the only bird in town.
Author: Shel Silverstein

Quote: I am a free soul, singing my heart out by myself no matter where I go and I call strangers my friends because I learn things and find ways to fit them into my own world. I hear what people say, rearrange it, take away and tear apart until it finds value in my reality and there I make it work. I find spaces in between the cracks and cuts where it feels empty and there I make it work.
Author: Charlotte Eriksson

Quote: Writing, then, was a substitute for myself: if you don't love me, love my writing & love me for my writing. It is also much more: a way of ordering and reordering the chaos of experience.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: Writing, then, was a substitute for myself: if you don't love me, love my writing & love me for my writing. It is also much more: a way of ordering and reordering the chaos of experience.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: No man can reveal to you aught but that which already lies half asleep in the dawning of your knowledge.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: No man can reveal to you aught but that which already lies half asleep in the dawning of your knowledge.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: I am that last, thatfinal thing, the bodyin a white sheet listening,
Author: Li-Young Lee

Quote: Not everything can be felt and not everything will be ever understood.
Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Obscurity

Quote: Understand the nature and influence of repeating patterns, from childhood experiences or even from past lives. Wthout understanding, patterns tend to repeat, unnecessarily damaging the relationship.
Author: Brian L. Weiss,  Messages from the Masters: Tapping Into the Power of Love

Quote: If it ain't a pleasure, it ain't a poem.
Author: William Carlos Williams

Quote: People don't get to our ages without having pasts. I'm more interested in the future.
Author: Robyn Donald,  Tiger, Tiger

Quote: Disagreement is not necessarily a reason to head for Splitsville. In fact, a relationship without disagreement is probably too brittle to last. Some of the best human bonds are forged in the fire of disagreement.
Author: Jerry Spinelli,  Today I Will: A Year of Quotes, Notes, and Promises to Myself

Quote: There are genuine mysteries in the world that mark the limits of human knowing and thinking. Wisdom is fortified, not destroyed, by understanding its limitations. Ignorance does not make a fool as surely as self-deception.
Author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Bestselling Guide to Reading Books and Accessing Information

Quote: I was drawn to horses as if they were magnets. It was in my blood. I must have inherited from my grandfather a genetic proclivity toward the equine species. Perhaps there's a quirk in the DNA that makes horse people different from everyone else, that instantly divides humanity into those who love horses and the others, who simply don't know.
Author: Allan J. Hamilton,  Zen Mind, Zen Horse: The Science and Spirituality of Working with Horses

Quote: But I don't shut up and I don't die.I liveand fight, maddeningthose who rule my country.For if I liveI fight,and if I fightI contribute to the dawn.
Author: Otto René Castillo

Quote: A woman's got one life: She's got to reach out and grab it with both hands, or it'll pass her by and leave nothing but a smelly old fart in her face.
Author: Robin Schone,  Scandalous Lovers

Quote: A laugh jumps out of my mouth, surprising me. I can’t even remember the last time I laughed and it puts me on edge. I suddenly want to do the same thing to her. Let her see how it feels to teeter on that cliff.
Author: Nyrae Dawn,  Charade

Quote: His right ear still held both studs, and I wondered who had the missing earring. I would have asked, but was afraid he’d tell me Ivy had it.
Author: Kim Harrison,  A Fistful of Charms

Quote: We are meant to be.” He pressed his lips to mine again; against myself, against my worry, I once again succumbed to the power of his kiss. “I know that now. Our love is stronger than magic, stronger than the laws of all Feyland. It will survive this...whatever the future brings.” - Prince Kian, Silver Frost.
Author: Kailin Gow,  Silver Frost

Quote: Let me feel how thy pulses beat.
Author: Thomas Middleton,  The Changeling

Quote: I’m out of health potions. Retreat! Retreat! Give me some of your health potions!” I screamed. “I don’t have any potions. Run, bitch, run,” Brody squealed. The red ran out on my health and my assassin was transported, stripped of everything we’d earned, back to the starting camp. “I’m dead! Fuck, they killed me!
Author: Kristen Ashley,  Rock Chick Redemption

Quote: As a rule of thumb, it was always safer if the Commander-in-Chief formulated a risky plan.
Author: Rowena Cherry,  Forced Mate

Quote: Knowledge was like candy: you never turned it down, especially if you didn't have to work too hard to get it.
Author: Robert Liparulo,  House of Dark Shadows

Quote: There was a time when people accepted magical experiences as natural. There were no priests then, and no one went chasing after the secrets of the occult.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: هل الورق مطفأة للذاكرة ؟ نترك فوقه كل مره رماد سيجارة الحنين الأخيرة, وبقايا الخيبة الأخيرة .. من منا يطفئ أو يشعل الآخر ؟ لا ادري فقبلك لم أكتب شيئاً يستحق الذكر .. معك فقط سأبدأ الكتابة .
Author: أحلام مستغانمي

Quote: To achieve lasting literature, fictional or factual, a writer needs perceptive vision, absorptive capacity, and creative strength.
Author: Lawrence Clark Powell

Quote: To achieve lasting literature, fictional or factual, a writer needs perceptive vision, absorptive capacity, and creative strength.
Author: Lawrence Clark Powell

Quote: A man must be prepared not only to be a martyr, but to be a fool. It is absurd to say that a man is ready to toil and die for his convictions if he is not even ready to wear a wreathe around his head for them.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: Inspiration fires you up; motivation keeps you burning.
Author: Stuart Aken

Quote: An intelligent person, looking out of his eyes and hearkening in his ears, with a smile on his face all the time, will get more true education than many another in a life of heroic vigils".
Author: Robert Louis Stevenson,  An Apology for Idlers

Quote: Men love women who are courageous for it means they can go all the way with him in his pursuit of his good dreams and intentions.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: Men love women who are courageous for it means they can go all the way with him in his pursuit of his good dreams and intentions.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: Men love women who are courageous for it means they can go all the way with him in his pursuit of his good dreams and intentions.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: Isn't this enough? Just this world? Just THIS?
Author: Tim Minchin

Quote: The average man, who does not know what to do with his life, wants another one which will last forever.
Author: Anatole France

Quote: Then that's what the Northern Lights are. All the lives that we're not living.
Author: Adi Alsaid,  Let's Get Lost

Quote: Love is a flower that should never cease to grow. Nurture it, and it will outlive you. Neglect it, and it will wilt away and die.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Fashion is about two things: the evolution and the opposite.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: I’m sure I am wrong about many things, although I’m not sure exactly which things I’m wrong about. I’m even sure I’m wrong about what I think I’m right about in at least some cases.
Author: Brian D. McLaren,  A Generous Orthodoxy

Quote: My goal is to write every day. I say it is my ideal. I am careful not to pass judgment or create anxiety if I do not do it. No one lives up to his ideal.
Author: Natalie Goldberg

Quote: We are not as Christ-centered and cross-cherishing as we should be, because we do not ponder the truth that everything good, and everything bad that God turns for the good, was purchased by the sufferings of Christ.
Author: John Piper,  The Passion of Jesus Christ

Quote: I want to hire someone to stand outside my door and knock three times, with each knock being three years apart. At the end of the nine years I’ll reply, “Who is it?” And without delay or reply, the person on the other side of the door is to find a new job.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

Quote: Listen for the call of your destiny, and when it comes, release your plans and follow.
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: Listen for the call of your destiny, and when it comes, release your plans and follow.
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: All that I've learned, I've forgotten. The little that I still know, I've guessed.
Author: Nicolas Chamfort

Quote: Unfathomable mind: now beacon, now sea.
Author: Samuel Beckett,  Molloy, Malone Dies, The Unnamable

Quote: Parents who discipline their child by discussing the consequences of their actions produce children who have better moral development , compared to children whose parents use authoritarian methods and punishment.
Author: Simon Baron-Cohen,  Zero Degrees of Empathy: A New Theory of Human Cruelty

Quote: INTENT reveals desire; ACTION reveals commitment.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: The people we consider successful in our society are all people that seize every moment and make the best of each situation.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Success is the best revenge.
Author: Kanye West

Quote: Success can be defined in many ways but failure in only one ... quitting!
Author: Gerard de Marigny,  The Watchman of Ephraim

Quote: It's not worth losing your soul to win a guy.
Author: Daniel Nayeri,  Another Faust

Quote: Is that all souls are for? For when we die?""No. They're for living, too.
Author: Laini Taylor,  Lips Touch: Three Times

Quote: The mind knows the truth when your heart denies what it feels. When you don't feel safe to let people in, it is because you're not ready to deal with the pain of honesty.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: The word 'innocence' means a mind that is incapable of being hurt.
Author: Jiddu Krishnamurti

Quote: It is of great importance, when we begin to practise prayer, not to let ourselves be frightened by our own thoughts.
Author: Teresa of Ávila,  The Life of Saint Teresa of Ávila by Herself

Quote: But it was not the room’s disorder which was frightening; it was the fact that when one began searching for the key to this disorder, one realized that it was not to be found in any of the usual places. For this was not a matter of habit or circumstance or temperament; it was a matter of punishment and grief.
Author: James Baldwin,  Giovanni's Room

Quote: This was how it was with travel: one city gives you gifts, another robs you. One gives you the heart’s affections, the other destroys your soul. Cities and countries are as alive and feeling, as fickle and uncertain as people. Their degrees of love and devotion are as varying as with any human relation. Just as one is good, another is bad.
Author: Roman Payne,  Cities & Countries

Quote: Even knowing that my presence brought a shadow over the lives of my loved ones, I can't regret the experiences I've had with them. They gave me life, becoming an integral part of my soul. They healed me when I was broken and somehow they recovered those parts of me, I thought lost forever.
Author: J.D. Stroube,  Caged by Damnation

Quote: Just let go of the need to care about whether it happens or not, then you are free from fear and can then concentrate on focusing.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: ‎Using his burgeoning intelligence, this most successful of all mammals has exploited the environment to produce food for an ever increasing population. Instead of controlling the environment for the benefit of the population, perhaps it's time we controlled the population to allow the survival of the environment.
Author: David Attenborough

Quote: A barrier is a limitation only when you perceive it as one.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Affirmations are our mental vitamins, providing the supplementary positive thoughts we need to balance the barrage of negative events and thoughts we experience daily.
Author: Tia Walker,  The Inspired Caregiver: Finding Joy While Caring for Those You Love

Quote: [we see that] science is eminently perfectible, and that each theory has constantly to give way to a fresh one.
Author: Jules Verne,  A Journey to the Center of the Earth

Quote: Sir,’ said Stephen, ‘I read novels with the utmost pertinacity. I look upon them--I look upon good novels--as a very valuable part of literature, conveying more exact and finely-distinguished knowledge of the human heart and mind than almost any other, with greater breadth and depth and fewer constraints.
Author: Patrick O'Brian,  The Nutmeg of Consolation

Quote: But the penciled sheets did not seem like nor smell like the library book so she had given it up, consoling herself with the vow that when she grew up, she would work hard, save money and buy every single book that she liked.
Author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

Quote: Books are lighthouses erected in the great sea of time.
Author: Edwin Percy Whipple

Quote: Libraries are not made; they grow. Good as it is to inherit a library, it is better to collect one.
Author: Augustine Birrell

Quote: We were never organized readers who would see a book through to its end in any sory of logical order. We weave in and out of words like tourists on a hop-on, hop-off bus tour. Put a book down in the kitchen to go to the bathroom and you might return to find it gone, replaced by another of equal interest. We are indiscriminate.
Author: Eleanor Brown,  The Weird Sisters

Quote: He had no money and no home; he lived entirely on the road of the racing circuit, sleeping in empty stalls, carrying with him only a saddle, his rosary, and his books....The books were the closest thing he had to furniture, and he lived in them the way other men live in easy chairs.
Author: Laura Hillenbrand,  Seabiscuit: An American Legend

Quote: Books have souls. Or so romantics like me tend to think.
Author: Douglas Rushkoff

Quote: What we achieve inwardly will change outer reality.
Author: Plutarch

Quote: Friendship is always a sweet responsibility, never an opportunity.
Author: Khalil Gibran

Quote: Every time you step on the football field in between those lines you're putting your life, your career, every single ligament in your body in jeopardy.
Author: Robert Griffin III

Quote: Hope is a state of mind, not of the world. Hope, in this deep and powerful sense, is not the same as joy that things are going well, or willingness to invest in enterprises that are obviously heading for success, but rather an ability to work for something because it is good.
Author: Vaclav Havel

Quote: Hope is a state of mind, not of the world. Hope, in this deep and powerful sense, is not the same as joy that things are going well, or willingness to invest in enterprises that are obviously heading for success, but rather an ability to work for something because it is good.

Quote: With my pictures, what I hope is that it encourages the reader to imagine more pictures of his own.
Author: Quentin Blake

Quote: The journey from teaching about love to allowing myself to be loved proved much longer than I realised.
Author: Henri Nouwen

Quote: From the very early stage when I started doing performance art in the '70s, the general attitude - not just me, but also my colleagues - was that there should not be any documentation, that the performance itself is artwork and there should be no documentation.
Author: Marina Abramovic

Quote: 'The Sopranos' is filled with really retrograde humor. Bathroom humor, falls, stupid puns, bad jokes - infantile, adolescent stuff, but it makes me laugh.
Author: David Chase

Quote: Everything existing in the universe is the fruit of chance and necessity.
Author: Democritus

Quote: Everything existing in the universe is the fruit of chance and necessity.
Author: Democritus

Quote: Every science begins as philosophy and ends as art; it arises in hypothesis and flows into achievement.
Author: Will Durant

Quote: Every science begins as philosophy and ends as art; it arises in hypothesis and flows into achievement.
Author: Will Durant

Quote: Many married women who have deliberately spurned the "hour"of childbearing are unhappy and frustrated. They never discovered the joys of marriage because they refused to surrender to the obligation of their state. In saving themselves, they lost themselves!
Author: Fulton J. Sheen,  Seven Words of Jesus and Mary: Lessons from Cana and Calvary

Quote: Many married women who have deliberately spurned the "hour"of childbearing are unhappy and frustrated. They never discovered the joys of marriage because they refused to surrender to the obligation of their state. In saving themselves, they lost themselves!

Quote: Don't hate the media; become the media.
Author: Jello Biafra,  Become the Media

Quote: All resistance is a rupture with what is. And every rupture begins, for those engaged in it, through a rupture with oneself.
Author: Alain Badiou,  Metapolitics

Quote: All resistance is a rupture with what is. And every rupture begins, for those engaged in it, through a rupture with oneself.
Author: Alain Badiou,  Metapolitics

Quote: We can speak and think only of what exists. And what exists is uncreated and imperishable for it is whole and unchanging and complete. It was not or nor shall be different since it is now, all at once, one and continuous.
Author: Parmenides

Quote: Skepticism is the agent of reason against organized irrationalism--and is therefore one of the keys to human social and civic decency.
Author: Stephen Jay Gould

Quote: Skepticism is the agent of reason against organized irrationalism--and is therefore one of the keys to human social and civic decency.
Author: Stephen Jay Gould

Quote: In the world of art, all things are possible.--George from Paradise Kiss
Author: Ai Yazawa

Quote: You may tend to get cancer from the thing that makes you want to smoke so much, not from the smoking itself.
Author: William Saroyan,  Not Dying: An Autobiographical Interlude

Quote: Is it better to go with the flow or let the flow go?
Author: Aidan Chambers,  Postcards from No Man's Land

Quote: We are alone. Live our lives, lacking anything better to do. Devise reason later.
Author: Alan Moore,  Watchmen

Quote: See the moon? It hates us.
Author: Donald Barthelme

Quote: The symbolism of meat-eating is never neutral. To himself, the meat-eater seems to be eating life. To the vegetarian, he seems to be eating death. There is a kind of gestalt-shift between the two positions which makes it hard to change, and hard to raise questions on the matter at all without becoming embattled.
Author: Mary Midgley,  Animals and Why They Matter

Quote: In the Kamigata area, they have a sort of tiered lunchbox they use for a single day when flower viewing. Upon returning, they throw them away, trampling them underfoot. The end is important in all things.
Author: Tsunetomo Yamamoto,  Hagakure: The Book of the Samurai

Quote: The only freedom which deserves the name, is that of pursuing our own good in our own way, so long as we do not attempt to deprive others of theirs, or impede their efforts to obtain it.
Author: John Stuart Mill,  On Liberty

Quote: Foreknowledge cannot be gotten from ghosts and spirits, cannot be had by analogy, cannot be found out by calculation. It must be obtained from people, people who know the conditions of the enemy.
Author: Sun Tzu,  The Art of War

Quote: The human person finds his perfection "in seeking and loving what is true and good.
Author: Pope Benedict XVI

Quote: Pull the string and it will follow wherever you wish. Push it, and it will go nowhere at all.
Author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

Quote: Cricket Bell.” I smiled into my phone. “How did you get so wise?
Author: Stephanie Perkins,  Lola and the Boy Next Door

Quote: Not only do you become what you think about, but the world also becomes what you think about. Those who think that the world is a dark place are blind to the light that might illuminate their lives. Those who see the light of the world view the dark spots as merely potential light.
Author: Wayne W. Dyer

Quote: When you showed someone how you felt, it was fresh and honest. When you told someone how you felt, there might be nothing behind the words but habit or expectation.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Handle with Care

Quote: If we amplify everything, we hear nothing.
Author: Jon Stewart

Quote: In the whole history of the world there is but one thing that money cannot buy...to wit--the wag of a dog's tail.
Author: Josh Billings

Quote: It was hard to live normally when you were constantly pretending you didn't see what was going on in front of your face.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Lady Midnight

Quote: Where happiness was not a possibility, the illusion of it was always more important.
Author: Colum McCann,  Zoli

Quote: We try to fix the outside so much, but our control of the outer world is limited, temporary, and often, illusory.
Author: Matthieu Ricard,  Happiness: A Guide to Developing Life's Most Important Skill

Quote: Only a female could be as calculating and have the foresight that destiny requires,' the gypsy explained. 'Now fate is a man,' he went on, 'no planning, just go with the flow and see what tomorrow brings.
Author: Traci Harding,  The Dragon Queens

Quote: Suffering just means you’re having a bad dream. Happiness means you’re having a good dream. Enlightenment means getting out of the dream altogether.
Author: Jed McKenna

Quote: What is grand is necessarily obscure to weak men. That which can be made explicit to the idiot is not worth my care.
Author: William Blake

Quote: What my parents kept failing to understand was how happy I was when I was alone with my books. There was no pressure to perform or be cute, and books never disappoint-- unless, of course, you've chosen a bad one. But then, you can always put it down and pick up another one without any repercussions.
Author: Lisa Yee,  Millicent Min, Girl Genius

Quote: The right to search for the truth implies also a duty; one must not conceal any part of what one has recognized to be the truth.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: You'd be amazed how much fun you can have if you get out of your own head. The problem is that now people are only interested in themselves. What we have is a non-voting generation. That's what they should call you guys, the non-voting generation. You think you can't fix anything until you fix yourselves. Well, let me be the first to tell you, you will never fix yourselves.p.32
Author: Stephen Elliott,  Happy Baby

Quote: When ill luck begins, it does not come in sprinkles, but in showers.
Author: Mark Twain,  Pudd'nhead Wilson

Quote: Just remember this, my girl, when you look up in the sky you can see the stars and still not see the light.
Author: Jack Tempchin

Quote: Just remember this, my girl, when you look up in the sky you can see the stars and still not see the light.
Author: Jack Tempchin

Quote: What is your idea of earthly happiness? To be vindicated in my own lifetime.
Author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

Quote: Fair as the moon and joyful as the light;Tot wan with waiting, not with sorrow dim; Not as she is, but was when hope shone bright;Not as she is, but as she fills his dreams.
Author: Christina Rossetti

Quote: One of the gravestones in the cemetery near the earliest church has an anchor on it and an hourglass, and the words In Hope.In Hope. Why did they put that above a dead person? Was it the corpse hoping, or those still alive?
Author: Margaret Atwood,  The Handmaid's Tale

Quote: One of the gravestones in the cemetery near the earliest church has an anchor on it and an hourglass, and the words In Hope.In Hope. Why did they put that above a dead person? Was it the corpse hoping, or those still alive?
Author: Margaret Atwood,  The Handmaid's Tale

Quote: One must love God first, and only then can one love one's closest of kin and neighbors. We must not be idols to one another, for such is not the will of God.
Author: Thaddeus of Vitovnica,  Our Thoughts Determine Our Lives: The Life and Teachings of Elder Thaddeus of Vitovnica

Quote: We live in a world that is beyond our control, and life is in a constant flux of change. So we have a decision to make: keep trying to control a storm that is not going to go away or start learning how to live within the rain.
Author: Glenn Pemberton,  Hurting with God

Quote: The fear of God reigning in the heart is the beauty of the soul.
Author: Matthew Henry

Quote: Your current circumstances are part of your redemption story He is writing.
Author: Evinda Lepins

Quote: The mystic chords of memory, stretching from every battle-field, and patriot grave, to every living heart and hearth-stone, all over this broad land, will yet swell the chorus of the Union, when again touched, as surely they will be, by the better angels of our nature.--as quoted in THE RIVER OF WINGED DREAMS
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: The mystic chords of memory, stretching from every battle-field, and patriot grave, to every living heart and hearth-stone, all over this broad land, will yet swell the chorus of the Union, when again touched, as surely they will be, by the better angels of our nature.--as quoted in THE RIVER OF WINGED DREAMS
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: If in my life I fail completely to heed others, solely out of a desire to be 'devout' and to perform my 'religious duties', then my relationship with God will also grow arid. It becomes merely 'proper', but loveless.
Author: Pope Benedict XVI,  God Is Love: Deus Caritas Est

Quote: Christian spirituality was not a children's story. It wasn't cute or neat. It was mystical and odd and clean, and it was reaching into dirty. There was wonder in it and enchantment.
Author: Donald Miller,  Blue Like Jazz: Nonreligious Thoughts on Christian Spirituality

Quote: The nature of the enemy's warfare in your life is to cause you to become discouraged and to cast away your confidence. Not that you would necessarily discard your salvation, but you could give up your hope of God's deliverance. The enemy wants to numb you into a coping kind of Christianity that has given up hope of seeing God's resurrection power.
Author: Bob Sorge,  Glory: When Heaven Invades Earth

Author: Kentetsu Takamori

Quote: Living in a world such as this is like dancing on a live volcano.
Author: Kentetsu Takamori

Quote: Having reached 451 books as of now doesn't help the situation. If I were to be dying now, I would be murmuring, "Too bad! Only four hundred fifty-one."(Those would be my next-to-last words. The last ones will be: "I love you, Janet.") [They were. -Janet.]
Author: Isaac Asimov,  I. Asimov

Quote: Being a cheerful hobbit, he had not needed hope, as long as despair could be postponed.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Two Towers

Quote: I know how you feel because I’ve been there too. I’ve hated and I’ve loved. I’ve seen my demons root and crawl and my angels branch and soar. I've died within myself and lived a thousand different lives. I too fight the same war and I too am drowning in the puddles of self-consciousness this world created.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Author: Paul David Tripp,  Instruments in the Redeemer's Hands: People in Need of Change Helping People in Need of Change

Quote: Prayers are to men as dolls are to children.
Author: Samuel Butler

Quote: A girl always remembers the first corpse she shaves.
Author: Caitlin Doughty,  Smoke Gets in Your Eyes: And Other Lessons from the Crematory

Quote: He gave her a bright fake smile; so much of life was a putting off of unhappiness for another time. Nothing was ever lost by delay. He had a dim idea that perhaps if one delayed long enough, things were taken out of one's hands altogether by death.
Author: Graham Greene,  The Heart of the Matter

Quote: The Christian should work as if all depended upon him, and pray as if it all depended upon God.
Author: Charles Haddon Spurgeon

Quote: Yes, alive,” said Fudge. “That is — I don’t know — is a man alive if he can’t be killed? I don’t really understand it, and Dumbledore won’t explain properly — but anyway, he’s certainly got a body and is walking and talking and killing, so I suppose, for the purposes of our discussion, yes, he’s alive.
Author: J.K. Rowling,  Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince

Quote: The true story of every person in this world is not the story you see, the external story. The true story of each person is the journey of his or her heart.
Author: John Eldredge,  The Sacred Romance: Drawing Closer to the Heart of God

Quote: I am unaware of his plans but I shall never stop believing in them because I cannot fathom them and I prefer to mistrust my own intellectual capacities than his justice.
Author: Alexis de Tocqueville,  Democracy in America

Quote: We mourn the blossoms of May because they are to whither; but we know that May is one day to have its revenge upon November, by the revolution of that solemn circle which never stops---which teaches us in our height of hope, ever to be sober, and in our depth of desolation, never to despair.
Author: William Peter Blatty,  The Exorcist

Quote: I love you Anna Covey,' he said, his voice barely audible. And slowly, clumsily, he leant forward, and his lips found hers, and Anna felt him kiss her awkwardly, she knew that she wasn't a Surplus any more. And nor was Peter.
Author: Gemma Malley,  The Declaration

Quote: I’ll admit that my garden now grows hope in lavish profusion, leaving little room for anything else. I suppose it has squeezed out more practical plants like caution and common sense. Still, though, hope does not flourish in every garden, and I feel thankful it has taken root in mine.
Author: Sharon Kay Penman,  The Reckoning

Quote: No matter what the cause, God is only as willing as you are.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: No matter what the cause, God is only as willing as you are.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: He was dead, all right. He had been shot, poisoned, stabbed, and strangled. Either somebody had really had it in for him or four people had killed him. Or else it was the cleverest suicide I'd ever heard of.
Author: Richard S. Prather,  Take a Murder, Darling

Quote: I met a boy whose eyes showed me that the past, present and future were all the same thing.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth

Quote: I met a boy whose eyes showed me that the past, present and future were all the same thing.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth

Author: Jennifer Elisabeth

Quote: Your guardian angel never, ever stops communicating with you.  I feel that at times they should be frustrated with us but they seem to have endless patience and they never ever give up on us.
Author: Lorna Byrne,  Angels In My Hair

Author: Lorna Byrne,  Angels In My Hair

Quote: Elder mocked me for praying once, and i spent an hour berating him for that. He ended up throwing up his hands, laughing, and telling me i could believe whatever i wanted if i was going to hold onto my beliefs so hard.
Author: Beth Revis,  A Million Suns

Quote: For if there's no everlasting God, there's no such thing as virtue, and there's no need of it.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

Quote: With or without God, good decisions can be made; But only with God will great decisions be made.
Author: Damon Thueson

Quote: With or without God, good decisions can be made; But only with God will great decisions be made.
Author: Damon Thueson

Quote: God is the reason I’m surviving, but he’s sure used you in my life wonderfully. I love you.
Author: Esther Earl,  This Star Won't Go Out: The Life and Words of Esther Grace Earl

Quote: I mean that the reason God seems to act in ways that make no sense to us is that our perceptions are wrong. Our expectations are subtly twisted. We long for things that harm us and run from the things that grow and heal us. We think good is bad and bad is good. God acts rightly, but to us, it seems confusing. Or sometimes plain wrong.
Author: Tessa Afshar,  Pearl in the Sand

Quote: Faith never stays put. It's always challenging always questioning. That's what makes it real.
Author: Patrick Carman,  Thirteen Days to Midnight

Quote: Guys like him, the ones who grip the Bible so tight they leave fingernail grooves, they're the ones who are the most scared of their dark side. Always going too far the other way, fighting for the Lord, often just because it gives them an excuse to fight.
Author: David Wong

Quote: Guys like him, the ones who grip the Bible so tight they leave fingernail grooves, they're the ones who are the most scared of their dark side. Always going too far the other way, fighting for the Lord, often just because it gives them an excuse to fight.
Author: David Wong

Quote: Death, my son, is a good thing for all men; it is the night for this worried day that we call life. It is in the sleep of death that finds rest for eternity the sickness, pain, desperation, and the fears that agitate, without end, we unhappy living souls.
Author: Jacques-Henri Bernardin de Saint-Pierre,  Paul et Virginie

Quote: - Никогда, Робби, не стремись знать слишком много! Чем меньше знаешь, тем проще живется. Знание делает человека свободным, но и несчастным. Давай выпьем за наивность, за глупость и все, что к ним относится - за любовь, за веру в будущее, за мечты о счастье - за божественную глупость, за потерянный рай...
Author: Erich Maria Remarque,  Three Comrades

Quote: I enjoy growing older and wiser and learning from my mistakes every single day.
Author: Ellen DeGeneres,  Seriously... I'm Kidding

Quote: I sat, a solitary man,In a crowded London shop,An open book and empty cupOn the marble table-top.While on the shop and street I gazedMy body of a sudden blazed;And twenty minutes more or lessIt seemed, so great my happiness,That I was blessed and could bless.
Author: W.B. Yeats,  The Winding Stair and Other Poems

Quote: ... a good idea always attracts other good ideas.
Author: Patrick Ness

Quote: The larger the island of knowledge, the longer the shoreline of wonder.
Author: Huston Smith,  Beyond the Post-Modern Mind: The Place of Meaning in a Global Civilization

Quote: If we surrenderedto earth’s intelligencewe could rise up rooted, like trees.Instead we entangle ourselvesin knots of our own makingand struggle, lonely and confused.So like children, we begin again...to fall,patiently to trust our heaviness.Even a bird has to do thatbefore he can fly.
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Rilke's Book of Hours: Love Poems to God

Quote: Free verse is like free love; it is a contradiction in terms.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: If you truly want to know a person, talk to their enemies.
Author: Jamie Leanne Gaines

Quote: she thought it was the misfortune of poetry, to be seldom safely enjoyed by those who enjoyed it completely; and that the strong feelings which alone could estimate it truly, were the very feelings which ought to taste it but sparingly.
Author: Jane Austen,  Persuasion

Quote: Pirate Captain Jim"Walk the plank,"says Pirate Jim"But Captain Jim, I cannot swim.""Then you must steer us through the gale.""But Captain Jim, I cannot sail.""Then down with the galley slaves you go.""But Captain Jim, I cannot row.""Then you must be the pirate's clerk.""But Captain Jim, I cannot work.
Author: Shel Silverstein

Quote: at first when the rain fell from the sky so wide and deepit smelled like sage, my favorite smellI went up on the plateau to watch it cometo see the gifts it always broughtbut this rain changed from blue to black and leftnothing.
Author: Ally Condie,  Matched

Quote: Eros, again now, the loosener of limbs troubles me,Bittersweet, sly, uncontrollable creature….
Author: Sappho

Quote: So the freshness lives onin a lemon,in the sweet-smelling house of the rind,the proportions, arcane and acerb.
Author: Pablo Neruda,  Odes to Common Things

Quote: If my poetry aims to achieve anything, it's to deliver people from the limited ways in which they see and feel.
Author: Jim Morrison

Quote: Just because he likes the same bizzaro crap as you doesn't mean he's your soul mate.
Author: Rachel Hansen

Quote: Romantic haste in drama bringstears and sighs when the hero diesbut the curtain fall is finalwhen in life we take the tragic wayThe sunset too is a glorious thingbut with it ends the day.
Author: C. P. Klapper,  The Washington Poems

Quote: Romantic haste in drama bringstears and sighs when the hero diesbut the curtain fall is finalwhen in life we take the tragic wayThe sunset too is a glorious thingbut with it ends the day.
Author: C. P. Klapper,  The Washington Poems

Quote: In my darkest night,when the moon was coveredand I roamed through wreckage,a nimbus-clouded voicedirected me:“Live in the layers,not on the litter.”Though I lack the artto decipher it,no doubt the next chapterin my book of transformationsis already written.I am not done with my changes.
Author: Stanley Kunitz,  The Collected Poems

Quote: The stars are forth, the moon above the topsOf the snow-shining mountains.—Beautiful!I linger yet with Nature, for the nightHath been to me a more familiar faceThan that of man; and in her starry shadeOf dim and solitary loveliness,I learn'd the language of another world.
Author: George Gordon Byron,  Manfred: A Dramatic Poem

Quote: What if it becomes less about how we look and more about how much we care? What if it becomes less about how much money we earn and more about how much we share our good fortune? Imagine a world where who we are in our hearts is the ultimate status symbol.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Since we cannot know all there is to be known about anything, we ought to know a little about everything.
Author: Blaise Pascal

Quote: He who replies to words of doubtdoth put the light of knowledge out.
Author: William Blake,  Auguries of Innocence

Quote: He who replies to words of doubtdoth put the light of knowledge out.
Author: William Blake,  Auguries of Innocence

Quote: The manlier you are, the harder it is to understand what a woman wants: there is not a hint of female brain in you.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Everything else has vanished, so you take them now. Maybe if you're the one keeping them, I'll be the one feeling better.
Author: Daniel Handler,  Why We Broke Up

Quote: I felt knowledge and the unity of the world circulate in me like my own blood.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Siddhartha

Quote: I am solitary as grass. What is it I miss?Shall I ever find it, whatever it is?
Author: Sylvia Plath

Quote: Two one-armed people might seem perfect for each other, but what if they’re both missing the same arm? Then even something simple like holding hands while walking becomes a case of they’re too similar to see themselves really going anywhere as a couple.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: Jase props himself up on an elbow, looking at me for a minute without saying anything. His face gets an unreadable expression, and I wish I could take back walking over.Then he observes, “I’m guessing that’s a uniform.”Crap. I’d forgotten I was still wearing it.
Author: Huntley Fitzpatrick,  My Life Next Door

Quote: Love is an emotion experienced by the many and enjoyed by the few.
Author: George Jean Nathan

Quote: Love is an emotion experienced by the many and enjoyed by the few.
Author: George Jean Nathan

Quote: That settles it, no more books about vampire before bedtime.
Author: Amanda Ashley

Quote: Okay, that one's pretty good,"Fred acknowledged, after she'd told him a particularly filthy joke. "But have you heard the one about the baker's wife?""No,"Kyra said."Rumor has it, she married him for his buns."Fred burst out laughing.Kyra groaned. "Okay, that was just bad.
Author: Bridget Zinn,  Poison

Quote: I think it [religion] is an art, the greatest one; an extension of the communion all the other arts attempt.
Author: Dodie Smith,  I Capture the Castle

Quote: There are very few innocent sentences in writing.
Author: David Foster Wallace

Quote: Writing comics? Still the best job in the world. I sit around all day making shit up and see it illustrated, in 99% of cases, exactly as I imagined it -- if not better. I've been doing this a long time now, and I'm going to do it until I die. Which probably won't be long, given the constant insane deadline pressure.
Author: Warren Ellis

Quote: ‎"Based on a true story"? No, thanks. I prefer "based on a true imagination".
Author: Enkelejd Lamaj

Quote: Every man with a bellyful of the classics is an enemy to the human race
Author: Henry Miller

Quote: قال بعض العارفين:من قرت عينه بالله قرت به كل عين ،ومن لم تقر عينه بالله تقطعت نفسه على الدنيا حسرات ،ويكفي في فضل هذه اللذة وشرفها انها تخرج من القلب ألم الحسرة على مايفوت من هذه الدنيا ، حتى انه ليتألم بأعظم مايلتذ به من أهلها ويفر منه فرارهم من المؤلم .
Author: ابن قيم الجوزية,  Taman Orang-orang Jatuh Cinta dan Memendam Rindu

Quote: A religion that takes no account of practical affairs and does not help to solve them is no religion.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: If the story you're telling, is the story you're telling, you're in deep shit.
Author: Robert McKee,  Story: Style, Structure, Substance, and the Principles of Screenwriting

Quote: To those who care about punctuation, a sentence such as "Thank God its Friday"(without the apostrophe) rouses feelings not only of despair but of violence. The confusion of the possessive "its"(no apostrophe) with the contractive "it's"(with apostrophe) is an unequivocal signal of illiteracy and sets off a Pavlovian "kill"response in the average stickler.
Author: Lynne Truss,  Eats, Shoots & Leaves: The Zero Tolerance Approach to Punctuation

Quote: Fueled by my inspiration, I ran across the room to steal the cup of coffee the bookshelf had taken prisoner. Lapping the black watery brew like a hyena, I tossed the empty cup aside. I then returned to the chair to continue my divine act of creation. Hot blood swished in my head as my mighty pen stole across the page.
Author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

Quote: He’s an indulgent sort of man……With a quick lip and a fierce tongue, the sort of tongue that draws you in with charm and words of praise, awkward silences and desperate worships.
Author: Coco J. Ginger

Quote: Money is like gasoline during a road trip. You don’t want to run out of gas on your trip, but you’re not doing a tour of gas stations.
Author: Tim O'Reilly

Quote: You have to find your own shtick. A Picasso always looks like Picasso painted it. Hemingway always sounds like Hemingway. A Beethoven symphony always sounds like a Beethoven symphony. Part of being a master is learning how to sing in nobody else's voice but your own.
Author: Hugh MacLeod,  Ignore Everybody: and 39 Other Keys to Creativity

Quote: Man is a slow, sloppy, and brilliant thinker; computers are fast, accurate, and stupid.
Author: John Pfeiffer

Quote: To realize one's destiny is a person's only real obligation and when you want something, all the universe conspires in helping you to achieve it.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Alchemist

Quote: I’m not out to compete with any one, I’m here to complete, by encouraging and inspiring souls through a text at a time
Author: Bernard Kelvin Clive,  Your Dreams Will Not Die

Quote: Writers don't write from experience, although many are hesitant to admit that they don't. ...If you wrote from experience, you'd get maybe one book, maybe three poems. Writers write from empathy.
Author: Nikki Giovanni

Quote: Do you wait for things to happen, or do you make them happen yourself? I believe in writing your own story.
Author: Charlotte Eriksson

Quote: Do you wait for things to happen, or do you make them happen yourself? I believe in writing your own story.
Author: Charlotte Eriksson

Quote: It is simply wrong to begin with a theme, symbol or other abstract unifying agent, and then try to force characters and events to conform to it.
Author: Thomas Pynchon,  Slow Learner: Early Stories

Quote: Writing may or may not be your salvation; it might or might not be your destiny. But that does not matter. What matters right now are the words, one after another. Find the next word. Write it down.
Author: Neil Gaiman

Quote: وتجديد الإسلام ليس نقل الدين من مكانه إلى حيث يهوى الناس، بل نقل الناس من نطاق أهوائهم إلى حيث يرضى الله
Author: محمد الغزالي,  كيف نفهم الإسلام

Quote: There seemed to be some correlation between devotion to God and a misguided zeal for marshmallows.
Author: David Sedaris,  Naked

Quote: If this typewriter can't do it, then fuck it, it can't be done.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Still Life with Woodpecker

Quote: The text you write must prove to me that it desires me. This proof exists: it is writing. Writing is: the science of the various blisses of language, its Kama Sutra (this science has but one treatise: writing itself).
Author: Roland Barthes,  The Pleasure of the Text

Quote: To turn your dreams into reality, all your resources, efforts and concentration should be aligned in the same direction.
Author: Roopleen

Quote: To turn your dreams into reality, all your resources, efforts and concentration should be aligned in the same direction.
Author: Roopleen

Author: Roopleen

Quote: How can you write if you can't cry?
Author: Ring Lardner

Quote: Each time you say hello to a stranger, your heart acknowledges over and over again that we are all family.
Author: Suzy Kassem

Quote: ...there were certain chapters when I stopped writing, saw the domestic situation I was in and thought, "I don't want to face this world, let's get back to the hellish one I'm imagining.
Author: Alasdair Gray

Quote: The purpose of the gospel is to make bad men good and good men better, and to change human nature.
Author: David O. McKay

Quote: It doesn`t hurt to get more education.
Author: Donald J. Trump

Quote: Effort within the mind further limits the mind, because effort implies struggle towards a goal and when you have a goal, a purpose, an end in view, you have placed a limit on the mind.
Author: Bruce Lee,  Tao of Jeet Kune Do

Quote: Once upon a time, all children were homeschooled. They were not sent away from home each day to a place just for children but lived, learned, worked, and played in the real world, alongside adults and other children of all ages.
Author: Rachel Gathercole,  The Well-Adjusted Child: The Social Benefits of Homeschooling

Quote: The difference between Success and failure is not giving up.
Author: Steven Redhead,  The Solution

Quote: A fourth-grade reader may be a sixth-grade mathematician. The grade is an administrative device which does violence to the nature of the developmental process.
Author: B.F. Skinner,  Walden Two

Quote: You have to appreciate where you have come from to know who you are in the present and whom you would like to be in the future.
Author: Truth Devour,  Unrequited

Quote: I imagine that one of the biggest troubles with colleges is there are too many distractions, too much panty-raiding, fraternities, and boola-boola and all of that.
Author: Malcolm X,  The Autobiography of Malcolm X

Quote: My idea of good company, Mr. Eliot, is the company of clever, well-informed people who have a great deal of conversation; that is what I call good company.
Author: Jane Austen,  Persuasion

Quote: Whenever we want to combat our enemies, first and foremost we must start by understanding them rather than exaggerating their motives.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Although teachers do care and do work very, very hard, the institution is psychopathic-it has no conscience. It rings a bell and the young man in the middle of writing a poem must close his notebook and move to a different cell where he must memorize that humans and monkeys derive from a common ancestor.
Author: John Taylor Gatto,  Dumbing Us Down: The Hidden Curriculum of Compulsory Schooling

Quote: In El-harím, there lived a man, a man with yellow eyes.To me, he said, "Beware the whispers, for they whisper lies.Do not wrestle with the demons of the dark,Else upon your mind they'll place a mark;Do not listen to the shadows of the deep,Else they haunt you even when you sleep.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Inheritance

Quote: If you have to ask if you’ve done enough, you haven’t. Each day brings with it the opportunity to do more than you did yesterday.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: There are no environments where you're only going to win, because life just isn't like that.
Author: Bobby Orr

Quote: Luck is a word the bitter teach to the ignorant.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: When you have faults, do not fear to abandon them.
Author: Confucius

Quote: The mind is a metaphor of the world of objects.
Author: Pierre Bourdieu

Quote: Consciousness does not just passively reflect the objective material world; it plays an active role in creating realityitself.
Author: Stanislav Grof

Quote: if you gone come in second, you're just the first loser!
Author: Tiger Woods

Quote: You have to take your own bold approach, and if you do you will be rewarded with success. Or calamitous failure. That can happen too.
Author: Steven Moffat

Quote: Positive energy is attracted to positive energy.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: I used to pray that God would feed the hungry, or do this or that, but now I pray that he will guide me to do whatever I'm supposed to do, what I can do. I used to pray for answers, but now I'm praying for strength. I used to believe that prayer changes things, but now I know that prayer changes us and we change things.
Author: Mother Teresa

Quote: There are lots of great ideas in my book, but as a cohesive unit, my book is only held together with glue at the spine. Or it would be, if it weren’t an ebook.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: I am not afraid of a person who knows 10000 kicks. But I am afraid of a person who knows one kick but practices it for 10000 times.
Author: Bruce Lee,  Bruce Lee — Wisdom for the Way

Quote: Indubitably, Magick is one of the subtlest and most difficult of the sciences and arts. There is more opportunity for errors of comprehension, judgement and practice than in any other branch of physics.
Author: Aleister Crowley,  The Confessions of Aleister Crowley: An Autohagiography

Quote: Your beliefs don't make you a better person, your behavior does.
Author: Sukhraj S. Dhillon

Quote: Science is the poetry of reality.
Author: Richard Dawkins

Quote: If a rat is a good model for your emotional life, you're in big trouble.
Author: Robert M. Sapolsky

Quote: If the history-deniers who doubt the fact of evolution are ignorant of biology, those who think the world began less than ten thousand years ago are worse than ignorant, they are deluded to the point of perversity. They are denying not only the facts of biology but those of physics, geology, cosmology, archaeology, history and chemistry as well.
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The Greatest Show on Earth: The Evidence for Evolution

Quote: I maintain that the cosmic religious feeling is the strongest and noblest motive for scientific research.
Author: Albert Einstein,  The World As I See It

Quote: Thrill me, chill me I went in search of money and success, all I got was a bellyful of excess! Now that I've realigned myself I’m on my tip-toes because life is sweet! I'm overwhelmed with gratitude for all the blessings that are manifesting in my life … neat!
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: the depth of a person's character is not measured by his or her physical strength, but by the depth of his or her nobility.
Author: Frank E. Peretti

Quote: I'm no longer quite sure what the question is, but I do know that the answer is Yes.
Author: Leonard Bernstein,  The Unanswered Question: Six Talks at Harvard (Charles Eliot Norton Lectures)

Quote: The very nature of the quantum theory ... forces us to regard the space-time coordination and the claim of causality, the union of which characterizes the classical theories, as complementary but exclusive features of the description, symbolizing the idealization of observation and description, respectively.
Author: Niels Bohr

Quote: If you`re wondering how you`ll find time, it means you don`t really want to read. Because nobody`s ever got time. Children certainly haven`t, nor have teenagers or grown-ups. Life always gets in the way. <...>Time to read is always time stolen. <...>Stolen from what? From the tyranny of living.”- p.125
Author: Daniel Pennac

Quote: I believe in books.
Author: Carole Maso,  Room Lit By Roses

Quote: It is a capital mistake to theorise before one has data.
Author: Arthur Conan Doyle,  The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes

Quote: It would be better for us to have some doubts in an honest pursuit of truth, than it would be for us to be certain about something that was not true.
Author: Daniel Wallace

Quote: Create each day anew.
Author: Morihei Ueshiba

Quote: A friend is what the heart needs all the time.
Author: Henry Van Dyke

Quote: Stuart Hall was an utterly unique figure. Although he arrived at the age of 19 from Jamaica and spent the rest of his life here, he never felt at home in Britain. This juxtaposition was a crucial source of his strength and originality. Because of his colour and origin, he saw the country differently - not as a native, but as an outsider.
Author: Martin Jacques

Quote: Positive thinking is the key to success in business, education, pro football, anything that you can mention. I go out there thinking that I'm going to complete every pass.
Author: Ron Jaworski

Quote: However, I hope I am also judged on my accomplishments as an actor and not just on my pretty face!
Author: Jonathan Brandis

Quote: All mankind love a lover.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: When you start a company, it's more an art than a science because it's totally unknown. Instead of solving high-profile problems, try to solve something that's deeply personal to you. Ideally, if you're an ordinary person and you've just solved your problem, you might have solved the problem for millions of people.
Author: Brian Chesky

Quote: I regard the writing of humor as a supreme artistic challenge.
Author: Herman Wouk

Quote: Truth gains more even by the errors of one who, with due study and preparation, thinks for himself, than by the true opinions of those who only hold them because they do not suffer themselves to think…
Author: John Stuart Mill,  On Liberty

Quote: Truth gains more even by the errors of one who, with due study and preparation, thinks for himself, than by the true opinions of those who only hold them because they do not suffer themselves to think…
Author: John Stuart Mill,  On Liberty

Quote: Don't appreciate me, I'm not up to it. Don't criticize me, I don't deserve it. Just be my friend and forgive me, because I am craving for it.
Author: Debasish Mridha

Quote: Reason is, and ought only to be the slave of the passions, and can never pretend to any other office than to serve and obey them.
Author: David Hume,  A Treatise of Human Nature

Quote: To stay or to go, it amounted to the same thing.
Author: Albert Camus,  The Stranger

Quote: Philosophers, for example, often fail to recognize that their remarks about the universe apply also to themselves and their remarks. If the universe is meaningless, so is the statement that it is so.
Author: Alan W. Watts

Quote: Love is silence multiplied by noise and divided by two.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

Quote: the body is wiser than its inhabitants. the body is the soul. the body is god’s messenger.
Author: Erica Jong

Quote: the body is wiser than its inhabitants. the body is the soul. the body is god’s messenger.
Author: Erica Jong

Quote: The free mind, unafraid of labor, presses on to attain the good.
Author: Laura Cereta,  Collected Letters of a Renaissance Feminist

Quote: In the battle that is philosophy all the techniques of war, including looting and camouflage, are permissible.
Author: Louis Althusser,  Philosophy and the Spontaneous Philosophy of the Scientists: And Other Essays

Author: Louis Althusser,  Philosophy and the Spontaneous Philosophy of the Scientists: And Other Essays

Quote: Every life is different because you passed this way and touched history.
Author: Barbara Kingsolver,  The Poisonwood Bible

Quote: After your death, you will be what you were before your birth.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Quote: Bring the mind into sharp focus and make it alert so that it can immediately intuit truth, which is everywhere. The mind must be emancipated from old habits, prejudices, restrictive thought processes and even ordinary thought itself.
Author: Bruce Lee,  Tao of Jeet Kune Do

Quote: let the speaker speak truly and the judge decide justly.
Author: Plato,  Plato I: Euthyphro. Apology. Crito. Phaedo. Phaedrus.

Quote: To sum it all up, the [Ayn] Rand belief system looks like this:1. Facts are facts: things can be absolutely right or absolutely wrong, as determined by reason.2. According to my reasoning, I am absolutely right.3. Charity is immoral.4. Pay for your own fucking schools.
Author: Matt Taibbi,  Griftopia: Bubble Machines, Vampire Squids, and the Long Con That Is Breaking America

Quote: The most total opposite of pleasure is not pain but boredom, for we are willing to risk pain to make a boring life interesting.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: This time, there was no escape, I could not turn away, could not leave without accepting what I had done. There was only one way to the other side, and that was through the pain.
Author: Vanessa Diffenbaugh,  The Language of Flowers

Quote: A picture held us captive. And we could not get outside it, for it lay in our language and language seemed to repeat it to us inexorably.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein,  Philosophical Investigations

Quote: The zipper displaces the button and a man lacks just that much time to think while dressing at dawn, a philosophical hour, and thus a melancholy hour.
Author: Ray Bradbury,  Fahrenheit 451

Quote: But what minutes! Count them by sensation, and not by calendars, and each moment is a day.
Author: Benjamin Disraeli

Quote: Go slowly, so that you do not bite your tail by accident.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Inheritance

Quote: We must not only obtain Wisdom: we must enjoy her.
Author: Marcus Tullius Cicero,  Selected Works

Quote: Reading is at the threshold of the spiritual life; it can introduce us to it. It does not constitute it ... There are certain cases of spiritual depression in which reading can become a sort of curative discipline ... reintroducing a lazy mind into the life of the Spirit.
Author: Marcel Proust

Quote: ولمّا فتحت قلبي لكي ارى السعادة, وجدت مرآتها وسريرها وملابسها, لكنّي لم اجدها.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: As Venus within Eros does not really aim at pleasure, so Eros does not aim at happiness. We may think he does, but when he is brought to the test it proves otherwise... For it is the very mark of Eros that when he is in us we had rather share unhappiness with the Beloved than be happy on any other terms.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

Quote: You will be your best self when you take time to understand what you really need, feel and want.
Author: Deborah Day,  BE HAPPY NOW!

Quote: You will be your best self when you take time to understand what you really need, feel and want.
Author: Deborah Day,  BE HAPPY NOW!

Quote: Worship your body, beauty, and sexual allure and you will die a million deaths before they finally grieve you.
Author: David Foster Wallace

Quote: Your teacher might be a child who takes you by the hand and asks you a question that you hadn't considered before, and your answer to the child is your answer to yourself.
Author: Wayne W. Dyer

Quote: Happiness doesn't have to be chased...it merely has to be chosen.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: Happiness doesn't have to be chased...it merely has to be chosen.
Author: Mandy Hale,  The Single Woman: Life, Love, and a Dash of Sass

Quote: Learning isn't acquiring knowledge so much as it is trimming information that has already been acquired.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Learning isn't acquiring knowledge so much as it is trimming information that has already been acquired.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Your life is always under construction. It is your job to learn howto untangle the threads and weave a tapestry that matches your desires.
Author: Dannye Williamsen

Quote: People with a grudge against the world are always dangerous. They seem to think life owes them something. I've known many an invalid who has suffered worse and been cut off from life much more . . . and they've managed to lead happy contented lives. It's what's in yourself that makes you happy or unhappy.
Author: Agatha Christie,  A Murder Is Announced

Quote: I had always been taught that the pursuit of happiness was my natural (even national) birthright. It is the emotional trademark of my culture to seek happiness. Not just any kind of happiness, either, but profound happiness, even soaring happiness. And what could possibly bring a person more soaring happiness than romantic love.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Committed: A Skeptic Makes Peace with Marriage

Quote: The truth between two people always cuts two ways.
Author: Diana Wynne Jones,  Fire and Hemlock

Quote: Even things that are true can be proved.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: See now the power of truth; the same experiment which at first glance seemed to show one thing, when more carefully examined, assures us of the contrary.
Author: Galileo Galilei,  Discorsi E Dimostrazioni Matematiche: Intorno a Due Nuoue Scienze, Attenenti Alla Mecanica & I Movimenti Locali

Quote: Sometimes you just have to jump in a mud puddle because it's there. Never get so old that you forget about having fun.
Author: Tom Giaquinto,  Be A Good Human

Quote: This moment is yours and yours alone! Take charge, seize this moment and allow it to propel you to the high levels of an empowered life. Allow upon this fertile moment to be planted the seeds of your happiness and success.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: This moment is yours and yours alone! Take charge, seize this moment and allow it to propel you to the high levels of an empowered life. Allow upon this fertile moment to be planted the seeds of your happiness and success.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: .. she believed a great happiness awaited her somewhere, and for this reason she remained calm as the days flew by.
Author: Gyula Krúdy,  Sunflower

Quote: There is no compulsion for man to accept the truth. But it is certainly a shame upon the human intellect when man is not even interested in finding out as to what is the truth! Islam teaches that God has given man the faculty of reason and therefore expects man to reason things out objectively and systematically for himself. To reflect and to question and to reflect.
Author: Maurice Bucaille,  The Qur'an and Modern Science

Quote: To realize the truth, you have to cross the boundaries of all religions and prophets.
Author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

Quote: To realize the truth, you have to cross the boundaries of all religions and prophets.
Author: Amit Ray,  Meditation: Insights and Inspirations

Quote: Once war becomes a clash of absolutes, there is no breathing room for mercy. Absolute truth is blind truth.
Author: Deepak Chopra,  The Third Jesus: The Christ We Cannot Ignore

Quote: O Diabo, invejoso, fez o homem confundir fé com religião e amor com casamento.
Author: Machado de Assis

Quote: O Diabo, invejoso, fez o homem confundir fé com religião e amor com casamento.
Author: Machado de Assis

Quote: O Diabo, invejoso, fez o homem confundir fé com religião e amor com casamento.
Author: Machado de Assis

Quote: Faith is the flame that eliminates fear.
Author: Suzy Kassem

Quote: Faith is the flame that eliminates fear.
Author: Suzy Kassem

Quote: Life is too fleet for onomatopoeia.
Author: Mervyn Peake,  Titus Groan

Quote: It felt as though the whole globe was dressed in snow. Like it has pulled it on, the way you pull on a sweater. Next to the train line, footprints were sunken to their shins. Trees wore blankets of ice. As you may expect, someone has died.
Author: Markus Zusak,  The Book Thief

Quote: I still believe in man in spite of man. I believe in language even though it has been wounded, deformed, and perverted by the enemies of mankind. And I continue to cling to words because it is up to us to transform them into instruments of comprehension rather than contempt. It is up to us to choose whether we wish to use them to curse or to heal, to wound or to console.
Author: Elie Wiesel,  Open Heart

Quote: You will be at your best forever, Even now you have good moments. Occasional glimpses of your heavenly self. When you change your baby's diaper, forgive your boss's temper, tolerate your spouse's moodiness, you display traces of saintliness.
Author: Max Lucado,  3:16: The Numbers of Hope

Quote: You will be at your best forever, Even now you have good moments. Occasional glimpses of your heavenly self. When you change your baby's diaper, forgive your boss's temper, tolerate your spouse's moodiness, you display traces of saintliness.
Author: Max Lucado,  3:16: The Numbers of Hope

Quote: Easily mistaken, it is not about a love for adversity, it is about knowing a strength and a faith so great that adversity, in all its adverse manifestations, hardly even exists.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Easily mistaken, it is not about a love for adversity, it is about knowing a strength and a faith so great that adversity, in all its adverse manifestations, hardly even exists.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Where music thundered let the mind be still,Where the will triumphed let there be no will,What light revealed, now let the dark fulfill.
Author: May Sarton

Quote: Where music thundered let the mind be still,Where the will triumphed let there be no will,What light revealed, now let the dark fulfill.
Author: May Sarton

Quote: When his brain died, all of the memoriesheld in his gray matter, along with all of the knowledge he had acquired, would simply evaporatein a flood of chemical reactions.
Author: Dan Brown,  The Lost Symbol

Quote: For death is life. It is only living that is lifeless.
Author: Mervyn Peake,  Titus Groan

Quote: It is good that a man's enemies want him dead, for it proves he has lived a life of worth.
Author: Forrest Carter,  The Outlaw Josey Wales

Quote: We must be content to grow slowly. Most of us will still barely be at the beginning of our recovery by the time we die. But that is better than killing ourselves pretending to be healthy.
Author: Simon Tugwell

Quote: I have always considered "Pascal's Wager"a questionable bet to place, since any God worth believing in would prefer an honest agnostic to a calculating hypocrite.
Author: Alan M. Dershowitz,  Letters to a Young Lawyer

Quote: I find relief from the questions only when I concede that I am not obliged to know everything. I remind myself it is sufficient to know what I know, and that what I know, may not always be true.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: Believe something and the Universe is on its way to being changed. Because you've changed, by believing. Once you've changed, other things start to follow. Isn't that the way it works?
Author: Diane Duane,  So You Want to Be a Wizard

Quote: Sometimes in life we take a leap of faith. Remember, the leap is not about getting from one side to the other. It's simply about taking the leap....and trusting the air, the universal breath, will support your wings so that you may soar.
Author: Kristi Bowman

Quote: By denying scientific principles, one may maintain any paradox.
Author: Galileo Galilei

Quote: By denying scientific principles, one may maintain any paradox.
Author: Galileo Galilei

Quote: whats here a cup closed in my true loves hand poisin i see hath been his timeless end. oh churl drunk all and left no friendly drop to help me after. i will kiss thy lips some poisin doth hang on them, to help me die with a restorative. thy lips are warm.yea noise then ill be brief oh happy dagger this is thy sheath. there rust and let me die.
Author: William Shakespeare

Quote: Hidup hanya menunda kekalahan.
Author: Chairil Anwar,  Derai-derai Cemara

Quote: It is said that God is always on the side of the big battalions.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: Sorry to hear about your Dad."He shrugged. "He was seventy, and we always told him fast food would kill him.""Heart attack?""He was hit by a Pizza Express truck.
Author: J.A. Konrath,  Whiskey Sour

Quote: Birth and death were easy. It was life that was hard.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Jitterbug Perfume

Quote: We're all dead the moment we're born. Just, some of us get there faster than others.
Author: Alex Scarrow,  The Eternal War

Quote: I don't buy idea of second chance.With hope we make a lot of chances.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Stability was overrated. Crises and adventures, on the other hand, could actually teach you something.
Author: Sarah Addison Allen

Quote: Am I as spontaneously kind to God as I used to be, or am I only expecting God to be kind to me? Am I full of the little things that cheer His heart over me, or am I whimpering because things are going hardly with me? There is no joy in the soul that has forgotten what God prizes.
Author: Oswald Chambers

Quote: Am I as spontaneously kind to God as I used to be, or am I only expecting God to be kind to me? Am I full of the little things that cheer His heart over me, or am I whimpering because things are going hardly with me? There is no joy in the soul that has forgotten what God prizes.
