Quote: [I]t is difficult to imagine a set of beliefs more suggestive of mental illness than those that lie at the heart of many of our religious traditions.
Author: Sam Harris,  The End of Faith: Religion, Terror, and the Future of Reason

Quote: [I]t is difficult to imagine a set of beliefs more suggestive of mental illness than those that lie at the heart of many of our religious traditions.
Author: Sam Harris,  The End of Faith: Religion, Terror, and the Future of Reason

Quote: Though wrong gratifies in the moment, good yields its gifts over a lifetime.
Author: Desmond Tutu

Quote: Hardships are the Lord's greatest blessings to the believer. Without them we would love the Lord only for what He does for us. Our troubles teach us to love Him for who He is."Sister Norton in "The Preacher's Bride
Author: Jody Hedlund

Quote: You can still be cool when you’re dead. In fact, it’s much easier, because you aren’t getting old and fat and losing your hair.
Author: Audrey Niffenegger,  The Time Traveler's Wife

Quote: O weep for Adonis - He is dead.""Peace. He is not dead he doth not sleep - he hath wakened from the dream of life
Author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

Quote: I'm not ashamed of heroic ambitions. If man and woman can only dance upon this earth for a few countable turns of the sun... let each of us be an Artemis, Odysseus, or Zeus... Aphrodite to the extent of the will of each one.
Author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

Quote: As long as you do things for God, you are a Hall of Famer in heaven's list.
Author: Rick Warren,  The Purpose Driven Life: What on Earth Am I Here for?

Quote: I never had any doubts about my abilities. I knew I could write. I just had to figure out how to eat while doing this.[Cormac McCarthy's Venomous Fiction, New York Times, April 19, 1992]
Author: Cormac McCarthy

Quote: I never had any doubts about my abilities. I knew I could write. I just had to figure out how to eat while doing this.[Cormac McCarthy's Venomous Fiction, New York Times, April 19, 1992]
Author: Cormac McCarthy

Quote: there's only one truth!
Author: Felix Y. Siauw,  Beyond The Inspiration

Quote: So the nymphs they spoke,we kissed and laid.By noontime’s hourour love was made.Like braided chains of crocus stems,we lay entwined, I laid with them.Our breath, one glassy, tideless sea,our bodies draping wearily,we slept, I slept so lucidly,with hopes to stay this memory.
Author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

Quote: Love for yourself is the key to loving other. Love begins with you.
Author: Miguel Ruiz,  Prayers: A Communion with Our Creator

Quote: We flatter those we scarcely know,We please the fleeting guest;And deal full many a thoughtless blow,To those who love us best.
Author: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

Quote: and I ask myself and you, which of our visions will claim uswhich will we claimhow will we go on livinghow will we touch, what will we knowwhat will we say to each other.
Author: Adrienne Rich

Quote: A fallen blossomreturning to the bough, I thought --But no, a butterfly.
Author: Arakida Moritake,  Traditional Japanese Poetry: An Anthology

Quote: I have been happy, though in a dream.I have been happy-and I love the theme:Dreams! in their vivid colouring of lifeAs in that fleeting, shadowy, misty strife
Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: If you never left anything or anyone there would be no room for the new. Naturally, to move on is an infidelity -- to others, to the past, to old notions of oneself. Perhaps every day should contain at least one essential infidelity or necessary betrayal. It would be an optimistic, hopeful act, guaranteeing belief in the future -- a declaration that things can be not only different but better.
Author: Hanif Kureishi,  Intimacy: das Buch zum Film von Patrice Chéreau

Quote: Taking personal accountability is a beautiful thing because it gives us complete control of our destinies.
Author: Heather Schuck,  The Working Mom Manifesto

Quote: Miro, I'm so sorry. I always felt such pity for you humans because you could only think of one thing at a time and your memories were so imperfect and . . . now I realize that just getting through the day without killing somebody can be an achievement."It gets to be a habit. Most of us manage to keep our body count quite low. It's the neighborly way to live.
Author: Orson Scott Card,  Children of the Mind

Quote: Love is supposed to be based on trust, and trust on love, it's something rare and beautiful when people can confide in each other without fearing what the other person will think.
Author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

Quote: God is great and God is good,"Lisa says. "But where are the Apache attack helicopters when you need them?
Author: Suzanne Finnamore,  Split: A Memoir of Divorce

Quote: There is something about me, doll face. It’s between my legs, and I do believe a few minutes ago you were praying to it.
Author: Debra Anastasia,  Crushed Seraphim

Quote: And you can't have two stars in one relationship. Somebody has to be willing to be the wagon...at lease some of the time
Author: Meg Cabot,  Queen of Babble Gets Hitched

Quote: As I nodded and smiled and umm-hmm'd and oh, my'd my way down the drive, I wondered if boys had any sort of magazine that told them how to attract women and, if so, did it ever tell them to put the girls' interests first?
Author: Jennifer Donnelly,  A Northern Light

Quote: Have you any other objection than your belief of my indifference?"- Elizabeth Bennet
Author: Jane Austen

Quote: If for some reason we get separated, I want you to wait for me. I’ll find you, I promise. - Gabriel Emerson
Author: Sylvain Reynard,  Gabriel's Inferno

Quote: Because a doubt is not a denial. Doubt is a powerful tool, and it should be applied to history.
Author: Walter M. Miller Jr.,  A Canticle for Leibowitz

Quote: Because a doubt is not a denial. Doubt is a powerful tool, and it should be applied to history.
Author: Walter M. Miller Jr.,  A Canticle for Leibowitz

Quote: With my career I want to either make something or make an impact. Writers both make something, and make an impact.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: Writers cannot choose their own mood: with them it is not always hide-tide, nor --thank Heaven!--always Storm.
Author: Charlotte Brontë

Quote: Dare to be different. Represent your maker well and you will forever abide in the beautiful embrace of his loving arms.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: Dare to be different. Represent your maker well and you will forever abide in the beautiful embrace of his loving arms.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: God is never tired of bringing the sun out every morning, taking it in the evenings and bringing out the moon.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: God is never tired of bringing the sun out every morning, taking it in the evenings and bringing out the moon.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: No matter how dim the light filtering through the trees is, you can still try your best to grasp it. -Kaien Cross
Author: Matsuri Hino,  Vampire Knight, Vol. 16

Quote: No matter how dim the light filtering through the trees is, you can still try your best to grasp it. -Kaien Cross
Author: Matsuri Hino,  Vampire Knight, Vol. 16

Quote: When the last dime is gone, I'll sit on the curb outside with a pencil and a ten cent notebook and start the whole thing over again.
Author: Preston Sturges

Quote: Writing is like going underwater - thank you for being there when I come back up.
Author: Ali Shaw,  The Girl With Glass Feet

Quote: When you give appreciation IN ORDER TO get something– it's manipulation and people can sense it. Appreciate genuinely.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: When you give appreciation IN ORDER TO get something– it's manipulation and people can sense it. Appreciate genuinely.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: So consider your options, make your choice and call me home.
Author: Kelley Armstrong,  Living with the Dead

Quote: Notice the difference between being in control and needing control.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: Notice the difference between being in control and needing control.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: Be like a postage stamp. Stick to it until you get there
Author: Bob Proctor

Quote: The mind travels faster than the pen; consequently, writing becomes a question of learning to make occasional wing shots, bringing down the bird of thought as it flashes by. A writer is a gunner, sometimes waiting in the blind for something to come in, sometimes roaming the countryside hoping to scare something up.
Author: E.B. White,  The Elements of Style

Quote: not to find out new principles, or new arguments, never before thought of . . . but to place before mankind the common sense of the subject, in terms so plain and firm as to command their assent, and to justify ourselves in the independent stand we are compelled to take.
Author: Thomas Jefferson,  The Declaration of Independence

Quote: I confess to wincing every so often at a poorly chosen word, a mangled sentence, an expression of emotion that seems indulgent or overly practiced. I have the urge to cut the book by fifty pages or so, possessed as I am with a keener appreciation for brevity.
Author: Barack Obama

Quote: The job of the first eight pages is not to have the reader want to throw the book at the wall, during the first eight pages.
Author: David Foster Wallace

Quote: Hello, I'm Shellie's new boyfriend and I'm out of my mind. If you so much as talk to her or even think her name, I'll cut you in ways that'll make you useless to a woman.
Author: Frank Miller,  Sin City, Vol. 3: The Big Fat Kill

Quote: Du kennst doch bestimmt den Spruch, dass Gott die Menschen nach seinem Ebenbild erschaffen hat. Guck dich mal um! Wenn man davon ausgeht, dass Gott ein Arschloch ist, ergibt das plötzlich mächtig viel Sinn.
Author: Marc-Uwe Kling,  Die Känguru-Chroniken: Ansichten eines vorlauten Beuteltiers

Quote: Religion is never more tested than when our emotions are ablaze. At such a time, the timeless grandeur of the Law and its ethics stand at our mercy.
Author: Timothy J. Winter - Abdal Hakim Murad

Quote: If you want to get rich from writing, write the sort of thing that's read by persons who move their lips when they're reading to themselves.
Author: Don Marquis

Quote: Fully inhale your dream and completely exhale manifestation of it.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: What each of us believes in is up to us, but life is impossible without believing in something.
Author: Kentetsu Takamori,  Unlocking Tannisho: Shinran's Words on the Pure Land Path

Quote: My worst flaw is that I tell secrets, my own and everybody else's.
Author: Isabel Allende,  My Invented Country: A Nostalgic Journey Through Chile

Quote: إن المؤمن ليدرك بحسن الخلق درجة الصائم والقائم
Author: Anonymous,  The Quran / القرآن الكريم

Quote: Religion must remain an outlet for people who say to themselves, 'I am not the kind of person I want to be.' It must never sink into an assemblage of the self-satisfied.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Dune

Quote: At the age of four, I wanted to be eight. At the age of eight, I wanted to be 16. At the age of 16, when I started driving, I wanted to be a Ferrari. And now, at the age of middle, I want to be Stalin’s mustache and matching armpit hair. But only for personal reasons, not political.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: Tell me this--if you knew you would be poor as a church mouse all your life--if you knew you'd never have a line published--would you still go on writing--would you?''Of course I would,' said Emily disdainfully. 'Why, I have to write--I can't help it at times--I've just got to.
Author: L.M. Montgomery,  Emily of New Moon

Quote: The fishing is best where the fewest go and the collective insecurity of the world makes it easy for people to hit home runs while everyone is aiming for base hits.
Author: Timothy Ferriss

Quote: With ordinary talent and extraordinary perseverance, all things are attainable
Author: Thomas Fowell Buxton

Quote: You will never know what you are doing until and unless you have done it.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Genius is an exceedingly common human quality, probably natural to most of us.
Author: John Taylor Gatto

Quote: Whoever educates himself and improves his own morals & character is superior to the man who tries to teach & train others.
Author: Hazrat Ali ibn Abu-Talib

Quote: Actually, all education is self-education. A teacher is only a guide, to point out the way, and no school, no matter how excellent, can give you education. What you receive is like the outlines in a child’s coloring book. You must fill in the colors yourself.
Author: Louis L'Amour

Quote: Success goes to the ones who do. Get up. Show up. Throw up if you have to. Do it afraid, but do it no matter.
Author: Toni Sorenson

Quote: Every man has a specific skill, whether it is discovered or not, that more readily and naturally comes to him than it would to another, and his own should be sought and polished. He excels best in his niche - originality loses its authenticity in one's efforts to obtain originality.
Author: Criss Jami,  Salomé: In Every Inch In Every Mile

Quote: Every man has a specific skill, whether it is discovered or not, that more readily and naturally comes to him than it would to another, and his own should be sought and polished. He excels best in his niche - originality loses its authenticity in one's efforts to obtain originality.
Author: Criss Jami,  Salomé: In Every Inch In Every Mile

Quote: One thought I think every person eventually thinks is, “Holy shit, I’m going to die!” Sorry, I just turned thirty yesterday, so my mortality is on my mind.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: God has mercifully ordered that the human brain works slowly; first the blow, hours afterwards the bruise.
Author: Walter de la Mare,  The Return

Quote: Action is the universal language of success.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: In an age in which the media broadcast countless pieces of foolishness, the educated man is defined not by what he knows, but by what he doesn't know.
Author: Nicolás Gómez Dávila

Quote: I live my life in widening circleThat reach out across the world. I may not ever complete the last one,But I give myself to it. I circle around God, that primordial tower.I have been circling for thousands of years,And I still don't know: am I a falcon,A storm, or a great song? [I, 2]
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Rilke's Book of Hours: Love Poems to God

Quote: He's satisfied with himself. If you have a soul you can't be satisfied.
Author: Graham Greene,  Doctor Fischer of Geneva or The Bomb Party

Quote: I want to be as idle as I can, so that my soul may have time to grow.
Author: Elizabeth von Arnim,  The Solitary Summer

Quote: The more expensive a school is, the more crooks it has — I'm not kidding.
Author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

Quote: There is more to a soul than what others see
Author: Colleen Coble,  Fire Dancer

Quote: We must never stop dreaming. Dreams provide nourishment for the soul, just as a meal does for the body. Many times in our lives we see our dreams shattered and our desires frustrated, but we have to continue dreaming. If we don't, our soul dies, and agape cannot reach it.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Pilgrimage

Quote: I would not bend.They could not make me Pliable.My mind was strong.My mind was mine.
Author: Janice Hardy,  Blue Fire

Quote: We move between two darknesses.
Author: E.M. Forster,  Aspects of the Novel

Quote: He offered her power, money, status...a giant prison, all in exchange for only...her soul.
Author: Coco J. Ginger

Quote: Digestion of words as well; I often read aloud to myself in my writing corner in the library, where no one can hear me, for the sake of better savouring the text, so as to make it all the more mine.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: As it unfolded, the structure of the story began to remind me of one of those Russian dolls that contain innumerable ever-smaller dolls within. Step by step the narrative split into a thousand stories, as if it had entered a gallery of mirrors, its identity fragmented into endless reflections.
Author: Carlos Ruiz Zafón,  The Shadow of the Wind

Quote: Understanding requires insight. Insight must be anchored.
Author: Brian Greene,  The Fabric of the Cosmos

Quote: If you take any step, no matter how small it is, towards achieving your dreams then you will surely find the right path and reach the abundance that lies in store for you.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Temporis filia veritas; cui me obstetricari non pudet.Truth is the daughter of time, and I feel no shame in being her midwife.
Author: Johannes Kepler

Quote: Nothing great is ever accomplished by following standards.
Author: Geoffroy Birtz

Quote: No one infers a god from the simple, from the known, from what is understood, but from the complex, from the unknown, and incomprehensible. Our ignorance is God; what we know is science.
Author: Robert G. Ingersoll,  On the Gods and Other Essays

Quote: If only the scientific experts could come up with something to get it out of our minds. One cup of fixit fizzle that will lift the dirt from our lives, soften our hardness, protect our inner parts, improve our processing, reduce our yellowing and wrinkling, improve our natural color, and make us sweet and good.
Author: Robert Fulghum,  All I Really Need to Know I Learned in Kindergarten: Uncommon Thoughts on Common Things

Quote: The paper does not provide the exact number of penises eaten by ducks, but the author says there have been enough over the years to prompt the coining of a popular saying: 'I better get home or the ducks will have something to eat.
Author: Mary Roach,  Bonk: The Curious Coupling of Science and Sex

Quote: The truth is more magical - in the best and most exciting sense of the word - than any myth or made-up mystery or miracle. Science has its own magic: the magic of reality.
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The Magic of Reality: How We Know What's Really True

Quote: That's the thing about a great book. Every time you read it, it's different, because you're different. You've changed since the last time you picked it up, things have happened to you.
Author: Jessica Zafra,  Twisted 9

Quote: The first door in the hall leads to youth, the second door leads to middle age, and the third door leads to the bathroom. But knock first, because I think grandpa’s in there.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: The philosopher whose dealings are with divine order himself acquires the characteristics of order and divinity.
Author: Plato,  The Republic

Quote: The greatest untold story is the evolution of God.
Author: G.I. Gurdjieff

Quote: To be a philosopher, just reverse everything you have ever been told...and have a sense of humor doing it.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: LORD ILLINGWORTH: The soul is born old but grows young. That is the comedy of life.MRS ALLONBY: And the body is born young and grows old. That is life's tragedy.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  A Woman of No Importance

Quote: He walked on in silence, the solitary sound of his footsteps echoing in his head, as in a deserted street, at dawn. His solitude was so complete, beneath a lovely sky as mellow and serene as a good conscience, amid that busy throng, that he was amazed at his own existence; he must be somebody else's nightmare, and whoever it was would certainly awaken soon.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre,  The Age of Reason

Quote: The universe danced towards life. Life was a remarkably common commodity. Anything sufficiently complicated seemed to get cut in for some, in the same way that anything massive enough got a generous helping of gravity. The universe had a definite tendency towards awareness. This suggested a certain subtle cruelty woven into the very fabric of space-time.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Soul Music

Quote: There is no such thing as educational value in the abstract. The notion that some subjects and methods and that acquaintance with certain facts and truths possess educational value in and of themselves is the reason why traditional education reduced the material of education so largely to a diet of predigested materials.
Author: John Dewey,  Experience and Education

Quote: There is no such thing as educational value in the abstract. The notion that some subjects and methods and that acquaintance with certain facts and truths possess educational value in and of themselves is the reason why traditional education reduced the material of education so largely to a diet of predigested materials.
Author: John Dewey,  Experience and Education

Quote: Impossible things are really rough to do, you know.
Author: Brandon Sanderson,  Alcatraz Versus the Shattered Lens

Quote: There is your truth and there is my truth. As for the universal truth, it does not exist.
Author: Amish Tripathi

Quote: The soul exists partly in eternity and partly in time.
Author: Marsilio Ficino

Quote: The soul exists partly in eternity and partly in time.
Author: Marsilio Ficino

Quote: When you are lonely for a while don't get restless, if you had born alone, you are going to die alone then for sometime you can certainly live alone.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: When you are lonely for a while don't get restless, if you had born alone, you are going to die alone then for sometime you can certainly live alone.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: When you are lonely for a while don't get restless, if you had born alone, you are going to die alone then for sometime you can certainly live alone.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: To be a god can ultimately become boring and degrading. There'd be reason enough for the invention of free will! A god might wish to escape into sleep and be alive only in the unconscious projections of his dream-creatures.
Author: Frank Herbert

Quote: Weariness that wants to reach the ultimate with one leap, with one fatal leap, a poor ignorant weariness that does not want to want any more: this created all gods and afterworlds.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Thus Spoke Zarathustra

Quote: I didn't want to do it,' Kiala said. 'The universe just kind of conspired to force me to make a fool of myself. It does that quite a lot, actually.
Author: Graham Parke,  Unspent Time

Quote: My teacher asked my favorite color. ... I said ‘Rainbow’.... and I was punished to stand out of my class.
Author: Saket Assertive

Quote: انه ينكر الحياة و لكنه لا يستحق الموت
Author: نجيب محفوظ,  أولاد حارتنا

Quote: Creativity sparks originality which then manifests itself into what we call evolution. To depreciate imagination is to depreciate life.
Author: Alecia Stone

Quote: Maybe I’m strange and perverse, but I’ve always thought there was something sexy about a compelling argument.
Author: Therese Doucet,  A Lost Argument

Quote: The best consolation in misfortune or affliction of any kind will be the thought of other people who are in a still worse plight than yourself; and this is a form of consolation open to every one. But what an awful fate this means for mankind as a whole! We are like lambs in a field, disporting themselves under the eye of the butcher, who chooses out first one and then another for his prey.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer,  On the Suffering of the World

Quote: The fool who knows his folly Becomes wise by that fact.But the fool who thinks he's wise - He's called 'a fool' indeed!
Author: Anonymous,  The Dhammapada

Quote: The fool who knows his folly Becomes wise by that fact.But the fool who thinks he's wise - He's called 'a fool' indeed!
Author: Anonymous,  The Dhammapada

Quote: Love is the wisdom of the fool and the folly of the wise.
Author: Samuel Johnson

Quote: Love is the wisdom of the fool and the folly of the wise.
Author: Samuel Johnson

Quote: That man is best who sees the truth himself. Good too is he who listens to wise counsel. But who is neither wise himself nor willing to ponder wisdom is not worth a straw.
Author: Hesiod

Quote: That man is best who sees the truth himself. Good too is he who listens to wise counsel. But who is neither wise himself nor willing to ponder wisdom is not worth a straw.
Author: Hesiod

Quote: Challenges in life can either enrich you or poison you. You are the one who decides.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Challenges in life can either enrich you or poison you. You are the one who decides.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: There are two goddesses in your heard. The Goddess of Wisdom and the Goddess of Wealth. Everyone thinks they need to get wealth first, and wisdom will come. So they concern themselves with chasing money. But they have it backwards. You have to give your heart to the Goddess of Wisdom, giver her all your love and attention, and the Goddess of Wealth will become jealous, and follow you.
Author: Joe Vigil

Quote: Why did I hope we would be happy abroad? A change of environment is that traditional fallacy upon which doomed loves, and lungs, rely.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: تعرفون اني لم أكن ملاكا طيلة الوقت , و أن الخلافات كانت تحدث من حيت لآخر , لكن لو نظرت للصورة الإجمالية من بعيد -حين تختفي البقع السوداء الصغيرةلأدركت اننا سعيدين حقا ..
Author: أحمد خالد توفيق

Quote: You can be happy with money and you can be wretched with it. It depends on what kind of person you are. -- A Prologue to Love
Author: Taylor Caldwell

Quote: Fine,"he repeated, and I wondered why it was I kept coming back to this, again and again, a word that you said when someone asked how you were but didn't really care to know the truth.
Author: Sarah Dessen,  The Truth About Forever

Quote: Happiness is spiritual, born of truth and love. It is unselfish; therefore it cannot exist alone, but requires all mankind to share it.
Author: Mary Baker Eddy

Quote: I've heard that the soul often recognizes truth when it hears it, even if the mind does not.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Storm Born

Quote: I've heard that the soul often recognizes truth when it hears it, even if the mind does not.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Storm Born

Quote: Anya looked upon Nin admirably. Having him as a partner-in-crime—if only on this one occasion, which she hoped would only be the start of something more—was more revitalizing than the cheap thrills of a cookie-cutter shallow, superficial romance, where the top priority was how beautiful a person was on the outside.
Author: Jess C. Scott,  The Other Side of Life

Quote: It is not what he has, nor even what he does, which directly expresses the worth of a man, but what he is.
Author: Henri-Frédéric Amiel

Quote: Dear me! how happy and good we'd be, if we had no worries!
Author: Louisa May Alcott,  Little Women

Quote: The British do not expect happiness. I had the impression, all the time that I lived there, that they do not want to be happy; they want to be right.
Author: Quentin Crisp

Quote: Taking a risk to survive isn’t that impressive. Taking a risk to be happy, that takes guts.
Author: Sarah Noffke,  Revived

Quote: Never play cards with a man called Doc. Never eat at a place called Mom's. Never sleep with a woman whose troubles are worse than your own.
Author: Nelson Algren,  A Walk on the Wild Side

Quote: Never play cards with a man called Doc. Never eat at a place called Mom's. Never sleep with a woman whose troubles are worse than your own.
Author: Nelson Algren,  A Walk on the Wild Side

Quote: She wished she could visit Mariam's grave, to sit with her awhile, leave a flower or two. But she sees now that it doesn't matter. Mariam is never very far.... Mariam is in her own heart, where she shines with the bursting radiance of a thousand suns.
Author: Khaled Hosseini,  A Thousand Splendid Suns

Quote: The advance of regret can be so gradual that it is impossible to say "yesterday I was happy, today I am not.
Author: E.M. Forster,  Where Angels Fear to Tread

Quote: When love and hate are both absent, everything becomes clear and undisguised. Make the slightest distinction, however, and heaven and earth are set infinitely apart. If you wish to see the truth, then hold no opinions for or against anything. To set up what you like against what you dislike is the disease of the mind.
Author: Hsin Hsin Ming

Quote: Kehidupan lebih nyata daripada pendapat siapapun tentang kenyataan.
Author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer,  Child of All Nations

Quote: Happiness is not a state of being. Happiness is a vector, it is movement.
Author: Neal Shusterman,  Bruiser

Quote: It's hard to say. Sometimes people have had terrible childhoods. And sometimes they just haven't found their special place in life. And sometimes they're dogs from hell and must be destroyed.
Author: Charles Addams

Quote: The past cannot be changed. The future is yet in your power.
Author: Mary Pickford

Quote: Your fear of the truth does not hide or dilute it.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: People who say that money can't buy happiness just don't know where to shop.
Author: Kathy Lette

Quote: Before you tell your life what you intend to do with it, listen for what it intends to do with you. Before you tell your life what truths and values you have decided to live up to, let your life tell you what truths you embody, what values you represent.
Author: Parker J. Palmer,  Let Your Life Speak: Listening for the Voice of Vocation

Quote: Everything was too sharp and clear, so that I could never tell where to start- the way a map that shows too much can sometimes be useless.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Norwegian Wood

Quote: Human happiness is defined by the hardships and conflicts you have been through. The greater they are, the greater is your happiness.
Author: Peter Deunov

Quote: Happiness is a big joke; let us laugh at it loud.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: But the happiest people are the ones who understand that good things occur when one allows them to.
Author: Danny Wallace,  Yes Man

Quote: In essentials, unity; in non-essentials, liberty; in all things, charity.
Author: Rupertus Meldenius

Quote: learn from the past live in the present plan for the future
Author: Audrey Farrell

Quote: You can’t live your life thinking death is going to come all the time. You have to live life and if it comes, then we can only hope we were able to do all the things we wanted. He has to want to do something. Everyone does.
Author: Shelena Shorts

Quote: You can’t live your life thinking death is going to come all the time. You have to live life and if it comes, then we can only hope we were able to do all the things we wanted. He has to want to do something. Everyone does.
Author: Shelena Shorts

Quote: There’s no such thing as `one, true way’; the only answers worth having are the ones you find for yourself; leave the world better than you found it. Love, freedom, and the chance to do some good — they’re the things worth living and dying for, and if you aren’t willing to die for the things worth living for, you might as well turn in your membership in the human race.
Author: Mercedes Lackey,  Brightly Burning

Quote: God, there must be a meaning. Fiercely he was certain that there must be a meaning.Surely, while we live we are not lost.Oh Janos, Janos my brother!Surely we are not lost--while we live.
Author: John Hepworth

Quote: God, there must be a meaning. Fiercely he was certain that there must be a meaning.Surely, while we live we are not lost.Oh Janos, Janos my brother!Surely we are not lost--while we live.
Author: John Hepworth

Quote: Two or three angelsCame near to the earth.They saw a fat church.Little black streams of peopleCame and went in continually.And the angels were puzzledTo know why the people went thus,And why they stayed so long within.
Author: Stephen Crane,  Complete Poems of Stephen Crane

Quote: There is no one true church, no one chosen people.
Author: Terry Tempest Williams,  Leap

Quote: The only thing that guarantees an open-ended collaboration among human beings, the only thing that guarantees that this project is truly open-ended, is a willingness to have our beliefs and behaviors modified by the power of conversation.
Author: Sam Harris

Author: Sam Harris

Quote: Nevertheless, in this sea of human wretchedness and malice there bloomed at times compassion, as a pale flower blooms in a putrid marsh.
Author: Henryk Sienkiewicz,  In Desert and Wilderness

Quote: I could watch him do this until morning — never asking questions and never interrupting his work. I worship quietly — his intense focus and attention to detail and then, out of no where, I realize the inconvenient, inappropriate truth: ‘I love this man… and it has swallowed me.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth

Author: Edgar Allan Poe

Quote: We are all resigned to death: it's life we aren't resigned to.
Author: Graham Greene,  The Heart of the Matter

Quote: Let us beware of saying that death is the opposite of life. The living being is only a species of the dead, and a very rare species.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  The Gay Science: with a Prelude in Rhymes and an Appendix of Songs

Quote: I drive a motorbike, so there is the whiff of the grim reaper round every corner, especially in London.
Author: Benedict Cumberbatch

Quote: What we have at the moment isn't as the old liturgies used to say, 'the sure and certain hope of the resurrection of the dead,' but a vague and fuzzy optimism that somehow things may work out in the end.
Author: N.T. Wright,  Surprised by Hope: Rethinking Heaven, the Resurrection, and the Mission of the Church

Quote: False hope is a terrible thing, if its the only thing keeping you alive you'll be dead by dawn.
Author: Charlie Rae

Quote: God is dead and I am his replacement.
Author: J.D. Robb,  Conspiracy in Death

Quote: القرآن الكريم ليس إعجازًا في البلاغة فقط ، ولكنه يحوي إعجازًا في كل ما يمكن للعقل البشري أن يحوم حوله ، فكل مفكر متدبر في كلام اللَّه يجد إعجازًا في القرآن الكريم . فالذي درس البلاغة رأى الإعجاز البلاغي ، والذي تعلم الطب وجد إعجازًا طبيًا في القرآن الكريم . وعالم النباتات رأى إعجازًا في آيات القرآن الكريم ، وكذلك عالم الفلك .
Author: محمد متولي الشعراوي,  كيف تقرأ القرآن الكريم وتحفظه

Quote: You said 'God is cruel' the way a person who's lived his whole life on Tahiti might say 'Snow is cold'. You knew, but you didn't understand."He stepped close to David and put his palms on the boy's cold cheeks. "Do you know how cruel your God can be, David. How fantastically cruel?
Author: Stephen King,  Desperation

Quote: Science Fiction: Any scientific acclaim that omits God.
Author: Johnny Hart

Quote: Science Fiction: Any scientific acclaim that omits God.
Author: Johnny Hart

Quote: Science Fiction: Any scientific acclaim that omits God.
Author: Johnny Hart

Quote: You are only a prisoner when you surrender.
Author: Tad Williams,  Shadowplay

Quote: You view the gods as entities without,"Montolio tried to explain. "You see them as physical beings trying to control our actions for their own ends, and thus you, in your stubborn independance, reject them. The gods are within, I say, whether one has named his own or not. You have followed Mielikki all your life, Drizzt. You merely never had a name to put on your heart.
Author: R.A. Salvatore,  Sojourn

Quote: I felt as if I were riding a pendulum. Just as I would swing into the abyss of hopelessness, the pendulum would swing back with some small goodness.
Author: Ruta Sepetys,  Between Shades of Gray

Quote: If you had hope, maybe you could find a way to make things change,. Because if you thought about it, there were so many reasons to try.
Author: Suzanne Collins,  Gregor and the Code of Claw

Quote: …God is a giant quiltmaker. With an infinite variety of designs. And the quilt is grown so big and confusing, the pattern is impossible to see, the squares and diamonds and triangles don’t fit well together anymore, it’s all become meaningless. So He has abandoned it.
Author: Rohinton Mistry,  A Fine Balance

Quote: I think it's cool to wear roadkill. If I died and somebody wanted to wear my teeth around their neck to VMAs, I'd feel honored.
Author: Ke$ha

Quote: Find what you want. I will find you.
Author: Lloyd Alexander,  Westmark

Quote: God sends meat and the devil sends cooks.
Author: Thomas Deloney

Quote: Belief creates the actual fact.
Author: William James

Quote: Belief creates the actual fact.
Author: William James

Quote: When you tire of living, change itself seems evil, does it not? for then any change at all disturbs the deathlike peace of the life-weary.
Author: Walter M. Miller Jr.,  A Canticle for Leibowitz

Quote: Jarod Kintz Day—it’s not just my birthday, but it should be a holiday that’s mandatory to celebrate, punishable by death if you don’t. It’ll be a holiday that honors freedom.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: We don't know the Devil's side of the story, because God wrote all the books.
Author: J.A. Konrath,  Origin

Quote: Whenever you see flies or insects in a still life—a wilted petal, a black spot on the apple—the painter is giving you a secret message. He’s telling you that living things don’t last—it’s all temporary. Death in life. That’s why they’re called natures mortes. Maybe you don’t see it at first with all the beauty and bloom, the little speck of rot. But if you look closer—there it is.
Author: Donna Tartt,  The Goldfinch

Quote: Dude, you don't want to be dead. Take it from me. No-pussy is bad. But dead is like no-pussy times ten.
Author: Junot Díaz,  The Brief Wondrous Life of Oscar Wao

Quote: There are those who know and those who don't know. And for every ten thousand who don't know there's only one who knows. That's the miracle of all time--the fact that these millions know so much but don't know this.
Author: Carson McCullers,  The Heart is a Lonely Hunter

Quote: [...] where ignorance is bliss,'Tis folly to be wise.
Author: Thomas Gray

Quote: You need to trustTo surrenderTo ask for guidanceGo within for the answersThey're within youYou have the answersAll you need do is ask
Author: Karen Hackel,  The Whisper of Your Soul

Quote: The world is before you, and you need not take it or leave it as it was when you came in.
Author: James Baldwin

Quote: The problem with thinking that you are the absolute best, is that it leaves no room for you to become any better and while you live life thinking that you're the best, truth is a lot of people around you are already better and becoming even more better.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: What we can change is our perceptions, which have the effect of changing everything.
Author: Donna Quesada,  Buddha in the Classroom: Zen Wisdom to Inspire Teachers

Quote: What we can change is our perceptions, which have the effect of changing everything.
Author: Donna Quesada,  Buddha in the Classroom: Zen Wisdom to Inspire Teachers

Quote: Don’t believe what your eyes are telling you. All they show is limitation. Look with your understanding.
Author: Richard Bach

Quote: sometimes i don't know, which momentwhich cool gust of wind will come,and enchant metousling my hairand my heart, stirring...that familiar ache of poetry, which drop will kissthe old wrench in my soulreminding me, all over againi miss you better in the rain.
Author: Sanober Khan,  A Thousand Flamingos

Quote: What we want to see is the child in pursuit of the knowledge not the knowledge in pursuit of the child.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: What we want to see is the child in pursuit of the knowledge not the knowledge in pursuit of the child.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: Love, our subject:we've trained it like ivy to our walls.
Author: Adrienne Rich

Quote: originality and a feeling of one's own dignity are achieved only through work and struggle.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky

Quote: Poetry is a deal of joy and pain and wonder, with a dash of the dictionary.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  Sand and Foam

Quote: Well, now,if little by little you stop loving meI shall stop loving you little by little.If suddenlyyou forget medo not look for me,for I shall already have forgotten you.
Author: Pable Neruda

Quote: We talk so abstractly about poetry because all of us are usually bad poets.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Anger has its place, but it will not serve you here, the way of the warrior is the way of knowing. Of that knowledge requires you to use anger, then you use anger, but you cannot wrest forth knowledge by losing your temper.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Inheritance

Quote: Those ancients who in poetry presented the golden age, who sang its happy state,perhaps, in their Parnassus, dreamt this place. Here, mankind's root was innocent; and herewere every fruit and never-ending spring; these streams--the nectar of which poets sing.
Author: Dante Alighieri,  The Divine Comedy

Quote: Any serious social, political, and economic change must include veganism.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: Any serious social, political, and economic change must include veganism.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: Verde que te quiero verde. Verde viento. Verdes ramas. El barco sobre la mar y el caballo en la montaña.
Author: Federico García Lorca

Quote: Life is a mystery to be lived not a problem to be solved
Author: Clive Ollies

Quote: Times change, as do our wills, What we are - is ever changing; All the world is made of change, And forever attaining new qualities.
Author: Luís Vaz de Camões,  Sonetos de Camões

Quote: I heard a song I hate and I thought of her. Ah, such is love.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  99 Cents For Some Nonsense

Quote: If you do not respect your own wishes, no one else will. You will simply attract people who disrespect you as much as you do.
Author: Vironika Tugaleva

Quote: Don't feed your ego with my soul.
Author: Arzum Uzun

Quote: As I saw it, all my mother's life, my father held her down, like lead strapped to her ankles.She wasbuoyant by nature;she wanted to travel,go to the theater, go to museums.What he wantedwas to lie on the couchwith the Timesover his face,so that death, when it came,wouldn't seem a significant change.
Author: Louise Glück,  Ararat

Quote: You wouldn't believe that so much could change just because a relationship ended.
Author: Nick Hornby,  About a Boy

Quote: He felt a spasm of excitement because he knew instinctively who it was, or at least knew who it was he wanted it to be, and once you know what it is you want to be true, instinct is a very useful device for enabling you to know that it is.
Author: Douglas Adams,  So Long, and Thanks for All the Fish

Quote: Those at too great a distance may, I am well are, mistake ignorance for perspective.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Dragons of Eden: Speculations on the Evolution of Human Intelligence

Quote: Those at too great a distance may, I am well are, mistake ignorance for perspective.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Dragons of Eden: Speculations on the Evolution of Human Intelligence

Quote: Oh! kangaroos, sequins, chocolate sodas! / You really are beautiful! Pearls, / harmonicas, jujubes, aspirins!
Author: Frank O'Hara

Quote: I won't be affected by your charm nor I will trap you into marriage. I've been there once, never again.- Kristine
Author: Martha Cecilia,  Wild Rose (Kristine Series, #11)

Quote: He leaned upon her as if there was no other support anywhere in the world, and she held him as if she would undertake no other task for all eternity.
Author: Sharon Shinn,  Angelica

Quote: I’ve never heard of a man being so eager to confess to the parent of a girl he’s just ruined
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Secrets of a Summer Night

Quote: We can do anything you like. Just be with me.
Author: Christine Feehan,  Magic in the Wind

Quote: Man is the candle light and a woman is the moonlight. They live far away but can grow together during lonesome nights.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: How do you feel?” she asked, trying to fluff his pillow. “Other than terrible, I mean.”He moved his head slightly to the side. It seemed to be a sickly interpretation of a shrug.“Of course you’re feeling terrible,” she clarified, “but is there any change? More terrible? Less terrible?”He made no response.“The same amount of terrible?
Author: Julia Quinn,  Just Like Heaven

Quote: As much as I would love to know what you know, I’d much rather eat your brain with a spoon.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: it's good for you to write down your thoughts. It'stherapeutic because it forces you to slow down and think aboutlife.
Author: Katie Kacvinsky,  Awaken

Quote: Menjadi penulis adalah sebuah perjalanan panjang, yang tidak selalu diisi oleh hal-hal yang menyenangkan. Akan selalu ada kritik, akan selalu ada komentar negatif, akan selalu ada kesalahan. Yang terpenting adalah kita belajar dari kesalahan-kesalahan tersebut dan bangkit untuk menggapai mimpi kita.
Author: Winna Efendi,  Draf 1: Taktik Menulis Fiksi Pertamamu

Quote: The main thing is to writefor the joy of it. Cultivate a work-lustthat imagines its haven like your hands at nightdreaming the sun in the sunspot of a breast.You are fasted now, light-headed, dangerous.Take off from here.
Author: Seamus Heaney,  Station Island

Quote: It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife,' I said, sighing.'Is it?' said Veronica, looking surprised. 'Universally acknowledged? Surely that presupposes life similar to human societies beyond this planet, and besides--''No, no, it's a quote from ... Never mind,' I said.
Author: Michelle Cooper,  The FitzOsbornes in Exile

Quote: Language is the mother, not the handmaiden, of thought; words will tell you things you never thought or felt before.
Author: W.H. Auden

Quote: Someone is always going to try to knock you down and take your place. It is up to you to fight for what you want.
Author: Teresa Mummert

Quote: The only way out of the labyrinth of suffering is to forgive
Author: John Green,  Looking for Alaska

Quote: Your words are powerful so what you say goes a long way to either establish or destroy you; this is why you should say things that God has said concerning you, not things that situations or circumstances say.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: Your words are powerful so what you say goes a long way to either establish or destroy you; this is why you should say things that God has said concerning you, not things that situations or circumstances say.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: How can cosmic religious feeling be communicated from one person to another, if it can give rise to no definite notion of a God and no theology? In my view, it is the most important function of art and science to awaken this feeling and keep it alive in those who are receptive to it.
Author: Albert Einstein,  The World As I See It

Quote: How can cosmic religious feeling be communicated from one person to another, if it can give rise to no definite notion of a God and no theology? In my view, it is the most important function of art and science to awaken this feeling and keep it alive in those who are receptive to it.

Quote: Without the support from religion--remember, we talked about it--no father, using only his own resources, would be able to bring up a child.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Quote: Scribbled secret notebooks, and wild typewritten pages, for yr own joy
Author: Jack Kerouac

Quote: It has been well said that an author who expects results from a first novel is in a position similar to that of a man who drops a rose petal down the Grand Canyon of Arizona and listens for the echo.
Author: P.G. Wodehouse,  Cocktail Time

Quote: Calligraphy is a geometry of the soul which manifests itself physically.
Author: Plato

Quote: When we are aware of our weaknesses or negative tendencies, we open the opportunity to work on them.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Pocket Peace: Effective Practices for Enlightened Living

Quote: Have you realized that today is the tomorrow you talked about yesterday? It is your responsibility to change your life for the better.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: It ain't that you get religion. Religion gets you and then milks you dry. Won't let you drink a little whiskey. Won't let you make no fat-assed girls grin and giggle. Won't let you do a damn thing except work for what you'll get in the hearafter. I live in the here and now.
Author: Dorothy Allison,  Bastard Out of Carolina

Quote: Not even waste/is inviolate./The day misspent,/the love misplaced,/has inside it/the seed of redemption./Nothing is exempt from resurrection.
Author: Kay Ryan

Quote: What in hell are you really made of, Howard? After all, it's only a building. It's not the combination of holy sacrament, Indian torture, and sexual ecstasy that you seem to make of it.""Isn't it?
Author: Ayn Rand,  The Fountainhead

Quote: Starting over can be the scariest thing in the entire world, whether it’s leaving a lover, a school, a team, a friend or anything else that feels like a core part of our identity but when your gut is telling you that something here isn’t right or feels unsafe, I really want you to listen and trust in that voice.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: Be careful what you wish for. You never know who will be listening.
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Soul Music

Quote: Life is short only if you are not living your purpose.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Life is short only if you are not living your purpose.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Love is tender, like the pot roast I’m keeping warm in my shoes.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

Quote: The Motto of Champions: If you are hurt, you can suck it up and press on. If injured, you can rebound and return bigger and better...and continue to inspire!
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Tie me up, please..."Chantal said. They looked above at some vines and roots hanging down from the grassy area above the depression in the canal they were standing in. She was in his hands—he had to comply.A little bit of kink was one of the most delicious of erotic pleasures. Catholic school girls were often the horniest—Brett could hardly contain his elation.
Author: Jess C. Scott,  Catholic School Girls Rule

Quote: Listen to the secret sound, the real sound, which is inside you. The one no one talks of speaks the secret sound to himself, and he is the one who has made it all.
Author: Kabir

Quote: Every game is winnable if you change your mind about what the prize should be and your perspective about the players at the table.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: If you want to use television to teach somebody, you must first teachthem how to use television.
Author: Umberto Eco

Quote: Even when in the midst of disturbance, the stillness of the mind can offer sanctuary.
Author: Stephen Richards,  The Ultimate Cosmic Ordering Meditation

Quote: Even when in the midst of disturbance, the stillness of the mind can offer sanctuary.
Author: Stephen Richards,  The Ultimate Cosmic Ordering Meditation

Quote: I am convinced that there are genuine and valid levels of perception available with cannabis (and probably with other drugs) which are, through the defects of our society and our educational system, un-available to us without such drugs.
Author: Lester Grinspoon,  Marihuana Reconsidered

Quote: Chanel is an institution, and you have to treat an institution like a whore – and then you get something out of her
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Night clubs are where Americans learn the laws of motion.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: Night clubs are where Americans learn the laws of motion.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: What we're learning in our schools is not the wisdom of life. We're learning technologies, we're getting information. There's a curious reluctance on the part of faculties to indicate the life values of their subjects.
Author: Joseph Campbell

Quote: True patience is grounded in wisdom & compassion.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: Self-knowledge is the only basis of true knowledge.
Author: John Taylor Gatto

Quote: You are the ruler of my heart. There is no measure greater than this.
Author: Truth Devour,  Unrequited

Quote: I still don't know if things fit together, or if everything will be all right in the end. But I believe that something means something. I believe in cleansing the soul through fun and games. I also believe in love. And I have several good friends, and just one bad one.
Author: Erlend Loe,  Naïve. Super

Quote: Dreams won't always take you on a straight path to destiny, but they're usually related to what your soul wants for you.
Author: Kelly Cutrone,  If You Have to Cry, Go Outside: And Other Things Your Mother Never Told You

Quote: My dreams are worthless, my plans are dust, my goals are impossible.All are of no value unless they are followed by action.
Author: Og Mandino,  The Greatest Salesman in the World

Quote: Eye can only see something ifidea about it has been in mind.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Juilin,"she asked hesitantly, "what were you going to do with the salt and cooking oil? Not exactly,"she added more quickly. "Just a general idea."He looked at her for a moment. "I do not know. But they did not, either. That is the trick of it; their minds made up worse then I ever could. I have seen a tough man break when I sent for a basket of figs and some mice.
Author: Robert Jordan,  The Fires of Heaven

Quote: You never know what lurks just beneath the surface of my fragile sanity.
Author: Ashly Lorenzana

Quote: A brain is only capable of what it could conceive, andit couldnt concieve what it hasnt experienced
Author: Graham Greene,  Brighton Rock

Quote: A sure way of retaining the grace of heaven is to disregard outward appearances, and diligently to cultivate such things as foster amendment of life and fervour of soul, rather than to cultivate those qualities that seem most popular.
Author: Thomas à Kempis,  The Inner Life

Quote: The real question is not whether machines think but whether men do. The mystery which surrounds a thinking machine already surrounds a thinking man.
Author: B.F. Skinner,  Contingencies Of Reinforcement: A Theoretical Analysis

Quote: Never fire a laser at a mirror.
Author: Larry Niven

Quote: The books that everybody admires are those that nobody reads.
Author: Anatole France

Quote: Our experience is coloured through and through by books and plays and the cinema, and it takes patience and skill to disentangle the things we have really learned from life for ourselves.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: The European talks of progress because by the aid of a few scientific discoveries he has established a society which has mistaken comfort for civilisation.
Author: Benjamin Disraeli

Quote: Certein bodies... become luminous when heated. Their luminosity disappears after some time, but the capacity of becoming luminous afresh through heat is restored to them by the action of a spark, and also by the action of radium.
Author: Marie Curie

Quote: When I was little, I had this science book. There was a section on 'What would happen to the world if there was no friction?' Answer: 'Everything on earth would fly into space from the centrifugal force of revolution.' That was my mood.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  Dance Dance Dance

Quote: I told Ella Mae Cheeks Johnson, then age 105, that she was the only person over 80 who I'd ever met who never referred to her physical infirmities or health problems. To which she replied, "I have my difficulties; I do not rejoice in them.
Author: Patricia Mulcahy,  It Is Well with My Soul: The Extraordinary Life of a 106-Year-Old Woman

Quote: In the world of the very small, where particle and wave aspects of reality are equally significant, things do not behave in any way that we can understand from our experience of the everyday world...all pictures are false, and there is no physical analogy we can make to understand what goes on inside atoms. Atoms behave like atoms, nothing else.
Author: John Gribbin,  In Search of Schrödinger's Cat: Quantum Physics and Reality

Quote: This mindless tolerance, which places observable scientific facts, subject to proof, on the same level as unprovable supernatural fantasy, has played a major role in the resurgence of both anti-intellectualism and anti-rationalism.
Author: Susan Jacoby,  The Age of American Unreason

Quote: Before it is science and career, before it is livelihood, before even it is family or love, freedom is sound sleep and safety to notice the play of morning sun.
Author: Richard Rhodes,  The Making of the Atomic Bomb

Quote: Never did she find anything so difficult as to keep herself from losing her temper when she was suddenly disturbed while absorbed in a book.
Author: Frances Hodgson Burnett,  A Little Princess

Quote: He fed his spirit with the bread of books
Author: Edwin Markham

Quote: Blind metaphysical necessity, which is certainly the same always and every where, could produce no variety of things. All that diversity of natural things which we find suited to different times and places could arise from nothing but the ideas and will of a Being, necessarily existing.
Author: Isaac Newton,  The Principia: Mathematical Principles of Natural Philosophy

Quote: The only way to discover the limits of the possible is to go beyond them into the impossible.
Author: Arthur C. Clarke

Quote: Don't walk behind me; I may not lead. Don't walk in front of me; I may not follow. Just walk beside me and be my friend.
Author: Albert Camus

Quote: For my senior prom, my father finally said I could go - as long as I was home by 9 P.M.! That was around the time that most people were heading out. When I was little I was so mad at them all the time. 'Why can't I do this?' 'Why are there so many rules?' But looking back now, my parents gave me the foundation to have so many choices in life.
Author: Amy Chua

Quote: The whole secret to our success is being able to con ourselves into believing that we're going to change the world because statistically we are unlikely to do it.
Author: Tom Peters

Quote: Peace is what enables development and is critical in providing opportunities to young people. Efforts to preserve peace are absolutely vital in bringing prosperity and hope for the future.
Author: Kim Yuna

Quote: There is always something left to love. And if you ain't learned that, you ain't learned nothing.
Author: Lorraine Hansberry

Quote: A lot of art and visual crafts are based on appropriating things.
Author: Lazaro Hernandez

Quote: Humor, humility, and, of course, honesty, all are qualities that work in public and cultural diplomacy.
Author: Cynthia P. Schneider

Quote: ..the most dangerous animal in a zoo is Man.
Author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

Quote: ..the most dangerous animal in a zoo is Man.
Author: Yann Martel,  Life of Pi

Quote: love make us poets, and the approach of death should make us philosophers.
Author: George Santayana

Quote: Because it's much more pleasant to be obsessed over how the hero gets out of his predicament than it is over how I get out of mine.
Author: Woody Allen

Quote: Possibility, infinity, beauty -- none of those words were right. [...] What he really wanted to say was: have you felt this? this phantom life streaking like a phosphorescent hound at the edges of your ruin?
Author: Haven Kimmel,  The Solace Of Leaving Early

Quote: The power of death signifies that this real world can only have a neutral image of life, that life's intimacy does not reveal it's dazzling consumption until the moment it gives out.
Author: Georges Bataille,  Theory of Religion

Quote: I, while the gods laugh, the world's vortex am;Maelström of passions in that hidden seaWhose waves of all-time lap the coasts of me;And in small compass the dark waters cram.- I, While the Gods Laugh, the World's Vortex Am
Author: Mervyn Peake,  Collected Poems

Quote: ...we're told by TV and Reader's Digest that a crisis will trigger massive personal change--and that those big changes will make the pain worthwhile. But from what he could see, big change almost never happens. People simply feel lost. They have no idea what to say or do or feel or think. they become messes and tend to remain messes.
Author: Douglas Coupland,  The Gum Thief

Quote: إنكم تنظرون إلى ما فوقكم عندما تتشوقون إلى الاعتلاء،اما انا فقد علوت حتى أصبحت اتطلع إلى ما تحت أقدامي فهل فيكم من يمكنه أن يضحك وهو واقف على الذرى..من يحوم فوق أعالي الجبال يستهزئ بجميع مآسي الحياة ويستهزئ بمسارحها بل بالحياة نفسها
Author: فريدريك نيتشه,  هكذا تكلم زرادشت

Quote: Are you not ashamed of caring so much for the making of money and for fame and prestige, when you neither think nor care about wisdom and truth and the improvement of your soul?
Author: Socrates

Quote: Are you not ashamed of caring so much for the making of money and for fame and prestige, when you neither think nor care about wisdom and truth and the improvement of your soul?
Author: Socrates

Quote: Are you not ashamed of caring so much for the making of money and for fame and prestige, when you neither think nor care about wisdom and truth and the improvement of your soul?
Author: Socrates

Quote: You can believe in whatsoever you like, but the truth remains the truth, no matter how sweet the lie may taste.
Author: Michael Bassey Johnson

Quote: You can believe in whatsoever you like, but the truth remains the truth, no matter how sweet the lie may taste.
Author: Michael Bassey Johnson

Quote: For the wise have always known that no one can make much of his life until self-searching has become a regular habit, until he is able to admit and accept what he finds, and until he patiently and persistently tries to correct what is wrong. – Bill W.
Author: Bill W.

Quote: But, like all happiness, it did not last long…
Author: Louisa May Alcott,  Little Women

Quote: Cheap booze is a false economy.
Author: Christopher Hitchens,  Hitch-22: A Memoir

Quote: ... too much brooding, not enough doing.
Author: Timothy Findley

Quote: Those who wish to sing always find a song.
Author: Swedish Proverb

Quote: Freddie often fold me that you've got to be happy when you can, because life won't wait for you to take the time. And she was right.
Author: April Genevieve Tucholke,  Between the Devil and the Deep Blue Sea

Quote: Then the world will be for the common people, and the sounds of happiness will reach the deepest springs. Ah! Come! People of every land, how can you not be roused.
Author: Karl Marx,  The Communist Manifesto

Quote: What hinders me from hearing is that I am taken up with other things. It is not that I will not hear God, but I am not devoted in the right place. I am devoted to things, to service, to convictions, and God may say what He likes but I do not hear Him.
Author: Oswald Chambers

Quote: But suppose it was truth double strong, it were no truth to me if I couldna take it in. I daresay there's truth in yon Latin book on your shelves; but it's gibberish and no truth to me, unless I know the meaning o' the words.
Author: Elizabeth Gaskell,  North and South

Quote: The formula of happiness and success is just, being actually yourself, in the most vivid possible way you can.
Author: Meryl Streep

Quote: It was funny how the old practices always came around again. It was the rhythm of human enterprise to invent and worship some new approach, to fully reject it a generation later, to realize the need for it again a generation or two after that and then hastily reinvent it as new, usually without its original elegance. Scientists hated to look backward for anything.
Author: Ann Brashares,  My Name Is Memory

Quote: You don’t have to be happy to smile.
Author: Daniel Willey

Quote: Every concept of reality is all in our head, belief is what makes truth.
Author: Christy Leigh Stewart

Quote: Every concept of reality is all in our head, belief is what makes truth.
Author: Christy Leigh Stewart

Quote: Why sadness was created?So we could rest from laughing.
Author: Nelson M. Lubao

Quote: Why sadness was created?So we could rest from laughing.
Author: Nelson M. Lubao

Quote: I don't know whether it is beautiful or sad, that I find such blissful happiness within the confines of my own mind, more so than I do in the reality that surrounds me.
Author: Kendal Rob

Quote: After his experience with Minos, Nico realized that most spectres held only as much power as you allowed them to have. They pried into your mind, using fear or anger or longing to influence you. Nico had learned to shield himself. Sometimes he could even turn the tables and bend ghosts to his will.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Blood of Olympus

Quote: For us lads of eighteen they ought to have been mediators and guides to the world of maturity, the world of work, of duty, of culture, of progress -- to the future.
Author: Erich Maria Remarque,  All Quiet on the Western Front

Quote: And so it turned out that only a life similar to the life of those around us, merging with it without a ripple, is genuine life, and that an unshared happiness is not happiness.
Author: Boris Pasternak

Quote: Perhaps the hardest lesson to learn is not to be attached to the results of your actions.
Author: Joan Borysenko

Quote: Nothing is easier than self-deceit.For what every man wishes,that he also believes to be true.
Author: Demosthenes

Quote: One of the most productive ways a government can spend money on the people is by building more prisons. That’s what makes the US so great. That’s what freedom is all about.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: Ah! how little knowledge does a man acquire in his life. He gathers it up like water, but like water it runs between his fingers, and yet, if his hands be but wet as though with dew, behold a generation of fools call out, 'See, he is a wise man!' Is it not so?
Author: H. Rider Haggard,  She

Quote: Sure, it was your idea and your fly, but he caught the big fish. Remember, fairness is a human idea largely unknown in nature.
Author: John Gierach,  Death, Taxes, and Leaky Waders: A John Gierach Fly-Fishing Treasury

Quote: Wisdom is justified by all her children.Luke 7:35
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

Quote: The secret of high finance...if you really need a loan, you won't qualify. And if you don't need a loan, all the lenders will line up to give you money.
Author: Joanne Fluke,  Peach Cobbler Murder

Quote: The topic of compassion is not at all religious business; it is important to know it is human business, it is a question of human survival.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: The topic of compassion is not at all religious business; it is important to know it is human business, it is a question of human survival.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Quote: You must become the producer, director and actor in the unfolding story of your life.
Author: Wayne W. Dyer

Quote: It almost seemed as if there must be some random and of course unfair thrift in the emotional housekeeping of the world, if the great happiness--however temporary, however flimsy--of one person could come out of the great unhappiness of another.
Author: Alice Munro,  Too Much Happiness

Quote: There is nothing so powerful as truth - and often nothing so strange.
Author: Daniel Webster

Quote: Love is the science of reducing your sound while upping the amplitude of another person.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. Specifically ages 18-81.

Quote: But thoughts don't care about truth and shit. They sit up in your mind and fuck with you whenever.
Author: Richard Pryor,  Pryor Convictions: and Other Life Sentences

Quote: لا تستهين بنفسك ، حتى لو كنت قطرة ، محاولاتك المستمرة .. بصبر تستطيع أن تفتت الصخر
Author: Hany Adeeb

Quote: The problem with certainty is that it is static; it can do little but endlessly reassert itself. Uncertainty, by contrast, is full of unknowns, possibilities, and risks. (65)
Author: Stephen Batchelor,  Confession of a Buddhist Atheist

Quote: I have hope for you, if only because you're the only one left to hope for.
Author: Orson Scott Card,  Ender's Game

Quote: Every Christian should be both conservative and radical; conservative in preserving the faith and radical in applying it.
Author: John R.W. Stott

Quote: Don't think you can frighten me by telling me that I am alone. France is alone. God is alone. And the loneliness of God is His strength.
Author: George Bernard Shaw,  Saint Joan

Quote: Only the hopeless love God.
Author: Jennifer Donnelly,  Revolution

Quote: A fish cannot drown in water,A bird does not fall in air.In the fire of creation,God doesn't vanish:The fire brightens.Each creature God mademust live in its own true nature;How could I resist my nature,That lives for oneness with God?
Author: Mechthild of Magdeburg,  Meditations from Mechthild of Magdeburg

Quote: Just above our terror, the stars painted this storyin perfect silver calligraphy. And our souls, too oftenabused by ignorance, covered our eyes with mercy.
Author: Aberjhani,  I Made My Boy Out of Poetry

Author: Aberjhani,  I Made My Boy Out of Poetry

Quote: But I was always coming here. I though about one of my favorite Sufi poems, which says that God long ago drew a circle in the sand exactly around the spot where you are standing right now. I was never not coming here. This was never not going to happen.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love
