Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: All you have to go on is the faith of a kiss.
Author: Whitney Otto,  How to Make an American Quilt

Quote: there comes a timewhen you have to let goall the wordsall the teachingand trust the infinite
Author: Billy Doyle,  The Mirage of Separation

Quote: I do not know what is happening. The reason of my waking mind tells me that great evil has befallen and we stand at the end of days. But my heart says nay; and all my limbs are light, and a hope and joy are come to me that no reason can deny. [...] I do not believe that darkness will endure!
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: Never loose hope. Stay strong, you never know what tomorrow brings.
Author: Magith Noohukhan

Quote: But what if you're wrong?What if there's more?What if there's hope you never dreamed of hoping for?What if you jump?And just close your eyes?What if the arms that catch you, catch you by surprise?What if He's more than enough?What if it's love?
Author: Nichole Nordeman

Quote: To die,so young to die.No, no, not I,I love the warm sunny skies,light, song, shining eyes,I want no war, no battle cry,No, no, not I.
Author: Hannah Senesh

Quote: To die,so young to die.No, no, not I,I love the warm sunny skies,light, song, shining eyes,I want no war, no battle cry,No, no, not I.
Author: Hannah Senesh

Quote: Whatever has befallen you was not meant to escape you, and whatever has escaped you was not meant to befall you.
Author: عائض القرني

Quote: ‎Those who aren't following Jesus aren't his followers. It's that simple. Followers follow, and those who don't follow aren't followers. To follow Jesus means to follow Jesus into a society where justice rules, where love shapes everything. To follow Jesus means to take up his dream and work for it.
Author: Scot McKnight,  One.Life: Jesus Calls, We Follow

Quote: Before you realize this truth, say the Yogis, you will always be in despair, a notion nicely expressed in this exasperated line from the Greek stoic philosopher Epictetus: 'You bear God within you, poor wretch, and know it not.
Author: Elizabeth Gilbert,  Eat, Pray, Love

Quote: Let our voices be heard. I hope they will not be shrill voices, but, I hope we shall speak with such conviction that those to whom we speak shall know of the strength of our feeling and the sincerity of our efforts.
Author: Gordon B. Hinckley

Quote: Believe what you believe and it will be, believe what others believe and they will consume you!
Author: Stanley Victor Paskavich

Quote: Believe what you believe and it will be, believe what others believe and they will consume you!
Author: Stanley Victor Paskavich

Quote: As long as we have faith in our own cause and an unconquerable will to win, victory will not be denied us.
Author: Winston Churchill

Quote: Even though you can't finally grasp me, guess what? I still want to be known.
Author: Wm. Paul Young

Quote: God didn’t give fear a body. God gave love a body.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: A foe to God was never true friend to man
Author: Edward Young

Quote: The Christian life is not about pleasing God the finger-shaker and judge. It is not about believing now or being good now for the sake of heaven later. It is about entering a relationship in the present that begins to change everything now. Spirituality is about this process: the opening of the heart to the God who is already here.
Author: Marcus J. Borg,  The God We Never Knew: Beyond Dogmatic Religion to a More Authentic Contemporary Faith

Quote: But all that is warm will go cold. My ears will fall off and my eyes will melt. My mouth will be clamped shut. My lips will turn to glue....No taste or smell or touch or sound.Nothing to look at. Total emptiness for ever.
Author: Jenny Downham,  Before I Die

Quote: There is hope in dreams, imagination, and in the courage of those who wish to make those dreams a reality.
Author: Jonas Salk

Quote: A mouth of no distinction but well practiced, before I entered my teens, in irony. For what is irony but the repository of hurt? And what is hurt but the repository of hope?
Author: Joyce Carol Oates,  Faithless: Tales of Transgression

Quote: Is the god the source, or is the god a human manner of conceiving of the force and energy that supports the world? In our tradition God is a male. This male and female differentiation is made, however, within the field of time and space, the field of duality. If God is beyond duality, you cannot say that God is a "He."You cannot say God is a "She."You cannot say God is an "It."(18)
Author: Joseph Campbell,  Thou Art That: Transforming Religious Metaphor

Quote: Those who live as though God sets the rules are not going by their own rules. That is the self-sacrifice, or selflessness, that peace more often than not requires. Those who insist on going by their own rules cannot make that sacrifice. They are the steady adherents of (global) conflict because they are forever fighting both themselves and others to do whatever they think that they want to do.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: God is love, and he who abides in love abides in God, and God in him.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: Hope without love is hopeless.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

Quote: Surely we cannot take an open question like the supernatural and shut it with a bang, turning the key of the madhouse on all the mystics of history. You cannot take the region of the unknown and calmly say that, though you know nothing about it, you know all the gates are locked. We do not know enough about the unknown to know that it is unknowable.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: It's a good sign but rare instance when, in a relationship, you find that the more you learn about the other person, the more you continue to desire them. A sturdy bond delights in that degree of youthful intrigue. Love loves its youth.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Part of her revolted against the insanity of the rules. Part of her was grateful. In a world of chaos, any guidelines helped. And she knew that each day she remained alive, she remained alive. One plus one plus one. The Devil's arithmetic...
Author: Jane Yolen

Quote: Joy is but the sign that creative emotion is fulfilling its purpose.
Author: Charles Du Bos

Quote: I know that your soul is on life support and that you feel lost and like you’re completely spinning out of control, but you’re finding yourself — here, tonight… even in this darkness.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth

Quote: I know that your soul is on life support and that you feel lost and like you’re completely spinning out of control, but you’re finding yourself — here, tonight… even in this darkness.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth

Quote: It is certain that an atom of goodness on the path of faith is never lost.
Author: Rumi

Quote: In my kind of falling, there’s no landing. There’s only hitting the ground. Hard. Dead, or wanting to be dead. So the whole time you’re falling, it’s the worst feeling in the world. Because you feel you have no control over it. Because you know how it ends.
Author: David Levithan,  Will Grayson, Will Grayson

Quote: It is stupid to hope, but sometimes hope is all you have.
Author: Cassandra Clare,  City of Lost Souls

Quote: Your life is a reflection of your thoughts. Think well.
Author: Danielle Pierre

Quote: What Brahman is cannot be described. All things in the world — the Vedas, the Puranas, the Tantras, the six systems of philosophy — have been defiled, like food that has been touched by the tongue, for they have been read or uttered by the tongue. Only one thing has not been defiled in this way, and that is Brahman. No one has ever been able to say what Brahman is.
Author: Ramakrishna,  Sayings of Sri Ramakrishna

Quote: Like everything else, Fletcher. Practice.
Author: Richard Bach,  Jonathan Livingston Seagull

Quote: An expert is one who knows more and more about less and less until he knows absolutely everything about nothing.
Author: Nicholas Murray Butler

Quote: He who speaks without modesty will find it difficult to make his words good.
Author: Confucius

Quote: Beauty exists not in what is seen and remembered, but in what is felt and never forgotten.
Author: Johnathan Jena

Quote: Tidak semua yang kita inginkan harus terjadi seketika. Kita tidak hidup di dunia dongeng.
Author: Tere Liye,  Eliana

Quote: There is no magic. There is only knowledge, more or less hidden.
Author: Gene Wolfe,  Shadow & Claw

Quote: Songwriting and poetry are so commonly birthed from underdogs because one can make even the ugliest situations admirable, or more beautiful than the beautiful situations - they are the most graceful media in which the lines of society are distorted.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Her searches after knowledge were arbitrary and without context. It was as if she were shining a small flashlight of curiosity into the dark room of the world.
Author: Gloria Steinem,  Marilyn

Quote: Let us each take up our flaming torches and mount as the blazing fireballs of light that we are and let's burn the skies and leave it with deep scars and let them be our signatures upon eternity as we go forth!
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: بی قرار توام ودر دل تنگم گله هاستآه بی تاب شدن عادت کم حوصله هاستمثل عکس رخ مهتاب که افتاده در آبدر دلم هستی وبین من وتو فاصله هاستآسمان با قفس تنگ چه فرقی داردبال وقتی قفس پر زدن چلچله هاستبی هر لحضه مرا بیم فرو ریختن استمثل شهری که به روی گسل زلزله هاستباز می پرسمت از مسئله دوری وعشقوسکوت تو جواب همه مسئله هاست
Author: فاضل نظری

Quote: For someone who is supposed to be a knight in shining armor, you're acting like an ass in aluminum foil.
Author: Lisa Logue,  Cursed Secrets

Quote: He was one of those quite rare adults who communicate with small children fairly well and who love them all impartially--not in a sugary way but in a businesslike fashion that may sometimes entail a hug, in the same way that closing a big business deal may call for a handshake.
Author: Stephen King,  The Gunslinger

Quote: If I knew everything, life would be lonely, as everyone else would want to explore the world, and I’d be content with a cat on my lap sitting in the dark.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

Quote: Sacrifices made for love are fine, unless the sacrifice is you.
Author: Kellie Elmore

Quote: It dawns on you one day... how precious your life is and how not okay it is for anyone, ever, to cause you any amount of suffering, ever. Then the next time you step out the door you look at everyone and you’re thinking, “My life is precious and you’re not allowed to hurt me.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: There is a soul-jealousy that can be as frantic as any body-jealousy.
Author: Arthur Conan Doyle,  The Case-Book of Sherlock Holmes

Quote: Sometimes I wore smiles but didn’t feel them. Sometimes I felt them and didn’t wear them. I didn’t want her to know how much I craved this. I bit my bottom lip.
Author: Penelope Douglas,  Rival

Quote: If the ignorance of nature gave birth to such a variety of gods, the knowledge of this nature is calculated to destroy them.
Author: Paul Henri Thiry d'Holbach,  System of Nature

Quote: Innocence invites protection, yet we might be smarter to protect ourselves against it...
Author: Megan Johns,  The Path of Innocence

Quote: I generally find subtlety a waste of time.
Author: Cindy Gerard,  To the Brink

Quote: When you sit that way, you look kind of like a beach ball with a head,” he continued. “Your haircut is really, really bad, I’m probably going to lose my job for helping you this way, and I’m dying to fuck you.” He glanced at her. “That honest enough for you?
Author: Suzanne Brockmann,  Bodyguard

Quote: The morning will come In the press of every kiss, With your head upon my chest Where I will annoy you With every waking breath Until you decide to wake up.
Author: Coheed and Cambria

Quote: We must not be so ready to fancy ourselves intentionally injured. We must not expect a lively young man to be always so guarded and circumspect. It is very often nothing but our own vanity that deceives us. Women fancy admiration means more than it does.
Author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

Quote: Write to your fear.
Author: Dorothy Allison

Quote: When writing goes painfully, when it’s hideously difficult, and one feels real despair (ah, the despair, silly as it is, is real!)–then naturally one ought to continue with the work; it would be cowardly to retreat. But when writing goes smoothly–why then one certainly should keep on working, since it would be stupid to stop. Consequently one is always writing or should be writing.
Author: Joyce Carol Oates

Quote: I have no argument with those who see in organized religion a template or an imperative to live life according to a prescribed set of beliefs. Just give others the room, within the laws of civil society, to believe or not believe whatever they like.
Author: Michael J. Fox,  Always Looking Up: The Adventures of an Incurable Optimist

Quote: I had an interview once with some German journalist—some horrible, ugly woman. It was in the early days after the communists—maybe a week after—and she wore a yellow sweater that was kind of see-through. She had huge tits and a huge black bra, and she said to me, ‘It’s impolite; remove your glasses.’ I said, ‘Do I ask you to remove your bra?
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Most of the writers I know work every day, in obscurity and close to poverty, trying to say one thing well and true. Day in, day out, they labor to find their voice, to learn their trade, to understand nuance and pace. And then, facing a sea of rejections, they hear about something like Barbara Bush’s dog getting a book deal.
Author: Timothy Egan

Quote: Procrastination is opportunity's natural assassin.
Author: Victor Kiam

Quote: So, the world is fine. We don’t have to save the world—the world is big enough to look after itself. What we have to be concerned about, is whether or not the world we live in, will be capable of sustaining us in it. That’s what we need to think about.
Author: Douglas Adams

Quote: Writing's funny, it's like walking down a hall in the dark looking for the light switch, and suddenly you find it, flip it on, and then you discover the hallway you passed through is papered with the novel you've written.
Author: Jonathan Safran Foer

Quote: No harm's done to history by making it something someone would want to read."(The Course of Human Events, NEH Jefferson Lecture in the Humanities 2003)
Author: David McCullough

Quote: Perfection is not a destination; it's a never-ending process...Enjoy!
Author: Jim Bouchard,  Think Like a Black Belt

Quote: If I were asked for a one-sentence sound bite on religion, I would say I was against it.
Author: Salman Rushdie

Quote: When we passed a Catholic church, I recalled, he said, "You think your dad's a good chemist? They're turning soda crackers into meat in there. Can your dad do that?
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: The mentally disturbed do not employ the Principle of Scientific Parsimony: the most simple theory to explain a given set of facts. They shoot for the baroque.
Author: Philip K. Dick,  VALIS

Quote: The mentally disturbed do not employ the Principle of Scientific Parsimony: the most simple theory to explain a given set of facts. They shoot for the baroque.
Author: Philip K. Dick,  VALIS

Quote: Still amazes me that people spend more time researching a new vehicle than they do the religion they entrust their souls to.
Author: Larissa Ione,  Eternal Rider

Quote: It is better to believe in men too rashly, and regret, than believe too meanly. Men could be more than they are, if they would try for it. He has shown them that.
Author: Mary Renault,  The Persian Boy

Quote: In the glad old days, before the rise of modern morbidities...it used to be thought a disadvantage to be misunderstood.
Author: G.K. Chesterton,  Heretics

Quote: You can't judge a book by it's cover but you can sure sell a bunch of books if you have a good one.
Author: Jayce O'Neal

Quote: You can't judge a book by it's cover but you can sure sell a bunch of books if you have a good one.
Author: Jayce O'Neal

Quote: I could name my penis Steve, and it would be appropriate, as it is sort of shaped like my dad’s face, whose name is Steve. Not just his face, but his whole body and person is named Steve. And he’s a dick.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Story That Talks about Talking Is Like Chatter to Chattering Teeth, and Every Set of Dentures Can Attest to the Fact That No..

Quote: Once you've condoned faith in general, you've condoned any crazy shit done because of faith.
Author: Penn Jillette,  God, No!: Signs You May Already Be an Atheist and Other Magical Tales

Quote: Most of the time it's not the Europeans who belittle us. What happens when we look at them is that we belittle ourselves. When we undertake the pilgrimage, it's not just to escape the tyranny at home but also to reach to the depths of our souls. The day arrives when the guilty must return to save those who could not find the courage to leave.
Author: Orhan Pamuk,  Snow

Quote: Maybe if I had to boil it down to one easy sentence, it would be this: I believe in evolution, and I believe in God. I just haven't worked out the details yet.
Author: Robin Brande,  Evolution, Me & Other Freaks of Nature

Quote: Maybe if I had to boil it down to one easy sentence, it would be this: I believe in evolution, and I believe in God. I just haven't worked out the details yet.
Author: Robin Brande,  Evolution, Me & Other Freaks of Nature

Quote: Opportunity doesn't make appointments, you have to be ready when it arrives.
Author: Tim Fargo

Quote: A homeless man visited my store today. The few quarters that he had in his pocket he invested on books. I offered him free books, but he insisted on giving me his quarters. He walked away filled with joy as if he possessed the world's riches in his hands. In a way, he did. He left me smiling and knowing that he was wealthier than many others... (01-21-10)
Author: Besa Kosova,  Raindrops

Quote: I learned to dream through reading, learned to create dreams through writing, and learned to develop dreamers through teaching. I shall always be a dreamer.
Author: Sharon M. Draper

Quote: When the actions becomes frequent than the words, success becomes heavier than the dreams. Do more, say less.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: Shouldn't we also ask ourselves what the consequences are of scrambling to provide the "most"of everything to our children in a world of fast dwindling resources?
Author: John Taylor Gatto

Quote: The foundation of every state is the education of its youth.
Author: Diogenes of Sinope

Quote: You have had a dream for so many years. Let today be the day you make a plan for it. Just think about how much more likely you are to hit your target when you finally aim at it.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Success isn't a result of spontaneous combustion. You must set yourself on fire.
Author: Arnold H. Glasow

Quote: Strive not to be a success, but rather to be of value.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: It is a thousand times better to have common sense without education than to have education without common sense.
Author: Robert G. Ingersoll

Quote: Our mind is capable of passing beyond the dividing line we have drawn for it. Beyond the pairs of opposites of which the world consists, other, new insights begin.
Author: Hermann Hesse

Quote: Joy blooms where minds and hearts are open.
Author: Jonathan Lockwood Huie

Quote: Play me something that makes me feel;This soul inside me is made of steel.Brain is breathing, but heart’s not beatingAnd, babe, I need you to make things real.Walk inside me without silence,Kill the past and change the tense.Empty gnawing and the ache is soaring;Take me places that make more sense.
Author: Melina Marchetta,  The Piper's Son

Quote: Failure is always an option
Author: Adam Savage

Quote: A library is a place where you learn what teachers were afraid to teach you.
Author: Alan M. Dershowitz

Quote: And suddenly solitude fell across his heart like a dusty reflection. He closed his eyes. The dark doors within him opened and he entered. The next performance in the theater of Grenouille's soul was beginning.
Author: Patrick Süskind,  Perfume: The Story of a Murderer

Quote: This look of thine will hurl my soul from heaven.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Othello

Quote: You will have fewer regrets in life if you start focusing and taking responsiblity for where you are and where you want to be.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: As for myself, I always willingly acknowledge my own self as the principal cause of every good and of every evil which may befall me; therefore, I have always found myself capable of being my own pupil, and ready to love my teacher.
Author: Giacomo Casanova,  Geschichte Meines Lebens

Quote: It is my belief...that the talents every child has, regardless of his official 'I.Q,' could stay with him through life, to enrich him and everybody else, if these talents were not regarded as commodities with a value in the success-stakes.
Author: Doris Lessing

Quote: . . . in no instance has a system in regard to religion been ever established, but for the purpose, as well as with the effect of its being made an instrument of intimidation, corruption, and delusion, for the support of depredation and oppression in the hands of governments.
Author: Jeremy Bentham,  Constitutional Code; For the Use All Nations and All Governments Professing Liberal Opinions Volume 1

Quote: The chief wonder of education is that it does not ruin everybody concerned in it, teachers and taught.
Author: Henry Adams,  The Education of Henry Adams

Quote: The more we see ourselves as a vibrant, successful, inspiring person who boldly declares and manifests her vision, the more we become just that.
Author: Kristi Bowman

Quote: Sometimes it takes great suffering to pierce the soul and open it up to greatness
Author: Jocelyn Murray

Quote: If there were a master of stupidity in this world, I would really love to listen to his success story.
Author: Toba Beta,  Betelgeuse Incident: Insiden Bait Al-Jauza

Quote: It is important that when we make a resolution, or establish a goal, that we take the ACTION necessary to accomplish that goal.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: Why be a man when you can be a success.
Author: Bertolt Brecht

Quote: My life changed the day I moved beyond just wishing for things and I started earning them. That is the day I learned that we don't get what we wish for, we get what we work for.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: The difference between greed and ambition is a greedy person desires things he isn't prepared to work for.
Author: Habeeb Akande

Quote: Don’t dare to dream big, just dream BIG!
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: The true measure of a man is not what he dreams, but what he aspires to be; a dream is nothing without action. Whether one fails or succeeds is irrelevant; all that matters is that there was motion in his life. That alone affects the world.
Author: Mike Norton,  White Mountain

Quote: What is happening to me happens to all fruits that grow ripe. It is the honey in my veins that makes my blood thicker, and my soul quieter.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Seemingly minor yet persistent things penetrate the mind over time making it difficult to ever realize the impact; hence, though quite unfortunate, the most dangerous forms of corruption are those that are subtle and below the radar.
Author: Criss Jami,  Salomé: In Every Inch In Every Mile

Quote: remembering is a great invention of the mind, and if you try hard enough you can remember anything, whether it really happened or not.
Author: Rodman Philbrick,  Freak the Mighty

Quote: It’s not in the book or in the writer that readers discern the truth of what they read; they see it in themselves, if the light of truth has penetrated their minds.
Author: Augustine of Hippo

Quote: War is the greatest evil Satan has invented to corrupt our hearts and souls. We should honor our soldiers, but we should never honor war.
Author: Dean Hughes,  Far From Home

Quote: You is getting nosier than a parker.
Author: Roald Dahl,  The BFG

Quote: For all the books in his possession, he still failed to read the stories written plain as day in the faces of the people around him.
Author: Emma Donoghue,  Slammerkin

Quote: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

Quote: All killer whales are named Kevin. You knew that, right?
Author: Christopher Moore,  Fluke: Or, I Know Why the Winged Whale Sings

Quote: With every challenge you face, there is an opportunity hidden that will lead you towards the path of wealth and abundance.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Be First: Achieve Every Dream

Quote: An experiment is a question which science poses to Nature and a measurement is the recording of Nature's answer.
Author: Max Planck,  Scientific Autobiography and Other Papers

Quote: In every man, there is a child. In every woman, there is a mother.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: The first place where self-esteem begins its journey is within us.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Those who cannot remember the past are condemned to compute it.
Author: Steven Pinker,  Words and Rules: The Ingredients of Language

Quote: In matters of the heart as well, a certain level of negativity and suspicion is universally recommended. You may try to project a thoroughly positive outlook in order to attract a potential boyfriend, but you are also advised to Google him.
Author: Barbara Ehrenreich

Quote: Using your mind is a faster method to getting what you want. I mean, all you have to do is sit there. What could be easier?
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: A person who has been punished is not thereby simply less inclined to behave in a given way; at best, he learns how to avoid punishment.
Author: B.F. Skinner,  Beyond Freedom and Dignity

Quote: Un libro leído a medias es una aventura amorosa incompleta.
Author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

Quote: ...I will not allow books to prove any thing.""But how shall we prove any thing?""We never shall.
Author: Jane Austen,  Persuasion

Quote: Maybe Heaven will be a library and then I might get to finish my ‘to-read’ list.
Author: Kellie Elmore,  Magic in the Backyard

Quote: And you are made of a hundred trillion cells. We are, each of us, a multitude.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: The world is full of magical things patiently waiting for our wits to grow sharper.
Author: Bertrand Russell

Quote: A single rose can be my garden... a single friend, my world.
Author: Leo Buscaglia

Quote: Your life is the fruit of your own doing. You have no one to blame but yourself.
Author: Joseph Campbell

Quote: You might well remember that nothing can bring you success but yourself.
Author: Napoleon Hill

Quote: It is our hope that the AP program can serve as an anchor for increasing rigor in our schools. Rigor can be maintained while increasing student participation.
Author: Gaston Caperton

Quote: Suffering passes, while love is eternal. That's a gift that you have received from God. Don't waste it.
Author: Laura Ingalls Wilder

Quote: To know how to grow old is the master work of wisdom, and one of the most difficult chapters in the great art of living.
Author: Herman Melville

Quote: I am often the brunt of my own humor.
Author: Charles R. Swindoll

Quote: Always be friendly, always be kind,Like the most beautiful flower that you can find.
Author: Debasish Mridha

Quote: Omnia vincit amor"- "Love conquers all
Author: Virgil

Quote: The mythology of your culture hums in your ears so constantly that no one pays the slightest bit of attention to it. Of course man is conquering space and the atom and the deserts and the oceans and the elements. According to your mythology, this is what he was BORN to do.
Author: Daniel Quinn,  Ishmael: An Adventure of the Mind and Spirit

Quote: The complexities of adult life get in the way of the truth. The great philosophers have always been able to clear away the complexities and see simple distinctions - simple once they are stated, vastly difficult before. If we are to follow them we too must be childishly simple in our questions - and maturely wise in our replies.
Author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

Quote: The complexities of adult life get in the way of the truth. The great philosophers have always been able to clear away the complexities and see simple distinctions - simple once they are stated, vastly difficult before. If we are to follow them we too must be childishly simple in our questions - and maturely wise in our replies.
Author: Mortimer J. Adler,  How to Read a Book: The Classic Guide to Intelligent Reading

Quote: And don't tell me the end justifies the means because it doesn't. We never reach the end. All we ever get is means. That's what we live with.
Author: Nick Harkaway,  Angelmaker

Quote: The more he identifies with the dominant images of need, the less he understands his own life and his own desires. The spectacle’s estrangement from the acting subject is expressed by the fact that the individual’s gestures are no longer his own; they are the gestures of someone else who represents them to him.
Author: Guy Debord,  The Society of the Spectacle

Quote: Each voice carries a portion of value, no matter how unpalatable or distasteful that voice may be: no one person, government, ideology, transnational, or religious institution can own and dominate the whole.
Author: B.W. Powe,  Towards A Canada Of Light

Quote: Slice a pear and you will find that its flesh is incandescent white. It glows with inner light. Those who carry a knife and a pear are never afraid of the dark.
Author: Yann Martel,  Beatrice and Virgil

Quote: An attempt to achieve the good by force is like an attempt to provide a man with a picture gallery at the price of cutting out his eyes.
Author: Ayn Rand

Quote: Upon this first, and in one sense this sole, rule of reason, that in order to learn you must desire to learn, and in so desiring not be satisfied with what you already incline to think, there follows one corollary which itself deserves to be inscribed upon every wall of the city of philosophy: Do not block the way of inquiry.
Author: Charles Sanders Peirce

Quote: Upon this first, and in one sense this sole, rule of reason, that in order to learn you must desire to learn, and in so desiring not be satisfied with what you already incline to think, there follows one corollary which itself deserves to be inscribed upon every wall of the city of philosophy: Do not block the way of inquiry.
Author: Charles Sanders Peirce

Quote: It is when those who are not strong enough have made some moderate amount of progress that they fail and give up...
Author: Confucius,  The Wisdom Of Confucius

Quote: It is when those who are not strong enough have made some moderate amount of progress that they fail and give up...
Author: Confucius,  The Wisdom Of Confucius

Quote: A nation is a detour of nature to arrive at five or six great men- yes, and then to get around them.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: You are what your creators and experiences have made you, like every other being in this universe. Accept that and be done; I tire of your whining.
Author: N.K. Jemisin,  The Hundred Thousand Kingdoms

Quote: The warrior learns of the spiritual realm by dwelling on the cutting edge of the sword, standing at the edge of the fire pit, venturing right up to the edge of starvation if necessary. Vibrant and intense living is the warrior's form of worship.
Author: Stephen K. Hayes

Quote: where the telescope ends the microscope begins, and who can say which has the wider vision?
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Quote: Do you believe in God, doctor?"No - but what does that really mean? I'm fumbling in the dark, struggling to make something out. But I've long ceased finding that original.
Author: Albert Camus,  The Plague

Quote: Do you believe in God, doctor?"No - but what does that really mean? I'm fumbling in the dark, struggling to make something out. But I've long ceased finding that original.
Author: Albert Camus,  The Plague

Quote: I hold strongly to this: that it is better to be impetuous than circumspect; because fortune is a woman and if she is to be submissive it is necessary to beat and coerce her.
Author: Niccolò Machiavelli,  The Prince - Niccolo Machiavelli - Original Version

Quote: Money is the root of all evil.' Then we hear, 'A fool and his money are soon parted.' What are they talking about? If money is so evil, shouldn't it be, 'A wise man and his money are soon parted'? And another thing, how does a fool get money in the first place? I know some fools who have a lot of money, but they won't tell me how they got it, and I won't tell them.
Author: George Burns,  Doctor Burns' Prescription for Happiness

Quote: Dance in the rain, follow the path of lovely lanes, you are what you always wanted to be, so chill out, dear friend!
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Tell people the hammered truth, and it will ring like steel against an anvil.
Author: Elizabeth Haydon,  The Floating Island

Quote: If names be not correct, language is not in accordance with the truth of things.
Author: Confucius,  The Analects of Confucius

Quote: Listen. Pay attention. Treasure every moment.
Author: Oprah Winfrey

Quote: It’s obvious you kids are smart-school and good teachers will do that for you-but wisdom is something altogether different. Wisdom can be gathered in your downtime. Wisdom that can change the very course of your life will come from the people you are around, the books you read, and the things you listen to or watch on radio or television.
Author: Andy Andrews,  The Noticer: Sometimes, All a Person Needs Is a Little Perspective

Quote: The fruit of empty hopes is more bitter than the saddest truth.
Author: Angel Wagenstein,  Isaac's Torah

Quote: The fruit of empty hopes is more bitter than the saddest truth.
Author: Angel Wagenstein,  Isaac's Torah

Quote: Half-truths are worth more than outright lies.
Author: George R.R. Martin,  A Storm of Swords

Quote: Old words are reborn with new faces.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Old words are reborn with new faces.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Old words are reborn with new faces.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Happiness is inseparably connected with decent, clean behavior.
Author: Boyd K. Packer

Quote: Happiness is inseparably connected with decent, clean behavior.
Author: Boyd K. Packer

Quote: Life isn't all grand, but it isn't all miserable either. There's both sweet and sour in every day. So why focus on the ugly when you can gaze at what's beautiful? Concentrate on the good.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

Quote: Life isn't all grand, but it isn't all miserable either. There's both sweet and sour in every day. So why focus on the ugly when you can gaze at what's beautiful? Concentrate on the good.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

Quote: Behold, the fool saith, "Put not all thine eggs in the one basket"- which is but a matter of saying, "Scatter your money and your attention"; but the wise man saith, "Pull all your eggs in the one basket and - WATCH THAT BASKET."- Pudd'nhead Wilson's Calendar
Author: Mark Twain,  Pudd'nhead Wilson

Quote: There are questions I'm still not wise enough to answer, just wise enough to no longer ask.
Author: George Jones

Quote: Lord, make me nowAs happy as the field.With flowers enriched...
Author: Eileen A. Soper

Quote: It's easier to fake it. When you fake it for sixteen years, it becomes part of you, something you don't think about.
Author: Alex Flinn,  Breathing Underwater

Quote: Extrapolating from the statistical growth of the legal profession, by the year 2035 every single person in the United States will be a lawyer, including newborn infants.
Author: Michael Crichton,  State of Fear

Quote: Proper lighting is everything, Julianna.
Author: Wendelin Van Draanen,  Flipped

Quote: His whole life was a sham, a fairy tale. The truth hidden behind a wall of lies, each lie another brick in the wall until he probably couldn't see the truth anymore.
Author: Shaun Jeffrey,  The Kult

Quote: I would rather die an individual than live my life as a clone.
Author: Cristina Marrero

Quote: The fear of God is not the beginning of wisdom. The fear of God is the death of wisdom. Skepticism and doubt lead to study and investigation, and investigation is the beginning of wisdom.
Author: Clarence Darrow,  Why I Am An Agnostic and Other Essays

Quote: Don't let the fear of losing them keep you from loving them.
Author: Nicole Williams,  Crash

Quote: Behind the veil of each night, there is a smiling dawn.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: The restless spirit never loses its wings. If sometimes it cannot fly, it is because during those moments the sky vanishes.
Author: R.N. Prasher

Quote: The restless spirit never loses its wings. If sometimes it cannot fly, it is because during those moments the sky vanishes.
Author: R.N. Prasher

Quote: Your angel cannot protect you against that which neither god nor the devil had made
Author: Cassandra Clare,  Clockwork Angel

Quote: Below me Rontu was running along the cliffs barking at the screaming gulls. Pelicans were chattering as they finished the blue water. But suddenly I thought of Tutok, and the island seemed very quiet.
Author: Scott O'Dell,  Island of the Blue Dolphins

Quote: Jeder für sich und Gott gegen alle
Author: Werner Herzog

Quote: كلمة : الآيات لا تطلق على مطلق موجود ، إنما تطلق على الموجود العجيب ، كما نقول : هذا آية في الحسن ، آية في الشجاعة ، فالآية علي الشيء العجيب .
Author: محمد متولي الشعراوي,  كيف تقرأ القرآن الكريم وتحفظه

Quote: God can inject hope into a absolutely hopeless situation.
Author: Mark Evans

Quote: There are, as we know, powerful and illustrious atheists. At bottom, led back to the truth by their very force, they are not absolutely sure that they are atheists; it is with them only a question of definition, and in any case, if they do not believe in God, being great minds, they prove God.
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Quote: Hope is sweet.Hope is illumining.Hope is fulfilling.Hope can be everlasting.Therefore, do not give up hope,Even in the sunset of your life.
Author: Sri Chinmoy,  My Life's Soul-Journey: Daily Meditations for Ever-Increasing Spiritual Fulfillment

Quote: Even if times got bad, he would never again deny himself the possibility that the future might be happy even if the present was painful. He would allow himself dreams.
Author: Suzanne Collins,  Gregor the Overlander

Quote: …told herself likewise not to hope. But it was too late. Hope had already entered…
Author: Jane Austen,  Sense and Sensibility

Quote: The real power in America is held by a fast-emerging new Oligarchy of pimps and preachers who see no need for Democracy or fairness or even trees, except maybe the ones in their own yards, and they don't mind admitting it. They worship money and power and death. Their ideal solution to all the nation's problems would be another 100 Year War.
Author: Hunter S. Thompson,  Kingdom of Fear: Loathsome Secrets of a Star-Crossed Child in the Final Days of the American Century

Quote: Unless you are willing to do the ridiculous, God will not do the miraculous. When you have God, you don’t have to know everything about it; you just do it.
Author: Mother Angelica

Quote: And indeed it could be said that once the faintest stirring of hope became possible, the dominion of plague was ended.
Author: Albert Camus,  The Plague

Quote: Oh God, Oh God we’re all gonna die  doesn’t really fit the definition of banter, now does it?
Author: Lilith Saintcrow,  Reckoning

Quote: I need you because I know I deserve you but let me fall in love with you one last time before I let go. So I can remember the beautiful imperfection that rattled my bones.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I need you because I know I deserve you but let me fall in love with you one last time before I let go. So I can remember the beautiful imperfection that rattled my bones.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I need you because I know I deserve you but let me fall in love with you one last time before I let go. So I can remember the beautiful imperfection that rattled my bones.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I need you because I know I deserve you but let me fall in love with you one last time before I let go. So I can remember the beautiful imperfection that rattled my bones.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I need you because I know I deserve you but let me fall in love with you one last time before I let go. So I can remember the beautiful imperfection that rattled my bones.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: But whichever form it took it brought with it, in those moments of bitter anguish, such a desperate surge of hope that it was almost untouchable, and flitted away like a golden butterfly into the bright blue sky - beautiful, unreachable and completely transistent.
Author: Tabitha Suzuma,  A Note of Madness

Quote: Have faith in your skills. Doubt kills more dreams than failure ever will.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: The way you make love is the way God will be with you.
Author: Rumi

Quote: Why wait? So precious is this life—this gift—this temporary blindness. Burn and drown and embrace the false dark, then grasp the unthinkable height of resulting joy. For in the end, in the light of truth when the flesh is cast off, there is nothing but this.
Author: Jennifer DeLucy

Quote: Why wait? So precious is this life—this gift—this temporary blindness. Burn and drown and embrace the false dark, then grasp the unthinkable height of resulting joy. For in the end, in the light of truth when the flesh is cast off, there is nothing but this.
Author: Jennifer DeLucy

Quote: This day is not a sieve, losing time. With each passing minute, each passing year, there's this deepening awareness that I am filling, gaining time. We stand on the brink of eternity.
Author: Ann Voskamp,  One Thousand Gifts: A Dare to Live Fully Right Where You Are

Quote: Pentru mine, moartea este doar hotarul unde inceteaza sa mai existe "maine". Numai pana acolo poti sa iubesti, sa visezi, sa regreti. Brusc, tot ce n-ai facut va ramane pentru totdeauna nefacut.
Author: Octavian Paler,  Deșertul pentru totdeauna

Quote: Don’t simply exist in this world, but grasp life’s potential by the jacket. Dare it to be all it can. Make life historical—a gripping account of accomplishment. Make life a mystery—a challenging, bold adventure. Make life heartfelt—an enduring, poetic romance. Whatever it is you make of your world, live the fairytale.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Eena, The Return of a Queen

Quote: And remember this most of all: when it is darkest, that is when you can see the stars most clearly.
Author: Kathleen McGowan,  The Poet Prince

Quote: Although, I admit, I desire,Occasionally, some backtalkFrom the mute sky, I can't honestly complain:A certain minor light may stillLean incandescentOut of kitchen table or chairAs if a celestial burning tookPossession of the most obtuse objects now and then --
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Collected Poems

Quote: Faith—is the Pierless BridgeSupporting what We seeUnto the Scene that We do not—Too slender for the eyeIt bears the Soul as boldAs it were rocked in SteelWith Arms of Steel at either side—It joins—behind the VeilTo what, could We presumeThe Bridge would cease to beTo Our far, vacillating FeetA first Necessity.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: Glory be to Him who changes others and remains Himself unchanged!
Author: Anonymous,  The Arabian Nights

Quote: I had always felt life first as a story: and if there is a story there is a story-teller
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: To find what you seek in the road of life, the best proverb of all is that which says:"Leave no stone unturned.
Author: Edward Bulwer-Lytton

Quote: I swear, the best things come to me by accident! Or should I say, effortless destiny?
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Maybe I don't really want to know what's going on. Maybe I'd rather not know. Maybe I couldn't bear to know. The Fall was a fall from innocence to knowledge.
Author: Margaret Atwood

Quote: أنا لا أريد أن أعبر دون أن أعرفَ كل ما يمكنني أن أعرفه
Author: ليلى الجهني,  40 في معنى أن أكبر

Quote: I used to think that once you really knew a thing, its truth would shine on forever. Now it's pretty obvious to me that more often than not the batteries fade, and sometimes what you knew even goes out with a bang when you try and call on it, just like a light bulb cracking off when you throw the switch.
Author: Lucy Grealy

Quote: First, I thought, almost despairing,This must crush my spirit now;Yet I bore it, and am bearing-Only do not ask me how.
Author: Heinrich Heine

Quote: Just remember that the only question in a house is who is to rule. The rest is only dancing around that, trying not to look it in the eye.
Author: Catherynne M. Valente,  Deathless

Quote: Just remember that the only question in a house is who is to rule. The rest is only dancing around that, trying not to look it in the eye.
Author: Catherynne M. Valente,  Deathless

Quote: There is no formula to relationships. They have to be negotiated in loving ways, with room for both parties, what they want and what they need, what they can do and what their life is like.
Author: Mitch Albom,  Tuesdays with Morrie

Quote: But writing poems and letters doesn't seem to do much good.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: truth, like gold, is to be obtained not by its growth, but by washing away from it all that is not gold.
Author: Leo Tolstoy

Quote: a bruise, bluein the muscle, youimpinge upon me.As bone hugs the ache home, soI'm vexed to love you, your bodythe shape of returns, your hair a torsoof light, your heatI must have, your openingI'd eat, each momentof that soft-finned fruit,inverted fountain in which I don't see me.
Author: Li-Young Lee,  The City in Which I Love You

Quote: Isn’t it time that these most ancient sorrows of ours grew fruitful? Time that we tenderly loosed ourselves from the loved one, and, unsteadily, survived: the way the arrow, suddenly all vector, survives the string to be more than itself. For abiding is nowhere.
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Duino Elegies

Quote: The bustle in a houseThe morning after deathIs solemnest of industriesEnacted upon earth,--The sweeping up the heart,And putting love awayWe shall not want to use againUntil eternity
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: We, all who live, haveA life that is livedAnd another life that is thought,And the only life we haveIt's the one that is dividedIn right or wrong.
Author: Fernando Pessoa

Quote: Autumn DuskI saw above a sea of hillsA solitary planet shine,And there was no one, near or far,to keep the world from being mine.
Author: Sara Teasdale,  Dark of the Moon

Quote: I thought my fireplace dead and stirred the ashes. I burned my fingers.
Author: Antonio Machado,  Border of a Dream: Selected Poems

Quote: How dull it is to pause, to make an end,To rust unburnish’d, not to shine in use!As tho’ to breathe were life!
Author: Alfred Lord Tennyson,  Ulysses

Quote: Poetry is a rich, full-bodied whistle, cracked ice crunching in pails, the night that numbs the leaf, the duel of two nightingales, the sweet pea that has run wild, Creation's tears in shoulder blades.
Author: Boris Pasternak

Quote: Fear is an aid to the warrior. It is a small fire burning. It heats the muscles, making us stronger. Panic comes when the fire is out of control, consuming all courage and pride.
Author: David Gemmell,  Lord of the Silver Bow

Quote: One woman filled with self love and self acceptance is a model more super than any cover girl.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Parker: She believed, absolutely, that each person, each heart, had a counterpart—had a mate. A rightness. She’d always believed it, and understood that unshakable belief was a reason she was good at what she did.
Author: Nora Roberts

Quote: I decided that giving a girl a ring when you're not in a serious relationship is sort of like giving a guy a blow job when you have no real feelings for him. It makes everything feel a little cheap.It cheapens the giver and the recipient.
Author: Emily Giffin,  Baby Proof

Quote: Everything stated or expressed by man is a note in the margin of a completely erased text. From what's in the note we can extract the gist of what must have been in the text, but there's always a doubt, and the possible meanings are many.
Author: Fernando Pessoa,  The Book of Disquiet

Quote: I sold my soul for knowledge of the future, only to have that very pact render me forever ignorant (Gerald Tarrant).
Author: C.S. Friedman,  When True Night Falls

Quote: I sold my soul for knowledge of the future, only to have that very pact render me forever ignorant (Gerald Tarrant).
Author: C.S. Friedman,  When True Night Falls

Quote: Happy wife, happy life.
Author: Paul Orfalea,  Copy This!: Lessons from a Hyperactive Dyslexic who Turned a Bright Idea Into One of America's Best Companies

Quote: Sweetest smile is made saddest tear-drop!
Author: Edwin Arnold

Quote: Never start with a clear idea of storyline. Instead, commence blindly, with a vague notion of trying to include a reference to your favourite band, gift shop, or chocolate bar.
Author: Alan C. Martin

Quote: The dream is to keep surprising yourself, never mind the audience.
Author: Tom Hiddleston

Quote: For a true artist, difficulties become opportunities and clouds become solid present.
Author: Alejandro Jodorowsky

Quote: People need a moral code, to help them make decisions. All this bio-yogurt virtue and financial self-righteousness are just filling the gap in the market. But the problem is that it's all backwards. It's not that you do the right thing and hope it pays off; the morally right thing is by definition the thing that gives the biggest payoff.
Author: Tana French,  In the Woods

Quote: Which came first — the observer or the particle?
Author: Vanna Bonta,  Flight: A Quantum Fiction Novel

Quote: Action creates/a taste/for itself.
Author: Kay Ryan

Quote: Some folks are happier not being saved.
Author: Lisa Kleypas,  Sugar Daddy

Quote: Religions die when they are proved to be true. Science is the record of dead religions.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Religions die when they are proved to be true. Science is the record of dead religions.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: We rely on faith only in the context of claims for which there is no sufficient sensory or logical evidence.
Author: Sam Harris

Quote: النظرة مثل الحبة تلقى في الأرض فإذا لم يلتفت إليها يبست، وإن سقيت نبتت وكذلك النظرة إذا لحقت بمثلهاكم نظرة فعلت في قلب صاحبهاكمبلغ السهم بين القوس والوتر
Author: ابن قيم الجوزية

Quote: It's not the despair, Laura. I can take the despair. It's the hope I can't stand. ~ Brian Stimpson, Clockwise
Author: John Cleese

Quote: I do believe that characters in novels belong to their writers and their readers pretty equally. I've learned a lot of things about the characters I write from people who read about them. Readers expand them in ways I don't think of and take them to places I can't go.
Author: Ann Brashares

Quote: Forgiveness isn’t something I’m preoccupied with — turning the other cheek isn’t my trip.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: Patriotism is a kind of religion; it is the egg from which wars are hatched."[My Uncle Sosthenes]
Author: Guy de Maupassant,  Complete Short Stories

Quote: Failure is usually boring. It is the credible but unrealized threat of failure that is interesting.
Author: Robin D. Laws

Quote: They are not mad. They're trained to believe, not to know. Belief can be manipulated. Only knowledge is dangerous.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Dune Messiah

Quote: To regret religion is to regret Western civilization.
Author: Theodore Dalrymple

Quote: Liberty a word without which all other words are vain.
Author: Robert G. Ingersoll

Quote: Everything in this life passes away — only God remains, only He is worth struggling towards. We have a choice: to follow the way of this world, of the society that surrounds us, and thereby find ourselves outside of God; or to choose the way of life, to choose God Who calls us and for Whom our heart is searching.
Author: Seraphim Rose

Quote: It has been discovered that with a dull urban population, all formed under a mechanical system of State education, a suggestion or command, however senseless and unreasoned, will be obeyed if it be sufficiently repeated.
Author: Hilaire Belloc,  An Essay on the Restoration of Property

Quote: If failure has the strength to turn your life into bitterness itself, then patience has the strength to turn your life into the sweetest joy. Do not surrender to fate after a single failure. Failure, at most, precedes success.
Author: Sri Chinmoy

Quote: One of these grand defects, as I humbly conceive, is this, that children are habituated to learning without understanding.
Author: Jonathan Edwards,  The Works of Jonathan Edwards, Vol. 16: Letters and Personal Writings

Quote: The aim of education should be to teach us rather how to think, than what to think - rather to improve our minds, so as to enable us to think for ourselves, than to load the memory with the thoughts of other men.
Author: James Beattie

Quote: Don't nourish your fears more than you nourish your hopes.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: The home is the chief school of human virtues.
Author: William Ellery Channing

Quote: But there was a special kind of gift that came with embracing the chaos, even if I cursed most of the way. I'm convinced that, when everything is wiped blank, it's life 's way of forcing you to become acquainted with and aware of who you are now, who you can become. What is the fulfillment of your soul?
Author: Jennifer DeLucy

Quote: How we feel is not who we are. We might feel like failures, but as long as we are still trying, we are not failures. We are works in progress.
Author: Toni Sorenson

Quote: Intelligence entails a strong mind, but genius entails a heart of a lion in tune with a strong mind.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: I came to the Greeks early, and I found answers in them. Greece's great men let all their acts turn on the immortality of the soul. We don't really act as if we believed in the soul's immortality and that's why we are where we are today.
Author: Edith Hamilton

Quote: Someday, I hope that we will all be patriots of our planet and not just of our respective nations.
Author: Zoe Weil,  Most Good, Least Harm: A Simple Principle for a Better World and Meaningful Life

Quote: My mum and dad had worked incredibly hard to afford me an education.
Author: Benedict Cumberbatch

Quote: Seven times have I despised my soul: The sixth time when she despised the ugliness of a face, and knew not that it was one of her own masks.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: Your mind was made to know and love God.
Author: John Piper,  Don't Waste Your Life

Quote: Your mind was made to know and love God.
Author: John Piper,  Don't Waste Your Life

Quote: Children are notoriously curious about everything, everything except... the things people want them to know. It then remains for us to refrain from forcing any kind of knowledge upon them, and they will be curious about everything.
Author: Floyd Dell

Quote: Once you've decided that something's absolutely true, you've closed your mind on it, and a closed mind doesn't go anywhere. Question everything. That's what education's all about.
Author: David Eddings,  Belgarath the Sorcerer

Quote: The artist’s task is to save the soul of mankind; and anything less is a dithering while Rome burns. Because of the artists, who are self-selected, for being able to journey into the Other, if the artists cannot find the way, then the way cannot be found.
Author: Terence McKenna

Quote: The sight of such aching beauty would infuse his soul with pain.
Author: Tabitha Suzuma,  A Note of Madness

Quote: Sex parties, alcohol and drugs lost their appeal to Sven after a while. Music never did, in his continual search for that sober connection--intimacy with one person over a long period of time, as opposed to periods of intimacy with a bunch of random faces.
Author: Jess C. Scott,  SVEN, Incubus Story.02

Quote: It is a very grave mistake to think that the enjoyment of seeing and searching can be promoted by means of coercion and a sense of duty. To the contrary, I believe it would be possible to rob even a healthy beast of prey of its voraciousness, if it were possible, with the aid of a whip, to force the beast to devour continuously, even when not hungry.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: It is grief that develops the powers of the mind.
Author: Marcel Proust

Quote: Crows don’t take from you,” Dean said. “They give your soul wings.
Author: Caitlin Kittredge,  The Iron Thorn

Quote: Of all the questions I have asked my readers this is the most important: What would you do if you weren't afraid? When you finally give wings to that answer then you have found your life's purpose.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Two types of choices seem to me to have been crucial in tipping the outcomes [of the various societies' histories] towards success or failure: long-term planning and willingness to reconsider core values. On reflection we can also recognize the crucial role of these same two choices for the outcomes of our individual lives.
Author: Jared Diamond,  Collapse: How Societies Choose to Fail or Succeed

Quote: The learnin' mind is the livin' mind... an' any sort o' smart is truesome smart, old smart or new, high smart or low.
Author: David Mitchell,  Cloud Atlas

Quote: In my experience, the most staunchly held views are based on ignorance or accepted dogma, not carefully considered accumulations of facts. The more you expose the intricacies and realtities of the situation, the less clear-cut things become.
Author: Mary Roach,  Spook: Science Tackles the Afterlife

Quote: Certain bookworms eat books. Eat them, swear in them, spill things on them.
Author: Tara Bray Smith

Quote: One book calls to another unexpectedly, creating alliances across different cultures and centuries.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: People have often told me that one of their strongest childhood memories is the scent of their grandmother's house. I never knew my grandmothers, but I could always count of the Bookmobile.
Author: Adriana Trigiani,  Big Stone Gap

Quote: A great book is a homing deviceFor navigating paradise.A good book somehow makes you careAbout the comfort of a chair.A bad book owes to many treesA forest of apologies.
Author: J. Patrick Lewis

Quote: ...I tell myself it does not matter what one reads--favorite authors, particular themes--as long as we read something. It is not even important to own the books.
Author: Helen Simonson,  Major Pettigrew's Last Stand

Quote: Big whirls have little whirls,That feed on their velocity;And little whirls have lesser whirls,And so on to viscosity.
Author: Lewis Fry Richardson

Quote: We are not born into the world. We are born into something that we make into the world.
Author: Michael Talbot,  Mysticism and the New Physics

Quote: Its the fate of all creators: They fall in love with their creations.
Author: Michael Grant,  Eve & Adam

Quote: I think we have different value systems."—Arthur"Well mine's better."—Ford
Author: Douglas Adams,  Mostly Harmless

Quote: Impossibility only lasts until you find new unbelievable hard evidences.
Author: Toba Beta

Quote: You tap in to this oneness and become part of the universe as a whole.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: Names and attributes must be accommodated to the essence of things, and not the essence to the names, since things come first and names afterwards.
Author: Galileo Galilei,  Discoveries and Opinions of Galileo

Quote: Science is the topography of ignorance.
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

Quote: One of the convenient things about literature is that, despite copyrights [...] a book belongs to the reader as well as to the writer.
Author: Anne Fadiman,  At Large and at Small: Familiar Essays

Quote: Beneath my eyes opens -- a book; I see to the bottom; the heart -- I see to the depths. I know what loves are trembling into fire; how jealousy shoots its green flashes hither and thither; how intricately love crosses love; love makes knots; love brutally tears them apart. I have been knotted; I have been torn apart.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  The Waves

Quote: The Bookshop has a thousand books,All colors, hues, and tinges,And every cover is a doorThat turns on magic hinges.
Author: Nancy Byrd Turner

Quote: I took to the Bodleian library as to a lover and ... would sit long hours in Bodley's arms to emerge, blinking and dazed with the small and feel of all those books.
Author: Laurie R. King,  The Beekeeper's Apprentice

Quote: There are a large number of people in the room, but one is unaware of them. They are in the books. At times they move among the pages, like sleepers turning over between two dreams. Ah, how good it is to be among people who are reading.
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  The Notebooks of Malte Laurids Brigge

Quote: Be faithful to that which exists within yourself.
Author: Andre Gide

Quote: One loyal friend is worth ten thousand relatives.
Author: Euripides

Quote: Life is too short to spend in negativity. So I have made a conscious effort to not be where I don't want to be.
Author: Hugh Dillon

Quote: Rockefeller once explained the secret of success. 'Get up early, work late - and strike oil.'
Author: Joey Adams

Quote: I'm going to try to enjoy the All-Star break, hope my players reflect on what happened the first half of the season, come back with a different attitude, try to find our solution on how to win it.
Author: Don Baylor

Quote: Oh, love will make a dog howl in rhyme.
Author: Francis Beaumont

Quote: Another unsettling element in modern art is that common symptom of immaturity, the dread of doing what has been done before.
Author: Edith Wharton

Quote: A sense of humor keen enough to show a man his own absurdities will keep him from the commission of all sins, or nearly all, save those worth committing.
Author: Samuel Butler

Quote: It doesn't matter how smart you are unless you stop and think.
Author: Thomas Sowell

Quote: You like me not because I like you. I like you just because I like me.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: He recognized with absolute certainty the empty fragility of even the noblest theorizings as compared with the definitive plenitude of the smallest fact grasped in its total, concrete reality.
Author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin,  Hymn of the Universe

Quote: He recognized with absolute certainty the empty fragility of even the noblest theorizings as compared with the definitive plenitude of the smallest fact grasped in its total, concrete reality.
Author: Pierre Teilhard de Chardin,  Hymn of the Universe

Quote: the Real-World was a sprawling mess of a book in need of a good editor.
Author: Jasper Fforde,  One of Our Thursdays Is Missing

Quote: We are a society of notoriously unhappy people: lonely, anxious, depressed, destructive, dependent — people who are glad when we have killed the time we are trying so hard to save.
Author: Erich Fromm,  To Have or to Be? The Nature of the Psyche

Quote: The truth is, going against the internal stream of ignorance is way more rebellious than trying to start some sort of cultural revolution.
Author: Noah Levine,  Dharma Punx: A Memoir

Quote: Les hommes construisent trop de murs et pas assez de ponts.
Author: Isaac Newton

Quote: The inner revolution will not be televised or sold on the Internet. It must take place within one's own mind and heart.
Author: Noah Levine,  Dharma Punx: A Memoir

Quote: Trebuie sa te departezi putin de tine ca sa te poti apropia de ceilalti.
Author: Andrei Pleșu

Quote: Philosophy ought to question the basic assumptions of the age. Thinking through, critically and carefully, what most of us take for granted is, I believe, the chief task of philosophy, and the task that makes philosophy a worthwhile activity.
Author: Peter Singer,  Animal Liberation

Quote: You were free, you are free and you will be free.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: For Reason, ruling alone, is a force confining; and Passion, unattended,is a flame that burns to its own destruction.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: Ask a deeply religious Christian if he’d rather live next to a bearded Muslim that may or may not be plotting a terror attack, or an atheist that may or may not show him how to set up a wireless network in his house. On the scale of prejudice, atheists don’t seem so bad lately.
Author: Scott Adams

Quote: Ask a deeply religious Christian if he’d rather live next to a bearded Muslim that may or may not be plotting a terror attack, or an atheist that may or may not show him how to set up a wireless network in his house. On the scale of prejudice, atheists don’t seem so bad lately.
Author: Scott Adams

Quote: A day unemployed is like a bagel- even when it's bad, it's still pretty good...
Author: CrimethInc.,  Evasion

Quote: A day unemployed is like a bagel- even when it's bad, it's still pretty good...
Author: CrimethInc.,  Evasion

Quote: Confidence that one's impressions are God-given is no guarantee that this is really so, even when they persist and grow stronger through long seasons of prayer. Bible-based wisdom must judge them.
Author: J.I. Packer

Quote: I been silent so long now it’s gonna roar out of me like floodwaters and you think the guy telling this is ranting and raving my God; you think this is too horrible to have really happened, this is too awful to be the truth! But, please. It’s still hard for me to have a clear mind thinking on it. But it’s the truth even if it didn’t happen.
Author: Ken Kesey,  One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest

Quote: The bitterness of joy lies in the knowledge that it cannot last. Nor should joy last beyond a certain season, for, after that season, even joy would become merely habit.
Author: Tanith Lee,  Delusion's Master

Quote: There is nothing around me but money, money, money.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: They like to tell us that it is important to speak the truth, but it has been my experience that real happiness lies in having people tell you what you want to believe, usually not the same thing at all, and if you have to stub your toe on the truth later, so be it.
Author: Jeff Lindsay,  Dexter Is Delicious

Quote: Brilliance is impossible without a touch of insanity.
Author: Skyla Madi,  Your Guardian Angel

Quote: The fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
Author: Isaiah Berlin

Quote: The fox knows many things, but the hedgehog knows one big thing.
Author: Isaiah Berlin

Quote: Happiness had never been like this before. Now it came like sun showers, the sun and the rain together. Happiness was happier than it had been - sharp, piercing, and snatched, like a breath while swimming in surf.
Author: Elizabeth Knox,  Dreamhunter

Quote: Success equals goals; all else is commentary.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: Before, you are wise; after, you are wise. In between you are otherwise
Author: David Zindell,  The Broken God

Quote: The happiness of love is in action; its test is what one is willing to do for others.
Author: Lew Wallace,  Ben-Hur: A Tale of the Christ

Quote: Ethical veganism represents a commitment to nonviolence.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: Ethical veganism represents a commitment to nonviolence.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: Ethical veganism represents a commitment to nonviolence.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: The notion of freedom proclaimed by the modern world is anti-discipline. But true freedom cannot be separated from discipline.
Author: Matthew Kelly,  Rediscover Catholicism: A Spiritual Guide to Living with Passion & Purpose

Quote: The truth has become an insult.
Author: Chimamanda Ngozi Adichie,  Half of a Yellow Sun

Quote: A dim vastness is spread before our souls; the perceptions of our mind are as obscure as those of our vision... But alas! when we have attained our object, when the distant 'there' becomes the present 'here,' all is changed; we are as poor and circumscribed as ever, and our souls still languish for unattainable happiness.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe,  The Sorrows of Young Werther

Quote: Every impulse of feeling should be guided by reason; and, in my opinion, exertion should always be in proportion to what is required.
Author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

Quote: The only way I can be angry at you is when I have thought, said, or done something that is unkind in my own opinion.
Author: Byron Katie

Quote: Before the fruits of prosperity can come, the storms of life need to first bring the required rains of testing, which mixes with the seeds of wisdom to produce a mature harvest.
Author: Lincoln Patz

Quote: Before the fruits of prosperity can come, the storms of life need to first bring the required rains of testing, which mixes with the seeds of wisdom to produce a mature harvest.
Author: Lincoln Patz

Quote: He saw in happiness the seeds of independence, and in independence the seeds of revolt.
Author: Mervyn Peake,  Titus Groan

Quote: I had to hand it to him, leaving the empty glove lying on the bed was an apt metaphor for love. Two things I can say about my grandpa are that he is wise, and his left hand is probably cold.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. And the ageless sages.

Quote: I had to hand it to him, leaving the empty glove lying on the bed was an apt metaphor for love. Two things I can say about my grandpa are that he is wise, and his left hand is probably cold.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Love quotes for the ages. And the ageless sages.

Quote: Atheists are my brothers and sisters of a different faith, and every word they speak speaks of faith. Like me, they go as far as the legs of reason will carry them -- and then they leap.
Author: Yann Martel

Quote: I wonder if everyone who faces death hurts like this. It's as though for the first time I realize how much just being alive makes my body ache. But I don't want that ache to stop.
Author: Shannon Hale,  Book of a Thousand Days

Quote: If you could really see that tree over there,"Merlin said, "you would be so astounded that you'd fall over.""Really? But why?"asked Arthur. "It's just a tree.""No,"Merlin said, "It's just a tree in your mind. To another mind it is an expression of infinite spirit and beauty. In God's mind it is a dear child, sweeter than anything you can imagine.
Author: Deepak Chopra,  The Way of the Wizard: Twenty Spiritual Lessons for Creating the Life You Want

Quote: Life must go on, even if it's no joke...just pretend to believe in the future.
Author: Louis-Ferdinand Céline,  North

Quote: Destiny isn't something you make as you're told. By overcoming difficulties, life and this whole world can advance forward. That's what destiny is for. A world that has lost the power to advance forward, will be destroyed - Aladdin
Author: Shinobu Ohtaka

Quote: I have realized that whatever good comes to me, comes from God, whatever bad comes to me, God has allowed it, and I choose to be thankful for both.
Author: Jeff Goins,  Wrecked: When a Broken World Slams into your Comfortable Life

Quote: It was becoming clearer and clearer that if I wanted to come to the end of my life and not say, “I’ve wasted it!” then I would need to press all the way in, and all the way up, to the ultimate purpose of God and join him in it. If my life was to have a single, all-satisfying, unifying passion, it would have to be God’s passion.
Author: John Piper,  Don't Waste Your Life

Quote: It was becoming clearer and clearer that if I wanted to come to the end of my life and not say, “I’ve wasted it!” then I would need to press all the way in, and all the way up, to the ultimate purpose of God and join him in it. If my life was to have a single, all-satisfying, unifying passion, it would have to be God’s passion.
Author: John Piper,  Don't Waste Your Life

Quote: Only God can take our failures and turn them into victories.
Author: Evinda Lepins

Quote: Belief consists in accepting the affirmations of the soul; unbelief, in denying them.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Belief consists in accepting the affirmations of the soul; unbelief, in denying them.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Belief consists in accepting the affirmations of the soul; unbelief, in denying them.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: What a comfort to know that God is a poet.
Author: Rachel Held Evans,  Evolving in Monkey Town: How a Girl Who Knew All the Answers Learned to Ask the Questions

Quote: Remember, an easy question can have an easy answer. But a hard question must have a hard answer. And for the hardest questions of all, there may be no answer - except faith.
Author: Charles Sheffield,  Brother to Dragons

Quote: Love only fails when we fail to love.
Author: Tyler Edwards,  Zombie Church: Breathing Life Back Into the Body of Christ

Quote: To be a child means to owe one's existence to another, and even in our adult life we never quite reach the point where we no longer have to give thanks for being the person we are.
Author: Hans Urs von Balthasar,  Unless You Become Like This Child

Quote: Let him who glories glory in this, That he understands and knows Me, That I am the LORD, exercising loving kindness, justice, and righteousness in the earth. For in these I delight,” says the LORD.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: New International Version

Quote: You have to believe what you're saying if you're going to convince me. I just can't break that rule, even if I want to.
Author: Ashly Lorenzana

Quote: The ancients were afraid that if they went to the end of the earth they would fall off and be consumed by dragons. But once we understand that Christianity is true to what is there, true to the ultimate environment - the infinite, personal God who is really there - then our minds are freed. We can pursue any question and can be sure that we will not fall off the end of the earth.
Author: Francis A. Schaeffer,  Art & the Bible

Quote: Thinking of death--strange, beautiful, terrible and a long way off--made me feel happier than ever.
Author: Dodie Smith,  I Capture the Castle

Quote: And believe me, a good piece of chicken can make anybody believe in the existence of God.
Author: Sherman Alexie,  The Absolutely True Diary of a Part-Time Indian

Quote: In a world plagued with commonplace tragedies, only one thing exists that truly has the power to save lives, and that is love.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Dandelions: The Disappearance of Annabelle Fancher

Quote: If you are a Buddhist, inspire yourself by thinking of the bodhisattva. If you are a Christian, think of the Christ, who came not to be served by others but to serve them in joy, in peace, and in generosity. For these things, these are not mere words, but acts, which go all the way, right up to their last breath. Even their death is a gift, and resurrection is born from this kind of death. (157)
Author: Jean-Yves Leloup,  Compassion and Meditation: The Spiritual Dynamic between Buddhism and Christianity

Quote: If you are a Buddhist, inspire yourself by thinking of the bodhisattva. If you are a Christian, think of the Christ, who came not to be served by others but to serve them in joy, in peace, and in generosity.
