Quote: Death is not an evil, because it frees us from all evils, and while it takes away good things, it takes away also the desire for them. Old age is the supreme evil, because it deprives us of all pleasures, leaving us only the appetite for them, and it brings with it all sufferings. Nevertheless, we fear death, and we desire old age.
Author: Giacomo Leopardi

Quote: A loss of any kind is horrible. Not because it takes away, but because it makes you believe- in newspapers, in tomatoes, in empty whiskey bottles.
Author: Anosh Irani,  The Cripple and His Talismans

Quote: You are not on a journey to God; you are on a journey WITH God.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: I know I'm not God, are you? Don't be silly.God? God? Everybody's God? Don't be silly.
Author: Allen Ginsberg,  Death and Fame: Last Poems, 1993-1997

Quote: Every Christian would agree that a man's spiritual health is exactly proportional to his love for God.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Four Loves

Quote: And after a while...I mean, how do you choose? Who gets to live? Part of life is that...well, some people have to die. My powers aren't a prescription you can get filled as needed.
Author: Richelle Mead,  Shadow Kiss

Quote: To look upon its grass grown yard, where the sunbeams seem to sleep so quietly, one would think that there at least the dead might rest in peace.
Author: Washington Irving,  The Legend of Sleepy Hollow

Quote: [W]hat makes patriotic and religious fanatics such dangerous opponents is not the deaths of the fanatics themselves, but their willingness to accept the deaths of a fraction of their number in order to annihilate or crush their infidel enemy.
Author: Jared Diamond,  Guns, Germs, and Steel: The Fates of Human Societies

Quote: I believe in hope, in what is something called ”radical hope.” I believe there is hope for all of us, even amid the suffering. And that’s why I write fiction, probaby. It’s my attempt to keep that fragile strand of radical hope, to buld a fire in the darkness.r
Author: John Green

Quote: I believe in hope, in what is something called ”radical hope.” I believe there is hope for all of us, even amid the suffering. And that’s why I write fiction, probaby. It’s my attempt to keep that fragile strand of radical hope, to buld a fire in the darkness.r
Author: John Green

Quote: The world is round and the place which may seem like the end may also be only the beginning.
Author: Rebecca West

Quote: He realized now he was only just beginning to see the full extent to which it was his destiny to follow, to walk blindly into fates he could never understand. In fate there was reward, in turning over one's heart to God there was a magnificence that lay beyond description. At the moment one is sure that all is lost, look at what is gained!
Author: Ann Patchett,  Bel Canto

Quote: Lihat, ini Arok, yang tetap mempertahankan Tumapel. Dia dan pasukannya akan mempertahankannya sampai titik darah terakhir. Bukan karena imbalan uang, emas dan perak dan singgasana. Hanya karena kesetiaan pada janji.
Author: Pramoedya Ananta Toer,  Arok Dedes

Quote: Any faith that does not command the one who holds it is not a real belief; it is a pseudo belief only. And it might shock some of us profoundly if we were brought suddenly face to face with our beliefs and forced to test them in the fires of practical living.
Author: A.W. Tozer,  The Root of the Righteous

Quote: إحدى يديه كانت منهمكة بالعبث في خصلات شعريوالأخرى كان ينفث بها سيجارته ،إلتقطتها منه بغضب وبإمتعاض ممقوتوهمست له : دعها تلك اللعينة فلن أسمح بأن تشاركني فيك !
Author: نجلاء حسن,  قلب صام عن هوى الرجال

Quote: إحدى يديه كانت منهمكة بالعبث في خصلات شعريوالأخرى كان ينفث بها سيجارته ،إلتقطتها منه بغضب وبإمتعاض ممقوتوهمست له : دعها تلك اللعينة فلن أسمح بأن تشاركني فيك !
Author: نجلاء حسن,  قلب صام عن هوى الرجال

Author: نجلاء حسن,  قلب صام عن هوى الرجال

Quote: It takes a lot of strength to hold onto and care for the things we love, so why is it that god seems to have made humans unable to conjure up that degree of power and love?
Author: Ai Yazawa

Quote: wonder what day god created the egg' 'how should we know? we should not question. our stay on earth is not for long. let us rejoice and believe and give thanks'. 'eat a egg
Author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Sun Also Rises

Quote: Always listen to the voice of your conscience. If your conscience conflicts with your faith, question everything.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Always listen to the voice of your conscience. If your conscience conflicts with your faith, question everything.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Always listen to the voice of your conscience. If your conscience conflicts with your faith, question everything.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: The presence of a noble nature, generous in its wishes, ardent in its charity, changes the lights for us: we begin to see things again in their larger, quieter masses, and to believe that we too can be seen and judged in the wholeness of our character.
Author: George Eliot,  Middlemarch

Quote: Despair is for people who know, beyond any doubt, what the future is going to bring. Nobody is in that position. So despair is not only a kind of sin, theologically, but also a simple mistake, because nobody actually knows. In that sense there is always hope.
Author: Patrick Curry,  Defending Middle-Earth: Tolkien: Myth and Modernity

Quote: We are all the fools of time and terror: DaysSteal on us and steal from us; yet we live,Loathing our life, and dreading still to die.
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: We are all the fools of time and terror: DaysSteal on us and steal from us; yet we live,Loathing our life, and dreading still to die.
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: Death is the Graduation of the Soul
Author: Sylvia Browne,  The Other Side and Back

Quote: As I look back on my own life, I recognize this simple truth: The greatest opportunities were the scariest lions. Part of me has wanted to play it safe, but I’ve learned that taking no risks is the greatest risk of all.
Author: Mark Batterson,  In a Pit with a Lion on a Snowy Day: How to Survive and Thrive When Opportunity Roars

Quote: Facts? What are facts? I only know imagination!
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: Your children will smash your understanding, knowledge and reality. You will be better off. Then they will leave. You'll miss them forever.
Author: Tibor Kalman

Quote: The secret of poetry is never explained - is always new. We have not got farther than mere wonder at the delicacy of the touch, & the eternity it inherits. In every house a child that in mere play utters oracles, & knows not that they are such. 'Tis as easy as breath. 'Tis like this gravity, which holds the Universe together, & none knows what it is.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: Unasked, Unsought, Love gives itself but is not bought
Author: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow,  The Complete Works of Henry Wadsworth Longfellow

Quote: I think we are in rats’ alley Where the dead men lost their bones.
Author: T.S. Eliot,  The Waste Land

Quote: The excitable observer will pass judgement first and then make knowledge conform to judgement; the prudent observer will first learn to know and then judge according to knowledge.
Author: Thomas Cleary

Quote: Everyone lives bound by their own knowledge and awareness. They define that as reality; but knowledge and awareness are vage, and perhaps better called illusions.
Author: Masashi Kishimoto

Quote: When certain parts of our bodies are touched, certain enzymes and chemicals that trigger sexual desire are released into our system. The more our bodies are stimulated, the more chemicals are released and the greater our sexual desire grows until it becomes a virtually unstoppable flood.
Author: Myles Munroe,  Waiting and Dating

Quote: It is not our job to remain whole.We came to lose our leavesLike the trees, and be born again,Drawing up from the great roots.
Author: Robert Bly

Quote: Mercy!"cried Gandalf. "If the giving of knowledge is to be the cure of your inquisitiveness, I shall spend all the rest of my days in answering you. What more should you like to know?""The names of all the stars, and of all living things, and the whole history of Middle-Earth and Over-heave and of the Sundering Seas,"laughed Pippin. "Of course! What less?
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Two Towers

Quote: Marmee: Oh, Jo. Jo, you have so many extraordinary gifts; how can you expect to lead an ordinary life? You’re ready to go out and – and find a good use for your talent. Tho’ I don’t know what I shall do without my Jo. Go, and embrace your liberty. And see what wonderful things come of it.
Author: Louisa May Alcott

Quote: Kill what you can't savewhat you can't eat throw outwhat you can't throw out buryWhat you can't bury give awaywhat you can't give away you must carry with you,it is always heavier than you thought.
Author: Margaret Atwood,  You are Happy

Quote: A relationship needs constant attention. It’s a living thing, not just a habit. You’ve got to keep on top of it.
Author: Matt Dunn,  Best Man

Quote: This is where men and women are different, we can put aside petty competition for relationships - they can't. It interferes.
Author: Adriana Trigiani,  Viola in Reel Life

Quote: I found the poems in the fields,And only wrote them down.
Author: John Clare,  The Later Poems, 1837-1864: Volumes I and II

Quote: Compassion isn't just about feeling the pain of others; it's about bringing them in toward yourself. If we love what God loves, then, in compassion, margins get erased. 'Be compassionate as God is compassionate,' means the dismantling of barriers that exclude.
Author: Gregory J. Boyle,  Tattoos on the Heart: The Power of Boundless Compassion

Quote: Dig deep and empower yourself today. Stand in your inner strength. Be uniquely you.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Happiness is a choice. Peace is a state of mind. Both are free!
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: But the world is out there, and it understands that the illusion of knowledge and freedom is not the same as the real thing. Eventually it will fade, and there are those who will do whatever it takes to make that happen sooner rather than later.
Author: Aimee Carter,  Pawn

Quote: Among the many answers I have found, I believe love is the most beautiful and simple art that reflects the beauty of life.
Author: Mabel Iam

Quote: The day he moved out was terrible – That evening she went through hell.His absence wasn’t a problemBut the corkscrew had gone as well.
Author: Wendy Cope,  Serious Concerns

Quote: Of course. You get everything from books.
Author: Gregory Maguire,  Out of Oz

Quote: It's important to have your private enjoyments because sometimes that's all we have.
Author: Kay Ryan

Quote: Your war drum ain't / louder than this breath.
Author: Suheir Hammad,  Zaatardiva

Quote: One merit of poetry few persons will deny: it says more and in fewer words than prose.
Author: Voltaire,  Philosophical Dictionary

Quote: His hands may have been the one to heal you, but it will be mine that awaken you.
Author: Charlotte Featherstone,  Sinful

Quote: Suffer love! A good ephitet! I do suffer love indeed, for I love thee against my will.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Much Ado About Nothing

Quote: Excuse me?"I said, palms down on the Formica tabletop. "Coffee? I thought we came here for pie.""I don't eat the kind of pie they serve here."I felt a flash of heat go through my stomach. I knew firsthand the kind of pie Ranger liked.
Author: Janet Evanovich,  To the Nines

Quote: I’m going to carry you now,” he told her, “so we can move even faster. I’m not asking you, I’m telling you. Any response from you is unnecessary and unwelcome.
Author: Suzanne Brockmann,  Out of Control

Quote: My house seems remarkably full of people,"he observed. "Is it possible we were expected.
Author: Georgette Heyer,  These Old Shades

Quote: And to think of all the colors in the world, blood chose to be red.
Author: Nelou Keramati

Quote: If I have to 'catch' a man to get a husband, I don't want one.
Author: Tamora Pierce,  Shatterglass

Quote: I read anything that’s going to be interesting. But you don’t know what it is until you’ve read it. Somewhere in a book on the history of false teeth there’ll be the making of a novel.
Author: Terry Pratchett

Quote: It's often a matter of sitting in front of the computer and worrying. It's what writing comes down to--worrying that things aren't going to work out.
Author: Khaled Hosseini

Quote: It's often a matter of sitting in front of the computer and worrying. It's what writing comes down to--worrying that things aren't going to work out.
Author: Khaled Hosseini

Quote: Writing is an affair of yearning for great voyages and hauling on frayed ropes.
Author: Israel Shenker

Quote: What is lovely never dies, but passes into other loveliness, Star-dust, or sea-foam, flower or winged air.
Author: Thomas Bailey Aldrich

Quote: There is a power that can be created out of pent-up indignation, courage, and the inspiration of a common cause, and that if enough people put their minds and bodies into that cause, they can win. It is a phenomenon recorded again and against in the history of popular movements against injustice all over the world.
Author: Howard Zinn,  You Can't Be Neutral on a Moving Train: A Personal History of Our Times

Quote: The words were unexpected, but so incisively true. So much of prayer is like that - an encounter with a truth that has sunk to the bottom of the heart, that wants to be found, wants to be spoken, wants to be elevated into the realm of sacredness.
Author: Sue Monk Kidd,  Traveling With Pomegranates: A Mother-Daughter Story

Quote: I write only when inspiration strikes. Fortunately it strikes every morning at nine o'clock sharp.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham

Quote: نجد أن الفن الحداثي يزداد ابهاما وتعقيدا حتى اصبح فنا نخبويا رغم ثورته على البرجوازية
Author: عبد الوهاب المسيري,  اللغة والمجاز بين التوحيد ووحدة الوجود

Quote: True beauty radiates not from outer cosmetics, but from the simple joy of making a difference for those that need your voice, passion, and time without expecting or wanting anything in return...
Author: Deborah Barnes

Quote: Déjà vu is more than just that fleeting moment of surprise, instantly forgotten because we never bother with things that make no sense. It show that time doesn't pass. It's a leap into something we have already experienced and that is being repeated.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  Aleph

Quote: Writing comes more easily if you have something to say.
Author: Sholem Asch

Quote: When you reduce a woman to writing, she makes you think of a thousand other women
Author: Gustave Flaubert

Quote: Roam abroad in the world, and take thy fill of its enjoyments before the day shall come when thou must quit it for good.
Author: Saadi

Quote: ugd بگذار هرکجا تنفراست بذرعشق بکارم هرکجا آزادگی هست ببخشایم وهر کجا غم هست شادی نثار کنم الهی توفیقم ده که بیش ازطلب همدلی همدلی کنم بیش از آنکه دوستم بدارند دوست بدارم زیرا در عطا کردن است که ستوده می شویم و در بخشیدن است که بخشیده می شویم
Author: Ali Shariati

Quote: Recognize that throughout this beautiful day,you have an incredible amount of opportunities to move your life into the direction you want it to go.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Recognize that throughout this beautiful day,you have an incredible amount of opportunities to move your life into the direction you want it to go.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Your daily life is your temple and your religion. When you enter into it take with you your all.
Author: Kahlil Gibran

Quote: Would you like to know the great drama of my life? It is that I have put my genius into my life...I have put only my talent into my works.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: My perfect day is sitting in a room with some blank paper. That's heaven. That's gold and anything else is just a waste of time.
Author: Cormac McCarthy

Quote: it is interesting to find that people of faith now seek defensively to say that they are no worse than fascists or Nazis or Stalinists
Author: Christopher Hitchens,  God Is Not Great: How Religion Poisons Everything

Quote: There certainly was some great mismanagement in the education of those two young men. One has got all the goodness, and the other all the appearance of it.
Author: Jane Austen,  Pride and Prejudice

Quote: Don't waste your time hating a failure. Failure is a greater teacher than success. Listen, learn, go on.
Author: Clarissa Pinkola Estés,  Women Who Run With the Wolves: Myths and Stories of the Wild Woman Archetype

Quote: Education is not confined to books, and the finest characters often graduate from no college, but make experience their master, and life their book. [Some care] only for the mental culture, and [are] in danger of over-studying, under the delusion . . . that learning must be had at all costs, forgetting that health and real wisdom are better.
Author: Louisa May Alcott,  Jo's Boys

Quote: I urge you to examine in your own mind the assumptions which must lay behind using the police power to insist that once-sovereign spirits have no choice but to submit to being schooled by strangers.
Author: John Taylor Gatto

Quote: Science is an attempt, largely successful, to understand the world, to get a grip on things, to get hold of ourselves, to steer a safe course. Microbiology and meteorology now explain what only a few centuries ago was considered sufficient cause to burn women to death.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

Quote: Science is an attempt, largely successful, to understand the world, to get a grip on things, to get hold of ourselves, to steer a safe course. Microbiology and meteorology now explain what only a few centuries ago was considered sufficient cause to burn women to death.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

Quote: Success is a decision, not a gift.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: The purpose of school should not be to prepare students for more school. We should be seeking to have fully engaged students now.
Author: Donalyn Miller,  The Book Whisperer: Awakening the Inner Reader in Every Child

Quote: What is the matter with universities is that the students are school children, whereas it is of the very essence of university education that they should be adults.
Author: George Bernard Shaw,  Misalliance

Quote: A great memory does not make a mind, any more than a dictionary is a piece of literature.
Author: John Henry Newman

Quote: Becoming well known (at least among your prospects & connections) is the most valuable element in the connection process.
Author: Jeffrey Gitomer

Quote: Far from failing in its intended task, our educational system is in fact succeeding magnificently because its aim is to keep the American people thoughtless enough to go on supporting the system.
Author: Richard Mitchell

Quote: She has often felt that her outsides were too dull for her insides, that deep within her there was something better than what everyone else could see.
Author: Myla Goldberg,  Bee Season

Quote: The weaker mind reacts.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Success has always been the greatest liar - and the "work"itself is a success; the great statesman, the conqueror, the discoverer is disguised by his creations, often beyond recognition; the "work,"whether of the artist or the philosopher, invents the man who has created it, who is supposed to have create it; "great men,"as they are venerated, are subsequent pieces of wretched minor fiction
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Beyond Good and Evil

Quote: If we lose all of our wealth and are only left with love then, indeed, we shall never be poor.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: It was ironic, but when you scratched the surface, most successful men were working for one thing only--to retire--and the sooner the better. Whereas women were the complete opposite. She had never heard a woman say she was working so she could retire to a desert island or to live on a boat. It was probably, she thought, because most women didn't think they deserved to do nothing.
Author: Candace Bushnell,  Lipstick Jungle

Quote: Erase self-doubt by working to build your strengths instead of focusing on your weaknesses.
Author: Rodolfo Costa,  Advice My Parents Gave Me: and Other Lessons I Learned from My Mistakes

Quote: There is no point in getting rich if we lose our soul along the way.
Author: Farahad Zama,  The Marriage Bureau for Rich People

Quote: Where does your soul go, when you die in Hell?
Author: Ursula K. Le Guin,  The Dispossessed

Quote: لن تتحرروا منا إلا حينما تتعلمون كيف تسعون على أقدامكم ، وكيف تجعلون عقولكم أعلى ما فيكم ؛ أغلى ما فيكم
Author: حياة الياقوت,  ألس في بلاد الواق واق! رواية ليست للصغار

Quote: A man who fails well is greater than one who succeeds badly.
Author: Thomas Merton,  No Man Is an Island

Quote: Acknowledgement is possession. When you acknowledge, think or have conviction in something, it actually will come true.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Deux choses sont infinies : l’Univers et la bêtise humaine. Mais, en ce qui concerne l’Univers, je n’en ai pas encore acquis la certitude absolue.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: The neural processes underlying that which we call creativity have nothing to do with rationality. That is to say, if we look at how the brain generates creativity, we will see that it is not a rational process at all; creativity is not born out of reasoning.
Author: Rodolfo R. Llinás,  I of the Vortex: From Neurons to Self

Quote: However much you study, you cannot know without action. A donkey laden with books is neither an intellectual nor a wise man. Empty of essence, what learning has he whether upon him is firewood or book?
Author: Saadi

Quote: Science never solves a problem without creating ten more
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: We ought not to ask why the human mind troubles to fathom the secrets of the universe. The diversity of the phenomena of nature is so great, and the treasures hidden in the skies so rich, precisely in order that the human mind shall never be lacking in fresh nourishment.
Author: Johannes Kepler

Quote: Limitations are like mirages created by your own mind. When you realise that limitation do not exist, those around you will also feel it and allow you inside their space.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: I would remind you to notice where the claim of consensus is invoked. Consensus is invoked only in situations where the science is not solid enough. Nobody says the consensus of scientists agrees that E=mc2. Nobody says the consensus is that the sun is 93 million miles away. It would never occur to anyone to speak that way.
Author: Michael Crichton

Quote: There is no such things as magic, though there is such a thing as knowledge of the hidden ways of Nature.
Author: H. Rider Haggard,  She

Quote: I guess I'm just an old mad scientist at bottom. Give me an underground laboratory, half a dozen atom-smashers, and a beautiful girl in a diaphanous veil waiting to be turned into a chimpanzee, and I care not who writes the nation's laws.
Author: S.J. Perelman

Quote: The most accessible field in science, from the point of view of language, is astrophysics. What do you call spots on the sun? Sunspots. Regions of space you fall into and you don’t come out of? Black holes. Big red stars? Red giants. So I take my fellow scientists to task. He’ll use his word, and if I understand it, I’ll say, “Oh, does that mean da-da-da-de-da?
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

Quote: The basic idea is that all things in the universe are intertwined.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: Whatever belief we have actually stems from the thankfulness that we feel and this feeling further attracts more happy feelings towards us.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Winning is great, but if it's not enough then then you'll never have enough!
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: Anyone who values truth should stop worshipping reason.
Author: Jonathan Haidt,  The Righteous Mind: Why Good People are Divided by Politics and Religion

Quote: But when nothing in your life happens in a positive frame, it is difficult to think positively and hope for the best.
Author: Faraaz Kazi

Quote: The fundamental claim of intelligent design is straightforward and easily intelligible: namely, there are natural systems that cannot be adequately explained in terms of undirected natural forces and that exhibit features which in any other circumstance we would attribute to intelligence.
Author: William A. Dembski,  The Design Revolution: Answering the Toughest Questions about Intelligent Design

Quote: It hardly matters why a library is destroyed: every banning, curtailment, shredding, plunder or loot gives rise (at least as a ghostly presence) to a louder, clearer, more durable library of the banned, looted, plundered, shredded or curtailed.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: Can all this just be an accident? Or could there be some alien intelligence behind it?
Author: Gene Roddenberry

Quote: There’s no way you can kill someone and get to the other side of the experience unchanged.
Author: Charlaine Harris,  Definitely Dead

Quote: He who wears his morality but as his best garment were better naked.The wind and the sun will tear no holes in his skin.
Author: Kahlil Gibran,  The Prophet

Quote: Do you think you wear a mask?’‘I’m wearing one right now.’ Valentino smiled softly. ‘We both are.’‘It’s a sad thought.’‘Yes,’ he said. ‘But sometimes I wonder about the alternative. Imagine if we had no secrets, no respite from the truth. What if everything was laid bare the moment we introduced ourselves?
Author: Catherine Doyle,  Vendetta

Quote: There is not much to be got anywhere in the world. It is filled with misery and pain; if a man escapes these, boredeom lies in wait for him at every corner. Nay more; it is evil which generally has the upper hand, and folly that makes the most noise. Fate is cruel and mankind pitiable.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer,  The Wisdom of Life

Quote: و هل وقت الفلسفه الا عندما تستعصى حلول الاشياء؟!
Author: توفيق الحكيم,  براكسا أو مشكلة الحكم

Quote: If you spend time with crazy and dangerous people, remember – their personalities are socially transmitted diseases; like water poured into a container, most of us eventually turn into – or remain – whoever we surround ourselves with. We can choose our tribe, but we cannot change that our tribe is our destiny.
Author: Stefan Molyneux

Quote: If the emotions are free the intellect will look after itself
Author: A.S. Neill

Quote: If the emotions are free the intellect will look after itself
Author: A.S. Neill

Quote: Philosophy is the toil which can never tire persons engaged in it. All ways are strewn with roses, and the farther you go, the more enchanting objects appear before you and invite you on.
Author: Mary Wortley Montagu

Quote: Philosophy is the toil which can never tire persons engaged in it. All ways are strewn with roses, and the farther you go, the more enchanting objects appear before you and invite you on.
Author: Mary Wortley Montagu

Quote: Mathematicians finally developed a financial model to accurately compare apples and oranges. Any two kinds of fruit can be compared, although guavas still cause minor rounding errors.
Author: Graham Parke,  No Hope for Gomez!

Quote: It was only after two years' work that it occurred to me that I was a writer. I had no particular expectation that the novel would ever be published, because it was sort of a mess. It was only when I found myself writing things I didn't realise I knew that I said, 'I'm a writer now.' The novel had become an incentive to deeper thinking. That's really what writing is—an intense form of thought.
Author: Don DeLillo

Quote: The ethos of redemption is realied in self-mastery, by means of temperance, that is, continence of desires.
Author: Pope John Paul II,  Blessed Are the Pure of Heart: Catechesis on the Sermon on the Mount and Writings of St. Paul

Quote: In truth, Freud sees nothing and understands nothing.
Author: Gilles Deleuze,  A Thousand Plateaus: Capitalism and Schizophrenia

Quote: God has abandoned you. Fear does not serve you. Your heart has betrayed you. Only the music can guide you.
Author: Noah Levine

Quote: Try for once to justify the meaning of your existence as it were a posteriori by setting yourself an aim, a goal... an exalted and noble 'to this end.' Perish in pursuit of this and only this
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Untimely Meditations

Quote: لو قال كل إنسان ما يفكر فيه بصدق فإن الحوار بين البشر يصبح قصيراً جداً.
Author: كونفوشيوس

Quote: And now we step to the rhythm of miracles.--from The Light, That Never Dies
Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Quote: And now we step to the rhythm of miracles.--from The Light, That Never Dies
Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Quote: It's not oil that runs the world, it's shame.
Author: Sherman Alexie,  War Dances

Quote: The youth gets together his materials to build a bridge to the moon, or, perchance, a palace or temple on the earth, and, at length, the middle-aged man concludes to build a woodshed with them.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: The youth gets together his materials to build a bridge to the moon, or, perchance, a palace or temple on the earth, and, at length, the middle-aged man concludes to build a woodshed with them.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: People talk to old people like they're children.'Oh you're very old aren't you?' Yeah I'm old. I'm not stupid.
Author: Craig Ferguson

Quote: Veganism is an act of nonviolent defiance. It is our statement that we reject the notion that animals are things and that we regard sentient nonhumans as moral persons with the fundamental moral right not to be treated as the property or resources of humans.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: All things, even the deepest sorrow or the most profound happiness are all temporary. Hope is fuel for the soul, without hope, forward motion ceases.
Author: Landon Parham,  First Night of Summer

Quote: All things, even the deepest sorrow or the most profound happiness are all temporary. Hope is fuel for the soul, without hope, forward motion ceases.
Author: Landon Parham,  First Night of Summer

Author: Landon Parham,  First Night of Summer

Quote: These men are worth your tears. You are not worth their merriment.
Author: Wilfred Owen,  The Poems Of Wilfred Owen

Quote: But neither infinite power nor infinite wisdom could bestow godhood upon men. For that there would have to be infinite love as well.
Author: Walter M. Miller Jr.,  A Canticle for Leibowitz

Quote: Once a wolf, always a wolf.
Author: Aesop,  Aesop's Fables

Quote: If you are a dreamer, come in,If you are a dreamer, a wisher, a liar,A hope-er, a pray-er, a magic bean buyer...If you're a pretender, come sit by my fireFor we have some flax-golden tales to spin. Come in!Come in!
Author: Shel Silverstein

Quote: Nico knew something about ghosts. Letting them get inside your head was dangerous. He wanted to help Reyna, but since his own strategy was to deal with his problems alone, spurning anyone who tried to get close, he couldn’t exactly criticize Reyna for doing the same thing.
Author: Rick Riordan,  The Blood of Olympus

Quote: The past is our definition. We may strive with good reason to escape it or to escape what is bad in it but we will escape it only by adding something better to it.
Author: Wendell Berry

Quote: Losing an illusion makes you wiser than finding a truth.
Author: Ludwig Börne

Quote: The man with toothache thinks everyone happy whose teeth are sound.The poverty stricken man makes the same mistake about the rich man.
Author: George Bernard Shaw

Quote: While Owen and Miles talk sports, I people watch. And this is what I see: teenagers trying to act like adults. Or how they think adults act. But mostly they look ridiculous, and I wonder what they don't want to do something that's more fun than drinking, smoking, flirting, and making out. Why are those activities considered to be fun?
Author: Melody Carlson,  Just Another Girl

Quote: In fact, the truth cannot be communicated until it is perceived.
Author: Percy Bysshe Shelley,  The Necessity of Atheism and Other Essays

Quote: Truth is handsomer than the affectation of love. Your goodness must have some edge to it--else it is none.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: There is a tragic clash between Truth and the world. Pure undistorted truth burns up the world.
Author: Nikolai A. Berdyaev

Quote: Honest, open communication is the only street that leads us into the real world... We then begin to grow as never before. And once we are on this road, happiness cannot be far away.
Author: John Powell,  Will the Real Me Please Stand Up?: 25 Guidelines for Good Communication

Quote: I drink to the general joy o’ the whole table."Macbeth
Author: William Shakespeare,  Macbeth

Quote: Unhappiness is caused when we cannot let go of our memories.
Author: Jed Rubenfeld,  The Interpretation of Murder

Quote: True virtue never appears so lovely as when it is most oppressed; and the divine excellency of real Christianity is never exhibited with such advantage as when under the greatest trials; then it is that true faith appears much more precious than gold, and upon this account is "found to praise and honour and glory.
Author: Jonathan Edwards,  The Religious Affections

Quote: Death! Strange that there should be such a word, and such a thing, and we ever forget it; that one should be living, warm and beautiful, full of hopes, desires and wants, one day, and the next be gone, utterly gone, and forever!
Author: Harriet Beecher Stowe,  Uncle Tom's Cabin

Quote: And starward drifts the stricken world,Lone in unalterable gloomDead, with a universe for tomb,Dark, and to vaster darkness whirled.(“The Testimony of the Suns”)
Author: George Sterling,  The Thirst of Satan: Poems of Fantasy and Terror

Quote: Sometimes thatwhich we fearstrengthens ourspirit and givesus a splashof hope.
Author: Harley King

Quote: I'm pretty much looking for beauty all the time. It just seems like some days the light is better to see it.
Author: Melodie Ramone

Quote: I'm pretty much looking for beauty all the time. It just seems like some days the light is better to see it.
Author: Melodie Ramone

Quote: Miracles were just second chances if you really thought about it--second chances when all hope was lost.
Author: Kaya McLaren,  How I Came to Sparkle Again

Quote: Remember: He WANTS your fellowship, and He has done everything possible to make it a reality. He has forgiven your sins, at the cost of His own dear Son. He has given you His Word, and the priceless privilege of prayer and worship.
Author: Billy Graham,  Hope for Each Day: Words of Wisdom and Faith

Quote: ‎Mark it down: God loves you with an unearthly love. You can't win it by being winsome. You can't lose it by being a loser. But you can be blind enough to resist it
Author: Max Lucado

Quote: When your only regret is if anyone thinks you regret anything - that is the definition of conviction.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: The geometry of judgment is a circle. Hate is a snake that turns to consume itself from the tail, a circle that diminishes to a point, then to nothing. Pride is such a snake, and envy, and greed. Love, however, is a hoop, a wheel, that rolls on forever. We are rescued by those whom we have rescued. The saved become the saviors of their saviors.
Author: Dean Koontz,  The Darkest Evening of the Year

Quote: Two lost things that had survived the seas and arrived on a coastline. What did they do? They implanted themselves in the sand and grew into trees and lined the beaches. Sometimes a lot can come of being all washed up. You can really grow.
Author: Cecelia Ahern,  The Book of Tomorrow

Quote: To me, God is like this happy bus driver.
Author: Jerry Stahl,  Permanent Midnight

Quote: My God is love and sweetly suffers all.
Author: Sri Aurobindo,  Savitri: A Legend and a Symbol

Quote: Obedience, fasting, and prayer are laughed at, yet only through them lies the way to real true freedom. I cut off my superfluous and unnecessary desires, I subdue my proud and wanton will and chastise it with obedience, and with God's help I attain freedom of spirit and with it spiritual joy.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

Quote: Hope is the greatest madness. What can we expect of a world that we enter with the assurance of seeing our fathers and mothers die? A world where, if two beings love each other and give their lives to each other, both can be sure that one will watch the other perish?
Author: Alfred de Vigny,  Stello

Quote: Hope is the greatest madness. What can we expect of a world that we enter with the assurance of seeing our fathers and mothers die? A world where, if two beings love each other and give their lives to each other, both can be sure that one will watch the other perish?

Quote: because it seemed too simple to accept that life was an act of faith.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  Veronika Decides to Die

Quote: Gratitude bestows reverence, allowing us to encounter everyday epiphanies, those transcendent moments of awe that change forever how we experience life and the world.
Author: Sarah Ban Breathnach

Quote: Take faith, for example. For many people in our world, the opposite of faith is doubt. The goal, then, within this understanding, is to eliminate doubt. But faith and doubt aren't opposites. Doubt is often a sign that your faith has a pulse, that it's alive and well and exploring and searching. Faith and doubt aren't opposites, they are, it turns out, excellent dance partners.
Author: Rob Bell,  What We Talk about When We Talk about God

Quote: Spirituality is not about being fixed; it is about God's being present in the mess of our unfixedness. (Messy Spirituality)
Author: Mike Yaconelli

Quote: Every worldview has to bring together reason and faith.
Author: Ravi Zacharias

Quote: Anything beyond the limits and grasp of the human mind is either illusion or futility; and because your god having to be one or the other of the two, in the first instance I should be mad to believe in him, and in the second a fool.
Author: Marquis de Sade

Quote: Tonight I saw myself in the dark window asthe image of my father, whose lifewas spent like this,thinking of death, to the exclusionof other sensual matters,so in the end that lifewas easy to give up, sinceit contained nothing: evenmy mother's voice couldn't make himchange or turn backas he believedthat once you can't love another human beingyou have no place in the world.
Author: Louise Glück

Quote: Please don't die.
Author: Randy Pausch,  The Last Lecture

Quote: Please don't die.
Author: Randy Pausch,  The Last Lecture

Quote: Girls are always saying things like, “I’m so unhappy that I’m going to overdose on aspirin,” but they’d be awfully surprised if they succeeded. They have no intention of dying. At the first sight of blood, they panic.
Author: Rachel Klein,  The Moth Diaries

Quote: How could I live above the water or breathe under it. How could I swim in darkness consumed in an ocean of you? Falling or flying towards you, losing or finding myself in you and beauty was never the word to catch all that you are. For now I know the means of the infinite and it all starts and ends with you.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: That we must all die, we always knew; I wish I had remembered it sooner.
Author: Samuel Johnson

Quote: I believe that more people would be alive today if there were a death penalty.
Author: Nancy Reagan

Quote: Hope and reality lie in inverse proportions, inside the walls of a hospital... Doubt is like dye. Once is spreads into the fabric of excuses you've woven, you'll never get rid of the stain.
Author: Jodi Picoult,  Lone Wolf

Quote: I challenge you to make your life the masterpiece you want to paint, the novel you want to read, the day you want to wake to.
Author: Toni Sorenson

Quote: Unless their use by readers bring them to life, books are indeed dead things.
Author: Lawrence Clark Powell

Quote: Unless their use by readers bring them to life, books are indeed dead things.
Author: Lawrence Clark Powell

Quote: At the end of the day I went to this place where your memories left footsteps on my skin and the breath of your touch stained my desire. Yea, it was one of those nights where I needed you the most.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: <…> God is a person; godliness is a quality. You cannot become God, but you can be godly. <...>
Author: Osho

Quote: But no matter how much evil I see, I think it’s important for everyone to understand that there is much more light than darkness.
Author: Robert Uttaro,  To the Survivors

Quote: But no matter how much evil I see, I think it’s important for everyone to understand that there is much more light than darkness.
Author: Robert Uttaro,  To the Survivors

Quote: Faith is about going through hell, coming out with some scars, and becoming a wiser person from the lessons you’ve learned along the way. You must take the scars of your past and appreciate them for what they have taught you. You also have to take the scars, the lessons of your past and not let them control your future….
Author: James A. Murphy,  The Waves of Life Quotes and Daily Meditations

Quote: Regardless of your faith, you can never escape uncertainty.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: Whoever possesses God in their being has Him in a divine manner, and He shines out to them in all things; for them all things taste of God and in all things it is God's image that they see.
Author: Meister Eckhart

Quote: Whoever possesses God in their being has Him in a divine manner, and He shines out to them in all things; for them all things taste of God and in all things it is God's image that they see.
Author: Meister Eckhart

Quote: No one can serve two masters. Either he will hate the one and love the other, or he will be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve both God and Money.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: Where there is a Key, there is yet hope.
Author: Catherynne M. Valente,  The Girl Who Circumnavigated Fairyland in a Ship of Her Own Making

Quote: The highest prize we can receive for creative work is the joy of being creative. Creative effort spent for any other reason than the joy of being in that light filled space, love, god, whatever we want to call it, is lacking in integrity. . .
Author: Marianne Williamson

Quote: Feet sandaled with dreams tread paths of vision leading to wisdom’s sharp peaks.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: Feet sandaled with dreams tread paths of vision leading to wisdom’s sharp peaks.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: Feet sandaled with dreams tread paths of vision leading to wisdom’s sharp peaks.
Author: Aberjhani,  The River of Winged Dreams

Quote: Do you think it is a vain hope that one day man will find joy in noble deeds of light and mercy, rather than in the coarse pleasures he indulges in today -- gluttony, fornication, ostentation, boasting, and envious vying with his neighbor? I am certain this is not a vain hope and that the day will come soon.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  The Brothers Karamazov

Quote: The beauty of a fragment is that it still supports the hope of brilliant completeness.
Author: Tobias Wolff,  Old School

Quote: For our people, butterflies are a symbol of hope. It's said that if you capture one in your hands and whisper your dreams to it, it will carry them up to the heavens so that the wish can be granted.
Author: Sherrilyn Kenyon,  Retribution

Quote: In honor of Oprah Winfrey: Even greater than the ability to inspire others with hope is the power to motivate them to give as much to the lives of others as they would give to their own; and to empower them to confront the worst in themselves in order to discover and claim the best in themselves.
Author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

Quote: In honor of Oprah Winfrey: Even greater than the ability to inspire others with hope is the power to motivate them to give as much to the lives of others as they would give to their own; and to empower them to confront the worst in themselves in order to discover and claim the best in themselves.

Quote: Now how can anybody look at that and not believe in God? I mean, how can anybody look at this and not believe there is some higher power, some divine force at work in the universe greater than Man, some god that created it, that created all this, that created us?
Author: Katharine Hepburn

Quote: Each day gives the opportunity for you to be treated right, to feel worthy, and to be successful. It’s a choice you have to make, a faith you have to embrace, and a standard you have to set.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Each day gives the opportunity for you to be treated right, to feel worthy, and to be successful. It’s a choice you have to make, a faith you have to embrace, and a standard you have to set.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: But we all suffer. For we all prize and love; and in this present existence of ours, prizing and loving yield suffering. Love in our world is suffering love. Some do not suffer much, though, for they do not love much. Suffering is for the loving. This, said Jesus, is the command of the Holy One: "You shall love your neighbor as yourself."In commanding us to love, God invites us to suffer.
Author: Nicholas Wolterstorff,  Lament for a Son

Quote: Shapeshifting requires the ability to transcend your attachments, in particular your ego attachments to identity and who you are. If you can get over your attachment to labeling yourself and your cherishing of your identity, you can be virtually anybody. You can slip in and out of different shells, even different animal forms or deity forms.
Author: Zeena Schreck

Quote: It's not whether your glass is empty or full, it's what you do with it that really matters.
Author: Sue Nelson Buckley

Quote: Knowledge is in the end based on acknowledgement.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

Quote: Someone needs to fight,someone needs to sacrifice, someone needs to inspire, someone needs to be a hero.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: If it were customary to send little girls to school and teach them the same subjects as are taught to boys, they would learn just as fully and would understand the subtleties of all arts and sciences.
Author: Christine de Pizan,  The Book of the City of Ladies

Quote: If it were customary to send little girls to school and teach them the same subjects as are taught to boys, they would learn just as fully and would understand the subtleties of all arts and sciences.
Author: Christine de Pizan,  The Book of the City of Ladies

Quote: A birth-date is a reminder to celebrate the life as well as to update the life.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: It takes writing a billion bad words before you get to the good ones.
Author: Ray Bradbury

Quote: Sometimes you're not ready to give the world quite what it wants. And that's okay, because the Earth is generously patient.
Author: Jaree Francis

Quote: Who you are contributes to your poetry in a number of important ways, but you shouldn't identify with your poems so closely that when they are cut, you're the one that bleeds.
Author: Dorianne Laux,  The Poet's Companion: A Guide To The Pleasures Of Writing Poetry

Quote: Who you are contributes to your poetry in a number of important ways, but you shouldn't identify with your poems so closely that when they are cut, you're the one that bleeds.
Author: Dorianne Laux,  The Poet's Companion: A Guide To The Pleasures Of Writing Poetry

Quote: O words are poor receipts for what time hath stole away
Author: John Clare,  Poems Chiefly from Manuscript

Quote: The true poem rests between the words.
Author: Vanna Bonta,  Shades Of The World

Quote: The true poem rests between the words.
Author: Vanna Bonta,  Shades Of The World

Quote: Many things that don't really mean so much of anything, are wonderful.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: They knew many things but had no idea why. And strangely this made them more, rather than less, certain that they were right.
Author: Neal Stephenson,  Anathem

Quote: She asked me if I was seeing anybody else, and I said, No, the other woman is invisible.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: She asked me if I was seeing anybody else, and I said, No, the other woman is invisible.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: That which others hear or read of, I felt and practised myself; they get their knowledge by books, I mine by melancholizing.
Author: Robert Burton,  The Anatomy of Melancholy

Quote: I could not love thee, Dear, so much, Loved I not Honour more.
Author: Richard Lovelace,  The Lucasta Poems

Quote: all appears to change when we change
Author: Henri-Frédéric Amiel

Quote: Librarians are tour-guides for all of knowledge.
Author: Patrick Ness

Quote: Every word was once a poem.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: I see your picture and in that picture I didn't see you.
Author: Santosh Kalwar,  Obscurity

Quote: A FEATHER.A feather is trimmed, it is trimmed by the light and the bug and the post, it is trimmed by little leaning and by all sorts of mounted reserves and loud volumes. It is surely cohesive.
Author: Gertrude Stein,  Tender Buttons

Quote: The ambitions are wake up, breathe, keep breathing.
Author: Nicole Blackman,  Blood Sugar

Quote: Far away, our dreams have nothing to do with what we do. The wind carries the night, and passes on, aimless.
Author: Mahmoud Darwish,  Absent Presence

Quote: And medecine, law, business, engineering, these are noble pursuits and necessary to sustain life. But poetry, beauty, romance, love: these are what we stay alive for.
Author: Tom Schulman,  Dead Poets Society

Quote: I wanted the past to go away, I wantedto leave it, like another country; I wantedmy life to close, and openlike a hinge, like a wing, like the part of the songwhere it fallsdown over the rocks: an explosion, a discovery;I wantedto hurry into the work of my life; I wanted to know,whoever I was, I wasalivefor a little while.
Author: Mary Oliver,  Dream Work

Quote: Unconditional love is the greatest gift we can ever give.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Rewards await you if you stay steadfast in your faith.
Author: Joel Osteen,  It's Your Time: Activate Your Faith, Accomplish Your Dreams, and Increase in God's Favor

Quote: Your dreams are worth it. Persevere. Your focus is your power. Harness it.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: All children are atheists, they have no idea of God.
Author: Paul Henri Thiry d'Holbach,  System of Nature

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... You turned red, then green, and then blue. You told me you were trying to fit in with the m&m's.
Author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: Wearing a condom is like eating an icecream cone with a sock on your tongue.
Author: Mark Gungor

Quote: This is the city, and I am one of the citizens/Whatever interests the rest interests me
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: Patti told me that to truly love someone ,you must hold them in a open hand.That was how I needed to love Kai. It was necessary to uncurl my fingers and let him go
Author: Wendy Higgins,  Sweet Evil

Quote: You're the one who made it seem like we were doing something wrong. Maybe you still feel like that, because for whatever reason, you think I'm not good enough for you. But I like you, okay? I've liked you from the very beginning.""It was never going anywhere""Because you wouldn't let it go anywhere.
Author: Siobhan Vivian,  Not That Kind of Girl

Quote: For this was the round of love: fear which leads on desire, tenderness and fury, and that brutal anguish which triumphantly follows pleasure.
Author: Françoise Sagan,  Bonjour tristesse

Quote: Sam…”“What?” she whispered.“Tell me what to do to fix it.”She shook her head and closed her eyes as though she couldn’t bear to see him. “You can’t fix it.”He had to. Failure here was not an option. “Let me try.
Author: Kaylea Cross,  No Turning Back

Quote: Foolishly romantic, yeah, sure, maybe: but she'd rather have dreams of Prince Charming than the reality of Mr. Wrong.
Author: Lisa Cach,  Wake Unto Me

Quote: If the fate of the universe was decided in a single moment at the instant of the Big Bang , that was the most creative moment of all.
Author: Deepak Chopra

Quote: Writing is the thing that props me up.
Author: Horton Foote

Quote: whatever you dobe gentle with yourself.you don’t just livein this worldor your homeor your skin.you also livein someone’s eyes.
Author: Sanober Khan

Quote: Every production of an artist should be the expression of an adventure of his soul.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham,  The Summing Up

Quote: Every production of an artist should be the expression of an adventure of his soul.
Author: W. Somerset Maugham,  The Summing Up

Quote: I don't see,' I said, 'how people stand being old. Your insides all dry up. When you're young you're so self-reliant. You don't even need much religion.
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: Some lean back. But those who lean forward are poised to cross the finish-line, first!
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: I use a whole lot of half-assed semicolons; there was one of them just now; that was a semicolon after 'semicolons,' and another one after 'now.
Author: Ursula K. Le Guin

Quote: At dawn of man, many words of inspiration.At the end, there will be words of revelation.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Perseverance is the act of true role models and heroes.
Author: Liza M. Wiemer

Quote: Change is not what we expect from religious people. They tend to love the past more than the present or the future.
Author: Richard Rohr,  Falling Upward: A Spirituality for the Two Halves of Life

Quote: Optimists enrich the present, enhance the future,challenge the improbable and attain the impossible
Author: William Arthur Ward

Quote: We make our own truths and lies....Truths are often lies and lies truths...
Author: Bernhard Schlink

Quote: The tension between what is, and what we dream of, is important. Not to discount what we have, but to hold onto that middle ground, because it's in there that the magic happens.
Author: Susan Branch

Quote: La vie est une aventure audacieuse ou alors elle n'est rien.
Author: Helen Keller

Quote: Jehovah's Witness are welcomed into my home...You gotta respect anybody who gets all dressed up in Sunday clothes and goes door-to-door on days so hot their high heels sink a half-inch into the pavement.The trick is to do all the talking yourself. Pretty soon, they'll look at their watches and say, 'Speaking of end times, wouldja look at what time it is now!
Author: Celia Rivenbark,  Bless Your Heart, Tramp: And Other Southern Endearments

Quote: I writeNotFor the sake of gloryNot For the sake of fameNotFor the sake of successBut for the sake of my soul
Author: Beth Nimmo,  Rachel's Tears: The Spiritual Journey of Columbine Martyr Rachel Scott

Quote: I writeNotFor the sake of gloryNot For the sake of fameNotFor the sake of successBut for the sake of my soul
Author: Beth Nimmo,  Rachel's Tears: The Spiritual Journey of Columbine Martyr Rachel Scott

Quote: I bet there are a lot of women out there who want to sleep with a guy who reads. And being the head of the reading foundation, I’m very well endowed.
Author: Bauvard,  Some Inspiration for the Overenthusiastic

Quote: And ever, as the story drainedThe wells of fancy dry,And faintly strove that weary oneTo put the subject by,"The rest next time--""It is next time!"The Happy voice cry.Thus grew the tale of Wonderland
Author: Lewis Carroll,  Alice's Adventures in Wonderland & Through the Looking-Glass

Quote: Laws of nature have no physical properties of mass /energy. They are platonic truths in transcendent realm that create & govern the Universe.
Author: Deepak Chopra

Quote: Laws of nature have no physical properties of mass /energy. They are platonic truths in transcendent realm that create & govern the Universe.
Author: Deepak Chopra

Quote: To me, religion is about our dignity, not our depravity.
Author: Yann Martel

Quote: I am writing in the garden. To write as one should of a garden one must write not outside it or merely somewhere near it, but in the garden.
Author: Frances Hodgson Burnett

Quote: He prays because he knows he doesn't control it. He's at the mercy of it.
Author: Michael Crichton,  Jurassic Park

Quote: I’m famous for my Shepherd’s Pie. Here’s my recipe: lamb, potatoes, cheese, peas, paprika, and a wool-covered apron for the chef/shepherd/wolf-like politician to wear while serving the sheeple up.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: God has judged me all my life. But that is God's privilege, my lady. Not yours.
Author: Barbara Hambly,  The Armies of Daylight

Quote: The natural is so awesome that we need not go beyond it.
Author: Ruth Hurmence Green,  The Born Again Skeptic's Guide To The Bible

Quote: If I’m going to write a book every American will want to read, it’s got to have lots of pictures. Those pictures must also move, and all the words in the book must be spoken and available audibly for all the readers to hear as they watch.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: If I’m going to write a book every American will want to read, it’s got to have lots of pictures. Those pictures must also move, and all the words in the book must be spoken and available audibly for all the readers to hear as they watch.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: Today evolution of human intelligence has advanced us to the stage where most of us are too smart to invent new gods but are reluctant to give up the old ones.
Author: Ruth Hurmence Green

Quote: I didn't know I had it in me. There's more to all of us than we realize. Life is so much bigger, grander, higher, and wider than we allow ourselves to think. We're capable of so much more than we allow ourselves to believe.
Author: Queen Latifah,  Put on Your Crown: Life-Changing Moments on the Path to Queendom

Quote: Love and religion! thought Clarissa, going back into the drawing room, tingling all over. How detestable, how detestable they are!
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Mrs. Dalloway

Quote: The most difficult dilemma for a person is perhaps when his heart testifies to an inevitable reality yet his tongue will not proclaim it, when his mind screams in acceptance of truth but he cant bring himself to state it.
Author: Umera Ahmed- Peer-e-Kamil

Quote: Our culture encourages us to plan every moment and fill our schedules with one activity and obligation after the next, with no time to just be. But the human body and mind require downtime to rejuvenate. I have found my greatest moments of joy and peace just sitting in silence, and then I take that joy and peace with me out into the world.
Author: Holly Mosier

Quote: A child's education should begin at least 100 years before he was born.
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr.

Quote: The most effective kind of education is that a child should play amongst lovely things.
Author: Plato

Quote: A brick could be used to perpetually feed the hungry, stop all wars, educate the masses, and ensure everlasting peace for all populations throughout time. Wait, I’m sorry, that’s not right. I was confusing a brick with a blanket. It’s a blanket that could be used for all those things.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A brick and a blanket walk into a bar

Quote: You can't learn everything you need to know legally.
Author: John Irving,  A Widow for One Year

Quote: Libraries allow children to ask questions about the world and find the answers. And the wonderful thing is that once a child learns to use a library, the doors to learning are always open.
Author: Laura Bush

Quote: ...Shouldn't schools be the place where students interact with interesting books? Shouldn't the faculty have an ongoing laser-like commitment to put good books in our students' hands? Shouldn't this be a front-burner issue at all times?
Author: Kelly Gallagher,  Readicide: How Schools Are Killing Reading and What You Can Do About It

Quote: No wonder so many adults long to return to university, to all those deadlines--ahhh, that structure! Scaffolding to which we may cling! Even if it is arbitrary, without it, we're lost, wholly incapable of separating the Romantic from the Victorian in our sad, bewildering lives...
Author: Marisha Pessl,  Special Topics in Calamity Physics

Quote: I'm a Prince of Wales Trust ambassador, so I'm all about giving youth an education, a voice and a chance to not take the wrong road.
Author: Benedict Cumberbatch

Quote: I read Shakespeare and the Bible, and I can shoot dice. That's what I call a liberal education.
Author: Tallulah Bankhead

Quote: Rich will be my life if I can keep my memories full and brimming, and record them on clear-eyed mornings while I set joyously to work setting pen to holy craft.
Author: Roman Payne,  Rooftop Soliloquy

Quote: People are afraid of being more ignorant than their children―especially, apparantly, their daughters.
Author: Daniel C. Dennett,  Breaking the Spell: Religion as a Natural Phenomenon

Quote: Is he well educated?""Yes, I think so, as far as he's gone,"I answered. "Of course he will go on being educated every day of his life, same as father. He says it is all rot about 'finishing' your education. You never do. You learn more important things each day...
Author: Gene Stratton-Porter,  Laddie: A True Blue Story

Quote: The COUNTRY is controlled by LAWS>LAWS are controlled by POLITICIANS>POLITICIANS are controlled by VOTERS>VOTERS are controlled by PUBLIC OPINION>PUBLIC OPINION is controlled by the MEDIA (News, Hollywood, Internet...) & EDUCATIONso. whoever controls MEDIA & EDUCATION, controls the COUNTRY.
Author: William J. Federer,  Change to Chains-The 6,000 Year Quest for Control -Volume I-Rise of the Republic

Quote: It's not that I feel that school is a good idea gone wrong, but a wrong idea from the word go. It's a nutty notion that we can have a place where nothing but learning happens, cut off from the rest of life.
Author: John Holt

Quote: If at first you don't succeed, remove all evidence you ever tried.
Author: David Brent

Quote: Behind the perfection of a man's style, must lie the passion of a man's soul.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  Reviews

Quote: Never surrender to you're passions. Dream and live to excess.
Author: Truth Devour,  Unrequited

Quote: The education of all children, from the moment that they can get along without a mother's care, shall be in state institutions.
Author: Karl Marx

Quote: How can the bird that is born for joySit in a cage and sing?How can a child, when fears annoy,But droop his tender wing,And forget his youthful spring?
Author: William Blake,  Songs of Innocence and of Experience

Quote: You are human, so stop acting as if though you are a sheep and start thinking for yourself.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: The key to a happy life is to have accomplishments to be proud of and purpose to look forward to, and at the moment I had both. How wonderful it was to be me.
Author: Jeff Lindsay,  Dearly Devoted Dexter

Quote: Wit and puns aren't just decor in the mind; they're essential signs that the mind knows it's on, recognizes its own software, can spot the bugs in its own program.
Author: Adam Gopnik

Quote: ...wanting soul life without the dark, warming intelligence of personal doubt is like expecting an egg without the brooding heat of the mother hen.
Author: David Whyte

Quote: There are three types of people in this world. Firstly, there are people who make things happen. Then there are people who watch things happen. Lastly, there are people who ask, what happened? Which do you want to be?
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: It is often much harder to get rid of books than to acquire them. They stick to us in that pact of need and oblivion we make with them, witnesses to a moment in our lives we will never see again. While they are still there, it is part of us.
Author: Carlos María Domínguez,  The House of Paper

Quote: Each soul has its own note to sing in the divine chorus and no voice is more important than another. (94)
Author: Prem Prakash,  The Yoga of Spiritual Devotion A Modern Translation of the Narada Bhakti Sutras

Quote: Powerful words come with powerful intent. Where you have passion, strength, courage, and determination you can accomplish anything!
Author: K.L. Toth

Quote: The thing is, it's very dangerous to have a fixed idea. A person with a fixed idea will always find some way of convincing himself in the end that he is right
Author: Atle Selberg

Quote: All that was required to measure the planet was a man with a stick and a brain. In other words, couple an intellect with some experimental apparatus and almost anything seems achievable.
Author: Simon Singh,  Big Bang: The Origin of the Universe

Quote: We note our place with bookmarkersThat measure what we've lost.
Author: Paul Simon,  Simon and Garfunkel's Greatest Hits

Quote: The science, the art, the jurisprudence, the chief political and social theories, of the modern world have grown out of Greece and Rome—not by favour of, but in the teeth of, the fundamental teachings of early Christianity, to which science, art, and any serious occupation with the things of this world were alike despicable.
Author: Thomas Henry Huxley,  Agnosticism and Christianity and Other Essays

Quote: Science is a first-rate piece of furniture for a man's upper chamber, if he has common sense on the ground floor.
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Sr.

Quote: Anyone who thinks cryptozoology is the study of the impossible has never really taken a very good look at the so-called "natural world."Once you get past the megamouth sharks, naked mole rats, and spotted hyenas, then the basilisks, dragons, and cuckoos just don't seem that unreasonable. Unpleasant, yes, but unreasonable? Not really.
Author: Seanan McGuire,  Discount Armageddon

Quote: You spend months barely acknowledging someone's existence and then BOOM, you're emotionally addicted to her. Science would probably blame it on chemicals, genetics or something equally logical, but it didn't feel like anything logical
Author: C.K. Kelly Martin,  I Know It's Over

Quote: Feast, and your halls are crowdedFast, and the world goes bySucceed and give, and it helps you liveBut no man can help you die
Author: Ella Wheeler Wilcox

Quote: Whether in the intellectual pursuits of science or in the mystical pursuits of the spirit, the light beckons ahead, and the purpose surging in our nature responds.
Author: Arthur Stanley Eddington,  The Nature of the Physical World

Quote: Reality is, you know, the tip of an iceberg of irrationality that we've managed to drag ourselves up onto for a few panting moments before we slip back into the sea of the unreal.
Author: Terence McKenna

Quote: New scientific ideas never spring from a communal body, however organized, but rather from the head of an individually inspired researcher who struggles with his problems in lonely thought and unites all his thought on one single point which is his whole world for the moment.
Author: Max Planck

Quote: The first rule when you are in a hole is to ask for a hand out!
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: If time heals all wounds, and a book can hold a person's entire life, then you can speed up the process with a pulp time warp.
Author: Deb Caletti,  Honey, Baby, Sweetheart

Quote: We are the children of a technological age. We have found streamlined ways of doing much of our routine work. Printing is no longer the only way of reproducing books. Reading them, however, has not changed.
Author: Lawrence Clark Powell

Quote: Books turn people into isolated individuals, and once that's happened, the road only grows rockier. Books wire you to want to be Steve McQueen, but the world wants you to be SMcQ23667bot@hotmail.com.
Author: Douglas Coupland,  Generation A

Quote: A man who wants the truth becomes a scientist; a man who wants to give free play to his subjectivity may become a writer; but what should a man do who wants something in between?
Author: Robert Musil,  The Man Without Qualities

Quote: It is not enough if you just live life as it comes to you like a floating leaf in a pond. Make use of the powers bestowed in you and soar like an eagle.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: A good self-esteem level is mostly dependant on how we value ourselves without any bias.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Lord, grant that my work increase knowledge and help other men. Failing that, Lord, grant that it will not lead to man’s destruction. Failing that, Lord, grant that my article in Brain be published before the destruction takes place.
Author: Walker Percy,  Love in the Ruins

Quote: The greatest shortcoming of the human race is our inability to understand the exponential function.
Author: Albert A. Bartlett

Quote: We keep quiet about what we read. Our enjoyment of a book remains a jealously guarded secret. Perhaps because there`s no need to talk, or because it takes time to distill what we've read before we can say anything. Silence is our guarantee of intimacy. We might have finished reading but we`re still livingthe book.
Author: Daniel Pennac

Quote: One of the poets, whose name I cannot recall, has a passage, which I am unable at the moment to remember, in one of his works, which for the time being has slipped my mind, which hits off admirably this age-old situation.
Author: P.G. Wodehouse

Quote: By looking far out into space we are also looking far back into time, back toward the horizon of the universe, back toward the epoch of the Big Bang.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: I believe it is in my nature to dance by virtue of the beat of my heart, the pulse of my blood and the music in my mind.
Author: Robert Fulghum

Quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
Author: Euripides

Quote: Friends show their love in times of trouble, not in happiness.
Author: Euripides

Quote: In life, all good things come hard, but wisdom is the hardest to come by.
Author: Lucille Ball

Quote: Married couples who work together to build and maintain a business assume broad responsibilities. Not only is their work important to our local and national economies, but their success is central to the well-being of their families.
Author: Melissa Bean

Quote: Love, we say, is life; but love without hope and faith is agonizing death.
Author: Elbert Hubbard

Quote: Love is the word used to label the sexual excitement of the young, the habituation of the middle-aged, and the mutual dependence of the old.
Author: John Ciardi

Quote: The work of art assumes the existence of the perfect spectator, and is indifferent to the fact that no such person exists.
Author: E. M. Forster

Quote: I think that sense of humor is important in marriage. A sense of humor gets people through marriage.
Author: Kyle Chandler

Quote: Muhabbat apni marzi se khulay pinjray main totay ki tarha bethnay ki salaahiyat hai. Muhabbat is ghulami ka toq hai jo insaan khud apnay ekhtyar se galay main dalta hai
Author: Bano Qudsiyah,  Hasil Ghat

Quote: Muhabbat apni marzi se khulay pinjray main totay ki tarha bethnay ki salaahiyat hai. Muhabbat is ghulami ka toq hai jo insaan khud apnay ekhtyar se galay main dalta hai
Author: Bano Qudsiyah,  Hasil Ghat

Quote: All actual life is encounter.
Author: Martin Buber

Quote: Every country has the government it deserves.
Author: Joseph de Maistre

Quote: I only seem negative to the fortunate. That's because I show the less fortunate that they aren't less fortunate after all.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Treat everyone you meet as if they were you.
Author: Doug Dillon

Quote: Treat everyone you meet as if they were you.
Author: Doug Dillon

Quote: Man is conceived in sin and born in corruption and he passeth from the stink of the didie to the stench of the shroud. There is always something(All The King's Men)
Author: Robert Penn Warren

Quote: The search for something permanent is one of the deepest of the instincts leading men to philosophy.
Author: Bertrand Russell,  A History of Western Philosophy

Quote: Deep connection is the antidote to madness.
Author: Stefan Molyneux

Quote: The principle of democracy is a recognition of the sovereign, inalienable rights of man as a gift from God, the Source of law.
Author: Fulton J. Sheen

Quote: The principle of democracy is a recognition of the sovereign, inalienable rights of man as a gift from God, the Source of law.
Author: Fulton J. Sheen

Quote: Tourism, human circulation considered as consumption is fundamentally nothing more than the leisure of going to see what has become banal.
Author: Guy Debord

Quote: A person whose desires and impulses are his own—are the expression of his own nature, as it has been developed and modified by his own culture—is said to have a character. One whose desires and impulses are not his own, has no character, no more than a steam-engine has character…
Author: John Stuart Mill,  On Liberty

Quote: Philosophers have often held disputeAs to the seat of thought in man and bruteFor that the power of thought attends the latterMy friend, thy beau, hath made a settled matter,And spite of dogmas current in all ages,One settled fact is better than ten sages. (O,Tempora! O,Mores!)
Author: Edgar Allan Poe,  The Complete Stories and Poems

Quote: Philosophers have often held disputeAs to the seat of thought in man and bruteFor that the power of thought attends the latterMy friend, thy beau, hath made a settled matter,And spite of dogmas current in all ages,One settled fact is better than ten sages. (O,Tempora! O,Mores!)
Author: Edgar Allan Poe,  The Complete Stories and Poems

Quote: A thing is only as great as the amount a person is willing to risk for it. If you are not willing to risk anything, then the thing mustn't be so great at all.
Author: Madeline Claire Franklin,  The Poppet and the Lune

Quote: فكرة الحداثة والعلمانية والتنوير فكرة متأخرة عن الثورة العلمية بقرنيين على الأقل وهي نتيجة الثورة العلمية ومعلولهاوليست شرطها وعلتها
Author: أبو يعرب المرزوقي,  صونًا للفلسفة والدين

Quote: We are all inventors, each sailing out on a voyage of discovery, guided each by a private chart, of which there is no duplicate. The world is all gates, all opportunities.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: সহজ হওয়ার মধ্যেই আছে কালচারের পরিচয়, আড়ম্বরের মধ্যে আছে দম্ভের। সে-দম্ভ কখনও অর্থের, কখনো বিদ্যার, কখনও-বা প্রতিপত্তির।
Author: Binoy Mukhopadyay (Jajabar),  দৃষ্টিপাত

Quote: When we die, as when the scenes have been fixed on to celluloid and the scenery is pulled down and burnt — we are phantoms in the memories of our descendants. Then we are ghosts, my dear, then we are myths. But still we are together. We are the past together, we are a distant past. Beneath the dome of the mysterious stars, I still hear your voice.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  Maya

Quote: Be a surfer. Watch the ocean. Figure out where the big waves are breaking and adjust accordingly.
Author: 37 Signals,  Getting Real: The Smarter, Faster, Easier Way to Build a Web Application

Quote: No one species shall make the life of the world its own.' … That's one expression of the law. Here's another: 'The world was not made for any one species.
Author: Daniel Quinn,  Ishmael: An Adventure of the Mind and Spirit

Quote: A writer is one who communicates ideas and emotions people want to communicate but aren't quite sure how, or even if, they should communicate them.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: You know, I think that only if one feels immensely important can one feel truly light.
Author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

Quote: You know, bicycling isn't just a matter of balance,"I said. "it's a matter of faith. You can keep upright only by moving forward. You have to have your eyes on the goal, not the ground. I'm going to call that the Bicyclist's Philosophy of Life.
Author: Susan Vreeland,  Clara and Mr. Tiffany

Quote: Congress shall make no law abridging the freedom of production and trade...
Author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

Quote: But understanding will always require some effort. You probably wouldn't admire a friend who was good at everything if it cost her no effort.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  Sophie's World

Quote: Everything smaller than Heaven bores us because only Heaven is bigger than our hearts.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: Philosophy is an amazing tissue of really fine thinking and incredible, puerile mistakes. It's like one of those rubber 'bones' they give dogs to chew, damned good for the mind's teeth, but as food - no bloody good at all.
Author: Olaf Stapledon,  Odd John

Quote: Your educators can only be your liberators.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Untimely Meditations

Quote: All pain is the same.
Author: Oprah Winfrey

Quote: why can't we control our anger? because we love perfection. make a little room for imperfection in our lives.
Author: Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

Quote: You would not want to be responsible for someone else’s happiness, so please do not hold someone else responsible for yours!
Author: Jennifer O'Neill,  Inspirational Quotes

Quote: If you stay in the company of anger, pain, or hurt, happiness will find someone else to visit. Make the choice to view all of your past relationships as a gift. Throw out what hasn’t worked in the past and incorporate new concepts. Focus on being happy .
Author: Kristen Crockett,  The Gift of Past Relationships

Quote: She had the best kind of courage, or maybe the worst kind, the kind that gets you into trouble.
Author: Alistair MacLean,  Fear is the Key

Quote: Those who try to juggle wisdom, power and greed, drop one of the balls, every time.”—Zarost
Author: Greg Hamerton,  The Riddler's Gift

Quote: I am thankful when I am hungry because then I know that when I eat, the food will taste better. Life has taught me that my true contentment rests in hope, and the pleasure itself is secondary. It is self-awareness, not happiness, that maintains peace.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy
