Author: نجلاء حسن,  قلب صام عن هوى الرجال

Quote: In her way, she was a hard one. Faith in any sort of natural justice was nothing but a night light; she knew of that. Whatever she did, she would end the same way with everyone does: flat on her back with a tube in her nose, wondering, "Is this all?
Author: Thomas Harris,  Red Dragon

Quote: A human being always acts and feels and performs in accordance with what he imagines to be true about himself and his environment...For imagination sets the goal ‘picture’ which our automatic mechanism works on. We act, or fail to act, not because of ‘will,’ as is so commonly believed, but because of imagination.
Author: Maxwell Maltz,  New Psycho-Cybernetics

Quote: Da used to say that lies were easy, but trust was hard. Trust is like faith: it can turn people into believers, but every time it's lost, trust becomes harder and harder to win back.
Author: Victoria Schwab,  The Unbound

Quote: Almighty God, thee only have I; thou steerest my fate, I must give myself up to thee! Give me a livelihood! Give me a bride! My blood wants love, as my heart does!
Author: Hans Christian Andersen

Quote: Only 8% of our worry will come to pass. 92% of our worry is wasted. DON'T PANIC
Author: Mark Gorman

Quote: It is straightforward—and never mind, for now, about plagues and famines: if God existed, and if he cared for humankind, he would never have given us religion.
Author: Martin Amis,  The Second Plane: 14 Responses to September 11

Quote: It is straightforward—and never mind, for now, about plagues and famines: if God existed, and if he cared for humankind, he would never have given us religion.
Author: Martin Amis,  The Second Plane: 14 Responses to September 11

Quote: God lives in the place of praise. If we want to be where He is, we need to go to His address.
Author: Nancy Leigh DeMoss

Quote: Before this generation lose the wisdom, one advice - read books.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: Before this generation lose the wisdom, one advice - read books.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: A manager is responsible for the application and performance of knowledge.
Author: Peter F. Drucker

Quote: This cruel age has deflected me,like a river from this course.Strayed from its familiar shores,my changeling life has flowedinto a sister channel.How many spectacles I've missed:the curtain rising without me,and falling too. How many friendsI never had the chance to meet.
Author: Anna Akhmatova,  The Complete Poems of Anna Akhmatova

Quote: One difference between poetry and lyrics is that lyrics sort of fade into the background. They fade on the page and live on the stage when set to music.
Author: Stephen Sondheim

Quote: Darkness cannot survive in light, but a light can shine in the dark!
Author: Odille Rault,  Beyond the Magic Pill: A Collection of the Insights of Illusions

Quote: What we most love is not what we know, but what knows us and draws us. . . . (78)
Author: Ravi Ravindra,  The Wisdom of Patanjali's Yoga Sutras: A New Translation and Guide by Ravi Ravindra

Quote: We've arranged a civilization in which most crucial elements profoundly depend on science and technology. We have also arranged things so that almost no one understands science and technology. This is a prescription for disaster.
Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: We've arranged a civilization in which most crucial elements profoundly depend on science and technology. We have also arranged things so that almost no one understands science and technology. This is a prescription for disaster.
Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: Long before we even lose our lives, we lose our souls. Tragic but true. Some carry on—willing to make the sacrifices, putting what is perceived as important before anything else. Some tread into the dark—wasting moments of grace, letting themselves suffer from their own decisions or the other’s domination. Some continue to love, give too much, and not leave even a little love for themselves.
Author: Joanne Crisner,  Brightest

Quote: I am suggesting that the radical of poetry lies not in theresolution of doubts but in their proliferation
Author: C.D. Wright,  Cooling Time: An American Poetry Vigil

Quote: You cannot go on 'explaining away' for ever: you will find that you have explained explanation itself away. You cannot go on 'seeing through' things for ever. The whole point of seeing through something is to see something through it.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Abolition of Man

Quote: I had a dream about you last night.. You thought you were a candy vampire, you were standing in the sun screaming 'I'm melting.
Author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... I was a brick and you were a blanket. Damn that improbability drive.
Author: Nicole McKay,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: There Will Be StarsThere will be stars over the place forever;Though the house we loved and the street we loved are lost,Every time the earth circles her orbitOn the night the autumn equinox is crossed,Two stars we knew, poised on the peak of midnightWill reach their zenith; stillness will be deep;There will be stars over the place forever,There will be stars forever, while we sleep.
Author: Sara Teasdale,  Dark of the Moon

Quote: Sometimes he did not know if he slept or just thought about sleep.
Author: Mark Strand

Quote: All things are strange which are worth knowing.
Author: Catherynne M. Valente,  In the Cities of Coin and Spice

Quote: A monk should surely love his books with humility, wishing their good and not the glory of his own curiosity; but what the temptation of adultery is for laymen and the yearning for riches is for secular ecclesiastics, the seduction of knowledge is for monks.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Name of the Rose

Quote: The Soul selects her own Society—Then—shuts the Door—To her divine Majority—Present no more—Unmoved—she notes the Chariots—pausing—At her low Gate—Unmoved—an Emperor be kneelingUpon her Mat—I've known her—from an ample nation—Choose One—Then—close the Valves of her attention—Like Stone—
Author: Emily Dickinson,  Selected Poems

Quote: I am obnoxious to each carping tongue/ Who says my hand a needle better fits./ A poet's pen all scorn I should thus wrong/ For such despite they cast on female wits;/ If what I do prove well, it won't advance,/ They'll say it's stolen, or else, it was by chance.
Author: Anne Bradstreet

Quote: How can I grieve what is still in motion?"I ask her. "Shoes are still dropping all over the place. I´m not kidding,"I say. "It´s Normandy out there.
Author: Suzanne Finnamore,  Split: A Memoir of Divorce

Quote: A precious, mouldering pleasure ’t is To meet an antique book, In just the dress his century wore; A privilege, I think.
Author: Emily Dickinson,  The Complete Poems

Quote: A precious, mouldering pleasure ’t is To meet an antique book, In just the dress his century wore; A privilege, I think.
Author: Emily Dickinson,  The Complete Poems

Quote: Our lives were now worlds apart, separated by time, circumstance, and the unbridgeable chasm of money.
Author: Travis Luedke,  The Shepherd

Quote: There is, so I believe, in the essence of everything, something that we cannot call learning. There is, my friend, only a knowledge-that is everywhere, that is Atman, that is in me and you and in every creature, and I am beginning to believe that this knowledge has no worse enemy than the man of knowledge, than learning.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Siddhartha

Quote: Mankind have a great aversion to intellectual labor; but even supposing knowledge to be easily attainable, more people would be content to be ignorant than would take even a little trouble to acquire it.
Author: Samuel Johnson

Quote: Every other knowledge is harmful to him who does not have knowledge of goodness.
Author: Michel de Montaigne,  The Complete Essays

Quote: Dumped doesn't even begin to describe it. If you're going to use a trash metaphor, incinerated is more like it.
Author: Rachel Cohn,  Naomi and Ely's No Kiss List

Quote: I had a dream about you last night. We went to the store cupboard to make out, but we ended up sharing our pain and then crying together. We wasn't prepared for this level of intimacy.
Author: Michael Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: Cut my life into pizzas. this is my plastic fork. oven baking, no breathing, dont give a fuck if its carbs that i'm eating' -Catherine Spann
Author: Catherine Spann

Quote: If you neglected to warn Djetth beforehand that you were going to shoot him down, Your Highness, he may consider you in breach of contract...-- Rhett
Author: Rowena Cherry,  Insufficient Mating Material

Quote: She could not leave him hanging like this. “If you were hurt, I need to know.” It was a rule somewhere, in the good-guy handbook.
Author: Tara Janzen,  Crazy Wild

Quote: I start with a tingle, a kind of feeling of the story I will write. Then come the characters, and they take over, they make the story.
Author: Karen Blixen

Quote: One thing about great art: it made you love people more, forgive them their petty transgressions. It worked in the way that religion was supposed to, if you thought about it.
Author: Nick Hornby,  Juliet, Naked

Quote: You do not exist to serve the illusion. The illusion exists to serve you.
Author: Lauren Zimmerman

Quote: It is only by risking our persons from one hour to another that we live at all.
Author: William James

Quote: As Dostoevski said: 'Love in action is a harsh and dreadful thing compared with love in dreams.
Author: Dorothy Day

Quote: Humans are strange. … They value punishment because they think it means their actions are important—that they are important. … it's vanity.
Author: Robert Jackson Bennett,  City of Stairs

Quote: Mindfulness, also called wise attention, helps us see what we’re adding to our experiences, not only during meditation sessions but also elsewhere.
Author: Sharon Salzberg,  Real Happiness: The Power of Meditation

Quote: You become what you think about
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude

Quote: You become what you think about
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Success Through A Positive Mental Attitude

Quote: The ball laughs, radiant, in the air. He brings her down, puts her to sleep, showers her with compliments, dances with her, and seeing such things never before seen his admirers pity their unborn grandchildren who will never see them.
Author: Eduardo Galeano

Quote: Gaps don't/just happen./There is a/generative element/inside them,/a welling motion/as when cold/waters shoulder/up through/warmer oceans./And where gaps/choose to widen,/coordinates warp,/even in places/constant since/the oldest maps.
Author: Kay Ryan

Quote: I could taste the salt on her lips, each kiss like a summer wave breaking on an empty beach.
Author: Michael Faudet

Quote: When you depersonalize abrasive behavior and see it as a call for help you become a catalyst for the best kind of change.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: Support and encouragement are found in the most unlikely places.
Author: Raquel Cepeda

Quote: Someone was coming through the velvet.He was pulling it wide, he was stepping onto Kestrel’s balcony—close, closer still as she turned and the curtain swayed, then stopped. He pinned the velvet against frame. He held the sweep of it high, at the level of his gray eyes, which were silver in the shadows.He was here. He had come.Arin.
Author: Marie Rutkoski,  The Winner's Crime

Quote: It is not possible to be 'incidentally a Christian.' The fact of Christianity must be overwhelmingly first or nothing. This suggests a reason for the dislike of Christians by nominal or non-Christians: their lives contain no overwhelming first but many balances.
Author: Sheldon Vanauken

Quote: In all times, and all countries especially in those countries which are divided within by religious faith, there are always fanatics who will be well contented to be regarded as martyrs.
Author: Alexandre Dumas,  The Three Musketeers

Quote: And one fine day the goddess of the wind kisses the foot of man, that mistreated, scorned foot, and from that kiss the soccer idol is born. He is born in a straw crib in a tin-roofed shack and he enters the world clinging to a ball.
Author: Eduardo Galeano

Quote: I'm not a big fan of inspiration. I'm too old to sit and wait for the muse to give me a little kiss... I write a lot, and I'm not afraid to make mistakes or to write badly. I can alsways fix something weak and dull. But I can't fix a blank page.
Author: Ron Koertge

Quote: This path was not that of my conscious choosing. But after persistent subconscious confrontation, I have finally embraced what is, 'souly' for me...and I am thankful, when called upon, to be able to share and give to those who seek their own way of the path.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: This path was not that of my conscious choosing. But after persistent subconscious confrontation, I have finally embraced what is, 'souly' for me...and I am thankful, when called upon, to be able to share and give to those who seek their own way of the path.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: It is this mythical, or rather symbolic, content of the religious traditions which is likely to come into conflict with science. This occurs whenever this religious stock of ideas contains dogmatically fixed statements on subjects which belong in the domain of science.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: It is this mythical, or rather symbolic, content of the religious traditions which is likely to come into conflict with science. This occurs whenever this religious stock of ideas contains dogmatically fixed statements on subjects which belong in the domain of science.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: I believe in rendering to science the things that belong to science. I have no problem with evolution or discussions of the age of the Earth, for I don't believe that we come anywhere near comprehending the mind of God or the workings of the universe. Science can explain a lot, but it cannot give us faith, and I think we need both.
Author: Brandon Sanderson

Quote: I'm Catholic. I don't pray, I just ask for forgiveness after.
Author: Abigail Roux,  Crash & Burn

Quote: If life didn’t give you at least one person not wanting you to succeed then half of us would lose are motivation to climb that cliff, in order to prove them wrong.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: If you really want to eat, keep climbing. The fruits are on the top of the tree. Stretch your hands and keep stretching them. Success is on the top, keep going.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: It is hard not to feel that there must be something very wrong with much of what we do in school, if we feel the need to worry so much about what many people call 'motivation'. A child has no stronger desire than to make sense of the world, to move freely in it, to do the things that he sees bigger people doing.
Author: John Holt

Quote: The only limitation is that which one sets up in one's own mind.
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

Quote: The only limitation is that which one sets up in one's own mind.
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

Quote: Our children are only as brilliant as we allow them to be.
Author: Eric Micha'el Leventhal

Quote: Education is the movement from darkness to light.
Author: Allan Bloom

Quote: For truth to tell, dancing in all its forms cannot be excluded from the curriculum of all noble education: dancing with the feet, with ideas, with words, and, need I add that one must also be able to dance with pen- that one must learn how to write
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Twilight of the Idols

Quote: Isana felt her throat tighten. "We failed."Serai lifted her chin and patted Isana's arm firmly."We have not yet succeeded. There is a difference.
Author: Jim Butcher,  Academ's Fury

Quote: Having a body is in itself the greatest threat to the mind... The body encloses the mind in a fortress; before long the mind is besieged on all sides, and in the end the mind has to give itself up.
Author: Marcel Proust

Quote: Would you mind if I used your kitchen sink to take a bath? I have the hygiene of a midget.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Sleepwalking is restercise

Quote: What all good teachers have in common, however, is that they set high standards for their students and do not settle for anything less.
Author: Marva Collins,  Marva Collins' Way: Updated

Quote: We do not live to think, but, on the contrary, we think in order that we may succeed in surviving.
Author: José Ortega y Gasset

Quote: There is a looming chasm between what your brain knows and what your mind is capable of accessing.
Author: David Eagleman,  Incognito: The Secret Lives of the Brain

Quote: For every one pupil who needs to be guarded against a weak excess of sensibility there are three who need to be awakened from the slumber of cold vulgarity. The task of the modern educator is not to cut down jungles but to irrigate deserts.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Abolition of Man

Quote: To learn something new, take the path that you took yesterday.
Author: John Burroughs

Quote: Art has always been the raft onto which we climb to save our sanity. I don't see a different purpose for it now.
Author: Dorothea Tanning

Quote: I was naked under his gaze. Skin was just that: skin. But to see your soul stripped, laid bare for the eyes of someone you barely knew-that was terrifying.
Author: Whitney Barbetti,  Ten Below Zero

Quote: The soul without imagination is what an observatory would be without a telescope.
Author: Henry Ward Beecher

Quote: But people of the deepest understanding look within, distracted by nothing. Since a clear mind is the Buddha, they attain the understanding of a Buddha without using the mind.
Author: Bodhidharma,  The Zen Teaching of Bodhidharma

Quote: His mind scolded him for his stupidity and urged him to forget her but his heart had no justifications for its stand. It remained unmoved, its solidarity unaffected, its arrogance still holding.
Author: Faraaz Kazi

Quote: Intent without dedicated action is simply not enough. Action without a clear intent is a waste. It is when these two powerful forces are aligned that the energy of the universe conspires in your favor.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Life, the Truth, and Being Free

Quote: The universe doesn’t give you what you ask for with your thoughts; it gives you what you demand with your actions. In essence, you don't get what you WANT, you get what you ARE.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Books are those faithful mirrors that reflect to our mind the minds of sages and heroes.
Author: Edward Gibbon

Quote: If the mind falls asleep, awaken it. Then if it starts wandering, make it quiet. If you reach the state where there is neither sleep nor movement of mind, stay still in that, the natural (real) state.
Author: Ramana Maharshi,  The Collected Works of Ramana Maharshi

Quote: Mattie sat at the table, obsessing, orbiting around herself. She was sick of her worried, hostile mind. It would have killed her long before, she felt, if it hadn't needed the transportation.
Author: Anne Lamott,  Blue Shoe

Quote: A real decision is measured by the fact that you've taken a new action. If there's no action, you haven't truly decided.
Author: Anthony Robbins,  Unlimited Power: The New Science Of Personal Achievement

Quote: Once you can write an alphabet, you can write a book of 100 million pages. It's just a matter of believing it as possible, and taking the cross millimetre by millimetre.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: The measure of greatness in a scientific idea is the extent to which it stimulates thought and opens up new lines of research.
Author: Paul A.M. Dirac

Quote: If the world should blow itself up, the last audible voice would be that of an expert saying it can't be done.
Author: Peter Ustinov

Quote: A new consciousness is developing which sees the earth as a single organism and recognizes that an organism at war with itself is doomed. We are one planet. One of the great revelations of the age of space exploration is the image of the earth finite and lonely, somehow vulnerable, bearing the entire human species through the oceans of space and time.
Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: To put it bluntly but fairly, anyone today who doubts that the variety of life on this planet was produced by a process of evolution is simply ignorant—inexcusably ignorant, in a world where three out of four people have learned to read and write.
Author: Daniel C. Dennett,  Darwin's Dangerous Idea: Evolution and the Meanings of Life

Quote: Jake went in, aware that he had, for the first time in three weeks, opened a door without hoping madly to find another world on the other side. A bell jingled overhead. The mild, spicy smell of old books hit him, and the smell was somehow like coming home.
Author: Stephen King,  The Waste Lands

Quote: The more we learn about the world, and the deeper our learning, the more conscious, specific, and articulate will be our knowledge of what we do not know; our knowledge of our ignorance. For this indeed, is the main source of our ignorance - the fact that our knowledge can be only finite, while our ignorance must necessarily be infinite.
Author: Karl Popper

Quote: The best scientist is open to experience and begins with romance - the idea that anything is possible.
Author: Ray Bradbury

Quote: Laboring through a world every day more stultified, which expected salvation in codes and governments, ever more willing to settle for suburban narratives and diminished payoffs--what were the chances of finding anyone else seeking to transcend that, and not even particularly aware of it?
Author: Thomas Pynchon,  Against the Day

Quote: Witchcraft to the ignorant, .... Simple science to the learned.
Author: Leigh Brackett

Quote: The History Of The Universe In Three WordsCHAPTER ONEBang!CHAPTER TWOsssssCHAPTER THREEcrunch.THE END
Author: Iain M. Banks

Quote: Here lies one from a distant star, but the soil is not alien to him, for in death he belongs to the universe.
Author: Clifford D. Simak,  Way Station

Quote: There is nothing to prove to anyone, just concentrate on your own needs.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: Feeling indifferent or reserved about doing something is a signal that it is probably not correct after all.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: If someone does not consider those around them to be valuable and hold only themselves in high regard, they too have a very bad self-esteem.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Geometry has two great treasures; one is the Theorem of Pythagoras; the other, the division of a line into extreme and mean ratio. The first we may compare to a measure of gold; the second we may name a precious jewel.
Author: Johannes Kepler

Quote: Science is my territory, but science fiction is the landscape of my dreams.
Author: Freeman Dyson,  Imagined Worlds

Quote: An ocean traveler has even more vividly the impression that the ocean is made of waves than that it is made of water.
Author: Arthur Stanley Eddington

Quote: Scientists have power by virtue of the respect commanded by the discipline... We live with poets and politicians, preachers and philosophers. All have their ways of knowing, and all are valid in their proper domain. The world is too complex and interesting for one way to hold all the answers.
Author: Stephen Jay Gould,  Bully for Brontosaurus: Reflections in Natural History

Quote: I used to measure the skies, now I measure the shadows of Earth.Although my mind was sky-bound, the shadow of my body lies here.[Epitaph he composed for himself a few months before he died]
Author: Johannes Kepler

Quote: Glendower: I can call the spirits from the vasty deep.Hotspur: Why, so can I, or so can any man;But will they come, when you do call for them?
Author: William Shakespeare,  King Henry IV, Part 1

Quote: Before you sleep, read something that is exquisite, and worth remembering.
Author: Desiderius Erasmus

Quote: Literature is the real life of imaginary people.
Author: Stefanos Livos

Quote: And so I'm me again, Leo. Thanks to the example of a five-year-old. I'm hoping you wouldn't want it any other way. Not that you weren't flattered, right? I mean, to have a girl two thousand miles away going to pieces over you, weeping at the mere memory of you, losing her appetite, losing herself and self-respect - well, that's trophy enough for any guy's ego, huh?
Author: Jerry Spinelli

Quote: There are books that one reads over and over again, books that become part of the furniture of one’s mind and alter one’s whole attitude to life, books that one dips into but never reads through, books that one reads at a single sitting and forgets a week later:
Author: George Orwell,  A Collection of Essays

Quote: By reading the writings of the most interesting minds in history, we meditate with our own minds and theirs as well. This is to me is a miracle.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Palm Sunday: An Autobiographical Collage

Quote: It is only in sorrow bad weather masters us; in joy we face the storm and defy it.
Author: Amelia Barr

Quote: It is one of the blessings of old friends that you can afford to be stupid with them.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

Quote: We are sinful not only because we have eaten of the Tree of Knowledge, but also because we have not yet eaten of the Tree of Life. The state in which we are is sinful, irrespective of guilt.
Author: Franz Kafka

Quote: There is no evidence that success in business will make us happy people or allow us to have happy families.
Author: Clayton Christensen

Quote: A person, who no matter how desperate the situation, gives others hope, is a true leader.
Author: Daisaku Ikeda

Quote: I long for the raised voice, the howl of rage or love.
Author: Leslie Fiedler

Quote: I just like art. I get pure pleasure from it. I have a lot of wonderful paintings, and every time I look at them I see something different.
Author: Jack Nicholson

Quote: I wasn't shy, but I was really hyper. Nobody got my sense of humor. I was a black skater kid.
Author: Tyler, The Creator

Quote: All the world is queer save thee and me, and even thou art a little queer.
Author: Robert Owen

Quote: The ways of fate are indeed hard to understand. If there is not some compensation hereafter, then the world is a cruel jest.
Author: Arthur Conan Doyle,  The Case-Book of Sherlock Holmes

Quote: One does not have to be a philosopher to be a successful artist, but he does have to be an artist to be a successful philosopher. His nature is to view the world in an unpredictable albeit useful light.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: One does not have to be a philosopher to be a successful artist, but he does have to be an artist to be a successful philosopher. His nature is to view the world in an unpredictable albeit useful light.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: One does not have to be a philosopher to be a successful artist, but he does have to be an artist to be a successful philosopher. His nature is to view the world in an unpredictable albeit useful light.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: High thoughts must have high language.
Author: Aristophanes,  Frogs and Other Plays

Quote: Philosophy begins in wonder. And at the end when philosophic thought has done its best the wonder remains.
Author: Alfred North Whitehead

Quote: ... is it truly possible to steal a life, if... the Self is eternal and cannot die? Should this be so, then one who 'murders' does no more than transgress against the will of another, whose choice it is to live. At bottom, a murderer offends not against the body, but against the spirit.
Author: Ki Longfellow,  Flow Down Like Silver: Hypatia of Alexandria

Quote: ... is it truly possible to steal a life, if... the Self is eternal and cannot die? Should this be so, then one who 'murders' does no more than transgress against the will of another, whose choice it is to live. At bottom, a murderer offends not against the body, but against the spirit.
Author: Ki Longfellow,  Flow Down Like Silver: Hypatia of Alexandria

Quote: With the truth, all given facts harmonize; but with what is false, the truth soon hits a wrong note.
Author: Aristotle,  The Nicomachean Ethics

Quote: The truth is helpless when up against perception
Author: Zack W. Van

Quote: He alone is free who lives with free consent under the entire guidance of reason
Author: Baruch Spinoza

Quote: Everything that can be thought at all can be thought clearly. Everything that can be said can be said clearly.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein,  Tractatus Logico-Philosophicus

Quote: Love itself is what is left over when being "in love"has burned away, and this is both an art and a fortunate accident.
Author: Louis de Bernières,  Corelli's Mandolin

Quote: Es ist nicht genug, zu wissen, man muß auch anwenden; es ist nicht genug, zu wollen, man muß auch tun.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: One does what one is; one becomes what one does.
Author: Robert Musil

Quote: Nu pot fi eu insumi decat daca ma inalt pana la furie sau cobor pana la descurajare: la nivelul meu obisnuit, ignor faptul ca exist.
Author: Emil Cioran

Quote: Problems in science are sometimes made easier by adding complications.
Author: Daniel C. Dennett,  Darwin's Dangerous Idea: Evolution and the Meanings of Life

Quote: Problems in science are sometimes made easier by adding complications.
Author: Daniel C. Dennett,  Darwin's Dangerous Idea: Evolution and the Meanings of Life

Quote: If your life is Christ, then your death will be only more of Christ, forever. If your life is only Christlessness, then your death will be only more Christlessness, forever. That's not fundamentalism, that's the law of non-contradiction.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: A lie never grows old.
Author: Sophocles,  White Lies

Quote: It’s ever been the way of the man of science or philosophy. Most folks stay in the dark and then complain they can’t see nothing.” – Snipes (185)
Author: Ron Rash,  Serena

Quote: It’s ever been the way of the man of science or philosophy. Most folks stay in the dark and then complain they can’t see nothing.” – Snipes (185)
Author: Ron Rash,  Serena

Quote: It was a dance of masks and every mask was perfect because every mask was a real face and every face was areal mask so there was no mask and there was no face for there was but one dance in which there was butone mask but one true face which was the same and which was a thing without a name which changed andchanged into itself over and over.
Author: Leonard Cohen,  Beautiful Losers

Quote: It was a dance of masks and every mask was perfect because every mask was a real face and every face was areal mask so there was no mask and there was no face for there was but one dance in which there was butone mask but one true face which was the same and which was a thing without a name which changed andchanged into itself over and over.
Author: Leonard Cohen,  Beautiful Losers

Quote: Believe in the wonderment of life, the magic of love, and the reality of death.
Author: Carroll Bryant

Quote: Inspiration may be a form of super-consciousness, orperhaps of subconsciousness—I wouldn't know. But I amsure it is the antithesis of self-consciousness.
Author: Aaron Copland

Quote: Vivo sin vivir en mí... muero porque no muero. (I live without really being alive... I die because I am not dying.)
Author: Teresa of Ávila

Quote: In presence of the Moon nobody sees stars.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: In presence of the Moon nobody sees stars.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: الوقت الإنساني لا يسير في شكل دائري بل يتقدم في خط مستقيم. من هنا، لا يمكن للإنسان أن يكون سعيداً لأن السعادة رغبة في التكرار.
Author: ميلان كونديرا,  The Unbearable Lightness of Being

Quote: İnsanoğlu nedense anlayamadığı şeylere kötülemeye meyilli.
Author: Elif Shafak

Quote: Without knowledge of what I am and why I am here, it is impossible to live, and since I cannot know that, I cannot live either. In an infinity of time, in an infinity of matter, and an infinity of space a bubble-organism emerges while will exist for a little time and then burst, and that bubble am I.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Quote: Without knowledge of what I am and why I am here, it is impossible to live, and since I cannot know that, I cannot live either. In an infinity of time, in an infinity of matter, and an infinity of space a bubble-organism emerges while will exist for a little time and then burst, and that bubble am I.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Anna Karenina

Quote: Our actions are guaranteed to affect others. Because we are not alone in this world, much of our learning about ourselves comes from our interaction with others. Our relationships are our teachers. We learn from each other.
Author: Tae Yun Kim,  Seven Steps to Inner Power

Quote: Hope burns eternal in the human heart.

Author: Walt Whitman,  Leaves of Grass

Author: Albert Camus

Author: Cyrus the Great

Author: Ilyas Kassam

Author: Steve Turner,  Poems

Author: Paulo Coelho

Author: William James

Quote: Those who possess wisdom cannot just ladle it out to every wantwit and jackanapes who comes along and asks for it. Author: Orson Scott Card,  Sarah

Author: Traci L. Slatton,  Immortal

Quote: Reality is what trips you up when you walk around with your eyes closed.
Author: F. Paul Wilson,  Healer

Author: Santosh Kalwar

Author: Jerry Spinelli,  Milkweed

Quote: As we grow detached from things, we come (with God's help) to master our desires, and we give the mastery over to God. Discipline and divine grace heal the intellect and the will of the effects of concupiscence. We can begin to see things clearly.

Author: Adam Silvera,  More Happy Than Not

Author: Louis-Ferdinand Céline,  Journey to the End of the Night

Quote: Maybe I had a "secret identity", but then when you think about it, don't we all? A part of ourselves very few people ever get to see. The part we think of as "me". The part that deals with the big stuff. Makes the real choices. The part everything else is a reflection of.

Quote: Our Father who art in nature, who has given the gift of survival to the coyote, the common brown rat, the English sparrow, the house fly and the moth, must have a great and overwhelming love for no-goods and blots-on-the-town and bums, and Mack and the boys. Virtues and graces and laziness and zest. Our Father who art in nature.
Author: John Steinbeck,  Cannery Row

Author: Robert A. Schuller

Author: Arthur W. Pink,  The Attributes of God

Quote: One knows so little. When one knows more it is too late.
Author: Agatha Christie,  Three Act Tragedy

Quote: I am a student of life, and don't want to miss any experience. There's poetry in this sort of thing, you know--or perhaps you don't know, but it's all the same.

I'd unfasten her clothing and lie with her onthat hard bed, and what was between us would be as far above the ordinary congress between man and woman as the stars are above their pale reflections in the lake below.

Quote: I don't care what is written,"Meyer Landsman says. "I don't care what supposedly got promised to some sandal-wearing idiot whose claim to fame is that he was ready to cut his own son's throat for the sake of a hare-brained idea. I don't care about red heifers and patriarchs and locusts. A bunch of old bones in the sand. My homeland is in my hat. It's in my ex-wife's tote bag.

Author: Miguel de Cervantes Saavedra,  Don Quixote

Quote: Thoughts do more. Words to much. Actions do much more.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: Every maker of video games knows something that the makers of curriculum don't seem to understand. You'll never see a video game being advertised as being easy. Kids who do not like school will tell you it's not because it's too hard. It's because it's--boring
Author: Seymour Papert

Quote: I am conscious of a soul-sense that lifts me above the narrow, cramping circumstances of my life. My physical limitations are forgotten- my world lies upward, the length and the breadth and the sweep of the heavens are mine!
Author: Helen Keller,  The Story of My Life: With Her Letters (1887 1901) and a Supplementary Account of Her Education Including Passages from the Reports and Letters of Her Teacher Anne Mansfield Sullivan by John Albert Macy

Quote: You have to be uncomfortable in order to be successful, in some ways. If you stay in your comfort zone! You would never do the things that you need to do.
Author: Lights Poxlietner

Quote: The great thing in this world is not so much where we are, but in what direction we are going.
Author: Oliver Wendell Holmes Jr.

Quote: I can no longer be sure whether the psyche is in me or whether I'm in the psyche...
Author: James Hillman

Quote: I had an out-of-body experience so strange that it felt normal. You see, my soul, or essence, had left my body and went and inhabited the body of my clone. So I wasn’t in my body, and yet I was. Or maybe none of that happened, and I was just in a delirious, sleep-deprived state.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: My body is precious and not separate from my soul.
Author: SARK,  Succulent Wild Woman

Quote: Always eyes watching you and the voice enveloping you. Asleep or awake, indoors or out of doors, in the bath or bed- no escape. Nothing was your own except the few cubic centimeters in your skull.
Author: George Orwell,  1984

Quote: The desire to live life to its fullest, to acquire more knowledge, to abandon the economic treadmill, are all typical reactions to these experiences in altered states of consciousness. The previous fear of death is typically quelled. If the individual generally remains thereafter in the existential state of awareness, the deep internal feeling of eternity is quite profound and unshakable.
Author: Edgar D. Mitchell,  The Way of the Explorer: An Apollo Astronaut's Journey Through the Material and Mystical Worlds

Quote: The mind is satisfied with phrased, but not the body, the body is more fastidious, it wants muscles. A body always tells the truth, that's why it's usually depressing and disgusting to look at.
Author: Louis-Ferdinand Céline,  Journey to the End of the Night

Quote: You're paved in my heart like an old road. Like the pebbles in a pebble field, dirt in dirt, dust in dust, cobwebs in cobwebs.
Author: Kyung-sook Shin,  Please Look After Mom

Quote: From the moment of my birth, I lived with pain at the center of my life. My only purpose in life was to find a way to coexist with intense pain.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle

Quote: Depend on it. God's work done in God's way will never lack God's supply. He is too wise a God to frustrate His purposes for lack of funds, and He can just as easily supply them ahead of time as afterwards, and He much prefers doing so.
Author: James Hudson Taylor

Quote: [On Schopenhauer in Black and White] Schopenhauer's views of love are flawed. Love can't be merely an illusion of the mind to aid in procreation, but the path to redemption for an otherwise violently selfish species. Past human greatness has proven that when challenged, love can overpower impulsive instinct, and in essence, the vilest aspects of our nature.
Author: Tiffany Madison

Quote: People will always prefer black-and-white over shades of grey, and so there will always be the temptation to hold overly-simplified beliefs and to hold them with excessive confidence
Author: Thomas Gilovich,  How We Know What Isn't So: The Fallibility of Human Reason in Everyday Life

Quote: ‎Determination, effort, and practice are rewarded with success.
Author: Mary Lydon Simonsen,  The Perfect Bride for Mr. Darcy

Quote: Success and failure are two edges of the same blade, two sides of the same coin. To fear one is to forever deny the possibility of the other.
Author: Michelle Sagara West,  Cast In Courtlight

Quote: That's the way the mind works: the brain is genetically disposed towards organization, yet if not controlled, will link even the most imagerial fragment to another on the flimsiest pretense and in the most freewheeling manner, as if it takes a kind of organic pleasure in creative association, without regards to logic or chronological sequence.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Fierce Invalids Home from Hot Climates

Quote: Man's mind may be likened to a garden, which may be intelligently cultivated or allowed to run wild.
Author: James Allen,  As a Man Thinketh

Quote: Don't call yourself discouraged anymore;it's no longer your name.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: As Lucretius says: 'Thus ever from himself doth each man flee.' But what does he gain if he does not escape from himself? He ever follows himself and weighs upon himself as his own most burdensome companion. And so we ought to understand that what we struggle with is the fault, not of the places, but of ourselves
Author: Seneca,  The Stoic Philosophy of Seneca: Essays and Letters

Quote: Human is a suffered mind but an enlightened soul.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Human is a suffered mind but an enlightened soul.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Failures can be called ‘strengtheners’ as they make you determined to reach your goal with the lessons they teach.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: It is either coincidence piled on top of coincidence,"said Hollus, "or it is deliberate design.
Author: Robert J. Sawyer,  Calculating God

Quote: I love books, they're in my blood.
Author: Karen Marie Moning,  Shadowfever

Quote: In the dark, with the windows lit and the rows of books glittering, the library is a closed space, a universe of self-serving rules that pretend to replace or translate those of the shapeless universe beyond.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: Try and penetrate with our limited means the secrets of nature and you will find that, behind all the descernible laws and connections, there remains something subtle, intangible and inexplicable. Veneration for this force beyond anything that we can comprehend is my religion. To that extent I am, in fact, religious.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: Science is not a heartless pursuit of objective information; it is a creative human activity.
Author: Stephen Jay Gould

Quote: There are many hypotheses in science which are wrong. That’s perfectly all right: it’s the aperture to finding out what’s right. Science is a self-correcting process.
Author: Carl Sagan,  Cosmos

Quote: Focusing is the great secret of power. If you want to use your full amount of focus, you must close down all other thought and direct your power of generating mental steam toward one outcome.
Author: Stephen Richards,  The Ultimate Focus Builder

Quote: The goal is to learn to be nurturing with yourself so you can feel free.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: We have not the reverent feeling for the rainbow that the savage has, because we know how it is made. We have lost as much as we gained by prying into that matter.
Author: Mark Twain

Quote: Le savant doit ordonner ; on fait la science avec des faits comme une maison avec des pierres ; mais une accumulation de faits n'est pas plus une science qu'un tas de pierres n'est une maison.The Scientist must set in order. Science is built up with facts, as a house is with stones. But a collection of facts is no more a science than a heap of stones is a house.
Author: Henri Poincaré,  Science and Hypothesis

Quote: Arguments from authority carry little weight – authorities have made mistakes in the past. They will do so again in the future. Perhaps a better way to say it is that in science there are no authorities; at most, there are experts.
Author: Carl Sagan,  The Demon-Haunted World: Science as a Candle in the Dark

Quote: Today the network of relationships linking the human race to itself and to the rest of the biosphere is so complex that all aspects affect all others to an extraordinary degree. Someone should be studying the whole system, however crudely that has to be done, because no gluing together of partial studies of a complex nonlinear system can give a good idea of the behavior of the whole.
Author: Murray Gell-Mann

Quote: Nothing in biology makes sense except in the light of evolution.
Author: Theodosius Dobzhansky

Quote: There are no things man was not meant to know. There are, perhaps, things man is too dumb to figure out, but that's a different problem.
Author: Michael Kurland

Quote: A person today who seems to have a great sense of self-esteem has his or her childhood days to thank for it.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: You will never get to the irreducible definition of anything because you will never be able to explain why you want to explain, and so on. The system will gobble itself up.
Author: Alan W. Watts,  The Essential Alan Watts

Quote: Take chances! Get messy! Make mistakes!
Author: Joanna Cole

Quote: When you can measure what you are speaking about, and express it in numbers, you know something about it, when you cannot express it in numbers, your knowledge is of a meager and unsatisfactory kind; it may be the beginning of knowledge, but you have scarely, in your thoughts advanced to the stage of science.
Author: William Thomson, 1st Baron Kelvin

Quote: He saw that science had become as great a hoax as religion, that nationalism was a farce, patriotism a fraud, education a form of leprosy, and that morals were for cannibals
Author: Henry Miller,  The Time of the Assassins: a Study of Rimbaud

Quote: Books. People have no idea how beautiful books are. How they taste on your fingers. How bright everything is when you light it with words.
Author: Rachel Kadish,  Tolstoy Lied: A Love Story

Quote: Epics are never written about libraries. They exist on whim; it depends on if the conquering army likes to read.
Author: Patricia A. McKillip

Quote: Books are all the dreams we would most like to have and like dreams they have the power to change consciousness.
Author: Victor Nell,  Lost in a Book: The Psychology of Reading for Pleasure

Quote: Great hopes make great men.
Author: Thomas Fuller

Quote: Great hopes make great men.
Author: Thomas Fuller

Quote: A true friend freely, advises justly, assists readily, adventures boldly, takes all patiently, defends courageously, and continues a friend unchangeably.
Author: William Penn

Quote: I think I got a lot of life skills; I got a lot of wisdom; I've seen a lot of bad things happen to a lot of good people.
Author: Young Jeezy

Quote: I think with the success of, like, every summer there has been a couple R-rated comedies that have done so well; I think it is so nice to see that people are turning out to see these movies, and it doesn't seem to be as big a stigma with the studios anymore.
Author: Will Ferrell

Quote: You can be diagnosed and treated early. And there is hope for the future.
Author: Teri Garr

Quote: Love is the attempt to form a friendship inspired by beauty.
Author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

Quote: Love is the attempt to form a friendship inspired by beauty.
Author: Marcus Tullius Cicero

Quote: Performance art is going to be the future. Plays on Broadway are so restricted. But performance art is like haikus, just one line thing. And it's more casual but more interesting.
Author: Yoko Ono

Quote: I am in the Master of Professional Writing program teaching Humor Writing, Literary and Dramatic.
Author: Shelley Berman

Quote: The moon is the reflection of your heart and moonlight is the twinkle of your love.
Author: Debasish Mridha

Quote: The moon is the reflection of your heart and moonlight is the twinkle of your love.
Author: Debasish Mridha

Quote: The moon is the reflection of your heart and moonlight is the twinkle of your love.
Author: Debasish Mridha

Author: Debasish Mridha

Author: Debasish Mridha

Quote: Communism is the final logic of the dehumanization of man.
Author: Fulton J. Sheen

Quote: It is never ridicule, but a compliment, that knocks a philosopher off his feet. He is already positioned for every possible counter-attack, counter-argument, and retort...only to find a big bear hug coming his way.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: The way you see people is the way you treat them and the way you treat them is what they become.
Author: Johann Wolfgang von Goethe

Quote: Health is the natural condition. When sickness occurs, it is a sign that Nature has gone off course because of a physical or mental imbalance. The road to health for everyone is through moderation, harmony, and a 'sound mind in a sound body'.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  Sophie's World

Quote: The Shadow-maker shapes forever.
Author: Lafcadio Hearn

Quote: When the heart is dry the eye is dry.
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables - anthology

Quote: I am a citizen of the world.
Author: Diogenes of Sinope,  The Lives and Opinions of Eminent Philosophers

Quote: The present convergence of crises––in money, energy, education, health, water, soil, climate, politics, the environment, and more––is a birth crisis, expelling us from the old world into a new.
Author: Charles Eisenstein,  Sacred Economics: Money, Gift, and Society in the Age of Transition

Quote: The present convergence of crises––in money, energy, education, health, water, soil, climate, politics, the environment, and more––is a birth crisis, expelling us from the old world into a new.
Author: Charles Eisenstein,  Sacred Economics: Money, Gift, and Society in the Age of Transition

Quote: Part of being of a true existentialist is wanting to be what we make ourselves be by the way we choose to act, as opposed to making excuses for the way we act and regretting it.
Author: Gary Cox,  How to Be an Existentialist: or How to Get Real, Get a Grip and Stop Making Excuses

Quote: Who we are now is all that really matters.
Author: Amy Joy,  The Academie

Quote: Charity is no substitute for justice withheld.
Author: Augustine of Hippo

Quote: ای آمده از عالم روحانی تفتحیران شده در چهار و پنج و شش و هفتمی خور چو ندانی ز کجا آمده ایخوش باش ندانی به کجا خواهی رفت
Author: Omar Khayyám,  رباعيات خيام

Quote: One word can change your life forever.I love youI hate youThink about it
Author: Alan Macmillan Orr,  The Natural Mind - Waking Up: Volume I

Quote: One word can change your life forever.I love youI hate youThink about it
Author: Alan Macmillan Orr,  The Natural Mind - Waking Up: Volume I

Quote: Everything, no matter how beautiful, is only with us for awhile.
Author: Geoff Ryman

Quote: On a grander scale, when a society segregates itself, the consequences affect the economy, the emotions, and the ecology. That's one reason why it's easy for pro-lifers to eat factory-raised animals that disrespect everything sacred about creation. And that is why it's easy for rabid environmentalists to hate chainsaws even though they snuggle into a mattress supported by a black walnut bedstead.
Author: Joel Salatin,  Everything I Want to Do Is Illegal: War Stories from the Local Food Front

Quote: The greatest mystery the universe offers is not life but Size.
Author: Stephen King,  The Gunslinger

Quote: Yes, you need a passport to prove to the world that you exist. The people at passport control, they cannot look at you and see you are a person. No! They have to look at a little photograph of you. Then they believe you exist.
Author: Jeffrey Eugenides,  The Marriage Plot

Quote: Body is a home, a prison and a grave.
Author: James Runcie,  The Colour Of Heaven

Quote: i don't regret the difficulties I experienced; I think they help helped me to become the person I am today. i feel the way a warrior must feel after years of traning; he doesn't remember the details of everything he learned, but he knows how to strike when the time is right
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Zahir

Quote: বিপদ যখন আসে একটার পর একটা আসে। বিপদরা পাঁচ ভাইবোন। এদের মধ্যে খুব মিল। এই ভাইবোনরা কখনো একা কারো কাছে যায় না। প্রথম একজন যায়, তারপর তার অন্য ভাইবোনরা উপস্থিত হয়।
Author: Humayun Ahmed,  এই মেঘ, রৌদ্রছায়া

Quote: فلنمارس تكنيك النعامه الشهير ::"ما لا نراه نحن - هو على الارجح - غير موجود "!
Author: أحمد خالد توفيق,  أسطورة الرقم المشئوم

Quote: To be, or not to be: what a question!
Author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Faust: My Soul Be Damned for the World: Volume I

Quote: What's the use of complaining about something you have no intentions of changing it?
Author: Mario L Castellanos

Quote: Suicidal glory is the luxury of the irresponsible.
Author: Lois McMaster Bujold,  Barrayar

Quote: Rien ne sert de courir il faut partir à point
Author: Jean de La Fontaine,  The Fables of La Fontaine

Quote: A sign of a lover of wisdom is his delight in not running his mouth about things he doesn't know.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: A sign of a lover of wisdom is his delight in not running his mouth about things he doesn't know.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: Each day acquire something that will fortify you against poverty, against death, indeed against other misfortunes as well; and after you have run over many thoughts, select one to be thoroughly digested that day.
Author: Seneca,  Letters from a Stoic

Quote: Without man and his potential for moral progress, the whole of reality would be a mere wilderness, a thing in vain, and have no final purpose.
Author: Immanuel Kant,  Perpetual Peace

Quote: We seem to inhabit a universe made up of a small number of elements-particles-bits that swirl in chaotic clouds, occasionally clustering together in geometrically logical temporary configurations.
Author: Timothy Leary,  Chaos & Cyber Culture

Quote: I have learned to be a friend to myself Great improvement this indeed Such a one can never be said to be alone for know that he who is a friend to himself is a friend to all mankind
Author: Seneca,  Letters from a Stoic

Quote: Is it better to be loved or feared?
Author: Niccolò Machiavelli,  The Prince

Quote: He was still thoughtful. 'Do you think any of us ever really knows anyone?'  'Philosophy, Lord Dryden? And yet it's daylight and everyone is still sober.
Author: Julie Anne Long,  How the Marquess Was Won

Quote: Whatever you want to be in life, you're training for it right now.
Author: Michael Anderson

Quote: Happiness is never there to stay [...] Happiness is merely a respite offered by inquietude.
Author: André Maurois,  Climats

Quote: Happiness is never there to stay [...] Happiness is merely a respite offered by inquietude.
Author: André Maurois,  Climats

Quote: A great benefit of Sabbath keeping is that we learn to let God take care of us — not by becoming passive and lazy, but in the freedom of giving up our feeble attempts to be God in our own lives.
Author: Marva J. Dawn,  Keeping the Sabbath Wholly: Ceasing, Resting, Embracing, Feasting

Quote: If lightning is the anger of the gods, then the gods are concerned mostly about trees.
Author: Lao Tzu

Quote: If lightning is the anger of the gods, then the gods are concerned mostly about trees.
Author: Lao Tzu

Quote: The pleasures arising from thinking and learning will make us think and learn all the more. 1153a 23
Author: Aristotle,  The Nicomachean Ethics

Quote: How can you tell somebody who is pursuing happiness that they're somehow not American when that was the very first promise that America made?
Author: Dan Savage

Quote: She was not too young to be wise, but she was too young to know that wisdom shouldn't be spoken aloud when you are happy.
Author: Graham Greene,  Loser Takes All

Quote: She was not too young to be wise, but she was too young to know that wisdom shouldn't be spoken aloud when you are happy.
Author: Graham Greene,  Loser Takes All

Quote: That truth should be silent I had almost forgot. (Enobarbus)
Author: William Shakespeare,  Antony and Cleopatra

Quote: He was persuaded he could know no happiness but in the society of one with whom he could for ever indulge the melancholy that had taken possession of his soul.
Author: Horace Walpole,  The Castle of Otranto

Quote: It is more important to be free than to be happy.
Author: Tom Robbins

Quote: You are the point of origin for everything in your world: you set the standard for yourself.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: You are the point of origin for everything in your world: you set the standard for yourself.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Nothing but truth is immortal.
Author: Robert G. Ingersoll,  The Ghosts and Other Lectures

Quote: Sex could be a blissful communion,. But it could also be a weapon, and its absence, sometimes, was required for the establishment of peace.
Author: Ann Brashares,  Girls In Pants: The Third Summer of the Sisterhood

Quote: We are all doomed to seek our own happiness; we can't help ourselves. We are all, the cruel and the gentle alike, condemned to seeking that happiness in the dark. We use our need as the blind use a walking stick, to determine the safety of every forward step.
Author: Jesse Browner

Quote: You see, nothing matters except pleasure - which is the opposite of happiness, its tragic part, I expect.
Author: Lawrence Durrell,  The Alexandria Quartet

Quote: How can I tell Bob that my happiness streams from having wrenched a piece out of my life, a piece of hurt and beauty, and transformed it to typewritten words on paper? How can he know I am justifying my life, my keen emotions, my feeling, by turning it into print?
Author: Sylvia Plath,  The Unabridged Journals of Sylvia Plath

Quote: The man is happiest who lives from day to day and asks no more, garnering the simple goodness of life.
Author: Euripides

Quote: God is not interested in your art but, your heart.
Author: Ifeanyi Enoch Onuoha

Quote: God is not interested in your art but, your heart.
Author: Ifeanyi Enoch Onuoha

Quote: God is not interested in your art but, your heart.
Author: Ifeanyi Enoch Onuoha

Quote: God is not interested in your art but, your heart.
Author: Ifeanyi Enoch Onuoha

Quote: وقتی در صحنه ی حق وباطل نیستیهر کجا خواهی باش ، چه به نماز ایستاده باشیچه به شراب ،هر دو یکی است...
Author: Ali Shariati

Quote: The words kept coming back to him, statement of a mystical truth and a palpable absurdity.
Author: George Orwell,  1984

Quote: The beauty of truth is that it need not be proclaimed or believed. It skips from soul to soul, changing form each time it touches, but it is what it is, I have seen it, and someday you will, too.
Author: Mark Helprin,  Winter's Tale

Quote: Superficiality is the curse of the modern world.
Author: Matthew Kelly,  Rediscover Catholicism: A Spiritual Guide to Living with Passion & Purpose

Quote: Christopher McCandless:"I will miss you too, but you are wrong if you think that the joy of life comes principally from the joy of human relationships. God's place is all around us, it is in everything and in anything we can experience. People just need to change the way they look at things.
Author: Shunryu Suzuki

Quote: We live in a community of people not so that we can suppress and dominate eachother or make each other miserable but so that we can better and more reliably satisfy all life's healthy needs.
Author: Wilhelm Reich,  Children of the Future: On the Prevention of Sexual Pathology

Quote: There is no happily-ever-after to run to. We have to work for happiness.
Author: Mary Balogh,  Simply Magic

Quote: Most of our suffering comes from resisting what is already here, particularly our feelings. All any feeling wants is to be welcomed, touched, allowed. It wants attention. It wants kindness. If you treated your feelings with as much love as you treated your dog or your cat or your child, you'd feel as if you were living in heaven every day of your sweet life.
Author: Geneen Roth

Quote: The key to ultimate happiness and fulfillment lies within our own transformation. The more we learn and grow and evolve as individuals, the more we will find happiness and satisfaction in relationships, work and life.
Author: Kristi Bowman

Quote: faith gaped at him"how the hell did you do this?"He looked at her as if she'd asked the dumbest question in history. "I'm brilliant.
Author: Dianne Sylvan,  Queen of Shadows

Quote: A King and Queen cannot support a crown with eyes looking down. Their universe expands as far as you can see.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: A King and Queen cannot support a crown with eyes looking down. Their universe expands as far as you can see.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Man must use what he has, not hope for what is not.
Author: G.I. Gurdjieff

Quote: A faith that does not result in activity of any kind is a dead faith; it is empty, worthless, insincere.
Author: Derek Prince

Quote: Every blade in the field - Every leaf in the forest - lays down its life in its season as beautifully as it was taken up.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: those who are afraid of freedom are those who cannot trust us to live in them. Trying to keep the law is actually a declaration of independence, a way of keeping control
Author: Wm. Paul Young,  The Shack

Quote: This is what it means to live on. When granted hope, a person uses it as fuel, as a guidepost to life. It is impossible to live without hope.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  1Q84

Quote: For a flicker of a moment I imagined a world completely different from the one I'd always known, a world in which I was treated with fairness, even kindness-- a world in which fathers didn't sell their daughters.
Author: Arthur Golden

Quote: There are certain mortal moments and minutes that matter. Certain hingepoints in the history of each human. Some seconds are so decisive they shrink the soul, while others are spent, so as to stretch the soul.
Author: Neal A. Maxwell

Author: Neal A. Maxwell

Quote: When Lincoln was asked if God was on the Union’s side, Lincoln’s unvarying response was that what was really important was whether they were on God’s side.
Author: Joe L. Wheeler,  Abraham Lincoln, a Man of Faith and Courage: Stories of Our Most Admired President
