Quote: He is not apprehended by reason, but by life.
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  War and Peace

Quote: ‎God remains silent so that men and women may speak, protest, and struggle. God remains silent so that people may really become people. When God is silent and men and women cry, God cries in solidarity with them but doesn't intervene. God waits for the shouts of protest.
Author: Elsa Tamez

Quote: Through the darkest hours of the nightand through the dreamers realm I seek,Far beyond the starry skyand beyond galaxies I am free.Through the grimmest memoriesand past a seasons air I cannot breathe,Far beyond this mortal worldin an afterlife we shall meet.
Author: Lee Argus

Quote: I started having doubts right on top of my certainty.
Author: David James Duncan,  The Brothers K

Quote: Is anything too hard for the Lord? (Genesis 18:14)
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: Your mother sets you up blind dates? With guys like that?"The corners of his mouth twitched. "She doesn't like you very much, does she?
Author: Kelley Armstrong,  Dates From Hell

Quote: To fear is to have more faith in your antagonist than in Christ.
Author: D.L. Moody,  The Overcoming Life

Quote: Faith is taking the first step even when you don't see the whole staircase.
Author: Martin Luther King Jr.

Quote: Beware the religion that turns you against another one. It's unlikely that it's really religion at all.
Author: Joan D. Chittister,  God Speaks in Many Tongues: Meditate with Joan Chittister

Quote: Beware the religion that turns you against another one. It's unlikely that it's really religion at all.
Author: Joan D. Chittister,  God Speaks in Many Tongues: Meditate with Joan Chittister

Quote: The purpose that you wish to find in life, like a cure you seek, is not going to fall from the sky. ...I believe purpose is something for which one is responsible; it's not just divinely assigned.
Author: Michael J. Fox,  Always Looking Up: The Adventures of an Incurable Optimist

Quote: I am convinced that one should tell one's spiritual director if one has a great desire for Communion, for Our Lord does not come from Heaven every day to stay in a golden ciborium; He comes to find another heaven, the heaven of our soul in which He loves to dwell.
Author: Thérèse de Lisieux,  The Story Of A Soul: The Autobiography Of St. Therese Of Lisieux

Quote: The truth is .. I'm okay with people not liking me. I'm not okay with them pretending that they do. Keep it real. Everybody ain't for everybody.
Author: Nakia R. Laushaul,  The Truth as I See It: In Poetry & Prose

Quote: There's a lot of talk these days about giving children self-esteem. It's not something you can give; it's something they have to build.
Author: Randy Pausch,  The Last Lecture

Quote: I love words. I crave descriptions that overwhelm my imagination with vivid detail. I dwell on phrases that make my heart thrum. I cherish expressions that pierce my emotions and force the tears to spill over. In essence, I long for a writer's soul sealed in ink on the page.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich

Quote: Interpretations of interpretations interpreted.
Author: James Joyce

Quote: I watch people sometimes, wonder how they can walk around with the weight of what they know.
Author: Cate Kennedy,  Dark Roots: Stories

Quote: Hendaknya kita mengukur ilmu bukan dari tumpukan buku yang kita habiskan. Bukan dari tumpukan naskah yang kita hasilkan. Bukan juga dari penatnya mulut dalam diskusi tak putus yang kita jalani. Tapi…dari amal (action) yang keluar dari setiap desah nafas kita
Author: ابن قيم الجوزية

Quote: The meditative mind sees disagreeable or agreeable things with equanimity, patience, and good-will. Transcendent knowledge is seeing reality in utter simplicity. (146)
Author: Jean-Yves Leloup,  Compassion and Meditation: The Spiritual Dynamic between Buddhism and Christianity

Quote: The meditative mind sees disagreeable or agreeable things with equanimity, patience, and good-will. Transcendent knowledge is seeing reality in utter simplicity. (146)
Author: Jean-Yves Leloup,  Compassion and Meditation: The Spiritual Dynamic between Buddhism and Christianity

Quote: I am a man who knows nothing, guesses sometimes, finds frequently and who's always amazed.
Author: Villiers de L'Isle-Adam

Quote: Thus we have on stage two men, each of whom knows nothing of what he believes the other knows, and to deceive each other reciprocally both speak in allusions, each of the two hoping (in vain) that the other holds the key to his puzzle.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Island of the Day Before

Quote: In order to survive, a plurality of true communities would require not egalitarianism and tolerance but knowledge, an understanding of the necessity of local differences, and respect. Respect, I think, always implies imagination - the ability to see one another, across our inevitable differences, as living souls. (pg. 181, Sex, Economy, Freedom, and Community)
Author: Wendell Berry,  The Art of the Commonplace: The Agrarian Essays

Quote: To say that a being who is sentient has no interest in continuing to live is like saying that a being with eyes has no interest in continuing to see. Death—however “humane”—is a harm for humans and nonhumans alike.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: To say that a being who is sentient has no interest in continuing to live is like saying that a being with eyes has no interest in continuing to see. Death—however “humane”—is a harm for humans and nonhumans alike.
Author: Gary L. Francione

Quote: Nothing lasts forever. But the thing is, you can reuse some. Use your mind. - Leo's Mother, The Lost Hero
Author: Rick Riordan

Quote: If it's knowledge and wisdom you want, then seek out the company of those who do real work for an honest purpose.
Author: Edward Abbey,  Postcards from Ed: Dispatches and Salvos from an American Iconoclast

Quote: If it's knowledge and wisdom you want, then seek out the company of those who do real work for an honest purpose.
Author: Edward Abbey,  Postcards from Ed: Dispatches and Salvos from an American Iconoclast

Quote: Isn’t that wonderful? That feeling of not knowing too much about something… Incomplete information… Endless possibilities… When you don’t know much about something, it’s the most exciting sensation.-Kutsnetz in TALUS
Author: Erol Ozan,  Talus

Quote: APPLY WITHINYou once told meYou wanted to findYourself in the world -And I told you toFirst apply within,To discover the worldwithin you.You once told meYou wanted to saveThe world from all its wars -And I told you toFirst save yourselfFrom the world,And all the warsYou put yourselfThrough.APPLY WITHIN by Suzy Kassem
Author: Suzy Kassem

Quote: APPLY WITHINYou once told meYou wanted to findYourself in the world -And I told you toFirst apply within,To discover the worldwithin you.You once told meYou wanted to saveThe world from all its wars -And I told you toFirst save yourselfFrom the world,And all the warsYou put yourselfThrough.APPLY WITHIN by Suzy Kassem

Quote: Someday you will name me, then gently place those burning holy roses in my hair.[Songs of Longing]
Author: Rainer Maria Rilke,  Rainer Maria Rilke - Sämtliche Werke (Complete Works)

Quote: Each month is gay,Each season nice,When eatingChicken soupWith rice
Author: Maurice Sendak,  Chicken Soup With Rice: A Book of Months

Quote: Through endless night the earth whirls toward a creation unknown...
Author: Henry Miller,  Tropic of Cancer

Quote: If I reveal myself without worrying about how others will respond, then some will care, though others may not. But who can love me, if no one knows me? I must risk it, or live alone.
Author: Sheldon B. Kopp

Quote: Bring up the past only if it will help to build the future, otherwise its best to be left to sleep
Author: Tahir M Khan

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... Unfortunately, it wasn't a dream.
Author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: Proclaim your pride and bitterness loudly to the world, but to me speak softly, and tell me simply that she doesn't love you.
Author: Edmond Rostand,  Cyrano de Bergerac

Quote: It's not always what we don't know that gets in our way; sometimes it's what we think we know that keeps us from learning.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: It's not always what we don't know that gets in our way; sometimes it's what we think we know that keeps us from learning.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: To be taught to read—what is the use of that, if you know not whether what you read is false or true? To be taught to write or to speak—but what is the use of speaking, if you have nothing to say? To be taught to think—nay, what is the use of being able to think, if you have nothing to think of? But to be taught to see is to gain word and thought at once, and both true.
Author: John Ruskin,  The Works of John Ruskin: Library Edition. 39 vols.

Quote: I had a dream about you last night... You tried to propose with a digital ceramic heater.
Author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: I had a dream about you last night.. You were in the amazon rain forest yipping like a dog.
Author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: I was going to say the beginning is the good part, when it's all sparks and sparkles, before they are inevitably unmasked as assholes.
Author: Laini Taylor,  Daughter of Smoke & Bone

Quote: Everyone disliked their partners at some time or another, she knew that. But she’d spent her hours in the dark wondering whether she’d ever liked him. Would it really have been so much worse to spend those years alone? Why did there have to be someone else in the room while she was eating, watching TV, sleeping?
Author: Nick Hornby,  Juliet, Naked

Quote: I had a dream about you last night.. You kept screaming at Ted Danson to pour you a drink.
Author: Amy Summers,  I Had a Dream About You

Quote: A pine tree standeth lonelyIn the North on an upland bare;It standeth whitely shroudedWith snow, and sleepeth there.It dreameth of a Palm treeWhich far in the East alone,In the mournful silence standethOn its ridge of burning stone.
Author: Heinrich Heine

Quote: Literature in the written sense represents the triumph of language over writing: the subversion of writing for purposes that have little or nothing to do with social and economic control.
Author: Robert Bringhurst,  The Solid Form of Language: An Essay on Writing and Meaning

Quote: Always suffer delusions of grandeur with your art. What you are unable to face will never hurt you
Author: Ginnetta Correli

Quote: ღ¸.•* Love is Colorblind *•.¸ღ
Author: M.G. Wells

Quote: That's why it's called a practice. We have to practice a practice if it is to be of value.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: Getting carried away is stupid, it won't get me anywhere.-Nana Komatsu
Author: Ai Yazawa

Quote: Doing what you wanted to do was the only training, and the only preliminary, needed for doing more of what you wanted to do.
Author: Kingsley Amis,  Lucky Jim

Quote: I take thee at thy word:Call me but love, and I'll be new baptized;Henceforth I never will be Romeo.
Author: William Shakespeare,  Romeo and Juliet

Quote: MANAGE YOUR MOOD: Name 1 thing that surprised you today...Name 1 thing that moved you...Name 1 thing that inspired you...
Author: Gino Norris

Quote: You do it for yourself. You don’t expect to change the world. You don’t even expect to influence your family or your friends. You do it because you can’t not do it and be who you are. Or who you’re meant to be.
Author: Martin Sheen

Quote: An intelligent woman is a goldmine! She has the ability to learn, reason and understand things better and faster than her contemporaries. She is competent, alert and can reason out stuffs easily.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: An intelligent woman is a goldmine! She has the ability to learn, reason and understand things better and faster than her contemporaries. She is competent, alert and can reason out stuffs easily.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: I realized that the good stories were affecting the organs of my body in various ways, and the really good ones were stimulating more than one organ. An effective story grabs your gut, tightens your throat, makes your heart race and your lungs pump, brings tears to your eyes or an explosion of laughter to your lips.
Author: Christopher Vogler,  The Writer's Journey: Mythic Structure for Writers

Quote: I started out of course with Hemingway when I learned how to write. Until I realized Hemingway doesn't have a sense of humor. He never has anything funny in his stories.
Author: Elmore Leonard

Quote: I started out of course with Hemingway when I learned how to write. Until I realized Hemingway doesn't have a sense of humor. He never has anything funny in his stories.
Author: Elmore Leonard

Quote: Every mother has to take care of her family.
Author: Kelly Long,  Sarah's Garden

Quote: There is only one you for all time. Fearlessly be yourself.
Author: Anthony Rapp

Quote: There is no tomorrow and there was no yesterday; if you truly want to accomplish your goals you must engulf yourself in today.
Author: Noel DeJesus

Quote: There is no tomorrow and there was no yesterday; if you truly want to accomplish your goals you must engulf yourself in today.
Author: Noel DeJesus

Quote: An average man is egoistic, proud and has strong self esteem. They always require partners who massage their ego not those who will drag their ego to the mud.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu
