Author: Deborah Day,  BE HAPPY NOW!

Quote: The Self-revealing of the Word is in every dimension - above, in creation; below, in the Incarnation; in the depth, in Hades; in the breadth, throughout the world. All things have been filled with the knowledge of God.
Author: Athanasius of Alexandria,  On the Incarnation

Quote: Time is too short in this one life, to be able to do everything, but it definitely is long enough at least to be able to develop the will to do anything & everything...
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: Do not do what you cannot continue to deliver.For, remember, the world wants to see a continuity of delivery of set standards...!
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: Because some information is better than no information. Life does not give you big, simple answers, Caitlyn. It demands patience, focus, and an open, intelligent mind to gather the pieces of a puzzle and fit them together into a coherent whole. Nothing worth knowing is ever easily learned.
Author: Lisa Cach,  Wake Unto Me

Quote: If you don't make the time to work on creating the life you want, you're eventually going to be forced to spend a LOT of time dealing with a life you don't want.
Author: Kevin Ngo,  Let's Do This! 100 Powerful Messages to Help You Take Action

Quote: Knowledge counts but common sense matters.
Author: LouAnne Johnson,  Dangerous Minds

Quote: Science fiction is very well suited to asking philosophical questions; questions about the nature of reality, what it means to be human, how do we know the things that we think we know.
Author: Ted Chiang

Quote: The range of human knowledge today is so great that we're all specialists and the distance between specializations has become so great that anyone who seeks to wander freely between them almost has to forego closeness with the people around him.
Author: Robert M. Pirsig

Quote: Knowledge unqualified is knowledge simply of something learned.
Author: Plato

Quote: We dream, we wake on a cold hillside, we pursue the dream again. In the beginning was the dream, and the work of disenchantment never ends.
Author: Kim Stanley Robinson,  Icehenge

Quote: There is no greater power than the one others do not believe you possess.
Author: Luis Marques,  Book of Orion - Liber Aeternus

Quote: There is no greater power than the one others do not believe you possess.
Author: Luis Marques,  Book of Orion - Liber Aeternus

Quote: The doorstep to the temple of wisdom is a knowledge of our own ignorance.
Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quote: a hero is just somebody who does the right thing when it would be far, far easier to do nothing.”-Cedric Diggory-
Author: G. Norman Lippert,  James Potter and the Hall of Elders' Crossing

Quote: Time changes all things; there is no reason why language should escape this universal law
Author: Ferdinand de Saussure,  Course in General Linguistics

Quote: I stepped from Plank to PlankSo slow and cautiouslyThe Stars about my Head I felt,About my Feet the Sea.I knew not but the nextWould be my final inch —This gave me that precarious GaitSome call Experience.
Author: Emily Dickinson,  The Complete Poems

Quote: You can only trust your emotions as you can lie to yourself with your brain but not your heart.
Author: Carl White

Quote: Any man who keeps working is not a failure. He may not be a great writer, but if he applies the old-fashioned virtues of hard, constant labor, he'll eventually make some kind of career for himself as writer."[1967 interview]
Author: Ray Bradbury

Quote: Why write stories? To join the conversation.
Author: Dorothy Allison,  Trash: Stories

Quote: If you have a painting in you, paint. If you have a song to sing, sing. Don’t judge your creation. Just create it. Banish doubt and fear and step out of your own way if you have to. Write if you’re a writer and invent if you’re an inventor. Do what you were born to do. Only then will you know a remarkable life.
Author: Toni Sorenson

Quote: What is more precious: a thousand answers derived from one question? Or, one answer…from a thousand questions?
Author: G.F. Smith

Quote: Belief isn't supposed to make sense, at least not all the time. In that, it finds its power. It gets to creep up on you and carry you forward. Until you can carry yourself again.
Author: Laura Dave,  The Divorce Party

Quote: Evil does not exist; once you have crossed the threshold, all is good. Once in another world, you must hold your tongue.
Author: Franz Kafka

Quote: There is no communication in this world except between equals.
Author: Ken Burns

Quote: كُنْ كما أنت، وستهديك نفسك إلى الصراط
Author: مصطفى محمود

Quote: An artist without ideas is a mendicant; barren, he goes begging among the hours.
Author: Irving Stone,  The Agony and the Ecstasy

Quote: Some women seem so voluptuous in every sense, richly bountiful and fertile with generous gifts of plenty, sensual and confident in their female strength that they are called "earth mothers."That’s how some days feel—when they are bountiful and fertile with the power of our imagination.
Author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

Quote: I'm interested in the way in which the past affects the present and I think that if we understand a good deal more about history, we automatically understand a great more about contemporary life.
Author: Toni Morrison

Quote: Where would we have been without the discoveries of our predecessors, and where are we going without your discoveries?
Author: Ogwo David Emenike

Quote: Goals are dreams with a deadline.
Author: Napoleon Hill

Quote: Luck? I don’t know anything about luck. I’ve never banked on it and I’m afraid of people who do. Luck to me is something else: hard work - and realizing what opportunity is and what isn’t."— Lucille Ball
Author: Lucille Ball

Quote: That’s what being alive is, Thing! It’s being badly prepared for everything! Because you only get one chance, Thing!
Author: Terry Pratchett,  Diggers

Quote: I am no nihilist. I am not even a cynic. I am, actually, rather romantic. And here’s my idea of romance: You will soon be dead. Life will sometimes seem long and tough and, god, it’s tiring. And you will sometimes be happy and sometimes sad. And then you’ll beold. And then you’ll be dead.
Author: Tim Minchin

Quote: Nothing is born into this world without labor.
Author: Rob Liano

Quote: First of all, let me assert my firm belief that the only thing we have to fear is fear itself - nameless, unreasoning, unjustified terror which paralyzes needed efforts to convert retreat into advance.
Author: Franklin D. Roosevelt

Quote: Because the development of inner calm & energy happens completely within & isn’t dependent on another person or a particular situation, we begin to feel a resourcefulness and independence that is quite beautiful—and a huge relief.
Author: Sharon Salzberg,  Real Happiness: The Power of Meditation

Quote: Everyone should strive to be a world citizen. Boundaries were created by man, not the Creator. There is no such thing as THEM vs. US. There is only 'WE'.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: What surrounds us is what is within us.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: When spontaneous demoralizing thoughts seep into your conscience, don't trip...allowing them to fester. These are random tests of your conviction and determination. Large or small, your reaction to such intrusions is a defining moment for which no one else, but you, can mitigate.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Christ did not die to save people, but to teach people how to save each other. This is, I have no doubt, a grave heresy, but it is also a fact.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Complete Letters of Oscar Wilde

Quote: The only thing that is still free in this world is religion, which is why a lot of people "find it.
Author: Jimmy Buffett,  A Pirate Looks at Fifty

Quote: Love is relentless, and so am I ;)
Author: Keisha Keenleyside

Quote: religion is no longer the opium of the people but the vitamin pills of the feeble.
Author: Régis Debray,  Media Manifestos: On the Technological Transmission of Cultural Forms

Quote: A working knowledge of the devil can be very well had from resisting him.
Author: Flannery O'Connor,  The Habit of Being: Letters of Flannery O'Connor

Quote: We are all too often told by someone that we are too old, too young, too different, too much the same, and those comments can be devastating.
Author: Sharon Salzberg,  The Force of Kindness: Change Your Life with Love & Compassion

Quote: I have always been resistant to doctrine, and any spirituality I had experienced thus far in my life had been much more abstract and not aligned with any recognized religion. For me, the most trustworthy vehicle for spirituality had always proven to be music. It cannot be manipulated, or politicized, and when it is, that becomes immediately obvious.
Author: Eric Clapton

Quote: Have you ever thought what a God would be like who actually ordained and executed the cruelty that is in [the biblical Book of Revelation]? A holocaust of mankind. Yet so many of these Bible-men accept the idea without a second thought.
Author: C.J. Sansom,  Revelation

Quote: Truth persuades by teaching, but does not teach by persuading.
Author: Tertullian

Quote: Getting an education is an awfully wearing process!
Author: Jean Webster,  Daddy-Long-Legs

Quote: Get out of your own way… stop the paralysis by analysis… decide what you want, create a simple plan, and get moving!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Success is realising the true joy and wonder of life can only be yours if you follow your own intuition, aiming to achieve your bliss.
Author: Steven Redhead,  The Solution

Quote: WINNER:is A Runner who “Wins Inspite Of Ninety Nine ExcellentRunners!
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: If you have a success you have it for the wrong reasons. If you become popular it is always because of the worst aspects of your work.
Author: Ernest Hemingway

Quote: Do not let your grand ambitions stand in the way of small but meaningful accomplishments.
Author: Bryant McGill

Quote: You cannot score a goal when you are sitting on the bench. To do so, you have to dress up and enter the game.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: I have always had the greatest respect for students. There is nothing I hate more than condescension—the attitude that they are inferior to you. I always assume they have good minds.
Author: Mark Van Doren

Quote: BREAKING NEWS: You're awesome and designed for success; live this day accordingly!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Integrity is a powerful force, keeping you alive to others long after you’ve left their presence.
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: Unless education promotes character making, unless it helps men to be more moral, more just to their fellows, more law abiding, more discriminatingly patriotic and public spirited, it is not worth the trouble taken to furnish it.
Author: William Howard Taft

Quote: If you are ready for the secret, you already possess one half of it,therefore, you will readily recognize the other half the moment it reaches your mind.
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich

Quote: Your sweet thank-you touches my heart, take my breath away, my only love. This day is only I have got.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: I’d compare college tuition to paying for a personal trainer at an athletic club. We professors play the roles of trainers, giving people access to the equipment (books, labs, our expertise) and after that, it is our job to be demanding.
Author: Randy Pausch,  The Last Lecture

Quote: The lake of my mind, unbroken by oars, heaves placidly and soon sinks into an oily somnolence.’ That will be useful.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  The Waves

Quote: Because you don't learn anything unless you can find the patience to read. TV takes that away from you. It robs you from your mind.
Author: Markus Zusak,  Underdog

Quote: When you’re busy, avoid taking the quickest action. Instead make the extra effort to truly serve the customer.
Author: Marilyn Suttle

Quote: We made love outdoors—without a roof, I like most, without stove, my favorite place, assuming the weather be fair and balmy, and the earth beneath be clean. Our souls intertwined and dripping with dew, and our love for each other was seen. Our love for the world was new.
Author: Roman Payne

Quote: Nobody think about that broken heart... life goes on, broken heart never join together but it tries very hard to get joined again. That;swhy may be it said "Heart is like a mirror, if its broken can never be joined.
Author: Shahid Islam

Quote: In 1971, after seven years in college, with that magic piece of paper clutched triumphantly in my fist, the best job I was able to get was night watchman on a sewer project in Babylon, N.Y. guarding a hole in the ground to prevent anyone from stealing it. God bless the American educational system!
Author: Spider Robinson,  The Callahan Chronicals (Callahan's Place Trilogy, #1-3)

Quote: THE soul should always stand ajar, That if the heaven inquire,He will not be obliged to wait, Or shy of troubling her.Depart, before the host has slid The bolt upon the door,To seek for the accomplished guest, -- Her visitor no more.
Author: Emily Dickinson,  The Complete Poems

Quote: It was after I first began to uplift my thoughts a bit that my cravings for junk food started to dissipate. I did not connect the two at that time. First, I simply noticed that I didn’t need to sleep so much. It took a while before I realized that in addition to my improved energy level, there was a direct correlation between chewing on mental garbage and putting garbage in my mouth.
Author: Holly Mosier

Quote: If the river has a soul, it's a peaceful one. If it has a lesson to impart, that lesson is patience. There will be drought, it says; there will be floods; the ice will form, the ice will melt; the water will flow and blend into the river's brackish mouth, then join the ocean between Lewes and Cape May, endlessly, forever, amen.
Author: Therese Anne Fowler,  Z: A Novel of Zelda Fitzgerald

Quote: Just like your body and lifestyle can be healthy or unhealthy, the same is true with your beliefs. Your beliefs can be your medicine or your poison.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Pessimists never go on a voyage of discovery, equally so they never leave the shoreline in search of new horizons.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: Success works as a cycle - growth and contraction, balancing and unbalancing - all while you're encountering hurdles that get higher and higher over time.
Author: Julien Smith,  The Flinch

Quote: Success does not consist in never making blunders, but in never making the same one a second time.
Author: Josh Billings

Quote: Have more humility. Remember you don't know the limits of your own abilities. Successful or not, if you keep pushing beyond yourself, you will enrich your own life – and maybe even please a few strangers.
Author: A.L. Kennedy

Quote: To ask, 'How do you do it?' is already starting off on the wrong foot. When reaching for the stars, there does not have to be a 'how' if there is a big enough 'why'.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: I am not simply teaching the reading; I am teaching the reader.
Author: Kelly Gallagher,  Readicide: How Schools Are Killing Reading and What You Can Do About It

Quote: Words are truly the image of the soul.
Author: Basil the Great

Quote: The mind is a powerful thing. It can take you through walls.
Author: Denis Avey,  The Man Who Broke Into Auschwitz: A True Story of World War II

Quote: He never reckoned much to schooling and that. He said you could learn most what was worth knowing from keeping your eyes and ears peeled. Best way of learning, he always said, was doing.
Author: Michael Morpurgo,  Farm Boy

Quote: One who swims with the tide and not the other side will benefit from the opportunity that flows.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Beliefs are not related to religion but they are basically about who you are.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Victory does not come to cowards;it comes to the brave ones.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: The soul may ask God for anything, and never fail.
Author: Annie Dillard,  Teaching a Stone to Talk: Expeditions and Encounters

Quote: For I need this scar over my heart to remind me. Crazy as it sounds, if I can bear the wound on my body, it lessens what I must carry on my soul. How he knew that about me, I cannot fathom.
Author: Ann Aguirre,  Aftermath

Quote: Let your wisdom guide youOn your own personal journey By listening to your heartYour soul will be alight And let you beAll that you are intended to be
Author: Karen Hackel,  The Whisper of Your Soul

Quote: ...primarily the individual is going to study at home.
Author: R. Buckminster Fuller,  Education Automation: Freeing the Scholar to Return to His Studies

Quote: Strength and success - they are above morality, above criticism. It seems, then, that it is not what you do, but how you do it and what you call it. Is there a check in men, deep in them, that stops or punishes? There doesn't seem to be. The only punishment is for failure. In effect no crime is committed unless a criminal is caught.
Author: John Steinbeck,  The Winter of Our Discontent

Quote: ... the greatest menace to our capacity for contemplation is the incessant fabrication of tawdry empty stimuli which kill the receptivity of the soul.
Author: Josef Pieper,  Happiness and Contemplation

Quote: I felt like some part of my soul was ripped out and put under a microscope for criticizing.
Author: Alysha Speer

Quote: Magic is a science.Miracle is the work.Mind is a laboratory.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: But there are weak men who can lift cars if their wives are pinned underneath. The brain, Garraty."McVries's voice had dropped to a hoarse whisper. "It isn’t man or God. It’s something...in the brain.
Author: Stephen King,  The Long Walk

Quote: في روح و عقل كل واحد منا شرارة صغيرة ربما تصبح من خلال النفخ فيها"نارًا عظيمة تضيء عقول و قلوب الملايين
Author: عبد الكريم بكار

Quote: Your future is only as bright as your mind is open.
Author: Rich Wilkins

Quote: We read each other through our eyes, and anatomically they are an extension of our brains. When we catch someone's eye, we look into a mind.
Author: Siri Hustvedt,  The Sorrows of an American

Quote: What chance combination of shadow and sound and his own thoughts had created it?
Author: Patricia Highsmith,  Strangers on a Train

Quote: A good reading strengthens the soul.
Author: Toba Beta

Quote: The advantage of the emotions is that they lead us astray, and the advantage of science is that it is not emotional.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: There are no foolish questions and no man becomes a fool until he has stopped asking questions.
Author: Charles Proteus Steinmetz

Quote: It took less than an hour to make the atoms, a few hundred million years to make the stars and planets, but five billion years to make man!
Author: George Gamow,  The Creation of the Universe

Quote: I don't know how many of you have ever met Dijkstra, but you probably know that arrogance in computer science is measured in nano-Dijkstras.
Author: Alan Kay

Quote: Although personally, I think cyberspace means the end of our species.
Author: Michael Crichton,  The Lost World

Quote: Sigmund Freud was a novelist with a scientific background. He just didn’t know he was a novelist. All those damn psychiatrists after him, they didn’t know he was a novelist either."(Interview in Writers at Work: The Paris Review Interviews, Eighth Series, ed. George Plimpton, 1988)
Author: John Irving

Quote: Discover the force of the skies O Men: once recognised it can be put to use.
Author: Johannes Kepler,  Epitome of Copernican Astronomy and Harmonies of the World

Quote: Science is essentially an anarchic enterprise: theoretical anarchism is more humanitarian and more likely to encourage progress than its law-and-order alternatives.
Author: Paul Karl Feyerabend,  Against Method: Outline of an Anarchistic Theory of Knowledge

Quote: Be humble for you are made of earth. Be noble for you are made of stars.
Author: Serbian Proverb

Quote: Footnote: In 1998, a woman in Saline, Michigan received a patent for a Decorative Penile Wrap...The patent included three pages of drawings, including a penis wearing a ghost outfit, another in the robes of the Grim Reaper, and one dressed up to look like a snowman.
Author: Mary Roach,  Bonk: The Curious Coupling of Science and Sex

Quote: A book with the genuine power to stir and comfort its readers.
Author: Mitch Albom

Quote: Yesterday we obeyed kings and bent our necks before emperors. But today we kneel only to truth, follow only beauty, and obey only love.
Author: Khalil Gibran

Quote: Love is blind; friendship closes its eyes.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: Love is blind; friendship closes its eyes.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: You can't go into new life experiences without the understanding that yeah, you may fail, but knowing you might fail can't stop you from trying.
Author: Alice Dreger

Quote: I don't know what keeps me going. Sometimes I wonder... I think it's just pure perseverance and wanting to succeed and having that burning desire to always have success.
Author: Tanya Tucker

Quote: Everyone has read about or knows someone who has gone through fertility treatments. It is an emotional nightmare, fueled by false hope and the promise of a treatment that will work.
Author: Ann Hood

Quote: When love is not madness, it is not love.
Author: Pedro Calderon de la Barca

Quote: Magic's an art where you use slight of hand or illusion to create wonder. And I was just intrigued with that idea.
Author: David Blaine

Quote: Today's business and health care climate may not be pleasant. Cutbacks, pay cuts and layoffs do not make anyone's job easy. But that does not mean that the humor need stop.
Author: Allen Klein

Quote: Faith in the possibilities of continued and rigorous inquiry does not limit access to truth to any channel or scheme of things. It does not first say that truth is universal and then add there is but one road to it.
Author: John Dewey,  A Common Faith

Quote: Aristotle may be regarded as the cultural barometer of Western history. Whenever his influence dominated the scene, it paved the way for one of history's brilliant eras; whenever it fell, so did mankind.
Author: Ayn Rand

Quote: It would be, for me, mere pointless pleasure, an illusion of order for this one frail, foolish, flicker-flash in the long dull fall of eternity.
Author: John Gardner,  Grendel

Quote: There is a danger there - a very real danger to humanity. Consider, Watson, that the material, the sensual, the worldly would all prolong their worthless lives. The spiritual would not avoid the call to something higher. It would be the survival of the least fit. What sort of cesspool may not our poor world become?
Author: Arthur Conan Doyle,  The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes

Quote: Reason is the power or capacity whereby we see or detect logical relationships among propositions.
Author: Alvin Plantinga,  Warranted Christian Belief

Quote: The bird of paradise alights only upon the hand that does not grasp.
Author: John Berry

Quote: The bird of paradise alights only upon the hand that does not grasp.
Author: John Berry

Quote: The bird of paradise alights only upon the hand that does not grasp.
Author: John Berry

Quote: This is the concentration camp and crematorium at Auschwitz. This is where people were turned into numbers. Into this pond were flushed the ashes of some four million people. And that was not done by gas. It was done by arrogance. It was done by dogma. It was done by ignorance. When people believe that they have absolute knowledge, with no test in reality, this is how they behave.
Author: Jacob Bronowski,  The Ascent of Man

Quote: Time is just quantified eternity.
Author: Deepak Chopra,  The Way of the Wizard: Twenty Spiritual Lessons for Creating the Life You Want

Quote: There lies before us, if we choose, continual progress in happiness, knowledge and wisdom. Shall we instead choose death, because we cannot forget our quarrels? I appeal as a human being to human beings; remember your humanity, and forget the rest.
Author: Bertrand Russell

Quote: Future is one of the wildest experiences that you will ever have.
Author: J.T.Abraham

Quote: Future is one of the wildest experiences that you will ever have.
Author: J.T.Abraham

Quote: Future is one of the wildest experiences that you will ever have.
Author: J.T.Abraham

Quote: The same word we love and hate, leaves in different directions, taking different paths.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

Quote: The same word we love and hate, leaves in different directions, taking different paths.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Sun Watches the Sun

Quote: Don't write to sell, write to tell.
Author: Jonas Eriksson

Quote: If you wish to make Pythocles rich, do not add to his store of money, but subtract from his desires.
Author: Epicurus

Quote: If you wish to make Pythocles rich, do not add to his store of money, but subtract from his desires.
Author: Epicurus

Quote: Nobody is good or bad. They are either strong or weak. Strong people stick to their morals, no matter what the trials and tribulations. Weak people, many a times, do not even realise how low they have fallen.
Author: Amish Tripathi,  The Secret of the Nagas

Quote: Kim olursak olalım, dünyanın hangi yerinde yaşarsak yaşayalım, ta derinlerde bir yerde hepimiz bir eksiklik duygusu taşımaktayız. Sanki temel bir şeyimizi kaybetmişiz de geri alamamaktan korkuyoruz. Neyin eksik olduğunu bilenimizde hakikaten çok az.
Author: Elif Shafak

Quote: All modern philosophizing is political, policed by governments, churches, academics, custom, fashion, and human cowardice, all off which limit it to a fake learnedness.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Philosophy in the Tragic Age of the Greeks

Quote: To Trin Tragula's horror, the shock completely annihilated her brain; but to his satisfaction he realized that he had proved conclusively that if life is going to exist in a Universe of this size, then the one thing it cannot afford to have is a sense of proportion.
Author: Douglas Adams,  The Restaurant at the End of the Universe

Quote: When your tears become invisible, disappear
Author: Benny Bellamacina

Quote: A few dud universes can really clutter up your basement.
Author: Neal Stephenson,  In the Beginning...Was the Command Line

Quote: Can a woman not walk with her possessions down the street of a city?
Author: Brandon Sanderson,  The Way of Kings

Quote: I believe in political solutions to political problems. But man's primary problems aren't political; they're philosophical. Until humans can solve their philosophical problems, they're condemned to solve their political problems over and over and over again. It's a cruel, repetitious bore.
Author: Tom Robbins,  Even Cowgirls Get the Blues

Quote: It's not enough merely to exist. Every man has to seek in his own way to make his own self more noble and to relize his own true worth.
Author: Albert Schweitzer

Quote: Laughter is the hand of God on the shoulder of a troubled world.
Author: Grady Nutt

Quote: I had a microscopic eye for the blemish, for the grain of ugliness which to me constituted the sole beauty of the object.
Author: Henry Miller,  Tropic of Capricorn

Quote: One says the things which one feels the need to say, and which the other will not understand: one speaks for oneself alone.
Author: Marcel Proust

Quote: Imagination is cheap as long as you don't have to worry about the details.
Author: Daniel C. Dennett,  Freedom Evolves

Quote: Imagination is cheap as long as you don't have to worry about the details.
Author: Daniel C. Dennett,  Freedom Evolves

Quote: ...as I get older, I find myself insisting on my right to be philosophically sloppy.
Author: Helen Simonson,  Major Pettigrew's Last Stand

Quote: Love will never let you down, if you don't give it up
Author: Benny Bellamacina

Quote: Love will never let you down, if you don't give it up
Author: Benny Bellamacina

Quote: Usually when people talk about the trickle-down theory, it has to do with economics. The richer people at the top of a society become, supposedly, the more wealth there is to trickle down to the people below. It never really works out that way, of course, because if there are 2 things people at the top can't stand, they have to be leakage and overflow.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Hocus Pocus

Quote: The Purpose of Philosophy is to fall in Love. To strip the world of all its clothes, and fall in Love with it as it stand before you completely naked.
Author: Ilyas Kassam

Quote: Did you have a rough month? I did :( but, you know what? There’s no time to dwell on a missed opportunity or worry about what I should’ve done or said, beating myself up & making myself miserable about my mistakes. That doesn’t work. So will take notes from that, put it behind me, move on & finish the year STRONG
Author: Pablo

Quote: Did you have a rough month? I did :( but, you know what? There’s no time to dwell on a missed opportunity or worry about what I should’ve done or said, beating myself up & making myself miserable about my mistakes. That doesn’t work. So will take notes from that, put it behind me, move on & finish the year STRONG
Author: Pablo

Quote: When a youth was giving himself airs in the Theatre and saying, 'I am wise, for I have conversed with many wise men,' Epictetus replied, 'I too have conversed with many rich men, yet I am not rich!’.
Author: Epictetus

Quote: Incredibly intelligent people always seem odd to those who are not as sharp.
Author: Alexei Maxim Russell,  Why Not-World

Quote: Don't show a friend your gift, or your bag of money if you still want to maintain your relationship, but if nay, go on, and all you'll see is hate and jealousy, and you'll fight with him in the street like a dog and all you'll feel is regret.
Author: Michael Bassey Johnson

Quote: I think now that maybe true sweetness can only happen in limbo.
Author: Peter Heller,  The Dog Stars

Quote: True happiness is when the love that is within us finds expression in external activities.
Author: Mata Amritanandamayi

Quote: There can be many opinions on a thing, but there is only one truth."Vashet smiled lazily. "And if the pursuit of the truth was my goal, that would concern me."She gave a long yawn, stretching like a happy cat. "Instead I will focus on the joy in my heart, [...}
Author: Patrick Rothfuss,  The Wise Man's Fear

Quote: And Nedley started saying,'Shut Up!Quit that! And i knew it really meant something to him. So I asked for his help,"Mark said. "Don't tell the story like that,"Nedley laughed. "What he said was 'Quit pretendin you're a bad guy I need your help, and I need it now!
Author: Margaret Peterson Haddix,  Among the Brave

Quote: Childbirth is normal until proven otherwise.
Author: Peggy Vincent,  Baby Catcher: Chronicles of a Modern Midwife

Quote: A house divided cannot stand.
Author: Abraham Lincoln

Quote: In a battle of believability, the winner is the one with the best body language, not the clearest logic.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: You think money can solve any problem, but all it s good for is buying the things it can, and leaving you free to pursue the things it can't.
Author: Ann Herendeen,  Phyllida and the Brotherhood of Philander : a Bisexual Regency Romance

Quote: It's not enough to be nice in life. You've got to have nerve.
Author: Georgia O'Keeffe

Quote: Nurturing, Providing, and loving you passionately. May that be, my number of responsibilities. As one to the end, forever more. That's how long I desire, our love to last for. Providing for you many and joyful memories. In hours of darkness, as well as brightness. I plan to supply for you. For your love for me and happiness, is all that matters to me.
Author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett,  Friends 2 Lovers: The Unthinkable

Quote: Speak up, stand up, and keep correcting the false perceptions. Stay true to your heart's views and keep chanting for peace and justice.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Happiness,... even the smallest happiness, is like a step out of Time, and the greatest happiness is sharing in Eternity.
Author: Josef Pieper,  Happiness and Contemplation

Quote: It is in the balancing of your spirituality with your humanity that you will find immeasurable happiness, success, good health, and love.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: It is in the balancing of your spirituality with your humanity that you will find immeasurable happiness, success, good health, and love.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: True happiness is not found in any other reward than that of being united with God. If I seek some other reward besides God Himself, I may get my reward but I cannot be happy.
Author: Thomas Merton,  No Man Is an Island

Quote: True happiness is not found in any other reward than that of being united with God. If I seek some other reward besides God Himself, I may get my reward but I cannot be happy.
Author: Thomas Merton,  No Man Is an Island

Quote: It’s true that laughter really is cheap medicine. It’s a prescription anyone can afford. And best of all, you can fill it right now.
Author: Steve Goodier

Quote: And although it might be best of all to be Socrates satisfied, having both happiness and depth, we would give up some happiness in order to gain the depth.
Author: Robert Nozick,  Examined Life: Philosophical Meditations

Quote: Bombs have kill-radiuses; churches should have love-radiuses--anyone within twenty miles of a church should know it.
Author: Tyler Edwards,  Zombie Church: Breathing Life Back Into the Body of Christ

Quote: Sister - if all this is true, what could I do or undo?
Author: Sophocles,  Antigone

Quote: I take leave to contradict those who say that salvation is an evolution! All that ever can be evolved out of the sinful heart of man is sin-and nothing else! Salvation is the free gift of God, by Jesus Christ, and the work of it is supernatural. It is done by the Lord Himself, and He has power to do it, however weak, no, however dead in sin, the sinner may be!
Author: Charles Haddon Spurgeon

Quote: Ultimately, totalitarianism is the only sort of politics that can truly serve the sky-god's purpose. Any movement of a liberal nature endangers his authority and that of his delegates on earth. One God, one King, one Pope, one master in the factory, one father-leader in the family at home.
Author: Gore Vidal

Quote: God is only a word dreamed up to explain the world
Author: Gustave Flaubert

Quote: Can a mortal ask questions which God finds unanswerable? Quite easily, I should think. All nonsense questions are unanswerable.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: Can a mortal ask questions which God finds unanswerable? Quite easily, I should think. All nonsense questions are unanswerable.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: Great minds think alike because a greater Mind is thinking through them.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: When you are convinced that everything that happens is the will of God, what is there to do but wait until God has mercy?
Author: Maaza Mengiste,  Beneath the Lion's Gaze

Quote: Rafael?””Yeah?”„Do we all have monsters?”„Yes.”„Why does God give us so many monsters?”„You want to know my theory?”„Sure.”„I think it’s other people who give us monsters. Maybe God doesn’t have anything to do with it.
Author: Benjamin Alire Sáenz,  Last Night I Sang to the Monster

Quote: And fragile is thy tenure of this worldStill haunted by the monstrous ghost of God.("To Science")
Author: George Sterling,  The Thirst of Satan: Poems of Fantasy and Terror

Quote: If we had more sleepless nights in prayer, there would be fewer souls to have a sleepless eternal night in hell.
Author: Leonard Ravenhill,  Revival God's Way

Quote: I cared about them. I wanted them to feel better, to live better lives. And then it occurred to me - I cared about myself. I wanted me to live a better life, too Caring about myself was allowing me to care about others.
Author: Cate Tiernan,  Immortal Beloved

Quote: Here is little habit that can make a big difference. Send sunbeams. Intentionally send a word of encouragement or appreciation every day to one person.
Author: Steve Goodier

Quote: There are two kinds of hope: the kind you couldn't do anything about and the kind you could. And even if the kind you could do something about wasn't what you'd originally wanted, it was still worth doing. A rainy day is better than no day. A small happiness can make a big sadness less sad.
Author: Rachel Simon,  The Story of Beautiful Girl

Quote: There are still Ava Maddoxes to find and sets to create and girls to kiss and colleges to attend. It's possible that someday I will hear a patsy Cline song and the heartbreak will barely register. It will be some distant, buried feeling. I won't remember how much it once hurt.
Author: Nina LaCour,  Everything Leads to You

Quote: What comes, when it comes, will be what it is.
Author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Collected Poems of Alberto Caeiro

Quote: I wish we had the technology to fight God on an equal basis. To beard him in his den. To fight back for all of the injustices heaped on humanity. To allow him to alter his smug arrogance or be blown to hell.
Author: Dan Simmons,  The Fall of Hyperion

Quote: Each life experience poses this question: how do you want to be changed because of me?
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: Excuse me, I feel interrupted and I think I've overdose from the idea of loving you.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: Excuse me, I feel interrupted and I think I've overdose from the idea of loving you.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: There is no hope for the hopeless but there is always some love for the loveless.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: But miracles are not for the asking; they come only when the stern eyes of God droop shut for a moment, and Our Lady takes advantage of His inattention to grant an illicit mercy. God...is an Anglican, whereas Our Lady is of the True Faith; the two of Them have an uneasy relationship, unable to agree on anything, except that if They divorce, the Devil will leap gleefully into the breach.
Author: Michel Faber,  The Crimson Petal and the White

Quote: When all else is lost, the future still remains.
Author: Christian Bovee

Quote: Brooklyn was a dream. All the things that happened there just couldn't happen. It was all dream stuff. Or was it all real and true and was it that she, Francie, was the dreamer?
Author: Betty Smith,  A Tree Grows in Brooklyn

Quote: We may be helpless to stop bad things from happening, but perhaps God leaves us signs and road maps to help us recover and reconnect, provided we know where to look.
Author: Jennifer Gardner Trulson,  Where You Left Me

Quote: To love is to soar in the wild unexpectedly.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: To love is to soar in the wild unexpectedly.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I honestly do not know if love vanquishes death as our traditional faiths teach but I do know that our vulnerabilities trump our ideologies and that love leavens the purity and logic of our beliefs propelling us to connect as the fiercely gracious human beings we are.
Author: Irwin Kula

Quote: It seems to me some people just go around lookin' to get their faith unsettled. That has been the fashion for the last hundred years or so.
Author: Marilynne Robinson,  Gilead

Quote: In all my travels, I've never seen a country's population more determined to forgive, and to build and succeed than in Rwanda.
Author: Rick Warren,  The Bishop of Rwanda: Finding Forgiveness Amidst a Pile of Bones

Quote: Sometimes I ask God what I did to deserve her love. I maintain my innocence, and of all the forms of God’s wrath from plagues, pestilence, and famine, her love is by far the cruelest.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: It was just like him, she thought; with him, a happy ending was always a foregone conclusion. But such was the power of his faith that when she was with him; she found herself believing in happy endings, too.
Author: Sharon Kay Penman,  When Christ and His Saints Slept

Quote: Something about being rejected at Church Camp felt so much more awful than being rejected at school.
Author: Craig Thompson,  Blankets

Quote: Some acts of faith, I believe, have the power to grant us something infinitely wiser than we imagine
Author: Ursula Hegi,  Floating in My Mother's Palm

Quote: Never hide your fear because it will become your own God, hidden inside you.
Author: Sorin Cerin,  Wisdom Collection: The Book of Wisdom

Quote: Then I knew that the sign I had asked for was not a little thing, not a passing nod of recognition, and a phrase came back to me from my childhood of the veil of the temple being rent from top to bottom.
Author: Evelyn Waugh,  Brideshead Revisited

Quote: I need no master to punish me in order to behave as I ought. If I did, I would be no more than a child who obeys his father's rules only because he fears the whip, and not because he actually means good.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Inheritance

Quote: While fear depletes power, faith gives wings for the soul’s elevation.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: While fear depletes power, faith gives wings for the soul’s elevation.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: He cursed himself for having assumed the weather would be sunny. Perhaps it was the result of evolution, he thought--some adaptive gene that allowed the English to go on making blithe outdoor plans in the face of almost certain rain.
Author: Helen Simonson,  Major Pettigrew's Last Stand

Quote: Faith: a device of the mind, fed by the soul, that functions like crutches to a man in a wheelchair.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: Of course, in our train of thought, we would all like to think we're on the right track, or at least the same railroad company as the right track.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: This is the story of how Dad lived with his lung cancer. But it is much more. Through his illness and the miracles we experienced, I came to see that Dad's was not just a journey. It was a journey home. Home to God.
Author: Joseph M. Hanneman,  The Journey Home: My Father's Story of Cancer, Faith and Life-Changing Miracles

Quote: This is the story of how Dad lived with his lung cancer. But it is much more. Through his illness and the miracles we experienced, I came to see that Dad's was not just a journey. It was a journey home. Home to God.
Author: Joseph M. Hanneman,  The Journey Home: My Father's Story of Cancer, Faith and Life-Changing Miracles

Quote: we need not avoid our active lives, but simply bring to them a new vision and shift of gravity. for in the center we are rooted in god's love. in such a place there is no need for striving and impatience and dashing about seeking approval.
Author: Sue Monk Kidd,  God's Joyful Surprise: Finding Yourself Loved

Quote: The most important lesson that we're supposed to be learning right now is how completely lost we are without God. If we don't learn this lesson, then our lives are going to have zero meaning. (Stronger: Forty Days of Metal and Spirituality)
Author: Brian "Head"Welch

Quote: The most important lesson that we're supposed to be learning right now is how completely lost we are without God. If we don't learn this lesson, then our lives are going to have zero meaning. (Stronger: Forty Days of Metal and Spirituality)
Author: Brian "Head"Welch

Quote: those who have loved are those that have found God
Author: Guru Nanak

Quote: those who have loved are those that have found God
Author: Guru Nanak

Quote: Protestants believe that the sacraments are like ladders that God gave to us by which we can climb up to Him. Catholics believe that they are like ladders that God gave to Himself by which He climbs down to us.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: It takes years and maturity to make the discovery that the power of faith is nobler than the power of doubt; and that there is a celestial wisdom in the ingenuous propensity to trust, which belongs to honest and noble natures.
Author: Harriet Beecher Stowe,  The Pearl of Orr's Island: A Story of the Coast of Maine

Quote: The day you learn to be publically specific in your prayer, that is the day you will discover power.
Author: David Wilkerson,  The Cross and the Switchblade

Quote: We oft know little of who we were, only something of who we are, and nothing of who we may be.
Author: Charlie Fletcher,  Silvertongue

Quote: Time after time have nations, ay, and rich and strong nations, learned in the arts, been, and passed away to be forgotten, so that no memory of them remains. This is but one of several; for Time eats up the works of man.
Author: H. Rider Haggard,  She

Quote: In my small way, I preserved and catalogued, and dipped into the vast ocean of learning that awaited, knowing all the time that the life of one man was insufficient for even the smallest part of the wonders that lay within. It is cruel that we are granted the desire to know, but denied the time to do so properly. We all die frustrated; it is the greatest lesson we have to learn.
Author: Iain Pears,  An Instance of the Fingerpost

Quote: To be agreeable in society, you must consent to be taught many things which you already know.
Author: Charles Maurice de Talleyrand-Périgord

Quote: I am powerful in my love for myself. The truth of my being is I love myself exactly as I am. I honor my empowered heart.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree,  The Spiritual Girl's Guide to Dating: Your Enlightened Path to Love, Sex, & Soul Mates

Quote: Deeply respecting yourself is the first step toward having a deep respect for others.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree,  The Spiritual Girl's Guide to Dating: Your Enlightened Path to Love, Sex, & Soul Mates

Quote: Create your best life with your consciously chosen thoughts, words, and actions.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Daily love and kindness are the path to a happy life.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: I want to disabuse people of the idea that knowledge is power. Knowing how to get to Detroit is not the same thing as having the bus fare.
Author: Andrew Vachss

Quote: The power of thought is the light of knowledge, the power of will is the energy of character, the power of heart is love. Reason, love and power of will are perfections of man.
Author: Ludwig Feuerbach,  The Essence of Christianity

Quote: Only through Beauty's morning-gate, dost thou penetrate the land of knowledge.
Author: Friedrich Schiller

Quote: I believe in miracles.... I have to.
Author: Terry Fox

Quote: Opportunities? They are all around us ... There is power lying latent everywhere waiting for the observant eye to discover it.
Author: Orison Swett Marden

Quote: It Hurts...It Kills...It Teaches...It Thrills...“IT” Is LIFE...!
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: One had to live a long time to know a man's true nature.
Author: Gabriel Garcí­a Márquez,  Love in the Time of Cholera

Quote: ...znanje u nekoj tački počinje da te ograničava, a neznanje - nikad.
Author: Marko Šelić,  Zajedno sami

Quote: The greatest thing you will ever give to the world is your committment to leave what you find in better condition than the way you found it. Leave a single light in a place where there was once darkness so those coming behind you may see further and begin where you left.
Author: Tonny K. Brown

Quote: Musicians have always had a better understanding of love than the rest of us. Over the years they have told us that love: is like a rock, is here to stay, is all you need, will find a way, will keep us together, will tear us apart, sucks.
Author: Cuthbert Soup,  Another Whole Nother Story

Quote: The only thing more dangerous than ignorance is the pretense of intelligent ignorance. The former is teachable; the latter is not.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: We the people have no excuse for starry-eyed sycophantic group-think in the Information Age. Knowledge is but a fingertip away.
Author: Tiffany Madison

Quote: He will one day meet his true love... A fellow traveler on the road... Her eyes will be his ocean... In her ocean he will sail forever....
Author: Kem,  Tales of a Chocolate Smuggler: My Life with Dragons

Quote: All we know is what we're told.
Author: Ashly Lorenzana

Quote: If you want to really know something you have to observe or experience it in person; if you claim to know something on the basis of hearsay, or on happening to see it in a book, you'll be a laughingstock to those who really know.
Author: Jonathan D. Spence,  Emperor of China: Self-Portrait of K'ang-Hsi

Quote: For every dilemma, find at least three or four possible solutions. The creative process leads to better results.
Author: Marilyn Suttle,  Who's Your Gladys?: How to Turn Even the Most Difficult Customer Into Your Biggest Fan

Quote: We make choices every day, some of them good, some of them bad. And if we are strong enough, we live with the consequences.
Author: David Gemmell

Quote: Hatred is a louder exhibition of inability.
Author: Qaisar Iqbal Janjua

Quote: A person must earn enlightenment, Eragon. It is not handed down to you by others, regardless of how revered they be.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Brisingr

Quote: I've decided that there isn't much difference in the way we treat our siblings and the way we treat our special someones. But at the end of it all we know our siblings have to forgive us...or they'll never be able to borrow our car.
Author: Emma Daley

Quote: When all one person do is complain, people don't want to talk or listen to them.
Author: Jonathan Anthony Burkett

Quote: Generosity is to help a deserving person without his request, and if you help him after hisrequest, then it is either out of self-respect or to avoid rebuke.
Author: Hazrat Ali ibn Abu-Talib

Quote: Men brave and generous live the best lives, seldom will they sorrow; then there are fools, afraid of everything, who grumble instead of giving.
Author: Anonymous,  The Poetic Edda

Quote: No power and no treasure can outweigh the extension of our knowledge.
Author: Democritus

Quote: When you enter a grove peopled with ancient trees, higher than the ordinary, and shutting out the sky with their thickly inter-twined branches, do not the stately shadows of the wood, the stillness of the place, and the awful gloom of this doomed cavern then strike you with the presence of a deity?
Author: Luci Anneu Sèneca

Quote: Anguish is the universal language
Author: Alice Fulton

Quote: Even after the stormiest weather, a true warrior will still reflect the brilliant rays of the magnificent sun through both his or her eyes. You may get hit by sudden lighting or take severe beatings from the cruel wind, but you will always get back up and stand strong on your feet again, soak in the sunlight, and be prepared to get hit by even the most merciless hail - time and time again.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: He had had a severe shock some weeks earlier, when, having narrowly failed to capture a large grey-brown hare for his dinner, it had stopped at the edge of the forest, looked at him with disdain, and said, 'Well, I hope you're proud of yourself, that's all,' and had scampered off into the long grass
Author: Neil Gaiman,  Stardust

Quote: The power of hope! Even a lack of ambition can, for a time, pay off as a necessary facet, as long as hope outweighs it.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: The power of hope! Even a lack of ambition can, for a time, pay off as a necessary facet, as long as hope outweighs it.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: The little boy nodded at the peony and the peony seemed to nod back. The little boy was neat, clean and pretty. The peony was unchaste, dishevelled as peonies must be, and at the height of its beauty.(...) Every hour is filled with such moments, big with significance for someone.
Author: Robertson Davies,  What's Bred in the Bone

Quote: I may grow rich by an art I am compelled to follow; I may recover health by medicines I am compelled to take against my own judgment; but I cannot be saved by a worship I disbelieve and abhor.
Author: Thomas Jefferson

Quote: Contrary to what we've been told, life is simple. We complicate matters with our choices.
Author: Michelle Richardson

Quote: Aim for what u want and the year will all make a sense.
Author: Cecelia Ahern

Quote: It is the kindness to take in a stranger when the levees break; the selflessness of workers who would rather cut their hours than see a friend lose their job which sees us through our darkest hours. It is the firefighter's courage to storm a stairway filled with smoke, but also a parent's willingness to nurture a child, that finally decides our fate.
Author: Barack Obama

Quote: No matter how much you know, your destiny depends on the Wisdom, Knowledge and Understanding you display.
Author: James C. Uwandu,  Almost the Whole Thing

Quote: Shut up and write.
Author: K.A. Laity

Quote: Second half of the year starts NOW July 1st with the next 6 months being MORE important than the last 6 months. I Your Name promise to do all that I can to achieve my Goal . I will not sit on a corner wait I will seek my opportunity. I promise to go after my Goal with passion knowing that the clock is ticking… Sign and date
Author: Pablo

Quote: Your life is a movie. You are the main character. You say your scripts and act to your lines. Of course you do your lines in each scene. There is a hidden camera and a director who you can ask for help anytime up above.
Author: Diana Rose Morcilla

Quote: Your life is a movie. You are the main character. You say your scripts and act to your lines. Of course you do your lines in each scene. There is a hidden camera and a director who you can ask for help anytime up above.
Author: Diana Rose Morcilla

Quote: National identity is the last bastion of the dispossessed. But the meaning of identity is now based on hatred, on hatred for those who are not the same.
Author: Umberto Eco,  The Prague Cemetery

Quote: ...Catholic versus Protestant, essentially. It's that kind of fight. ... And it goes on to this day. Will we never learn? Who knows? Religion. Shit it.
Author: Stephen Fry

Quote: Comedy is a necessity to get through life with the fewest scars. Humor is the best antidote to help relieve all struggles.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: i was lieing to myself when I thought I was lost, I have never been lost - I just wasn't ready to be found.
Author: Nikki Rowe

Quote: The night is still waiting.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic,  Circling: 1978-1987

Quote: We need to eliminate the concept of division by class, skills, race, income, religion, and nationality. Every human requires food and water to survive and every human has a heart that bleeds, loves, and grieves.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: We need to eliminate the concept of division by class, skills, race, income, religion, and nationality. Every human requires food and water to survive and every human has a heart that bleeds, loves, and grieves.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Always be wary of people who use quotes. I don't know who said that.' - Murdoc Niccals
Author: Gorillaz,  Gorillaz: Rise of the Ogre

Quote: I shall drink to the Pope, if you please, still, to conscience first, and to the Pope afterwards.
Author: John Henry Newman

Quote: لما رأى المتيقظون سطوة الدنيا بأهلها, وخداع الأمل لأربابه, وتملك الشيطان قياد النفوس, ورأوا الدولة للنفس الأمارة؛ لجأوا إلى حصن التضرع والالتجاء؛ كما يأوي العبد المذعور إلى حرم سيده
Author: ابن قيم الجوزية

Quote: He has done things that caused me to doubt His wisdom, but never His existence.
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: The energy it took to exit mother’s womb is the same force required to manifest a dream...a different kind of struggle. Push, push, push!
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: From the cradle to the grave, joy and pain is the fertilizer for wisdom.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Divide the constant tide and random noisiness of energetic flow, with conscious recurring moments of empty mind, solitude, gratitude and deep...slow...breathing. Of this, the natural law of self-preservation demands.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Divide the constant tide and random noisiness of energetic flow, with conscious recurring moments of empty mind, solitude, gratitude and deep...slow...breathing. Of this, the natural law of self-preservation demands.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Whoever has My commandments and keeps them loves Me. And he who loves Me will be loved by My Father, and I will love him and show Myself to him.
Author: Anonymous

Quote: الدين إجابة على سؤال كيف تحيا في ذاتك وتواجه هذه الذات ، وليس إجابة على سؤال كيف تعيش في العالم مع الآخرين.
Author: علي عزت بيجوفيتش,  الإسلام بين الشرق والغرب

Quote: We are enjoined to love our neighbor, not our tribe.
Author: Chris Hedges

Quote: The key ingredient to any kind of happiness or success is to never give less than your best
Author: Russell Simmons

Quote: Last year, millions of students didn’t graduate from high school. They didn’t drop out, they were simply in elementary and middle schools.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: The ultimate goal of the educational system is to shift to the individual the burden of pursing his own education. This will not be a widely shared pursuit until we get over our odd conviction that education is what goes on in school buildings and nowhere else.
Author: John W. Gardner

Quote: You will not reap the fruit of individuality in your children if you clone their education.
Author: Marilyn Howshall

Quote: Some men never recover from education.
Author: Oliver St. John Gogarty,  It Isn't This Time of Year at All: An Unpremeditated Autobiography

Quote: We as economic society are going to have to pay our whole population to go to school and pay it to stay at school.
Author: R. Buckminster Fuller,  Education Automation: Freeing the Scholar to Return to His Studies

Quote: Ambition is not what a man would do, but what a man does, for ambition without action is fantasy.
Author: Bryant McGill

Quote: Most children, even very bright ones, need constant review and practice to truly own a concept in grammar, math or science. In schools today, on paper it may appear that kids are learning skills, but in reality they are only renting them, soon to forget what they've learned over the weekend or summer vacation.
Author: Rafe Esquith,  Lighting Their Fires: Raising Extraordinary Children in a Mixed-up, Muddled-up, Shook-up World

Quote: Education is the preparation of a child intellectually, emotionally, spiritually, and physically for life and for eternity.
Author: Kevin Swanson,  Upgrade: 10 Secrets to the Best Education for Your Child

Quote: I suppose the secret of his success is in his tremendous idleness which almost approaches the supernatural.
Author: Lawrence Durrell,  Justine

Quote: Do the best you can, with what you can, while you can, and success in inevitable.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Orthodoxy is a relaxation of the mind accompanied by a stiffening of the heart.
Author: Edward Abbey,  A Voice Crying in the Wilderness

Quote: We think to dance, and dance in thought. But to hibernate in the mind, is to bring upon us an apocalypse of the Soul.
Author: Ilyas Kassam

Quote: We think to dance, and dance in thought. But to hibernate in the mind, is to bring upon us an apocalypse of the Soul.
Author: Ilyas Kassam

Quote: When we are connected to the source, we will not be afraid of any task set before us.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: fanaticism is the only way to put an end to the doubts that constantly trouble the human soul.
Author: Paulo Coelho,  The Zahir

Quote: In monasteries, seminaries, retreats and synagogues, they fear hell and seek paradise. Those who know the mysteries of God never let that seed be planted in their souls.
Author: Omar Khayyám,  Quatrains

Quote: Success in this world depends on knowing exactly how little effort each job is worth...distribution of energy...
Author: Evelyn Waugh,  Vile Bodies

Quote: Ready comprehension is often a knee-jerk response and the most dangerous form of understanding. It blinks an opaque screen over your ability to learn. Be warned. Understand nothing. All comprehension is temporary.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Chapterhouse: Dune

Quote: The utmost form of respect is to give sincerely of your presence.
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: Most doctors are prisoners of their education and shackled by their profession.
Author: Richard Diaz

Quote: What do teachers and curriculum directors mean by 'value' reading? A look at the practice of most schools suggests that when a school 'values' reading what it really means is that the school intensely focuses on raising state-mandated reading test scores- the kind of reading our students will rarely, if ever, do in adulthood.
Author: Kelly Gallagher,  Readicide: How Schools Are Killing Reading and What You Can Do About It

Quote: Our moral economy went bankrupt long before our financial one.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: I'm not trying to tell you,"he said "that only educated men are able to contribute something valuable to the world. It's not so.But I do say that educated and scholarly men, if they're brilliant and creative to begin with--which, unfortunately, is rarely the case--tend to leave infinitely more valuable records behind them than men do who are MEREly brilliant and creative.
Author: J.D. Salinger,  The Catcher in the Rye

Quote: ...a butterfly is like the soul of a person, it dries out in captivity.
Author: Marlene Van Niekerk,  Agaat

Quote: The momentum of the mind can be vexingly, involuntarily capricious.
Author: Gregory Maguire,  A Lion Among Men

Quote: Once a man gets a fixed idea, there's nothing to be done.
Author: Anton Chekhov

Quote: She had a way of moving that moved him as much as music, which was what moved him most of all. Surely the spirit animating that pearless body must be unusual too? Why would nature make a vessel like that, if not to contain something still more valuable?
Author: J.K. Rowling,  The Casual Vacancy

Quote: We must come together in ways that respect the solitude of the soul that avoid the unconscious violence we do when we try to save each other that evoke our capacity to hold another life without dishonoring its mystery never trying to coerce the other into meeting our own needs.
Author: Parker J. Palmer,  Let Your Life Speak: Listening for the Voice of Vocation

Quote: Decision decides destiny. What God wants you to become is the positive person you decide to become when led by God's spirit.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

Quote: Decision decides destiny. What God wants you to become is the positive person you decide to become when led by God's spirit.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

Quote: Stunt dwarf or destroy the imagination of a child and you have taken away its chances of success in life. Imagination transforms the commonplace into the great and creates the new out of the old.
Author: L. Frank Baum

Quote: When faced with a hurdle then give it all you've got to jump over it because it can't be done in two stages.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: When a tree is polled, it will sprout new shoots nearer its roots. A soul that is ruined in the bud will frequently return to the springtime of its beginnings and its promise-filled childhood, as though it could discover new hopes there and retie the broken threads of life. The shoots grow rapidly and eagerly, but it is only a sham life that will never be a genuine tree.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  Beneath the Wheel

Quote: Is there a word halfway between hello and goodbye? Because that’s the word my soul is trying to say.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: CALL YOURSELFLook deep in the mirrorAnd say: 'I LOVE YOU'And immediatelyAn electric current willRipple throughout your soulAnd burst through your eyesLike shooting starsDancing across the skiesIn ecstasy.To tell your soul you love it -Is like rememberingWHO YOU AREAfter being in a comaFor a hundred years.Your face will beam the lightOf a hundred galaxies.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Women show men beauty in things beyond their ambitions. Women tell men to stop and smell the roses.
Author: Criss Jami,  Diotima, Battery, Electric Personality

Quote: The first step is the most important. It is the most crucial and the most effective as it will initiate the direction you have chosen.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: He did not like the grown-ups who talked down to him, but the ones who went on talking in their usual way, leaving him to leap along in their wake, jumping at meanings, guessing, clutching at known words, and chuckling at complicated jokes as they suddenly dawned. He had the glee of the porpoise then, pouring and leaping through strange seas.
Author: T.H. White,  The Sword in the Stone

Quote: I've managed to bring the backlog down to a mere sixty-eight years,"she announced with some small sense of achievement. "I hope to be able to start marking the papers of pupils who are still alive by the end of the decade.
Author: Jasper Fforde,  Shades of Grey

Quote: Dominate in your domain; You can do it.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: Remember, we Christians think man lives for ever. Therefore, what really matters is those little marks or twists on the central, inside part of the soul which are going to turn it, in the long run, into a heavenly or a hellish creature.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  Mere Christianity

Quote: Our own self-esteem is something we can actually twist in whatever way we want.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Boost Your Self Esteem

Quote: Sex is not about reproduc-tion, gender is not about males and females, courtship is not aboutpersuasion, fashion is not about beauty, and love is not about affec-tion. Below the surface of every banality and cliche there lies irony,cynicism, and profundity.
Author: Matt Ridley,  The Red Queen: Sex and the Evolution of Human Nature

Quote: The true men of action in our time those who transform the world are not the politicians and statesmen but the scientists. Unfortunately poetry cannot celebrate them because their deeds are concerned with things, not persons, and are therefore speechless. When I find myself in the company of scientists, I feel like a shabby curate who has strayed by mistake into a drawing room full of dukes.
Author: W.H. Auden

Quote: One has a greater sense of intellectual degradation after an interview with a doctor than from any human experience.
Author: Alice James

Quote: Mr. Watson — Come here — I want to see you.[First intelligible words spoken over the telephone]
Author: Alexander Graham Bell

Quote: Scientists seek the lawfulness of events. It is the task of Religion to fit man into this lawfulness.
Author: Frank Herbert,  Dune

Quote: The way we think may be completely different, but you and I are an ancient, archetypal couple, the original man and woman. We are the model for Adam and Eve. For all couples in love, there comes a moment when a man gazes at a woman with the very same kind of realization. It is an infinite helix, the dance of two souls resonating, like the twist of DNA, like the vast universe.
Author: Banana Yoshimoto

Quote: One day, on tearing off some old bark, I saw two rare beetles, and seized one in each hand. Then I saw a third and new kind, which I could not bear to lose, so I popped the one which I held in my right hand into my mouth. Alas! it ejected some intensely acrid fluid, which burnt my tongue so that I was forced to spit the beetle out, which was lost, as was the third one.
Author: Charles Darwin

Quote: But still try for who knows what is possible!
Author: Michael Faraday

Quote: Deviner avant de démontrer! Ai-je besoin de rappeler que c'est ainsi que se sont faites toutes les découvertes importantes.Guessing before proving! Need I remind you that it is so that all important discoveries have been made?
Author: Henri Poincaré,  The Value of Science: Essential Writings of Henri Poincare

Quote: Your dreams will come true, but do not be overly demanding. Be logical – there are not enough mansions for everyone in the world, are there?
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: And yet we knew, for a certainty, that when first emissaries of Earth went walking among the planets, Earth's other sons would be dreaming not about such expeditions but about a piece of bread.
Author: Stanisław Lem,  His Master's Voice

Quote: Men-kind shared this world for but a blink, then, sadly, they became enlightened, found science and religion. The new world of men left little room for magic or the magical creatures of old. Earth’s first children were driven into the shadows by flame and cold iron, by man’s insatiable need of conquest.
Author: Brom,  The Child Thief

Quote: I didn't want a world in which I had to choose between blind human babies and tortured monkey ones. To be frank, that's the sort of choice I expect science to protect me from, not give me.
Author: Karen Joy Fowler,  We Are All Completely Beside Ourselves

Quote: Choice forms the divider which is responsible for the formation of all futures that can be possible.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: Don't water your weeds
Author: Harvey MacKay

Quote: Once we open our eyes to the infinite magic that the universe has in abundance, we are sure to be enthralled by what we see and this miraculous creation gets us closer to our dreams and to the world as a whole.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: One today is worth two tomorrows.
Author: Benjamin Franklin

Quote: There are no strangers here; Only friends you haven't yet met.
Author: William Butler Yeats

Quote: Don't worry about writing a book or getting famous or making money. Just lead an interesting life.
Author: Michael Morpurgo

Quote: If I believe that I became the best quarterback that I could possibly be, the best football player that I could possibly be... That's how I'm going to measure my career as a success or not.
Author: Tim Tebow

Quote: One of the greatest men to ever walk this land was Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. His life exemplified unity by bringing people together for the good of all. In any small way I hope to someday bring people together like Dr. King.
Author: Zack Wamp

Quote: Follow love and it will flee, flee love and it will follow thee.
Author: John Gay

Quote: Whenever I think about movies, I always look at that art process as having the best of a lot of worlds. Because if you watch a great film, you have a musical element to it, not just on the scoring, but in the way that the shots are edited - that has music and rhythm and time.
Author: Frank Ocean

Quote: Writing a novel is one of those modern rites of passage, I think, that lead us from an innocent world of contentment, drunkenness, and good humor, to a state of chronic edginess and the perpetual scanning of bank statements.
Author: J. G. Ballard

Quote: The connection between art and Christ is like the connection between sunlight and the sun. It is, in fact, the connection between Sonlight and the Son.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Jesus-Shock

Quote: By the time we began to understand enough about what the world to ask the right questions, our visit is over, and someone else is visiting, asking the same questions.
Author: D.K. LeVick,  Bridges: A Tale of Niagara

Quote: Philosophers console themselves with explanations.
Author: Marty Rubin

Quote: The logical man must either deny all miracles or none.
Author: Charles Alexander Eastman,  The Soul of the Indian

Quote: She said, "You're a warrior. So how do you kill without rage?""In compassion. Because of necessity."Hrahima set the empty water bowl back in Samarkar's hands. "The same way you carry water.
Author: Elizabeth Bear,  Range of Ghosts

Quote: It is related that Sakyamuni [the historical Buddha] once dismissed as of small consequence a feat of levitation on the part of a disciple, and cried out in pity for a yogin by the river who had spent twenty years of his human existence learning to walk on water, when the ferryman might have taken him across for a small coin.
Author: Peter Matthiessen,  The Snow Leopard

Quote: There is nothing more natural than to consider everything as starting from oneself, chosen as the center of the world; one finds oneself thus capable of condemning the world without even wanting to hear its deceitful chatter.
Author: Guy Debord

Quote: As long as a man had the courage to reject what society told him to do, he could live life on his own terms. To what end? To be free. But free to what end? To read books, to write books, to think.
Author: Paul Auster,  The Brooklyn Follies

Quote: You know,"Daddy said, "it's some that can live their whole life out without asking about it and it's others has to know why it is, and this boy is one of the latters. He's going to be into everything!
Author: Flannery O'Connor

Author: Margaret Fuller

Author: Marcel Proust,  Swann's Way

Quote: NOT, I’ll not, carrion comfort, Despair, not feast on thee;Not untwist—slack they may be—these last strands of manIn me ór, most weary, cry I can no more. I can;Can something, hope, wish day come, not choose not to be.
Author: Gerard Manley Hopkins,  Poems by Gerard Manley Hopkins

Quote: We take it for granted that Jesus was not interested in political life: his mission was purely religious. Indeed we have witnessed . . . the 'iconization' of the life of Jesus: 'This is a Jesus of hieratic, stereotyped gestures, all representing theological themes. In this way, the life of Jesus is no longer a human life, submerged in history, but a theological life -- an icon.

To put an 'if' in God's promise when God has put none there, is tantamount to charging God with being insincere.

Quote: Ah, how many Marahs have been sweetened by a simple, satisfying glimpse of the Tree and the Love which underwent its worst confict there. Yes, the Cross is the tree that sweetens the waters. 'Love never faileth.
Author: Jim Elliot

Quote: The Lord will fulfill his purpose for me; your love, O Lord, endures forever - do not abandon the works of your hands.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Author: Terry Goodkind,  Confessor

Author: Priscilla Warner,  The Faith Club: A Muslim, A Christian, A Jew--Three Women Search for Understanding

Quote: I believe that we are lost here in America, but I believe we shall be found. And this belief, which mounts now to the catharsis of knowledge and conviction, is for me--and I think for all of us--not only our own hope, but America's everlasting, living dream.
Author: Thomas Wolfe

Quote: We all have to have something to hold on to, even if it’s our own torso.

Quote: Love meant hope. Without love, life held no promise.
Author: Christie Craig,  Shut Up and Kiss Me

Quote: Admire and adore the Author of the telescopic universe, love and esteem the work, do all in your power to lessen ill, and increase good, but never assume to comprehend.
Author: John Adams

Quote: I am the child of a lunatic. Not a child of God.
Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Choke

Quote: Just because I flap my arms, that doesn’t make me a bird. No, I’m a bird because I believe myself to be. That’s the power of faith.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Zebra is the Piano of the Animal Kingdom

Quote: Спомням си как през летните следобеди, които прекарвах там, баба ми, привършила домашната работа, сядаше до прозореца на светло и вадеше от своя скришен сандък една огромна Библия с твърди корици, обвита с тогавашния официозен вестник "Работническо дело"по конспиративни причини. Вече знаех, че комунизмът и Библията никак не се обичаха.

Author: Alain de Botton,  Religion for Atheists: A Non-Believer's Guide to the Uses of Religion

Quote: Perchance you who pronounce my sentence are in greater fear than I who receive it.
Author: Giordano Bruno

Quote: Having one king, one god, one belief, they can act single-mindedly.

Quote: You do not get what you wish for, unless it be known to the source of your desire.
