Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: Being a Dream Girl is never going to be about what you look like or how much you weigh. After all, our physical appearances are just reflections of our inner worlds. What makes you a Dream Girl is your emotional sensitivity, your self-awareness, and your ability to communicate who you are effectively and compassionately in the world.
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: That’s the biggest purpose of religious gathering: permission to look terrible in public. We used to go to church to confess our worst behaviour, to be heard and forgiven, then to be redeemed and accepted back into our communityChuck Palahniuk in interview with TMO
Author: Chuck Palahniuk

Quote: We acquire both the language and religious concepts from our immediate culture – at the same time. A child cannot discriminate between useful survival information and the emotional and psychological manipulations of religion. Once infected, these ideas are deeply embedded and almost impossible to change.
Author: Darrel Ray,  Sex & God: How Religion Distorts Sexuality

Quote: One is often so busy doing life that it is easy to avoid evaluating whether you are putting your energy in the direction you value most.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: Education will only take you so far. To go even further, I’d recommend getting a piggyback ride from a midget half your body weight.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: Imagine in vibrant, wonderful detail your heart’s desire—a reality only you can envision, an adventure only you can direct.Then cradle your creation. Caress it. Mold it. Coddle it until it comes to life.And when your precious treasure grows so grand as to steal your breath away, set it free for all the world to experience. For that is how you live your dreams.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Eena, The Curse of Wanyaka Cave

Quote: Families are designed to nurture the minds, wills, and emotions of its members so that the barriers created by fear of the unknown can be replaced by the confidence that comes from knowing you are loved whether you succeed or fail.
Author: Leigh A. Bortins,  The Core: Teaching Your Child the Foundations of Classical Education

Quote: He who has the audacity to stop you from dreaming is he who had given you the imaginations to think, but not those who watch you as you explore the dreams!
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: Failure is the condiment that gives success its flavour.
Author: Truman Capote

Quote: Increasing pressure on students to subject themselves to ever more tests, whittling themselves down to rows and rows of tight black integers upon a transcript, all ready to goose-step straight into a computer.
Author: Leah Hager Cohen,  Heart, You Bully, You Punk

Quote: Books have to be read (worse luck, for it takes a long time); it is the only way of discovering what they contain.
Author: E.M. Forster,  Aspects of the Novel

Quote: A PHD is not the end of education. Education exists even among the bees who feed their queen only with the purest
Author: Sahndra Fon Dufe

Quote: Because most of the girls were still in mourning and all of them had lost their textbooks, even pencils and pens, Shaukat Ali began the first classes by reading to them from poetry and religious texts. "Reading, literature, and spirituality are good for the soul,"he told them. "So we will start with these studies.
Author: Greg Mortenson,  Stones Into Schools: Promoting Peace With Books, Not Bombs, in Afghanistan and Pakistan

Quote: Observe & accept what ever arises & know that everything is as it needs to be.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: You know you made it, when your friends tell their friends that you are their friend.
Author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

Quote: Never let success get to your head and never let failure get to your heart.
Author: Ziad K. Abdelnour

Quote: The foundation of reverence is this perception, that the present holds within itself the complete sum of existence, backwards and forwards, that whole amplitude of time, which is eternity.
Author: Alfred North Whitehead

Quote: In Paris, where raillery is so quick to throw emotion out the window, silence, in a roomful of clever people after a story, is the most flattering of all marks of success
Author: Jules Barbey d'Aurevilly

Quote: If you are a success in life, there are places you must go and pay to be humiliated. It is an unwritten law that human beings must be tormented throughout their lives in one way or another. If you are fortunate enough to have risen to a social level where no one does it to you for free, then you must pay for the service.
Author: Jonathan Carroll,  White Apples

Quote: it is easy to surpass a predecessor, but difficult to avoid being surpassed by a successor.
Author: Eiji Yoshikawa,  Musashi

Quote: How can I tell anyone that there has always lived within me a rusty sense of disgust-a dull, brackish water that I suspect is my soul?
Author: A.M. Homes,  May We Be Forgiven

Quote: it’s that sense of powerlessness that destroyed my soul. i cannot be as good as i would like to be.nor as bad as i think i need to be.i think you have the same doubts that your goodness was not rewarded
Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Most people are mirrors, reflecting the moods and emotions of the times; few are windows, bringing light to bear on the dark corners where troubles fester. The whole purpose of education is to turn mirrors into windows.
Author: Sydney Harris

Quote: It is the task of the enlightened not only to ascend to learning and to see the good but to be willing to descend again to those prisoners and to share their troubles and their honors, whether they are worth having or not. And this they must do, even with the prospect of death.
Author: Plato,  The Allegory of the Cave

Quote: There needs not a great soul to make a hero; there needs a god-created soul which will be true to its origin; that will be a great soul!
Author: Thomas Carlyle,  On Heroes, Hero Worship and the Heroic in History

Quote: ....Charles laughingly observed,'Gospel and the blues are really, if you break it down, almost the same thing. It's just a question of whether you're talkin' about a woman or God.
Author: Craig Werner,  Higher Ground: Stevie Wonder, Aretha Franklin, Curtis Mayfield, and the Rise and Fall of American Soul

Quote: stronger than mountains.a place where my heart feels the safest- underneath his shirt.
Author: Sanober Khan

Quote: I have always considered myself a person with a gypsy heart, and I Surrender my dreams to my soul, for it's a free sprit who believes in no boundaries of region and religion.
Author: Megha Khare,  Write like no one is reading 2

Quote: Every person is a living treasure box. Listening holds the key.
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: Most of my friends from Columbia are going on to get advanced degrees. And why not? A Ph.D. is the new M.A., a master's is the new bachelor's, a B.A. is the new high school diploma, and a high school diploma is the new smiley-face sticker on your first-grade spelling test.
Author: Megan McCafferty,  Fourth Comings

Quote: Have faith that your child's brain is an evolving planet that rotates at its own speed. It will naturally be attracted to or repel certain subjects. Be patient. Just as there are ugly ducklings that turn into beautiful swans, there are rebellious kids and slow learners that turn into serious innovators and hardcore intellectuals.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: The key to flow is to pursue an activity for its own sake, not for the rewards it brings.
Author: Susan Cain,  Quiet: The Power of Introverts in a World That Can't Stop Talking

Quote: Philosophy, art, politics, religion and bohemia have never sought to do away entirely with the status hierarchy; they have attemptee, rather, to institute new kinds of hierarchies based on sets of values unrecognised by, and critical of, those of the majority.. They have provided us with persuasive and consoling reminders that there is more than one way of succeeding in life.
Author: Alain de Botton,  Status Anxiety

Quote: Nothing succeeds like indifference to success.
Author: Marty Rubin

Quote: The big uncookable sections of who we are, they’re the ones I love to taste the most.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

Quote: As in all infant sciences, the universal habit of the human mind - to take a partial or local truth, generalise it unduly and try to explain a whole field of nature in its narrow terms - runs riot here (in psychoanalysis). Moreover, the exaggeration of the importance of suppressed sexual complexes is a dangerous falsehood.
Author: Sri Aurobindo,  Integral Yoga: Teaching and Method of Practice

Quote: I'd rather be a failure in something that I love than a success in something that I hate.
Author: George Burns

Quote: The future reshapes the memory of the past in the way it recalibrates significance: some episodes are advanced, others lose purchase.
Author: Gregory Maguire,  A Lion Among Men

Quote: the difference between the old and the new education being) in a word, the old was a kind of propagation - men transmitting manhood to men; the new is merely propaganda.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  The Abolition of Man

Quote: I'm happy for all who reached for the stars happily and successfully.
Author: Ana Monnar

Quote: When the awareness of what is achievable brushes your life, your journey has begun.
Author: Lorii Myers,  Make It Happen, A Healthy, Competitive Approach to Achieving Personal Success

Quote: Life may bring you to your knees; pray. Then GET UP and participate in the answer. BECOME the remedy! BE the solution!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: The essence of a successful business is really quite simple. It is your ability to offer a product or service that people will pay for at a price sufficiently above your costs, ideally three or four or five times your cost, thereby giving you a profit that enables you to buy and to offer more products and services.
Author: Brian Tracy

Quote: Do ordinary things extraordinarily well.
Author: Gregg Harris

Quote: Songs of myselfI am the poet of the Body and I am the poet of the Soul, The pleasures of heaven are with me and the pains of hell are with me, The first I graft and increase upon myself, the latter I translate into new tongue. I am the poet of the woman the same as the man, And I say it is as great to be a woman as to be a man,..
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: Anybody is liable to rheumatism in her legs, Anne. It's only old people who should have rheumatism in their souls, though. Thanks goodness, I never have. When you get rheumatism in your soul you might as well go and pick out your coffin.
Author: L.M. Montgomery,  Anne of the Island

Quote: When your drive is moving your purpose, focus must hold the wheels else your might miss the way. And do you know what that means? Avoid Crash!!!. Stay focused!
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: If obstacles are large, jump higher.

Author: Alex Filippenko

Author: Richard Feynman

Quote: The larger a star the shorter its life, but all the more fascinating its death. As it collapses within it’s body, the infalling material can be no longer be compressed; the star is blown to pieces; its shattered mass realeases out ward at the speed of light.

Quote: Success is within reach of all people, but you can grasp it only when you realise the power within you.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Author: Jose Rizal

Quote: All love is vanquished by a succeeding love.
Author: Ovid

Author: Ann Landers

Quote: وإذا كان العقل الإنساني لا ينفي بالدليل المقنع وجود العقل الأبدي فليس له أن يجزم باستحالة شيء مما يستطيعه ذلك العقل الأبدي من العلم بالأبد كله، أو من القدرة على الإيحاء به إلى من يشاء أو من القدرة على خوارق العادات، لأن الخوارق بالنسبة إليه كالعادات ،ولأن التغيير عنده كالإنشاء والإبداع، إذ ليست قدرته على تغيير ما حدث دون قدرته على الخلق الأول مرة في زمن بعيد أو زمن قريب

Quote: For an author to write as he speaks is just as reprehensible as the opposite fault, to speak as he writes; for this gives a pedantic effect to what he says, and at the same time makes him hardly intelligible
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Quote: Socrates: This man, on one hand, believes that he knows something, while not knowing [anything]. On the other hand, I – equally ignorant – do not believe [that I know anything].

Tom loved all of them passionately, but he felt heavy and earth-bound. He climbed ecstatic mountains and floundered in the rocky darkness between the peaks. He had spurts of bravery but they were bracketed in battens of cowardice.
Author: John Steinbeck,  East of Eden

Quote: Plato offers the amazing idea that contemplation of the way things really are is, in itself, a purifying process that can bring human beings into the only divinity there is.
Author: Jennifer Michael Hecht,  Doubt: A History: The Great Doubters and Their Legacy of Innovation from Socrates and Jesus to Thomas Jefferson and Emily Dickinson

Author: David Mitchell

Quote: إن ضيق أفق الإنسان الحديث يتجلّى أكثر ما يكون في اعتقاده بأنه لا يرى أمامه لُغزاً. كأن حكمته هي مجموع علمه وجهله معاً. إنه جهل، ولكن الإنسان غير واعٍ به، حتى أنه يتقبله باعتباره معرفة في مواجهة أعظم لغز، يتصرّف بعنجهية وغرور، حتى أنه لا يرى المشكلة. وهذا الحجم الحقيقي لجهل الإنسان

Quote: You know, if a waitress asks me if I want ketchup with my fries, I’ll reply, “No thanks, I’ll just drink water.” And that’s not just a statement about table etiquette; it’s a personal quote that accurately reflects my moral and philosophical belief system.

I am above everything then, above the gods themselves. Perhaps that is what death is: a sensation of great, of extreme superiority.
Author: Emil Cioran

Author: Diogenes Laërtius

Quote: Always blow your own trumpet, blowing someone else’s is unhygienic
Author: Benny Bellamacina

Quote: Every man knows that he will die: and nobody believes it. On that paradox stand not only a host of religions but the entity of a sane being.
Author: John Myers Myers

Quote: Look up.

Quote: A man is a fool to live in hopes of a better tomorrow. I have a thousand, better ways today to spend what time remains ahead of me, and I have brighter, lighter and more pleasant places in which to spend it.
Author: Jack Whyte,  Uther

Quote: Seen politically, systems follow one another, each consuming the previous one. They live on ever-bequeathed and ever-disappointed hope, which never entirely fades. Its spark is all that survives, as it eats its way along the blasting fuse. For this spark, history is merely an occasion, never a goal.
Author: Ernst Jünger,  Eumeswil

Quote: In the midst of her tears came the thought, "When people are in danger, they ask God to save them;"and, slipping down upon her knees, she said her prayer as she had never said it before, for when human help seems gone we turn to Him as naturally as lost children cry to their father, and feel sure that he will hear and answer them.
Author: Louisa May Alcott,  Jack and Jill

Quote: The reason most people give up so fast is that they look at how far they still have to go, instead of how far they have come.
Author: Anonymous

Quote: The reason most people give up so fast is that they look at how far they still have to go, instead of how far they have come.
Author: Anonymous

Quote: The positive emotions that arise in...unpromising circumstances demonstrate that social ties and meaningful work are deeply desired, readily improvised, and intensely rewarding. The very structure of our economy and society prevent these goals from being achieved.
Author: Rebecca Solnit

Quote: If the church is to survive as a place where head and heart are equal partners in faith, then we will need to commit ourselves once again not to the worship of Christ, but to the imitation of Jesus. His invitation was not to believe, but to follow. (p. 145)
Author: Robin R. Meyers,  Saving Jesus from the Church: How to Stop Worshiping Christ and Start Following Jesus

Quote: We need to shed our unearthly and nonsocial and idealistic and romantic and uber-spiritual visions of kingdom and get back to what Jesus meant. By kingdom, Jesus means: God's Dream Society on earth, spreading out from the land of Israel to encompass the whole world.
Author: Scot McKnight,  One.Life: Jesus Calls, We Follow

Quote: She knew then that white was more than a color: It was a cold, pale shade of understanding that seems to take all of your hope away.
Author: Vannetta Chapman,  A Perfect Square

Quote: I can still bring into my body the joy I felt at seeing the first trillium of spring, which seemed to be telling me, "Never give up hope, spring will come.
Author: Jessica Stern,  Denial: A Memoir of Terror

Quote: I want you to trust yourself, baby. Love is all that matters and you’ve always known that. You’ve known, since you were a very little girl, what your life is meant to be about…
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: I want you to trust yourself, baby. Love is all that matters and you’ve always known that. You’ve known, since you were a very little girl, what your life is meant to be about…
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: I want you to trust yourself, baby. Love is all that matters and you’ve always known that. You’ve known, since you were a very little girl, what your life is meant to be about…
Author: Jennifer Elisabeth,  Born Ready: Unleash Your Inner Dream Girl

Quote: Grief is an amputation, but hope is incurable haemophilia: you bleed and bleed and bleed. Like Schrödinger’s cat inside a box you can never ever open.
Author: David Mitchell,  Slade House

Quote: Faith is stronger than so-called reason.
Author: Hermann Hesse,  The Journey to the East

Quote: Follow the evidence to where it leads, even if the conclusion is uncomfortable.
Author: Steven James,  The Knight

Quote: Men do not turn from God so easily. Not so easily. Deep in each man is the knowledge that something knows of his existence. Something knows, and cannot e fled nor hid from. To imagine otherwise is to imagine the unspeakable. It was never that this man ceased to believe in God. No. It was rather that he came to believe terrible things of him.
Author: Cormac McCarthy,  The Crossing

Quote: The material world is simply an expression of the mind; that's what so many fail to see. We're so dependent on what is before us that we discount our intuition. Yet if one dismisses instinct, how can one understand or believe in a world that exists beyond one's sight?
Author: Megan Chance,  The Spiritualist

Quote: Hope is a journeyInto an enchanted tomorrow
Author: Karen Hackel,  The Whisper of Your Soul

Quote: I bet you've seen the fundamentalist bumper sticker that says, "God said it! I believe it! That settles it!"It must be a typo because what the driver really means is, "I said it! God believes it! That settles it!
Author: Robert M. Price

Quote: They should know that just because things get difficult, it's no reason to believe God is on vacation.
Author: Harry H. Harrison Jr.,  1001 Things Every Teen Should Know Before They Leave Home:

Quote: The Prophet Muhammad, peace be upon him, said, When Allah loves a people, He tries them.
Author: Leila Aboulela,  Lyrics Alley

Quote: So as I shivered, naked and damp, in front of the bathroom mirror, I raised my eyes skyward. "I hope we're still okay."I got no answer, but then, I didn't really expect one. Answer or not, it didn't matter. That's the thing about faith, I guess.
Author: Chloe Neill

Quote: I kept loving and loving and loving. Every waking hour, I marveled on how these moments would make made me feel. I wanted to love the world and be the change it so deliciously craved.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I kept loving and loving and loving. Every waking hour, I marveled on how these moments would make made me feel. I wanted to love the world and be the change it so deliciously craved.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: If justice takes place, there may be hope, even in the face of a seemingly capricious divinity.
Author: Alberto Manguel,  The Library at Night

Quote: The Victorian Age, for all its humbug, was a period of rapid progress, because men were dominated by hope rather than fear. If we are again to have progress, we must again be dominated by hope.
Author: Bertrand Russell,  Why I Am Not a Christian and Other Essays on Religion and Related Subjects

Quote: ...for liberty is an acknowledgment of faith in God and His works.
Author: Frédéric Bastiat

Quote: Faith is not a feeling, she says. It's a set of actions. By taking the actions, you demonstrate more faith than somebody who actually has experienced the rewards of prayer and so feels hope.
Author: Mary Karr

Quote: (About changing faith) At our best, Christians embrace it, leaving enough space within orthodoxy for God to surprise us every now and then.
Author: Rachel Held Evans,  Evolving in Monkey Town: How a Girl Who Knew All the Answers Learned to Ask the Questions

Quote: Thoughts frame your portrait, action paints it.
Author: Charles F. Glassman,  Brain Drain The Breakthrough That Will Change Your Life

Quote: Thoughts frame your portrait, action paints it.
Author: Charles F. Glassman,  Brain Drain The Breakthrough That Will Change Your Life

Quote: Don't settle for anyone just to have a someone. Be patient. Have faith and wait for the right one.
Author: Elizabeth Bourgeret

Quote: To the knights of faith nobody believes.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic,  Circling: 1978-1987

Quote: We have not reached the consensus that to eat is a basic human right. This is an ethical crisis. This is a crisis of faith.
Author: Jean-Bertrand Aristide,  Eyes of the Heart: Seeking a Path for the Poor in the Age of Globalization

Quote: Comparing yourself to others does nothing for you. Society has conditioned us to value people who fit a secular mold of perfection".
Author: Michele Woolley,  God's Favor - Breath Of Heaven

Quote: Christians walk as strangers in the world: They are untamed. They are free. To persevere with love, yet untamed by man, is often what leaves that open space for divine revelation when God so wills.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: I am very close to HIM, sometimes I think I am HIM, with my mood is the weather,bright and sunny forever.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: I am very close to HIM, sometimes I think I am HIM, with my mood is the weather,bright and sunny forever.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: If all men are made in God's reflection, then why do some people continue to acknowledge only what is in their part of the mirror? If every man was created equal and in the image of God, then how can any man claim that one race is better than another?
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: If all men are made in God's reflection, then why do some people continue to acknowledge only what is in their part of the mirror? If every man was created equal and in the image of God, then how can any man claim that one race is better than another?
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: People keep looking for the perfect one, but perfection is an attribute of God alone.
Author: Farahad Zama,  The Marriage Bureau for Rich People

Quote: Wealth is a gift from God, and pride is bequeathed to us from the devil.
Author: Douglas Wilson

Quote: Ultimately we have nothing to fear. Jesus loves us, and he invites us to be confident in that love. As we seek to obey Him, we are not called to assess the risk involved and determine whether or not obedience will be beneficial or safe for us. We are simply called to trust and obey.
Author: Dan Baumann,  A Beautiful Way: An Invitation to a Jesus-Centered Life

Quote: Love and faith are not common companions. More commonly power and fear consort with faith....Power is not to be crossed; one must respect and obey. Power means strength, whereas love is a human frailty the people mistrust. It is a sad fact of life that power and fear are the fountainheads of faith.
Author: Saul D. Alinsky,  Rules for Radicals: A Pragmatic Primer for Realistic Radicals

Quote: I arrived, I saw humans and I saw through their faces. Nothing ever changes but the light in their eyes. For I too have buried my demons today, without knowing what might remain beneath the face of tomorrow.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: I arrived, I saw humans and I saw through their faces. Nothing ever changes but the light in their eyes. For I too have buried my demons today, without knowing what might remain beneath the face of tomorrow.
Author: Robert M. Drake

Quote: Sometimes people need to know they could be forgiven to have the strength to change.
Author: J. Leigh Bralick,  Prism

Quote: Somewhere fate laughs in her far-off country, because now I am the human and it is Grace I will lose again and again, immer wieder, always the same, every winter, losing more of her each year, unless I find a cure.
Author: Maggie Stiefvater,  Linger

Quote: Anyone who doesn't fear God, has no idea at all about Him.
Author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

Quote: As goes the family, so goes the faith; as goes the faith, so goes the culture.
Author: Kenneth L. Gentry Jr.,  The Greatness of the Great Commission: The Christian Enterprise in a Fallen World

Quote: Dusty, dark, cold, and hard, coal has no beauty of its own, but when it is consummated by fire it is beautiful and becomes what it was designed to be.
Author: Frederica Mathewes-Green,  At the Corner of East and Now: A Modern Life in Ancient Christian Orthodoxy

Quote: Anybody who says "I know how to get to God and you don't, do this and do that and go here and go there"is going to become 1. very powerful and 2. very rich. The simple truth is, if I am with God, no less can you be with God at the same time as I am.
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: But try to remember that a good man can never die. You will see your brother many times again-in the streets, at home, in all the places of the town. The person of a man may go, but the best part of him stays. It stays forever.
Author: William Saroyan

Quote: Lincoln grew immeasurably as he came to think of himself as an “instrument of God’s will.
Author: Joe L. Wheeler,  Abraham Lincoln, a Man of Faith and Courage: Stories of Our Most Admired President

Quote: I am going to open myself up to all that is superior in the world and beyond and I am going to spend time trying to take delight in things! Not finding ruin in them! If the ruin of you is what you look for, the ruin of you is what you are going to find!
Author: C. JoyBell C.

Quote: I can manage,"said Frodo. "I must.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: A hero is not know by the number of battles he has won, but rather by the kind of battles he chooses to fight.
Author: Tonny K. Brown

Quote: That knowledge which purifies the mind and heart alone is true Knowledge, all else is only a negation of Knowledge.
Author: Ramakrishna

Quote: L'esercizio rende perfetti, ma nessuno è perfetto, quindi perché esercitarsi?
Author: Billie Joe Armstrong

Quote: Do what you love or die a slow death doing what you hate
Author: Sonya Watson

Quote: The one ironclad rule is that I have to try. I have to walk into my writing room and pick up my pen every weekday morning.
Author: Anne Tyler

Quote: People do not meet by chance––they navigate their lives to certain people for certain reasons.
Author: Ruti Yudovich,  I Hate to Say Goodbye

Quote: Every comforting word is a command from a man of action...While every word of command is commotion from a man of just words...
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: All have dreams, live for them, They add meaning to LIFE.The only thing that differentiates us from other beings is the fact that us can DREAM!!!
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: So long as we do not depend on the facts entirely, incomplete knowledge is better than complete ignorance.--Egwene al'Vere
Author: Brandon Sanderson,  Towers of Midnight

Quote: ...I like stories very much,” the priest said. “They help me understand myself better.
Author: Simon Van Booy,  Love Begins in Winter: Five Stories

Quote: The first step to success it's to imagine it
Author: Pete Hautman,  The Big Crunch

Quote: Anyway, the trick is simply this: No matter what happens, keep your heart open. Wide open. The heart is made of love, and love is indestructible, and only the arrogance of ego would presume that it requires protection. To open your heart is to reduce your ego, and this is the only magic that is ever required to experience the naked truth.
Author: Tony Vigorito,  Nine Kinds of Naked

Quote: God used my year of waiting not to frustrate me, or abandon me, but to draw me into a closer relationship with Him.
Author: Suzanne Elizabeth Anderson,  Waiting with God

Quote: When God throws something your way, catch it!
Author: Chriscinthia Blount

Quote: When there is nothing left to give somone in need, we give them what we do have. We give them Divine Love, faith, and friendship. This is always enough to see anyone through anything. This, my friends, is how we save the world. (pg.99 of A Journey In to Divine Love)
Author: C.Michelle Gonzalez,  A Journey in to Divine Love: Live, Laugh, Love, Meditate

Quote: Generally in life, knowledge is acquired to be used. But school learning more often fits Freire's apt metaphor: knowledge is treated like money, to be put away in a bank for the future.
Author: Seymour Papert,  The Children's Machine: Rethinking School In The Age Of The Computer

Quote: Generally in life, knowledge is acquired to be used. But school learning more often fits Freire's apt metaphor: knowledge is treated like money, to be put away in a bank for the future.
Author: Seymour Papert,  The Children's Machine: Rethinking School In The Age Of The Computer

Quote: In search of Truth the hopeful zealot goes,But all the sadder tums, the more he knows!
Author: H.P. Lovecraft

Quote: I like to set my dreams high. That way, even if I only make it half way there, it's still pretty darned good.
Author: Elizabeth O. Dulemba

Quote: Once you discover that you can, you must.
Author: Al Jarreau

Quote: A sense of the divine presence and indwelling bears the soul towards heaven as upon the wings of eagles.
Author: Charles Haddon Spurgeon

Quote: Ignorance is a knowledge illiteracy.
Author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

Quote: I have sent books and music there, and all / Those instruments with which high spirits call / The future from its cradle, and the past / Out of its grave, and make the present last / In thoughts and joys which sleep, but cannot die, / Folded within their own eternity.
Author: Percy Bysshe Shelley,  Poetry and Prose

Quote: She had discovered that her love of knowing was not unnatural or sinful but the direct consequence of a God-given ability to reason.
Author: Donna Woolfolk Cross,  Pope Joan

Quote: A #loveselfie isn't a picture or a status update. It's an attitude of embracing, accepting, and valuing yourself, exactly as you are in each moment. It's being one hundred percent present with yourself. Try it.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: when you have no spirit to seize the day, find it behind the music, between the flowing leaves, beneath the sun rays, and just within yourself. Talk to yourself, be the best friend for yourself, and do not hesitate to ask God help
Author: Maria Magdalena

Quote: We all take a different path to the same place. Why we took the path we did will always be a mystery.
Author: Michael R. Krozer,  Diary of a Short Life

Quote: Every man reaches his destination, if he just keeps walking
Author: Philen Naidu,  My Life My Africa

Quote: Pray for "all men."We usually pray more for things than we do for men. Our prayers should be thrown across their pathway as they rush in their downward course to a lost eternity.
Author: E.M.Bounds

Quote: A book is a product of a pact with the Devil that inverts the Faustian contract, he'd told Allie. Dr Faustus sacrificed eternity in return for two dozen years of power; the writer agrees to the ruination of his life, and gains (but only if he's lucky) maybe not eternity, but posterity, at least. Either way (this was Jumpy's point) it's the Devil who wins.
Author: Salman Rushdie,  The Satanic Verses

Quote: The more you test him, the slower he will learn and the less he'll want to do. The less you test him, the quicker he will learn and the more he'll want to learn. Knowledge is the most precious gift you can give your child. Give it as generously as you give him food.
Author: Glenn Doman,  How to Teach Your Baby Math

Quote: We give up our backs and allow religious myths to apply the rear naked choke to our minds.
Author: Cameron Conaway,  Caged: Memoirs of a Cage-Fighting Poet

Quote: We give up our backs and allow religious myths to apply the rear naked choke to our minds.
Author: Cameron Conaway,  Caged: Memoirs of a Cage-Fighting Poet

Quote: Neglect of mathematics work injury to all knowledge, since he who is ignorant of it cannot know the other sciences or things of this world. And what is worst, those who are thus ignorant are unable to perceive their own ignorance, and so do not seek a remedy.
Author: Roger Bacon,  Mathematics

Quote: Knowing trees, I came to realize, understand and appreciate the act of patience.
Author: Ogwo David Emenike

Quote: The people need to know that the people need to know. And I’m just the man to let them know that they need to know. However, what they need to know, I do not know.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

Quote: If you want the answer—ask the question.
Author: Lorii Myers

Quote: If you want the answer—ask the question.
Author: Lorii Myers

Quote: While wisdom dictates the need for education, education does not necessarily make one wise.
Author: Ben Carson,  One Nation: What We Can All Do to Save America's Future

Quote: While wisdom dictates the need for education, education does not necessarily make one wise.
Author: Ben Carson,  One Nation: What We Can All Do to Save America's Future

Quote: The obvious can sometimes be illuminating when perceived in an unhabitual way.
Author: Daniel Quinn,  Ishmael: An Adventure of the Mind and Spirit

Quote: When we stop fighting against death, we are able to wake up to our lives.
Author: Daniel Gottlieb,  Letters to Sam: A Grandfather's Lessons on Love, Loss, and the Gifts of Life

Quote: Life is agid, life is fulgid. Life is what the least of us make most of us feel the least of us make the most of. Life is a burgeoning, a quickening of the dim primordial urge in the murky wastes of time.
Author: Willard Van Orman Quine

Quote: It is the road you take that decides your destiny and not your destiny that decides the road you take.
Author: Apoorve Dubey,  The Flight Of Ambition

Quote: Dreaming is the poetry of Life, and we must be forgiven if we indulge in it a little.
Author: John Galsworthy,  Five Speeches to P.E.N. Clubs and a Letter

Quote: We are the ones we've been waiting for.
Author: Colin Beavan,  No Impact Man: The Adventures of a Guilty Liberal Who Attempts to Save the Planet and the Discoveries He Makes About Himself and Our Way of Life in the Process

Quote: Only one who has learned much can fully appreciate his ignorance.
Author: Louis L'Amour,  Education of a Wandering Man

Quote: Only one who has learned much can fully appreciate his ignorance.
Author: Louis L'Amour,  Education of a Wandering Man

Quote: knowledge without application is like a book that is never read' Christopher Crawford, Hemel Hempstead.
Author: Christopher Crawford

Quote: We don’t know anything about silent sages, buried knowledge, the eye of the mute poet, serene seers, yet how many talkative destroyers, prophets and ideologues, teachers and beautifiers there are on the other side.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic,  The Shape

Quote: I think, to be happy is to be interested and engaged.
Author: Aimee Mann

Quote: We all have issues & we have usually come by them honestly.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: What have you gained since you haven't prayed? What will you lose if you pray?
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Best Option

Quote: What have you gained since you haven't prayed? What will you lose if you pray?
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Best Option

Quote: But that initial, comet-blazing-across-the-sky, Big Idea is only the beginning. Each book is composed of a mosaic of thousands of little ideas, ideas that invariably come to me at two in the morning when my alarm is set for seven.
Author: Lauren Willig

Quote: We have a right to decide how we want our bodies to look and feel, but unfortunately we do not exercise these rights. Instead, we tend to drift along, victims of our own ignorance of the fact that we can have what we want, if we are willing to take that first step toward developing the self-discipline to govern our thoughts.
Author: Holly Mosier

Quote: Trying to live up to yourself is the most trying thing.
Author: Ren Garcia

Quote: But can one actually see beauty with eyes blurred by the lack of almost everything a human being needs?
Author: Paulo Lins,  City of God

Quote: Emotions are like muscles. Most of them go highly unattended, it's usually the weaker, undefined ones that cause injury to the rest, and there is most certainly memory response in play.
Author: Erica Goros

Quote: The philosophies of men surround us. The face of sin today often wears the mask of tolerance. Do not be deceived; behind that facade is heartache, unhappiness, and pain. You know what is right and what is wrong, and no disguise, however appealing, can change that. Be the one to make a stand for right, even if you stand alone. Have the moral courage to be a light for others to follow.
Author: Thomas S. Monson

Quote: دعوة علماء الدين إلى أن يكونوا رسل الديمقراطية الإسلامية بالسعي لتعديل مابين طبقات الناس من الفروق الشاسعة
Author: مصطفى صبري,  موقف العقل والعلم والعالم من رب العالمين وعباده المرسلين

Quote: We would never call inexplicable little insights 'hunches,' for fear of drawing the universe's attention. But they happened, and you knew you had been in the proximity of one that had come through if you saw a detective kiss his or her fingers and touch his or her chest where a pendant to Warsha, patron saint of inexplicable inspirations, would, theoretically, hang.
Author: China Miéville,  The City & the City

Quote: Consider what really makes up your self-worth—like your caring heart or your ability to stand tall in the face of adversity
Author: Susan Bernstein

Quote: Directing the mind to stay in the present can be a formidable task.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: Directing the mind to stay in the present can be a formidable task.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: You're never going to walk around fear. You're only going to walk through it. I have to do all those things I am afraid of, but I do them constantly renewing my mind.
Author: Suzanne D. Williams,  Fearless

Quote: What is more yours than what always holds you back?
Author: James Richardson

Quote: In a time when I need a little hope I look at a photo of where I call home and think of the moment I'll have when I go back with my trials and struggles carried in a box able to be let free and turn into achievements and happiness.
Author: Cassandra Shea

Quote: You never know what will save you.
Author: Abbey Wilson

Quote: You're the only one that can put pressure on yourself... No one else can put pressure on you. It's self-inflicted. For me, I just want to go out and play football.
Author: Maurice Jones-Drew

Quote: When inspiration is silent reason tires quickly.
Author: Roger Zelazny,  Trumps of Doom

Quote: Perhaps just to have loved was enough - just to have seen this world,and known it,through the eyes of love.
Author: Rosie Alison,  The Very Thought of You

Quote: Don't try to follow trends. Create them.
Author: Simon Zingerman,  We All Need Heroes: Stories of the Brave and Foolish

Quote: Don't try to follow trends. Create them.
Author: Simon Zingerman,  We All Need Heroes: Stories of the Brave and Foolish

Quote: Motivation gets you going; Inspiration keeps you going.
Author: Todd Stocker,  Refined: Turning Pain Into Purpose

Quote: God is indeed able to make you what He wants you to be.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: The only walls that exist are those you have placed in your mind. And whatever obstacles you conceive, exist only because you have forgotten what you have already achieved.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: The only walls that exist are those you have placed in your mind. And whatever obstacles you conceive, exist only because you have forgotten what you have already achieved.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: As every inquiry which regards religion is of the utmost importance, there are two questions in particular which challenge our attention, to wit, that concerning its foundation in reason, and that concerning it origin in human nature.
Author: David Hume,  The Natural History of Religion

Quote: I figured anybody who talked about church as much as she did was using it a little like cocaine anyhow.
Author: Keith Ablow,  Denial

Quote: Unto whomsoever much is given, of him shall much be required.
Author: Anonymous,  Holy Bible: King James Version

Quote: The positive vibrations of unregulated joy, peace, happiness and tranquility is freedom.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: The Church of England is the only church in the world that interferes neither with your politics nor your religion
Author: Anthony Trollope

Quote: Religion turned some folks belligerent.
Author: Eileen Wilks,  On the Prowl

Quote: Be the winner in your life!
Author: Tae Yun Kim,  Seven Steps to Inner Power

Quote: The smooth folds of her dress concealed a tumultuous heart, and her modest lips told nothing of her torment. She was in love.
Author: Gustave Flaubert,  Madame Bovary

Quote: Life makes fools of us all sooner or later. But keep your sense of humor and you'll at least be able to take your humiliations with some measure of grace. In the end, you know, it's our own expectations that crush us."-- from Skippy Dies
Author: Paul Murray,  Skippy Dies

Quote: What does it mean?” Flynn turns to gaze at me, eyes finally meeting mine.I find myself smiling because I know exactly what it means. “It means the clouds are clearing on Avon.
Author: Amie Kaufman,  This Shattered World

Quote: She had one of those goofy smiles that made you wonder if she was too stupid to know that life sucks most of the time.
Author: Darcia Helle,  Hit List

Quote: I would like to be a one-man multinational fashion phenomenon.
Author: Karl Lagerfeld

Quote: A fundamentalist is someone who wants to substitute what he believes for what you believe,"Max said. "And someone who thinks he knows the will of God better than anyone else.
Author: Robin Wasserman,  The Book of Blood and Shadow

Quote: Religion and ethics were not always - or even frequently - mutually compatible. The demands of religious absolutism or fundamentalism or rampaging relativism often deflected the worst aspects of contemporary culture or prejudices rather than a system which both man and God could live under with a sense of real justice.
Author: Dan Simmons,  The Fall of Hyperion

Quote: The word "seek"is a verb. Are you treating it as such in your life? If you seek change, success, or love, DO it - BE it!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Try not to become a person of success, but rather try to become a person of value.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: In the Reggio Emilia preschools, however, each child is viewed as infinitely capable, creative, and intelligent. The job of the teacher is to support these qualities and to challenge children in appropriate ways so that they develop fully.
Author: Louise Boyd Cadwell,  Bringing Reggio Emilia Home: An Innovative Approach to Early Childhood Education

Quote: To confuse compulsory schooling with equal educational opportunity is like confusing organized religion with spirituality. One does not necessarily lead to the other. Schooling confuses teaching with learning, grade advancement with education, a diploma with competence, and fluency with the ability to say something new.
Author: Wendy Priesnitz

Quote: The quality of the relationships that students have in class with their peers and teachers is important to their success in school.
Author: Bob Pletka,  Educating the Net Generation: How to Engage Students in the 21st Century

Quote: Stand aside for a while and leave room for learning, observe carefully what children do, and then, if you have understood well, perhaps teaching will be different from before.
Author: Loris Malaguzzi

Quote: Some people have just rented your body to live in it for sometime and depart. Others consider you as a permanent residence to dwell in forever. Which ever, you must remember to accommodate all those who want to be accommodated. Be each other's keeper
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: And the thing is, we can’t fail. We’ve already hit the bottom and come out of it. From here on out, if we just love and listen, we can’t go wrong, babe.
Author: Erin McCarthy,  Hot Finish

Quote: Discover a purpose that gives you passion. Develop a plan that makes you persistent. Design a preparation and motivates you to optimize your potentials. Do it because you love it!
Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  Dream Big!: See Your Bigger Picture!

Quote: I am happy.I have something to accomplish, create, and achieve.I am happy.
Author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

Quote: Your young white, who gathers his learning from books and can measure what he knows by the page, may conceit that his knowledge, like his legs, outruns that of his fathers’, but, where experience is the master, the scholar is made to know the value of years, and respects them accordingly.
Author: James Fenimore Cooper,  The Last of the Mohicans

Quote: I wouldn’t have minded school if they taught you important things like how to have good sex and what brand of wine is the best… But for some reason they were hell bent on teaching me algebra
Author: Ben Mitchell

Quote: Congress and state legislatures should not tell teachers how to teach, any more than they should tell surgeons how to perform operations.
Author: Diane Ravitch,  The Death and Life of the Great American School System: How Testing and Choice Are Undermining Education

Quote: I probably felt more resentment for what I personally was to suffer than for the wrong they were doing to anyone and everyone. But at that time I was determined not to put up with badly behaved people more out of my own interest than because I wanted them to become good people.
Author: Augustine of Hippo,  Confessions

Quote: While meditating we are simply seeing what the mind has been doing all along.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: Les enfants sont par définition des apprentis, et apprendre est l'activité humaine qui nécessite le moins de manipulation par autrui. La majeure partie de l'apprentissage n'est pas le resultat de l'instruction. Elle serait plutôt le résultat d'une participation dans un environnement chargé de sens.
Author: Ivan Illich

Quote: The white cat Sal-al was lying on the straw matting in the empty conservatory. She looked at us with a wicked, conceited expression as if all her appetites had just been satisfied. She was beautiful. Vesta and I both said, "I wish I were a cat!"Before we got to the last word we smiled at each other in annoyance, not liking the idea that most human beings think very much alike.
Author: Denton Welch,  Maiden Voyage

Quote: As we have seen there is some kind of continuity in any case since every experience affects for better or worse the attitudes which help decide the quality of further experiences, by setting up certain preference and aversion, and making it easier or harder to act for this or that end.
Author: John Dewey

Quote: An educated mind is a questioning mind. Or is it?
Author: T.S. Welti,  The Fifth Specter

Quote: The gardener does not make a plant grow. The job of a gardener is to create optimal conditions.
Author: Ken Robinson

Quote: You can start to change your luck today. Begin believing that you can have what you desire and superior things will arrive.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: We cannot reach the pinnacle except by taking advantage of the abilities we have and acquiring those that we do not.
Author: محمد عبد الرحمن العريفي,  Enjoy Your Life

Quote: A farm is a business, and I ran mine into the ground. The next year it grew back.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: Do not let your good ideas to spend your brain energy, do it with all the effort because the shadow of the success can become a reality only with hard work.
Author: Isra

Quote: The measure of a society is not only what it does but the quality of its aspirations.
Author: Wade Davis

Quote: Your greatest responsibility in your life is to be the best version of yourself. When you feel for what the soul believes that is who you become.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: A good education helps us make sense of the world and find our way in it
Author: Mike Rose,  Why School?

Quote: Being aware is being aware of one's own mind and the games it plays on itself.
Author: Robin Macnaughton,  Power Astrology: Make The Most Of Your Sun Sign

Quote: She dotes on poetry, sir. She adores it; I may say that her whole soul and mind are wound up, and entwined with it. She has produced some delightful pieces, herself, sir. You may have met with her 'Ode to an Expiring Frog,' sir.
Author: Charles Dickens,  The Pickwick Papers

Quote: She dotes on poetry, sir. She adores it; I may say that her whole soul and mind are wound up, and entwined with it. She has produced some delightful pieces, herself, sir. You may have met with her 'Ode to an Expiring Frog,' sir.
Author: Charles Dickens,  The Pickwick Papers

Quote: The really essential factors of success in any undertaking are money and opportunity, and as a rule, the man who can make the first can make the second.
Author: Dorothy L. Sayers,  Whose Body?

Quote: A failure establishes only this, that our determination to succeed was not strong enough.
Author: C.N. Bovee

Quote: I've always believed that one woman's success can only help another woman's success.
Author: Gloria Vanderbilt,  It Seemed Important at the Time: A Romance Memoir

Quote: O the joy of my spirit--it is uncaged--it darts like lightning!It is not enough to have this globe or a certain time,I will have thousands of globes and all time.
Author: Walt Whitman

Quote: Strong lives are motivated by dynamic purposes.
Author: Kenneth Hildebrand

Quote: Act like a champion, and then become one.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: Money. The ultimate motivation. The ultimate way of keeping score.
Author: Michael Connelly,  Chasing the Dime

Quote: When we do cross paths with people whose beliefs and attitudes conflict with our own, we are rarely challenged.
Author: Thomas Gilovich,  How We Know What Isn't So: The Fallibility of Human Reason in Everyday Life

Quote: If not now, when?
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: Why don't we want our children to learn to do mathematics? Is it that we don't trust them, that we think it's too hard? We seem to feel that they are capable of making arguments and coming to their own conclusions about Napoleon. Why not about triangles?
Author: Paul Lockhart,  A Mathematician's Lament: How School Cheats Us Out of Our Most Fascinating and Imaginative Art Form

Quote: I may err but I am not a heretic, for the first has to do with the mind and the second with the will!
Author: Meister Eckhart

Quote: Worship is the marriage of two Spirits - the Spirit of God and the Spirit of man.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu

Quote: Jemanden zu beeinflussen bedeutet, ihm eine fremde Seele zu geben.
Author: Oscar Wilde,  The Picture of Dorian Gray

Quote: Man has no Body distinct from his soul; for that called Body is a portion of a Soul discerned by the five senses, the chief inlets of Soul in this age.
Author: William Blake

Quote: To be successful, one has to be one of three bees - the queen bee, the hardest working bee, or the bee that does not fit in.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Every flower blooms at a different pace.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: The number of ways to live in one lifetime is limitless. So why limit yourself?
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: In the spiritual world many forms of the physical universe that are potentially effective can be perceived but with regard to time, we can observe only one form.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: The first rule about the low hanging fruit principle is to always watch out for low hanging branches, they’re the ones to take it away from you.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: If practice makes you perfectshouldn't good behavior be addedto the curriculum
Author: Cornelia "Connie D."DeDona,  Letters to a Prisoner

Quote: Beneath the violet pillar, in the vacuum before the roar of the cloud, there came a soft sound that might have been heard by those who listened closely: the gentle sigh of an idea unbound.
Author: Lydia Millet,  Oh Pure and Radiant Heart

Quote: The highest court is in the end one’s own conscience and conviction—that goes for you and for Einstein and every other physicist—and before any science there is first of all belief.
Author: Max Planck,  The Dilemmas of an Upright Man: Max Planck and the Fortunes of German Science

Quote: One of the advantages of science is that one's work, ultimately, is either replicated or it is not.
Author: Kay Redfield Jamison,  An Unquiet Mind: A Memoir of Moods and Madness

Quote: Science isn't just about blowing things up. Rather it's about blowing things up and knowing how you did it.
Author: William Gurstelle

Quote: العلم دقيق أما الفن فصادق. انظر إلى لوحة لوجه إنسان أو منظر طبيعي... كم هما صادقان؟! إن فيهما من الصدق أكثر مما في أي صورة فوتوغرافية للوجة.
Author: علي عزت بيجوفيتش,  الإسلام بين الشرق والغرب

Quote: While the art of printing is left to us science can never be retrograde; what is once acquired of real knowledge can never be lost.
Author: Thomas Jefferson,  Letters of Thomas Jefferson

Quote: Beliefs that are good promote your potential and enhance your unique special qualities.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: When you act on your beliefs, the realisation that happens is caused by you and this will in turn lead to a consequence.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: If Darwinists are opposed to mentioning scientific problems with their view, you would think they would be even more opposed to mentioning intelligent design. Yet Darwinists have been discussing ID in public school science classes for years... Biology textbooks have been mentioning intelligent design since the late 1990s—but only to misrepresent and disparage it.
Author: Jonathan Wells,  The Politically Incorrect Guide to Darwinism And Intelligent Design

Quote: Yes, yes, I see it all! — an enormous social activity, a mighty civilization, a profuseness of science, of art, of industry, of morality, and afterwords, when we have filled the world with industrial marvels, with great factories, with roads, museums and libraries, we shall fall exhausted at the foot of it all, and it will subsist — for whom? Was man made for science or was science made for man?
Author: Miguel de Unamuno,  Tragic Sense of Life

Quote: All we know of the Missing Link is that he is missing - and he won't be missed either.
Author: G.K. Chesterton

Quote: Why would you take a drug that is guaranteed to kill you in forty years? One reason, right? It's the only thing that will stop you dying tomorrow.
Author: Sharon Moalem,  Survival of the Sickest: A Medical Maverick Discovers Why We Need Disease

Quote: Human suffering has been caused because too many of us cannot grasp that words are only tools for our use.The mere presence in the dictionary of a word like 'living' does not mean it necessarily has to refer to something definite in the real world.
Author: Richard Dawkins,  The Selfish Gene

Quote: He did not know that the Old One was his father, for such a relationship was utterly beyond his understanding, but as he looked at the emaciated body he felt a dim disquiet that was the ancestor of sadness.
Author: Arthur C. Clarke,  2001: A Space Odyssey

Quote: Eve and the apple was the first great step in experimental science.
Author: James Bridie

Quote: Desire is the key to motivation, but it's the determination and commitment to unrelenting pursuit of your goal - a commitment to excellence - that will enable you to attain the success you seek.
Author: Mario Andretti

Quote: Desire is the key to motivation, but it's the determination and commitment to unrelenting pursuit of your goal - a commitment to excellence - that will enable you to attain the success you seek.
Author: Mario Andretti

Quote: People often say that motivation doesn't last. Well, neither does bathing - that's why we recommend it daily.
Author: Zig Ziglar

Quote: Thought is the wind, knowledge the sail, and mankind the vessel.
Author: Augustus Hare

Quote: Keep all special thoughts and memories for lifetimes to come. Share these keepsakes with others to inspire hope and build from the past, which can bridge to the future.
Author: Mattie Stepanek

Quote: Keep all special thoughts and memories for lifetimes to come. Share these keepsakes with others to inspire hope and build from the past, which can bridge to the future.
Author: Mattie Stepanek

Quote: All you need to do to be my friend is like me.
Author: Taylor Swift

Quote: I always felt that the great high privilege, relief and comfort of friendship was that one had to explain nothing.
Author: Katherine Mansfield

Quote: Life is a great sunrise. I do not see why death should not be an even greater one.
Author: Vladimir Nabokov

Quote: I went to the woods because I wished to live deliberately, to front only the essential facts of life, and see if I could not learn what it had to teach, and not, when I came to die, discover that I had not lived.
Author: Henry David Thoreau

Quote: Hope is trust in God's promises, faith that if we act now, the desired blessings will be fulfilled in the future.
Author: James E. Faust

Quote: Charity can be the outward expression of faith and hope.
Author: Joseph B. Wirthlin

Quote: Love is like a faucet, it turns off and on.
Author: Billie Holiday

Quote: Love dies only when growth stops.
Author: Pearl S. Buck

Quote: Find a beautiful piece of art. If you fall in love with Van Gogh or Matisse or John Oliver Killens, or if you fall love with the music of Coltrane, the music of Aretha Franklin, or the music of Chopin - find some beautiful art and admire it, and realize that that was created by human beings just like you, no more human, no less.
Author: Maya Angelou

Quote: When I go to an art gallery and stand in front of a painting, I don't want someone telling me what I should be seeing or thinking; I want to feel whatever I feel, see whatever I see, and figure out what I figure out.
Author: James Frey

Quote: I think you can have moderate success by copying something else, but if you really want to knock it out of the park, you have to do something different and take chances.
Author: Lee Ann Womack

Quote: Be careful of success; it has a dark side.
Author: Robert Redford

Quote: Half the battle is that people have to like you before you say one joke, one bit of humor.
Author: Don Rickles

Quote: I value humor, kindness, and the ability to tell a good story far more than money, status, or the kind of car someone drives.
Author: Rebecca Wells

Quote: What’s the opposite of start? Would the average person think stop or finish? The answer may reflect the difference between a winner and a loser.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: Philosophy cannot and should not give us an account of faith, but should understand itself and know just what it has indeed to offer, without taking anything away, least of all cheating people out of something by making them think it is nothing.
Author: Søren Kierkegaard

Quote: ...convinced that in trying to please all, he had pleased none, and had lost his ass into the bargain.
Author: Aesop

Quote: What really frightens and dismays us is not external events themselves, but the way in which we think about them. It is not things that disturb us, but our interpretation of their significance.
Author: Epictetus

Quote: The time of the autumn floods came and the hundred streams poured into the Yellow River. … Then the Lord of the River was beside himself with Joy, believing that all the beauty in the world belonged to him alone.
Author: Zhuangzi,  Chuang Tzu: Basic Writings

Quote: striid andWthdraw into yourself. Our master-reason asks no more than to act justly, and thereby to achieve calm.
Author: Marcus Aurelius,  Meditations

Quote: I do not know what the heart of a rascal may be, but I know what is in the heart of an honest man; it is horrible.
Author: Joseph de Maistre

Quote: Qualsiasi uomo notevole, chiunque cioè non appartenga a quei 5/6 dell'umanità dotati tanto miseramente dalla natura, rimarrà dopo i quarant'anni difficilmente esente da una certa traccia di misantropia.
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Quote: Bodies are real entities. Surfaces and lines are but fictitious entities. A surface without depth, a line without thickness, was never seen by any man; no; nor can any conception be seriously formed of its existence.
Author: Jeremy Bentham,  The Panopticon Writings

Quote: In the name of Bacon will you chicken me up that egg.Shall I swallow cave-phantoms?
Author: Samuel Beckett,  Collected Poems in English and French

Quote: [O]ther thinkers have philosophised since the time of Plato, but that does not destroy the interest and beauty of his philosophy
Author: Frederick Charles Copleston,  A History of Philosophy Volume 1: Greece and Rome, From the Pre-Socratics to Plotinus

Quote: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can floods drown it. What then kills love? Only this: Neglect.
Author: Jeanette Winterson,  Written on the Body

Quote: I have no desire for others to take it on themselves to analyze my thoughts. I am without thoughts. I have never, not even once, acted on the basis of any doctrine or philosophy.I am convinced that those people whom the world considers good and respects are all liars and fakes. I do not trust the world.
Author: Osamu Dazai,  The Setting Sun

Quote: I will not join the rat race because I'm not a rat. And I will not blindly follow a specific faith because I'm not a bat. The only race I'll take part in is for humans being humane. It's called the human race, and sadly it's got the least participants.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Life: It is better not to wrap philosophy around such an inconceivable evolving beautiful mystery. If based on perception, alone; whatever the conclusion - it is still guessing.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: I wonder why peopke are so afraid of love. Of different kinds of love. I just don't get it. Why aren't we afraid of racism"Of war? But love? It just doesn't make sense.
Author: Gail Sidonie Sobat,  Chance to Dance for You

Quote: Her maktul katilinde yaşamaya devam eder.
Author: Elif Shafak

Quote: Believe in human beings - not all are good, but deep down all can be. But that doesn't mean you need to hang around crappy people and try to turn them around.
Author: Jonas Eriksson

Quote: I tried to think the same thought in as many different religions as possible, so the thought itself wouldn't be limited by any particular way of reasoning, the way words restrict -- the whole eskimo-seventeen-words-for-snow idea.
Author: Patricia Geary,  Strange Toys

Quote: L'étude du beau est un duel où l'artiste crie de frayeur avant d'être vaincu.
Author: Charles Baudelaire,  Petits Poemes En Prose

Quote: The ethos of redemption is realized in self-mastery, by means of temperance, that is, continence of desires.
Author: Pope John Paul II

Quote: Don’t reject something just because it seems strange. It’s comfort that will kill you in the end.
Author: Simon Morden,  The Lost Art

Quote: Any person who, with all the sincerity of heart, is in search for God, on land or in the sea, is worthy of respect.
Author: Riaz Ahmed Gohar Shahi,  The Religion of God

Quote: Entertainment is temporary happiness, but the real happiness is permanent entertainment.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: Entertainment is temporary happiness, but the real happiness is permanent entertainment.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: The most unlucky generation is the one which couldn't produce a hero to look upto.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: The more details, depth and thought you put into your ideas the more valuable they become.
Author: Simon Zingerman,  We All Need Heroes: Stories of the Brave and Foolish

Quote: Think of me as an impetuous Hegel, drunk with power, and also, regular drunk.
Author: Eugene Mirman,  The Will to Whatevs: A Guide to Modern Life

Quote: love as a passion—it is our European specialty—must absolutely be of noble origin; as is well known, its invention is due to the Provencal poet-cavaliers, those brilliant, ingenious men of the "gai saber,"to whom Europe owes so much, and almost owes itself.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Beyond Good and Evil

Quote: Etre dans le vent, c'est avoir le destin des feuilles mortes.
Author: Jean Guitton

Quote: How could someone possibly be that beautiful? She wondered for the hundred thousandth time. What higher power orchestrated such a perfect union of genes? Who decided that one single solitary soul deserved skin like that? It was so fundamentally unfair.(Chasing Harry Winston)
Author: Lauren Weisberger

Quote: The best of humanity's recorded history is a creative balance between horrors endured and victories achieved, and so it was during the Harlem Renaissance.
Author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

Quote: Business people - Your business - is your greatest prejudice: it ties you to your locality, to the company you keep, to the inclinations you feel. Diligent in business - but indolent in spirit, content with your inadequacy, and with the cloak of duty hung over this contentment: that is how you live, that is how you want your children to live!
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Daybreak: Thoughts on the Prejudices of Morality

Quote: Were prayers of murderers, when fighting on the “right side” of the war, ever heard—let alone answered?
Author: Kristina McMorris,  Letters From Home

Quote: Poetry and art nourish the soul of the world with the flavor-filled substances of beauty, wisdom and truth.
Author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

Quote: Dreams. They start in your beautiful mind. Think of beautiful things and it will manifest into actions because your body will listen to you. Like it always does.
Author: Diana Rose Morcilla

Author: Diana Rose Morcilla

Quote: Always ask the questions you want to, life is too short to know if you'll get a second chance to ask , and afterlife is probably too long to wonder what the answer may be.
Author: Kaitlin Hollon

Quote: One of the professors told me last week that he feels bad teaching with the way the economy is now. ‘What’s the point?’ he said. ‘Kids aren’t getting jobs.’ You never hear faculty talk that way. He did.
Author: Daniel Amory,  Minor Snobs

Quote: But no: he was empty, he was confronted by a vast anger, a desperate anger, he saw it and could almost have touched it. But it was inert - if it were to live and find expression and suffer, he must lend it his own body. It was other people's anger. "Swine!"He clenched his fists, he strode along, but nothing came, the anger remained external to himself.
Author: Jean-Paul Sartre,  The Age of Reason

Quote: The best proof that He will never cease to love us lies in that He never began.
Author: Geerhardus Vos,  Redemptive History and Biblical Interpretation: The Shorter Writings of Geerhardus Vos

Quote: Never say never
Author: Charles Dickens

Quote: The philosopher is a person who refuses no pleasures which do not produce greater sorrows, and who knows how to create new ones.
Author: Giacomo Casanova

Quote: For the newborn and wise, everything begins small.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Any man filled with empathy is capable of gaining valuable insights on the human condition through the suffering of others. You do not need to suffer to know suffering, but you need empathy first to identify and feel the suffering of others around you.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Any man filled with empathy is capable of gaining valuable insights on the human condition through the suffering of others. You do not need to suffer to know suffering, but you need empathy first to identify and feel the suffering of others around you.

Quote: Wisdom comes alone through suffering.
Author: Aeschylus

Quote: Wisdom comes alone through suffering.
Author: Aeschylus

Quote: You have to be ill if you want to get better.
Author: Colin Firth,  Speaking With the Angel

Quote: He had an answer to almost everything and he retired at an early age.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic

Quote: He had an answer to almost everything and he retired at an early age.
Author: Dejan Stojanovic

Quote: The greatest happiness is when the eye discovers beauty where neither then mind conceived of nor the hand intended any.
Author: Orhan Pamuk,  The Innocence of Objects

Quote: Are you happy here with me? Because if not, we can scoot over a few feet.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: So he caught her in his arms and kissed her, and they were very happy, and told each other what a beautiful world it was, and how wonderful it was that they should have found each other, seeing that the world is not only beautiful but rather large.
Author: E. Nesbit,  The Magic World

Quote: In order to have great happiness, you have to have great pain and unhappiness-otherwise how would you know when you're happy?
Author: Leslie Caron

Quote: Through strength I found loveIn time I found myself in happiness with you
Author: Alexis Jordan

Quote: If you love a person, you should show it in adundance, not reserve it for special occasions like fine china.
Author: Bryan Cohen,  The Post-College Guide to Happiness

Quote: Ultimately, happiness comes down to choosing between the discomfort of becoming aware of your mental afflictions and the discomfort of being ruled by them.
Author: Yongey Mingyur,  The Joy of Living: Unlocking the Secret and Science of Happiness

Quote: As I watch him, a sudden recognition comes over me: Tonight, I can be anyone I want… maybe being happy only means living in the moment, appreciating the exact moment you're in and not thinking about the worries of the future.
Author: Laura Fitzgerald,  Veil of Roses

Quote: I know how syrupy this sounds, how dull, provincial, and possibly whitewashed, but what can I do? Happy childhoods happen
Author: Marisa de los Santos,  Belong to Me

Quote: Then hope unlooked-for came so suddenly to Eomer's heart, and with it the bite of care and fear renewed, that he said no more, but turned and went swiftly from the hall.
Author: J.R.R. Tolkien,  The Return of the King

Quote: But you'd get arguments from all kinds of people that the Bible has got to be perfect. That God would not permit such errors to be made in the Holy Word.""I thought God gave everyone free will. Which would presumably - and evidently - include the freedom to be incorrect when translating one language into another.""Stop making me think. I'm believing over here.
Author: Jim Butcher,  White Night

Quote: Many were the steps taken in doubt, that saw their shapeless ends in no time. Those who travail in faith today will truimph in joy tomorrow. Let faith lead the way.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

(p. 21)
Author: Robin R. Meyers,  Saving Jesus from the Church: How to Stop Worshiping Christ and Start Following Jesus

Author: Frederica Mathewes-Green,  At the Corner of East and Now: A Modern Life in Ancient Christian Orthodoxy

Quote: It's better to dare to dream big and achieve half of your dreams than to dream small dreams and achieve all
Author: Bernard Kelvin Clive,  Your Dreams Will Not Die

Author: Bernard Kelvin Clive,  Your Dreams Will Not Die

Author: Julia Cameron,  Faith and Will: Weathering the Storms in Our Spiritual Lives

Quote: Waiting is an exercise of faith that demonstrates the condition of our hearts. Waiting on God is an act of faith. And faith is what separates the men from the boys.
Author: Steve Farrar,  God Built (Joseph) - Forged By God...In The Bad And Good Of Life

Quote: Think about this: You don't know when these people are going to die. They could get into a car today and be killed on the way home. Did they ever hear about Jesus? God has put you in their lives to be His ambassador. You're His megaphone, through which He wants to call out to them to come to Him and be saved.
Author: Ryan Dobson,  Be Intolerant: Because Some Things Are Just Stupid

Quote: God's love for his people is so great that it turns God against himself, his love against his justice.
Author: Pope Benedict XVI,  God Is Love: Deus Caritas Est

Quote: ...Our Lord Jesus Christ added nothing to God in his essential being and glory, either by what He did or suffered. True, blessedly and gloriously true. He manifested the glory of God to us, but he added nought to God... Christ's goodness and rightousness reached unto His saints in the earth but God was high above and beyond it all....
Author: Arthur W. Pink,  The Attributes of God

Quote: If God had not permitted the people of Jerusalem to be torn asunder and driven them from the land, but had let them keep it after before, no one could convince them that they are not God`s chosen people.
Author: Martin Luther,  The Jews and Their Lies

Quote: ONE BUT MANYOne God, many faces.One family, many races.One truth, many paths.One heart, many complexions.One light, many reflections.One world, many imperfections.ONE.We are all one,But many.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: My mother-in-law got so angry at me she vowed she’d never speak to me again, and I smiled and gave thanks for the little miracle God worked in my life.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book is Not FOR SALE

Quote: The typical atheist rebels against God as a teenager rebels against his parents. When his own desires or standards are not fulfilled in the way that he sees fit, he, in revolt, storms out of the house in denial of the Word of God and in scrutiny of a great deal of those who stand by the Word of God. The epithet 'Heavenly Father' is a grand reflection, a relation to that of human nature.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: They ought to make it a binding clause that if you find God you get to keep Him.
Author: Philip K. Dick,  VALIS

Quote: Oh my God ... YOU are real.Oh my God ... You ARE real.OH MY GOD ... You are REAL!Oh my God ... You're really real!
Author: Pattie Mallette,  Nowhere But Up: The Story of Justin Bieber's Mom

Quote: Statistics, likelihoods, and probabilities mean everything to men, nothing to God.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Smile Anyway: Quotes, Verse, & Grumblings for Every Day of the Year

Quote: In tough and desperate times when your creativity begs to be birthed, loose the confines of the ground; stand up in your faith and walk atop the waves…
Author: Stanice Anderson

Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Hope, how she had grown to hate the word. It was an insideious seed planted inside a person's soul, surviving covertly on little tending, then flowering so spectacularly that none could help but cherish it.
Author: Kate Morton,  The Forgotten Garden

Quote: It's true I live on hope. Why shouldn't I? Every day I see her beauty while you rot in hell. You will tell me that I'm deluded but we are all deluded in some way. The question is which is the best delusion.
Author: Danny Scheinmann,  Random Acts Of Heroic Love

Quote: Man invents nothing God did not create first.
Author: Mitch Albom,  The Time Keeper

Quote: A man of God would never burn or harm a temple of any kind - regardless of religion. A true man of God would see every temple or divine mansion built to glorify the Creator - as an extension of the temple closest to his home, regardless of its shape, size, or color. A man who truly recognizes and knows God can see God in all things.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Author: Javier Bardem
