Author: Victor Hugo

Author: Victor Hugo

Quote: You know that I know you know, but I want you to know that I know you know I know you know I know. It’s important for you to know that, you know?
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: The whole of the world could be deduced from the smallest grain of sand if one studied it closely enough.
Author: Christopher Paolini,  Inheritance

Quote: A thousand years ago, everybody knew the Earth was the center of the universe. Five hundred years ago, they knew the Earth was flat. Fifteen minutes ago, you knew we humans were alone on it. Imagine what you'll know tomorrow.
Author: Tommy Lee Jones

Quote: No hay caminos para la paz; la paz es el camino.
Author: Mahatma Gandhi

Quote: love yourself,.,.,.,for the sake of  your better future
Author: John Grisham,  La tapadera

Quote: Feed your self-esteem; not your ego!
Author: Deborah Brodie

Quote: When you make the dream of your heart a treasure of heaven, it holds an eternal value.
Author: Deborah Brodie,  The Path That Gets Brighter: A Devotional to Instruct, Illustrate, and Encourage Kingdom Principles

Quote: When we embrace who we are the world embraces us right back.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Treat yourself today! You are a unique, sparkling, spectacular soul. Celebrate you!
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Kindness and caring are ambrosia for the soul.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Lie beside me, oh my beloved! For thy thorns are more pleasurable than the petals of the world.Hold me in thy arms of hope, for the truth of separation can rest tonight.
Author: Faraaz Kazi

Author: Faraaz Kazi

Author: Gary L. Francione

Author: Amy McGuire

Quote: Harus menjadi pemberani pada hidup yang dipilih, harus menjadi pejuang pada hidup yang di luar pilihan.
Author: Ophan Bunjos,  BIN

Quote: To be too knowing is a downfall.
Author: Laura Linney

Quote: Why covet a knowledge of new facts? Day and night, house and garden, a few books, a few actions, serve us as well as would all trades and all spectacles. We are far from having exhausted the significance of the few symbols we use. We can come to use them yet with a terrible simplicity.
Author: Ralph Waldo Emerson,  The Essays of Ralph Waldo Emerson

Author: Gopichand Lagadapati

Quote: We're never called on to do what hurts. We just do what hurts out of ignorance and habit. Once we see what we're doing, we can stop.
Author: Steve Hagen,  Buddhism Plain and Simple

Quote: Quotes ain’t all that useful. Fact is, there’s more concise ways to express what you’re feelin’, like screams and moans.
Author: M.C. Humphreys

Quote: Extend your "best before"date by living a youthful life.
Author: Lorii Myers,  Make It Happen, A Healthy, Competitive Approach to Achieving Personal Success

Quote: God doesn't like it when we ask Him for the smallest things, dare to make your dream so big that He can conveniently fit into it and make your dream come true.

Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Best Option

Author: Dee J. Adams

Quote: In the height of the gusts, in my high position, where the seas did not break, I found myself compelled to cling tightly to the rail to escape being blown away. My face was stung to severe pain by the high-driving spindrift, and I had a feeling that the wind was blowing the cobwebs out of my sleep-starved brain.
Author: Jack London,  The Mutiny of the Elsinore

Author: Tadahiko Nagao

Author: John Paul Warren

Author: John Paul Warren

Author: Kay Ryan

Author: Stephen King

Author: Paulo Coelho

Quote: Memoria selectiva para recordar lo bueno, prudencia logica para no arruinar el presente y optimismo desafiante para encarar al futuro.
Author: Jean Shinoda Bolen

Author: David Kofi Awusi

Quote: The excitement of dreams coming true is beyond the description of words.
Author: Lailah Gifty Akita

By getting boys interested in raising a horse rather than killing another human being, these cowboys gave the youth something positive: father figures, focus, and the ability to stand tall.
Author: G. Neri,  Ghetto Cowboy

Quote: If you like fantasy and you want to be the next Tolkien, don’t read big Tolkienesque fantasies — Tolkien didn’t read big Tolkienesque fantasies, he read books on Finnish philology. Go and read outside of your comfort zone, go and learn stuff.

Quote: The ultimate source of comfort and peace is within ourselves.
Author: Dalai Lama XIV

Author: Shannon L. Alder

And even worse, I never asked her what frightened me the most: Why had she given up hope?

Author: Anamika Mishra

Author: Sarah McLean,  Soul-Centered: Transform Your Life in 8 Weeks with Meditation

Now, when she looks at me, it's a vacuum. I had drained so much from her over the course of our marriage that every glance rips a little bit of my soul away to fill the void I had whittled within her.

Author: Antonio R. Damasio

Author: Milton H. Erickson

And such a leader is dangerous, because they only feel secure in the darkness. Only a leader who is free from corruption welcomes scrutiny; for scrutiny allows a good leader to be an even greater leader.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: There are, and always have been, destructive pseudo-scientific notions linked to race and religion; these are the most widespread and damaging. Hopefully, educated people can succeed in shedding light into these areas of prejudice and ignorance, for as Voltaire once said: 'Men will commit atrocities as long as they believe absurdities.
Author: Martin Gardner

Author: Thomas Jefferson

Author: Margaret Mead

Author: Elizabeth George,  A Woman's High Calling

Author: Truth Devour,  Unrequited

Author: Leah Hager Cohen,  Glass, Paper, Beans: Revolutions on the Nature and Value of Ordinary Things

Author: Kurt Hahn

Author: Chuck Palahniuk,  Fight Club

Author: Thomas Moore,  Original Self: Living with Paradox and Originality

Author: W.P. Kinsella,  Shoeless Joe

Quote: Success is counted sweetest by those ne'er succeed.
Author: Emily Dickinson

Quote: Success, if I simply gave it to you, you wouldn’t have the pleasure of taking it.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

Quote: ...even though I was getting better education at home than any of the kids in Toyah, I'd need to go to finishing school when I was thirteen, both to acquire social graces and to earn a diploma. Because in this world, Dad said, it's not enough to have a fine education. You need a piece of paper to prove you go it.
Author: Jeannette Walls,  Half Broke Horses

Quote: life is a continous journey of transformation
Author: Sukant Ratnakar,  Open the Windows

Quote: Whoever is under a man's power is under his protection, too.
Author: David J. Schwartz

Quote: So here I am with this double life, one where my grammatically incorrect writing is a nice success with tens of thousands of readers, and another one where my carefully written books are read by a dozen people.
Author: Christian A. Dumais

Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  Dream Big!: See Your Bigger Picture!

Quote: Powerful words harmonize heart and mind as if a symphony.
Author: Toba Beta,  Master of Stupidity

Quote: The library is full of stories of supposed triumphs which makes me very suspicious of it. It's misleading for people to read about great successes, since even for middle-class and upper-class white people, in my experience, failure is the norm
Author: Kurt Vonnegut,  Hocus Pocus

Author: Thornton Wilder,  The Ides of March

Author: Jodi Thomas

Quote: If you’ve got a dozen pitchers, you need to speak 12 different languages.
Author: Michael Lewis,  Moneyball: The Art of Winning an Unfair Game

Quote: Spell is a structured words that creates miracles in mind.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Get off the treadmill of consumption, replication, and mediocrity. Begin lifting the weights of creativity, originality, and success.
Author: Ryan Lilly

Quote: I'd rather strive for the kind of interview where instead of me asking to introduce myself to society, society asks me to introduce myself to society.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: The disempowered mind believes dreams come true; the empowered mind knows you bring your dreams to life.
Author: Steve Maraboli

Quote: It is our action that determines the viability of our dream.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: With large industries throwing out the factory model as counterproductive, it is long past time for schools to do the same. I wonder how many adults would do well at dealing with different job requirements and a different boss every 47 minutes.
Author: Susan Ohanian

Quote: We had some good times at school. I didn't know how good those times was till I left, but I guess that's the way of it
Author: Ron Rash,  Serena

Quote: [E]ducation is a holistic endeavor that involves the whole person, including our bodies, in a process of formation that aims our desires, primes our imagination, and orients us to the world -- all before we ever start thinking about it.
Author: James K.A. Smith,  Desiring the Kingdom: Worship, Worldview, and Cultural Formation

Quote: Dont struggle for salary.. DO struggle for Success..
Author: Bhadra

Quote: The way to be nothing is to do nothing
Author: Nathaniel Howe

Quote: The female is, as it were, a mutilated male, and the catamenia are semen, only not pure; for there is only one thing they have not in them, the principle of soul.
Author: Aristotle

Quote: Reading feeds the soul, writing nourishes it!
Author: Joanne McClean

Quote: Sometimes callers from a distance invade my solitude, and it is on these occasions that I realize how absolutely alone each individual is, and how far away from his neighbour; and while they talk (generally about babies, past, present, and to come), I fall to wondering at the vast and impassable distance that separates one's own soul from the soul of the person sitting in the next chair.
Author: Elizabeth von Arnim,  Elizabeth and Her German Garden

Quote: Oh, Irrylath,Irrylath, we squaundered our two years together.
Author: Meredith Ann Pierce,  The Pearl of the Soul of the World

Quote: I walk with a purpose. And a limp. (The limp helps serve my purpose, which is to gain sympathy.)
Author: Jarod Kintz,  99 Cents For Some Nonsense

Quote: Don't live in regret! It is such a useless idea.Use the memory to prevent us do bad things!Regret is a childish wish, or an empty hope,trying to revise the bitter memory of the past.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Blame is the creed of the disempowered.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: If you remain static and wait for success to come to you it will certainly not happen.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: The quest for a lost city erodes your body, damaging you beyond all reason. But it is your mind that bears the heaviest toll. Listen to the doubters, the worriers and the weak, and the vaguest hope of success evaporates.
Author: Tahir Shah,  House of the Tiger King: The Quest for a Lost City

Quote: If you want to continue to be the best in the world, then you have to train and compete like you are second best in the world.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: See it first in your mind, then become it.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: Human beings are incredibly slow, Cosmic Ordering is incredibly fast!
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Connection

Quote: Your life isn't behind you; your memories are behind you. Your life is ALWAYS ahead of you. Today is a new day - seize it!
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Live your epitaph
Author: Zoe Weil,  Most Good, Least Harm: A Simple Principle for a Better World and Meaningful Life

Quote: The mind is just like a muscle - the more you exercise it, the stronger it gets and the more it can expand.
Author: Idowu Koyenikan,  Wealth for All: Living a Life of Success at the Edge of Your Ability

Quote: It is as though we are understanding now what (William) Blake intuited, the senses were, in Eden, spread over the whole being. It might seem, then, that our bodies still live in Eden, but our minds refuse to know it.
Author: Peter Redgrove,  The Black Goddess and the Unseen Real: Our Uncommon Senses and Their Common Sense

Quote: Create your world with God's Word in your mouth just say it and it will be accomplished!
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: It is only normal that people count losses with their minds, and ignore to count blessings with the graciousness of their hearts.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Some piously record 'In the beginning God', but I say 'In the beginning hydrogen'.
Author: Harlow Shapley

Quote: As long as scepticism is based on a sound understanding of science it is invaluable, for that is how science progresses. But poor criticism can lead those who are unfamiliar with the science involved into doubting everything about climate change predictions.
Author: Tim Flannery,  The Weather Makers: How Man Is Changing the Climate and What It Means for Life on Earth

Quote: Truths are as much a matter of questions as answers.
Author: Ozzie Zehner,  Green Illusions

Author: Ludwig Feuerbach,  Principles of the Philosophy of the Future

Quote: This (...) had made me aware for the first time of the well-disguised myth that they and the academic institutions they represent are bastions of a free exchange of ideas. They are -but only of those ideas that don't 'rock the boat', that refrain from challenging hallowed taboos.
Author: Jack Kevorkian,  Prescription: Medicide: The Goodness of Planned Death

Quote: I want to meddle with an Olympic medal made of silver metal. I want to alchemize it into gold, and use a mixture of science and mysticism to transform losing into winning.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  99 Cents For Some Nonsense

Quote: Each being in the universe yearns for the free energy necessary for survival and development. Each existence resists extinction. The consequent history of violence in the universe is as inevitable as the gravitational pull between the Earth and the Sun.
Author: Brian Swimme,  The Universe Story: From the Primordial Flaring Forth to the Ecozoic Era--A Celebration of the Unfol

Quote: ... respecto al origen del mundo, si es que lo tuvo, no nos queda más remedio que aceptar que nunca sabremos cómo ocurrió y que Dios es una explicación necia que no explica nada pues es tan difícil imaginar la eternidad suya como la de la materia. Dios es la vuelta del bobo: lo postulamos para entender cuanto no entendemos, pero sin entenderlo a Él.
Author: Fernando Vallejo,  La puta de Babilonia

Quote: Half of all broccoli grown commercially in America today is a single variety- Marathon- notable for it's high yield. The overwhelming majority of the chickens raised for meat in America are the same hybrid, the Cornish cross; more than 99 percent of turkeys are the Broad-Breasted Whites.
Author: Michael Pollan,  In Defense of Food: An Eater's Manifesto

Quote: Because God is perfect, his handiwork functions in accord with immutable principles. By the full use of our God-given powers of reason and observation, it ought to be possible to discover these principles. These were the crucial ideas that explain why science arose in Christian Europe and no where else.
Author: Rodney Stark

Quote: It's almost as if each instant is our last and first. We are always dying, and always reborn. And that is living.
Author: Jonathan Weiner,  Long For This World: The Strange Science of Immortality

Quote: Science, I am told, is making great strides, experimenting, groping after things which no sane man has ever dreamed of before – without being burned alive for it.
Author: Walter de la Mare,  The Return

Quote: think of it.' said Robert Rosenbluth, a doctor whose acquaintance i made at the start of this book. 'no engineer could design something as multifunctional and fine tuned as an anus. to call someone an asshole is really bragging him up.
Author: Mary Roach,  Gulp: Adventures on the Alimentary Canal

Quote: Catch sunbeams in a mirror! A reflection of a sunbeam can melt an iceberg.
Author: Lara Biyuts

Quote: You may not think you eat a lot of corn and soybeans, but you do: 75 percent of the vegetable oils in your diet come from soy (representing 20 percent of your daily calories) and more than half of the sweeteners you consume come from corn (representing around 10 perecent of daily calories).
Author: Michael Pollan,  In Defense of Food: An Eater's Manifesto

Quote: All what we think and know is an illusion. Nothing exists. Everything is an opinion.
Author: Ash Vaz

Quote: ...Man has a tyrant, ignorance. I voted for the demise of that particular tyrant. That particular tyrant has engendered royalty, which is authority based on falsehood, whereas science is authority based on truth. Man should be governed by science alone.""And conscience,"added the bishop."It's the same thing. Conscience is the quota of innate science we each have inside us.
Author: Victor Hugo,  Les Misérables

Quote: Motivation is the art of getting people to do what you want them to do because they want to do it.
Author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

Quote: Motivation is the art of getting people to do what you want them to do because they want to do it.
Author: Dwight D. Eisenhower

Quote: When I lose the sense of motivation and the sense to prove something as a basketball player, it's time for me to move away from the game.
Author: Michael Jordan

Quote: Each day provides its own gifts.
Author: Marcus Aurelius

Quote: Love the moment and the energy of that moment will spread beyond all boundaries.
Author: Corita Kent

Quote: Love the moment and the energy of that moment will spread beyond all boundaries.
Author: Corita Kent

Quote: It is important to our friends to believe that we are unreservedly frank with them, and important to friendship that we are not.
Author: Mignon McLaughlin

Quote: You find out who your real friends are when you're involved in a scandal.
Author: Elizabeth Taylor

Quote: Life is 10 percent what you make it, and 90 percent how you take it.
Author: Irving Berlin

Quote: The monotony and solitude of a quiet life stimulates the creative mind.
Author: Albert Einstein

Quote: When people endure a traumatic event, they are either defeated or made stronger. On Sept. 11, I told New Yorkers, 'I want you to emerge stronger from this.' My words were partially a hope and partially an observation that people in New York City handle big things better than little things. I could not be more proud of the way my city responded.
Author: Rudy Giuliani

Quote: The Grateful Dead, they're my best friends. Their message of hope, peace, love, teamwork, creativity, imagination, celebration, the dance, the vision, the purpose, the passion all of the things I believe in makes me the luckiest Deadhead in the world.
Author: Bill Walton

Quote: The ear is the avenue to the heart.
Author: Voltaire

Quote: There is only one kind of love, but there are a thousand imitations.
Author: Francois de La Rochefoucauld

Quote: Insurrection is an art, and like all arts has its own laws.
Author: Leon Trotsky

Quote: Let's say intelligence is your ability to compose poetry, symphonies, do art, math and science. Chimps can't do any of that, yet we share 99 percent DNA. Everything that we are, that distinguishes us from chimps, emerges from that one-percent difference.
Author: Neil deGrasse Tyson

Quote: They thought I was a success as soon as I started paying the bills.
Author: Mahalia Jackson

Quote: In working with top leaders and thought philosophers of our time, I will tell you that among their secrets of success is a regular practice of acknowledging and appreciating what they have. It can offer an oracle into the future because it not only tells you where you are, but it also helps clarify where you want to go in life.
Author: Jack Canfield

Quote: At the risk of appearing disingenuous, I don't really think of myself as 'writing humor.' I'm simply reporting on the world I observe, which is frequently hilarious.
Author: Richard Russo

Quote: I think God gave us senses of humor, and we should use them.
Author: Vera Farmiga

Quote: You are not just for the right or left, but for what is right over the wrong.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: Weather is a purely personal matter. There is no such thing as a climate that is cold or hot, good or bad, healthy or unhealthy. People take it upon themselves to create a fantasy in their imagination and call it weather. There's only one climate in the world, but the message that nature sends is interpreted according to strictly personal, non-transferable rules.
Author: Álvaro Mutis,  The Adventures and Misadventures of Maqroll

Quote: If he was not exactly a Spartan, he was, you might say, spartanatical. Things happened to you; they were good,or they were bad - and that was the truth about everything.
Author: A.E. Coppard,  Dusky Ruth: And Other Stories

Quote: Time is the Mind of Space.
Author: Samuel Alexander,  Space, Time and Deity: The Gifford Lectures at Glasgow Part One

Quote: We must think beyond ourselves
Author: Kevin J. Anderson,  A Forest of Stars

Quote: History is a hermaphrodite with many distinguished lovers. We are neither mysteries nor strangers but the living breath of revelation made flesh by the unrestrained desires of a free and universal love. Universal me. Universal you.”--from Past Present and Future are One
Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Quote: I am serving the purpose for which I was designed, therefore I am satisfied with my existence.
Author: Kevin J. Anderson

Quote: I am serving the purpose for which I was designed, therefore I am satisfied with my existence.
Author: Kevin J. Anderson

Quote: I speak gibberish to the civilized world and it replies in kind.
Author: Kurt Vonnegut

Quote: Mr. Trask, do you think the thoughts of people suddenly become important at a given age? Do you have sharper feelings or clearer thoughts now than when you were ten? Do you see as well, hear as well, taste as vitally?
Author: John Steinbeck

Quote: A farm regulated to production of raw commodities is not a farm at all. It is a temporary blip until the land is used up, the water polluted, the neighbors nauseated, and the air unbreathable. The farmhouse, the concrete, the machinery, and outbuildings become relics of a bygone vibrancy when another family farm moves to the city financial centers for relief.
Author: Joel Salatin,  Everything I Want to Do Is Illegal: War Stories from the Local Food Front

Quote: To establish that a rule is likely to be true, one must try to prove it false.
Author: Stuart Sutherland,  Irrationality

Quote: Propounding peace and love without practical or institutional engagement is delusion, not virtue.
Author: Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel

Quote: I mean really, how could an artistic individual stay grounded in the nitty-gritty of how many minutes per pound meat has to stay in the oven when trying to fathom the creative philosophy behind the greatest artistic minds of the world?
Author: E.A. Bucchianeri,  Brushstrokes of a Gadfly

Quote: If we thought more for ourselves we would have very many more bad books and very many more good ones.
Author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg

Quote: When they have discovered truth in nature they fling it into a book, where it is even worse hands.
Author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg

Quote: I have always thought that all philosophical debates are ultimately between the partisans of structure and the partisans of "goo.
Author: Alan W. Watts,  The Essential Alan Watts

Quote: Morality can provide at most only a severely limited and insufficient answer to the question of how a person should live.
Author: Harry G. Frankfurt,  The Reasons of Love

Quote: Never say no to now
Author: Benny Bellamacina,  Piddly poems for children vol:3

Quote: Almost all arguments for skepticism make reference to seemingly ridiculous possibilities—we are being deceived by an evil demon, life is just a dream, we are brains in vats. You might propose psychoanalysis, rather than philosophical reflection, for anyone who worries about these possibilities.
Author: Richard Feldman

Quote: Keinginan telah mengajarkan kepadamu betapa sia-sianya keinginan, penyesalan mengajarkan betapa sia-sianya penyesalan. Bersabarlah wahai kekeliruan, karena kami semua menjadi bagianmu. Bersabarlah wahai Ketidaksempurnaan, berkat engkaulah Kesempurnaan menyadari dirinya. Bersabarlah kemarahan, karena engkau tidak kekal abadi.
Author: Marguerite Yourcenar

Quote: Love' is the only weapon I have, I will defend with love, I will attack with love.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: Love' is the only weapon I have, I will defend with love, I will attack with love.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: A false-statement requires deceit and distortion for someone to buy it, but a truthful-statement sells itself.
Author: William Bailey,  Great Ship of Knowledge: Learning Earth's Deathly History

Quote: In every ancient religious and sacred text, faith is a verb; a thing to be demonstrated. It is in modern days that we have diluted faith from an act to a philosophy.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: In every ancient religious and sacred text, faith is a verb; a thing to be demonstrated. It is in modern days that we have diluted faith from an act to a philosophy.
Author: Steve Maraboli,  Unapologetically You: Reflections on Life and the Human Experience

Quote: Why is it so difficult for us to think in relative terms? Well, for the good reason that human nature loves absoluteness, and erroneously considers it as a state of higher knowledge.
Author: Felix Alba-Juez,  Who was Right: Ptolemy or Copernicus?

Quote: We co-create our reality with others in unseen ways.
Author: Doug Dillon

Quote: We co-create our reality with others in unseen ways.
Author: Doug Dillon

Quote: You have made the moon,"The Jester said. "That is the moon.
Author: James Thurber,  Many Moons

Quote: Therefore we will not listen to the source itself in order to learn what it is or what it means, but rather to the turns of speech, the allegories, figures, metaphors, as you will, into which the source has deviated, in order to lose it or rediscover it—which always amounts to the same.
Author: Jacques Derrida

Quote: A world without poetry and art would be too much like one without birds or flowers: bearable but a lot less enjoyable.
Author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

Quote: All that exists is just and unjust and is equally justified in both respects.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche

Quote: How keen everyone is to make this world their home forgetting its impermanence It's like trying to see and name constellations in a fireworks display.
Author: Nadeem Aslam,  The Wasted Vigil

Quote: We're on a planet, relax!
Author: Benny Bellamacina,  Piddly Poems for Children, v.2

Quote: When it comes to Schopenhauer, I think I need a To-Go box.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Quote: Philosophy, as we use the word, is a fight against the fascination which forms of expression exert upon us.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein,  کتاب آبی

Quote: If you go to Singapore or Amsterdam or Seoul or Buenos Aires or Islamabad or Johannesburg or Tampa or Istanbul or Kyoto, you'll find that the people differ wildly in the way they dress, in their marriage customs, in the holidays they observe, in their religious rituals, and so on, but they all expect the food to be under lock and key. It's all owned, and if you want some, you'll have to buy it.
Author: Daniel Quinn

Quote: Thank heaven for people who are satisfied with facts that conform to the reality they wish to believe.
Author: Gary Inbinder,  Confessions of the Creature

Quote: There is no such thing as objectivity. We are all just interpreting signals from the universe and trying to make sense of them. Dim, shaky, weak, static-y little signals that only hint at the complexity of a universe we cannot begin to understand.
Author: Bones The Doctor in the Photo

Quote: €7,500, first-class, everything—and all that for 40 minutes selling them some old stuff.
Author: Slavoj Žižek

Quote: But the goal of the arts, culinary or otherwise, is not to increase our comfort. That is the goal of an easy chair.
Author: Jeffrey Steingarten,  The Man Who Ate Everything

Quote: Buffett does enjoy being a billionaire, but in offbeat ways. As he put it, though money cannot change your health or how many people love you, it lets you be in 'more interesting environments.
Author: Roger Lowenstein,  Buffett: The Making of an American Capitalist

Quote: Art is whatever you can get away with.
Author: Marshall McLuhan,  The Medium is the Massage

Quote: It takes a well-spent lifetime, and perhaps more, to crystalize in us that for which we exist.
Author: Jean Toomer,  Cane

Quote: Maybe we should always start everything from the inside and work to the outside, and not from the outside to the inside. What d'you think?
Author: Aidan Chambers,  Postcards from No Man's Land

Quote: Good authors worry about genres great authors don't.
Author: Frank X. Gaspar

Quote: To the untutored sage, the concentration of population was the prolific mother of all evils, moral no less than physical. He argued that food is good, while surfeit kills; that love is good, but lust destroys; and not less dreaded than the pestilence following upon crowded and unsanitary dwellings was the loss of spiritual power inseparable from too close contact with one's fellow-men.
Author: Charles Alexander Eastman,  The Soul of the Indian

Quote: I believe that just because something didn’t go the way you planned it once, it’s no reason not to try again.
Author: Chantelle Shaw,  The Ultimate Risk

Quote: An over examination of life can deter you from life itself
Author: Ilyas Kassam

Quote: Visible objects therefore do not perish utterly, since nature repairs one thing from another and allows nothing to be born without the aid of another's death.
Author: Titus Lucretius Carus

Quote: FRANCISCUS: How sweetly she looks! Oh, but there's a wrinkle in her brow as deep as philosophy.
Author: Thomas Middleton,  The Changeling

Quote: We are the lucky ones for we shall die, as there is an infinite number of possible forms of DNA all but a few billions of which will never burst into consciousness.
Author: Frank Close,  The Void

Author: Longinus,  Longinus on the Sublime: The Greek Text

Quote: What is humor?' one of their professors had posed, and he had answered, ''nondangerous, unexpectedly inappropriate juxtaposition.
Author: Sena Jeter Naslund,  Four Spirits

Quote: As a man, casting off worn out garments taketh new ones, so the dweller in the body, entereth into ones that are new.
Author: Epictetus

Quote: There are no free lunches in philosophy any more than in real life.
Author: Jaegwon Kim,  Mind in a Physical World: An Essay on the Mind-Body Problem and Mental Causation

Quote: Snow floated down every once in a while, but it was frail snow, like a memory fading into the distance.
Author: Haruki Murakami,  The Wind-Up Bird Chronicle

Quote: As individuals express their life, so they are.
Author: Karl Marx,  The German Ideology

Quote: Of course there’s a risk that that could happen, but what is the alternative? To never allow myself to get close to anyone ever again? Never know the joy of loving someone for fear that it could end up in tears? My heart might stay safe, but it wouldn’t be much of a life.
Author: Chantelle Shaw,  The Ultimate Risk

Quote: ...even nursery tales only echo an almost pre-natal leap of interest and amazement. These tales say that apples were golden only to refresh the forgotten moment when we found that they were green. They make rivers run with wine only to make us remember, for one wild moment, that they run with water.
Author: G.K. Chesterton,  Orthodoxy

Quote: Пустинните бурени оцеляват, а пролетното цвете разцъфва и повяхва.
Author: Khaled Hosseini,  The Kite Runner

Quote: Philosophy cannot be extinguished, though men will try ... The spirit seeks the light, that is its nature. It wishes to return to its origin, and must forever try to reach enlightenment.
Author: Iain Pears,  The Dream of Scipio

Quote: Flow is the best of what happens when potential is activated by consciousness.
Author: Dew Platt,  The Rudeness of Soul

Quote: Nature, it seems, is the popular namefor milliards and milliards and milliardsof particles playing their infinite gameof billiards and billiards and billiards.
Author: Piet Hein

Quote: Comprehending and knowing better and deeper are the best guarantees we can have to attain ideas and criteria of our own; i.e. to stop depending on what other people say. In summary, to be freer to choose our own path in life.
Author: Manuel Toharia-Cortés,  Galloping with Light - Einstein, Relativity, and Folklore

Author: Felix Alba-Juez

Author: Benny Bellamacina

Quote: Staring at a world too horrible to comprehend, believing -- by dint of ignorance and innocence -- that beneath this unbearable contract of guilt and blame there is always an older contract that may bind and release in a more salutary way.
Author: Gregory Maguire,  Wicked: The Life and Times of the Wicked Witch of the West

Author: Felix Alba-Juez

Author: Doug Dillon

Author: Doug Dillon

Quote: Who are you? No really. Way, way down deep. Who are you?
Author: Doug Dillon

Author: Paul Karl Feyerabend,  Problems of Empiricism: Philosophical Papers: Problems of Empiricism v. 2 (Philosophical Papers

Quote: I can blend words easily with my pen, and show concepts from deep within. Yet not everyone gets the message I send. So why do I even let these words begin? Maybe they will soak in one day at the right time. When the readers on a new path to find. So for now I'll continue to drop ink and not worry about what other people think.
Author: Stanley Victor Paskavich

Quote: Hence the sterile, uninspiring futility of a great many theoretical discussions of ethics, and the resentment which many people feel towards such discussions: moral principles remain in their minds as floating abstractions, offering them a goal they cannot grasp and demanding that they reshape their souls in its image, thus leaving them with a burden of undefinable moral guilt.
Author: Ayn Rand,  The Romantic Manifesto

Quote: You and I are part of the colony of heaven. Right now, we may reside here on earth, but our passport indicates that our citizenship is in heaven. We are on the earth, but not of the earth.
Author: Allen R. Hunt,  Confessions of a Mega Church Pastor: How I Discovered the Hidden Treasures of the Catholic Church

Quote: When you're in the muck you can only see muck. If you somehow manage to float above it, you still see the muck but you see it from a different perspective. And you see other things too. That's the consolation of philosophy.
Author: David Cronenberg

Quote: Furthermore, as the body suffers the horrors of disease and the pangs of pain, so we see the mind stabbed with anguish, grief and fear. What more natural than that it should likewise have a share in death?
Author: Titus Lucretius Carus,  On the Nature of Things

Author: L.E. Modesitt Jr.,  The Elysium Commission

Quote: Popular medicine and popular morality belong together and ought not to be evaluated so differently as they still are: both are the most dangerous pseudo-sciences.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Daybreak: Thoughts on the Prejudices of Morality

Quote: Question for your life: If Socrates had a clone, would he advise that clone to know thy self, or to know myself, with myself in this case being himself?
Author: Jarod Kintz,  $3.33

Author: Omaid olovejlj Zazai

Author: Barbara Barrington Jones

Quote: For a woman to deny the necessity of true love in her life would be to deny herself, and her creator.
Author: Dwain K. White Sr.,  Every Woman's Dream

Quote: Merry hearts are vulnerable to death, don't be over-joyed to the state of oblivion, lest the enemy poison your meal.
Author: Michael Bassey Johnson

Quote: A FriendSomeoneYou're happy to see,Who's happy to see you.SomeoneYou like for who they areNot just for what they can do for you.
Author: Nancy J. Cavanaugh,  This Journal Belongs to Ratchet

Quote: Happiness does not come from a job. It comes from knowing what you truly value, and behaving in a way that’s consistent with those beliefs.
Author: Mike Rowe

Quote: when you live forever and don't age, it gives you time to hope
Author: Laurell K. Hamilton

Quote: And I don't believe you dead. How can you be dead if I still feel you? Maybe, like God, you changed into something different that I'll have to speak to in a different way, but you not dead to me Nettie. And never will you be.
Author: Alice Walker,  The Color Purple

Author: Sanhita Baruah

Quote: Faith is a process of leaping into the abyss not on the basis of any certainty about where we shall land, but rather on the belief that we shall land.
Author: Carter Heyward

Quote: The creation of man is evidence for the love of God, the preservation of man is evidence for the patience of God, and Christ is evidence for the forgiveness of God. It is when we are wrapped up in our own little peeves that we begin to displace His benevolence with malevolence.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: I feel no need for any other faith than my faith in human beings.
Author: Pearl S. Buck

Quote: في بعض الأحيان ، نتخلى عن درب ما ، لأننا ببساطة لا نؤمن بها . وهذا سهل ، فكل ما علينا فعله إثبات أن تلك الطريق ليست لنا . لكن الأحداث التي تبدأ بالحصول ، والإلهام الذي يأتينا خلال مسيرتنا ،يبعثان فينا الخوف من المتابعة
Author: Paulo Coelho,  Brida

Quote: But I could tell thee of other things, Inglés, and do not doubt what thou simply cannot see nor cannot hear. Thou canst not hear what a dog hears. Nor canst thou smell what a dog smells. But already thou hast experienced a little of what can happen to man.
Author: Ernest Hemingway,  For Whom the Bell Tolls

Quote: Shoulders are from God, and burdens too.
Author: Isaac Bashevis Singer,  Gimpel the Fool and Other Stories

Quote: Any profession of faith…entrusts the mind and heart to a truth that cannot be proven but can be lived.
Author: Luke Timothy Johnson,  The Creed: What Christians Believe and Why it Matters

Quote: ... the mind was designed not to defend what we want, but to discover what is ultimately true, which should shape our wants and satisfy them more deeply with God. The purpose of the mind is not to rationalize subjective preferences, but to recognize objective reality and to help the heart revel in God.
Author: John Piper,  The Pleasures of God: Meditations on God's Delight in Being God
