Quote: I look for a sign. Where to go next. you never know when you'll get one. Even the most faithless among us are waiting to be proven wrong.
Author: Jillian Lauren,  Pretty

Quote: I get glimmers of the bad nineteenth-century teaching which has made Mother remove God from the realm of mystery and beauty and glory, but why do people half my age think that they don't have faith unless their faith is small and comprehensible and like a good old plastic Jesus?
Author: Madeleine L'Engle,  The Summer of the Great-Grandmother

Quote: Fidelity is a living, breathing entity. On wobbly footing, it can wander, becoming something different entirely.
Author: Kay Goodstadt,  Love and Death Over Tea

Quote: ...the truth of the matter is that we've all got cracks in our spirits, and we have to remember they're only there because we need them.... Otherwise, how could God's grace filter in deep enough to give us the joy and peace we're all searching for in this world. It couldn't, plain and simple.
Author: Delia Parr,  Hearts Awakening

Quote: If there was no free will in men, then there is no sins. When sins happened, it was 'free will' that made them doable. This is true, unless God has predestined human to do and to have sins.
Author: Toba Beta

Quote: Sometimes the Lord allows us to go through tough times so we learn to rely upon Him.
Author: Shirley Corder,  Strength Renewed: Meditations for Your Journey Through Breast Cancer

Quote: Zeena's first published sermon at 7 years old. From “The Cloven Hoof” periodical, 1970, San Francisco, CA, USA.:“The question, 'What is the difference between God and Satan?,' was put to Zeena LaVey, seven-year-old daughter of the High Priest. Her answer was...'SATAN MADE THE ROSE AND GOD MADE THE THORNS.
Author: Zeena Schreck,  Demons of the Flesh: The Complete Guide to Left Hand Path Sex Magic

Quote: Human desire is the criterion of all truth and all good. Truth does not lie beyond humanity, but is one of the products of the human mind and feeling. There is really nothing to fear. The motive of fear in religion is base...
Author: D.H. Lawrence

Quote: Kuikaribisha amani ya Mungu katika maisha yangu kumenisaidia. Naishi mbinguni duniani.
Author: Enock Maregesi

Quote: Move on, sky is not limit, wind can touch you, water can dip you, mother will care you, wife will nurture you and above all, oneday you will see your child following, up above the sky; you became a star, twinkling, watching and waiting to come back again, on earth.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: Free at last, he thought. Great God Almighty, I'm free at last. Then: I believe this is redemption. And it's good, isn't it? Quite good, indeed.
Author: Stephen King,  The Dark Tower

Quote: How many fears came between us?Earthquakes, diseases, wars where hellrained smoldering pus from skies made of winged death.Horror tore this world asunder.While inside the bleeding smokeand beyond the shredded weeping fleshwe memorized tales of infinite good.--from The History Lesson
Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Quote: How many fears came between us?Earthquakes, diseases, wars where hellrained smoldering pus from skies made of winged death.Horror tore this world asunder.While inside the bleeding smokeand beyond the shredded weeping fleshwe memorized tales of infinite good.--from The History Lesson
Author: Aberjhani,  Elemental: The Power of Illuminated Love

Quote: I used to believe my art had to be about the things that brought me joy and gave me hope. But I learned that art can be found in all of life, even in pain. --Valentine, while in Italy (pg 267)
Author: Adriana Trigiani,  Very Valentine

Quote: The key is loveIt is the gatewayTo hopeTo joyTo enhanced livingLove is the answer
Author: Karen Hackel,  The Whisper of Your Soul

Quote: His hope wasn't lost, it was buried, and somehow Prudence Ryland made that old grave seem much more shallow than it once was.
Author: Kathryn Smith

Quote: Uncertainty is the refuge of hope.
Author: Henri-Frédéric Amiel

Quote: When the world caves inStill my hope will clingTo Your promiseWhere my courage endsLet my heart find strengthIn Your presence
Author: Hillsong

Quote: With no positivity, there is no hope; with no negativity, there is no improvement.
Author: Criss Jami,  Healology

Quote: With no positivity, there is no hope; with no negativity, there is no improvement.
Author: Criss Jami,  Healology

Quote: A DAY LAYE""Every dawn of our lives a heart is forged andLinked with lore to one so similarBorn with blessed life dustStored beneath its soulTo bless and pass onto its childrenEven though the wind may blow it all awayDon't ever worry 'cos I'm your friend.
Author: Marc Bolan,  Marc Bolan Lyric Book

Quote: Once a day has begun eventfully, it generally carries on being every bit as lively.
Author: Albert Ehrenstein,  Tubutsch

Quote: He can't have gone, he said "Christ know he can't have gone. He's making a turn. Maybe he has been hooked before and her remembers something of it."The he felt the gentle touch on the line and he was happy.
Author: Ernest Hemingway,  The Old Man and the Sea

Quote: If I were a character in one of my books, I'd be the optimistic one, believing the best and urging others to do the same.
Author: Stacy Hawkins Adams,  Dreams That Won't Let Go

Quote: If I were a character in one of my books, I'd be the optimistic one, believing the best and urging others to do the same.
Author: Stacy Hawkins Adams,  Dreams That Won't Let Go

Quote: Because now that it's finally morning, the shadows are beginning to fade, the shadows that have been covering my mind and my soul. Now that they're gone, I can almost start to see the way, and it's different from the one they'd convinced me was all I could have.
Author: Vixen Phillips,  Trapdoor

Quote: Only add Deeds to thy knowledge answerable; add faith; Add virtue, patience, temperance; add love, By name to come called charity, the soul Of all the rest: then wilt thou not be loath To leave this Paradise; but shalt possess A paradise within thee, happier far.
Author: John Milton

Quote: People have a hunger to experience the spectacular, but the Lord is supernatural.
Author: Sherry K. White

Quote: Hit ain't sacrilege. Miss Effie Belle says when she cain't think what to have for dinner, she asts God and right off He gives her an idea. To my thinkin', thet's sacrilege."Miss Love really laughed. "There's not a woman in the world who hasn't prayed what to cook for dinner, Rucker!
Author: Olive Ann Burns,  Cold Sassy Tree

Quote: Faith doesn't have to be much. Not any bigger than a mustard seed... That small. Only that much faith you'll need in me, God says, because I am so big. I am the Great I Am. So have faith in me.
Author: Patricia Raybon,  I Told the Mountain to Move: Learning to Pray So Things Change

Quote: There is nothing more powerful than truth. It is undeniable and should always be appreciated. The truth gives you unlimited freedom to be who you are and express how you feel. The truth offers you peace of mind which is something we all love.
Author: Amaka Imani Nkosazana

Quote: We must seek together to address the good aspirations of people everywhere, for we are bound together through great commonality.
Author: Bryant McGill,  Voice of Reason

Quote: Life is full of change, honey. That's how we learn and grow. When we're born, the Good Lord gives each of us a Life book. Chapter by chapter, we live and learn.
Author: Beth Hoffman,  Saving CeeCee Honeycutt

Quote: If we rely on anything else besides faith to maintain the practice of the presence of God, we will certainly fail, whether this is our feelings, or experiences, or sincerity, or good intentions, or reasonings, or plans. The reason these things will fail while faith will not fail is that all these things depend on us, while faith depends on God. It is a gift of God.
Author: Peter Kreeft,  Prayer for Beginners

Quote: God is perceived by the heart, not by your reason. But what is reason? Your heart simplifying God’s guidance to fit your own needs.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: God is A.W.E.S.O.M.E! HE is Always Working Extraordinary Supernatural On-time Miracles Everyday
Author: Sommer Ellison

Quote: Action is what makes hope a reality.
Author: T. M. Brenner

Quote: She was a dreamer and a schemer & one didnt dream and scheme without hope.
Author: Loretta Chase,  Silk Is for Seduction

Quote: Lovelessness is a huge sin in the church. The four primary personalities in the New Testament- Jesus, Paul, Peter, and John- all four of them say that love is the most important thing. But the only time love really counts is when something unlovely happens.
Author: Chu Jeff

Quote: Now listen. Faith is like oxygen. It keeps you afloat at all times. Sometimes you need it. Sometimes you don’t. but when you do need it you better be practiced at having faith, otherwise it won’t work. That’s why the missionaries built all the churches. Before we got those churches we weren’t practicing enough. That’s what prayers are for—practice, children. Practice.
Author: Lloyd Jones,  Mister Pip

Quote: Jauh lebih menyenangkan merasa bahwa Tuhan mendengarkanmu dan mengatakan tidak, ketimbang merasa tak ada siapa pun yang mendengarkanmu
Author: Mitch Albom,  Have a Little Faith: a True Story

Quote: To come to faith on the basis of experience alone is unwise, though not so foolish as to reject faith altogether because of lack of experience ... the quality of a Christian's experience depends on the quality of his faith, just as the quality of his faith depends in turn on the quality of his understanding of God's truth.
Author: Os Guinness,  In Two Minds

Quote: As prayer without faith is but a beating of the air, so trust without prayer [is] but a presumptuous bravado. He that promises to give, and bids us trust His promises, commands us to pray, and expects obedience to his commands. He will give, but not without our asking.
Author: Thomas Lye

Quote: The back door of every tomb opens on a hilltop.
Author: George MacDonald,  Weighed and Wanting

Quote: For those constantly full of joy, they sometimes feel a little guilty for always feeling so good. That guilt is compassion: it flies in with an attempt to share one's joy with others who do not have it.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: You could sit in there all day drinking coffee and they never asked you to leave no matter how bad you looked. They just asked the bums not to bring their wine and drink it there. Places like that gave you hope when there wasn´t much hope.
Author: Charles Bukowski,  Ham on Rye

Quote: My mother is my friendWho shares with me her breadAll my hopelessness cured!Her company makes me secured!
Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

Quote: The child was slender as fleeting hope.
Author: William Peter Blatty,  The Exorcist

Quote: Of course the cat will growl and spit at the operator and bite him if she can. But the real question is whether he is a vet or a vivisector.
Author: C.S. Lewis,  A Grief Observed

Quote: The tide was a poem that only time could create, and I watched it stream and brim and makes its steady dash homeward, to the ocean.
Author: Pat Conroy,  South of Broad

Quote: The day we put an end to believing in hope will be the day we stop existing, for without hope, we are nothing.
Author: Kale Lawrence,  The Clairvoyance Clock

Quote: He won't listen to the music, and I can't turn it off.
Author: V.C. Andrews

Quote: Remember that a wish held fervently turns into belief, and a belief held diligently becomes reality.
Author: Jim Stovall,  The Lamp

Quote: Z is for Zany! Master the Zany habit of thinking backwards. it will help you become a really great thinker!
Author: Lucas Remmerswaal,  The A-Z of 13 Habits: Inspired by Warren Buffett

Quote: If a nation has not God that nation must fall, but if a nation has God then all the powers of evil, and all the armies, cannot shake its foundations; no, not even if the whole world is arrayed against it.
Author: Taylor Caldwell,  Dear and Glorious Physician

Quote: The man who sees both sides of a question is a man who sees absolutely nothing.
Author: Oscar Wilde

Quote: Shall any gazer see with mortal eyes,Or any searcher know by mortal mind,Veil after veil will lift--but there must be Veil upon veil behind.
Author: Edwin Arnold,  The Light of Asia

Quote: لم اتصور انه عندما تفقد من تحب تصبح جسدا حي وروحا ميته ...الحب يحيي الروح كما يحي الغيث الارض
Author: Shady Baraya

Quote: Persistance is the quality of winners. Successful people never never give up
Author: Lynda Field

Quote: No one of real intelligence will accept anything just because some authority declares it be so. Don't accept the truth of anything you have not confirmed for yourself.
Author: Paul Hoffmann

Quote: A poet is simply an artist whose medium is human emotions. A poet chisels away at our own sensibilities, shaping our vision while molding our hearts. A poet wraps words around our own feelings and presents them as fresh gifts to humanity.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich,  Making Wishes: Quotes, Thoughts, & a Little Poetry for Every Day of the Year

Quote: YOU are your own guru. YOU are your own soul mate. YOU are powerful. Take the reigns and drive your carriage home to love.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: It takes drive and focus to move from potential to reality.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree,  The Spiritual Girl's Guide to Dating: Your Enlightened Path to Love, Sex, & Soul Mates

Quote: A circle's unity and never ending smoothness is how we can aim to feel inside. Smooth, gentle, accepted, no rough edges, only love for all parts of our selves.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Pursue knowledge as though it is your life-blood, then you will know greatness!
Author: Monique Rockliffe

Quote: The Glory Is Always Hidden Between The Lines Of the Story
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: Have a GOAL to keep the following 5-‘H’ OUT of your lifeH – HarassH – HamperH – HurtH – HarmH – HinderTo Ensure H=Happiness Prevails forever!
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: Everybody liked better to conjecture how the thing was, than simply to know it; for conjecture soon became more confident than knowledge, and had a more liberal allowance for the incompatible.
Author: George Eliot,  Middlemarch

Quote: I have always believed in the power of collaboration. Early on in my professional career, I realized that you can't develop all the competencies you need fast enough on your own. Furthermore, if you don't collaborate, your ideas will be limited to your own abilities. As a result, you will not be able to serve your clientele and thus can't achieve the anticipated impact.
Author: Vishwas Chavan,  Vishwasutras: Universal Principles for Living: Inspired by Real-Life Experiences

Quote: Just remember, the difference between being good versus being great is just a few points, inches, or seconds.
Author: Bruce H. Jackson

Quote: Even though your life is Rainy and muggy you can fight through it just Make sure you know what is happening And make sure you don't take to much pressure on it just shake it off!
Author: Skye Daphne

Quote: Fairies with gossamer wings, Bring forth beauty, grace and joyful things. Fairies of the earth are caretakers of our soil, water and trees,They watch over beautiful creatures such as bears, bunnies and bees.Fairies ask that you breathe in and appreciate the vantage point from which you stand,Then trod carefully and respectfully with each intentional step you make across this beautiful land.
Author: Molly Friedenfeld

Quote: An item is only worth what someone is willing to pay for it
Author: Bianca Baker

Quote: This is heaven my child.
Author: Santosh Kalwar

Quote: It is in the darkest hour, when we are faced with our deepest most wrenching fears, that we are given the greatest strength. The choice is whether we succumb to the fear or rise with courage to face our truth and shine our brilliance as our sword of valor.
Author: Monika Zands

Quote: You opinions about me does not change who I am.
Author: Lailah Gifty Akita,  Think Great: Be Great!

Quote: God’s joy can fill our days with gladness until we receive the answer we are waiting for.
Author: Suzanne Elizabeth Anderson,  Waiting with God

Quote: Aujourd'hui, on cherche partout à répandre le savoir; qui sait si, dans quelques siècles, il n'y aura pas des universités pour rétablir l'ancienne ignorance?
Author: Georg Christoph Lichtenberg,  Dieses Und Jenes: Aufsätze Und Aphorismen

Quote: Wenn du weißt, behaupte, dass du es weißt. Und wenn du etwas nicht weißt, gib zu, dass du es nicht weißt. Das ist Wissen.
Author: Confucius

Quote: Judging is the cause that creates the effect of choosing.
Author: Joey Lawsin

Quote: In that case, on behalf of Earthlife, I urge that, with full knowledge of our limitations, we vastly increase our knowledge of the Solar System and then begin to settle other worlds.
Author: Carl Sagan

Quote: If you ask me what remains to be known in the future, I’ll say, ‘Memorize all the world’s encyclopedias.’ Once you do that, forget all that fancy junk and rake the leaves – else I’m gonna take a stick to you, boy.
Author: M.C. Humphreys

Quote: Something ought to be said for those who see beyond what most cannot, and this most precious opportunity happens the moment when ones personal value begins blossoming its perfect absolute."-Steven Cuoco
Author: Steven Cuoco,  Guided Transformation

Quote: You are limitless! Accept this truth and soar to infinity.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Mind of a loving heart is the fountain of knowledge.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Mind of a loving heart is the fountain of knowledge.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: In order to exert influence over people, there were other things that could be used besides love. Knowledge seemed to be an equally strong force, perhaps even stronger. Whoever possessed knowledge not only had power over the changeable passions of people, but also power over their thinking, over their minds, hearts and souls.
Author: Peter Prange,  The Philosopher's Kiss: A Novel

Quote: Truth resists being projected into the realm of knowledge.
Author: Walter Benjamin,  Reflections: Essays, Aphorisms, Autobiographical Writings

Quote: One of the greatest pieces of economic wisdom is to know what you do not know.
Author: John Kenneth Galbraith

Quote: Knowledge is as infinite as the universe. The man who claims to know all only reveals to all that he really knows nothing.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: The best of knowledge and righteous acts are those hidden to the people.
Author: Al-Fudhayl ibn Iyyadh

Quote: I see at last that all the knowledgeI wrung from the darkness—that the darkness flung me—Is worthless as ignorance: nothing comes from nothing,The darkness from the darkness. Pain comes from the darknessAnd we call it wisdom. It is pain.
Author: Randall Jarrell,  The Complete Poems

Quote: Genius is the power of lighting one's own fire!
Author: John Forster

Quote: Dance through life flinging kindness like shimmering rainbows. Find your bliss by sharing your heart.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Enchantment lies in everyday moments if you are observant.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Women united can create movements. We can empower entire generations. We can build peace one action at a time. Together we rise. The time is now.
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: Breathtaking, splendid, wondrous, sublime, all those words describe you, exactly as you are. You are a work of art! Enjoy your beauty!
Author: Amy Leigh Mercree

Quote: If she could no longer be called beautiful, she possessed something better-a knowledge of beauty; it’s inflated value, it’s inevitable loss.
Author: Hilary Thayer Hamann,  Anthropology of an American Girl

Quote: ...to her all books were the same and, as with her subjects, she felt a duty to approach them without prejudice...Lauren Bacall, Winifred Holtby, Sylvia Plath - who were they? Only be reading could she find out.
Author: Alan Bennett,  The Uncommon Reader

Quote: It was strange how she found out, One moment she didn't know; the next minute she did. One moment her mind was as blank as the desert; the next minute the snake of suspicion had slithered into her thoughts and raised its poisonous head.
Author: Thrity Umrigar,  The Space Between Us

Quote: It was strange how she found out, One moment she didn't know; the next minute she did. One moment her mind was as blank as the desert; the next minute the snake of suspicion had slithered into her thoughts and raised its poisonous head.
Author: Thrity Umrigar,  The Space Between Us

Quote: Gather the best you have to offer and create a heartfelt, prosperous life full of purpose.
Author: Gail McMeekin,  The 12 Secrets of Highly Successful Women: A Portable Life Coach for Creative Women

Quote: I am the only force strong enough to stop me.
Author: Naya S. Wood

Quote: Take the first step. No more, no less, and the next will be revealed.
Author: Clement Watt

Quote: Last night at Bingo, Sylvia won the last prize. 'What am I going to do with a mermaid?""Learn to swim in the murkiest water, reinvent yourself,"the mermaid said #149
Author: Monique Duval,  The Persistence of Yellow: A Book of Recipes for Life

Quote: We live in the hope that life will be different. Just a little more substance perhaps in the intrinsic frailty of the days. Such resignation frightens me. Between gunshots I get drunk. In secret, all knowledge becomes anxiety.
Author: Floriano Martins

Quote: Knowledge was the great thing--not abstract knowledge in which Dr. Forester had been so rich, the theories which lead one enticingly on with their appearance of nobility, of transcendent virtue, but detailed, passionate, trivial human knowledge.
Author: Graham Greene,  The Ministry of Fear

Quote: El problema es que el niño es una esponja que registra y absorbe indiscriminadamente todo lo que ve [...] El niño formado en la imagen se reduce a ser un hombre que no lee, y, por lo tanto, la mayoría de las veces, es un ser «reblandecido por la televisión», adicto de por vida a los videojuegos.
Author: Giovanni Sartori,  Homo videns: La sociedad teledirigida

Quote: In-existence, the soul’s greatest imposition is its perfection. It is projected as a perfected form of the physical embodiment, an emblem of things, perhaps hyperreal and untouchably perfect as existence. It can not be! The soul in-existence is nothing of perfection. It is raw potential. The soul is nothing but potential. To be specific, the soul is unordered potential!
Author: Dew Platt,  The Rudeness of Soul

Quote: In-existence, the soul’s greatest imposition is its perfection. It is projected as a perfected form of the physical embodiment, an emblem of things, perhaps hyperreal and untouchably perfect as existence. It can not be! The soul in-existence is nothing of perfection. It is raw potential. The soul is nothing but potential. To be specific, the soul is unordered potential!
Author: Dew Platt,  The Rudeness of Soul

Quote: You know how sometimes you remember a place you once loved, a movie you’ve enjoyed, only to be disappointed when you return to that place or see that movie for a second time? Well, it wasn’t disappointing. She sounds exactly as I remember her—and there is still something so warm and caring about her that it is difficult to hate her for how she abandoned us.
Author: Christina Westover,  Poisoning Sylvie

Quote: Scientists used to do an experiment whereby a dog’s repeated reward for performing a task was unaccountably replaced by punishment. The dog, knowing it would be penalized for doing well or doing badly, would become melancholic and inactive. This and other unforeseeable results were funded by taxing up to sixty percent of people’s earnings. People became strangely melancholic and inactive
Author: Steve Aylett

Quote: Seek first the kingdom of heaven WITHIN, whereby lies an abundance of treasures and resources that you need
Author: Lisa Washington

Quote: Sorry. I get attacks of quotitis every once in a while. It's a very rare disease with no cure. It usually attacks older people, and here i am afflicted with it at my tender age.
Author: Madeleine L'Engle,  The Joys of Love

Quote: Dituntun oleh masa laluku, didorong oleh keberadaanku, aku terbang mencari sesuatu yang tak kuketahui. Antusiasme, rasa ingin tahu, dan harapan menemaniku.
Author: Samarpan,  Tiya: A Parrot's Journey Home

Quote: Being a senior doesn't automatically make one wise but the wise & foolish alike have things to teach us.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Pocket Peace: Effective Practices for Enlightened Living

Quote: Silence is so steadfast, you know. It is so ample, after all.
Author: Alice Fulton,  The Nightingales of Troy: Stories of One Family's Century

Quote: When his writing is going well, Gordon Strangle Mars likes to wake up at 6 a.m. and go out driving. He works out new plot lines about giant spiders and keeps an eye out for abandoned couches, which he wrestles into the back of his pickup truck. Then he writes for the rest of the day.
Author: Kelly Link,  Pretty Monsters: Stories

Quote: One can't work/by limelight.//A bowlful/right at/one's elbow//produces no/more than/a baleful/glow against/the kitchen table.//The fruit purveyor's/whole unstable/pyramid//doesn't equal/what daylight did.
Author: Kay Ryan

Quote: A traitor commits his crime but once. The rest/is retribution.
Author: Marie Howe,  The Good Thief

Quote: Circumstances are the seeds of literature.
Author: Salvador de Madariaga,  Essays with a Purpose

Quote: Let it be told to the future world that in the depth of winter, when nothing but hope and virtue could survive, that the city and the country, alarmed at one common danger, came forth to meet it.
Author: Barack Obama

Quote: Fear is what keeps the walls up, so open the gate and let what you want, in when you want
Author: Joshua Wright

Quote: In this walk to freedom, we must, without question obtain hearts of honesty and a tongue of truthfulness.
Author: The Tru Sum,  Excerpts To Exodus

Quote: Seek your own answers in life, and not what others dictate to you.
Author: Jemina Akhtar,  Veil of Lies

Quote: We will never have a perfect world, but it’s not romantic or naïve to work toward a better one.
Author: Steven Pinker

Quote: God is not willing to do everything, and thus take away our free will and that share of glory which belongs to us.
Author: Niccolò Machiavelli,  The Prince

Quote: I'm not particularly in favor of doctrine or creed, ordination, the elevation of holy texts, the institution of church, or, for that matter, Christianity. Like most religions, it has irreconcilable shortcomings and an unforgivable history. What I do favor is the attempt to make sense of things by living within a story. The Christian story, for good or ill, is my inheritance.
Author: Elizabeth Jarrett Andrew,  On The Threshold: Home, Hardwood, and Holiness

Quote: We train the mind so that we can enjoy greater peace, happiness, wisdom & equanimity.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Pocket Peace: Effective Practices for Enlightened Living

Quote: From the pastor who has an affair with his secretary, to the jerk at the office who happens to be a deacon, to the overbearing boss who can’t miss his Monday night Bible study, Christians today cause more problems for the gospel than all the devil’s demons put together.
Author: Wes Moore,  Forcefully Advancing

Quote: Love is holy.
Author: William Shakespeare,  All's Well That Ends Well

Quote: At last everything was satisfactorily arranged, and I could not help admiring the setting: these mingled touches betrayed on a small scale the inspiration of a poet, the research of a scientist, the good taste of an artist, the gourmet’s fondness for good food, and the love of flowers, which concealed in their delicate shadows a hint of the love of women
Author: August Strindberg,  Madman's Defence

Quote: We as authors sign a pact with our readers; they'll go on reading because they trust us to play fair with them and deliver what we've promised.
Author: Pamela Glass Kelly,  From Inspiration to Publication: How to Succeed as a Children's Writer: Advice from 15 Award Winning Writers

Quote: To be saved is here, local and mortal
Author: A.R. Ammons

Quote: Tidak ada seorang pun yang bisa dikalahkan, sampai dia menyerah--DI DALAM PIKIRANNYA SENDIRI!
Author: Napoleon Hill,  Think and Grow Rich: A Black Choice

Quote: Each of us suffers with envy/for the forgiven.
Author: Marie Howe,  The Good Thief

Quote: Rulers are not anointed. They are created by the void of self-mastery.
Author: T.F. Hodge,  From Within I Rise: Spiritual Triumph Over Death and Conscious Encounters with "The Divine Presence"

Quote: Balanced emotions are crucial to intuitive decision making.
Author: Michael D. Eisner

Quote: I think all artists struggle to represent the geometryof life in their own way, just like writers deal witharchetypes. There are only so many stories that you cantell, but an infinite number of storytellers.
Author: Henry Mosquera,  Sleeper's Run

Quote: I’m more terrified of failure than rejection—so I’ll no my way to YES!
Author: Jarod Kintz,  A Zebra is the Piano of the Animal Kingdom

Quote: It is not a single cowardice that drives us into fiction's fantasies. We often fear that literature is a game we can't afford to play — the product of idleness and immoral ease. In the grip of that feeling it isn't life we pursue, but the point and purpose of life — its facility, its use.
Author: William H. Gass,  Fiction and the Figures of Life

Quote: But artists didn't need to achieve "firsts", and Hughes wanted to be an artist.
Author: Diane Wood Middlebrook,  Her Husband: Ted Hughes and Sylvia Plath - A Marriage

Quote: Do it because it's right, not because it's right for your resume.
Author: Howard Behar,  It's Not About the Coffee: Leadership Principles from a Life at Starbucks

Quote: We get schooled by the people around us, and it stays inside us deep.
Author: George Pelecanos,  Soul Circus

Quote: ...rather than assuming that education is primarily about preparing for jobs and careers, what would it mean to think of education as a process of guiding kids' participation in public life more generally, a public life that includes social, recreational, and civic engagement.
Author: Mizuko Ito,  Living and Learning with New Media: Summary of Findings from the Digital Youth Project

Quote: You honor yourself by acting with dignity and composure.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: Our progress as a nation can be not swifter than our progress in education.
Author: John F. Kennedy

Quote: Now, I have nothing against the public school system as it is presently organized, once you allow the humor of its basic assumption about how it is possible to teach things to children....
Author: Shirley Jackson,  Life Among the Savages

Quote: The task of teaching has never been more complex and the expectations that burden teachers are carried out in antiquated systems that offer little support—and yet, teachers are finding success every day.
Author: Tucker Elliot

Quote: Those who reach for the Sun, usually drop the world.
Author: Lionel Suggs

Quote: Nothing succeeds like success.
Author: Alexandre Dumas,  Ange Pitou

Quote: I have an 8th grade education. Of course, I also have a bachelor’s degree.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

Quote: The concept of leadership is abused by people who think a person becomes a leader when he grows grey hair, put into a position and expected to function. Everyone has a leadership potential carried within in a specific area of his or purpose. Leadership is universal and built on trust.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor

Quote: The circumstances of the world are so variable that an irrevocable purpose or opinion is almost synonymous with a foolish one.
Author: William Seward

Quote: If we could push ajar the gates of life,And stand within, and all God's workings see,We could interpret all this doubt and strife,And for each mystery could find a key.But not today. Then be content, poor heart!God's plans, like lilies pure and white, unfold:We must not tear the close-shut leaves apart--Time will reveal the calyxes of gold.
Author: Mary Riley Smith

Quote: COMPETITOR is one who can steal a few deals, but, the pinch of which, A VISIONARY Never feels...!
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: When every minute of your day is planned & you are packed for days, you shall soon realize that the pain of past fades, vision of life gets clearer and all that seemed to poison your life Ceases to exist.
Author: Sujit Lalwani,  Life Simplified!

Quote: Before you were born, and were still too tiny for the human eye to see, you won the race for life from among 250 million competitors. And yet, how fast you have forgotten your strength, when your very existence is proof of your greatness.
Author: Suzy Kassem,  Rise Up and Salute the Sun: The Writings of Suzy Kassem

Quote: I’m hungry for success. And lasagna.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  At even one penny, this book would be overpriced. In fact, free is too expensive, because you'd still waste time by reading it.

Quote: Nobody can make you feel ignorant but you—the you from before, the one who skipped school and slept in class. By you, of course, I mean me.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This is the best book I've ever written, and it still sucks

Quote: American Education has a long history of infatuation with fads and ill-considered ideas. The current obsession with making our schools work like a business may be the worst of them, for it threatens to destroy public education. Who will Stand up to the tycoons and politicians and tell them so?
Author: Diane Ravitch,  The Death and Life of the Great American School System: How Testing and Choice Are Undermining Education

Quote: This book is not about "homeschooling"at all. School is an artificial institution contrived by man. This book is about educating a child in the heart of the family given to that child by his Creator.
Author: Elizabeth Foss,  Real Learning: Education In The Heart Of The Home

Quote: A lot of people come up here and they thank Jesus for this award. I want you to know that no one had less to do with this award than Jesus. He didn't help me a bit. If it was up to him, Cesar Millan would be up here with that damn dog. So all I can say is, 'suck it, Jesus! This award is my God now'!
Author: Kathy Griffin

Quote: You know you made it, when people you know, tell people they know, that you know them.
Author: Mokokoma Mokhonoana

Quote: I don't have a problem with these Arizona laws. I have a problem with Chicano, Gay and Lesbian, Asian-American and African-American histories not being taught in American History courses.
Author: M.G. Hardie

Quote: To some education is just a bore; to most education is food for the brain and enrichment for the present and future.
Author: Ana Monnar

Quote: When we teach a child patience we offer them the gift of a dignified life.
Author: Allan Lokos,  Patience: The Art of Peaceful Living

Quote: Mindfulness can play a big role in transforming our experience with pain & other difficulties; it allows us to recognize the authenticity of the distress & yet not be overwhelmed by it.
Author: Sharon Salzberg,  Real Happiness: The Power of Meditation

Quote: The reassuring smile was now useless. I was plastic. Everything was veiled. Objectivity, facts, hard information--these were things only in the outline stage. There was nothing tying anything together yet, so the mind built up a defense, and the evidence was restructured, and that was what I tried to do on that morning--to restructure the evidence so it made sense--and that is what I failed at.
Author: Bret Easton Ellis,  Lunar Park

Quote: O the mind, mind has mountains; cliffs of fallFrightful, sheer, no-man-fathomed.
Author: Gerard Manley Hopkins

Quote: The mind is in a sad state when Sleep, the all-involving, cannot confine her spectres within the dim region of her sway, but suffers them to break forth, affrighting this actual life with secrets that perchance belong to a deeper one.
Author: Nathaniel Hawthorne,  The Birthmark and Other Stories

Quote: To get him to agree, I put a gun to his head. To get him to not change his mind, I blew out his brains.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  How to construct a coffin with six karate chops

Quote: Go higher and higher, until it becomes impossible to bring you down, I wanna use a microscope to locate you, don't even dream of coming down.
Author: Michael Bassey Johnson

Quote: If you have time to whine then you have time to find solution.
Author: Dee Dee Artner

Quote: Sharing your success with others reveals your true humanity. Don't ever be afraid to open your heart to that practice. It has made all the world of difference to me.
Author: Andrea Michaels,  Reflections Of A Successful Wallflower: Lessons In Business; Lessons In Life

Quote: If you're always following the crowd, you will never truly know who you are. Walk your own path.
Author: Julian Pencilliah

Quote: One person's success doesn't take away from your own.
Author: Jeremy Piven

Quote: If you drop your beliefs, you drop your success. God's mighty people begin to fall even as achievers when they begin to drop the beliefs they pursue at first.
Author: Israelmore Ayivor,  The Great Hand Book of Quotes

Quote: There are three qualities that every individual must have to achieve success: a Monk’s patience, a Warrior’s courage, a Child’s imagination.
Author: Sharad Vivek Sagar

Quote: Things get done only if the data we gather can inform and inspire those in a position to make difference.
Author: Mike Schmoker,  Results

Quote: He is the only option for better living.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: Happy roads is bunk. Weary roads is right. Get you nowhere fast. That's where I've got—nowhere. Where everyone lands in the end, even if most of the suckers won't admit it.
Author: Eugene O'Neill,  Long Day's Journey Into Night

Quote: Let fear once get possession of the soul, and it does not readily yield its place to another sentiment.Sebastopol by Leo Tolstoy
Author: Leo Tolstoy,  Sebastopol in December

Quote: For the first time she could see a man's head naked of its skull. Saw the cunning thoughts race in and out through the caves and promontories of his mind long before they darted through the tunnel of his mouth.
Author: Zora Neale Hurston,  Their Eyes Were Watching God

Quote: Life had stepped into the place of theory and something quite different would work itself out in his mind.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Crime and Punishment

Quote: Life had stepped into the place of theory and something quite different would work itself out in his mind.
Author: Fyodor Dostoyevsky,  Crime and Punishment

Quote: I want to kidnap kids and force them to take useless tests all day long. Wait, that’s what our public education system already does.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  Seriously delirious, but not at all serious

Quote: I mean what else is there for a woman to do if she doesn't want to go from the parental to the marital home with nothing in between? 'An educated woman,'Millie amended. 'An educated woman,' Ursula agreed.
Author: Kate Atkinson,  Life After Life

Quote: God steals my soul.
Author: Harley King

Quote: If for us culture means museum and library and open house and art gallery, for them it meant the activities and amenities of everyday life... The rift is... between "folk"culture, where the unschooled can be wise, and print culture, which enslaved the other senses to the eye.
Author: Nick Joaquín,  Culture and History

Quote: [Math] curriculum is obsessed with jargon and nomenclature seemingly for no other purpose than to provide teachers with something to test the students on.
Author: Paul Lockhart,  A Mathematician's Lament: How School Cheats Us Out of Our Most Fascinating and Imaginative Art Form

Quote: The mystery which underlies the beauty of women is never raised above the reach of all expression until it has claimed kindred with the deeper mystery in our own souls.
Author: Wilkie Collins,  The Woman in White

Quote: At night I lay awake, her likeness casting dark shadows across my soul and senses, and my stomach throbbing away. I imagined her arms around me, lulling me into a phantom bliss, so frustrating, so unreal.
Author: Stephen Mosley

Quote: Helping others in need is not only a responsibility of life; it is what gives meaning to life.
Author: Mollie Marti

Quote: Being truly happy in life involves you feeling more in control of the direction your life is going.
Author: Deborah Day

Quote: Peter's destiny lay along a different path from John's. And your calling is unlike anyone else's. But the call remains the same: "Follow Me!
Author: Charles R. Swindoll

Quote: A man who has come to the full realization of his responsibility to men won't stick to one man. It will be foolhardy if he does that.
Author: Ogwo David Emenike

Quote: Creation is bringing potential into being, bringing inspiration into action. Inspiration and action are nothing when they are apart. Inspiration feels like a great a wondrous thing, but if it is not manifested, it is as if it never existed. Likewise, action without inspiration has no purpose. It is only when they are together as one that they are truly something.
Author: Kristi Bowman,  Journey to One: A Woman's Story of Emotional Healing and Spiritual Awakening

Quote: Thousands of persons, many of whom never darkened the door of a college, have learned to read books that most of our college graduates fear to tackle. teachers who understand this fact can help a student read the books that educated the Founding Fathers but not by explaining in lectures what the author would have said if he had been as bright as the lecturer.
Author: Stringfellow Barr

Quote: Lernen und nicht denken ist nichtig, denken und nicht lernen ist ermüdend.
Author: Confucius,  Gespräche

Quote: I preach that odd defiant melancholy that sees the dreadful loneliness of the human soul and the pitiful disaster of human life as ever redeemable and redeemed by compassion, friendship and love.
Author: John Derbyshire,  Fire from the Sun

Quote: Do you have any idea who Erin was kissing?""Yeah, so we'll brush out teeth really, really thoroughly afterwards,"I said, bumping her nose with mine gently. I wasn't going to let anyone spoil this moment.
Author: Stacey Kade

Quote: Only great fools remain ungrateful.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Best Option

Quote: Ada: And why life? (Pause.) Why life, Henry? (Pause.) Is there anyone about?Henry: Not a living soul.Ada: I thought as much. (Pause.) When we longed to have it to ourselves there was always someone. Now that it does not matter the place is deserted.
Author: Samuel Beckett,  Embers

Quote: A book without words is a mind without thought.
Author: Catherine Forbes

Quote: If you want to be sure of unusual thing such as aliens or UFOs, then you have to think about it from an unusual way of thinking.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Some false representations contravene the law; some do not. ... The sensibilities of no two men are the same. Some would refuse to sell property without carefully explaining all about its merits and defects, and putting themselves in the purchasers' place and inquiring if he himself would buy under the circumstances. But such men never would be prosperous merchants.
Author: Clarence Darrow,  The Story of My Life

Quote: Even so, I’m somebody.I’m the Discoverer of Nature.I’m the Argonaut of true sensations.I bring a new Universe to the UniverseBecause I bring the Universe to itself.
Author: Alberto Caeiro,  The Keeper of Sheep

Quote: He wastes his time over his writing, trying to accomplish what geniuses and rare men with college educations sometimes accomplish.
Author: Jack London

Quote: She watched the tunnels as they flowed past: bare walls of concrete, a net of pipes and wires, a web of rails that went off into black holes where green and red lights hung as distant drops of color. There was nothing else to dilute it, so that one could admire naked purpose and the ingenuity that had achieved it.
Author: Ayn Rand,  Atlas Shrugged

Quote: It is the vocation of the Christian in every generation to out-think all opposition.
Author: Elton Trueblood

Quote: Լաւ է աչքով կոյր ըլլալ՝ քան մտքով:It is preferable to be blind by eyesight, than by mind.
Author: Saint Vardapet Eghishē

Quote: Be a person that others will look for your posts daily because they know you will encourage them. Be the positive one and help others to have a great day and you will find that not only they like you but you will like you too.
Author: John Patrick Hickey,  Oops! Did I Really Post That

Quote: Success needs vision to see, passion to transcend, patience to withstand and the character to overcome failures.
Author: Amit Ray,  Walking the Path of Compassion

Quote: Destiny, Talent, Calling, purpose. each of us came with our Talents, Purpose and Calling. What you do with them is the summary of your life here on earth.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  RISK IT, BE DIFFERENT!

Quote: If all the world's a stage, I suggest you start performing at your best.
Author: Rob Liano

Quote: The season of evil,"I echoed. "Protect your soul.
Author: David Almond

Quote: Education is a lifetime assignment & terminates when you do.
Author: Orrin Woodward,  LIFE

Quote: the old maxim... "there are three things necessary to success in life--Impudence! Impudence! Impudence!
Author: William Hazlitt

Quote: No matter how many leaves would the tree of your soul have in front of the intense heat in the words of Time in this world, they can never shade the eternity lost inside you.
Author: Sorin Cerin,  Wisdom Collection: The Book of Wisdom

Quote: …for it is often to be observed of the shallower men, that they are the very last to despond. It is the glory of the bladder that nothing can sink it; it is the reproach of a box of treasure, that once overboard it must drown
Author: Herman Melville,  Pierre: or, the Ambiguities

Quote: During the day I would move my body to the rhythm that only I could hear. I would try and connect with everything in my surroundings thinking that it somehow connected to who I was and was secretly sending me messages about what was in my soul.
Author: Sage Steadman "The Hippie",  Snowflake Obsidian: Memoir of a Cutter

Quote: Bella. You were always my soul.
Author: Lora Leigh,  Wild Card

Quote: What’s on my mind? I could say you, but we both know I'd be lying. Actually, I'm only pretending that you aren't on my mind. But I know that you don't mind.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Days of Yay are Here! Wake Me Up When They're Over.

Quote: Nothing could be any worse than having to turn to your friends, your colleagues and your loved ones and say –‘I gave up too soon’.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: A composition—and every work of art is one—is created in a wondrous interplay between imagination and reason, or between mind and reflection. For there will always be an element of chance in the creative process.
Author: Jostein Gaarder,  Sophie's World

Quote: To think is good. To obsess is bad.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: Every time a champion makes a decision they have a chance to learn something new, regardless of the outcome.
Author: Steve Backley,  The Champion in all of Us: 12 Rules for Success

Quote: Love as education is one of the great powers of the world, but it hangs in a delicate suspension; it achieves its harmony as seldom as does love by the senses. Frustrated, it creates even greater havoc, for like all love it is a madness.
Author: Thornton Wilder,  The Ides of March

Quote: Respect is tendered with pleasure only where it is not exacted.
Author: Anne-Robert-Jacques Turgot,  The Turgot Collection

Quote: The mind's first step to self-awareness must be through the body.
Author: George Sheehan

Quote: The presence of God is so important in the life of believers. There is abundance of all you need to make your life comfortable in His presence.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: I awoke one morning to find myself famous.
Author: George Gordon Byron

Quote: God wants all man's attention, thoughts and focus to be on Him.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: The presence of the Lord destroys a life of struggle. You will struggle until you encounter His presence.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: Your status has changed. Your Name is changed! You are a new creation.
Author: Jaachynma N.E. Agu,  The Prince and the Pauper

Quote: Give me the positions and velocities of all the particles in the universe, and I will predict the future.
Author: Marquis Pierre Simon de Laplace

Quote: The Creator has – I say it in all reverence - drawn a myriad red herrings across the track, but the true scientist refuses to be baffled by superficial appearances in detecting the secrets of Nature. The vulgar herd catches at the gross apparent fact, but the man of insight knows what lies on the surfaces does lie.
Author: Israel Zangwill,  The Big Bow Mystery

Quote: We will restore science to its rightful place and wield technology's wonders to raise health care's quality and lower its cost.
Author: Barack Obama

Quote: Life […] is scientific, that’s what it is.
Author: William Golding,  Lord of the Flies

Quote: A man who knows what other men know,know nothing for they all know the same
Author: Alchemist

Quote: when the words not enough to describe how much you love....even you know she/he don't anything for you......you cant fall a sleep exactly like before's"-kuntal
Author: Bob Marley,  The Future Is the Beginning: The Words and Wisdom of Bob Marley

Quote: Read Euler, read Euler, he is the master of us all.
Author: Pierre-Simon Laplace

Quote: The slang for the rectum is "prison wallet".
Author: Mary Roach,  Gulp: Adventures on the Alimentary Canal

Quote: The aim of science is to make difficult things understandable in a simpler way; the aim of poetry is to state simple things in an incomprehensible way. The two are incompatible.
Author: Paul A.M. Dirac

Quote: When we consider the magnitude and extent of his discoveries and their influence on the progress of science and of industry, there is no honour too great to pay to the memory of Faraday, one of the greatest scientific discoverers of all time.
Author: Ernest Rutherford

Quote: Every time a scientist publishes a good piece of work, she helps to maintain and raise the standards for what is true. We have to keep chipping away.
Author: Deborah M. Gordon,  Ants at Work: How an Insect Society is Organized

Quote: Alfred Nobel stipulated that no distinction of race or colour will determine who received of his generosity.
Author: Abdus Salam

Quote: The idea that one can go to the fossil record and expect to empirically recover an ancestor-descendant sequence, be it of species, genera, families, or whatever, has been, and continues to be, a pernicious illusion.
Author: Gareth J. Nelson

Quote: The Earth is cylindrical, three times as wide as it is deep, and only the upper part is inhabited. But this Earth is isolated in space, and the sky is a complete sphere in the center of which is located, unsupported, our cylinder, the Earth, situated at an equal distance from all the points of the sky.
Author: Anaximander

Quote: We tend to think of future inventions and discoveries, but in reality, these things already exist in the knowledge bank of the universe.
Author: Stephen Richards

Quote: Science is not a collection of facts. Nor is science something that happens in the laboratory. Science happens in the head. It's a flight of imagination beyond the constraints of ordinary perception. Columbus chapter -The Virgin and the Mousetrap
Author: Chet Raymo

Quote: ...since the order of the world is shaped by death, mightn't it be better for God if we refuse to believe in Him and struggle with all our might against death, without raising our eyes towards the heaven where He sits in silence?
Author: Albert Camus

Quote: Science is an organized pursuit of triviality.Art is a casual pursuit of significance.Let's keep it in perspective.
Author: Vera Nazarian,  The Perpetual Calendar of Inspiration

Quote: His work seems to confirm my old axiom: it is useless to try to keep the whole body alive.
Author: Adolfo Bioy Casares,  The Invention of Morel

Quote: Much later, when I discussed the problem with Einstein, he remarked that the introduction of the cosmological term was the biggest blunder he ever made in his life. But this 'blunder,' rejected by Einstein, is still sometimes used by cosmologists even today, and the cosmological constant denoted by the Greek letter Λ rears its ugly head again and again and again.
Author: George Gamow

Quote: Since extra-sensory perception (ESP) is awareness of the world beyond the senses, it would be inappropriate to term this Sixth Sense ‘extrasensory’.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Cosmic Ordering Guide

Quote: Your beliefs have the power to unlock your inner genius or keep you from fully achieving your greatest potential.
Author: Deborah Day,  BE HAPPY NOW!

Quote: It so happens that at times your desires tend to disagree with the reality and this is due to the fact that you have not let the two elements complement each other.
Author: Stephen Richards,  Think Your way to Success: Let Your Dreams Run Free

Quote: One sometimes finds what one is not looking for
Author: Alexander Fleming

Quote: Even though worker capacity and motivation are destroyed when leaders choose power over productivity, it appears that bosses would rather be in control than have the organization work well.
Author: Margaret J. Wheatley

Quote: Today is the only day. Yesterday is gone.
Author: John Wooden

Quote: Nothing so fortifies a friendship as a belief on the part of one friend that he is superior to the other.
Author: Honore de Balzac

Quote: Life is a tragedy when seen in close-up, but a comedy in long-shot.
Author: Charlie Chaplin

Quote: Faith is the substance of hope - of things hoped for and the evidence of things not seen. So if you can hope for it and imagine it, and keep imagining and hoping and seeing yourself driving a new car, or seeing yourself getting that job, or seeing yourself excel, seeing yourself help that person - that is faith.
Author: Duane Chapman

Quote: The sweetest noise on earth, a woman's tongue; A string which hath no discord.
Author: Bryan Procter

Quote: Creative output, you know, is just pain. I'm going to be cliche for a minute and say that great art comes from pain.
Author: Kanye West

Quote: We always reminisce about how everyone tried to get Diane Lane's attention, to very little success.
Author: Rob Lowe

Quote: Jeffrey Zeldman had an astonishing ability to craft a seductive coolness using educated references, dry humor, and retro/organic imagery.
Author: Matt Mullenweg

Quote: Thought is what we start from: the simple, intimate, immediate datum. Matter is the inferred thing, the mystery.
Author: C.S. Lewis

Quote: la propriété, c'est le vol!
Author: Pierre-Joseph Proudhon,  Théorie de la propriété

Quote: Apakah seorang pencari keheningan adalah si mulia? ataukah si pengecut yang tidak berani menghadapi masalah dunia?
Author: Cok Sawitri

Quote: We belittle what we cannot bear. We make figments out of fundamentals, all in the name of preserving our own peculiar fancies. The best way to secure one's own deception is to accuse others of deceit.
Author: R. Scott Bakker,  The White Luck Warrior

Quote: Every life has a destiny... the trick is to discover it before then end of your life. Otherwise, you will have too many regrets.
Author: Kevin J. Anderson,  A Forest of Stars

Quote: If the moment is everthing, then everything is time.
Author: Benny Bellamacina,  The King of Rhyme

Quote: Percayalah, bila kamu tidak dapat mengalihkan perhatian pada hal lain yang fana..., dan hanya memikirkan kehidupan itu sendiri, kamu akan gila: karena ia akan mengalahkan dan merendahkanmu secara perlahan.
Author: Soe Tjen Marching,  Mati, Bertahun yang Lalu

Quote: There is nothing more wonderful than a book. It may be a message to us from the dead, from human souls we never saw who lived perhaps thousands of miles away, and yet these little sheets of paper speak to us, arouse us, teach us, open our hearts and in turn open their hearts to us like brothers. Without books, God is silent, justice dormant, philosophy lame.
Author: Charles Kingsley

Quote: There is nothing more wonderful than a book. It may be a message to us from the dead, from human souls we never saw who lived perhaps thousands of miles away, and yet these little sheets of paper speak to us, arouse us, teach us, open our hearts and in turn open their hearts to us like brothers. Without books, God is silent, justice dormant, philosophy lame.
Author: Charles Kingsley

Quote: It is evident as a matter of logic that, since they (world religions) disagree, not more than one of them can be true.
Author: Bertrand Russell

Quote: The scepticism which men affect towards their higher inspirations is often not an honest doubt, but a guilty negligence, and is a sign of narrow mind and defective wisdom.
Author: James Martineau,  Tides of the Spirit: Selections from the Writings of James Martineau

Quote: The Philosopher's Motto: I came, I saw, I pondered!
Author: Greg Curtis

Quote: Question everything, unless it's the answer
Author: Benny Bellamacina

Quote: Tristetea, ca si suferinta, ne revela existenta, deoarece în ele avem în constiinta separatia noastra de lumea obiectiva si nelinistea care da un caracter tragic vietuirii în existenta.Daca ar exista un zeu al tristetii, lui nu i-ar putea creste decât aripi negre si grele, pentru a zbura nu înspre ceruri, ci în infern.
Author: Emil Cioran

Quote: Septimus has been working too hard"- that was all she could say to her own mother. To love makes one solitary, she thought.
Author: Virginia Woolf,  Mrs. Dalloway

Quote: Students of the heavens are separable into astronomers and astrologers as readily as are the minor domestic ruminants into sheep and goats, but the separation of philosophers into sages and cranks seems to be more sensitive to frames of reference.
Author: Willard Van Orman Quine

Quote: Le spectacle est le mauvais rêve de la société moderne enchaînée, qui n'exprime finalement que son désir de dormir. Le spectacle est le gardien de ce sommeil.
Author: Guy Debord

Quote: Our enemies are quite good for relentlessly keeping us sharp and on our toes. This especially goes for sincere philosophers. They use their enemies to challenge their arguments so that they can know the weak points in their own reasoning and how to argue for and strengthen their position. There are just none like one's enemies to always look for his mistakes and do it harder than anyone else.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: This is why they started us here so young: to give ourselves away before the age when the questions 'why' and 'to what' grow real beaks and claws.
Author: David Foster Wallace,  Infinite Jest

Quote: One must reach out and try to grasp this astonishing finesse, that the value of lif cannot be estimated.
Author: Friedrich Nietzsche,  Twilight of the Idols

Quote: Ignore a person kill the person.
Author: M.Azeem Talib

Quote: Life is a complexwith real and imaginary parts
Author: Angela Suba,  From My Pen, On Life

Quote: Society can and does execute its own mandates: and if it issues wrong mandates instead of right, or any mandates at all in things with which it ought not to meddle, it practises a social tyranny more formidable than many kinds of political oppression...
Author: John Stuart Mill,  On Liberty

Quote: The best ship, the best culture, the best knowledge, is the one which allows us to go farther, explore more territories or oceans of reality, and have the least damaging leaks possible.
Author: Jesus Zamora Bonilla,  Galloping with Light - Einstein, Relativity, and Folklore

Quote: The best ship, the best culture, the best knowledge, is the one which allows us to go farther, explore more territories or oceans of reality, and have the least damaging leaks possible.
Author: Jesus Zamora Bonilla,  Galloping with Light - Einstein, Relativity, and Folklore

Quote: God created philosophy for all the intellects that got bored of hearing the same bible stories every Sunday.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: God created philosophy for all the intellects that got bored of hearing the same bible stories every Sunday.
Author: Shannon L. Alder

Quote: În clipa când ți se impune să nu te gândești la un lucru, te vei gândi doar la el, obsesiv. Interdicția devine obligație.
Author: Jean-Claude Carrière,  Nu sperați că veți scăpa de cărți

Quote: Good man and bad man with money goes a long ways."~ Amunhotep El Bey
Author: Amunhotep El Bey,  The Quotations Book of life and Death

Quote: The sun symbolizes the Divine intelligence; the empty vastness of space symbolizes the Divine All-Possibility and also the Divine immutability; a bird symbolizes the soul; a tree symbolizes the grades of being; and water symbolizes knowledge and rain revelation.
Author: Osman Bakar,  Tawhid and Science

Quote: ...the only way to judge a philosophy is to examine the lives of those who live it.
Author: Karl Friedrich,  Wings: A Novel of World War II Flygirls

Quote: —¿Cómo una persona puede sentirse sola cuando está rodeada de gente? —le pregunté.—Supongo que en eso consiste la soledad —me respondió—. En aislarte cuando se supone que tienes que sentirte rodeada.
Author: Audrey Dry,  Sin mirar atrás

Quote: According to the Buddha's teaching the beginning of the life-stream of living beings is unthinkable. THe believer in the creation of life by God may be astonished at this reply. But if you were to ask him 'What is the beginning of God?' he would answer without hesitation 'God has no beginning', and he is not astonished at his own reply.
Author: Walpola Rahula,  What the Buddha Taught: Revised and Expanded Edition with Texts from Suttas and Dhammapada

Quote: Those who make conversations impossible, make escalation inevitable.
Author: Stefan Molyneux

Quote: Those who make conversations impossible, make escalation inevitable.
Author: Stefan Molyneux

Quote: Let the love of the moon kiss you good night, let the morning sun wake you up with loving light.
Author: Debasish Mridha

Author: Debasish Mridha

Author: Debasish Mridha

Quote: God is a philosophical black hole – the point where reason breaks down.
Author: Kedar Joshi

Quote: The universe is a philosophical abyss.
Author: Kedar Joshi

Quote: One great function of the arts is to keep ideals alive in a culture that does not yet realize them.
Author: Susan Neiman,  Moral Clarity: A Guide for Grown-up Idealists

Quote: I will tell you why I became a philosopher. I became a philosopher because I wanted to be able to talk about many, many things, ideally with knowledge, but sometimes not quite the amount of knowledge that I would need if I were to be a specialist in them. It allows you to be many different things. And plurality and complexity are very, very important to me.
Author: Alexander Nehamas

Quote: By heavens! there is something after all in the world allowing one man to steal a horse while another must not look at a halter. Steal a horse straight out. Very well. He has done it. Perhaps he can ride. But there is a way of looking at a halter that would provoke the most charitable of saints into a kick.
Author: Joseph Conrad,  Heart of Darkness

Quote: Putting food under lock and key was one of the great innovations of your culture. No other culture in history has ever put food under lock and key - and putting it there is the cornerstone of your economy.[...] Because if the food wasn't under lock and key, Julie, who would work?
Author: Daniel Quinn

Quote: For the former, activity, any kind of activity, was an end in itself; for the latter, activity was but a progress toward the true end, which was rest, and peace of mind. Action was to be undertaken only when equilibrium was disturbed.
Author: Olaf Stapledon,  Last and First Men

Quote: Let people be the pursuits of happiness, you be the pursuit of perfection.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: Let people be the pursuits of happiness, you be the pursuit of perfection.
Author: Amit Kalantri

Quote: For wordsmiths and masters of words, without necessarily being harsh with words, the words have a tendency to shoot straight to the hearts of people, and this either deeply touches them or deeply angers them. Like the apostles in all their loving controversies are those who are masters of words while combining this gift with truth.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: There's more to logic than identifying logical fallacies.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: A crude age. Peace is stabilized with cannon and bombers, humanity with concentration camps and pogroms. We're living in a time when all standards are turned upside-down, Kern. Today the aggressor is the shepherd of peace, and the beaten and hunted are the troublemakers of the world. What's more, there are whole races who believe it!
Author: Erich Maria Remarque,  Flotsam: A Novel of World War II

Quote: This body is fragile. It is just flesh. Listen to the heartbeat. Life depends on the pumping of a muscle.
Author: Stephen Batchelor,  Buddhism without Beliefs: A Contemporary Guide to Awakening

Quote: There is until there isn’t. That’s just the way it is. Until it isn’t.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  The Titanic would never have sunk if it were made out of a sink.

Quote: The most boring and unproductive question one can ask of any religion is whether or not it is true.
Author: Alain de Botton,  Religion for Atheists: A Non-Believer's Guide to the Uses of Religion

Quote: The line between him and the enemy had simultaneously blurred and solidified. Somehow, while perhaps it shouldn't have, this thought provided a strange sense of peace.
Author: Kristina McMorris,  Bridge of Scarlet Leaves

Quote: The sole remaining task for philosophy is the analysis of language.
Author: Ludwig Wittgenstein

Quote: To question reason is to trust it.
Author: Mitch Stokes

Quote: Hey, I am thinking of it myself, in this part of world (East), we all do endeavors in praying and are sweating (white liquid) and this is our situation, frustrated , but on the other part of world (West) ,they are enjoying in party and drinking liquor (white liquid) but their situation is that, successful, I do not know that the problem relates to the type of liquid or the way of drinking!!
Author: Ali Shariati

Author: Linus Pauling

Author: Ilyas Kassam

Quote: He who writes well runs the civilization. Everyone else does the grunt work.
Author: Kenneth W. Harl

Quote: Nat: Maybe you broke something.Midge: I know. Never fall down, never fall down!Nat: Ah, it's nothing. I fall down every morning. I get up, I have a cup of coffee, I fall down. That's the system. Two years old, you stand up and then BOOM! seventy years later, you fall down again.
Author: Herb Gardner,  I'm Not Rappaport

Quote: Perhaps in his loneliness he had acquired the silent conviction that he was 'the last', the one, the only. And, being the last, he ceased to be Benjamin, becoming Israel. And upon his heart had settled the history of five thousand years, no longer remote, but become as the history of his own lifetime. His "I"was the converse of the imperial "We.
Author: Walter M. Miller Jr.,  A Canticle for Leibowitz

Quote: Life is like a rape. If we cannot resist it, split the legs and enjoy it.
Author: Aaron Lee

Quote: Together, "Light and Knowledge"are Inanimate, Intangible, and Inseparable.
Author: William Bailey,  Great Ship of Knowledge: Learning Earth's Deathly History

Author: William Bailey,  Great Ship of Knowledge: Learning Earth's Deathly History

Quote: For me, writing is immortality. It is wisdom. It is never-ending.
Author: Alecia Stone

Quote: Far from rejecting outright any hierarchy of success or failure, philosophy instead reconfigures the judging process, lending legitimacy to theidea that themainstream value system may unfairly consign some people to disgrace and others to respectability.
Author: Alain de Botton,  Status Anxiety

Quote: As life in general constituted much pain in the form of struggles against poverty, disease, ignorance, and emotional anguish, what more civilized way for people to alleviate the same than by giving themselves to one another as brothers and sisters in deed as well as in word? A society of people hoping to become politically superior needed first to become spiritually valid.
Author: Aberjhani,  The Wisdom of W.E.B. DuBois

Quote: What is this slow blue dream of living, and this fevered death by dreaming?
Author: Aberjhani,  Journey through the Power of the Rainbow: Quotations from a Life Made Out of Poetry

Quote: The pity of it was that this discovery, if such it was, now seemed so stale, so profitless to me. What good was it? What good did thinking ever do?
Author: Jed Rubenfeld,  The Interpretation of Murder

Quote: Standing in the middle between the idea of an event and the actual event, a strange kind of physical reality just in the middle between possibility and reality.
Author: Heisenberg

Quote: Of all knowledge, the wise and good seek mostly to know themselves.
Author: William Shakespeare

Quote: Man in general, if reduced to himself, is too wicked to be free.
Author: Joseph de Maistre

Quote: You can change your mind, don't let your mind change you
Author: Benny Bellamacina

Author: Benny Bellamacina

Author: Doug Dillon

Quote: Compassion is the basis of all morality
Author: Arthur Schopenhauer

Author: Seneca,  Letters from a Stoic

Quote: Good god it's great to be a Bull Mongoni!
Author: James J. Caterino,  Rise of the Bull Mongoni

Author: Kehinde Sonola,  Klosophy

Author: Kehinde Sonola,  Klosophy

Author: Leo Frobenius,  Kulturgeschichte Afrikas

Author: Kshitij Shringi

Not only did it require wrapping different sounds around the very movement of your soul, it involved learning things somehow already known, as though much of what he was somehow existed apart from him. A kind of enlightenment accompanied these first lessons, a deeper understanding of self.
Author: R. Scott Bakker,  The Judging Eye

Quote: What i took away from witnessing the broken climbers in Moshi was this: *Everything is easy until it isn't.*
Author: Josh Gates,  Destination Truth: Memoirs of a Monster Hunter

Author: G.K. Chesterton,  The Superstition of Divorce

Author: Lynda Williams,  Holy war

Author: Elyne Mitchell,  Moon Filly

Author: Lailah Gifty Akita

Author: Joseph Fletcher

Author: Ralph Hodgson

Quote: In the end, only God can see the heart of an individual and distinguish the difference between legalistic deadweight and the passion of holy solemnity.
Author: Criss Jami,  Killosophy

Quote: Sometimes asking God for a reason for something is like asking Him why the sky is blue. There is a complex, scientific reason for it, Claire, but most children, including you, are content with knowing it is blue because it is. If we understood everything about everything, we would have no need for faith.
Author: Susan Meissner,  Why the Sky Is Blue

Author: Margaret Jensen

Quote: You didn’t just automatically become a Christian, did you? You weren’t made a Christian by just going to church. Just like you are not made a car by sitting in a garage all day! You have to make a decision.
Author: Corallie Buchanan,  Watch Out! Godly Women on the Loose

Quote: Faith doesn't always come naturally but as we take those steps of faith, we notice little by little that our faith has grown and it isn't as hard as we first thought.
Author: Jacqueline Winslow

Author: Martha N. Beck

Author: Bethany Brookbank,  Write like no one is reading

Quote: Faith is not knowledge of an object but communion with it.
Author: Nicolás Gómez Dávila

Author: Gordon Lindsay

Quote: God is not someone you meet when you die. His smiling face will be the first and the most familiar to greet you on the other side of mortality. You’ll recognize Him and know in your heart of hearts that you’re not entering a new sphere, but returning home to the place you’ve always belonged.
Author: Toni Sorenson

Quote: Great faith overcomes laws of nature that govern physical world.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: When someone looks at something they don’t understand and they say, “That could be a good thing, or that could be a bad thing,” they’re just highlighting the fact that they have no clue what they are talking about. Everything in the universe, besides God, could be a good or bad thing.
Author: Jarod Kintz,  This Book Has No Title

Author: Scylar Tyberius,  Sebastian the Great

Author: Baxter Clare Trautman,  The River Within

Author: Chimnese Davids,  Muses of Wandering Passions

Author: John Rachel,  A Long Night's Journey Into Daylight

Author: Edenia Archuleta

Quote: Past and Present I know well; each is a friend and sometimes an enemy to me. But it is the quiet, beckoning Future, an absolute stranger, with whom I have fallen madly in love.
Author: Richelle E. Goodrich

Quote: I think at the heart of so much restlessness of the day is a spiritual vacuum. There is a yearning for meaningful lives, a yearning for values we can commonly embrace. I hear an almost inaudible but pervasive discontent with the price we pay for our current materialism. And I hear a fluttering of hope that there might be more to life than bread and circuses.
Author: Bill Moyes

Quote: I had learned that every patient has the right to hope, despite long odds, and it was my role to help nurture that hope.
Author: Jerome Groopman

Quote: ...the best Evil Plan offers something much more for people--a chance to buy into an idea that matters, and share it with people who matter to them.
Author: Hugh MacLeod,  Evil Plans: Having Fun on the Road to World Domination

Author: Joseph Conrad,  Lord Jim

Author: Frederica Mathewes-Green

Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Some are professors and others are possessors.
Author: Lawrence Kennedy

Quote: The greatest hindrance to growth in faith is comfortable living.
Author: John Carey

Quote: He had that sense, or inward prophecy,-- which a young man had better never have been born than not to have, and a mature man had better die at once than utterly to relinquish,-- that we are not doomed to creep on forever in the old bad way, but that, this very now, there are harbingers abroad of a golden era, to be accomplished in his own lifetime.
Author: Nathaniel Hawthorne,  The House of the Seven Gables

Author: Langston Hughes

Quote: ... challenge the church to do better, be more of who Christ wants us to be ...
Author: Justin Lee,  Torn: Rescuing the Gospel from the Gays-vs.-Christians Debate

Quote: Faith is the choice of the nobler hypothesis.' Not the noblest, one never knows what that is. But the nobler, the best one can see when the choice is made.
Author: Robert K. Greenleaf,  Servant As Leader

Quote: The true value of a man is not determined by his possession, supposed or real, of Truth, but rather by his sincere exertion to get to the Truth. It is not possession of the Truth, but rather the pursuit of Truth by which he extends his powers and in which his ever-growing perfectibility is to be found. Possession makes one passive, indolent, and proud.
Author: Gotthold Ephraim Lessing

And as he prayed, he made it clear that our witness as his body in thisfractured , messed-up, chaotic world would depend on our love for another.
Author: Ed Galisewski,  A Simpler Faith: Hope For Those Who Struggle With Church

Quote: Hope is possible, when you decide to believe that what you are hoping for is possible.
Author: Patti Snodgrass

Quote: We are ready to despair too soon, we are ready to say, ‘What’s the good of doing anything?’ Hope is the virtue we should cultivate most in this present day and age.
Author: Agatha Christie

Quote: My true religion, my faith in God. He gives me love and compassion. I simply return them by loving and being compassionate towards others. Our own heart, our own mind, is the temple of God. The teachings of God is to love one another as he loves us. We love by respecting and being compassionate, whatever they decide to do with their life
Author: Ann Marie Aguilar

Quote: I do not know the answers to life's hard questions, but I do know the One who knows them and that's sufficient...for now.
Author: Toni Sorenson

Author: E'yen A. Gardner

Quote: Forget yesterday ... Tomorrow still holds happy surprises for us.
Author: David S. Mark

Quote: Mile by mile, it's a trial; yard by yard, it's hard; but inch by inch, it's a cinch.
Author: Gabrielle Giffords

Quote: The only sweeter than union is reunion.
Author: Kathleen McGowan,  The Poet Prince

Quote: I tried to convince myself once, when I was a teenager, that I felt God. Alone in the sanctuary, accompanying my mom on an evening errand to the church. I stared at the ceiling and drew deep breath as quickly as I could. I told our youth minister in his ball cap that I had felt Him. That I was blessed. But in the end, it was only the wind and the rain, making noise in the darkness.
Author: Darin Bradley,  Noise

Quote: My purpose is: What Lord? Where Lord? When Lord? Yes Lord!
Author: Christine Brooks-Martin

Quote: My purpose is: What Lord? Where Lord? When Lord? Yes Lord!
Author: Christine Brooks-Martin

Quote: I am forever grateful for not knowing—What would have been. WHAT WILL BE holds none of those bittersweet pangs and it is lit w joy.
Author: Erica Goros

Quote: Oh, but I was an idiot. Wanting to be whatever magic she waited for, when I had no magic - only darkness or death to give. But it seemed in that one instant, when she turned to discover what was behind her, that I could have brought happiness to at least one mortal. Me and my dreams of goodness. I had always been a fool for them.
Author: Krisi Keley,  On the Soul of a Vampire

Quote: Our greatest challenge today...is to couple conviction with doubt. By conviction, I mean some pragmatically developed faith, trust, or centeredness; and by doubt I mean openness to the ongoing changeability, mystery, and fallibility of the conviction.
Author: Kirk J. Schneider

Quote: Doubter wants proof which contributes nothing to her faith.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: Promise has faith as premise. Only men of faith can promise.
Author: Toba Beta,  My Ancestor Was an Ancient Astronaut

Quote: God blesses to the degree in which you believe.
Author: Pamela R. Jeffers,  Something Old, New, Borrowed & True
